  const fetchData = useCallback(async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    setActionError("");
    try {
      const [partnersRes, serviceAreasRes, pricingProfilesRes, categoryRulesRes, vehicleRulesRes] = await Promise.all([
        apiFetch("/logistics-partners/"),
        apiFetch("/logistics-partners/service-areas"),
        apiFetch("/logistics-partners/pricing-profiles"),
        apiFetch("/logistics-partners/category-rules"),
        apiFetch("/logistics-partners/vehicle-rules"),
      ]);
      if (!partnersRes.ok) {
        throw new Error("Could not load logistics partners");
      }

      const nextPartners: LogisticsPartner[] = await partnersRes.json();
      const nextAreas: ServiceArea[] = serviceAreasRes.ok ? await serviceAreasRes.json() : [];
        const nextPricingProfiles: PricingProfile[] = pricingProfilesRes.ok ? await pricingProfilesRes.json() : [];
        const nextCategoryRules: CategoryPricingRule[] = categoryRulesRes.ok ? await categoryRulesRes.json() : [];
        const nextVehicleRules: VehicleRule[] = vehicleRulesRes.ok ? await vehicleRulesRes.json() : [];
      setPartners(nextPartners);
      setSelectedPartnerIds((prev) => new Set(Array.from(prev).filter((id) => nextPartners.some((partner) => partner.id === id))));
      setServiceAreas(Array.isArray(nextAreas) ? nextAreas : []);
        setPricingProfiles(Array.isArray(nextPricingProfiles) ? nextPricingProfiles : []);
        setCategoryRules(Array.isArray(nextCategoryRules) ? nextCategoryRules : []);
        setVehicleRules(Array.isArray(nextVehicleRules) ? nextVehicleRules : []);
      setStats({
        total_partners: nextPartners.length,
        active_partners: nextPartners.filter((partner) => partner.status === "active").length,
        approved_profiles: nextPartners.filter((partner) => partner.verification_status === "approved").length,
        pending_profiles: nextPartners.filter((partner) => ["pending", "under_review"].includes(partner.verification_status)).length,
      });
    } catch (error) {
      setActionError(error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Could not load logistics admin data");
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isLoggedIn && canAccessAdminLogisticsPartnerManagement(user?.role)) fetchData();
  }, [fetchData, isLoggedIn, user?.role]);

  useEffect(() => {
    setActiveWorkspace(defaultWorkspace);
  }, [defaultWorkspace]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if ((isWorkspaceVisible("distance") || isWorkspaceVisible("areas")) && !distancesLoading && cityDistances.length === 0) {
      void fetchCityDistances();
    }
  }, [activeWorkspace, cityDistances.length, distancesLoading, fetchCityDistances, isStackedScope, isWorkspaceVisible, scope]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (scope !== "pricing") return;
    setControlPartnerId((current) => {
      if (selectedPartnerId !== "all") return selectedPartnerId;
      if (current && partners.some((partner) => String(partner.id) === current)) return current;
      return partners[0] ? String(partners[0].id) : "";
    });
  }, [scope, selectedPartnerId, partners]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (expandedPartnerId != null && !partners.some((partner) => partner.id === expandedPartnerId)) {
      setExpandedPartnerId(null);
    }
  }, [expandedPartnerId, partners]);

  const partnerAreaCounts = useMemo(() => {
    return serviceAreas.reduce<Record<number, { approved: number; pending: number; rejected: number }>>((accumulator, area) => {
      if (!accumulator[area.partner_id]) {
        accumulator[area.partner_id] = { approved: 0, pending: 0, rejected: 0 };
      }
      if (area.approval_status === "approved") accumulator[area.partner_id].approved += 1;
      else if (area.approval_status === "rejected") accumulator[area.partner_id].rejected += 1;
      else accumulator[area.partner_id].pending += 1;
      return accumulator;
    }, {});
  }, [serviceAreas]);

  const filteredAreas = useMemo(() => {
    let areas = selectedPartnerId === "all" ? serviceAreas : serviceAreas.filter((area) => area.partner_id === Number(selectedPartnerId));
    if (areaStatusFilter !== "all") areas = areas.filter((a) => a.approval_status === areaStatusFilter);
    return areas;
  }, [selectedPartnerId, serviceAreas, areaStatusFilter]);

  const filteredPricingProfiles = useMemo(() => {
    let profiles = selectedPartnerId === "all" ? pricingProfiles : pricingProfiles.filter((profile) => profile.partner_id === Number(selectedPartnerId));
    if (pricingProfileStatusFilter !== "all") profiles = profiles.filter((profile) => profile.approval_status === pricingProfileStatusFilter);
    return profiles;
  }, [selectedPartnerId, pricingProfiles, pricingProfileStatusFilter]);

  const filteredCategoryRules = useMemo(() => {
    let rules = selectedPartnerId === "all" ? categoryRules : categoryRules.filter((rule) => rule.partner_id === Number(selectedPartnerId));
    if (categoryRuleStatusFilter !== "all") rules = rules.filter((rule) => rule.approval_status === categoryRuleStatusFilter);
    return rules;
  }, [selectedPartnerId, categoryRules, categoryRuleStatusFilter]);

  const filteredVehicleRules = useMemo(() => {
    let rules = selectedPartnerId === "all" ? vehicleRules : vehicleRules.filter((rule) => rule.partner_id === Number(selectedPartnerId));
    if (vehicleRuleStatusFilter !== "all") rules = rules.filter((rule) => rule.approval_status === vehicleRuleStatusFilter);
    return rules;
  }, [selectedPartnerId, vehicleRules, vehicleRuleStatusFilter]);

  const filteredCityDistances = useMemo(() => {
    if (selectedPartnerId === "all") return cityDistances;
    const partnerAreaKeys = new Set(
      serviceAreas
        .filter((area) => area.partner_id === Number(selectedPartnerId))
        .map((area) => normalizeGeoKey(area.country_code, area.city_name || area.zone_label || area.country_name)),
    );
    return cityDistances.filter((entry) => (
      partnerAreaKeys.has(normalizeGeoKey(entry.origin_country_code, entry.origin_city_name))
      || partnerAreaKeys.has(normalizeGeoKey(entry.destination_country_code, entry.destination_city_name))
    ));
  }, [cityDistances, selectedPartnerId, serviceAreas]);

  const cityCoordinateLookup = useMemo(() => {
    const lookup = new Map<string, CoverageCityPoint>();
    serviceAreas.forEach((area) => {
      if (!hasCoordinates(area.latitude, area.longitude)) return;
      const latitude = Number(area.latitude);
      const longitude = Number(area.longitude);
      if (typeof latitude !== "number" || typeof longitude !== "number") return;
      const cityKey = normalizeGeoKey(area.country_code, area.city_name || area.zone_label || area.country_name);
      if (!cityKey || lookup.has(cityKey)) return;
      lookup.set(cityKey, {
        key: cityKey,
        label: area.city_name || area.zone_label || area.country_name,
        latitude,
        longitude,
      });
    });
    return lookup;
  }, [serviceAreas]);

  const mappedServiceAreas = useMemo<CoverageReviewPoint[]>(() => filteredAreas.reduce<CoverageReviewPoint[]>((items, area) => {
    if (!hasCoordinates(area.latitude, area.longitude)) return items;
    const latitude = Number(area.latitude);
    const longitude = Number(area.longitude);
    if (typeof latitude !== "number" || typeof longitude !== "number") return items;
    const partner = partners.find((candidate) => candidate.id === area.partner_id);
    items.push({
      id: area.id,
      key: `area-${area.id}`,
      label: area.zone_label || area.city_name || area.country_name,
      latitude,
      longitude,
      approvalStatus: area.approval_status,
      partnerName: partner?.name ?? null,
    });
    return items;
  }, []), [filteredAreas, partners]);

  const routeReviewRows = useMemo<CoverageRouteRow[]>(() => filteredCityDistances.map((entry) => ({
    id: entry.id,
    label: `${entry.origin_city_name} to ${entry.destination_city_name}`,
    distanceKm: entry.distance_km,
    notes: entry.notes,
    origin: cityCoordinateLookup.get(normalizeGeoKey(entry.origin_country_code, entry.origin_city_name)) ?? null,
    destination: cityCoordinateLookup.get(normalizeGeoKey(entry.destination_country_code, entry.destination_city_name)) ?? null,
  })), [cityCoordinateLookup, filteredCityDistances]);

  const unresolvedCoverageRows = useMemo(() => {
    const unresolvedAreas = filteredAreas
      .filter((area) => !hasCoordinates(area.latitude, area.longitude))
      .map((area) => ({
        key: `area-${area.id}`,
        label: area.zone_label || area.city_name || area.country_name,
        detail: "Missing service-area latitude or longitude.",
      }));
    const unresolvedRoutes = routeReviewRows
      .filter((route) => !route.origin || !route.destination)
      .map((route) => ({
        key: `route-${route.id}`,
        label: route.label,
        detail: `${!route.origin ? "Origin" : "Destination"} city has no mapped service-area point yet.`,
      }));
    return [...unresolvedAreas, ...unresolvedRoutes];
  }, [filteredAreas, routeReviewRows]);

  const coverageBoardBounds = useMemo(() => {
    const latitudes: number[] = [];
    const longitudes: number[] = [];
    mappedServiceAreas.forEach((point) => {
      latitudes.push(point.latitude);
      longitudes.push(point.longitude);
    });
    routeReviewRows.forEach((route) => {
      if (route.origin) {
        latitudes.push(route.origin.latitude);
        longitudes.push(route.origin.longitude);
      }
      if (route.destination) {
        latitudes.push(route.destination.latitude);
        longitudes.push(route.destination.longitude);
      }
    });
    if (!latitudes.length || !longitudes.length) return null;
    const minLat = Math.min(...latitudes);
    const maxLat = Math.max(...latitudes);
    const minLng = Math.min(...longitudes);
    const maxLng = Math.max(...longitudes);
    return {
      minLat,
      minLng,
      latSpan: Math.max(maxLat - minLat, 0.01),
      lngSpan: Math.max(maxLng - minLng, 0.01),
    };
  }, [mappedServiceAreas, routeReviewRows]);

  const pendingAreaCount = useMemo(() => serviceAreas.filter((a) => a.approval_status === "pending" || a.approval_status === "under_review").length, [serviceAreas]);
  const pendingPricingProfileCount = useMemo(() => pricingProfiles.filter((profile) => profile.approval_status === "pending" || profile.approval_status === "under_review").length, [pricingProfiles]);
  const pendingCategoryRuleCount = useMemo(() => categoryRules.filter((rule) => rule.approval_status === "pending" || rule.approval_status === "under_review").length, [categoryRules]);
  const pendingVehicleRuleCount = useMemo(() => vehicleRules.filter((rule) => rule.approval_status === "pending" || rule.approval_status === "under_review").length, [vehicleRules]);

  const openAreaEditor = useCallback((area: ServiceArea) => {
    setEditingAreaId(area.id);
    setAdminAreaForm({
      partner_id: String(area.partner_id),
      country_code: area.country_code,
      country_name: area.country_name,
      city_name: area.city_name ?? "",
      zone_label: area.zone_label ?? "",
      latitude: area.latitude != null ? String(area.latitude) : "",
      longitude: area.longitude != null ? String(area.longitude) : "",
      charge_amount: String(area.charge_amount),
      minimum_charge: area.minimum_charge != null ? String(area.minimum_charge) : "",
      per_kg_rate: area.per_kg_rate != null ? String(area.per_kg_rate) : "",
      per_km_rate: area.per_km_rate != null ? String(area.per_km_rate) : "",
      fuel_multiplier: area.fuel_multiplier != null ? String(area.fuel_multiplier) : "",
      pickup_charge: formatMoney(area.pickup_charge) ?? "",
      dropoff_charge: formatMoney(area.dropoff_charge) ?? "",
      currency: area.currency,
      delivery_days_min: area.delivery_days_min != null ? String(area.delivery_days_min) : "",
      delivery_days_max: area.delivery_days_max != null ? String(area.delivery_days_max) : "",
      is_active: area.is_active,
    });
    setAreaFormError("");
    setShowAreaForm(true);
  }, []);

  const openProfileEditor = useCallback((pricingProfile: PricingProfile) => {
    setEditingProfileId(pricingProfile.id);
    setAdminProfileForm({
      partner_id: String(pricingProfile.partner_id),
      service_area_id: pricingProfile.service_area_id != null ? String(pricingProfile.service_area_id) : "",
      profile_name: pricingProfile.profile_name ?? "",
      base_in_city_fee: pricingProfile.base_in_city_fee != null ? String(pricingProfile.base_in_city_fee) : "",
      base_inter_city_fee: pricingProfile.base_inter_city_fee != null ? String(pricingProfile.base_inter_city_fee) : "",
      per_km_rate: pricingProfile.per_km_rate != null ? String(pricingProfile.per_km_rate) : "",
      per_kg_rate: pricingProfile.per_kg_rate != null ? String(pricingProfile.per_kg_rate) : "",
      minimum_charge: pricingProfile.minimum_charge != null ? String(pricingProfile.minimum_charge) : "",
      maximum_charge: pricingProfile.maximum_charge != null ? String(pricingProfile.maximum_charge) : "",
      fuel_multiplier: pricingProfile.fuel_multiplier != null ? String(pricingProfile.fuel_multiplier) : "",
      bulk_discount_threshold_kg: pricingProfile.bulk_discount_threshold_kg != null ? String(pricingProfile.bulk_discount_threshold_kg) : "",
      bulk_discount_percent: pricingProfile.bulk_discount_percent != null ? String(pricingProfile.bulk_discount_percent) : "",
      currency: pricingProfile.currency,
      is_active: pricingProfile.is_active,
    });
    setProfileFormError("");
    setShowProfileForm(true);
  }, []);

  const openCategoryRuleEditor = useCallback((rule: CategoryPricingRule) => {
    const handlingAmount = Math.max(Number(rule.flat_fee_override ?? 0), Number(rule.special_handling_fee ?? 0));
    setEditingCatRuleId(rule.id);
    setAdminCatRuleForm({
      partner_id: String(rule.partner_id),
      service_area_id: rule.service_area_id != null ? String(rule.service_area_id) : "",
      category_name: rule.category_name,
      flat_fee_override: "",
      special_handling_fee: handlingAmount > 0 ? String(handlingAmount) : "",
      currency: rule.currency,
      is_active: rule.is_active,
    });
    setCatRuleFormError("");
    setShowCatRuleForm(true);
  }, []);

  const openVehicleRuleEditor = useCallback((rule: VehicleRule) => {
    setEditingVehRuleId(rule.id);

      service_area_id: rule.service_area_id != null ? String(rule.service_area_id) : "",
      vehicle_type: rule.vehicle_type,
      route_scope: rule.route_scope,
      max_weight_kg: rule.max_weight_kg != null ? String(rule.max_weight_kg) : "",
      max_volume_cm3: rule.max_volume_cm3 != null ? String(rule.max_volume_cm3) : "",
      cost_multiplier: String(rule.cost_multiplier),
      priority_rank: String(rule.priority_rank),
      is_active: rule.is_active,
    });
    setVehRuleFormError("");
    setShowVehRuleForm(true);
  }, []);

  const openDistanceEditor = useCallback((entry: CityDistance) => {
    setEditingDistanceId(entry.id);
    setDistanceForm({
      origin_country_code: entry.origin_country_code,
      origin_city_name: entry.origin_city_name,

      destination_city_name: entry.destination_city_name,
      distance_km: String(entry.distance_km),
      notes: entry.notes || "",
    });
  }, []);

  const partnerColumns = useMemo<Array<EnterpriseColumn<LogisticsPartner>>>(() => [
    {
      key: "partner",
      label: "Partner",
      sortable: true,
      sortValue: (partner) => partner.name,
      searchValue: (partner) => [partner.name, partner.code, partner.linked_user_email, partner.linked_username].filter(Boolean).join(" "),
      render: (partner) => (
        <div className="space-y-1">
          <p className="font-semibold text-text">{partner.name}</p>
          <p className="font-mono text-[11px] text-text-muted">{partner.code}</p>
          {partner.linked_user_email ? <p className="text-[11px] text-text-muted">Portal user: {partner.linked_user_email}</p> : null}
        </div>
      ),
    },
    {
      key: "contact",
      label: "Contact",
      searchValue: (partner) => [partner.contact_name, partner.contact_email, partner.contact_phone].filter(Boolean).join(" "),
      render: (partner) => (
        <div className="space-y-1 text-xs text-text-muted">
          <p className="font-medium text-text">{partner.contact_name || "No contact name"}</p>

          <p>{partner.contact_phone || "No phone"}</p>
        </div>
      ),
    },

          <p className="line-clamp-2 max-w-xs">{partner.address || partner.bio || "No location or bio submitted yet."}</p>
        </div>

        </span>

    },
  ], []);
  const unresolvedCoverageColumns = useMemo<Array<EnterpriseColumn<{ key: string; label: string; detail: string }>>>(() => [
    {

      sortable: true,

  const areaColumns = useMemo<Array<EnterpriseColumn<ServiceArea>>>(() => [

              <span className="font-semibold text-text">{area.zone_label || area.city_name || area.country_name}</span>
            </div>
            <p className="mt-1 text-[11px] text-text-muted">{partner?.name || `Partner #${area.partner_id}`}</p>
          </div>
        );
      },
    },
    {
      key: "location",
      label: "Location",
      searchValue: (area) => `${area.city_name || ""} ${area.country_name} ${area.country_code}`,

  const pricingProfileColumns = useMemo<Array<EnterpriseColumn<PricingProfile>>>(() => [

  const categoryRuleColumns = useMemo<Array<EnterpriseColumn<CategoryPricingRule>>>(() => [
    {
      key: "category_name",
      label: "Rule",
      sortable: true,
      sortValue: (rule) => rule.category_name,
      searchValue: (rule) => `${rule.category_name} ${rule.currency}`,
      render: (rule) => {

        return (
          <div>
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
              <span className={`rounded-lg px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-semibold ${STATUS_CHIP[rule.approval_status] ?? "theme-chip-muted"}`}>{formatStatusLabel(rule.approval_status)}</span>
              <span className="font-semibold text-text">{rule.category_name}</span>
            </div>
            <p className="mt-1 text-[11px] text-text-muted">{partner?.name || `Partner #${rule.partner_id}`}</p>
          </div>
        );
      },
    },
    {
      key: "scope",
      label: "Scope",
      searchValue: (rule) => `${rule.service_area_id || ""}`,
      render: (rule) => {
        const serviceArea = serviceAreas.find((area) => area.id === rule.service_area_id);
        return <span className="text-text-muted">{serviceArea ? `Targets ${serviceArea.zone_label || serviceArea.city_name || serviceArea.country_name}` : "All service areas"}</span>;
      },
    },
    {
      key: "fees",
      label: "Fees",
      searchValue: (rule) => describeCategoryRule(rule),
      render: (rule) => <span className="text-text-muted">{describeCategoryRule(rule)}</span>,
    },
  ], [describeCategoryRule, partners, serviceAreas]);
  const vehicleRuleColumns = useMemo<Array<EnterpriseColumn<VehicleRule>>>(() => [
    {
      key: "vehicle_type",
      label: "Load-fit Rule",
      sortable: true,
      sortValue: (rule) => rule.vehicle_type,
      searchValue: (rule) => `${rule.vehicle_type} ${rule.route_scope}`,
      render: (rule) => {
        const partner = partners.find((candidate) => candidate.id === rule.partner_id);
        return (
          <div>
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
              <span className={`rounded-lg px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-semibold ${STATUS_CHIP[rule.approval_status] ?? "theme-chip-muted"}`}>{formatStatusLabel(rule.approval_status)}</span>
              <span className="font-semibold text-text">{rule.vehicle_type}</span>
            </div>
            <p className="mt-1 text-[11px] text-text-muted">{partner?.name || `Partner #${rule.partner_id}`}</p>
          </div>
        );
      },
    },
    {
      key: "scope",
      label: "Scope",
      searchValue: (rule) => `${rule.route_scope} ${rule.service_area_id || ""}`,
      render: (rule) => {
        const serviceArea = serviceAreas.find((area) => area.id === rule.service_area_id);
        return <span className="text-text-muted">{serviceArea ? `Targets ${serviceArea.zone_label || serviceArea.city_name || serviceArea.country_name}` : "All service areas"} · {rule.route_scope.replace(/_/g, " ")}</span>;

    {
      key: "limits",
      label: "Limits",
      searchValue: (rule) => `${rule.max_weight_kg || ""} ${rule.max_volume_cm3 || ""} ${rule.cost_multiplier} ${rule.priority_rank}`,
      render: (rule) => <span className="text-text-muted">{rule.max_weight_kg != null ? `up to ${rule.max_weight_kg}kg` : "No weight cap"}{rule.max_volume_cm3 != null ? ` · ${rule.max_volume_cm3}cm3` : ""}{` · legacy x${rule.cost_multiplier} · priority ${rule.priority_rank}`}</span>,
    },
  ], [partners, serviceAreas]);
  const distanceColumns = useMemo<Array<EnterpriseColumn<CityDistance>>>(() => [
    {
      key: "origin_city_name",

    },
    {
      key: "destination_city_name",

      sortValue: (entry) => `${entry.destination_country_code}-${entry.destination_city_name}`,

      render: (entry) => <span className="font-semibold text-text">{entry.destination_country_code} / {entry.destination_city_name}</span>,

    {
      key: "distance_km",

  const controlApprovedAreas = useMemo(() => {
    if (!controlPartnerId) return [] as ServiceArea[];
    return serviceAreas.filter(
      (area) => area.partner_id === Number(controlPartnerId) && area.approval_status === "approved" && area.is_active,
    );
  }, [controlPartnerId, serviceAreas]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (scope !== "pricing") return;
    setControlServiceAreaId((current) => {
      if (current && controlApprovedAreas.some((area) => String(area.id) === current)) return current;
      return controlApprovedAreas[0] ? String(controlApprovedAreas[0].id) : "";
    });
  }, [scope, controlApprovedAreas]);

  const controlArea = useMemo(() => {
    if (!controlServiceAreaId) return null;
    return controlApprovedAreas.find((area) => area.id === Number(controlServiceAreaId)) ?? null;
  }, [controlApprovedAreas, controlServiceAreaId]);

  const controlApprovedProfiles = useMemo(() => {
    if (!controlPartnerId) return [] as PricingProfile[];
    return pricingProfiles.filter(
      (profile) => profile.partner_id === Number(controlPartnerId) && profile.approval_status === "approved" && profile.is_active,
    );
  }, [controlPartnerId, pricingProfiles]);

  const controlProfile = useMemo(() => {
    const scopedAreaId = controlServiceAreaId ? Number(controlServiceAreaId) : null;
    return controlApprovedProfiles.find((profile) => profile.service_area_id === scopedAreaId)
      ?? controlApprovedProfiles.find((profile) => profile.service_area_id == null)
      ?? null;
  }, [controlApprovedProfiles, controlServiceAreaId]);

  const controlCategoryOptions = useMemo(() => {
    if (!controlPartnerId) return [] as Array<{ key: string; rule: CategoryPricingRule }>;
    const scopedAreaId = controlServiceAreaId ? Number(controlServiceAreaId) : null;
    const candidates = categoryRules
      .filter(
        (rule) => rule.partner_id === Number(controlPartnerId)
          && rule.approval_status === "approved"
          && rule.is_active
          && (rule.service_area_id == null || rule.service_area_id === scopedAreaId),
      )
      .sort((left, right) => {
        const leftPriority = left.service_area_id === scopedAreaId ? 0 : 1;
        const rightPriority = right.service_area_id === scopedAreaId ? 0 : 1;
        if (leftPriority !== rightPriority) return leftPriority - rightPriority;
        return left.category_name.localeCompare(right.category_name);
      });

    const deduped = new Map<string, CategoryPricingRule>();
    candidates.forEach((rule) => {
      const key = normalizeControlKey(rule.category_name);
      if (key && !deduped.has(key)) deduped.set(key, rule);
    });
    return Array.from(deduped.entries()).map(([key, rule]) => ({ key, rule }));
  }, [categoryRules, controlPartnerId, controlServiceAreaId]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const allowedKeys = new Set(controlCategoryOptions.map((option) => option.key));
    setCalculatorForm((current) => {
      const selectedCategories = current.selectedCategories.filter((categoryKey) => allowedKeys.has(categoryKey));
      if (!selectedCategories.length && controlCategoryOptions.length > 0) {
        return { ...current, selectedCategories: [controlCategoryOptions[0].key] };
      }
      if (selectedCategories.length === current.selectedCategories.length) return current;
      return { ...current, selectedCategories };
    });
  }, [controlCategoryOptions]);

  const selectedCategoryRules = useMemo(
    () => controlCategoryOptions.filter((option) => calculatorForm.selectedCategories.includes(option.key)).map((option) => option.rule),
    [calculatorForm.selectedCategories, controlCategoryOptions],
  );

  const calculatorBreakdown = useMemo(() => {
    const routeType = calculatorForm.routeType;
    const weightKg = Math.max(Number(calculatorForm.weightKg) || 0, 0);
    const distanceKm = routeType === "inter_city" ? Math.max(Number(calculatorForm.distanceKm) || 0, 0) : 0;
    const pickupCount = Math.max(Number(calculatorForm.pickupCount) || 1, 1);
    const dropoffCount = Math.max(Number(calculatorForm.dropoffCount) || 1, 1);
    const extraPickupCount = Math.max(pickupCount - 1, 0);
    const extraDropoffCount = Math.max(dropoffCount - 1, 0);

    const baseFee = roundCharge(routeType === "in_city"
      ? Number(controlProfile?.base_in_city_fee ?? controlArea?.charge_amount ?? 0)
      : Number(controlProfile?.base_inter_city_fee ?? controlArea?.charge_amount ?? 0));
    const perKgRate = Number(controlProfile?.per_kg_rate ?? controlArea?.per_kg_rate ?? 0);
    const perKmRate = routeType === "inter_city" ? Number(controlProfile?.per_km_rate ?? controlArea?.per_km_rate ?? 0) : 0;
    const pickupRate = Number(controlArea?.pickup_charge ?? 0);
    const dropoffRate = Number(controlArea?.dropoff_charge ?? 0);
    const fuelMultiplier = Number(controlProfile?.fuel_multiplier ?? controlArea?.fuel_multiplier ?? 1);
    const minimumCharge = controlProfile?.minimum_charge ?? controlArea?.minimum_charge ?? null;
    const maximumCharge = controlProfile?.maximum_charge ?? null;
    const weightFee = roundCharge(weightKg * perKgRate);
    const distanceFee = roundCharge(distanceKm * perKmRate);
    const pickupFee = roundCharge(extraPickupCount * pickupRate);
    const dropoffFee = roundCharge(extraDropoffCount * dropoffRate);
    const appliedCategoryRule = selectedCategoryRules.reduce<{ rule: CategoryPricingRule | null; total: number }>((current, rule) => {
      const total = roundCharge(Math.max(Number(rule.flat_fee_override ?? 0), Number(rule.special_handling_fee ?? 0)));
      if (!current.rule || total > current.total) {
        return { rule, total };
      }
      return current;
    }, { rule: null, total: 0 });
    const categoryTotal = appliedCategoryRule.total;
    const subtotal = roundCharge(baseFee + weightFee + distanceFee + pickupFee + dropoffFee + categoryTotal);
    const fuelAdjusted = roundCharge(subtotal * fuelMultiplier);
    const minimumChargeApplied = minimumCharge != null && fuelAdjusted < minimumCharge;
    const afterMinimum = minimumChargeApplied ? roundCharge(Number(minimumCharge)) : fuelAdjusted;
    const maximumChargeApplied = maximumCharge != null && maximumCharge > 0 && afterMinimum > maximumCharge;
    const finalCharge = maximumChargeApplied ? roundCharge(Number(maximumCharge)) : afterMinimum;

    return {
      routeType,
      pickupCount,
      dropoffCount,
      extraPickupCount,
      extraDropoffCount,
      baseFee,
      perKgRate,
      perKmRate,
      pickupRate,
      dropoffRate,
      weightFee,
      distanceFee,
      pickupFee,
      dropoffFee,
      categoryTotal,
      appliedCategoryRule: appliedCategoryRule.rule,
      subtotal,
      fuelMultiplier,
      fuelAdjusted,
      minimumCharge,
      maximumCharge,
      minimumChargeApplied,
      maximumChargeApplied,
      finalCharge,
    };
  }, [calculatorForm, controlArea, controlProfile, selectedCategoryRules]);

  if (authLoading) return <div className="space-y-3">{Array.from({ length: 3 }).map((_, i) => <div key={i} className="h-16 animate-pulse rounded-xl bg-surface-2" />)}</div>;

  const openCreate = () => {
    setActiveWorkspace("partners");
    setEditingId(null);
    setForm(BLANK_FORM);
    setSaveError("");
    setShowForm(true);
  };

  const openEdit = (partner: LogisticsPartner) => {
    setActiveWorkspace("partners");
    setEditingId(partner.id);
    setForm({
      name: partner.name,
      code: partner.code,
      contact_name: partner.contact_name ?? "",
      contact_email: partner.contact_email ?? "",
      contact_phone: partner.contact_phone ?? "",
      website: partner.website ?? "",
      status: partner.status,
      coverage_regions: (partner.coverage_regions ?? []).join(", "),
      service_types: (partner.service_types ?? []).join(", "),
      linked_user_email: partner.linked_user_email ?? "",
      country: partner.country ?? "",
      city: partner.city ?? "",
      address: partner.address ?? "",
      bio: partner.bio ?? "",
      verification_note: partner.verification_note ?? "",
    });
    setSaveError("");
    setShowForm(true);
  };

  const handleSave = async (event: React.FormEvent) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    setSaveError("");
    if (!form.name.trim() || !form.code.trim()) {
      setSaveError("Name and code are required");
      return;
    }
    setSaving(true);
    try {
      const body = {
        ...form,
        coverage_regions: form.coverage_regions.split(",").map((value) => value.trim()).filter(Boolean),
        service_types: form.service_types.split(",").map((value) => value.trim()).filter(Boolean),
        linked_user_email: form.linked_user_email.trim() || null,
      };
      const url = editingId ? `/logistics-partners/${editingId}` : "/logistics-partners/";
      const method = editingId ? "PUT" : "POST";
      const response = await apiFetch(url, {
        method,
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify(body),
      });
      if (!response.ok) {
        const payload = await response.json().catch(() => ({}));
        throw new Error(payload.detail || "Save failed");
      }
      await fetchData();
      setActiveWorkspace("partners");
      setShowForm(false);
      setEditingId(null);
      setActionMessage(editingId ? "Partner updated." : "Partner created.");
    } catch (error) {
      setSaveError(error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Network error");
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  };

  const handleReviewProfile = async (partnerId: number, status: "approved" | "rejected") => {
    setReviewingKey(`profile-${partnerId}-${status}`);
    setActionError("");
    setActionMessage("");
    try {
      const response = await apiFetch(`/logistics-partners/review/profile/${partnerId}`, {
        method: "POST",

      });
      if (!response.ok) {
        const payload = await response.json().catch(() => ({}));
        throw new Error(payload.detail || "Could not review partner profile");
      }
      await fetchData();
      setActionMessage(`Profile ${status}.`);
    } catch (error) {
      setActionError(error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Could not review partner profile");
    } finally {

  };

  const handleTogglePartnerStatus = async (partner: LogisticsPartner) => {

  const handleDeletePartner = async (partner: LogisticsPartner) => {
    if (!confirm(`Delete ${partner.name}? This removes the logistics partner record.`)) {
      return;
    }
    setDeleteActionId(partner.id);
    setActionError("");
    setActionMessage("");
    try {
      const response = await apiFetch(`/logistics-partners/${partner.id}`, { method: "DELETE" });
      if (!response.ok) {
        const payload = await response.json().catch(() => ({}));
        throw new Error(payload.detail || "Could not delete logistics partner");
      }
      await fetchData();
      setActionMessage("Partner deleted.");
    } catch (error) {
      setActionError(error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Could not delete logistics partner");
    } finally {
      setDeleteActionId(null);
    }
  };

  const handleBulkPartnerAction = async (action: "approve" | "reject" | "activate" | "suspend" | "delete") => {
    const partnerIds = Array.from(selectedPartnerIds);
    if (!partnerIds.length) return;
    if (action === "delete" && !confirm(`Delete ${partnerIds.length} logistics partner record(s)?`)) {
      return;
    }

    setBulkLoading(true);
    setActionError("");
    setActionMessage("");
    try {
      const response = await apiFetch("/logistics-partners/bulk", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ partner_ids: partnerIds, action }),
      });
      const payload = await response.json().catch(() => ({}));
      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error(payload.detail || "Could not process logistics partner bulk action");
      }
      await fetchData();
      setSelectedPartnerIds(new Set());
      setActionMessage(`${payload.processed ?? partnerIds.length} partner(s) processed.`);
    } catch (error) {
      setActionError(error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Could not process logistics partner bulk action");
    } finally {
      setBulkLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const totalPendingReviews = pendingAreaCount + pendingPricingProfileCount + pendingCategoryRuleCount + pendingVehicleRuleCount;

                  : status === "rejected"

  };

  const openSelectedProfileEditor = () => {
    setShowProfileForm(true);
    setProfileFormError("");
    if (controlProfile) {
      setEditingProfileId(controlProfile.id);
      setAdminProfileForm({
        partner_id: String(controlProfile.partner_id),
        service_area_id: controlProfile.service_area_id != null ? String(controlProfile.service_area_id) : "",
        profile_name: controlProfile.profile_name ?? "",
        base_in_city_fee: controlProfile.base_in_city_fee != null ? String(controlProfile.base_in_city_fee) : "",
        base_inter_city_fee: controlProfile.base_inter_city_fee != null ? String(controlProfile.base_inter_city_fee) : "",
        per_km_rate: controlProfile.per_km_rate != null ? String(controlProfile.per_km_rate) : "",
        per_kg_rate: controlProfile.per_kg_rate != null ? String(controlProfile.per_kg_rate) : "",
        minimum_charge: controlProfile.minimum_charge != null ? String(controlProfile.minimum_charge) : "",
        maximum_charge: controlProfile.maximum_charge != null ? String(controlProfile.maximum_charge) : "",
        fuel_multiplier: controlProfile.fuel_multiplier != null ? String(controlProfile.fuel_multiplier) : "",
        bulk_discount_threshold_kg: controlProfile.bulk_discount_threshold_kg != null ? String(controlProfile.bulk_discount_threshold_kg) : "",
        bulk_discount_percent: controlProfile.bulk_discount_percent != null ? String(controlProfile.bulk_discount_percent) : "",

        is_active: controlProfile.is_active,
      });
      return;
    }

    setEditingProfileId(null);
    setAdminProfileForm({
      ...BLANK_PROFILE_FORM,
      partner_id: controlPartnerId,
      service_area_id: controlServiceAreaId,
    });
  };

  return (
      <>
      <div className="space-y-6">
        {scope === "full" ? (
        <section className="theme-card rounded-xl border p-3">
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-end gap-2">
            <button onClick={openCreate} className="theme-btn-primary flex items-center gap-2 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-xs font-semibold">
              <Plus className="h-4 w-4" />Add Partner
            </button>
            <button
              onClick={() => setActiveWorkspace("distance")}
              className="rounded-lg border border-border bg-surface-2 px-3 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-text-muted transition-colors hover:text-text"
            >
              Open Distance Matrix
            </button>
            <button
              onClick={fetchData}
              disabled={loading}
              className="flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg border border-border bg-surface-2 px-3 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-text-muted hover:text-text disabled:opacity-50"
            >
              <RefreshCw className={`h-3.5 w-3.5 ${loading ? "animate-spin" : ""}`} />
              Refresh Data
            </button>
          </div>

          {actionMessage ? <div className="mt-3 rounded-xl border border-success/30 bg-success/10 px-4 py-3 text-xs text-success">{actionMessage}</div> : null}
          {actionError ? <div className="mt-3 rounded-xl border border-danger/30 bg-danger/10 px-4 py-3 text-xs text-danger">{actionError}</div> : null}

          {stats ? (
            <div className="mt-3 grid gap-2 md:grid-cols-4">
              {[
                { label: "Total Partners", value: stats.total_partners, chip: "theme-chip-info" },
                { label: "Active Portals", value: stats.active_partners, chip: "theme-chip-success" },
                { label: "Approved Profiles", value: stats.approved_profiles, chip: "theme-chip-success" },
                { label: "Pending Review", value: totalPendingReviews, chip: "theme-chip-warning" },
              ].map(({ label, value, chip }) => (
                <div key={label} className="rounded-lg border border-border bg-surface-2 px-3 py-2.5">
                  <span className={`rounded-lg px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold ${chip}`}>{label}</span>
                  <p className="mt-2 text-lg font-bold text-text">{value}</p>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          ) : null}
        </section>
        ) : null}

        {scope !== "full" && scopedHeader ? (
          <section className="theme-card rounded-xl border p-3">
            <div className="flex flex-col gap-2 lg:flex-row lg:items-center lg:justify-between">
              <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 text-xs text-text-muted">
                <span className="rounded-lg border border-border bg-surface-2 px-2 py-1 text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.16em] text-text-faint">
                  {scopedHeader.eyebrow}
                </span>
                <span className="font-semibold text-text">{scopedHeader.title}</span>
                <span className="hidden text-text-faint xl:inline">{scopedHeader.description}</span>
              </div>
              <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                {scope === "partners" ? (
                  <button onClick={openCreate} className="theme-btn-primary flex items-center gap-2 rounded-xl px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold">
                    <Plus className="h-4 w-4" />Add Partner
                  </button>
                ) : null}
                <button
                  onClick={fetchData}
                  disabled={loading}
                  className="flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface-2 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-text-muted hover:text-text disabled:opacity-50"
                >
                  <RefreshCw className={`h-3.5 w-3.5 ${loading ? "animate-spin" : ""}`} />
                  Refresh Data
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
            {actionMessage ? <div className="mt-3 rounded-xl border border-success/30 bg-success/10 px-4 py-3 text-xs text-success">{actionMessage}</div> : null}
            {actionError ? <div className="mt-3 rounded-xl border border-danger/30 bg-danger/10 px-4 py-3 text-xs text-danger">{actionError}</div> : null}
          </section>
        ) : null}

        {scope === "pricing" ? (
          <section className="theme-card rounded-xl border p-3">
            <div className="flex flex-col gap-3 xl:flex-row xl:items-start xl:justify-between">
              <div>
                <p className="text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.18em] text-text-faint">Cost Drivers</p>
                <h2 className="mt-1 text-sm font-bold text-text">ZOZI logistics pricing control</h2>
                <p className="mt-1 text-[11px] text-text-muted">Pick a partner and approved service area, inspect the active charges, and test the simplified if-else formula before editing the queues below.</p>
              </div>
              <div className="grid gap-2 sm:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-4">
                <label className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-text-muted">
                  Rate Card Filter
                  <select value={selectedPartnerId} onChange={(event) => setSelectedPartnerId(event.target.value)} className="theme-input mt-1 w-full rounded-xl border px-3 py-2 text-xs">
                    <option value="all">All rate cards</option>
                    {partners.map((partner) => (
                      <option key={partner.id} value={String(partner.id)}>{partner.name}</option>
                    ))}
                  </select>
                </label>
                <label className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-text-muted">
                  Partner
                  <select value={controlPartnerId} onChange={(event) => setControlPartnerId(event.target.value)} className="theme-input mt-1 w-full rounded-xl border px-3 py-2 text-xs">
                    <option value="">Select partner</option>
                    {partners.map((partner) => (
                      <option key={partner.id} value={String(partner.id)}>{partner.name}</option>
                    ))}
                  </select>
                </label>
                <label className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-text-muted">
                  Service Area
                  <select value={controlServiceAreaId} onChange={(event) => setControlServiceAreaId(event.target.value)} className="theme-input mt-1 w-full rounded-xl border px-3 py-2 text-xs" disabled={!controlApprovedAreas.length}>
                    {!controlApprovedAreas.length ? <option value="">No approved areas</option> : null}
                    {controlApprovedAreas.map((area) => (
                      <option key={area.id} value={String(area.id)}>{area.zone_label || area.city_name || area.country_name}</option>
                    ))}
                  </select>
                </label>
                <button onClick={openSelectedProfileEditor} disabled={!controlPartnerId} className="theme-btn-secondary mt-5 rounded-xl border px-3 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-text-muted disabled:opacity-50">
                  {controlProfile ? "Edit Selected Profile" : "Create Profile"}
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>

            {actionMessage ? <div className="mt-3 rounded-xl border border-success/30 bg-success/10 px-4 py-3 text-xs text-success">{actionMessage}</div> : null}
            {actionError ? <div className="mt-3 rounded-xl border border-danger/30 bg-danger/10 px-4 py-3 text-xs text-danger">{actionError}</div> : null}

            {!controlPartnerId ? (
              <div className="mt-4 rounded-xl border border-dashed border-border px-4 py-8 text-center text-xs text-text-muted">Select a logistics partner to load approved service areas, compatibility controls, and the live calculator.</div>
            ) : !controlArea ? (
              <div className="mt-4 rounded-xl border border-dashed border-border px-4 py-8 text-center text-xs text-text-muted">This partner has no approved service area yet. Approve a route first so the pricing control can load real charge inputs.</div>
            ) : !controlProfile ? (
              <div className="mt-4 rounded-xl border border-dashed border-border px-4 py-8 text-center text-xs text-text-muted">No approved pricing profile is available for the selected area. Create or approve a pricing profile to activate the live control widget.</div>
            ) : (
              <div className="mt-4 grid gap-4 2xl:grid-cols-[1.1fr_0.9fr]">
                <div className="grid gap-4 xl:grid-cols-2">
                  <section className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface-2 p-4">
                    <p className="text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.16em] text-text-faint">Rate Card Inputs</p>
                    <div className="mt-3 grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2">
                      <div className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface p-3">
                        <p className="text-xs font-bold text-text">In-City</p>
                        <p className="mt-2 text-[11px] text-text-muted">Base Fee: {controlProfile.base_in_city_fee != null ? `${controlProfile.base_in_city_fee.toFixed(2)} ${controlProfile.currency}` : "Not set"}</p>
                        <p className="mt-1 text-[11px] text-text-muted">Per-Kg: {controlProfile.per_kg_rate != null ? `${controlProfile.per_kg_rate.toFixed(2)} ${controlProfile.currency}/kg` : "0.00"}</p>
                      </div>
                      <div className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface p-3">
                        <p className="text-xs font-bold text-text">Inter-City</p>
                        <p className="mt-2 text-[11px] text-text-muted">Base Fee: {controlProfile.base_inter_city_fee != null ? `${controlProfile.base_inter_city_fee.toFixed(2)} ${controlProfile.currency}` : "Not set"}</p>
                        <p className="mt-1 text-[11px] text-text-muted">Per-Km: {controlProfile.per_km_rate != null && controlProfile.per_km_rate > 0 ? `${controlProfile.per_km_rate.toFixed(2)} ${controlProfile.currency}/km` : "Flat rate only"}</p>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </section>

                  <section className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface-2 p-4">
                    <p className="text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.16em] text-text-faint">Extra Stop Charges</p>
                    <div className="mt-3 space-y-2 text-[11px] text-text-muted">
                      <div className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface p-3">
                        <p className="font-semibold text-text">Pickups</p>
                        <p className="mt-1">1st pickup is included. Each additional stop adds {(controlArea.pickup_charge ?? 0).toFixed(2)} {controlArea.currency}.</p>
                      </div>
                      <div className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface p-3">
                        <p className="font-semibold text-text">Drop-offs</p>
                        <p className="mt-1">1st drop-off is included. Each additional stop adds {(controlArea.dropoff_charge ?? 0).toFixed(2)} {controlArea.currency}.</p>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </section>

                  <section className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface-2 p-4 xl:col-span-2">
                    <p className="text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.16em] text-text-faint">Highest Handling Rule</p>
                    {controlCategoryOptions.length === 0 ? (
                      <div className="mt-3 rounded-xl border border-dashed border-border px-4 py-6 text-center text-xs text-text-muted">No approved handling rules for this area yet. The calculator will apply the single highest approved handling amount once one exists.</div>
                    ) : (
                      <div className="mt-3 space-y-3">
                        <div className="rounded-xl border border-primary/20 bg-primary/5 px-3 py-2 text-[11px] text-text-muted">
                          If more than one handling rule matches, the calculator uses only the single highest approved handling amount.
                        </div>
                        <div className="overflow-x-auto">
                        <table className="w-full text-[11px]">
                          <thead>
                            <tr className="border-b border-border text-left text-text-faint">
                              <th className="pb-2 pr-3 font-semibold">Category</th>
                              <th className="pb-2 pr-3 font-semibold">Handling Amount</th>
                              <th className="pb-2 font-semibold">Runtime Behavior</th>
                            </tr>
                          </thead>
                          <tbody className="divide-y divide-border">
                            {controlCategoryOptions.map(({ key, rule }) => (
                              <tr key={key}>
                                <td className="py-2 pr-3 font-medium text-text">{rule.category_name}</td>
                                <td className="py-2 pr-3 text-text-muted">{Math.max(Number(rule.flat_fee_override ?? 0), Number(rule.special_handling_fee ?? 0)).toFixed(2)} {rule.currency}</td>
                                <td className="py-2 text-text-muted">Highest match wins</td>
                              </tr>
                            ))}
                          </tbody>
                        </table>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </section>

                  <section className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface-2 p-4 xl:col-span-2">
                    <p className="text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.16em] text-text-faint">Compatibility Controls</p>
                    <div className="mt-3 grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-4">
                      <div className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface p-3">
                        <p className="text-xs font-bold text-text">Floor Charge</p>
                        <p className="mt-2 text-lg font-bold text-text">{calculatorBreakdown.minimumCharge != null ? `${Number(calculatorBreakdown.minimumCharge).toFixed(2)} ${controlProfile.currency}` : "None"}</p>
                      </div>
                      <div className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface p-3">
                        <p className="text-xs font-bold text-text">Ceiling Charge</p>
                        <p className="mt-2 text-lg font-bold text-text">{calculatorBreakdown.maximumCharge != null ? `${Number(calculatorBreakdown.maximumCharge).toFixed(2)} ${controlProfile.currency}` : "None"}</p>
                      </div>
                      <div className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface p-3">
                        <p className="text-xs font-bold text-text">Runtime Surcharge Factor</p>
                        <p className="mt-2 text-lg font-bold text-text">x{calculatorBreakdown.fuelMultiplier.toFixed(2)}</p>
                      </div>
                      <div className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface p-3">
                        <p className="text-xs font-bold text-text">Area Split</p>
                        <p className="mt-2 text-[11px] text-text-muted">Pickup {(controlArea.pickup_charge ?? 0).toFixed(2)} / Drop-off {(controlArea.dropoff_charge ?? 0).toFixed(2)} {controlArea.currency}</p>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </section>
                </div>

                <section className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface-2 p-4">
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
                    <div>
                      <p className="text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.16em] text-text-faint">Live Calculator</p>
                      <h3 className="mt-1 text-sm font-bold text-text">Test the weight-first formula</h3>
                    </div>
                    <button onClick={scrollToDistanceMatrix} className="theme-btn-secondary rounded-xl border px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-text-muted">
                      Open Distance Matrix
                    </button>
                  </div>

                  <div className="mt-4 grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2">
                    <label className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-text-muted">
                      Route Type
                      <select value={calculatorForm.routeType} onChange={(event) => setCalculatorForm((current) => ({ ...current, routeType: event.target.value as PricingCalculatorForm["routeType"] }))} className="theme-input mt-1 w-full rounded-xl border px-3 py-2 text-xs">
                        <option value="in_city">In-City</option>
                        <option value="inter_city">Inter-City</option>
                      </select>
                    </label>
                    <label className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-text-muted">
                      Weight (kg)
                      <input type="number" min="0" value={calculatorForm.weightKg} onChange={(event) => setCalculatorForm((current) => ({ ...current, weightKg: event.target.value }))} className="theme-input mt-1 w-full rounded-xl border px-3 py-2 text-xs" />
                    </label>
                    <label className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-text-muted">
                      Pickups
                      <input type="number" min="1" value={calculatorForm.pickupCount} onChange={(event) => setCalculatorForm((current) => ({ ...current, pickupCount: event.target.value }))} className="theme-input mt-1 w-full rounded-xl border px-3 py-2 text-xs" />
                    </label>
                    <label className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-text-muted">
                      Drop-offs
                      <input type="number" min="1" value={calculatorForm.dropoffCount} onChange={(event) => setCalculatorForm((current) => ({ ...current, dropoffCount: event.target.value }))} className="theme-input mt-1 w-full rounded-xl border px-3 py-2 text-xs" />
                    </label>
                    <label className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-text-muted sm:col-span-2">
                      Distance (km)
                      <input type="number" min="0" value={calculatorForm.distanceKm} onChange={(event) => setCalculatorForm((current) => ({ ...current, distanceKm: event.target.value }))} disabled={calculatorForm.routeType !== "inter_city"} className="theme-input mt-1 w-full rounded-xl border px-3 py-2 text-xs disabled:opacity-50" />
                    </label>
                  </div>

                  <div className="mt-4">
                    <p className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-text-muted">Handling rules</p>
                    <div className="mt-2 flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                      {controlCategoryOptions.length === 0 ? <span className="text-xs text-text-muted">No approved handling rules</span> : null}
                      {controlCategoryOptions.map(({ key, rule }) => {
                        const isSelected = calculatorForm.selectedCategories.includes(key);
                        return (
                          <button
                            key={key}
                            type="button"
                            onClick={() => setCalculatorForm((current) => ({
                              ...current,
                              selectedCategories: isSelected
                                ? current.selectedCategories.filter((value) => value !== key)
                                : [...current.selectedCategories, key],
                            }))}
                            className={`rounded-full border px-3 py-1 text-[11px] font-semibold transition-colors ${isSelected ? "theme-btn-primary" : "theme-btn-secondary text-text-muted"}`}
                          >
                            {rule.category_name}
                          </button>
                        );
                      })}
                    </div>
                    <p className="mt-2 text-[11px] text-text-muted">
                      {calculatorBreakdown.appliedCategoryRule
                        ? `Highest rule: ${calculatorBreakdown.appliedCategoryRule.category_name}`
                        : "No handling rule selected."}
                    </p>
                  </div>

                  <div className="mt-4 rounded-xl border border-primary/20 bg-primary/5 px-3 py-2 text-[11px] text-text-muted">
                    Load-fit rules stay in the queue below for operational approval. They do not change the customer charge shown in this calculator.
                  </div>

                  <div className="mt-4 rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface p-4">
                    <div className="space-y-2 text-[11px] text-text-muted">
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3"><span>Base Fee</span><span>{calculatorBreakdown.baseFee.toFixed(2)} {controlProfile.currency}</span></div>
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3"><span>Weight ({Number(calculatorForm.weightKg || 0)}kg x {calculatorBreakdown.perKgRate.toFixed(2)})</span><span>{calculatorBreakdown.weightFee.toFixed(2)} {controlProfile.currency}</span></div>

                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3"><span>Extra Pickups ({calculatorBreakdown.extraPickupCount})</span><span>{calculatorBreakdown.pickupFee.toFixed(2)} {controlProfile.currency}</span></div>
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3"><span>Extra Drop-offs ({calculatorBreakdown.extraDropoffCount})</span><span>{calculatorBreakdown.dropoffFee.toFixed(2)} {controlProfile.currency}</span></div>
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3"><span>Handling Amount</span><span>{calculatorBreakdown.categoryTotal.toFixed(2)} {controlProfile.currency}</span></div>
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3"><span>Applied Handling Rule</span><span>{calculatorBreakdown.appliedCategoryRule?.category_name ?? "None"}</span></div>
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 border-t border-border pt-2"><span>Subtotal</span><span>{calculatorBreakdown.subtotal.toFixed(2)} {controlProfile.currency}</span></div>
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3"><span>After runtime surcharge (x{calculatorBreakdown.fuelMultiplier.toFixed(2)})</span><span>{calculatorBreakdown.fuelAdjusted.toFixed(2)} {controlProfile.currency}</span></div>
                    </div>
                    <div className="mt-3 grid gap-2 sm:grid-cols-2">
                      <div className={`rounded-xl border px-3 py-2 text-[11px] ${calculatorBreakdown.minimumChargeApplied ? "border-warning/40 bg-warning/10 text-warning" : "border-border bg-surface-2 text-text-muted"}`}>
                        Minimum floor {calculatorBreakdown.minimumCharge != null ? `${Number(calculatorBreakdown.minimumCharge).toFixed(2)} ${controlProfile.currency}` : "not set"}
                      </div>
                      <div className={`rounded-xl border px-3 py-2 text-[11px] ${calculatorBreakdown.maximumChargeApplied ? "border-warning/40 bg-warning/10 text-warning" : "border-border bg-surface-2 text-text-muted"}`}>
                        Maximum cap {calculatorBreakdown.maximumCharge != null ? `${Number(calculatorBreakdown.maximumCharge).toFixed(2)} ${controlProfile.currency}` : "not set"}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                    <div className="mt-4 flex items-center justify-between gap-3 border-t border-border pt-3">
                      <div>
                        <p className="text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.16em] text-text-faint">Final Charge</p>
                        <p className="text-lg font-bold text-text">{calculatorBreakdown.finalCharge.toFixed(2)} {controlProfile.currency}</p>
                      </div>
                      <div className="text-right text-[11px] text-text-muted">
                        <p>{calculatorBreakdown.minimumChargeApplied ? "Minimum floor applied" : "Minimum floor not hit"}</p>
                        <p>{calculatorBreakdown.maximumChargeApplied ? "Maximum cap applied" : "Maximum cap not hit"}</p>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </section>
              </div>
            )}
          </section>
        ) : null}

        {scope === "full" ? (
        <section className="theme-card rounded-xl border p-3">
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-4">
            <div>
              <h2 className="text-sm font-bold text-text">{WORKSPACE_COPY[activeWorkspace].title}</h2>
              <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-text-muted">{WORKSPACE_COPY[activeWorkspace].description}</p>
            </div>
            {activeWorkspace !== "overview" && activeWorkspace !== "distance" ? (
              <select value={selectedPartnerId} onChange={(event) => setSelectedPartnerId(event.target.value)} className="theme-input rounded-xl border px-3 py-2 text-xs">
                <option value="all">All partners</option>
                {partners.map((partner) => (
                  <option key={partner.id} value={String(partner.id)}>{partner.name}</option>
                ))}
              </select>
            ) : null}
          </div>

          <div className="mt-3 flex flex-wrap gap-2">
            {workspaceTabs.map((workspace) => (
              <button
                key={workspace.key}
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setActiveWorkspace(workspace.key)}
                className={`inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-xl px-3 py-2 text-xs font-semibold transition-colors ${
                  activeWorkspace === workspace.key ? "theme-btn-primary" : "theme-btn-secondary border text-text-muted"
                }`}
              >
                <span>{workspace.label}</span>
                {workspace.count != null ? (
                  <span className={`rounded-full px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold ${activeWorkspace === workspace.key ? "bg-black/10 text-current" : "theme-chip-brand"}`}>
                    {workspace.count}
                  </span>
                ) : null}
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>

          {isWorkspaceVisible("overview") ? (
            <div className="mt-4 grid gap-3 xl:grid-cols-[1.15fr,0.85fr]">
              <div className="space-y-3">
                <div className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface-2 p-3">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-warning">
                    <AlertCircle className="h-4 w-4" />
                    <p className="text-xs font-bold text-text">{totalPendingReviews} item(s) need admin review</p>
                  </div>
                  <div className="mt-3 grid gap-2 sm:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-4">
                    {reviewShortcutCards.map((card) => (
                      <button
                        key={card.title}
                        onClick={card.action}
                        className="rounded-lg border border-border bg-surface px-3 py-2.5 text-left transition-colors hover:border-warning/40 hover:bg-warning/5"
                      >
                        <p className="text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.16em] text-text-faint">Queue</p>
                        <p className="mt-1 text-sm font-bold text-text">{card.title}</p>
                        <p className="mt-2 text-xs text-text-muted">{card.count} pending</p>
                      </button>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div className="grid gap-3 md:grid-cols-3">
                  {GOVERNANCE_CARDS.map((card) => (
                    <div key={card.title} className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface-2 p-3">
                      <p className="text-xs font-bold text-text">{card.title}</p>
                      <p className="mt-2 text-xs text-text-muted">{card.body}</p>
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface-2 p-3">
                <p className="text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.18em] text-text-faint">How to use this page</p>
                <div className="mt-3 space-y-2 text-xs text-text-muted">
                  <div className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface p-3">
                    <p className="font-semibold text-text">1. Check pending review</p>
                    <p className="mt-1">Use the overview cards to jump into the queue that is blocking approvals.</p>
                  </div>
                  <div className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface p-3">
                    <p className="font-semibold text-text">2. Work one workspace at a time</p>
                    <p className="mt-1">Partner registry, service areas, pricing, categories, vehicles, and distance lookups are separated so actions are easier to understand.</p>
                  </div>
                  <div className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface p-3">
                    <p className="font-semibold text-text">3. Use the shared partner filter</p>
                    <p className="mt-1">Every review workspace can be narrowed to a single partner instead of scanning one long mixed queue.</p>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          ) : null}
        </section>
        ) : null}

        {isWorkspaceVisible("partners") ? (
          <>
            <div className={showForm ? "grid gap-6 xl:grid-cols-[minmax(0,1.6fr),minmax(320px,0.9fr)]" : ""}>

                {loading ? (
                  <div className="space-y-3 p-6">{Array.from({ length: 3 }).map((_, index) => <div key={index} className="h-16 animate-pulse rounded-xl bg-surface-2" />)}</div>
                ) : partners.length === 0 ? (
                  <div className="p-12 text-center text-xs text-text-muted">No logistics partners yet. Create the first one from the action bar above.</div>
                ) : (
                  <EnterpriseDataTable
                    columns={partnerColumns}
                    rows={partners}
                    rowKey={(partner) => partner.id}
                    densityMode={density}
                    enableBulkActions
                    enableExport={false}
                    searchPlaceholder="Search by partner, code, portal user, contact, or location"
                    selectedRowKeys={Array.from(selectedPartnerIds)}
                    onSelectedRowKeysChange={(keys) => setSelectedPartnerIds(new Set(keys.map((key) => Number(key))))}
                    showSelectionSummary={false}
                    emptyState="No logistics partners yet. Create the first one from the action bar above."
                    toolbarSlot={<span className="rounded-full bg-surface-2 px-3 py-1 text-[11px] font-semibold text-text-muted">{partners.length} partner record(s){selectedPartnerIds.size ? ` · ${selectedPartnerIds.size} selected` : ""}</span>}
                    rowActions={(partner) => {
                      const isExpanded = expandedPartnerId === partner.id;
                      const disabled = reviewingKey !== null || statusActionId === partner.id || deleteActionId === partner.id;
                      return (
                        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-end gap-1.5">
                          <button

                            onClick={() => setExpandedPartnerId(isExpanded ? null : partner.id)}
                            className="rounded-md border border-border bg-surface-2 px-2 py-1 text-[11px] font-semibold text-text-muted transition-colors hover:border-primary/30 hover:text-primary"
                          >
                            {isExpanded ? "Hide details" : "Details"}
                          </button>
                          <button type="button" onClick={() => openEdit(partner)} className="rounded-md border border-border bg-surface-2 px-2 py-1 text-[11px] font-semibold text-text-muted transition-colors hover:border-primary/30 hover:text-primary">Edit</button>
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            onClick={() => handleReviewProfile(partner.id, "approved")}
                            disabled={disabled}
                            className="theme-chip-success rounded-md px-2 py-1 text-[11px] font-semibold disabled:opacity-50"
                          >
                            Approve
                          </button>
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            onClick={() => handleReviewProfile(partner.id, "rejected")}
                            disabled={disabled}
                            className="theme-chip-danger rounded-md px-2 py-1 text-[11px] font-semibold disabled:opacity-50"
                          >
                            Reject
