                          <button
                            type="button"
                            onClick={() => handleTogglePartnerStatus(partner)}
                            disabled={disabled}
                            className="theme-chip-info rounded-md px-2 py-1 text-[11px] font-semibold disabled:opacity-50"
                          >
                            {partner.status === "active" ? "Suspend" : "Activate"}
                          </button>
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            onClick={() => handleDeletePartner(partner)}
                            disabled={disabled}
                            className="theme-chip-danger rounded-md px-2 py-1 text-[11px] font-semibold disabled:opacity-50"
                          >
                            Delete
                          </button>
                        </div>
                      );
                    }}
                    mobileCardRenderer={(partner) => {
                      const counts = partnerAreaCounts[partner.id] || { approved: 0, pending: 0, rejected: 0 };
                      return (
                        <div className="space-y-2 text-xs">
                          <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3">
                            <div>
                              <p className="font-semibold text-text">{partner.name}</p>
                              <p className="mt-1 font-mono text-[11px] text-text-muted">{partner.code}</p>
                            </div>
                            <span className={`inline-flex rounded-full px-2 py-1 text-[10px] font-semibold ${STATUS_CHIP[partner.status] ?? "theme-chip-muted"}`}>
                              {formatStatusLabel(partner.status)}
                            </span>
                          </div>
                          <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">
                            <span className={`rounded-full px-2 py-1 text-[10px] font-semibold ${STATUS_CHIP[partner.verification_status] ?? "theme-chip-muted"}`}>{formatStatusLabel(partner.verification_status)}</span>
                            <span className="theme-chip-success rounded-full px-2 py-1 text-[10px] font-semibold">Areas {counts.approved}/{counts.pending}/{counts.rejected}</span>
                          </div>
                          <p className="text-text-muted">{[partner.city, partner.country].filter(Boolean).join(", ") || "Location pending"}</p>
                          <p className="text-text-muted">{partner.contact_email || partner.contact_phone || "No contact info"}</p>
                        </div>
                      );
                    }}
                    expandedRowKey={expandedPartnerId ?? undefined}
                    expandedRowRenderer={(partner) => {
                      const counts = partnerAreaCounts[partner.id] || { approved: 0, pending: 0, rejected: 0 };
                      const partnerProfiles = pricingProfiles.filter((profile) => profile.partner_id === partner.id);
                      const partnerCategoryRules = categoryRules.filter((rule) => rule.partner_id === partner.id);
                      const partnerVehicleRules = vehicleRules.filter((rule) => rule.partner_id === partner.id);
                      return (
                        <div className="p-4">
                          <div className="mb-3 flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
                            <div>
                              <h4 className="text-sm font-bold text-text">Partner Details</h4>
                              <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-text-muted">Expanded partner context for {partner.name}. Profile, coverage, and pricing governance stay in the same workspace.</p>
                            </div>
                            <button type="button" onClick={() => setExpandedPartnerId(null)} className="rounded-lg border border-border bg-surface px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-text-muted hover:text-text">
                              Close
                            </button>
                          </div>
                          <div className="grid gap-3 md:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-3">
                            <div className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface-1 p-3">
                              <p className="text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.18em] text-text-faint">Portal Access</p>
                              <p className="mt-1.5 text-xs font-medium text-text">{partner.linked_user_email || partner.linked_username || "No linked portal user"}</p>
                              <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-text-muted">{partner.contact_name || "Primary contact not set"}</p>
                            </div>
                            <div className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface-1 p-3">
                              <p className="text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.18em] text-text-faint">Coverage Regions</p>
                              <p className="mt-1.5 text-xs font-medium text-text">{partner.coverage_regions?.join(", ") || "No coverage regions submitted"}</p>
                              <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-text-muted">Service types: {partner.service_types?.join(", ") || "No service types set"}</p>
                            </div>
                            <div className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface-1 p-3">
                              <p className="text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.18em] text-text-faint">Lifecycle</p>
                              <p className="mt-1.5 text-xs font-medium text-text">Created {new Date(partner.created_at).toLocaleDateString()}</p>
                              <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-text-muted">Website: {partner.website ? <a href={partner.website} target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" className="text-primary hover:underline">{partner.website}</a> : "Not provided"}</p>
                            </div>
                            <div className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface-1 p-3">
                              <p className="text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.18em] text-text-faint">Coverage Review</p>
                              <div className="mt-2 flex flex-wrap gap-1.5 text-[11px]">
                                <span className="theme-chip-success rounded-lg px-2 py-0.5 font-semibold">Approved {counts.approved}</span>
                                <span className="theme-chip-warning rounded-lg px-2 py-0.5 font-semibold">Pending {counts.pending}</span>
                                <span className="theme-chip-danger rounded-lg px-2 py-0.5 font-semibold">Rejected {counts.rejected}</span>
                              </div>
                            </div>
                            <div className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface-1 p-3">
                              <p className="text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.18em] text-text-faint">Pricing Inputs</p>
                              <p className="mt-1.5 text-xs font-medium text-text">{partnerProfiles.length} pricing profile(s)</p>
                              <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-text-muted">{partnerCategoryRules.length} handling rule(s) · {partnerVehicleRules.length} load-fit rule(s)</p>
                            </div>
                            <div className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface-1 p-3">
                              <p className="text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.18em] text-text-faint">Location Notes</p>
                              <p className="mt-1.5 text-xs font-medium text-text">{[partner.city, partner.country].filter(Boolean).join(", ") || "Location not provided"}</p>
                              <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-text-muted">{partner.address || partner.bio || partner.verification_note || "No address, bio, or admin note recorded."}</p>
                            </div>
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      );
                    }}
                  />
                )}
              </div>

              {showForm ? (
                <div className="space-y-4">
                  <form onSubmit={handleSave} className="theme-card space-y-4 rounded-xl border p-5">
            <h2 className="text-xs font-bold text-text">{editingId ? "Edit Partner" : "Add New Partner"}</h2>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2">
              {[
                ["Company Name *", "name"],
                ["Code (unique) *", "code"],
                ["Contact Name", "contact_name"],
                ["Contact Email", "contact_email"],
                ["Contact Phone", "contact_phone"],
                ["Website", "website"],
                ["Country", "country"],
                ["City", "city"],
                ["Linked Portal User Email", "linked_user_email"],
                ["Coverage Regions", "coverage_regions"],
                ["Service Types", "service_types"],
              ].map(([label, field]) => (
                <div key={String(field)} className={field === "linked_user_email" || field === "coverage_regions" || field === "service_types" ? "sm:col-span-2" : ""}>
                  <label className="mb-1 block text-xs font-semibold text-text-muted">{label}</label>
                  <input
                    value={form[field as keyof typeof form]}
                    onChange={(event) => setForm((current) => ({ ...current, [field]: field === "code" ? event.target.value.toUpperCase() : event.target.value }))}
                    className="theme-input w-full rounded-xl border px-3 py-2 text-xs"
                  />
                </div>
              ))}
              <div>
                <label className="mb-1 block text-xs font-semibold text-text-muted">Portal Status</label>
                <select value={form.status} onChange={(event) => setForm((current) => ({ ...current, status: event.target.value }))} className="theme-input w-full rounded-xl border px-3 py-2 text-xs">
                  <option value="pending_onboarding">Pending Onboarding</option>
                  <option value="active">Active</option>
                  <option value="suspended">Suspended</option>
                </select>
              </div>
              <div className="sm:col-span-2">
                <label className="mb-1 block text-xs font-semibold text-text-muted">Address</label>
                <textarea value={form.address} onChange={(event) => setForm((current) => ({ ...current, address: event.target.value }))} className="theme-input w-full rounded-xl border px-3 py-2 text-xs" rows={3} />
              </div>
              <div className="sm:col-span-2">
                <label className="mb-1 block text-xs font-semibold text-text-muted">Short Bio</label>
                <textarea value={form.bio} onChange={(event) => setForm((current) => ({ ...current, bio: event.target.value }))} className="theme-input w-full rounded-xl border px-3 py-2 text-xs" rows={3} />
              </div>
              <div className="sm:col-span-2">
                <label className="mb-1 block text-xs font-semibold text-text-muted">Verification Note</label>
                <textarea value={form.verification_note} onChange={(event) => setForm((current) => ({ ...current, verification_note: event.target.value }))} className="theme-input w-full rounded-xl border px-3 py-2 text-xs" rows={2} />
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="flex gap-3">
              <button type="submit" disabled={saving} className="theme-btn-primary flex items-center gap-2 rounded-xl px-5 py-2.5 text-xs font-semibold disabled:opacity-50">
                {saving ? <RefreshCw className="h-4 w-4 animate-spin" /> : <CheckCircle className="h-4 w-4" />}
                {editingId ? "Update" : "Create"}
              </button>
              <button type="button" onClick={closePartnerForm} className="theme-btn-secondary rounded-xl px-5 py-2.5 text-xs font-semibold">
                Cancel
              </button>
            </div>
                  </form>
                </div>

                { label: "Reject Selected", onClick: () => handleBulkPartnerAction("reject"), loading: bulkLoading, variant: "danger" },
                { label: "Activate Selected", onClick: () => handleBulkPartnerAction("activate"), loading: bulkLoading, variant: "primary" },
                { label: "Suspend Selected", onClick: () => handleBulkPartnerAction("suspend"), loading: bulkLoading, variant: "warning" },
                { label: "Delete Selected", onClick: () => handleBulkPartnerAction("delete"), loading: bulkLoading, variant: "danger" },
              ]}
            />
          </>
        ) : null}

        {isWorkspaceVisible("areas") ? (
          <div className="theme-card space-y-4 rounded-xl border p-5">
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3">

                <ShieldCheck className="h-5 w-5 text-primary" /> Service Area Review Queue
                {pendingAreaCount > 0 && (
                  <span className="theme-chip-warning rounded-full px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold">{pendingAreaCount} pending</span>
                )}
              </h2>
              <p className="text-xs text-text-muted">Approve or reject the city, country, and charge rows that control customer shipping quotes and prepared pickup visibility.</p>

              <button onClick={() => { setEditingAreaId(null); setAdminAreaForm(BLANK_AREA_FORM); setAreaFormError(""); setShowAreaForm((v) => !v); }} className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-xl border border-border px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-text hover:bg-surface-2">
                <Plus className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />New Area
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>

          {showAreaForm && (
            <div className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface-2 p-4 space-y-3">

              {areaFormError && <p className="text-xs font-medium text-danger">{areaFormError}</p>}
              <div className="grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3">
                <div><label className="mb-1 block text-xs font-semibold text-text-muted">Partner *</label>
                  <select value={adminAreaForm.partner_id} onChange={(e) => setAdminAreaForm((p) => ({ ...p, partner_id: e.target.value }))} className="theme-input w-full rounded-xl border px-3 py-2 text-xs">
                    <option value="">— Select partner —</option>
                    {partners.map((pt) => <option key={pt.id} value={pt.id}>{pt.name}</option>)}
                  </select>
                </div>
                <div><label className="mb-1 block text-xs font-semibold text-text-muted">Country Code *</label><input value={adminAreaForm.country_code} onChange={(e) => setAdminAreaForm((p) => ({ ...p, country_code: e.target.value.toUpperCase() }))} placeholder="AE" className="theme-input w-full rounded-xl border px-3 py-2 text-xs" /></div>
                <div><label className="mb-1 block text-xs font-semibold text-text-muted">Country Name *</label><input value={adminAreaForm.country_name} onChange={(e) => setAdminAreaForm((p) => ({ ...p, country_name: e.target.value }))} placeholder="United Arab Emirates" className="theme-input w-full rounded-xl border px-3 py-2 text-xs" /></div>
                <div><label className="mb-1 block text-xs font-semibold text-text-muted">City</label><input value={adminAreaForm.city_name} onChange={(e) => setAdminAreaForm((p) => ({ ...p, city_name: e.target.value }))} placeholder="Dubai" className="theme-input w-full rounded-xl border px-3 py-2 text-xs" /></div>
                <div><label className="mb-1 block text-xs font-semibold text-text-muted">Zone Label</label><input value={adminAreaForm.zone_label} onChange={(e) => setAdminAreaForm((p) => ({ ...p, zone_label: e.target.value }))} placeholder="Zone A" className="theme-input w-full rounded-xl border px-3 py-2 text-xs" /></div>
                <div><label className="mb-1 block text-xs font-semibold text-text-muted">Latitude</label><input type="number" value={adminAreaForm.latitude} onChange={(e) => setAdminAreaForm((p) => ({ ...p, latitude: e.target.value }))} placeholder="25.2048" className="theme-input w-full rounded-xl border px-3 py-2 text-xs" /></div>
                <div><label className="mb-1 block text-xs font-semibold text-text-muted">Longitude</label><input type="number" value={adminAreaForm.longitude} onChange={(e) => setAdminAreaForm((p) => ({ ...p, longitude: e.target.value }))} placeholder="55.2708" className="theme-input w-full rounded-xl border px-3 py-2 text-xs" /></div>
                <div><label className="mb-1 block text-xs font-semibold text-text-muted">Charge Amount *</label><input type="number" value={adminAreaForm.charge_amount} onChange={(e) => setAdminAreaForm((p) => ({ ...p, charge_amount: e.target.value }))} placeholder="15.00" className="theme-input w-full rounded-xl border px-3 py-2 text-xs" /></div>
                <div><label className="mb-1 block text-xs font-semibold text-text-muted">Minimum Charge</label><input type="number" value={adminAreaForm.minimum_charge} onChange={(e) => setAdminAreaForm((p) => ({ ...p, minimum_charge: e.target.value }))} placeholder="10.00" className="theme-input w-full rounded-xl border px-3 py-2 text-xs" /></div>
                <div><label className="mb-1 block text-xs font-semibold text-text-muted">Per kg Rate</label><input type="number" value={adminAreaForm.per_kg_rate} onChange={(e) => setAdminAreaForm((p) => ({ ...p, per_kg_rate: e.target.value }))} placeholder="0.50" className="theme-input w-full rounded-xl border px-3 py-2 text-xs" /></div>
                <div><label className="mb-1 block text-xs font-semibold text-text-muted">Per km Rate</label><input type="number" value={adminAreaForm.per_km_rate} onChange={(e) => setAdminAreaForm((p) => ({ ...p, per_km_rate: e.target.value }))} placeholder="0.30" className="theme-input w-full rounded-xl border px-3 py-2 text-xs" /></div>
                <div><label className="mb-1 block text-xs font-semibold text-text-muted">Runtime Surcharge Factor</label><input type="number" value={adminAreaForm.fuel_multiplier} onChange={(e) => setAdminAreaForm((p) => ({ ...p, fuel_multiplier: e.target.value }))} placeholder="1.0" className="theme-input w-full rounded-xl border px-3 py-2 text-xs" /></div>
                <div><label className="mb-1 block text-xs font-semibold text-text-muted">Pickup Fee Per Stop</label><input type="number" value={adminAreaForm.pickup_charge} onChange={(e) => setAdminAreaForm((p) => ({ ...p, pickup_charge: e.target.value }))} placeholder="5.00" className="theme-input w-full rounded-xl border px-3 py-2 text-xs" /></div>
                <div><label className="mb-1 block text-xs font-semibold text-text-muted">Dropoff Fee Per Stop</label><input type="number" value={adminAreaForm.dropoff_charge} onChange={(e) => setAdminAreaForm((p) => ({ ...p, dropoff_charge: e.target.value }))} placeholder="5.00" className="theme-input w-full rounded-xl border px-3 py-2 text-xs" /></div>
                <div><label className="mb-1 block text-xs font-semibold text-text-muted">Currency</label><input value={adminAreaForm.currency} onChange={(e) => setAdminAreaForm((p) => ({ ...p, currency: e.target.value }))} placeholder="AED" className="theme-input w-full rounded-xl border px-3 py-2 text-xs" /></div>
                <div><label className="mb-1 block text-xs font-semibold text-text-muted">Min Delivery Days</label><input type="number" value={adminAreaForm.delivery_days_min} onChange={(e) => setAdminAreaForm((p) => ({ ...p, delivery_days_min: e.target.value }))} placeholder="1" className="theme-input w-full rounded-xl border px-3 py-2 text-xs" /></div>
                <div><label className="mb-1 block text-xs font-semibold text-text-muted">Max Delivery Days</label><input type="number" value={adminAreaForm.delivery_days_max} onChange={(e) => setAdminAreaForm((p) => ({ ...p, delivery_days_max: e.target.value }))} placeholder="3" className="theme-input w-full rounded-xl border px-3 py-2 text-xs" /></div>
              </div>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <label className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-semibold text-text-muted cursor-pointer"><input type="checkbox" checked={adminAreaForm.is_active} onChange={(e) => setAdminAreaForm((p) => ({ ...p, is_active: e.target.checked }))} className="rounded" /> Active</label>
              </div>

"Saving..." : editingAreaId ? "Update Area" : "Create Area"}</button>
                <button onClick={() => { setShowAreaForm(false); setEditingAreaId(null); setAdminAreaForm(BLANK_AREA_FORM); setAreaFormError(""); }} className="rounded-xl border border-border px-4 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-text-muted hover:text-text">Cancel</button>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          <div className="grid gap-4 xl:grid-cols-[1.15fr_0.85fr]">
            <div className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface-2 p-4">
              <div>
                <p className="text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.16em] text-text-faint">Coverage and Route Board</p>
                <h3 className="mt-1 text-sm font-bold text-text">Approved and pending coverage on one map</h3>
                <p className="mt-1 text-[11px] text-text-muted">Service-area points and route rows are projected from stored coordinates so admins can review coverage and missing map data in one place.</p>
              </div>

              {coverageBoardBounds ? (
                <div className="mt-4 rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface p-3">
                  <svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" className="h-72 w-full rounded-lg bg-[radial-gradient(circle_at_top,rgba(14,165,233,0.18),transparent_42%),linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(15,23,42,0.04),rgba(15,23,42,0.12))]">
                    <defs>
                      <pattern id="coverage-grid" width="12" height="12" patternUnits="userSpaceOnUse">
                        <path d="M 12 0 L 0 0 0 12" fill="none" stroke="rgba(148,163,184,0.22)" strokeWidth="0.4" />
                      </pattern>
                    </defs>
                    <rect x="0" y="0" width="100" height="100" fill="url(#coverage-grid)" rx="4" />
                    {routeReviewRows.filter((route) => route.origin && route.destination).map((route) => {
                      const x1 = 8 + (((route.origin?.longitude ?? 0) - coverageBoardBounds.minLng) / coverageBoardBounds.lngSpan) * 84;
                      const y1 = 8 + (1 - (((route.origin?.latitude ?? 0) - coverageBoardBounds.minLat) / coverageBoardBounds.latSpan)) * 78;
                      const x2 = 8 + (((route.destination?.longitude ?? 0) - coverageBoardBounds.minLng) / coverageBoardBounds.lngSpan) * 84;
                      const y2 = 8 + (1 - (((route.destination?.latitude ?? 0) - coverageBoardBounds.minLat) / coverageBoardBounds.latSpan)) * 78;
                      return <line key={route.id} x1={x1} y1={y1} x2={x2} y2={y2} stroke="rgba(14,165,233,0.55)" strokeWidth="1.6" strokeDasharray="2.5 1.5" />;
                    })}
                    {mappedServiceAreas.map((point) => {
                      const cx = 8 + ((point.longitude - coverageBoardBounds.minLng) / coverageBoardBounds.lngSpan) * 84;
                      const cy = 8 + (1 - ((point.latitude - coverageBoardBounds.minLat) / coverageBoardBounds.latSpan)) * 78;
                      const fill = point.approvalStatus === "approved" ? "rgba(34,197,94,0.95)" : point.approvalStatus === "rejected" ? "rgba(239,68,68,0.95)" : "rgba(245,158,11,0.95)";
                      return (
                        <g key={point.key}>
                          <circle cx={cx} cy={cy} r="2.7" fill={fill} stroke="rgba(255,255,255,0.92)" strokeWidth="0.8" />
                          <text x={cx + 2.8} y={cy - 2.5} fontSize="3.3" fill="rgba(15,23,42,0.82)">{point.label}</text>
                        </g>
                      );
                    })}
                  </svg>
                </div>
              ) : (
                <div className="mt-4 rounded-xl border border-dashed border-border px-4 py-10 text-center text-xs text-text-muted">No route or service-area coordinates are ready to project yet. Add latitude and longitude to start the coverage board.</div>
              )}
            </div>

                </div>

        apiFetch("/payments/config/runtime", { disableCache: true }),
        apiFetch("/payments/config/gateways", { disableCache: true }),
      ]);
      const runtimePayload = (await parseJsonResponse(runtimeResponse)) ?? {};
      const gatewaysPayload = (await parseJsonResponse(gatewaysResponse)) ?? [];

      if (!runtimeResponse.ok) {
        throw new Error(getErrorMessage(runtimePayload));
      }
      if (!gatewaysResponse.ok) {
        throw new Error(getErrorMessage(gatewaysPayload));
      }

      const runtime = runtimePayload as PaymentRuntimeConfig;
      const gatewayList = gatewaysPayload as PaymentGatewayConnection[];

      setRuntimeConfig(runtime);
      setSelectedMode(runtime.online_provider);
      setGateways(gatewayList);

      const defaultGatewayCode = gatewayList.find((gateway) => gateway.provider_code === selectedGatewayCode)
        ? selectedGatewayCode
        : (gatewayList[0]?.provider_code || "stripe");
      setSelectedGatewayCode(defaultGatewayCode);

      const nextGateway = gatewayList.find((gateway) => gateway.provider_code === defaultGatewayCode);
      if (nextGateway) {
        setGatewayForm(gatewayToForm(nextGateway));
      }
      setQuoteForm((current) => ({
        ...current,
        gateway_code: defaultGatewayCode,
      }));
    } catch (error) {
      addToast(error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Failed to load payment settings", "error");
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, [addToast, selectedGatewayCode]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (authLoading || !isLoggedIn || !canAccessAdminPaymentManagement(user?.role)) {
      return;
    }
    void loadPageData();
  }, [authLoading, isLoggedIn, loadPageData, user?.role]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (selectedGateway) {
      setGatewayForm(gatewayToForm(selectedGateway));
      setQuoteForm((current) => ({
        ...current,
        gateway_code: selectedGateway.provider_code,
      }));
    }
  }, [selectedGateway]);

  const handleModeSave = async () => {
    setSavingMode(true);
    try {
      const response = await apiFetch("/payments/config/runtime", {
        method: "PUT",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ online_provider: selectedMode }),
      });
      const payload = (await parseJsonResponse(response)) ?? {};
      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error(getErrorMessage(payload));
      }
      setRuntimeConfig(payload as PaymentRuntimeConfig);
      addToast("Checkout payment mode updated", "success");
    } catch (error) {
      addToast(error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Failed to update payment mode", "error");
    } finally {
      setSavingMode(false);
    }
  };

  const buildGatewayPayload = () => ({
    provider_code: gatewayForm.provider_code.trim().toLowerCase(),
    provider_kind: gatewayForm.provider_kind,
    display_name: gatewayForm.display_name.trim(),
    is_enabled: gatewayForm.is_enabled,
    supports_customer_checkout: gatewayForm.supports_customer_checkout,
    supports_payouts: gatewayForm.supports_payouts,
    mode: gatewayForm.mode,
    public_key: gatewayForm.public_key.trim() || null,
    secret_key: gatewayForm.secret_key.trim() || null,
    webhook_secret: gatewayForm.webhook_secret.trim() || null,
    merchant_id: gatewayForm.merchant_id.trim() || null,
    api_base_url: gatewayForm.api_base_url.trim() || null,
    webhook_url: gatewayForm.webhook_url.trim() || null,
    test_url: gatewayForm.test_url.trim() || null,
    supported_currencies: gatewayForm.supported_currencies
      .split(",")
      .map((value) => value.trim().toUpperCase())
      .filter(Boolean),
    extra_config: {},
    notes: gatewayForm.notes.trim() || null,
    fee_percent: parseNumber(gatewayForm.fee_percent),
    fixed_fee_amount: parseNumber(gatewayForm.fixed_fee_amount),
    payout_fee_percent: parseNumber(gatewayForm.payout_fee_percent),
    payout_fixed_fee_amount: parseNumber(gatewayForm.payout_fixed_fee_amount),
    pass_fee_to_customer: gatewayForm.pass_fee_to_customer,
    settlement_cycle: gatewayForm.settlement_cycle,
  });

  const handleGatewaySave = async () => {
    const providerCode = gatewayForm.provider_code.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (!providerCode || !gatewayForm.display_name.trim()) {
      addToast("Gateway code and display name are required", "error");
      return;
    }

    setSavingGateway(true);
    try {
      const response = await apiFetch(`/payments/config/gateways/${providerCode}`, {
        method: "PUT",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify(buildGatewayPayload()),
      });
      const payload = (await parseJsonResponse(response)) ?? {};
      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error(getErrorMessage(payload));
      }
      addToast("Gateway configuration saved", "success");
      setSelectedGatewayCode(providerCode);
      await loadPageData();
    } catch (error) {
      addToast(error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Failed to save gateway", "error");
    } finally {
      setSavingGateway(false);
    }
  };

  const handleGatewayTest = async () => {
    const providerCode = gatewayForm.provider_code.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (!providerCode) {
      addToast("Gateway code is required before testing", "error");
      return;
    }

    setTestingGateway(true);
    try {
      const saveResponse = await apiFetch(`/payments/config/gateways/${providerCode}`, {
        method: "PUT",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify(buildGatewayPayload()),
      });
      const savePayload = (await parseJsonResponse(saveResponse)) ?? {};
      if (!saveResponse.ok) {
        throw new Error(getErrorMessage(savePayload));
      }

      const response = await apiFetch(`/payments/config/gateways/${providerCode}/test`, {
        method: "POST",
      });
      const payload = (await parseJsonResponse(response)) ?? {};
      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error(getErrorMessage(payload));
      }

      addToast((payload as { message?: string }).message || "Gateway test passed", "success");
      setSelectedGatewayCode(providerCode);
      await loadPageData();
    } catch (error) {
      addToast(error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Gateway test failed", "error");
    } finally {
      setTestingGateway(false);
    }
  };

  const handleQuotePreview = async () => {
    setQuoting(true);
    try {
      const response = await apiFetch("/payments/config/finance-quote", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          gateway_code: quoteForm.gateway_code || null,
          subtotal_amount: parseNumber(quoteForm.subtotal_amount),
          discount_amount: parseNumber(quoteForm.discount_amount),
          shipping_amount: parseNumber(quoteForm.shipping_amount),
          vat_amount: parseNumber(quoteForm.vat_amount),
        }),
      });
      const payload = (await parseJsonResponse(response)) ?? {};
      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error(getErrorMessage(payload));
      }
      setQuote(payload as PaymentFinanceQuote);
    } catch (error) {
      addToast(error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Failed to generate finance quote", "error");
    } finally {
      setQuoting(false);
    }
  };

  const createCustomGatewayDraft = () => {
    setSelectedGatewayCode("custom_gateway");
    setGatewayForm({
      ...EMPTY_GATEWAY_FORM,
      provider_code: `custom_gateway_${gateways.filter((gateway) => gateway.provider_kind === "custom").length + 1}`,
      display_name: "Custom Gateway",
    });
  };

  const handleProviderTemplateChange = (templateCode: string) => {
    if (templateCode === "custom") {
      createCustomGatewayDraft();
      return;
    }
    const existing = gateways.find((gateway) => gateway.provider_code === templateCode) || null;
    setSelectedGatewayCode(templateCode);
    setGatewayForm(existing ? gatewayToForm(existing) : draftForProviderTemplate(templateCode));
  };

  if (authLoading || !isLoggedIn || !canAccessAdminPaymentManagement(user?.role)) {
    return null;
  }

  return (
    <AdminLayout title="Payments" headerMode="compact">
      <PanelContent width="full" className="space-y-6">
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-end gap-2">
          <button
            onClick={createCustomGatewayDraft}
            className="theme-panel inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-lg border px-4 py-2 text-xs text-text-muted transition-colors hover:bg-surface-2 hover:text-text"
          >
            <PlugZap className="h-4 w-4" />
            New Custom Gateway
          </button>
          <button
            onClick={() => void loadPageData()}
            className="theme-panel inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-lg border px-4 py-2 text-xs text-text-muted transition-colors hover:bg-surface-2 hover:text-text"
          >
            <RefreshCw className="h-4 w-4" />
            Refresh
          </button>
        </div>

        {loading ? (
          <div className="theme-card rounded-xl p-10 text-center text-text-muted">Loading payment gateway settings...</div>
        ) : (
          <>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-2 sm:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-4">
              <StatusCard title="Checkout Mode" value={labelForMode(runtimeConfig?.online_provider || selectedMode)} icon={Settings2} />
              <StatusCard title="Connectors" value={String(gateways.length)} icon={PlugZap} />
              <StatusCard title="Stripe" value={runtimeConfig?.stripe_configured ? "Configured" : "Missing"} icon={CreditCard} />
              <StatusCard title="Tap" value={runtimeConfig?.tap_configured ? "Configured" : "Missing"} icon={RadioTower} />
            </div>

            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-6 xl:grid-cols-[1.15fr_0.85fr]">
              <div className="theme-card rounded-xl p-4">
                <div className="mb-5 flex items-center justify-between gap-4">
                  <div>
                    <h2 className="text-lg font-medium text-text">Customer Checkout Mode</h2>
                    <p className="text-xs text-text-muted">Choose which live adapter customers can see during checkout.</p>
                  </div>
                  <span className="theme-chip-info rounded-full px-3 py-1 text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.2em]">{runtimeConfig?.source || "database"}</span>
                </div>

                <div className="space-y-3">
                  {MODE_OPTIONS.map((option) => {
                    const active = selectedMode === option.value;
                    return (
                      <button
                        key={option.value}
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => setSelectedMode(option.value)}
                        className={`w-full rounded-xl border p-3 text-left transition-colors ${
                          active ? "border-brand bg-brand/10" : "border-border bg-surface-1 hover:bg-surface-2"
                        }`}
                      >
                        <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
                          <p className="font-medium text-text">{option.title}</p>
                          <span className={`h-3.5 w-3.5 shrink-0 rounded-full border ${active ? "border-brand bg-brand" : "border-border bg-transparent"}`} />
                        </div>
                      </button>
                    );
                  })}
                </div>

                <div className="mt-6 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 border-t border-border pt-5">
                  <p className="text-xs text-text-muted">Current customer-visible methods: {humanizeProcessors(runtimeConfig?.enabled_processors || [])}</p>
                  <button
                    onClick={() => void handleModeSave()}
                    disabled={savingMode || !runtimeConfig || selectedMode === runtimeConfig.online_provider}
                    className="theme-btn-primary rounded-xl px-5 py-2.5 text-xs font-medium disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-60"
                  >
                    {savingMode ? "Saving..." : "Save Checkout Mode"}
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="theme-card rounded-xl p-4">
                <h2 className="text-lg font-medium text-text">Adapter Notes</h2>
                <div className="mt-4 space-y-3 text-xs text-text-muted">
                  <InfoBlock
                    title="Built-in adapters"
                    detail="Stripe, Tap, and PayTabs are live adapters. PayPal, HyperPay, and OmanNet ship as managed templates so admins can save credentials, fee rules, test endpoints, and settlement cycles before a dedicated checkout adapter is added."
                  />
                  <InfoBlock
                    title="Custom gateways"
                    detail="You can store credentials, fee rules, URLs, and run connectivity tests for custom gateways. A provider-specific adapter is still required before they can drive live checkout automatically."
                  />
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-6 xl:grid-cols-[0.72fr_1.28fr]">
              <div className="theme-card rounded-xl p-4 xl:sticky xl:top-24 xl:h-fit">
                <div className="mb-4 flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
                  <div>
                    <h2 className="text-lg font-medium text-text">Gateway Connections</h2>
                    <p className="text-xs text-text-muted">Select a connector to edit credentials, fees, and test settings.</p>
                  </div>
                </div>
                <div className="space-y-3">
                  {gateways.map((gateway) => {
                    const active = gateway.provider_code === selectedGatewayCode;
                    return (
                      <button
                        key={gateway.provider_code}
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => setSelectedGatewayCode(gateway.provider_code)}
                        className={`w-full rounded-xl border p-3 text-left transition-colors ${
                          active ? "border-brand bg-brand/10" : "border-border bg-surface-1 hover:bg-surface-2"
                        }`}
                      >
                        <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
                          <div className="min-w-0">
                            <p className="font-medium text-text">{gateway.display_name}</p>
                            <p className="text-xs text-text-muted">{gateway.provider_code} · {gateway.provider_kind} · {gateway.settlement_cycle}</p>
                          </div>
                          <div className="flex flex-wrap justify-end gap-2 text-xs">
                            <span className={`rounded-full px-2.5 py-1 ${gateway.adapter_supported ? "theme-chip-success" : "theme-chip-warning"}`}>
                              {gateway.adapter_supported ? "Live adapter" : "Needs adapter"}
                            </span>
                            <span className={`rounded-full px-2.5 py-1 ${gateway.test_status === "passed" ? "theme-chip-success" : gateway.test_status === "failed" ? "theme-chip-warning" : "theme-chip-muted"}`}>
                              {gateway.test_status}
                            </span>
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      </button>
                    );
                  })}
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="theme-card rounded-xl p-4">
                <div className="mb-5 flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-4">
                  <div>
                    <h2 className="text-lg font-medium text-text">Gateway Credentials and Fees</h2>
                    <p className="text-xs text-text-muted">Blank secret fields keep the stored secret in place. Provider templates cover common gateways, while custom records let you model any other processor.</p>
                  </div>
                  {selectedGateway && (
                    <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2 text-xs">
                      <span className="theme-chip-info rounded-full px-3 py-1 uppercase tracking-[0.2em]">{selectedGateway.source}</span>
                      {selectedGateway.secret_key_configured ? <span className="theme-chip-success rounded-full px-3 py-1">Secret stored</span> : null}
                      {selectedGateway.webhook_secret_configured ? <span className="theme-chip-success rounded-full px-3 py-1">Webhook secret stored</span> : null}
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>

                <div className="space-y-5">
                  <FormSection title="Gateway Identity" description="Pick the provider template and core metadata first.">
                    <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 md:grid-cols-2">
                      <Field label="Gateway Provider">
                        <select
                          value={PROVIDER_TEMPLATE_OPTIONS.some((option) => option.value === selectedGatewayCode) ? selectedGatewayCode : "custom"}
                          onChange={(event) => handleProviderTemplateChange(event.target.value)}
                          className="input"
                        >
                          {PROVIDER_TEMPLATE_OPTIONS.map((option) => (
                            <option key={option.value} value={option.value}>{option.label}</option>
                          ))}
                        </select>
                      </Field>
                      <Field label="Gateway Code">
                        <input value={gatewayForm.provider_code} onChange={(event) => setGatewayForm((current) => ({ ...current, provider_code: event.target.value }))} className="input" disabled={BUILT_IN_PROVIDER_CODES.has(selectedGatewayCode)} />
                      </Field>
                      <Field label="Display Name">
                        <input value={gatewayForm.display_name} onChange={(event) => setGatewayForm((current) => ({ ...current, display_name: event.target.value }))} className="input" />
                      </Field>
                      <Field label="Gateway Kind">
                        <select value={gatewayForm.provider_kind} onChange={(event) => setGatewayForm((current) => ({ ...current, provider_kind: event.target.value as GatewayKind }))} className="input" disabled={BUILT_IN_PROVIDER_CODES.has(selectedGatewayCode)}>
                          <option value="stripe">Stripe</option>
                          <option value="tap">Tap</option>
                          <option value="custom">Custom</option>
                        </select>
                      </Field>
                      <Field label="Mode">
                        <select value={gatewayForm.mode} onChange={(event) => setGatewayForm((current) => ({ ...current, mode: event.target.value as GatewayMode }))} className="input">
                          <option value="test">Test</option>
                          <option value="live">Live</option>
                        </select>
                      </Field>
                      <Field label="Settlement Cycle">
                        <select value={gatewayForm.settlement_cycle} onChange={(event) => setGatewayForm((current) => ({ ...current, settlement_cycle: event.target.value as SettlementCycle }))} className="input">
                          <option value="daily">Daily</option>
                          <option value="weekly">Weekly</option>
                          <option value="monthly">Monthly</option>
                        </select>
                      </Field>
                    </div>
                  </FormSection>

                  <FormSection title="Credentials" description="Sensitive fields can stay blank to keep the currently stored secrets.">
                    <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 md:grid-cols-2">
                      <Field label="Public Key / Publishable Key">
                        <input value={gatewayForm.public_key} onChange={(event) => setGatewayForm((current) => ({ ...current, public_key: event.target.value }))} className="input" />
                      </Field>
                      <Field label="Merchant ID">
                        <input value={gatewayForm.merchant_id} onChange={(event) => setGatewayForm((current) => ({ ...current, merchant_id: event.target.value }))} className="input" />
                      </Field>
                      <Field label={`Secret Key${selectedGateway?.secret_key_configured ? " (stored)" : ""}`}>
                        <input value={gatewayForm.secret_key} onChange={(event) => setGatewayForm((current) => ({ ...current, secret_key: event.target.value }))} className="input" type="password" placeholder="Leave blank to keep current secret" />
                      </Field>
                      <Field label={`Webhook Secret${selectedGateway?.webhook_secret_configured ? " (stored)" : ""}`}>
                        <input value={gatewayForm.webhook_secret} onChange={(event) => setGatewayForm((current) => ({ ...current, webhook_secret: event.target.value }))} className="input" type="password" placeholder="Leave blank to keep current webhook secret" />
                      </Field>
                    </div>
                  </FormSection>

                  <FormSection title="Endpoints and Coverage" description="Configure API endpoints and currency coverage used by this connector.">
                    <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 md:grid-cols-2">
                      <Field label="API Base URL">
                        <input value={gatewayForm.api_base_url} onChange={(event) => setGatewayForm((current) => ({ ...current, api_base_url: event.target.value }))} className="input" placeholder="https://api.gateway.com" />
                      </Field>
                      <Field label="Webhook URL">
                        <input value={gatewayForm.webhook_url} onChange={(event) => setGatewayForm((current) => ({ ...current, webhook_url: event.target.value }))} className="input" placeholder="https://api.zoziom.com/payments/provider/webhook" />
                      </Field>
                      <Field label="Test URL">
                        <input value={gatewayForm.test_url} onChange={(event) => setGatewayForm((current) => ({ ...current, test_url: event.target.value }))} className="input" placeholder="https://api.gateway.com/health" />
                      </Field>
                      <Field label="Supported Currencies">
                        <input value={gatewayForm.supported_currencies} onChange={(event) => setGatewayForm((current) => ({ ...current, supported_currencies: event.target.value }))} className="input" placeholder="OMR,AED,USD" />
                      </Field>
                    </div>
                  </FormSection>

                  <FormSection title="Fee Rules" description="Set fee rules used in finance calculations and payout estimates.">
                    <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 md:grid-cols-4">
                      <Field label="Gateway Fee %">
                        <input value={gatewayForm.fee_percent} onChange={(event) => setGatewayForm((current) => ({ ...current, fee_percent: event.target.value }))} className="input" inputMode="decimal" />
                      </Field>
                      <Field label="Fixed Gateway Fee">
                        <input value={gatewayForm.fixed_fee_amount} onChange={(event) => setGatewayForm((current) => ({ ...current, fixed_fee_amount: event.target.value }))} className="input" inputMode="decimal" />
                      </Field>
                      <Field label="Payout Fee %">
                        <input value={gatewayForm.payout_fee_percent} onChange={(event) => setGatewayForm((current) => ({ ...current, payout_fee_percent: event.target.value }))} className="input" inputMode="decimal" />
                      </Field>
                      <Field label="Fixed Payout Fee">
                        <input value={gatewayForm.payout_fixed_fee_amount} onChange={(event) => setGatewayForm((current) => ({ ...current, payout_fixed_fee_amount: event.target.value }))} className="input" inputMode="decimal" />
                      </Field>
                    </div>
                  </FormSection>

                  <FormSection title="Capabilities" description="Toggle what this gateway supports in your commerce flow.">
                    <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-3 md:grid-cols-2">
                      <CheckboxRow label="Enabled" checked={gatewayForm.is_enabled} onChange={(checked) => setGatewayForm((current) => ({ ...current, is_enabled: checked }))} />
                      <CheckboxRow label="Supports customer checkout" checked={gatewayForm.supports_customer_checkout} onChange={(checked) => setGatewayForm((current) => ({ ...current, supports_customer_checkout: checked }))} />
                      <CheckboxRow label="Supports payouts" checked={gatewayForm.supports_payouts} onChange={(checked) => setGatewayForm((current) => ({ ...current, supports_payouts: checked }))} />
                      <CheckboxRow label="Pass fee to customer" checked={gatewayForm.pass_fee_to_customer} onChange={(checked) => setGatewayForm((current) => ({ ...current, pass_fee_to_customer: checked }))} />
                    </div>
                  </FormSection>

                  <FormSection title="Internal Notes" description="Save operational notes for your team.">
                    <Field label="Notes">
                      <textarea value={gatewayForm.notes} onChange={(event) => setGatewayForm((current) => ({ ...current, notes: event.target.value }))} className="input min-h-28" />
                    </Field>
                  </FormSection>
                </div>

                {selectedGateway && !selectedGateway.adapter_supported ? (
                  <div className="theme-chip-warning mt-4 rounded-xl px-4 py-3 text-xs">
                    Credentials and fee rules can be stored and tested here, but live checkout for this provider still needs a dedicated adapter implementation.
                  </div>
                ) : null}

                <div className="mt-6 flex flex-wrap gap-3 border-t border-border pt-5">
                  <button onClick={() => void handleGatewaySave()} disabled={savingGateway} className="theme-btn-primary inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-xl px-5 py-2.5 text-xs font-medium disabled:opacity-60">
                    <Save className="h-4 w-4" />
                    {savingGateway ? "Saving..." : "Save Gateway"}
                  </button>
                  <button onClick={() => void handleGatewayTest()} disabled={testingGateway} className="theme-panel inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-xl border px-5 py-2.5 text-xs text-text-muted hover:bg-surface-2 hover:text-text disabled:opacity-60">
                    <ShieldCheck className="h-4 w-4" />
                    {testingGateway ? "Testing..." : "Save and Test"}
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-6 xl:grid-cols-[0.9fr_1.1fr]">
              <div className="theme-card rounded-xl p-4">
                <div className="mb-5 flex items-center gap-3">
                  <Calculator className="h-5 w-5 theme-status-info" />
                  <div>
                    <h2 className="text-lg font-medium text-text">Order to Payout Preview</h2>
                    <p className="text-xs text-text-muted">Estimate processor fees, customer payable total, supplier payout, logistics payout, and platform net retention.</p>
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 md:grid-cols-2">
                  <Field label="Gateway">
                    <select value={quoteForm.gateway_code} onChange={(event) => setQuoteForm((current) => ({ ...current, gateway_code: event.target.value }))} className="input">
                      {gateways.map((gateway) => (
                        <option key={gateway.provider_code} value={gateway.provider_code}>{gateway.display_name}</option>
                      ))}
                    </select>
                  </Field>
                  <Field label="Subtotal">
                    <input value={quoteForm.subtotal_amount} onChange={(event) => setQuoteForm((current) => ({ ...current, subtotal_amount: event.target.value }))} className="input" inputMode="decimal" />
                  </Field>
                  <Field label="Discount">
                    <input value={quoteForm.discount_amount} onChange={(event) => setQuoteForm((current) => ({ ...current, discount_amount: event.target.value }))} className="input" inputMode="decimal" />
                  </Field>
                  <Field label="Shipping">
                    <input value={quoteForm.shipping_amount} onChange={(event) => setQuoteForm((current) => ({ ...current, shipping_amount: event.target.value }))} className="input" inputMode="decimal" />
                  </Field>
                  <Field label="VAT">
                    <input value={quoteForm.vat_amount} onChange={(event) => setQuoteForm((current) => ({ ...current, vat_amount: event.target.value }))} className="input" inputMode="decimal" />
                  </Field>
                </div>

                <button onClick={() => void handleQuotePreview()} disabled={quoting} className="theme-btn-primary mt-5 rounded-xl px-5 py-2.5 text-xs font-medium disabled:opacity-60">
                  {quoting ? "Calculating..." : "Calculate Preview"}
                </button>
              </div>

              <div className="theme-card rounded-xl p-4">
                <h2 className="text-lg font-medium text-text">Preview Result</h2>
                {!quote ? (
                  <div className="mt-4 rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface-1 p-4 text-xs text-text-muted">Run the calculator to preview how this gateway affects order totals, processor fees, and payout economics.</div>
                ) : (
                  <div className="mt-4 grid grid-cols-1 gap-3 md:grid-cols-2">
                    <QuoteMetric label="Gateway" value={quote.gateway_display_name || quote.gateway_code || "N/A"} />
                    <QuoteMetric label="Adapter" value={quote.adapter_supported ? "Live supported" : "Stored only"} />
                    <QuoteMetric label="Order total" value={formatMoney(quote.order_total)} />
                    <QuoteMetric label="Gateway fee" value={formatMoney(quote.gateway_fee_amount)} />
                    <QuoteMetric label="Customer pays" value={formatMoney(quote.customer_payable_total)} />
                    <QuoteMetric label="Processor net capture" value={formatMoney(quote.processor_net_capture)} />
                    <QuoteMetric label="Taxable product amount" value={formatMoney(quote.taxable_product_amount)} />
                    <QuoteMetric label="Zozi commission" value={formatMoney(quote.zozi_commission_amount)} />
                    <QuoteMetric label="Supplier payout" value={formatMoney(quote.supplier_payout_estimate)} />
                    <QuoteMetric label="Logistics payout" value={formatMoney(quote.logistics_payout_estimate)} />
                    <QuoteMetric label="Estimated payout cost" value={formatMoney(quote.estimated_payout_cost)} />
                    <QuoteMetric label="Platform net" value={formatMoney(quote.platform_net_after_gateway_and_payout_costs)} highlight />
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>
          </>
        )}
      </PanelContent>
    </AdminLayout>
  );
}

function labelForMode(mode: OnlineProviderMode): string {
  if (mode === "both") return "Both";
  if (mode === "tap") return "Tap Only";
  return "Stripe Only";
}

function humanizeProcessors(processors: string[]): string {
  if (!processors.length) return "Cash on Delivery only";
  return processors.map((processor) => (processor === "tap" ? "Tap" : processor === "stripe" ? "Stripe" : processor === "paytabs" ? "PayTabs" : processor)).join(" + ");
}

function StatusCard({ title, value, icon: Icon }: { title: string; value: string; icon: React.ComponentType<{ className?: string }> }) {
  return (
    <div className="theme-card rounded-xl border p-3">
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
        <div className="flex h-8 w-8 items-center justify-center rounded-lg bg-primary/10 text-primary">
          <Icon className="h-4 w-4" />
        </div>
        <div>
          <p className="text-[11px] uppercase tracking-[0.16em] text-text-faint">{title}</p>
          <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-text">{value}</p>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function Field({ label, children, className = "" }: { label: string; children: React.ReactNode; className?: string }) {
  return (
    <label className={`space-y-1 text-xs text-text-muted ${className}`}>
      <span className="font-medium text-text">{label}</span>
      {children}
    </label>
  );
}

function FormSection({ title, description, children }: { title: string; description: string; children: React.ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <section className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface-1 p-4">
      <div className="mb-4">
        <h3 className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.12em] text-text">{title}</h3>
        <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-text-muted">{description}</p>
      </div>
      {children}
    </section>
  );
}

function CheckboxRow({ label, checked, onChange }: { label: string; checked: boolean; onChange: (checked: boolean) => void }) {
  return (
    <label className="theme-panel flex items-center gap-3 rounded-xl border px-4 py-3 text-xs text-text-muted">
      <input type="checkbox" checked={checked} onChange={(event) => onChange(event.target.checked)} />
      <span className="font-medium text-text">{label}</span>
    </label>
  );
}

function InfoBlock({ title, detail }: { title: string; detail: string }) {
  return (
    <div className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface-1 p-4">
      <p className="font-medium text-text">{title}</p>
      <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-text-muted">{detail}</p>
    </div>
  );
}

function QuoteMetric({ label, value, highlight = false }: { label: string; value: string; highlight?: boolean }) {
  return (
    <div className={`rounded-xl border p-4 ${highlight ? "border-brand bg-brand/10" : "border-border bg-surface-1"}`}>
      <p className="text-xs text-text-muted">{label}</p>
      <p className="mt-1 text-lg font-bold text-text">{value}</p>
    </div>
  );
}

  const visibleReasons = skippedDetails

function buildQueryString(params: Record<string, string | number | undefined | null>) {

}

function statusForSupplier(supplier: SupplierRecord): string {
  if (supplier.is_deleted) return "deleted";
  const verificationStatus = supplier.profile?.verification_status || "pending";
  if (!Boolean(supplier.is_active) && verificationStatus === "archived") return "archived";
  if (!Boolean(supplier.is_active)) return "suspended";
  if (verificationStatus === "verified" || verificationStatus === "approved") return "approved";
  if (supplier.is_verified && verificationStatus === "pending") return "approved";
  return verificationStatus;
}

function safeDate(value?: string | null): string {
  if (!value) return "-";
  const date = new Date(value);
  return Number.isNaN(date.getTime()) ? "-" : date.toLocaleDateString();
}

function safeDateTime(value?: string | null): string {
  if (!value) return "-";
  const date = new Date(value);

}

function parseDetails(details?: string | null): string {
  if (!details) return "-";
  try {
    const parsed = JSON.parse(details) as Record<string, unknown>;
    return Object.entries(parsed)
      .slice(0, 4)
      .map(([key, value]) => `${key}: ${typeof value === "object" ? JSON.stringify(value) : String(value)}`)
      .join(" | ") || "-";
  } catch {
    return details;
  }
}

function parseCsvRows(text: string): string[][] {
  const rows: string[][] = [];
  let currentCell = "";
  let currentRow: string[] = [];
  let insideQuotes = false;

  for (let index = 0; index < text.length; index += 1) {
    const character = text[index];
    const nextCharacter = text[index + 1];
    if (character === '"') {
      if (insideQuotes && nextCharacter === '"') {
        currentCell += '"';
        index += 1;
      } else {
        insideQuotes = !insideQuotes;
      }
      continue;
    }
    if (character === "," && !insideQuotes) {
      currentRow.push(currentCell.trim());
      currentCell = "";
      continue;
    }
    if ((character === "\n" || character === "\r") && !insideQuotes) {
      if (character === "\r" && nextCharacter === "\n") index += 1;
      currentRow.push(currentCell.trim());
      currentCell = "";
      if (currentRow.some((cell) => cell.length > 0)) rows.push(currentRow);
      currentRow = [];
      continue;
    }
    currentCell += character;
  }

  if (currentCell.length > 0 || currentRow.length > 0) {
    currentRow.push(currentCell.trim());
    if (currentRow.some((cell) => cell.length > 0)) rows.push(currentRow);
  }

  return rows;
}

function generateTemporaryPassword(seed: string) {

function downloadCsvFile(filename: string, rows: Array<Record<string, unknown>>) {
  if (!rows.length) return;
  const columns = Array.from(
    rows.reduce((set, row) => {
      Object.keys(row).forEach((key) => set.add(key));
      return set;
    }, new Set<string>()),
  );
  const csv = [
    columns.join(","),
    ...rows.map((row) =>
      columns
        .map((column) => {
          const value = row[column] == null ? "" : String(row[column]);
          return /[",\n]/.test(value) ? `"${value.replace(/"/g, '""')}"` : value;
        })
        .join(","),
    ),
  ].join("\n");
  const blob = new Blob([csv], { type: "text/csv;charset=utf-8;" });
  const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  const anchor = document.createElement("a");
  anchor.href = url;
  anchor.download = filename;
  document.body.appendChild(anchor);
  anchor.click();
  anchor.remove();
  URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
}
