          });
          const payload = await response.json().catch(() => null);
          if (!response.ok) {
            throw new Error(payload?.detail || "Could not verify Thawani payment.");
          }

          const status = String(payload?.status || "").toLowerCase();
          if (status === "confirmed") {
            finalStatus = "confirmed";
            break;
          }
          if (["failed", "cancelled"].includes(status)) {
            finalStatus = "failed";
            break;
          }

          if (attempt < 5) {
            await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, (attempt + 1) * 1000));
          }
        }

        if (cancelled) return;

        setOrderId(thawaniOrderId);
        setHandledThawaniRedirectOrderId(thawaniOrderId);
        if (typeof window !== "undefined") {
          window.history.replaceState({}, "", "/checkout");
        }

        if (finalStatus === "confirmed") {
          clearCart();
          setSuccess(true);
          addToast("Thawani Pay payment confirmed. Your order has been placed.", "success");
          return;
        }
        if (finalStatus === "failed") {
          setError("Thawani Pay payment was not completed. You can retry checkout or review the order in My Orders.");
          return;
        }
        setError("Thawani Pay payment is still being verified. Check My Orders shortly for the final status.");
        addToast("Thawani Pay payment is still being verified in the background.", "info");
      } catch (err) {
        if (cancelled) return;
        setHandledThawaniRedirectOrderId(thawaniOrderId);
        if (typeof window !== "undefined") {
          window.history.replaceState({}, "", "/checkout");
        }
        setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Could not verify Thawani payment.");
      } finally {
        if (!cancelled) setProcessing(false);
      }
    };

    void verifyThawaniRedirectOrder();
    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
    };
  }, [addToast, clearCart, handledThawaniRedirectOrderId, isLoggedIn, searchParams]);

  const confirmCardPaymentOnBackend = async (orderId: number, paymentIntentId?: string): Promise<"confirmed" | "pending"> => {
    for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 5; attempt += 1) {
      const response = await apiFetch("/payments/confirm-card-payment", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          order_id: orderId,
          payment_intent_id: paymentIntentId,
        }),
      });
      const payload = await response.json().catch(() => null);

      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error(payload?.detail || "Could not confirm payment with Zozi.");
      }

      if (payload?.status === "confirmed") return "confirmed";
      if (payload?.status === "failed") {
        throw new Error("Payment verification failed. Please retry checkout or contact support.");
      }

      if (attempt < 4) {
        await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, (attempt + 1) * 700));
      }
    }
    return "pending";
  };

  const handleCardSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!paymentMethods.card.enabled) {
      setError("Card payments are not configured yet.");
      return;
    }
    if (!stripe || !elements) {
      setError("Card payments are not configured yet.");
      return;
    }
    setError("");
    setProcessing(true);

    try {
      const order = await createOrder("card");

      const piRes = await apiFetch("/payments/create-payment-intent", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          order_id: order.id,
          currency: currency.code,
          country: deliveryDetails.country,
        }),
      });

      if (!piRes.ok) {
        const detail = await piRes.json().catch(() => null);
        setError(detail?.detail || "Could not create payment. Please try again.");
        return;
      }

      const { client_secret } = await piRes.json();

      const { error: stripeErr, paymentIntent } = await stripe.confirmCardPayment(
        client_secret,
        {
          payment_method: {
            card: elements.getElement(CardElement)!,
            billing_details: { name: deliveryDetails.fullName },
          },
        }
      );

      if (stripeErr) {
        setError(stripeErr.message || "Payment failed");
        return;
      }

      const confirmationStatus = await confirmCardPaymentOnBackend(order.id, paymentIntent?.id);
      clearCart();
      setSuccess(true);
      if (confirmationStatus === "confirmed") {
        addToast("Order placed successfully!", "success");
      } else {
        addToast("Payment received. Final order confirmation is processing in the background.", "info");
      }
    } catch {
      setError("An unexpected error occurred.");
    } finally {
      setProcessing(false);
    }
  };

  const handleCashOnDeliverySubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setError("");
    setProcessing(true);

    try {
      await createOrder("cod");
      clearCart();
      setSuccess(true);
      addToast("Cash on delivery order placed successfully!", "success");
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : "An unexpected error occurred.");
    } finally {
      setProcessing(false);
    }
  };

  const handleTapSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!paymentMethods.tap.enabled) {
      setError("Tap payments are not configured yet.");
      return;
    }
    setError("");
    setProcessing(true);
    try {
      const order = await createOrder("tap");
      const tapSuccessUrl = `${window.location.origin}/checkout?tap_order_id=${order.id}`;
      const tapRes = await apiFetch("/payments/tap/create", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          order_id: order.id,
          currency: currency.code,
          country: deliveryDetails.country,
          success_url: tapSuccessUrl,
        }),
      });
      if (tapRes.ok) {
        const tapData = await tapRes.json();
        if (tapData.redirect_url) {
          window.location.href = tapData.redirect_url;
          return;
        }
        setError("Could not get Tap redirect URL.");
        return;
      }

      const detail = await tapRes.json().catch(() => null);
      setError(detail?.detail || "Tap payment failed.");
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : "An unexpected error occurred.");
    } finally {
      setProcessing(false);
    }
  };

  const handlePayTabsSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!paymentMethods.paytabs.enabled) {
      setError("PayTabs is not configured yet.");
      return;
    }
    setError("");
    setProcessing(true);
    try {
      const order = await createOrder("paytabs");
      const payTabsSuccessUrl = `${window.location.origin}/checkout?paytabs_order_id=${order.id}`;
      const payTabsRes = await apiFetch("/payments/paytabs/create", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          order_id: order.id,
          currency: currency.code,
          country: deliveryDetails.country,
          success_url: payTabsSuccessUrl,
        }),
      });
      if (payTabsRes.ok) {
        const payTabsData = await payTabsRes.json();
        if (payTabsData.redirect_url) {
          window.location.href = payTabsData.redirect_url;
          return;
        }
        setError("Could not get PayTabs redirect URL.");
        return;
      }

      const detail = await payTabsRes.json().catch(() => null);
      setError(detail?.detail || "PayTabs payment failed.");
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : "An unexpected error occurred.");
    } finally {
      setProcessing(false);
    }
  };

  const handleThawaniSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!paymentMethods.thawani.enabled) {
      setError("Thawani Pay is not configured yet.");
      return;
    }
    setError("");
    setProcessing(true);
    try {
      const order = await createOrder("thawani");
      const thawaniSuccessUrl = `${window.location.origin}/checkout?thawani_order_id=${order.id}`;
      const thawaniRes = await apiFetch("/payments/thawani/checkout", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          order_id: order.id,
          currency: currency.code,
          country: deliveryDetails.country,
          success_url: thawaniSuccessUrl,
          cancel_url: `${window.location.origin}/checkout`,
        }),
      });
      if (thawaniRes.ok) {
        const thawaniData = await thawaniRes.json();
        if (thawaniData.checkout_url) {
          window.location.href = thawaniData.checkout_url;
          return;
        }
        setError("Could not get Thawani checkout URL.");
        return;
      }
      const detail = await thawaniRes.json().catch(() => null);
      setError(detail?.detail || "Thawani Pay checkout failed.");
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : "An unexpected error occurred.");
    } finally {
      setProcessing(false);
    }
  };

  if (success) {
    return (
      <motion.div
        initial={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.95 }}
        animate={{ opacity: 1, scale: 1 }}
        className="text-center py-16"
      >
        <div className="theme-alert-success mx-auto mb-4 flex h-16 w-16 items-center justify-center rounded-full">
          <CheckCircle className="theme-status-success h-8 w-8" />
        </div>
        <h2 className="text-xl font-bold text-text mb-2">Order Confirmed!</h2>
        <p className="text-text-muted text-xs mb-6">
          Your order has been placed successfully. You can track fulfilment from your orders page.
        </p>
        <div className="flex gap-3 justify-center">
          <button
            onClick={() => orderId ? router.push(`/orders/${orderId}`) : router.push("/orders")}
            className="theme-btn-primary rounded-xl px-5 py-2.5 text-xs font-bold"
          >
            View Order Details
          </button>
          <button
            onClick={() => router.push("/orders")}
            className="theme-btn-secondary rounded-xl border px-5 py-2.5 text-xs font-bold"
          >
            {tr("myOrders")}
          </button>
        </div>
      </motion.div>
    );
  }

  // ── Mini order summary (shown on all steps) ────────────────────────────────
  const renderOrderSummaryPanel = () => (
    <div className="glass-panel p-4 space-y-2">
      <h3 className="text-xs font-bold text-text mb-3">{tr("orderSummary")}</h3>
      {items.slice(0, 3).map((item) => (
        <div key={item.line_id} className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs">
          <span className="text-text-muted truncate max-w-40">
            {item.name} × {item.quantity}
            {(item.selected_size || item.selected_color) ? ` (${[item.selected_size, item.selected_color].filter(Boolean).join(" / ")})` : ""}
          </span>
          <span className="font-medium text-text">
            {formatPrice(Number(item.price ?? 0) * item.quantity)}
          </span>
        </div>
      ))}
      {items.length > 3 && (
        <p className="text-[11px] text-text-faint">+{items.length - 3} more items</p>
      )}
      <div className="border-t border-border pt-2 space-y-1">
        <div className="flex justify-between text-xs text-text-muted">
          <span>{tr("subtotal")}</span>
          <span>{formatPrice(subtotal)}</span>
        </div>
        {discountAmount > 0 && (
          <div className="theme-status-success flex justify-between text-xs">
            <span>Coupon discount</span>
            <span>-{formatPrice(discountAmount)}</span>
          </div>
        )}
        <div className="flex justify-between text-xs text-text-muted">
          <span>{tr("shipping")}</span>
          <span>{formatPrice(shippingAmount)}</span>
        </div>
        {shippingQuote?.source === "approved_logistics_partner" && shippingQuote.partner_name && !serverOrder ? (
          <div className="flex justify-between text-[11px] text-text-faint">
            <span>Logistics rate</span>
            <span>{shippingQuote.partner_name}</span>
          </div>
        ) : null}
        {shippingQuote?.source === "approved_logistics_partner" && !serverOrder && (
          shippingQuote.estimated_delivery_min != null || shippingQuote.estimated_delivery_max != null
        ) ? (
          <div className="flex justify-between text-[11px] text-text-faint">
            <span>Estimated delivery</span>
            <span>
              {shippingQuote.estimated_delivery_min ?? "?"}-{shippingQuote.estimated_delivery_max ?? "?"} days
            </span>
          </div>
        ) : null}
        <div className="flex justify-between text-xs text-text-muted">
          <span>{vatLabel}</span>
          <span>{formatPrice(vatAmount)}</span>
        </div>
        {paymentMethod !== "cod" && finalGatewayFee > 0 ? (
          <div className="flex justify-between text-xs text-text-muted">
            <span>
              {selectedMethodMeta.label || paymentMethod}
              {finalGatewayFeePassedToCustomer ? " fee" : " fee (covered by Zozi)"}
            </span>
            <span>{formatPrice(finalGatewayFee)}</span>
          </div>
        ) : null}
        <div className="flex justify-between text-sm font-bold text-text border-t border-border pt-2 mt-1">
          <span>{finalGatewayFeePassedToCustomer ? "Customer pays" : tr("total")}</span>
          <span>{formatPrice(finalCustomerTotal)}</span>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
        <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-3 justify-center glass-panel p-3">
        <span className="trust-badge"><Lock className="w-3 h-3 text-primary" /> SSL Protected</span>
        <span className="trust-badge"><CheckCircle className="w-3 h-3 text-primary" /> Secure Payment</span>
        <span className="trust-badge"><Shield className="w-3 h-3 text-primary/70" /> Verified Supplier</span>
      </div>
      <StepIndicator step={step} />

      {error && (
        <div className="theme-alert-danger flex items-center gap-2 rounded-xl p-3 text-xs">
          <AlertCircle className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0" />
          {error}
        </div>
      )}

      <AnimatePresence mode="wait">
        {/* ── Step 1: Cart Review + Coupon ────────────────────────────────── */}
        {step === 1 && (
          <motion.div
            key="step1"
            initial={{ opacity: 0, x: 20 }}
            animate={{ opacity: 1, x: 0 }}
            exit={{ opacity: 0, x: -20 }}
            className="space-y-4"
          >
            {/* Cart items */}
            <div className="glass-panel p-4 space-y-3">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-1">
                <ShoppingBag className="w-4 h-4 text-primary" />
                <h3 className="text-xs font-bold text-text">
                  Your Cart ({items.length} item{items.length !== 1 ? "s" : ""})
                </h3>
              </div>
              {items.length === 0 ? (
                <p className="text-xs text-text-muted">Your cart is empty.</p>
              ) : (
                items.map((item) => (
                  <div key={item.line_id} className="flex items-center gap-3">
                    {item.image_url && (
                      <Image
                        src={resolveImage(item.image_url)}
                        alt={item.name}
                        width={40}
                        height={40}
                        className="h-10 w-10 rounded-lg bg-border object-cover"
                      />
                    )}
                    <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                      <p className="text-xs font-medium text-text truncate">{item.name}</p>
                      <p className="text-[11px] text-text-muted">Qty: {item.quantity}</p>
                    </div>
                    <span className="text-xs font-bold text-text">
                      {formatPrice(Number(item.price ?? 0) * item.quantity)}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                ))
              )}
            </div>

            {/* Coupon */}
            <div className="glass-panel p-4">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-3">
                <Tag className="theme-status-warning h-4 w-4" />
                <h3 className="text-xs font-bold text-text">{tr("couponCode")}</h3>
              </div>
              <div className="flex gap-2">
                <input
                  value={couponCode}
                  onChange={(e) => {
                    setCouponCode(e.target.value);
                    setCouponResult(null);
                    setCouponError("");
                  }}
                  placeholder="Enter coupon code"
                  className="theme-input flex-1 rounded-xl border px-3 py-2 text-xs uppercase focus:border-primary focus:outline-none transition-colors"
                />
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={applyCoupon}
                  disabled={couponLoading || !couponCode.trim()}
                  className="theme-btn-primary rounded-xl px-4 py-2 text-xs font-bold disabled:opacity-50"
                >
                  {couponLoading ? "..." : tr("applyCoupon")}
                </button>
              </div>
              {couponError && <p className="theme-status-danger mt-2 text-[11px]">{couponError}</p>}
              {couponResult && (
                <p className="theme-status-success mt-2 text-[11px]">

            {paymentMethod === "paytabs" && (
              <form onSubmit={handlePayTabsSubmit}>
                <div className="glass-panel p-4 mb-4">
                  <p className="text-xs text-text-muted">
                    You will be redirected to PayTabs to complete your payment securely.
                  </p>
                </div>

                {renderOrderSummaryPanel()}

                <div className="flex gap-3 mt-4">
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={handleBack}
                    className="theme-btn-secondary flex items-center gap-2 rounded-xl border px-5 py-3 text-sm font-bold"
                  >
                    <ChevronLeft className="w-4 h-4" />
                    Back
                  </button>
                  <button
                    type="submit"
                    disabled={processing || !paymentMethods.paytabs.enabled}
                    className="btn-place-order flex flex-1 items-center justify-center gap-2 py-3 text-sm font-bold disabled:opacity-50"

                    {processing ? (
                      <div className="btn-spinner" />

                      <CreditCard className="w-4 h-4" />
                    )}
                    {processing ? "Redirecting..." : `Pay ${formatPrice(finalCustomerTotal)} via PayTabs`}
                  </button>
                </div>
              </form>
            )}

            {paymentMethod === "thawani" && (
              <form onSubmit={handleThawaniSubmit}>
                <div className="glass-panel p-4 mb-4">
                  <p className="text-xs text-text-muted">
                    You will be redirected to Thawani Pay to complete your payment securely.
                  </p>
                  <p className="text-[11px] text-text-faint mt-1">
                    Amount is processed in your active checkout currency ({currency.code}).
                  </p>
                </div>

                {renderOrderSummaryPanel()}

                <div className="flex gap-3 mt-4">
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={handleBack}
                    className="theme-btn-secondary flex items-center gap-2 rounded-xl border px-5 py-3 text-sm font-bold"
                  >
                    <ChevronLeft className="w-4 h-4" />
                    Back
                  </button>
                  <button
                    type="submit"
                    disabled={processing || !paymentMethods.thawani.enabled}
                    className="btn-place-order flex flex-1 items-center justify-center gap-2 py-3 text-sm font-bold disabled:opacity-50"
                  >
                    {processing ? (
                      <div className="btn-spinner" />
                    ) : (
                      <CreditCard className="w-4 h-4" />
                    )}
                    {processing ? "Redirecting to Thawani..." : `Pay via Thawani Pay`}
                  </button>
                </div>
              </form>
            )}
          </motion.div>
        )}
      </AnimatePresence>
    </div>
  );
}

export default function CheckoutPage() {
  const tr = useLocaleStore((s) => s.t);
  return (
    <main className="min-h-screen">
      <div className="max-w-lg mx-auto px-4 py-8">

          {tr("checkout")}
        </motion.h1>
        <Elements stripe={stripePromise}>

        </Elements>

  if (!selected) return null;
  const latitudes = locations.map((location) => location.latitude);
  const longitudes = locations.map((location) => location.longitude);
  const latPad = Math.max(0.02, (Math.max(...latitudes) - Math.min(...latitudes)) * 0.25 || 0.02);
  const lngPad = Math.max(0.02, (Math.max(...longitudes) - Math.min(...longitudes)) * 0.25 || 0.02);
  const minLat = Math.min(...latitudes, selected.latitude) - latPad;
  const maxLat = Math.max(...latitudes, selected.latitude) + latPad;
  const minLng = Math.min(...longitudes, selected.longitude) - lngPad;
  const maxLng = Math.max(...longitudes, selected.longitude) + lngPad;
  return `https://www.openstreetmap.org/export/embed.html?bbox=${minLng}%2C${minLat}%2C${maxLng}%2C${maxLat}&layer=mapnik&marker=${selected.latitude}%2C${selected.longitude}`;
}

function buildLogisticsSocketUrl(): string | null {
  if (typeof window === "undefined") return null;
  const token = getAccessToken();
  if (!token) return null;
  const base = API_URL.replace(/^http/i, "ws").replace(/\/$/, "");
  return `${base}/ws/logistics?scope=partner&token=${encodeURIComponent(token)}`;
}

export default function LogisticsPartnerDashboardPage() {
  const { density } = useDensity();
  const cellPad = dc(density, "px-1.5 py-1", "px-2 py-1.5", "px-3 py-2");
  const bodyText = dc(density, "text-[10px]", "text-[11px]", "text-xs");
  const [data, setData] = useState<DashboardData | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [refreshing, setRefreshing] = useState(false);
  const [selectedShipmentId, setSelectedShipmentId] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const hasLoadedRef = useRef(false);
  const requestInFlightRef = useRef<Promise<void> | null>(null);
  const locale = useLocaleStore((s) => s.locale);
  const isRtl = isRtlLocale(locale);
  const formatPrice = useCurrencyStore((s) => s.format);

  // Quote calculator state
  const [calcExpanded, setCalcExpanded] = useState(false);
  const [calcCountry, setCalcCountry] = useState("");
  const [calcCity, setCalcCity] = useState("");
  const [calcWeight, setCalcWeight] = useState("");
  const [calcLoading, setCalcLoading] = useState(false);
  const [calcResult, setCalcResult] = useState<ShippingQuoteResult | null>(null);
  const [calcError, setCalcError] = useState("");

  const handleCalcQuote = useCallback(async () => {
    setCalcLoading(true);
    setCalcError("");
    setCalcResult(null);
    try {
      const res = await apiFetch("/logistics-partners/shipping-quote", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          country: calcCountry,
          city: calcCity,
          total_weight_kg: parseFloat(calcWeight) || 0,
        }),
      });
      const payload = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error(payload.detail || "Quote failed");
      setCalcResult(payload as ShippingQuoteResult);
    } catch (err) {
      setCalcError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Could not compute quote");
    } finally {
      setCalcLoading(false);
    }
  }, [calcCountry, calcCity, calcWeight]);

  const fetchDashboard = useCallback(async (mode: "initial" | "background" | "manual" = "initial") => {
    if (requestInFlightRef.current) {
      return requestInFlightRef.current;
    }

    if (mode === "initial" && !hasLoadedRef.current) {
      setLoading(true);
    } else {
      setRefreshing(true);
    }

    const requestPromise = (async () => {
      const res = await apiFetch("/logistics-partners/dashboard").catch(() => null);
      if (res?.ok) {
        const nextData = normalizeDashboardData(await res.json());
        setData(nextData);
      }
      hasLoadedRef.current = true;
    })()
      .finally(() => {
        requestInFlightRef.current = null;
        setLoading(false);
        setRefreshing(false);
      });

    requestInFlightRef.current = requestPromise;
    return requestPromise;
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    void fetchDashboard("initial");
  }, [fetchDashboard]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!data?.live_locations?.length) {
      setSelectedShipmentId(null);
      return;
    }
    setSelectedShipmentId((current) => {
      if (current && data.live_locations.some((location) => location.shipment_id === current)) {
        return current;
      }
      return data.live_locations[0].shipment_id;
    });
  }, [data]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const socketUrl = buildLogisticsSocketUrl();
    if (!socketUrl) return;
    const scheduler = createRealtimeRefreshScheduler(() => fetchDashboard("background"), 900);
    const handle = openRealtimeSocket(socketUrl, {
      onMessage: () => {
        scheduler.trigger();
      },
    });
    return () => {
      scheduler.cancel();
      handle.close();
    };
  }, [fetchDashboard]);

  const selectedLocation = useMemo(() => {
    if (!data?.live_locations?.length) return null;
    return data.live_locations.find((location) => location.shipment_id === selectedShipmentId) ?? data.live_locations[0];
  }, [data, selectedShipmentId]);

  const mapEmbedUrl = useMemo(
    () => buildMapEmbedUrl(data?.live_locations ?? [], selectedLocation),
    [data, selectedLocation],
  );

  return (
    <LogisticsPartnerLayout title="Dashboard">
        <PanelContent className="space-y-3" dir={isRtl ? "rtl" : "ltr"}>
        <PanelHero
          eyebrow="Operations"
          title={<TranslatedText text="Shipment Operations" />}
          description={<TranslatedText text="Live fleet activity, SLA compliance, and delivery operations." />}
          actions={
            <>
              <Link href="/logistics-partner/payouts" className="theme-btn-accent rounded-xl px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-bold">
                <TranslatedText text="Open Payouts" />
              </Link>
              <button
                onClick={() => {
                  void fetchDashboard("manual");
                }}
                className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface-2 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-text-muted transition-colors hover:text-text"
              >
                <RefreshCw className={`h-3.5 w-3.5 ${loading || refreshing ? "animate-spin" : ""}`} />
                <TranslatedText text="Refresh" />
              </button>
            </>
          }
        />

        {/* Stats strip */}
        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 sm:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-5">
          {loading || !data
            ? Array.from({ length: 5 }).map((_, index) => (
                <div key={index} className="h-14 animate-pulse rounded-xl bg-surface-2" />
              ))
            : STAT_CARDS.map((card, index) => (
                <motion.div
                  key={card.key}
                  initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 6 }}
                  animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
                  transition={{ delay: index * 0.04 }}
                  className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface p-2.5"
                >
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-1 mb-0.5">
                    <span className={`rounded-lg px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold ${card.chip}`}>
                      <TranslatedText text={card.label} />
                    </span>
                    <card.icon className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-primary" />
                  </div>
                  <p className="text-xs font-bold text-text">{data.stats[card.key]}</p>
                </motion.div>
              ))}
        </div>

        {loading || !data ? (
          <div className="grid gap-3 xl:grid-cols-[1.35fr_0.95fr]">
            <div className="space-y-3">
              {Array.from({ length: 3 }).map((_, i) => (
                <div key={i} className="h-32 animate-pulse rounded-xl bg-surface-2" />
              ))}
            </div>
            <div className="space-y-3">
              {Array.from({ length: 2 }).map((_, i) => (
                <div key={i} className="h-24 animate-pulse rounded-xl bg-surface-2" />
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <>
            <div className="grid gap-3 xl:grid-cols-[1.35fr_0.95fr]">
              <div className="space-y-3">
                <div className="theme-card rounded-xl border p-3">
                  <div className="mb-2 flex items-center gap-2">
                    <BarChart3 className="h-4 w-4 text-primary" />
                    <h3 className="text-xs font-bold text-text"><TranslatedText text="Operational Analytics" /></h3>
                  </div>
                    <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-1.5 lg:grid-cols-4">
                      {ANALYTICS_CARDS.map((card) => (
                        <div key={card.key} className="rounded-lg border border-border bg-surface-2/50 px-2 py-1.5">
                          <p className="text-xs font-bold text-text">{card.format(data.analytics[card.key])}</p>
                          <p className="text-[11px] text-text-muted"><TranslatedText text={card.label} /></p>
                      </div>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                  {Object.keys(data.analytics.status_breakdown).length > 0 && (
                    <div className="mt-2 grid grid-cols-2 gap-1.5 lg:grid-cols-4">
                      {Object.entries(data.analytics.status_breakdown).map(([status, count]) => (
                        <div key={status} className="rounded-lg border border-border bg-surface-2/50 px-2 py-1.5">
                          <p className="text-xs font-bold text-text">{count}</p>
                          <p className="text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-text-faint">
                            <TranslatedText text={status.replace(/_/g, " ")} />
                          </p>
                        </div>
                      ))}
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>

                <div className="theme-card rounded-xl border p-3">
                  <div className="mb-2 flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                      <MapPinned className="h-4 w-4 text-primary" />
                      <h3 className="text-xs font-bold text-text"><TranslatedText text="Live Fleet Map" /></h3>
                    </div>
                    <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-full bg-primary/10 px-2.5 py-1 text-[11px] font-semibold text-primary">
                      <Radio className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                      {data.live_locations.length} live pings
                    </span>
                  </div>
                  {selectedLocation && mapEmbedUrl ? (
                    <>
                      <div className="overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface-2">
                        <iframe
                          title="Live fleet map"
                          src={mapEmbedUrl}
                          className="h-48 w-full border-0"
                          loading="lazy"
                          referrerPolicy="no-referrer-when-downgrade"
                        />
                      </div>
                      <div className="mt-2 flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">
                        {data.live_locations.map((location) => (
                          <button
                            key={location.shipment_id}
                            onClick={() => setSelectedShipmentId(location.shipment_id)}
                            className={`rounded-lg border px-2 py-1 text-left text-xs transition-colors ${selectedShipmentId === location.shipment_id ? "border-primary bg-primary/10 text-primary" : "border-border bg-surface-2 text-text-muted hover:text-text"}`}
                          >
                            <span className="block font-semibold text-[11px]">#{location.shipment_id}</span>
                            <span className="block text-[10px] text-text-faint">{location.current_hub || location.location || location.tracking_number || "GPS"}</span>
                          </button>
                        ))}
                      </div>
                      <div className="mt-2 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface-2/50 px-3 py-2 text-xs text-text-muted">
                        <div>
                          <p className="font-semibold text-text">Shipment #{selectedLocation.shipment_id}</p>
                          <p>{selectedLocation.current_hub || selectedLocation.location || "No hub recorded"}</p>
                          <p className="tabular-nums">{selectedLocation.latitude.toFixed(4)}, {selectedLocation.longitude.toFixed(4)}</p>
                        </div>
                        <a
                          href={buildMapHref(selectedLocation)}
                          target="_blank"
                          rel="noreferrer"
                          className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 font-semibold text-primary hover:underline"
                        >
                          Open full map <ExternalLink className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                        </a>
                      </div>
                    </>
                  ) : (
                    <div className="rounded-xl border border-dashed border-border bg-surface-2/40 px-4 py-8 text-center text-xs text-text-muted">
                      <TranslatedText text="No GPS checkpoints have been received yet for active shipments." />
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>

                <div className="theme-card overflow-hidden rounded-xl border">
                  <div className="border-b border-border px-3 py-2">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                      <Package className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-primary" />
                      <h3 className="text-xs font-bold text-text"><TranslatedText text="Active Shipments" /></h3>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  {data.active_shipments.length === 0 ? (
                    <div className="p-5 text-center text-xs text-text-muted"><TranslatedText text="No active shipments" /></div>
                  ) : (
                    <div className="overflow-x-auto">
                      <table className="w-full text-xs">
                        <thead>
                          <tr className="border-b border-border bg-surface-2/40">
                            {["Order", "Tracking", "Carrier", "Status", "Hub", "ETA"].map((heading) => (
                              <th key={heading} className={`${cellPad} text-left text-[11px] font-semibold text-text-faint uppercase tracking-wide`}><TranslatedText text={heading} /></th>
                            ))}
                          </tr>
                        </thead>
                        <tbody>
                          {data.active_shipments.map((shipment) => (
                            <tr key={shipment.id} className="border-b border-border/40 last:border-0 transition-colors hover:bg-surface-2/40">
                              <td className={`${cellPad} ${bodyText} text-text-muted tabular-nums`}>#{shipment.order_id}</td>
                              <td className={`${cellPad} font-mono ${bodyText} text-text`}>{shipment.tracking_number ?? "\u2014"}</td>
                              <td className={`${cellPad} ${bodyText} text-text-muted`}>{shipment.carrier_name ?? "\u2014"}</td>
                              <td className={cellPad}>
                                <span className="theme-chip-warning rounded-md px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-semibold">
                                  {shipment.status.replace(/_/g, " ")}
                                </span>
                              </td>
                              <td className={`${cellPad} ${bodyText} text-text-muted`}>{shipment.current_hub ?? "\u2014"}</td>
                              <td className={`${cellPad} ${bodyText} text-text-muted tabular-nums`}>
                                {shipment.estimated_delivery ? new Date(shipment.estimated_delivery).toLocaleDateString() : "—"}
                              </td>
                            </tr>
                          ))}
                        </tbody>
                      </table>
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="space-y-3">
                <div className="theme-card rounded-xl border p-3">
                  <div className="mb-2 flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                      <Wallet className="h-4 w-4 text-primary" />
                      <h3 className="text-xs font-bold text-text"><TranslatedText text="Revenue & Payouts" /></h3>
                    </div>
                    <Link href="/logistics-partner/payouts" className="text-xs font-semibold text-primary hover:underline">
                      <TranslatedText text="Manage payouts" />
                    </Link>
                  </div>
                  <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-1.5">
                    <div className="rounded-lg border border-border bg-surface-2/50 px-2 py-1.5">
                      <p className="text-xs font-bold text-text">{formatPrice(data.payout_summary.total_earned)}</p>
                      <p className="text-xs text-text-muted"><TranslatedText text="Total earned" /></p>
                    </div>
                    <div className="rounded-lg border border-border bg-surface-2/50 px-2 py-1.5">
                      <p className="text-xs font-bold text-text">{formatPrice(data.payout_summary.available_balance)}</p>
                      <p className="text-xs text-text-muted"><TranslatedText text="Available balance" /></p>
                    </div>
                    <div className="rounded-lg border border-border bg-surface-2/50 px-2 py-1.5">
                      <p className="text-xs font-bold text-text">{formatPrice(data.payout_summary.pending_amount)}</p>
                      <p className="text-xs text-text-muted"><TranslatedText text="Pending" /></p>
                    </div>
                    <div className="rounded-lg border border-border bg-surface-2/50 px-2 py-1.5">
                      <p className="text-xs font-bold text-text">{formatPrice(data.payout_summary.completed_amount)}</p>
                      <p className="text-xs text-text-muted"><TranslatedText text="Completed" /></p>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <div className="mt-2 space-y-1.5">
                    {data.payout_summary.recent_payouts.length === 0 ? (
                      <p className="text-xs text-text-muted"><TranslatedText text="No payout requests yet." /></p>
                    ) : (
                      data.payout_summary.recent_payouts.map((payout) => (
                        <div key={payout.id} className="flex items-center justify-between rounded-lg border border-border bg-surface-2/40 px-2 py-1.5 text-xs">
                          <div>
                            <p className="font-semibold text-text">{formatPrice(payout.amount)}</p>
                            <p className="text-[10px] text-text-muted">{payout.method || "bank"}</p>
                          </div>
                          <span className="theme-chip-info rounded-md px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-semibold capitalize">
                            {payout.status}
                          </span>
                        </div>
                      ))
                    )}
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* ── Recent Earnings Breakdown ─────────────────────────── */}
                <div className="theme-card rounded-xl border p-3">
                  <div className="mb-2 flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                      <TrendingUp className="h-4 w-4 text-primary" />
                      <h3 className="text-xs font-bold text-text"><TranslatedText text="Recent Earnings" /></h3>
                    </div>
                    <Link href="/logistics-partner/payouts" className="text-xs font-semibold text-primary hover:underline">
                      <TranslatedText text="View all" />
                    </Link>
                  </div>
                  {data.payout_summary.recent_earnings.length === 0 ? (
                    <p className="text-xs text-text-muted"><TranslatedText text="No delivered shipments yet." /></p>
                  ) : (
                    <div className="space-y-1.5">
                      {data.payout_summary.recent_earnings.map((earning) => (
                        <div key={earning.shipment_id} className="flex items-center justify-between rounded-lg border border-border bg-surface-2/40 px-2 py-1.5 text-xs">
                          <div>
                            <p className="font-semibold text-text">{formatPrice(earning.amount)}</p>
                            <p className="text-[10px] text-text-muted">
                              Order #{earning.order_id} · Shipment #{earning.shipment_id}

                            </p>
                            <p className="text-[10px] text-text-faint">
                              {earning.delivered_at ? new Date(earning.delivered_at).toLocaleDateString() : "—"}
                            </p>
                          </div>
                          <span className="theme-chip-success rounded-md px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-semibold">Delivered</span>
                        </div>
                      ))}

                  )}
                </div>

                {/* ── Earnings Calculator ───────────────────────────────── */}
                <div className="theme-card rounded-xl border p-3">
                  <button
                    onClick={() => setCalcExpanded((prev) => !prev)}
                    className="flex w-full items-center justify-between gap-2"
                  >
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                      <Calculator className="h-4 w-4 text-primary" />
                      <h3 className="text-xs font-bold text-text"><TranslatedText text="Earnings Calculator" /></h3>
                    </div>
                    <ChevronDown className={`h-4 w-4 text-text-muted transition-transform ${calcExpanded ? "rotate-180" : ""}`} />
                  </button>
                  {calcExpanded && (
                    <div className="mt-3 space-y-3">
                      <p className="text-[11px] text-text-muted"><TranslatedText text="Estimate how much you earn delivering to a destination based on your approved service areas." /></p>
                      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
                        <div>
                          <label className="mb-1 block text-[10px] font-semibold text-text-muted">Country</label>
                          <input
                            value={calcCountry}
                            onChange={(e) => setCalcCountry(e.target.value)}
                            placeholder="e.g. UAE"
                            className="theme-input w-full rounded-lg border px-2 py-1.5 text-xs"
                          />
                        </div>
                        <div>
                          <label className="mb-1 block text-[10px] font-semibold text-text-muted">City</label>
                          <input
                            value={calcCity}
                            onChange={(e) => setCalcCity(e.target.value)}
                            placeholder="e.g. Dubai"
                            className="theme-input w-full rounded-lg border px-2 py-1.5 text-xs"
                          />
                        </div>
                        <div className="col-span-2">
                          <label className="mb-1 block text-[10px] font-semibold text-text-muted">Weight (kg)</label>
                          <input
                            type="number"
                            min="0"
                            step="0.1"
                            value={calcWeight}
                            onChange={(e) => setCalcWeight(e.target.value)}
                            placeholder="e.g. 2.5"
                            className="theme-input w-full rounded-lg border px-2 py-1.5 text-xs"
                          />
                        </div>
                      </div>
                      <button
                        onClick={handleCalcQuote}

                          ) : (
                            <>
                              <div className="flex items-center justify-between rounded-xl border border-success/30 bg-success/10 px-3 py-2">
                                <p className="text-xs font-bold text-text"><TranslatedText text="You earn" /></p>
                                <p className="text-sm font-black text-success">{formatPrice(calcResult.shipping_amount)}</p>
                              </div>
                              {calcResult.pricing_breakdown && (
                                <div className="space-y-1 rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface-2/50 p-2.5 text-xs">
                                  {(
                                    [
                                      { label: "Base fee", value: calcResult.pricing_breakdown.base_fee },
                                      ...(calcResult.pricing_breakdown.pickup_fee > 0 ? [{ label: "Pickup charge", value: calcResult.pricing_breakdown.pickup_fee }] : []),
                                      ...(calcResult.pricing_breakdown.dropoff_fee > 0 ? [{ label: "Dropoff charge", value: calcResult.pricing_breakdown.dropoff_fee }] : []),
                                      ...(calcResult.pricing_breakdown.weight_fee > 0
                                        ? [{
                                            label: `Weight (${calcResult.pricing_breakdown.total_weight_kg ?? "?"}kg × ${calcResult.pricing_breakdown.per_kg_rate ?? "?"}/${String.fromCharCode(0x6b,0x67)})`,
                                            value: calcResult.pricing_breakdown.weight_fee,
                                          }]
                                        : []),
                                      ...(calcResult.pricing_breakdown.distance_fee > 0
                                        ? [{
                                            label: `Distance (${calcResult.pricing_breakdown.distance_km ?? "?"}km × ${calcResult.pricing_breakdown.per_km_rate ?? "?"}/km)`,
                                            value: calcResult.pricing_breakdown.distance_fee,
                                          }]
                                        : []),
                                      ...(calcResult.pricing_breakdown.handling_fee !== 0 ? [{ label: "Handling", value: calcResult.pricing_breakdown.handling_fee }] : []),
                                      ...(calcResult.pricing_breakdown.load_fit_adjustment_amount !== 0 ? [{ label: `Load-fit (${calcResult.pricing_breakdown.load_fit_label || "standard"})`, value: calcResult.pricing_breakdown.load_fit_adjustment_amount }] : []),
                                      ...(calcResult.pricing_breakdown.surcharge_amount !== 0 ? [{ label: "Runtime surcharge", value: calcResult.pricing_breakdown.surcharge_amount }] : []),
                                      ...(calcResult.pricing_breakdown.weight_discount_amount > 0 ? [{ label: "Weight discount", value: -calcResult.pricing_breakdown.weight_discount_amount }] : []),
                                    ] as Array<{ label: string; value: number }>
                                  ).map(({ label, value }) => (
                                    <div key={label} className="flex items-center justify-between text-[11px]">
                                      <span className="text-text-muted">{label}</span>
                                      <span className={`font-semibold tabular-nums ${value < 0 ? "text-success" : "text-text"}`}>
                                        {value < 0 ? "−" : "+"}{formatPrice(Math.abs(value))}
                                      </span>
                                    </div>
                                  ))}
                                  <div className="mt-1 flex items-center justify-between border-t border-border pt-1.5 text-xs font-bold">
                                    <span className="text-text"><TranslatedText text="Total" /></span>
                                    <span className="text-primary">{formatPrice(calcResult.pricing_breakdown.shipping_amount)}</span>
                                  </div>
                                  {calcResult.pricing_breakdown.floor_applied && (
                                    <p className="text-[10px] text-text-muted"><TranslatedText text="Minimum charge floor applied." /></p>
                                  )}
                                  <p className="mt-0.5 text-[10px] text-text-faint capitalize">
                                    {calcResult.pricing_breakdown.route_type === "in_city" ? "In-city delivery" : "Inter-city delivery"}
                                    {calcResult.partner_name ? ` · ${calcResult.partner_name}` : ""}
                                  </p>
                                </div>
                              )}
                            </>
                          )}
                        </div>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>

                <div className="theme-card rounded-xl border p-3">
                  <div className="mb-2 flex items-center gap-2">
                    <Route className="h-4 w-4 text-primary" />
                    <h3 className="text-xs font-bold text-text"><TranslatedText text="Suggested Route Plan" /></h3>
                  </div>
                  <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-1.5">
                    <div className="rounded-lg border border-border bg-surface-2/50 px-2 py-1.5">
                      <p className="text-xs font-bold text-text">{data.route_plan.total_stops}</p>
                      <p className="text-xs text-text-muted"><TranslatedText text="Stops" /></p>
                    </div>
                    <div className="rounded-lg border border-border bg-surface-2/50 px-2 py-1.5">
                      <p className="text-xs font-bold text-text">{data.route_plan.estimated_distance_km.toFixed(1)} km</p>
                      <p className="text-xs text-text-muted"><TranslatedText text="Distance" /></p>
                    </div>
                    <div className="col-span-2 rounded-lg border border-border bg-surface-2/50 px-2 py-1.5">
                      <p className="text-xs font-bold text-text">{data.route_plan.estimated_duration_hours.toFixed(1)} h</p>
                      <p className="text-xs text-text-muted"><TranslatedText text="Est. duration" /></p>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <div className="mt-2 space-y-1.5">
                    {data.route_plan.stops.length === 0 ? (
                      <p className="text-xs text-text-muted"><TranslatedText text="Route guidance will appear after GPS updates arrive." /></p>
                    ) : (
                      data.route_plan.stops.slice(0, 5).map((stop) => (
                        <div key={stop.shipment_id} className="rounded-lg border border-border bg-surface-2/40 px-2 py-1.5 text-xs">
                          <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
                            <p className="font-semibold text-text">Stop {stop.stop_number}: #{stop.shipment_id}</p>
                            <span className="text-text-muted tabular-nums">+{stop.distance_from_previous_km.toFixed(1)} km</span>
                          </div>
                          <p className="text-[11px] text-text-muted">{stop.current_hub || stop.location || stop.tracking_number || "Live position"}</p>
                        </div>
                      ))
                    )}
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div className="theme-card rounded-xl border p-3">
                  <div className="mb-2 flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                      <AlertTriangle className="h-4 w-4 text-danger" />
                      <h3 className="text-xs font-bold text-text"><TranslatedText text="SLA Breach Alerts" /></h3>
                    </div>
                    <span className="rounded-full bg-danger/10 px-2.5 py-1 text-[11px] font-semibold text-danger">
                      {data.sla_alerts.length} <TranslatedText text="open alerts" />
                    </span>
                  </div>
                  {data.sla_alerts.length === 0 ? (
                    <div className="rounded-xl border border-dashed border-border bg-surface-2/30 px-4 py-4 text-center text-xs text-text-muted">
                      <TranslatedText text="No overdue shipments. Current route is within SLA." />
                    </div>
                  ) : (
                    <div className="space-y-1.5">
                      {data.sla_alerts.map((alert) => (
                        <div key={alert.shipment_id} className="rounded-lg border border-danger/20 bg-danger/5 px-2.5 py-1.5 text-xs">
                          <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
                            <p className="font-semibold text-text">#{alert.shipment_id}</p>
                            <span className="font-medium text-danger tabular-nums">{alert.overdue_hours.toFixed(1)}h overdue</span>
                          </div>
                          <p className="text-[11px] text-text-muted">{alert.current_hub || "Unknown"} · <TranslatedText text="ETA was" /> {formatLocalizedDateTime(alert.estimated_delivery, locale)}</p>
                        </div>
                      ))}
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>

                {Object.keys(data.channel_breakdown).length > 0 && (
                  <div className="theme-card rounded-xl border p-3">
                    <div className="mb-2 flex items-center gap-2">
                      <BarChart3 className="h-4 w-4 text-primary" />
                      <h3 className="text-xs font-bold text-text"><TranslatedText text="Distribution Channels" /></h3>
                    </div>
                    <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-1.5">
                      {Object.entries(data.channel_breakdown).map(([channel, count]) => (
                        <div key={channel} className="theme-chip-info rounded-xl px-3 py-2">
                          <p className="text-base font-bold text-text">{count}</p>
                          <p className="text-[11px] capitalize text-text-muted"><TranslatedText text={channel.replace(/_/g, " ")} /></p>
                        </div>
                      ))}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>
          </>
        )}
        </PanelContent>
    </LogisticsPartnerLayout>
  );
}

  const readiness = useMemo(() => {
    const checks = [
      { label: "Company name", done: Boolean(profile.name?.trim()) },
      { label: "Contact email", done: Boolean(profile.contact_email?.trim()) },
      { label: "Contact phone", done: Boolean(profile.contact_phone?.trim()) },
      { label: "Base city and country", done: Boolean(profile.city?.trim() && profile.country?.trim()) },
      { label: "Terms accepted", done: profile.is_terms_accepted },
      { label: "At least one approved or pending rate", done: serviceAreas.length > 0 },
    ];
    const completed = checks.filter((check) => check.done).length;
    return { checks, completed, total: checks.length };
  }, [profile, serviceAreas.length]);

  const canLoadPartnerData = !authLoading && user?.role === "logistics_partner";

  const fetchLpDocuments = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!canLoadPartnerData) return;
    setLpDocsLoading(true);
    try {
      const res = await apiFetch("/logistics-partners/me/docs");
      if (res.ok) setLpDocs(await res.json());
    } catch {
      // silently ignore doc fetch errors
    } finally {
      setLpDocsLoading(false);
    }
  }, [canLoadPartnerData]);

  const loadData = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!canLoadPartnerData) return;
    setLoading(true);
    setError("");
    try {
      const [profileResponse, areasResponse, pricingProfilesResponse, categoryRulesResponse, vehicleRulesResponse, bankResponse] = await Promise.all([
        apiFetch("/logistics-partners/profile"),
        apiFetch("/logistics-partners/service-areas"),
        apiFetch("/logistics-partners/pricing-profiles"),
        apiFetch("/logistics-partners/category-rules"),
        apiFetch("/logistics-partners/vehicle-rules"),
        apiFetch("/logistics-partners/me/bank-account"),
      ]);
      if (!profileResponse.ok) {
        throw new Error("Could not load partner profile");
      }
      const nextProfile = await profileResponse.json();
      const nextAreas = areasResponse.ok ? await areasResponse.json() : [];
      const nextPricingProfiles = pricingProfilesResponse.ok ? await pricingProfilesResponse.json() : [];
      const nextCategoryRules = categoryRulesResponse.ok ? await categoryRulesResponse.json() : [];
      const nextVehicleRules = vehicleRulesResponse.ok ? await vehicleRulesResponse.json() : [];
      setProfile(normalizeProfile(nextProfile));
      setServiceAreas(Array.isArray(nextAreas) ? nextAreas : []);
      setPricingProfiles(Array.isArray(nextPricingProfiles) ? nextPricingProfiles : []);
      setCategoryRules(Array.isArray(nextCategoryRules) ? nextCategoryRules : []);
      setVehicleRules(Array.isArray(nextVehicleRules) ? nextVehicleRules : []);
      if (bankResponse.ok) {
        const bankPayload: LPBankAccount = await bankResponse.json();
        if (bankPayload?.id) {
          setLpBankAccount(bankPayload);
          setLpBankForm({
            beneficiary_name: bankPayload.beneficiary_name || "",
            bank_name: bankPayload.bank_name || "",
            branch_name: bankPayload.branch_name || "",
            account_number: bankPayload.account_number || "",
            iban: bankPayload.iban || "",
            swift_code: bankPayload.swift_code || "",
            routing_number: bankPayload.routing_number || "",
            bank_country: bankPayload.bank_country || "",
            currency: bankPayload.currency || "OMR",
          });
        }
      }
    } catch (loadError) {
      setError(loadError instanceof Error ? loadError.message : "Could not load logistics partner profile");
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, [canLoadPartnerData]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (canLoadPartnerData) {
      void loadData();
    }
  }, [canLoadPartnerData, loadData]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (canLoadPartnerData && tab === "operations") {
      void fetchLpDocuments();
    }
  }, [canLoadPartnerData, fetchLpDocuments, tab]);

  const handleLpDocUpload = async (event: React.FormEvent) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    if (!selectedLpDocFile) return;
    setLpDocUploading(true);
    try {
      const formData = new FormData();
      formData.append("file", selectedLpDocFile);
      formData.append("document_type", lpDocForm.document_type);
      formData.append("document_name", lpDocForm.document_name || selectedLpDocFile.name);
      if (lpDocForm.expires_at) formData.append("expires_at", lpDocForm.expires_at);
      const res = await apiFetch("/logistics-partners/me/docs/upload", { method: "POST", body: formData });
      if (!res.ok) {
        const payload = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
        throw new Error(payload.detail || "Upload failed");
      }
      setLpDocForm({ document_type: "trade_license", document_name: "", expires_at: "" });
      setSelectedLpDocFile(null);
      await fetchLpDocuments();
    } catch (uploadError) {
      setError(uploadError instanceof Error ? uploadError.message : "Could not upload document");
    } finally {
      setLpDocUploading(false);

  const changeLpPassword = async (event: React.FormEvent) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    setMessage("");
    setError("");
    if (newPw !== confirmPw) {
      setError("New passwords do not match.");
      return;
    }
    setPwSaving(true);
    try {
      const res = await apiFetch("/auth/change-password", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ current_password: currentPw, new_password: newPw }),
      });
      if (res.ok) {
        setCurrentPw(""); setNewPw(""); setConfirmPw("");
        setMessage("Password changed successfully.");
      } else {
        const payload = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
        setError(payload.detail || "Could not change password.");
      }
    } catch {
      setError("Network error. Please try again.");
    } finally {
      setPwSaving(false);
    }
  };

  if (loading) {

      <LogisticsPartnerLayout title="Profile">

import { apiFetch } from "@/lib/api";
import { resolveImage } from "@/lib/utils";

type ServiceArea = {
  id: number;
  country_code: string;
  country_name: string;
  city_name?: string | null;
  origin_city?: string | null;
  zone_label?: string | null;
  charge_amount: number;
  pickup_charge?: number | null;
  dropoff_charge?: number | null;
  currency: string;
  delivery_days_min?: number | null;
  delivery_days_max?: number | null;
};

type LogisticsPartnerDetail = {
  id: number;
  name: string;
  code: string;
  bio?: string | null;
  about_us?: string | null;
  city?: string | null;
  country?: string | null;
  address?: string | null;
  website?: string | null;
  contact_phone?: string | null;
  contact_email?: string | null;
  logo_url?: string | null;
  banner_url?: string | null;
  verification_status: string;
  service_types?: string[];
  coverage_regions?: string[];
  service_areas?: ServiceArea[];
};

export default function LogisticsPartnerDetailPage() {
  const params = useParams<{ id: string }>();
  const router = useRouter();
  const { isLoggedIn, isLoading: authLoading } = useAuth();
  const [reloadKey, setReloadKey] = useState(0);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const [partner, setPartner] = useState<LogisticsPartnerDetail | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (authLoading) return;
    if (!isLoggedIn) {
      router.push("/login");
    }
  }, [authLoading, isLoggedIn, router]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isLoggedIn) return;
    let active = true;
    const load = async () => {
      setLoading(true);
      setError("");
      try {
        const response = await apiFetch(`/logistics-partners/public/${params.id}`);
        const payload = await response.json().catch(() => null);
        if (!response.ok) {
          throw new Error(payload?.detail || "Could not load this logistics partner.");
        }
        if (!active) return;
        setPartner(payload);
      } catch (err) {
        if (!active) return;
        setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Could not load this logistics partner.");
      } finally {
        if (active) {
          setLoading(false);
        }
      }
    };
    void load();
    return () => {
      active = false;
    };
  }, [isLoggedIn, params.id, reloadKey]);

  const serviceAreaSummary = useMemo(() => {
    const areas = partner?.service_areas || [];
    const countries = new Set(areas.map((area) => area.country_name).filter(Boolean));
    const cities = new Set(areas.map((area) => area.city_name).filter(Boolean));
    return {
      totalAreas: areas.length,
      countryCount: countries.size,
      cityCount: cities.size,
    };
  }, [partner?.service_areas]);

  }

      <main className="min-h-screen px-4 py-8">

          <div className="h-64 animate-pulse rounded-3xl border border-border bg-surface-2" />
          <div className="grid gap-4 lg:grid-cols-[1.1fr_0.9fr]">
            <div className="h-72 animate-pulse rounded-3xl border border-border bg-surface-2" />
            <div className="h-72 animate-pulse rounded-3xl border border-border bg-surface-2" />
          </div>
        </div>
      </main>
    );
  }

          <div className="flex items-start gap-2">
            <AlertCircle className="mt-0.5 h-4 w-4 shrink-0" />
            <div>
              <p className="font-semibold">Logistics partner unavailable</p>
              <p className="mt-1">{error || "This approved logistics partner could not be loaded."}</p>
              <button onClick={() => router.push("/logistics-partners")} className="mt-4 text-xs font-semibold text-danger underline">
                Back to logistics partners
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </main>
    );
  }

            <ArrowLeft className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />Back to logistics partners

            <RefreshCw className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />Refresh
          </button>
        </div>

        <section className="overflow-hidden rounded-3xl border border-border bg-surface">
          <div className="relative h-52 overflow-hidden bg-surface-2">
            <img src={banner} alt={partner.name} className="h-full w-full object-cover" />
            <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-linear-to-t from-black/55 via-black/10 to-transparent" />
            <div className="absolute bottom-0 left-0 right-0 p-6">
              <div className="flex flex-wrap items-end gap-4">
                <img src={logo} alt={partner.name} className="h-20 w-20 rounded-3xl border border-white/60 bg-white object-cover shadow-xl" />
                <div>

                    <h1 className="text-3xl font-black tracking-tight text-white">{partner.name}</h1>

          <div className="grid gap-4 border-t border-border p-6 md:grid-cols-3">

              <Truck className="h-4 w-4" />About this partner
            </div>
            {partner.bio ? <p className="mt-4 text-sm leading-7 text-text-muted">{partner.bio}</p> : null}
            {partner.about_us ? <p className="mt-4 text-sm leading-7 text-text-muted">{partner.about_us}</p> : null}

    }

    if (!isLoggedIn) return;
    let active = true;

    const load = async () => {
      setLoading(true);
      setError("");
      try {
        const params = new URLSearchParams();
        if (submittedQuery.trim()) {
          params.set("q", submittedQuery.trim());
        }
        params.set("limit", "24");
        const path = `/logistics-partners/public${params.toString() ? `?${params.toString()}` : ""}`;
        const response = await apiFetch(path);

        if (!response.ok) {
          throw new Error(payload?.detail || "Could not load logistics partners right now.");

        if (!active) return;
        setData({
          total: Number(payload?.total ?? 0),
          items: Array.isArray(payload?.items) ? payload.items : [],
        });

        if (!active) return;

        if (active) {

﻿"use client";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { motion } from "framer-motion";
import { Mail, CheckCircle, Bell, Tag, Zap, Gift } from "@/lib/icons";
import { apiFetch } from "@/lib/api";
import { useAuth } from "@/lib/useAuth";
import Link from "next/link";

const BENEFITS = [
  { icon: Tag, label: "Exclusive deals", desc: "Get access to subscriber-only discounts and offers." },
  { icon: Zap, label: "Flash sale alerts", desc: "Be the first to know when limited-time sales go live." },
  { icon: Gift, label: "New arrivals", desc: "Discover new products before they hit the homepage." },
  { icon: Bell, label: "Order updates", desc: "Stay informed about your order and shipment status." },
];

export default function NewsletterPage() {
  const { user, isLoggedIn, isLoading: authLoading } = useAuth();
  const [email, setEmail] = useState("");
  const [subscribed, setSubscribed] = useState(false);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [checkLoading, setCheckLoading] = useState(false);
  const [success, setSuccess] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  // For logged-in users, check their subscription status
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isLoggedIn || !user?.email || authLoading) return;
    setEmail(user.email);
    setCheckLoading(true);
    apiFetch(`/email/newsletter/preferences?email=${encodeURIComponent(user.email)}`)
      .then(async (res) => {
        if (res.ok) {
          const data = await res.json();
          setSubscribed(data?.is_active ?? false);
        }
      })
      .catch(() => {})
      .finally(() => setCheckLoading(false));
  }, [isLoggedIn, user, authLoading]);

  const handleSubscribe = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!email.trim()) return;
    setLoading(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      const res = await apiFetch("/email/newsletter/subscribe", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ email: email.trim() }),
      });
      if (res.ok) {
        setSuccess(true);
        setSubscribed(true);
      } else {
        const d = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
        setError(d.detail ?? "Failed to subscribe. Please try again.");
      }
    } catch { setError("Network error. Please try again."); }
    setLoading(false);
  };

  const handleUnsubscribe = async () => {
    if (!email.trim()) return;
    setLoading(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      const res = await apiFetch("/email/newsletter/unsubscribe", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ email: email.trim() }),
      });
      if (res.ok) {
        setSubscribed(false);
        setSuccess(false);
      } else {
        const d = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
        setError(d.detail ?? "Failed to unsubscribe.");
      }
    } catch { setError("Network error. Please try again."); }
    setLoading(false);
  };

  return (
    <main className="min-h-screen px-4 py-12">
      <div className="max-w-2xl mx-auto">
        {/* Hero */}
        <motion.div
          initial={{ opacity: 0, y: -12 }}
          animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
          className="text-center mb-10"
        >
          <div className="w-16 h-16 rounded-2xl bg-brand/10 flex items-center justify-center mx-auto mb-4">
            <Mail className="w-8 h-8 text-brand" />
          </div>
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-extrabold theme-text mb-2">Stay in the Loop</h1>
          <p className="theme-text-muted max-w-md mx-auto">
            Subscribe to the Zozi newsletter for exclusive deals, new arrivals, and flash sale alerts delivered straight to your inbox.
          </p>
        </motion.div>

        {/* Benefits grid */}
        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 mb-8">
          {BENEFITS.map(({ icon: Icon, label, desc }, i) => (
            <motion.div
              key={label}
              initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 8 }}
              animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
              transition={{ delay: i * 0.06 }}
              className="theme-card p-4"
            >
              <Icon className="w-5 h-5 text-brand mb-2" />
              <p className="font-bold theme-text text-sm mb-1">{label}</p>
              <p className="text-xs theme-text-muted">{desc}</p>
            </motion.div>
          ))}
        </div>

        {/* Subscription card */}
        <motion.div
          initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 12 }}
          animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
          transition={{ delay: 0.25 }}
          className="theme-card p-6"
        >
          {checkLoading ? (
            <div className="flex justify-center py-6">
              <div className="w-6 h-6 border-2 border-brand border-t-transparent rounded-full animate-spin" />
            </div>
          ) : subscribed || success ? (
            <div className="text-center">
              <CheckCircle className="w-10 h-10 text-success mx-auto mb-3" />
              <p className="font-bold theme-text text-lg mb-1">
                {success ? "You're subscribed!" : "Already subscribed"}
              </p>
              <p className="theme-text-muted text-sm mb-5">
                {success
                  ? "Welcome aboard! Check your inbox for a confirmation email."
                  : `You're receiving our newsletter at ${email}.`}
              </p>
              <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2 justify-center">
                <Link
                  href="/newsletter/preferences"
                  className="px-4 py-2 rounded-xl theme-btn-primary font-semibold text-sm"
                >
                  Manage Preferences
                </Link>
                <button
                  onClick={handleUnsubscribe}
                  disabled={loading}
                  className="px-4 py-2 rounded-xl theme-chip text-sm font-semibold disabled:opacity-50"
                >
                  {loading ? "…" : "Unsubscribe"}
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <>
              <h2 className="font-bold theme-text mb-4">Subscribe to our Newsletter</h2>
              <form onSubmit={handleSubscribe} className="space-y-3">
                <div>
                  <label className="text-sm theme-text-muted block mb-1">Email address</label>
                  <input
                    type="email"
                    value={email}
                    onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)}
                    placeholder="you@example.com"
                    required
                    disabled={isLoggedIn}
                    className="theme-input w-full disabled:opacity-70"
                  />
                  {isLoggedIn && (
                    <p className="text-xs theme-text-muted mt-1">Using your account email.</p>
                  )}
                </div>
                {error && <p className="text-danger text-sm">{error}</p>}
                <button
                  type="submit"
                  disabled={loading || !email.trim()}
                  className="w-full py-2.5 rounded-xl theme-btn-primary font-bold disabled:opacity-50"
                >
                  {loading ? "Subscribing…" : "Subscribe for Free"}
                </button>
                <p className="text-xs theme-text-muted text-center">
                  No spam, ever. Unsubscribe anytime in{" "}
                  <Link href="/newsletter/preferences" className="text-brand hover:underline">
                    preferences
                  </Link>
                  .
                </p>
              </form>
            </>
          )}
        </motion.div>
      </div>
    </main>
  );
}

﻿"use client";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { motion } from "framer-motion";

const MotionDiv: any = motion.div;

import { Mail, CheckCircle, XCircle } from "@/lib/icons";
import { apiFetch } from "@/lib/api";
import { useAuth } from "@/lib/useAuth";

interface UserPreferences {
  email: string;
  first_name: string;
  last_name: string;
  preferences: {
    promotional_emails: boolean;
    newsletter: boolean;
    product_updates: boolean;
    order_updates: boolean;
    marketing_emails: boolean;
  };
  subscribed_at: string;
  is_active: boolean;
}

export default function NewsletterPreferences() {
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const [preferences, setPreferences] = useState<UserPreferences | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [message, setMessage] = useState("");

  const loadPreferences = async () => {
    try {
      const userEmail = user?.email;
      if (!userEmail) {
        setMessage("Please log in to manage your email preferences.");
        setLoading(false);
        return;
      }

      const response = await apiFetch(`/email/newsletter/preferences?email=${encodeURIComponent(userEmail)}`);
      if (response.ok) {
        const data = await response.json();
        setPreferences(data);
      } else {
        setMessage("Unable to load your preferences. Please try again.");
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error("Failed to load preferences:", error);
      setMessage("An error occurred while loading your preferences.");
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    void loadPreferences();
  }, [user]);

  const updatePreferences = async (newPreferences: Partial<UserPreferences['preferences']>) => {
    if (!preferences) return;

    setSaving(true);
    try {
      const response = await apiFetch("/email/newsletter/preferences", {
        method: "PUT",
        headers: {
          "Content-Type": "application/json"
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          email: preferences.email,
          preferences: { ...preferences.preferences, ...newPreferences }
        })
      });

      if (response.ok) {
        setPreferences(prev => prev ? {
          ...prev,
          preferences: { ...prev.preferences, ...newPreferences }
        } : null);
        setMessage("Preferences updated successfully!");
        setTimeout(() => setMessage(""), 3000);
      } else {
        setMessage("Failed to update preferences. Please try again.");
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error("Failed to update preferences:", error);
      setMessage("An error occurred while updating your preferences.");
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  };

  const unsubscribeAll = async () => {
    if (!confirm("Are you sure you want to unsubscribe from all emails? You can always resubscribe later.")) {
      return;
    }

    try {
      const response = await apiFetch("/email/newsletter/unsubscribe", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: {
