```text
﻿"use client";

import type { ComponentType } from "react";
import { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";
import {
  AlertTriangle,
  ArrowUpRight,
  CheckCircle,
  CreditCard,
  DollarSign,
  RefreshCw,
  Truck,
  XCircle,
} from "@/lib/icons";
import { apiFetch, getErrorMessage, parseJsonResponse } from "@/lib/api";
import { type BackgroundJob, trackBackgroundJob } from "@/lib/backgroundJobs";
import { useCurrencyStore } from "@/lib/currencyStore";
import { useDensity } from "@/lib/densityContext";
import { useAuth } from "@/lib/useAuth";
import { isAdminStaffRole } from "@shared/adminPermissions";
import { EnterpriseDataTable, type EnterpriseColumn } from "@shared/components/EnterpriseDataTable";

interface FinancialSummary {
  total_revenue: number;
  total_supplier_payable: number;
  total_logistics_payable: number;
  pending_cod_remittances: number;
  unreconciled_bank_txns: number;
  net_zozi_revenue?: number;
}

interface LedgerEntry {
  id: number;
  order_id: number;
  supplier_id: number;
  logistics_partner_id?: number | null;
  payment_method: string;
  product_subtotal: number;
  discount_amount: number;
  delivery_total: number;
  vat_amount: number;
  net_supplier_amount: number;
  net_logistics_amount: number;
  cod_remittance_due?: number | null;
  settlement_status: string;
  created_at: string;
  order?: AdminOrder | null;
  supplier?: SupplierSummary | null;
}

interface SupplierSettlement {
  id: number;
  order_id: number;
  supplier_id: number;
  gross_amount: number;
  commission_deducted: number;
  net_amount: number;
  status: string;
  eligible_at?: string | null;
  settled_at?: string | null;
  created_at: string;
  settlement_cycle?: string | null;
}

interface LogisticsSettlement {
  id: number;
  order_id: number;
  partner_id: number;
  total_delivery_fee: number;
  cod_collected?: number | null;
  cod_remitted?: number | null;
  cod_remittance_status?: string | null;
  status: string;
  eligible_at?: string | null;
  settled_at?: string | null;
  created_at: string;
}

interface RefundEntry {
  id: number;
  order_id: number;
  refund_reason: string;
  refund_method: string;
  customer_refund_amount: number;
  status: string;
  created_at: string;
}

interface AdminOrderProduct {
  id: number;
  name?: string;
  supplier_id?: number | null;
}

interface AdminOrderItem {
  id: number;
  product_id: number;
  quantity: number;
  price?: number | null;
  selected_size?: string | null;
  selected_color?: string | null;
  product?: AdminOrderProduct | null;
}

interface AdminOrder {
  id: number;
  user_id: number;
  customer_username?: string | null;
  payment_status?: string | null;
  payment_method?: string | null;
  status: string;
  created_at: string;
  total_amount?: number;
  total?: number;
  shipping_address?: string | null;
  items?: AdminOrderItem[];
}

interface TransferProvider {
  key: string;
  name: string;
  configured: boolean;
  missing_requirements?: string[];
  is_default?: boolean;
}

interface TransferProviderResponse {
  default_provider: string;
  providers: TransferProvider[];
}

interface SupplierSummary {
  id: number;
  username?: string | null;
  profile?: {
    business_name?: string | null;
    badge_level?: string | null;
    verification_status?: string | null;
  } | null;
}

interface SupplierPayoutResult {
  payouts: Array<{ payout_id: number; supplier_id: number; amount: number; order_count: number; reference: string }>;
  processed: number;
}

interface LogisticsPayoutResult {
  payouts: Array<{ payout_id: number; partner_id: number; amount: number; delivery_count: number; reference: string }>;
  processed: number;
}

interface CodReceipt {
  id: number;
  settlement_id: number;
  partner_id: number;
  order_id: number;
  amount: number;
  currency: string;
  bank_reference?: string | null;
  receipt_file_url: string;
  notes?: string | null;
  status: string;
  review_note?: string | null;
  created_at: string;
  reviewed_at?: string | null;
  partner_name?: string | null;
  partner_code?: string | null;
  due_amount: number;
  remitted_before_receipt: number;
  remaining_amount: number;
  settlement_status?: string | null;
  cod_remittance_status?: string | null;
}

type TableStatusFilter = "all" | "needs-action" | "processing" | "refund";
type PaymentFilter = "all" | "card" | "cod";
type TransactionFilter = "all" | "closed" | "remaining";
type ReceiptFilter = "all" | "pending" | "verified" | "rejected";

type FinanceRow = {
  key: string;
  orderId: number;
  order?: AdminOrder;
  ledger: LedgerEntry;
  supplierSettlement?: SupplierSettlement;
  logisticsSettlement?: LogisticsSettlement;
  refund?: RefundEntry;
  supplier?: SupplierSummary | null;
  customerPaidAmount: number;
};

function titleCase(value?: string | null) {
  if (!value) return "Unknown";
  return value.replace(/_/g, " ").replace(/\b\w/g, (letter) => letter.toUpperCase());
}

function normalizeStatus(value?: string | null) {
  return String(value || "").trim().toLowerCase();
}

function fmtDate(value?: string | null) {
  if (!value) return "Pending";
  return new Date(value).toLocaleDateString("en-GB", { day: "2-digit", month: "short", year: "numeric" });
}

function paymentMethodLabel(value?: string | null) {
  const normalized = normalizeStatus(value);
  if (normalized === "cod") return "Cash on Delivery";
  if (normalized === "card" || normalized === "stripe") return "Card";
  if (normalized === "tap") return "Tap";
  if (normalized === "paytabs") return "PayTabs";
  if (normalized === "thawani") return "Thawani";
  if (normalized === "paypal") return "PayPal";
  if (normalized === "hyperpay") return "HyperPay";
  if (!normalized) return "Unknown";
  return titleCase(normalized);
}

function cycleDaysLabel(cycle?: string | null, createdAt?: string | null, eligibleAt?: string | null) {
  const normalized = normalizeStatus(cycle);
  if (normalized === "daily") return "1 day";
  if (normalized === "weekly") return "7 days";
  if (normalized === "monthly") return "30 days";
  if (!createdAt || !eligibleAt) return "-";
  const diff = Math.max(0, Math.round((new Date(eligibleAt).getTime() - new Date(createdAt).getTime()) / 86400000));
  return `${diff} day${diff === 1 ? "" : "s"}`;
}

function statusTone(status?: string | null) {
  const normalized = normalizeStatus(status);
  if (["settled", "completed", "paid", "reconciled", "fully_settled", "remitted"].includes(normalized)) return "theme-chip-success";
  if (["eligible", "ready"].includes(normalized)) return "theme-chip-info";
  if (["pending", "processing", "partial", "supplier_settled", "logistics_settled"].includes(normalized)) return "theme-chip-warning";
  if (["reversed", "failed", "rejected", "refund_pending", "refund_failed", "cancelled"].includes(normalized)) return "theme-chip-danger";
  return "theme-chip-muted";
}

function badgeTone(badge?: string | null) {
  const normalized = normalizeStatus(badge);
  if (normalized === "gold") return "bg-warning/15 text-warning border border-warning/20";
  if (normalized === "silver") return "bg-slate-200/60 text-slate-700 border border-slate-300";
  if (normalized === "bronze") return "bg-orange-100 text-orange-700 border border-orange-200";
  if (normalized === "verified") return "bg-success/10 text-success border border-success/20";
  return "bg-surface-2 text-text-muted border border-border";
}

function paymentMethodTone(method?: string | null) {
  return normalizeStatus(method) === "cod" ? "bg-warning/10 text-warning border border-warning/20" : "bg-info/10 text-info border border-info/20";
}

function StatusChip({ status }: { status?: string | null }) {
  return <span className={`rounded-full px-2 py-1 text-[10px] font-semibold ${statusTone(status)}`}>{titleCase(status)}</span>;
}

function isCodRow(row: FinanceRow) {
  return normalizeStatus(row.ledger.payment_method) === "cod";
}

function codReceiptComplete(row: FinanceRow) {
  if (!isCodRow(row)) return true;
  const status = normalizeStatus(row.logisticsSettlement?.cod_remittance_status);
  const due = Number(row.ledger.cod_remittance_due || 0);
  const remitted = Number(row.logisticsSettlement?.cod_remitted || 0);
  if (due <= 0) return true;
  return ["remitted", "reconciled", "settled", "completed", "complete", "verified"].includes(status) || remitted >= due;
}

function settlementComplete(status?: string | null) {
  return ["settled", "completed", "paid", "reconciled", "fully_settled"].includes(normalizeStatus(status));
}

function isTransactionClosed(row: FinanceRow) {
  const supplierDone = !row.supplierSettlement || settlementComplete(row.supplierSettlement.status);
  const logisticsDone = !row.logisticsSettlement || settlementComplete(row.logisticsSettlement.status);
  return supplierDone && logisticsDone && codReceiptComplete(row);
}

function transactionRowTone(row: FinanceRow) {
  if (isTransactionClosed(row)) return "bg-success/5";
  if (row.refund && !["settled", "completed", "paid"].includes(normalizeStatus(row.refund.status))) return "bg-danger/5";
  if ([normalizeStatus(row.supplierSettlement?.status), normalizeStatus(row.logisticsSettlement?.status)].includes("processing")) return "bg-info/5";
  return "bg-warning/5";
}

export default function FinanceTab() {
  const formatMoney = useCurrencyStore((state) => state.format);
  const { density } = useDensity();
  const { user, isLoggedIn, isLoading: authLoading } = useAuth();
  const role = user?.role ?? null;
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [summary, setSummary] = useState<FinancialSummary | null>(null);
  const [ledgerEntries, setLedgerEntries] = useState<LedgerEntry[]>([]);
  const [supplierSettlements, setSupplierSettlements] = useState<SupplierSettlement[]>([]);
  const [logisticsSettlements, setLogisticsSettlements] = useState<LogisticsSettlement[]>([]);
  const [refunds, setRefunds] = useState<RefundEntry[]>([]);
  const [codReceipts, setCodReceipts] = useState<CodReceipt[]>([]);
  const [transferProviders, setTransferProviders] = useState<TransferProviderResponse | null>(null);
  const [selectedTransferProvider, setSelectedTransferProvider] = useState("");
  const [statusFilter, setStatusFilter] = useState<TableStatusFilter>("all");
  const [paymentFilter, setPaymentFilter] = useState<PaymentFilter>("all");
  const [transactionFilter, setTransactionFilter] = useState<TransactionFilter>("all");
  const [receiptFilter, setReceiptFilter] = useState<ReceiptFilter>("all");
  const [selectedSupplierSettlementIds, setSelectedSupplierSettlementIds] = useState<number[]>([]);
  const [selectedLogisticsSettlementIds, setSelectedLogisticsSettlementIds] = useState<number[]>([]);
  const [focusedRowKey, setFocusedRowKey] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [processing, setProcessing] = useState(false);
  const [receiptActionId, setReceiptActionId] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [message, setMessage] = useState<{ type: "success" | "error"; text: string } | null>(null);

  const loadData = useCallback(async () => {
    if (authLoading || !isLoggedIn || !isAdminStaffRole(role)) return;

    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const [summaryPayload, ledgerPayload, supplierPayload, logisticsPayload, refundPayload, providerPayload, codReceiptPayload] = await Promise.all([
        apiFetch("/finance/admin/summary").then((response) => (response.ok ? response.json() : null)).catch(() => null),
        apiFetch("/finance/admin/ledger?limit=200").then((response) => (response.ok ? response.json() : [])).catch(() => []),
        apiFetch("/finance/admin/supplier-settlements?limit=200").then((response) => (response.ok ? response.json() : [])).catch(() => []),
        apiFetch("/finance/admin/logistics-settlements?limit=200").then((response) => (response.ok ? response.json() : [])).catch(() => []),
        apiFetch("/finance/admin/refunds?limit=200").then((response) => (response.ok ? response.json() : [])).catch(() => []),
        apiFetch("/finance/admin/transfer-providers").then((response) => (response.ok ? response.json() : null)).catch(() => null),
        apiFetch("/finance/admin/cod-remittance-receipts?limit=50").then((response) => (response.ok ? response.json() : [])).catch(() => []),
      ]);

      setSummary(summaryPayload as FinancialSummary | null);
      setLedgerEntries(Array.isArray(ledgerPayload) ? (ledgerPayload as LedgerEntry[]) : []);
      setSupplierSettlements(Array.isArray(supplierPayload) ? (supplierPayload as SupplierSettlement[]) : []);
      setLogisticsSettlements(Array.isArray(logisticsPayload) ? (logisticsPayload as LogisticsSettlement[]) : []);
      setRefunds(Array.isArray(refundPayload) ? (refundPayload as RefundEntry[]) : []);
      setCodReceipts(Array.isArray(codReceiptPayload) ? (codReceiptPayload as CodReceipt[]) : []);

      if (providerPayload) {
        const nextProviders = providerPayload as TransferProviderResponse;
        setTransferProviders(nextProviders);
        setSelectedTransferProvider((current) => current || nextProviders.default_provider || nextProviders.providers?.[0]?.key || "");
      }
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, [authLoading, isLoggedIn, role]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (authLoading || !isLoggedIn || !isAdminStaffRole(role)) return;
    void loadData();
  }, [authLoading, isLoggedIn, role, loadData]);

  const selectedProvider = useMemo(
    () => transferProviders?.providers.find((provider) => provider.key === selectedTransferProvider) || null,
    [selectedTransferProvider, transferProviders],
  );

  const eligibleSupplierSettlementIds = useMemo(
    () => supplierSettlements
      .filter((settlement) => normalizeStatus(settlement.status) === "eligible")
      .map((settlement) => settlement.id),
    [supplierSettlements],
  );

  const eligibleLogisticsSettlementIds = useMemo(
    () => logisticsSettlements
      .filter((settlement) => normalizeStatus(settlement.status) === "eligible")
      .map((settlement) => settlement.id),
    [logisticsSettlements],
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    const supplierEligible = new Set(eligibleSupplierSettlementIds);
    const logisticsEligible = new Set(eligibleLogisticsSettlementIds);
    setSelectedSupplierSettlementIds((current) => current.filter((id) => supplierEligible.has(id)));
    setSelectedLogisticsSettlementIds((current) => current.filter((id) => logisticsEligible.has(id)));
  }, [eligibleSupplierSettlementIds, eligibleLogisticsSettlementIds]);

  const financeRows = useMemo<FinanceRow[]>(() => {
    const supplierMap = new Map(supplierSettlements.map((settlement) => [`${settlement.order_id}:${settlement.supplier_id}`, settlement]));
    const logisticsMap = new Map(logisticsSettlements.map((settlement) => [`${settlement.order_id}:${settlement.partner_id}`, settlement]));
    const refundMap = new Map<number, RefundEntry>();

    refunds.forEach((refund) => {
      const existing = refundMap.get(refund.order_id);
      if (!existing || new Date(refund.created_at).getTime() > new Date(existing.created_at).getTime()) {
        refundMap.set(refund.order_id, refund);
      }
    });

    return [...ledgerEntries]
      .sort((left, right) => right.order_id - left.order_id)
      .map((ledger) => ({
        key: `${ledger.order_id}:${ledger.supplier_id}:${ledger.logistics_partner_id || 0}:${ledger.id}`,
        orderId: ledger.order_id,
        order: ledger.order || undefined,
        ledger,
        supplierSettlement: supplierMap.get(`${ledger.order_id}:${ledger.supplier_id}`),
        logisticsSettlement: ledger.logistics_partner_id ? logisticsMap.get(`${ledger.order_id}:${ledger.logistics_partner_id}`) : undefined,
        refund: refundMap.get(ledger.order_id),
        supplier: ledger.supplier,
        customerPaidAmount: Number(ledger.product_subtotal || 0) - Number(ledger.discount_amount || 0) + Number(ledger.delivery_total || 0) + Number(ledger.vat_amount || 0),
      }));
  }, [ledgerEntries, logisticsSettlements, refunds, supplierSettlements]);

  const filteredRows = useMemo(() => {
    return financeRows.filter((row) => {
      if (paymentFilter === "card" && normalizeStatus(row.ledger.payment_method) === "cod") return false;
      if (paymentFilter === "cod" && normalizeStatus(row.ledger.payment_method) !== "cod") return false;

      if (transactionFilter === "closed" && !isTransactionClosed(row)) return false;
      if (transactionFilter === "remaining" && isTransactionClosed(row)) return false;

      if (statusFilter === "needs-action") {
        const supplierReadyRow = normalizeStatus(row.supplierSettlement?.status) === "eligible";
        const logisticsReadyRow = normalizeStatus(row.logisticsSettlement?.status) === "eligible";
        if (!supplierReadyRow && !logisticsReadyRow) return false;
      }

      if (statusFilter === "processing") {
        const supplierProcessingRow = normalizeStatus(row.supplierSettlement?.status) === "processing";
        const logisticsProcessingRow = normalizeStatus(row.logisticsSettlement?.status) === "processing";
        if (!supplierProcessingRow && !logisticsProcessingRow) return false;
      }

      if (statusFilter === "refund" && !row.refund) return false;
      return true;
    });
  }, [financeRows, paymentFilter, statusFilter, transactionFilter]);

  const supplierSelectedAmount = useMemo(() => {
    const selected = new Set(selectedSupplierSettlementIds);
    return supplierSettlements.filter((settlement) => selected.has(settlement.id)).reduce((sum, settlement) => sum + Number(settlement.net_amount || 0), 0);
  }, [selectedSupplierSettlementIds, supplierSettlements]);

  const logisticsSelectedAmount = useMemo(() => {
    const selected = new Set(selectedLogisticsSettlementIds);
    return logisticsSettlements.filter((settlement) => selected.has(settlement.id)).reduce((sum, settlement) => sum + Number(settlement.total_delivery_fee || 0), 0);
  }, [logisticsSettlements, selectedLogisticsSettlementIds]);

  const selectedCount = selectedSupplierSettlementIds.length + selectedLogisticsSettlementIds.length;
  const allEligibleSupplierSelected = eligibleSupplierSettlementIds.length > 0
    && eligibleSupplierSettlementIds.every((id) => selectedSupplierSettlementIds.includes(id));
  const allEligibleLogisticsSelected = eligibleLogisticsSettlementIds.length > 0
    && eligibleLogisticsSettlementIds.every((id) => selectedLogisticsSettlementIds.includes(id));
  const remainingCount = financeRows.filter((row) => !isTransactionClosed(row)).length;
  const closedCount = financeRows.filter((row) => isTransactionClosed(row)).length;
  const filteredCodReceipts = useMemo(
    () => codReceipts.filter((receipt) => receiptFilter === "all" ? true : normalizeStatus(receipt.status) === receiptFilter),
    [codReceipts, receiptFilter],
  );
  const pendingReceiptCount = codReceipts.filter((receipt) => normalizeStatus(receipt.status) === "pending").length;
  const receiptColumns = useMemo<Array<EnterpriseColumn<CodReceipt>>>(() => [
    {
      key: "receipt",
      label: "Receipt",
      sortable: true,
      searchValue: (row) => `${row.id} ${row.settlement_id}`,
      sortValue: (row) => row.id,
      render: (row) => (
        <div>
          <div className="font-semibold text-text">#{row.id}</div>
          <div className="mt-1 text-[10px] text-text-faint">Settlement #{row.settlement_id}</div>
        </div>
      ),
    },
    {
      key: "partner",
      label: "Partner",
      searchable: true,
      searchValue: (row) => `${row.partner_name || ""} ${row.partner_code || ""} ${row.partner_id}`,
      render: (row) => (
        <div>
          <div className="font-semibold text-text">{row.partner_name || `Partner #${row.partner_id}`}</div>
          <div className="mt-1 text-[10px] text-text-faint">{row.partner_code || "No code"}</div>
        </div>
      ),
    },
    {
      key: "order_id",
      label: "Order",
      sortable: true,
      searchable: true,
      searchValue: (row) => `${row.order_id} ${row.bank_reference || ""}`,
      render: (row) => (
        <div className="text-text-muted">
          <div>#{row.order_id}</div>
          <div className="mt-1 text-[10px]">Uploaded {new Date(row.created_at).toLocaleDateString()}</div>
        </div>
      ),
    },
    {
      key: "amount",
      label: "Amount",
      sortable: true,
      align: "right",
      sortValue: (row) => row.amount,
      render: (row) => (
        <div className="text-right">
          <div className="font-semibold text-text">{formatMoney(row.amount)}</div>
          <div className="mt-1 text-[10px] text-text-faint">Remaining {formatMoney(row.remaining_amount)}</div>
        </div>
      ),
    },
    {
      key: "status",
      label: "Status",
      sortable: true,
      searchable: true,
      render: (row) => (
        <div>
          <StatusChip status={row.status} />
          {row.review_note ? <div className="mt-1 text-[10px] text-text-faint">{row.review_note}</div> : null}
        </div>
      ),
    },
    {
      key: "evidence",
      label: "Evidence",
      searchable: true,
      searchValue: (row) => `${row.receipt_file_url} ${row.bank_reference || ""}`,
      render: (row) => (
        <div className="text-text-muted">
          <a href={row.receipt_file_url} target="_blank" rel="noreferrer" className="text-primary underline-offset-2 hover:underline">View proof</a>
          <div className="mt-1 text-[10px]">{row.bank_reference || "No bank reference"}</div>
        </div>
      ),
    },
  ], [formatMoney]);

  const financeColumns = useMemo<Array<EnterpriseColumn<FinanceRow>>>(() => [
    {
      key: "order",
      label: "Order",
      sortable: true,
      searchValue: (row) => `${row.orderId} ${row.order?.customer_username || ""} ${(row.order?.items || []).map((item) => item.product?.name || "").join(" ")}`,
      sortValue: (row) => row.orderId,
      render: (row) => (
        <div>
          <div className="font-semibold text-text">#{row.orderId}</div>
          <div className="mt-1 text-[10px] text-text-faint">{row.order?.customer_username || "Unknown customer"}</div>
        </div>
      ),
    },
    {
      key: "payment",
      label: "Payment",
      searchable: true,
      searchValue: (row) => `${paymentMethodLabel(row.ledger.payment_method)} ${row.order?.status || ""} ${row.order?.payment_status || ""}`,
      render: (row) => (
        <div>
          <span className={`inline-flex rounded-full px-2 py-1 text-[10px] font-semibold ${paymentMethodTone(row.ledger.payment_method)}`}>
            {paymentMethodLabel(row.ledger.payment_method)}
          </span>
          <div className="mt-1 text-[10px] text-text-faint">{titleCase(row.order?.status || row.ledger.settlement_status)}</div>
        </div>
      ),
    },
    {
      key: "customerPaid",
      label: "Customer Paid",
      sortable: true,
      align: "right",
      sortValue: (row) => row.customerPaidAmount,
      render: (row) => (
        <div className="text-right">
          <div className="font-semibold text-text">{formatMoney(row.customerPaidAmount)}</div>
          <div className="mt-1 text-[10px] text-text-faint">Total {formatMoney(Number(row.order?.total_amount ?? row.order?.total ?? row.customerPaidAmount))}</div>
        </div>
      ),
    },
    {
      key: "supplier",
      label: "Supplier",
      searchable: true,
      searchValue: (row) => `${row.supplier?.profile?.business_name || row.supplier?.username || ""} ${row.supplier?.profile?.badge_level || ""}`,
      render: (row) => (
        <div>
          <div className="font-semibold text-text">{row.supplier?.profile?.business_name || row.supplier?.username || `Supplier #${row.ledger.supplier_id}`}</div>
          <div className="mt-1 text-[10px] text-text-faint">{formatMoney(Number(row.supplierSettlement?.net_amount ?? row.ledger.net_supplier_amount ?? 0))} · {titleCase(row.supplierSettlement?.status || "missing")}</div>
        </div>
      ),
    },
    {
      key: "supplierPayout",
      label: "Supplier Payout",
      align: "center",
      render: (row) => (
        <SelectionCheckbox
          settlement={row.supplierSettlement}
          selected={row.supplierSettlement ? selectedSupplierSettlementIds.includes(row.supplierSettlement.id) : false}
          onToggle={() => row.supplierSettlement && toggleSelection("supplier", row.supplierSettlement.id)}
        />
      ),
    },
    {
      key: "logistics",
      label: "Logistics",
      searchable: true,
      searchValue: (row) => `${row.ledger.logistics_partner_id || ""} ${row.logisticsSettlement?.status || ""} ${row.logisticsSettlement?.cod_remittance_status || ""}`,
      render: (row) => (
        <div>
          <div className="font-semibold text-text">{formatMoney(Number(row.logisticsSettlement?.total_delivery_fee ?? row.ledger.net_logistics_amount ?? 0))}</div>
          <div className="mt-1 text-[10px] text-text-faint">COD {titleCase(row.logisticsSettlement?.cod_remittance_status || "n/a")}</div>
        </div>
      ),
    },
    {
      key: "logisticsPayout",
      label: "Logistics Payout",
      align: "center",
      render: (row) => (
        <SelectionCheckbox
          settlement={row.logisticsSettlement}
          selected={row.logisticsSettlement ? selectedLogisticsSettlementIds.includes(row.logisticsSettlement.id) : false}
          onToggle={() => row.logisticsSettlement && toggleSelection("logistics", row.logisticsSettlement.id)}
        />
      ),
    },
    {
      key: "remittance",
      label: "COD Receipt",
      searchable: true,
      searchValue: (row) => `${row.logisticsSettlement?.cod_remittance_status || ""} ${row.ledger.cod_remittance_due || 0}`,
      render: (row) => <ReceivedFromLogisticsCell row={row} formatMoney={formatMoney} />,
    },
    {
      key: "refund",
      label: "Refund",
      searchable: true,
      searchValue: (row) => `${row.refund?.refund_reason || ""} ${row.refund?.status || ""}`,
      render: (row) => (
        <div className="text-text-muted">
          <div className="text-text">{row.refund ? titleCase(row.refund.status) : "None"}</div>
          <div className="mt-1 text-[10px] text-text-faint">{row.refund?.refund_reason || "No inquiry"}</div>
        </div>
      ),
    },
    {
      key: "transaction",
      label: "Transaction",
      sortable: true,
      searchValue: (row) => isTransactionClosed(row) ? "closed" : "remaining",
      sortValue: (row) => isTransactionClosed(row) ? 1 : 0,
      render: (row) => (
        <span className={`inline-flex rounded-full px-2 py-1 text-[10px] font-semibold ${isTransactionClosed(row) ? "theme-chip-success" : "theme-chip-warning"}`}>
          {isTransactionClosed(row) ? "Closed" : "Remaining"}
        </span>
      ),
    },
  ], [formatMoney, selectedLogisticsSettlementIds, selectedSupplierSettlementIds]);

  const toggleSelection = (kind: "supplier" | "logistics", settlementId: number) => {
    if (kind === "supplier") {
      setSelectedSupplierSettlementIds((current) => current.includes(settlementId) ? current.filter((value) => value !== settlementId) : [...current, settlementId]);
      return;
    }
    setSelectedLogisticsSettlementIds((current) => current.includes(settlementId) ? current.filter((value) => value !== settlementId) : [...current, settlementId]);
  };

  const toggleSelectAll = (kind: "supplier" | "logistics", checked: boolean) => {
    if (kind === "supplier") {
      setSelectedSupplierSettlementIds(checked ? eligibleSupplierSettlementIds : []);
      return;
    }
    setSelectedLogisticsSettlementIds(checked ? eligibleLogisticsSettlementIds : []);
  };

  const runDispatch = async (kind: "supplier" | "logistics") => {
    if (!selectedTransferProvider) {
      throw new Error("Select a payment gateway first.");
    }

    const response = await apiFetch(`/finance/admin/payouts/${kind}/dispatch?provider=${encodeURIComponent(selectedTransferProvider)}&dry_run=false&background=true`, { method: "POST" });
    const payload = await parseJsonResponse(response);
    if (!response.ok) throw new Error(getErrorMessage(payload));

    const job = payload as BackgroundJob<Record<string, unknown>>;
    const label = kind === "supplier" ? "Supplier payout dispatch" : "Logistics payout dispatch";
    void trackBackgroundJob(job, {
      label,
      description: `${selectedTransferProvider} live dispatch`,
      route: "/admin/finance?section=finance",
      queuedToast: `${label} queued`,
      successToast: () => `${label} completed`,
      errorToast: (text) => `${label} failed: ${text}`,
    });
  };

  const handleProcessSelected = async () => {
    const hasSupplierSelection = selectedSupplierSettlementIds.length > 0;
    const hasLogisticsSelection = selectedLogisticsSettlementIds.length > 0;

    if (!hasSupplierSelection && !hasLogisticsSelection) {
      setMessage({ type: "error", text: "Select at least one supplier or logistics payout checkbox first." });
      return;
    }

    if (!selectedProvider?.configured) {
      setMessage({ type: "error", text: "Choose a configured payment gateway before proceeding." });
      return;
    }

    setProcessing(true);
    setMessage(null);

    try {
      const messages: string[] = [];

      if (hasSupplierSelection) {
        const response = await apiFetch("/finance/admin/payouts/supplier/process", {
          method: "POST",
          headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
          body: JSON.stringify({ settlement_ids: selectedSupplierSettlementIds }),
        });
        const payload = await parseJsonResponse(response);
        if (!response.ok) throw new Error(getErrorMessage(payload));
        const data = payload as SupplierPayoutResult;
        messages.push(`supplier ${data.processed}`);
        if ((data.payouts || []).length > 0) {
          await runDispatch("supplier");
        }
      }

      if (hasLogisticsSelection) {
        const response = await apiFetch("/finance/admin/payouts/logistics/process", {
          method: "POST",
          headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
          body: JSON.stringify({ settlement_ids: selectedLogisticsSettlementIds }),
        });
        const payload = await parseJsonResponse(response);
        if (!response.ok) throw new Error(getErrorMessage(payload));
        const data = payload as LogisticsPayoutResult;
        messages.push(`logistics ${data.processed}`);
        if ((data.payouts || []).length > 0) {
          await runDispatch("logistics");
        }
      }

      setSelectedSupplierSettlementIds([]);
      setSelectedLogisticsSettlementIds([]);
      setMessage({ type: "success", text: `Proceed selected payouts queued through ${selectedProvider.name}. ${messages.join(" · ")}.` });
      await loadData();
    } catch (error) {
      setMessage({ type: "error", text: error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Failed to proceed selected payouts." });
    } finally {
      setProcessing(false);
    }
  };

  const handleVerifyReceipt = async (receiptId: number) => {
    setReceiptActionId(receiptId);
    try {
      const response = await apiFetch(`/finance/admin/cod-remittance-receipts/${receiptId}/verify`, {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ note: "Verified in finance workspace" }),
      });
      const payload = await parseJsonResponse(response);
      if (!response.ok) throw new Error(getErrorMessage(payload));
      setMessage({ type: "success", text: `COD receipt #${receiptId} verified and reconciled.` });
      await loadData();
    } catch (error) {
      setMessage({ type: "error", text: error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Failed to verify COD receipt." });
    } finally {
      setReceiptActionId(null);
    }
  };

  const handleRejectReceipt = async (receiptId: number) => {
    const note = window.prompt("Reason for rejecting this COD receipt:");
    if (!note) return;
    setReceiptActionId(receiptId);
    try {
      const response = await apiFetch(`/finance/admin/cod-remittance-receipts/${receiptId}/reject`, {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ note }),
      });
      const payload = await parseJsonResponse(response);
      if (!response.ok) throw new Error(getErrorMessage(payload));
      setMessage({ type: "success", text: `COD receipt #${receiptId} rejected.` });
      await loadData();
    } catch (error) {
      setMessage({ type: "error", text: error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Failed to reject COD receipt." });
    } finally {
      setReceiptActionId(null);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      <div className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface p-2.5">
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-2">
          <div className="grid flex-1 gap-2 sm:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-5">
            <MiniStat label="Gross Collected" value={formatMoney(summary?.total_revenue || 0)} icon={DollarSign} tone="theme-chip-success" />
            <MiniStat label="Supplier Selected" value={formatMoney(supplierSelectedAmount)} icon={ArrowUpRight} tone={selectedSupplierSettlementIds.length > 0 ? "theme-chip-warning" : "theme-chip-muted"} />
            <MiniStat label="Logistics Selected" value={formatMoney(logisticsSelectedAmount)} icon={Truck} tone={selectedLogisticsSettlementIds.length > 0 ? "theme-chip-info" : "theme-chip-muted"} />
            <MiniStat label="Transaction Remaining" value={String(remainingCount)} icon={CreditCard} tone={remainingCount > 0 ? "theme-chip-warning" : "theme-chip-success"} />
            <MiniStat label="Transaction Closed" value={String(closedCount)} icon={CheckCircle} tone={closedCount > 0 ? "theme-chip-success" : "theme-chip-muted"} />
          </div>
          <button onClick={() => void loadData()} className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-lg border border-border bg-surface-2 px-3 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-text-muted hover:text-text">
            <RefreshCw className={`h-3.5 w-3.5 ${loading ? "animate-spin" : ""}`} /> Refresh
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {message ? (
        <div className={`rounded-xl border px-3 py-2 text-xs font-medium ${message.type === "success" ? "border-success/30 bg-success/5 text-success" : "border-danger/30 bg-danger/5 text-danger"}`}>
          {message.text}
        </div>
      ) : null}

      <div className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface p-3">
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-3">
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 text-xs text-text-muted">
            <span className="rounded-full bg-primary/10 px-3 py-1 font-semibold text-primary">Selected {selectedCount}</span>
            <span>Supplier {selectedSupplierSettlementIds.length}</span>
            <span>Logistics {selectedLogisticsSettlementIds.length}</span>
            <span>COD pending {formatMoney(summary?.pending_cod_remittances || 0)}</span>
          </div>
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-end justify-end gap-2 border-t border-border pt-3">
            <label className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-lg border border-border bg-surface-2 px-3 py-2 text-xs text-text-muted">
              <input
                type="checkbox"
                className="h-3.5 w-3.5 accent-current"
                checked={allEligibleSupplierSelected}
                disabled={loading || processing || eligibleSupplierSettlementIds.length === 0}
                onChange={(event) => toggleSelectAll("supplier", event.currentTarget.checked)}
              />
              Supplier payout selection ({eligibleSupplierSettlementIds.length})
            </label>
            <label className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-lg border border-border bg-surface-2 px-3 py-2 text-xs text-text-muted">
              <input
                type="checkbox"
                className="h-3.5 w-3.5 accent-current"
                checked={allEligibleLogisticsSelected}
                disabled={loading || processing || eligibleLogisticsSettlementIds.length === 0}
                onChange={(event) => toggleSelectAll("logistics", event.currentTarget.checked)}
              />
              Logistics payout selection ({eligibleLogisticsSettlementIds.length})
            </label>
            <label className="block text-xs text-text-muted">
              <span className="mb-1 block font-semibold text-text">Payment Gateway</span>
              <select value={selectedTransferProvider} onChange={(event) => setSelectedTransferProvider(event.target.value)} className="min-w-52 rounded-lg border border-border bg-surface-2 px-3 py-2 text-xs text-text">
                {(transferProviders?.providers || []).map((provider) => (
                  <option key={provider.key} value={provider.key}>{provider.name}</option>
                ))}
              </select>
            </label>
            <button
              onClick={() => void handleProcessSelected()}
              disabled={processing || loading || selectedCount === 0 || !selectedProvider?.configured}
              className={`inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-lg px-4 py-2 text-xs font-semibold transition-colors disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50 ${selectedCount > 0 && selectedProvider?.configured ? "theme-btn-primary" : "border border-border bg-surface-2 text-text-muted"}`}
            >
              {processing ? <RefreshCw className="h-4 w-4 animate-spin" /> : <CheckCircle className="h-4 w-4" />} Proceed Selected Payouts
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
        {selectedProvider?.missing_requirements && selectedProvider.missing_requirements.length > 0 ? (
          <div className="mt-3 rounded-xl border border-warning/30 bg-warning/5 px-3 py-2 text-xs text-warning">
            {selectedProvider.missing_requirements.join(" · ")}
          </div>
        ) : null}
      </div>

      <div className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface p-3">
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-4">
          <div>
            <h3 className="flex items-center gap-2 text-base font-bold text-text">
              <AlertTriangle className="h-4 w-4 text-warning" /> COD Receipt Verification
            </h3>
            <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-text-muted">Review logistics-uploaded proof before marking COD deposits as reconciled in finance.</p>
          </div>
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
            <span className={`rounded-full px-3 py-1 text-xs font-semibold ${pendingReceiptCount > 0 ? "bg-warning/10 text-warning" : "bg-success/10 text-success"}`}>
              Pending {pendingReceiptCount}
            </span>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="mt-4">
          <EnterpriseDataTable
            columns={receiptColumns}
            rows={filteredCodReceipts}
            rowKey={(row) => row.id}
            densityMode={density}
            searchPlaceholder="Search receipts, partner, reference..."
            enableBulkActions={false}
            showSelectionSummary={false}
            toolbarSlot={(
              <select value={receiptFilter} onChange={(event) => setReceiptFilter(event.target.value as ReceiptFilter)} className="rounded-lg border border-border bg-surface-2 px-3 py-2 text-xs text-text">
                <option value="all">All proof states</option>
                <option value="pending">Pending review</option>
                <option value="verified">Verified</option>
                <option value="rejected">Rejected</option>
              </select>
            )}
            emptyState="No COD receipts match the current filter."
            rowActions={(receipt) => {
              const actionable = normalizeStatus(receipt.status) === "pending";
              return (
                <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    disabled={!actionable || receiptActionId === receipt.id}
                    onClick={() => void handleVerifyReceipt(receipt.id)}
                    className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-lg border border-success/25 bg-success/10 px-2.5 py-1 text-[11px] font-semibold text-success disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50"
                  >
                    <CheckCircle className="h-3.5 w-3.5" /> Verify
                  </button>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    disabled={!actionable || receiptActionId === receipt.id}
                    onClick={() => void handleRejectReceipt(receipt.id)}
                    className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-lg border border-danger/25 bg-danger/10 px-2.5 py-1 text-[11px] font-semibold text-danger disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50"
                  >
                    <XCircle className="h-3.5 w-3.5" /> Reject
                  </button>
                </div>
              );
            }}
            mobileCardRenderer={(receipt) => (
              <div className="space-y-2 text-xs">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
                  <span className="font-semibold text-text">Receipt #{receipt.id}</span>
                  <StatusChip status={receipt.status} />
                </div>
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 text-text-muted">
                  <span>{receipt.partner_name || `Partner #${receipt.partner_id}`}</span>
                  <span>{formatMoney(receipt.amount)}</span>
                </div>
              </div>
            )}
          />
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface p-3">
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-4">
          <div>
            <h3 className="text-base font-bold text-text">Order Settlement Table</h3>
            <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-text-muted">Expand a row to inspect supplier badge, order items, shipping context, and payout readiness before proceeding.</p>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="mt-4">
          <EnterpriseDataTable
            columns={financeColumns}
            rows={filteredRows}
            rowKey={(row) => row.key}
            densityMode={density}
            searchPlaceholder="Search order, supplier, badge, item..."
            enableBulkActions={false}
            showSelectionSummary={false}
            toolbarSlot={(
              <>
                <select value={paymentFilter} onChange={(event) => setPaymentFilter(event.target.value as PaymentFilter)} className="rounded-lg border border-border bg-surface-2 px-3 py-2 text-xs text-text">
                  <option value="all">All payments</option>
                  <option value="card">Card</option>
                  <option value="cod">COD</option>
                </select>
                <select value={statusFilter} onChange={(event) => setStatusFilter(event.target.value as TableStatusFilter)} className="rounded-lg border border-border bg-surface-2 px-3 py-2 text-xs text-text">
                  <option value="all">All states</option>
                  <option value="needs-action">Needs action</option>
                  <option value="processing">Processing</option>
                  <option value="refund">Refund linked</option>
                </select>
                <select value={transactionFilter} onChange={(event) => setTransactionFilter(event.target.value as TransactionFilter)} className="rounded-lg border border-border bg-surface-2 px-3 py-2 text-xs text-text">
                  <option value="all">All transactions</option>
                  <option value="closed">Transaction Closed</option>
                  <option value="remaining">Transaction Remaining</option>
                </select>
              </>
            )}
            emptyState="No finance rows match the current filters."
            rowActions={(row) => (
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setFocusedRowKey((current) => current === row.key ? null : row.key)}
                className="rounded-md border border-border bg-surface-2 px-2 py-1 text-[11px] font-semibold text-text-muted transition-colors hover:border-primary/30 hover:text-primary"
              >
                {focusedRowKey === row.key ? "Hide details" : "Details"}
              </button>
            )}
            mobileCardRenderer={(row) => (
              <div className="space-y-2 text-xs">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
                  <span className="font-semibold text-text">Order #{row.orderId}</span>
                  <span className={`inline-flex rounded-full px-2 py-1 text-[10px] font-semibold ${isTransactionClosed(row) ? "theme-chip-success" : "theme-chip-warning"}`}>
                    {isTransactionClosed(row) ? "Closed" : "Remaining"}
                  </span>
                </div>
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 text-text-muted">
                  <span>{row.supplier?.profile?.business_name || row.supplier?.username || `Supplier #${row.ledger.supplier_id}`}</span>
                  <span>{formatMoney(row.customerPaidAmount)}</span>
                </div>
              </div>
            )}
            expandedRowKey={focusedRowKey ?? undefined}
            expandedRowRenderer={(row) => (
              <div className="p-4">
                <div className="mb-3 flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
                  <div>
                    <h4 className="text-sm font-bold text-text">Transaction Details</h4>
                    <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-text-muted">Expanded settlement context for order #{row.orderId}.</p>
                  </div>
                  <button type="button" onClick={() => setFocusedRowKey(null)} className="rounded-lg border border-border bg-surface px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-text-muted hover:text-text">
                    Close
                  </button>
                </div>
                <ExpandedFinanceDetails row={row} formatMoney={formatMoney} />
              </div>
            )}
          />
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function SelectionCheckbox({
  settlement,
  selected,
  onToggle,
}: {
  settlement?: { status: string; eligible_at?: string | null };
  selected: boolean;
  onToggle: () => void;
}) {
  if (!settlement) return <span className="text-text-faint">N/A</span>;

  const normalized = normalizeStatus(settlement.status);
  const disabled = normalized !== "eligible";
  const helperText = normalized === "settled"
    ? "Paid"
    : normalized === "processing"
      ? "Processing"
      : disabled
        ? `Hold until ${fmtDate(settlement.eligible_at)}`
        : "Ready";

  return (
    <label className={`inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-lg border px-2 py-1 text-[11px] font-medium ${selected ? "border-success/30 bg-success/10 text-success" : disabled ? "border-border bg-surface text-text-faint" : "border-info/25 bg-info/5 text-info"}`}>
      <input type="checkbox" className="h-3.5 w-3.5 accent-current" checked={selected} disabled={disabled} onChange={onToggle} />
      <span>{helperText}</span>
    </label>
  );
}

function ReceivedFromLogisticsCell({ row, formatMoney }: { row: FinanceRow; formatMoney: (value: number) => string }) {
  if (!isCodRow(row)) {
    return <span className="theme-chip-muted rounded-full px-2 py-1 text-[10px] font-semibold">Not required</span>;
  }

  const remitted = Number(row.logisticsSettlement?.cod_remitted || 0);
  const collected = Number(row.logisticsSettlement?.cod_collected || 0);
  const due = Number(row.ledger.cod_remittance_due || 0);
  const complete = codReceiptComplete(row);

  return (
    <div>
      <div className={`inline-flex rounded-full px-2 py-1 text-[10px] font-semibold ${complete ? "theme-chip-success" : "theme-chip-warning"}`}>
        {complete ? "Received" : "Awaiting"}
      </div>
      <div className="mt-1 font-semibold text-text">{formatMoney(remitted)}</div>
      <div className="mt-1 text-[10px] text-text-faint">Collected {formatMoney(collected)} · Due {formatMoney(due)}</div>
    </div>
  );
}

function ExpandedFinanceDetails({ row, formatMoney }: { row: FinanceRow; formatMoney: (value: number) => string }) {
  const supplierName = row.supplier?.profile?.business_name || row.supplier?.username || `Supplier #${row.ledger.supplier_id}`;
  const supplierBadge = row.supplier?.profile?.badge_level || "none";
  const relevantItems = (row.order?.items || []).filter((item) => {
    const supplierId = item.product?.supplier_id;
    return supplierId == null || supplierId === row.ledger.supplier_id;
  });
  const itemsToShow = relevantItems.length > 0 ? relevantItems : (row.order?.items || []);

  return (
    <div className="grid gap-4 lg:grid-cols-[1.1fr,1fr,1.2fr]">
      <div className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface p-3">
        <p className="text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.16em] text-text-faint">Supplier Decision Context</p>
        <div className="mt-3 space-y-2 text-xs text-text-muted">
          <div>
            <p className="font-semibold text-text">{supplierName}</p>
            <div className="mt-1 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
              <span className={`rounded-full px-2 py-1 text-[10px] font-semibold ${badgeTone(supplierBadge)}`}>{titleCase(supplierBadge)} badge</span>
              <StatusChip status={row.supplier?.profile?.verification_status || "pending"} />
            </div>
          </div>
          <p>Supplier ID: #{row.ledger.supplier_id}</p>
          <p>Net supplier amount: <span className="font-semibold text-text">{formatMoney(Number(row.supplierSettlement?.net_amount ?? row.ledger.net_supplier_amount ?? 0))}</span></p>
          <p>Commission deducted: <span className="font-semibold text-text">{formatMoney(Number(row.supplierSettlement?.commission_deducted || 0))}</span></p>
          <p>Supplier payout eligibility: <span className="font-semibold text-text">{fmtDate(row.supplierSettlement?.eligible_at)}</span></p>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface p-3">
        <p className="text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.16em] text-text-faint">Order Context</p>
        <div className="mt-3 space-y-2 text-xs text-text-muted">
          <p>Customer: <span className="font-semibold text-text">{row.order?.customer_username || "Unknown"}</span></p>
          <p>Created: <span className="font-semibold text-text">{fmtDate(row.order?.created_at || row.ledger.created_at)}</span></p>
          <p>Payment method: <span className="font-semibold text-text">{paymentMethodLabel(row.ledger.payment_method)}</span></p>
          <p>Shipping: <span className="font-semibold text-text">{row.order?.shipping_address || "Not captured"}</span></p>
          <p>Customer paid: <span className="font-semibold text-text">{formatMoney(row.customerPaidAmount)}</span></p>
          {isCodRow(row) ? (
            <p>COD received from logistics: <span className="font-semibold text-text">{formatMoney(Number(row.logisticsSettlement?.cod_remitted || 0))}</span></p>
          ) : null}
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface p-3">
        <p className="text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.16em] text-text-faint">Order Items</p>
        <div className="mt-3 space-y-2 text-xs text-text-muted">
          {itemsToShow.length === 0 ? (
            <p>No item details available.</p>
          ) : (
            itemsToShow.map((item) => (
              <div key={item.id} className="rounded-lg border border-border bg-surface-2 px-3 py-2">
                <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
                  <p className="font-semibold text-text">{item.product?.name || `Product #${item.product_id}`}</p>
                  <p className="font-semibold text-text">{formatMoney(Number(item.price || 0) * Number(item.quantity || 0))}</p>
                </div>
                <p className="mt-1">Qty {item.quantity}{item.selected_size ? ` · Size ${item.selected_size}` : ""}{item.selected_color ? ` · ${item.selected_color}` : ""}</p>
              </div>
            ))
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function MiniStat({ label, value, icon: Icon, tone }: { label: string; value: string; icon: ComponentType<{ className?: string }>; tone: string }) {
  return (
    <div className="rounded-lg border border-border bg-surface-2 px-3 py-2">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
        <span className={`rounded-full px-2 py-1 text-[10px] font-semibold ${tone}`}>{label}</span>
        <Icon className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-primary" />
      </div>
      <p className="mt-1.5 text-[15px] font-bold text-text">{value}</p>
    </div>
  );
}
```

### `frontend\web_app\src\app\admin\dashboard\tabs\FlashSalesTab.tsx`

```text
﻿"use client";

import { useEffect, useState, useCallback } from "react";
import { Sparkles } from "@/lib/icons";
import { apiFetch } from "@/lib/api";
import { normalizeListPage } from "@/lib/listResponse";

interface FlashSale {
  id: number;
  title: string;
  discount_pct: number;
  starts_at: string;
  ends_at: string;
  is_active: boolean;
  product_ids: number[] | null;
  created_at: string;
}

export default function FlashSalesTab() {
  const [flashSales, setFlashSales] = useState<FlashSale[]>([]);
  const [flashSalesLoading, setFlashSalesLoading] = useState(false);
  const [flashSaleForm, setFlashSaleForm] = useState({ title: "", discount_pct: "20", starts_at: "", ends_at: "", is_active: true, product_ids: "" });
  const [flashSaleFormError, setFlashSaleFormError] = useState("");
  const [flashSaleSaving, setFlashSaleSaving] = useState(false);
  const [showFlashSaleForm, setShowFlashSaleForm] = useState(false);
  const [editingFlashSaleId, setEditingFlashSaleId] = useState<number | null>(null);

  const fetchFlashSales = useCallback(async () => {
    setFlashSalesLoading(true);
    try {
      const res = await apiFetch("/admin/flash-sales");
      if (res.ok) {
        const payload = normalizeListPage<FlashSale>(await res.json());
        setFlashSales(payload.data);
      }
    } catch {}
    setFlashSalesLoading(false);
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => { fetchFlashSales(); }, [fetchFlashSales]);

  const handleSaveFlashSale = async () => {
    if (!flashSaleForm.title.trim() || !flashSaleForm.starts_at || !flashSaleForm.ends_at) {
      setFlashSaleFormError("Title, start date, and end date are required"); return;
    }
    const pct = parseFloat(flashSaleForm.discount_pct);
    if (isNaN(pct) || pct <= 0 || pct > 100) { setFlashSaleFormError("Discount must be 1–100"); return; }
    setFlashSaleSaving(true); setFlashSaleFormError("");
    const body = {
      title: flashSaleForm.title.trim(),
      discount_pct: pct,
      starts_at: new Date(flashSaleForm.starts_at).toISOString(),
      ends_at: new Date(flashSaleForm.ends_at).toISOString(),
      is_active: flashSaleForm.is_active,
      product_ids: flashSaleForm.product_ids.trim()
        ? flashSaleForm.product_ids.split(",").map((item) => Number(item.trim())).filter((item) => Number.isFinite(item) && item > 0)
        : null,
    };
    const url = editingFlashSaleId ? `/admin/flash-sales/${editingFlashSaleId}` : "/admin/flash-sales";
    const method = editingFlashSaleId ? "PUT" : "POST";
    const res = await apiFetch(url, { method, headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" }, body: JSON.stringify(body) });
    if (res.ok) { await fetchFlashSales(); setShowFlashSaleForm(false); } else { const e = await res.json().catch(() => ({})); setFlashSaleFormError(e.detail || "Save failed"); }
    setFlashSaleSaving(false);
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <h3 className="text-xs font-bold text-text flex items-center gap-2">
          <Sparkles className="w-4 h-4 theme-status-warning" /> Flash Sales
        </h3>
        <button
          onClick={() => { setShowFlashSaleForm(true); setEditingFlashSaleId(null); setFlashSaleForm({ title: "", discount_pct: "20", starts_at: "", ends_at: "", is_active: true, product_ids: "" }); setFlashSaleFormError(""); }}
          className="theme-btn-primary rounded-xl px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold"
        >
          + New Flash Sale
        </button>
      </div>

      {showFlashSaleForm && (
        <div className="theme-card border rounded-xl p-4 space-y-3">
          <h4 className="text-xs font-bold text-text">{editingFlashSaleId ? "Edit Flash Sale" : "Create Flash Sale"}</h4>
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3">
            <div>
              <label className="text-[10px] text-text-faint font-semibold uppercase">Title</label>
              <input value={flashSaleForm.title} onChange={(e) => setFlashSaleForm((f) => ({ ...f, title: e.target.value }))}
                className="w-full mt-1 rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface-2 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs text-text outline-none focus:border-primary" placeholder="Summer 50% Off" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className="text-[10px] text-text-faint font-semibold uppercase">Discount %</label>
              <input type="number" min="1" max="100" value={flashSaleForm.discount_pct} onChange={(e) => setFlashSaleForm((f) => ({ ...f, discount_pct: e.target.value }))}
                className="w-full mt-1 rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface-2 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs text-text outline-none focus:border-primary" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className="text-[10px] text-text-faint font-semibold uppercase">Starts At</label>
              <input type="datetime-local" value={flashSaleForm.starts_at} onChange={(e) => setFlashSaleForm((f) => ({ ...f, starts_at: e.target.value }))}
                className="w-full mt-1 rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface-2 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs text-text outline-none focus:border-primary" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className="text-[10px] text-text-faint font-semibold uppercase">Ends At</label>
              <input type="datetime-local" value={flashSaleForm.ends_at} onChange={(e) => setFlashSaleForm((f) => ({ ...f, ends_at: e.target.value }))}
                className="w-full mt-1 rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface-2 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs text-text outline-none focus:border-primary" />
            </div>
            <div className="sm:col-span-2">
              <label className="text-[10px] text-text-faint font-semibold uppercase">Product IDs (JSON array, optional — leave blank for all)</label>
              <input value={flashSaleForm.product_ids} onChange={(e) => setFlashSaleForm((f) => ({ ...f, product_ids: e.target.value }))}
                className="w-full mt-1 rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface-2 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs text-text outline-none focus:border-primary font-mono" placeholder='[1, 2, 3]' />
            </div>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <input type="checkbox" id="fs-active" checked={flashSaleForm.is_active} onChange={(e) => setFlashSaleForm((f) => ({ ...f, is_active: e.target.checked }))} className="rounded" />
              <label htmlFor="fs-active" className="text-xs text-text">Active</label>
            </div>
          </div>
          {flashSaleFormError && <p className="text-xs text-danger">{flashSaleFormError}</p>}
          <div className="flex gap-2">
            <button disabled={flashSaleSaving} onClick={handleSaveFlashSale} className="theme-btn-primary rounded-xl px-4 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold disabled:opacity-50">
              {flashSaleSaving ? "Saving…" : editingFlashSaleId ? "Update" : "Create"}
            </button>
            <button onClick={() => setShowFlashSaleForm(false)} className="theme-btn-secondary rounded-xl px-4 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold">Cancel</button>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {flashSalesLoading ? (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-3">
          {Array.from({ length: 3 }).map((_, i) => <div key={i} className="h-32 rounded-xl bg-surface-2 animate-pulse" />)}
        </div>
      ) : flashSales.length === 0 ? (
        <div className="py-12 text-center text-text-faint text-xs">No flash sales yet. Create your first one above.</div>
      ) : (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-3">
          {flashSales.map((fs) => {
            const now = Date.now();
            const started = new Date(fs.starts_at).getTime() <= now;
            const ended = new Date(fs.ends_at).getTime() < now;
            const statusLabel = !fs.is_active ? "Inactive" : ended ? "Ended" : started ? "Live" : "Upcoming";
            const statusCls = !fs.is_active ? "theme-chip-muted" : ended ? "theme-chip-danger" : started ? "theme-chip-success" : "theme-chip-info";
            return (
              <div key={fs.id} className="theme-card border rounded-xl p-4 space-y-2">
                <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-2">
                  <p className="text-xs font-bold text-text leading-tight">{fs.title}</p>
                  <span className={`shrink-0 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-lg text-[10px] font-semibold ${statusCls}`}>{statusLabel}</span>
                </div>
                <p className="text-2xl font-bold text-primary">{fs.discount_pct}% OFF</p>
                <p className="text-[10px] text-text-faint">
                  {new Date(fs.starts_at).toLocaleString()} → {new Date(fs.ends_at).toLocaleString()}
                </p>
                <p className="text-[10px] text-text-faint font-mono truncate">Products: {fs.product_ids?.length ? fs.product_ids.join(", ") : "All active products"}</p>
                <div className="flex gap-2 pt-1">
                  <button onClick={() => { setEditingFlashSaleId(fs.id); setFlashSaleForm({ title: fs.title, discount_pct: String(fs.discount_pct), starts_at: fs.starts_at.replace("Z", "").slice(0, 16), ends_at: fs.ends_at.replace("Z", "").slice(0, 16), is_active: fs.is_active, product_ids: fs.product_ids?.join(", ") ?? "" }); setShowFlashSaleForm(true); setFlashSaleFormError(""); }}
                    className="text-[10px] font-semibold text-primary hover:underline">Edit</button>
                  <button onClick={async () => { if (!confirm("Delete this flash sale?")) return; await apiFetch(`/admin/flash-sales/${fs.id}`, { method: "DELETE" }); fetchFlashSales(); }}
                    className="text-[10px] font-semibold text-danger hover:underline">Delete</button>
                </div>
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```text
"use client";

import { useEffect, useState, useCallback } from "react";
import { apiFetch } from "@/lib/api";
import { useAuth } from "@/lib/useAuth";
import { hasAdminPermission, setAdminPermissionOverrides } from "@shared/adminPermissions";
import { useToastStore } from "@/lib/toastStore";

interface HierarchyPermissions {
  role: string;
  permissions: string[];
  matrix: Record<string, string[]>;
}

/** All permission keys that can ever be assigned to a role. */
const ALL_PERMISSIONS = [
  "analytics.view",
  "audit.read",
  "coupons.manage",
  "hierarchy.view",
  "moderation.products",
  "moderation.suppliers",
  "orders.manage",
  "payouts.verify",
  "products.manage",
  "staff.create",
  "tickets.manage",
  "users.delete",
  "users.read",
  "users.role.update",
  "users.toggle_active",
] as const;

export default function HierarchyTab() {
  const { user, isLoggedIn, isLoading: authLoading } = useAuth();
  const role = user?.role ?? null;
  const isAdmin = role === "admin";
  const addToast = useToastStore((s) => s.addToast);

  const [hierarchyPermissions, setHierarchyPermissions] = useState<HierarchyPermissions | null>(null);
  const [editingRole, setEditingRole] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [editPerms, setEditPerms] = useState<Set<string>>(new Set());
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);

  const fetchHierarchyPermissions = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      const res = await apiFetch("/admin/hierarchy/permissions");
      if (res.ok) {
        const data = (await res.json()) as HierarchyPermissions;
        setHierarchyPermissions(data);
        setAdminPermissionOverrides(data.matrix);
      } else {
        setHierarchyPermissions(null);
      }
    } catch {
      setHierarchyPermissions(null);
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!authLoading && isLoggedIn && hasAdminPermission(role, "hierarchy.view")) {
      fetchHierarchyPermissions();
    }
  }, [fetchHierarchyPermissions, authLoading, isLoggedIn, role]);

  const startEditing = (targetRole: string, currentPerms: string[]) => {
    setEditingRole(targetRole);
    setEditPerms(new Set(currentPerms));
  };

  const cancelEditing = () => {
    setEditingRole(null);
    setEditPerms(new Set());
  };

  const togglePerm = (perm: string) => {
    setEditPerms((prev) => {
      const next = new Set(prev);
      if (next.has(perm)) next.delete(perm);
      else next.add(perm);
      return next;
    });
  };

  const savePermissions = async () => {
    if (!editingRole) return;
    setSaving(true);
    try {
      const res = await apiFetch(`/admin/hierarchy/permissions/${editingRole}`, {
        method: "PUT",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ permissions: Array.from(editPerms) }),
      });
      if (res.ok) {
        const data = (await res.json()) as HierarchyPermissions;
        setHierarchyPermissions(data);
        setAdminPermissionOverrides(data.matrix);
        cancelEditing();
        addToast(`Permissions for "${editingRole}" updated`, "success");
      } else {
        const err = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
        addToast(err.detail || "Failed to save permissions", "error");
      }
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  };

  if (!hierarchyPermissions) {
    return (
      <div className="theme-card rounded-2xl border p-6 text-sm text-text-muted">
        Could not load hierarchy permissions.
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      <div className="theme-card rounded-2xl border p-5">
        <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-text">Current Role: {hierarchyPermissions.role}</h3>
        <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-text-muted">
          Effective permissions ({hierarchyPermissions.permissions.length})
        </p>
        <div className="mt-3 flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">
          {hierarchyPermissions.permissions.map((permission) => (
            <span
              key={permission}
              className="rounded-full border border-border bg-surface-2 px-2.5 py-1 text-[10px] font-semibold text-text-muted"
            >
              {permission}
            </span>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="grid gap-3 md:grid-cols-2">
        {Object.entries(hierarchyPermissions.matrix).map(([matrixRole, permissions]) => {
          const isEditingThis = editingRole === matrixRole;
          return (
            <div key={matrixRole} className="theme-card rounded-2xl border p-4">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-2">
                <h4 className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-text">{matrixRole}</h4>
                {isAdmin && !isEditingThis && (
                  <button
                    onClick={() => startEditing(matrixRole, permissions)}
                    className="text-[10px] font-semibold text-brand hover:underline"
                  >
                    Edit
                  </button>
                )}
                {isAdmin && isEditingThis && (
                  <div className="flex gap-2">
                    <button
                      onClick={cancelEditing}
                      disabled={saving}
                      className="text-[10px] font-semibold text-text-muted hover:underline disabled:opacity-50"
                    >
                      Cancel
                    </button>
                    <button
                      onClick={savePermissions}
                      disabled={saving}
                      className="text-[10px] font-semibold text-brand hover:underline disabled:opacity-50"
                    >
                      {saving ? "Saving…" : "Save"}
                    </button>
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>

              {isEditingThis ? (
                <div className="mt-2 flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                  {ALL_PERMISSIONS.map((perm) => (
                    <label
                      key={`edit-${matrixRole}-${perm}`}
                      className="flex cursor-pointer items-center gap-1 rounded-full border border-border bg-surface-2 px-2.5 py-1 text-[10px] font-semibold text-text-muted hover:border-brand"
                    >
                      <input
                        type="checkbox"
                        checked={editPerms.has(perm)}
                        onChange={() => togglePerm(perm)}
                        className="accent-brand h-3 w-3"
                      />
                      {perm}
                    </label>
                  ))}
                </div>
              ) : (
                <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">
                  {permissions.map((permission) => (
                    <span
                      key={`${matrixRole}-${permission}`}
                      className="rounded-full border border-border bg-surface-2 px-2.5 py-1 text-[10px] font-semibold text-text-muted"
                    >
                      {permission}
                    </span>
                  ))}
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          );
        })}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```text
"use client";

import { useEffect, useState, useCallback } from "react";
import { motion } from "framer-motion";
import { apiFetch } from "@/lib/api";
import { useAuth } from "@/lib/useAuth";
import { useCurrencyStore } from "@/lib/currencyStore";
import { hasAdminPermission } from "@shared/adminPermissions";

const MotionDiv = motion.div as any;

interface TopCustomer {
  user_id: number;
  username: string;
  email: string;
  order_count: number;
  total_spent: number;
}

export default function InsightsTab() {
  const { user, isLoggedIn, isLoading: authLoading } = useAuth();
  const role = user?.role ?? null;
  const formatMoney = useCurrencyStore((s) => s.format);

  const [topCustomers, setTopCustomers] = useState<TopCustomer[]>([]);
  const [topCatPurchased, setTopCatPurchased] = useState<{ category: string; units_sold: number }[]>([]);
  const [newCustThisMonth, setNewCustThisMonth] = useState(0);
  const [newCustLastMonth, setNewCustLastMonth] = useState(0);
  const [totalCustomers, setTotalCustomers] = useState(0);

  const fetchCustomerInsights = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      const res = await apiFetch("/admin/customers/insights");
      if (res.ok) {
        const data = await res.json();
        setTopCustomers(data.top_customers ?? []);
        setTopCatPurchased(data.top_categories ?? []);
        setNewCustThisMonth(data.new_customers_this_month ?? 0);
        setNewCustLastMonth(data.new_customers_last_month ?? 0);
        setTotalCustomers(data.total_customers ?? 0);
      }
    } catch {}
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!authLoading && isLoggedIn && hasAdminPermission(role, "analytics.view")) {
      fetchCustomerInsights();
    }
  }, [fetchCustomerInsights, authLoading, isLoggedIn, role]);

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      {/* Growth metrics */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
        <div className="theme-card rounded-2xl border p-5">
          <p className="text-xs text-text-faint mb-1">New Customers This Month</p>
          <p className="text-3xl font-bold theme-status-success">{newCustThisMonth}</p>
          {newCustLastMonth > 0 && (
            <p className="text-xs text-text-muted mt-1">
              vs {newCustLastMonth} last month
              <span className={`ml-1 font-semibold ${newCustThisMonth >= newCustLastMonth ? "theme-status-success" : "theme-status-danger"}`}>
                ({newCustThisMonth >= newCustLastMonth ? "+" : ""}{((newCustThisMonth - newCustLastMonth) / Math.max(newCustLastMonth, 1) * 100).toFixed(0)}%)
              </span>
            </p>
          )}
        </div>
        <div className="theme-card rounded-2xl border p-5">
          <p className="text-xs text-text-faint mb-1">Total Customers</p>
          <p className="text-3xl font-bold theme-status-info">{totalCustomers}</p>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Top customers */}
      <div className="theme-card rounded-2xl border overflow-hidden">
        <div className="p-4 border-b border-border">
          <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-text">Top Customers by Spend</h3>
        </div>
        {topCustomers.length === 0 ? (
          <div className="p-8 text-center text-sm text-text-muted">No customer data yet</div>
        ) : (
          <div className="overflow-x-auto">
            <table className="w-full text-sm">
              <thead>
                <tr className="border-b border-border">
                  {["#", "Customer", "Email", "Orders", "Total Spent"].map((h) => (
                    <th key={h} className="text-left p-4 text-xs font-semibold text-text-faint">{h}</th>
                  ))}
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody>
                {topCustomers.map((c, i) => (
                  <tr key={c.user_id} className="border-b border-border/50 last:border-0 hover:bg-surface-2/50 transition-colors">
                    <td className="p-4 text-text-muted text-xs">{i + 1}</td>
                    <td className="p-4 text-text font-medium">{c.username}</td>
                    <td className="p-4 text-text-muted text-xs">{c.email}</td>
                    <td className="p-4 theme-status-info font-semibold text-center">{c.order_count}</td>
                    <td className="p-4 theme-status-success font-bold">{formatMoney(c.total_spent)}</td>
                  </tr>
                ))}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Top purchased categories */}
      <div className="theme-card rounded-2xl border p-5">
        <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-text mb-4">Most Purchased Categories</h3>
        <div className="space-y-2">
          {topCatPurchased.map((c) => {
            const max = Math.max(...topCatPurchased.map((x) => x.units_sold), 1);
            return (
              <div key={c.category} className="flex items-center gap-3">
                <div className="w-28 text-xs text-text-muted truncate text-right">{c.category}</div>
                <div className="flex-1 h-4 rounded-full bg-surface-3 overflow-hidden">
                  <MotionDiv
                    initial={{ width: 0 }}
                    animate={{ width: `${(c.units_sold / max) * 100}%` }}
                    transition={{ delay: 0.2, duration: 0.6 }}
                    className="h-full rounded-full bg-info"
                  />
                </div>
                <div className="w-12 text-xs text-text-muted text-right">{c.units_sold}</div>
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```
