### `frontend\web_app\src\app\admin\dashboard\tabs\LogisticsPartnersTab.tsx`

```text
﻿"use client";

import { useCallback, useEffect, useState, type MouseEvent } from "react";
import { motion, AnimatePresence } from "framer-motion";
import Link from "next/link";
import { AlertCircle, Plus, RefreshCw, ShieldCheck, Trash2 } from "@/lib/icons";
import { apiFetch } from "@/lib/api";
import { dc, useDensity } from "@/lib/densityContext";

const MotionDiv = motion.div as any;

interface LogisticsPartner {
  id: number;
  name: string;
  code: string;
  contact_name?: string;
  contact_email?: string;
  contact_phone?: string;
  website?: string;
  coverage_regions?: string[];
  service_types?: string[];
  status: string;
  verification_status?: string;
  user_id?: number | null;
  notes?: string | null;
  created_at: string;
}

export default function LogisticsPartnersTab() {
  const { density } = useDensity();
  const cellPad = dc(density, "p-2", "p-3", "p-4");
  const bodyText = dc(density, "text-[11px]", "text-xs", "text-sm");
  const [logisticsPartners, setLogisticsPartners] = useState<LogisticsPartner[]>([]);
  const [lpLoading, setLpLoading] = useState(false);
  const [showLpModal, setShowLpModal] = useState(false);
  const [lpForm, setLpForm] = useState({ name: "", code: "", contact_name: "", contact_email: "", contact_phone: "", website: "", notes: "", coverage_regions: "", service_types: "" });
  const [lpSaving, setLpSaving] = useState(false);
  const [lpError, setLpError] = useState("");
  const [lpActionId, setLpActionId] = useState<number | null>(null);

  const fetchLogisticsPartners = useCallback(async () => {
    setLpLoading(true);
    try {
      const res = await apiFetch("/logistics-partners/");
      if (res.ok) setLogisticsPartners(await res.json());
    } catch {}
    setLpLoading(false);
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchLogisticsPartners();
  }, [fetchLogisticsPartners]);

  const handleCreatePartner = async () => {
    setLpSaving(true);
    setLpError("");
    try {
      const res = await apiFetch("/logistics-partners/", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify(lpForm),
      });
      if (res.ok) {
        setShowLpModal(false);
        setLpForm({ name: "", code: "", contact_name: "", contact_email: "", contact_phone: "", website: "", notes: "", coverage_regions: "", service_types: "" });
        fetchLogisticsPartners();
      } else {
        const err = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
        setLpError((err as any).detail || "Failed to create partner");
      }
    } catch { setLpError("Network error"); }
    setLpSaving(false);
  };

  const handleDeletePartner = async (id: number) => {
    if (!confirm("Remove this logistics partner?")) return;
    setLpActionId(id);
    try {
      await apiFetch(`/logistics-partners/${id}`, { method: "DELETE" });
      fetchLogisticsPartners();
    } catch {}
    setLpActionId(null);
  };

  const handleTogglePartnerStatus = async (partner: LogisticsPartner) => {
    const newStatus = partner.status === "active" ? "suspended" : "active";
    try {
      const res = await apiFetch(`/logistics-partners/${partner.id}`, {
        method: "PUT",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ status: newStatus }),
      });
      if (res.ok) fetchLogisticsPartners();
    } catch {}
  };

  return (
    <>
      <div className="space-y-4">
        <div className="flex justify-end gap-2">
          <Link href="/admin/logistics-partners" className="flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-xl border border-border px-3 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-text-muted transition-colors hover:text-text">
            <ShieldCheck className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            Review Queue
          </Link>
          <button
            onClick={() => { setLpForm({ name: "", code: "", contact_name: "", contact_email: "", contact_phone: "", website: "", notes: "", coverage_regions: "", service_types: "" }); setShowLpModal(true); }}
            className="theme-btn-accent flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-xl px-3 py-2 text-xs font-semibold"
          >
            <Plus className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            Add Partner
          </button>
        </div>
        <div className="theme-card rounded-xl border overflow-hidden">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between p-5 border-b border-border">
            <h3 className="font-semibold text-text">Logistics Partners</h3>
            <button onClick={fetchLogisticsPartners} className="p-1.5 rounded-lg hover:bg-surface-2 text-text-muted transition-colors">
              <RefreshCw className={`w-4 h-4 ${lpLoading ? "animate-spin" : ""}`} />
            </button>
          </div>
          {lpLoading ? (
            <div className="p-8 text-center text-xs text-text-muted">Loading…</div>
          ) : logisticsPartners.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="p-8 text-center text-xs text-text-muted">No partners registered yet</div>
          ) : (
            <div className="overflow-x-auto">
              <table className="w-full text-xs">
                <thead>
                  <tr className="border-b border-border">
                    {["Name", "Code", "Contact", "Coverage", "Approval", "Status", "Actions"].map((h) => (
                      <th key={h} className={`text-left ${cellPad} ${bodyText} font-semibold text-text-faint`}>{h}</th>
                    ))}
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody>
                  {logisticsPartners.map((lp) => (
                    <tr key={lp.id} className="group border-b border-border/50 last:border-0 hover:bg-surface-2/40 transition-colors">
                      <td className={`${cellPad} ${bodyText} font-medium text-text`}>{lp.name}</td>
                      <td className={`${cellPad} ${bodyText} font-mono text-text-muted`}>{lp.code}</td>
                      <td className={`${cellPad} ${bodyText} text-text-muted`}>
                        <div>{lp.contact_email}</div>
                        <div>{lp.contact_phone ?? "—"}</div>
                      </td>
                      <td className={`${cellPad} ${bodyText} text-text-muted`}>{lp.coverage_regions ?? "\u2014"}</td>
                      <td className={cellPad}>
                        <span className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded-lg text-[10px] font-semibold ${
                          lp.verification_status === "approved"
                            ? "theme-chip-success"
                            : lp.verification_status === "rejected"
                              ? "theme-chip-danger"
                              : "theme-chip-warning"
                        }`}>{(lp.verification_status ?? "pending").replace(/_/g, " ")}</span>
                      </td>
                      <td className={cellPad}>
                        <span className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded-lg text-[10px] font-semibold ${
                          lp.status === "active" ? "theme-chip-success" : "theme-chip-muted"
                        }`}>{lp.status}</span>
                      </td>
                      <td className={`${cellPad} opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity`}>
                        <div className="flex gap-1.5">
                          <button
                            disabled={lpActionId === lp.id}
                            onClick={() => handleTogglePartnerStatus(lp)}
                            className="theme-chip-info rounded-lg px-2.5 py-1 text-[10px] font-semibold disabled:opacity-50"
                          >{lp.status === "active" ? "Disable" : "Enable"}</button>
                          <button
                            disabled={lpActionId === lp.id}
                            onClick={() => handleDeletePartner(lp.id)}
                            className="theme-chip-danger rounded-lg px-2.5 py-1 text-[10px] font-semibold flex items-center gap-1 disabled:opacity-50"
                          ><Trash2 className="w-3 h-3" />Delete</button>
                        </div>
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  ))}
                </tbody>
              </table>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Create Partner Modal */}
      <AnimatePresence>
        {showLpModal && (
          <MotionDiv
            initial={{ opacity: 0 }}
            animate={{ opacity: 1 }}
            exit={{ opacity: 0 }}
            className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 theme-overlay"
            onClick={(e: MouseEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => e.target === e.currentTarget && setShowLpModal(false)}
          >
            <MotionDiv
              initial={{ scale: 0.95, opacity: 0, y: 20 }}
              animate={{ scale: 1, opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
              exit={{ scale: 0.95, opacity: 0, y: 20 }}
              className="theme-card w-full max-w-md rounded-xl border p-6"
            >
              <h2 className="text-base font-bold text-text mb-5">Add Logistics Partner</h2>
              <div className="space-y-3">
                {[
                  { field: "name", label: "Company Name", placeholder: "Emirates Logistics" },
                  { field: "code", label: "Partner Code", placeholder: "EML" },
                  { field: "contact_email", label: "Contact Email", placeholder: "ops@company.com" },
                  { field: "contact_phone", label: "Phone (optional)", placeholder: "+971 50 000 0000" },
                  { field: "coverage_regions", label: "Coverage Regions", placeholder: "Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah" },
                  { field: "service_types", label: "Service Types", placeholder: "standard, express, same-day" },
                ].map(({ field, label, placeholder }) => (
                  <div key={field}>
                    <label className="mb-1 block text-xs text-text-muted">{label}</label>
                    <input
                      value={(lpForm as Record<string, string>)[field]}
                      onChange={(e) => setLpForm((prev) => ({ ...prev, [field]: e.target.value }))}
                      placeholder={placeholder}
                      className="theme-input w-full rounded-xl border px-3 py-2.5 text-xs placeholder:text-text-faint focus:border-accent focus:outline-none transition-colors"
                    />
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
              {lpError && (
                <div className="theme-alert-danger mt-3 flex items-center gap-2 rounded-xl p-3">
                  <AlertCircle className="h-4 w-4 shrink-0" />
                  <p className="text-xs">{lpError}</p>
                </div>
              )}
              <div className="flex gap-3 mt-6">
                <button onClick={() => setShowLpModal(false)} className="flex-1 rounded-xl border border-border py-2.5 text-xs font-semibold text-text-muted transition-colors hover:text-text">
                  Cancel
                </button>
                <button
                  onClick={handleCreatePartner}
                  disabled={lpSaving || !lpForm.name || !lpForm.code || !lpForm.contact_email}
                  className="theme-btn-accent flex-1 rounded-xl py-2.5 text-xs font-bold disabled:opacity-50"
                >
                  {lpSaving ? "Creating…" : "Create Partner"}
                </button>
              </div>
            </MotionDiv>
          </MotionDiv>
        )}
      </AnimatePresence>
    </>
  );
}
```

### `frontend\web_app\src\app\admin\dashboard\tabs\LogisticsTab.tsx`

```text
﻿"use client";

import { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { RefreshCw } from "@/lib/icons";
import { apiFetch } from "@/lib/api";
import { useDensity } from "@/lib/densityContext";
import { useAuth } from "@/lib/useAuth";
import { useTranslateText } from "@/lib/useTranslate";
import TranslatedText from "@/components/TranslatedText";
import { isAdminStaffRole } from "@shared/adminPermissions";
import { EnterpriseDataTable, type EnterpriseColumn } from "@shared/components/EnterpriseDataTable";

interface LogisticsSummary {
  total_shipments: number;
  awaiting_fulfilment: number;
  in_transit: number;
  delivered_total: number;
  active_zones?: number;
}

interface LogisticsChannel {
  channel: string;
  total_shipments?: number;
  total?: number;
  in_transit: number;
  delivered: number;
  returned_or_failed?: number;
  pending?: number;
}

interface LogisticsShipment {
  id: number;
  order_id: number;
  status: string;
  carrier_name?: string | null;
  tracking_number?: string | null;
  distribution_channel?: string | null;
  current_hub?: string | null;
  shipping_address?: string | null;
  created_at?: string | null;
  updated_at?: string | null;
}

interface LogisticsCarrier {
  id: number;
  name: string;
  code: string;
  is_active: boolean;
}

interface LogisticsZone {
  id: number;
  name: string;
  is_active: boolean;
}

const STATUS_BADGE: Record<string, string> = {
  success: "theme-chip-success",
  failure: "theme-chip-danger",
  warning: "theme-chip-warning",
  delivered: "theme-chip-success",
  cancelled: "theme-chip-danger",
  pending: "theme-chip-warning",
  confirmed: "theme-chip-info",
  shipped: "theme-chip-brand",
  processing: "theme-chip-info",
  refunded: "theme-chip-muted",
};

export default function LogisticsTab() {
  const { density } = useDensity();
  const { user, isLoggedIn, isLoading: authLoading } = useAuth();
  const role = user?.role ?? null;
  const refreshLabel = useTranslateText("Refresh");

  const [logisticsSummary, setLogisticsSummary] = useState<LogisticsSummary | null>(null);
  const [logisticsChannels, setLogisticsChannels] = useState<LogisticsChannel[]>([]);
  const [logisticsShipments, setLogisticsShipments] = useState<LogisticsShipment[]>([]);
  const [logisticsCarriers, setLogisticsCarriers] = useState<LogisticsCarrier[]>([]);
  const [logisticsZones, setLogisticsZones] = useState<LogisticsZone[]>([]);
  const [logisticsLoading, setLogisticsLoading] = useState(false);

  const shipmentColumns = useMemo<Array<EnterpriseColumn<LogisticsShipment>>>(() => [
    { key: "id", label: "Shipment", sortable: true, render: (row) => <span className="font-medium text-text">#{row.id}</span> },
    { key: "order_id", label: "Order", sortable: true, render: (row) => <span className="text-text-muted">#{row.order_id}</span> },
    {
      key: "status",
      label: "Status",
      sortable: true,
      render: (row) => (
        <span className={`inline-flex rounded-lg border px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-semibold ${STATUS_BADGE[row.status] ?? "theme-chip-muted"}`}>
          {row.status}
        </span>
      ),
    },
    { key: "carrier_name", label: "Carrier", searchable: true, render: (row) => row.carrier_name || "—" },
    {
      key: "distribution_channel",
      label: "Channel",
      searchable: true,
      render: (row) => <span className="capitalize text-text-muted">{row.distribution_channel?.replace(/_/g, " ") || "—"}</span>,
    },
    { key: "current_hub", label: "Hub", searchable: true, render: (row) => row.current_hub || "—" },
    { key: "tracking_number", label: "Tracking", searchable: true, render: (row) => row.tracking_number || "—" },
    {
      key: "updated_at",
      label: "Updated",
      sortable: true,
      render: (row) => row.updated_at ? new Date(row.updated_at).toLocaleString() : (row.created_at ? new Date(row.created_at).toLocaleString() : "—"),
      sortValue: (row) => new Date(row.updated_at || row.created_at || 0).getTime(),
    },
  ], []);

  const fetchLogistics = useCallback(async () => {
    if (authLoading || !isLoggedIn || !isAdminStaffRole(role)) return;

    setLogisticsLoading(true);
    try {
      const [summaryRes, channelsRes, shipmentsRes, carriersRes, zonesRes] = await Promise.all([
        apiFetch("/logistics/summary"),
        apiFetch("/logistics/distribution/channels"),
        apiFetch("/logistics/shipments/active"),
        apiFetch("/logistics/carriers"),
        apiFetch("/logistics/zones"),
      ]);

      if (summaryRes.ok) setLogisticsSummary(await summaryRes.json());
      if (channelsRes.ok) setLogisticsChannels(await channelsRes.json());
      if (shipmentsRes.ok) setLogisticsShipments(await shipmentsRes.json());
      if (carriersRes.ok) setLogisticsCarriers(await carriersRes.json());
      if (zonesRes.ok) setLogisticsZones(await zonesRes.json());
    } catch {
      setLogisticsSummary(null);
      setLogisticsChannels([]);
      setLogisticsShipments([]);
      setLogisticsCarriers([]);
      setLogisticsZones([]);
    }
    setLogisticsLoading(false);
  }, [authLoading, isLoggedIn, role]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (authLoading || !isLoggedIn || !isAdminStaffRole(role)) return;
    void fetchLogistics();
  }, [authLoading, isLoggedIn, role, fetchLogistics]);

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      <div className="flex justify-end">
        <button
          onClick={fetchLogistics}
          disabled={logisticsLoading}
          className="flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg border border-border bg-surface-2 px-3 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-text-muted hover:text-text transition-colors disabled:opacity-50"
        >
          <RefreshCw className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 ${logisticsLoading ? "animate-spin" : ""}`} />
          {refreshLabel}
        </button>
      </div>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 lg:grid-cols-6">
        {[
          { label: "Awaiting", value: logisticsSummary?.awaiting_fulfilment ?? 0, chip: "theme-chip-warning" },
          { label: "In Transit", value: logisticsSummary?.in_transit ?? 0, chip: "theme-chip-brand" },
          { label: "Delivered", value: logisticsSummary?.delivered_total ?? 0, chip: "theme-chip-success" },
          { label: "Shipments", value: logisticsSummary?.total_shipments ?? logisticsShipments.length, chip: "theme-chip-info" },
          { label: "Carriers", value: logisticsCarriers.length, chip: "theme-chip-muted" },
          { label: "Zones", value: logisticsSummary?.active_zones ?? logisticsZones.length, chip: "theme-chip-info" },
        ].map((item) => (
          <div key={item.label} className="theme-card rounded-lg border px-3 py-2.5">
            <span className={`inline-flex rounded-lg px-2 py-1 text-[10px] font-bold ${item.chip}`}><TranslatedText text={item.label} /></span>
            <p className="mt-2 text-lg font-bold text-text">{item.value}</p>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-3 xl:grid-cols-2">
        <div className="theme-card rounded-xl border p-3">
          <h3 className="mb-3 text-xs font-bold text-text"><TranslatedText text="Distribution Channels" /></h3>
          {logisticsChannels.length === 0 ? (
            <p className="text-xs text-text-faint py-8 text-center"><TranslatedText text="No distribution channel data available." /></p>
          ) : (
            <div className="space-y-2">
              {logisticsChannels.map((channel) => {
                const total = channel.total_shipments ?? channel.total ?? 0;
                const deliveredPct = total > 0 ? (channel.delivered / total) * 100 : 0;
                return (
                  <div key={channel.channel} className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface-1 p-3">
                    <div className="mb-2 flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
                      <div>
                        <p className="text-xs font-semibold text-text capitalize"><TranslatedText text={channel.channel.replace(/_/g, " ")} /></p>
                        <p className="text-xs text-text-muted">{total} <TranslatedText text="shipments" /> · {channel.in_transit} <TranslatedText text="in transit" /> · {(channel.pending ?? channel.returned_or_failed ?? 0)} <TranslatedText text="pending/issues" /></p>
                      </div>
                      <span className="theme-chip-success rounded-lg px-2 py-1 text-[10px] font-bold">{channel.delivered} <TranslatedText text="delivered" /></span>
                    </div>
                    <div className="h-2 rounded-full bg-surface-3 overflow-hidden">
                      <div className="h-full rounded-full bg-success" style={{ width: `${Math.max(6, deliveredPct)}%` }} />
                    </div>
                  </div>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

        <div className="theme-card rounded-xl border p-3">
          <h3 className="mb-3 text-xs font-bold text-text"><TranslatedText text="Carriers & Zones" /></h3>
          <div className="mb-3 grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
            <div className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface-1 p-3">
              <p className="text-xs text-text-muted"><TranslatedText text="Active Carriers" /></p>
              <p className="mt-1 text-lg font-bold text-text">{logisticsCarriers.filter((carrier) => carrier.is_active).length}</p>
            </div>
            <div className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface-1 p-3">
              <p className="text-xs text-text-muted"><TranslatedText text="Active Zones" /></p>
              <p className="mt-1 text-lg font-bold text-text">{logisticsZones.filter((zone) => zone.is_active).length}</p>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div className="space-y-2 max-h-72 overflow-auto pr-1">
            {logisticsCarriers.slice(0, 6).map((carrier) => (
              <div key={`carrier-${carrier.id}`} className="flex items-center justify-between rounded-xl border border-border/60 bg-surface-1 px-3 py-2 text-xs">
                <div>
                  <p className="font-semibold text-text">{carrier.name}</p>
                  <p className="text-text-muted uppercase">{carrier.code}</p>
                </div>
                <span className={carrier.is_active ? "theme-chip-success rounded-lg px-2 py-1 text-[10px] font-bold" : "theme-chip-muted rounded-lg px-2 py-1 text-[10px] font-bold"}>
                  {carrier.is_active ? "Active" : "Inactive"}
                </span>
              </div>
            ))}
            {logisticsZones.slice(0, 6).map((zone) => (
              <div key={`zone-${zone.id}`} className="flex items-center justify-between rounded-xl border border-border/60 bg-surface-1 px-3 py-2 text-xs">
                <div>
                  <p className="font-semibold text-text">{zone.name}</p>
                  <p className="text-text-muted">Zone #{zone.id}</p>
                </div>
                <span className={zone.is_active ? "theme-chip-info rounded-lg px-2 py-1 text-[10px] font-bold" : "theme-chip-muted rounded-lg px-2 py-1 text-[10px] font-bold"}>
                  {zone.is_active ? "Active" : "Disabled"}
                </span>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="theme-card overflow-hidden rounded-xl border">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-border px-3 py-2.5">
          <h3 className="text-xs font-bold text-text">Active Shipments</h3>
          <span className="text-xs text-text-muted">{logisticsShipments.length} active</span>
        </div>
        {logisticsShipments.length === 0 ? (
          <div className="p-8 text-center text-xs text-text-muted">No active shipments found.</div>
        ) : (
          <div className="p-3">
            <EnterpriseDataTable
              columns={shipmentColumns}
              rows={logisticsShipments}
              rowKey={(row) => row.id}
              densityMode={density}
              enableExport
              searchPlaceholder="Search shipments, hubs, carriers..."
              initialRowsPerPage={20}
              rowsPerPageOptions={[10, 20, 50]}
              virtualizeRows
              virtualWindowHeight={440}
              mobileCardRenderer={(row) => (
                <div className="space-y-2 text-xs">
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
                    <span className="font-semibold text-text">Shipment #{row.id}</span>
                    <span className={`inline-flex rounded-lg border px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-semibold ${STATUS_BADGE[row.status] ?? "theme-chip-muted"}`}>
                      {row.status}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 text-text-muted">
                    <span>Order #{row.order_id}</span>
                    <span>{row.carrier_name || "—"}</span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 text-text-muted">
                    <span className="capitalize">{row.distribution_channel?.replace(/_/g, " ") || "—"}</span>
                    <span>{row.tracking_number || "No tracking"}</span>
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}
            />
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

### `frontend\web_app\src\app\admin\dashboard\tabs\ModerationTab.tsx`

```text
﻿"use client";

import { useEffect, useState, useCallback } from "react";
import { CheckCircle, XCircle, RefreshCw } from "@/lib/icons";
import { apiFetch } from "@/lib/api";
import { normalizeListPage } from "@/lib/listResponse";
import { useAuth } from "@/lib/useAuth";
import { useCurrencyStore } from "@/lib/currencyStore";
import { resolveImage } from "@/lib/utils";
import { hasAdminPermission, isAdminStaffRole } from "@shared/adminPermissions";
import { connectUserRealtimeSocket, isAdminAlertRealtimeMessage } from "@/lib/userRealtime";
import { createRealtimeRefreshScheduler } from "@shared/realtime";

interface PendingProduct {
  id: number;
  name: string;
  category: string;
  price: number;
  supplier_id?: number;
  image_url?: string;
  created_at: string;
}

export default function ModerationTab() {
  const { user, isLoggedIn, isLoading: authLoading } = useAuth();
  const role = user?.role ?? null;
  const formatMoney = useCurrencyStore((s) => s.format);

  const [pendingProducts, setPendingProducts] = useState<PendingProduct[]>([]);
  const [moderationLoading, setModerationLoading] = useState(false);
  const [moderationActionId, setModerationActionId] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [rejectNote, setRejectNote] = useState<Record<number, string>>({});

  const fetchPendingProducts = useCallback(async () => {
    setModerationLoading(true);
    try {
      const res = await apiFetch("/admin/products/pending");
      if (res.ok) {
        const payload = normalizeListPage<PendingProduct>(await res.json());
        setPendingProducts(payload.data);
      }
    } catch {}
    setModerationLoading(false);
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!authLoading && isLoggedIn && hasAdminPermission(role, "moderation.products")) {
      fetchPendingProducts();
    }
  }, [fetchPendingProducts, authLoading, isLoggedIn, role]);

  // WebSocket: auto-refresh on admin product alerts
  useEffect(() => {
    if (authLoading || !isLoggedIn || !isAdminStaffRole(role)) return;
    if (!hasAdminPermission(role, "moderation.products")) return;

    const scheduler = createRealtimeRefreshScheduler(fetchPendingProducts);

    const socket = connectUserRealtimeSocket(
      () => undefined,
      (payload) => {
        if (payload && isAdminAlertRealtimeMessage(payload) && payload.type === "admin.alert.product") {
          scheduler.trigger();
        }
      },
    );

    return () => {
      scheduler.cancel();
      socket?.close();
    };
  }, [authLoading, isLoggedIn, role, fetchPendingProducts]);

  const handleApproveProduct = async (id: number) => {
    setModerationActionId(id);
    try {
      const res = await apiFetch(`/admin/products/${id}/approve`, { method: "POST" });
      if (res.ok) setPendingProducts((prev) => prev.filter((p) => p.id !== id));
    } catch {}
    setModerationActionId(null);
  };

  const handleRejectProduct = async (id: number) => {
    setModerationActionId(id);
    try {
      const note = rejectNote[id] || "";
      const params = note ? `?note=${encodeURIComponent(note)}` : "";
      const res = await apiFetch(`/admin/products/${id}/reject${params}`, { method: "POST" });
      if (res.ok) setPendingProducts((prev) => prev.filter((p) => p.id !== id));
    } catch {}
    setModerationActionId(null);
  };

  return (
    <div>
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-4">
        <h2 className="text-xs font-bold text-text">Product Moderation Queue</h2>
        <button onClick={fetchPendingProducts} className="p-2 rounded-xl text-text-muted hover:text-text transition-colors">
          <RefreshCw className={`w-4 h-4 ${moderationLoading ? "animate-spin" : ""}`} />
        </button>
      </div>
      {moderationLoading ? (
        <div className="space-y-2">{Array.from({ length: 4 }).map((_, i) => (
          <div key={i} className="h-16 rounded-xl bg-surface-2 animate-pulse" />
        ))}</div>
      ) : pendingProducts.length === 0 ? (
        <div className="text-center py-12 text-text-faint text-xs flex flex-col items-center gap-2">
          <CheckCircle className="w-8 h-8 theme-status-success" />
          <p>No products pending review</p>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className="space-y-3">
          {pendingProducts.map((p) => (
            <div key={p.id} className="theme-card border rounded-xl p-4">
              <div className="flex items-start gap-4">
                {p.image_url && (
                  <img src={resolveImage(p.image_url)} alt={p.name} className="w-14 h-14 object-cover rounded-lg" />
                )}
                <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                  <p className="text-xs font-semibold text-text truncate">{p.name}</p>
                  <p className="text-xs text-text-muted">{p.category} · {formatMoney(Number(p.price) || 0)}</p>
                  <p className="text-xs text-text-faint">Supplier #{p.supplier_id} · {new Date(p.created_at).toLocaleDateString()}</p>
                </div>
                <div className="flex flex-col gap-2 shrink-0">
                  <button
                    onClick={() => handleApproveProduct(p.id)}
                    disabled={moderationActionId === p.id}
                    className="theme-chip-success flex items-center gap-1 rounded-lg px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold transition-colors disabled:opacity-50"
                  >
                    <CheckCircle className="w-3 h-3" /> Approve
                  </button>
                  <div className="flex gap-2">
                    <input
                      value={rejectNote[p.id] || ""}
                      onChange={(e) => setRejectNote((prev) => ({ ...prev, [p.id]: e.target.value }))}
                      placeholder="Rejection note..."
                      className="flex-1 min-w-0 px-2 py-1 rounded-lg theme-input border text-xs focus:outline-none focus:border-danger"
                    />
                    <button
                      onClick={() => handleRejectProduct(p.id)}
                      disabled={moderationActionId === p.id}
                      className="theme-chip-danger flex items-center gap-1 rounded-lg px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold transition-colors disabled:opacity-50 shrink-0"
                    >
                      <XCircle className="w-3 h-3" /> Reject
                    </button>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```text
"use client";

import { useCurrencyStore } from "@/lib/currencyStore";

const STATUS_BADGE: Record<string, string> = {

                </td>
              </tr>
            ))}
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

### `frontend\web_app\src\app\admin\dashboard\tabs\PayoutsTab.tsx`

```text
﻿"use client";

import { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { RefreshCw, CheckCircle, XCircle, Clock, CreditCard, TrendingDown } from "@/lib/icons";
import { apiFetch } from "@/lib/api";
import { useDensity } from "@/lib/densityContext";
import { useCurrencyStore } from "@/lib/currencyStore";
import { useAuth } from "@/lib/useAuth";
import { isAdminStaffRole } from "@shared/adminPermissions";
import { EnterpriseDataTable, type EnterpriseColumn } from "@shared/components/EnterpriseDataTable";

interface PayoutRecord {
  id: number;
  supplier_id: number;
  supplier_username?: string;
  amount: number;
  currency?: string;
  status: string;
  method: string;
  reference?: string | null;
  notes?: string | null;
  created_at: string;
  processed_at?: string | null;
}

interface SettlementRecord {
  id: number;
  supplier_id: number;
  order_id: number;
  gross_amount: number;
  commission_deducted: number;
  net_amount: number;
  status: string;
  eligible_at?: string | null;
  currency: string;
  payment_method?: string | null;
  gateway_code?: string | null;
  settlement_cycle?: string | null;
  gateway_fee_deducted?: number | null;
}

interface GatewaySummary {
  gateway_code: string;
  settlement_cycle: string;
  count: number;
  total_net: number;
  total_fee_deducted: number;
  next_eligible?: string | null;
}

function buildGatewaySummaries(settlements: SettlementRecord[]): GatewaySummary[] {
  const map = new Map<string, GatewaySummary>();
  for (const s of settlements) {
    const code = s.gateway_code || "unknown";
    const cycle = s.settlement_cycle || "—";
    const key = `${code}::${cycle}`;
    const existing = map.get(key);
    const fee = s.gateway_fee_deducted ?? 0;
    if (existing) {
      existing.count += 1;
      existing.total_net += s.net_amount;
      existing.total_fee_deducted += fee;
      if (s.eligible_at && (!existing.next_eligible || s.eligible_at < existing.next_eligible)) {
        existing.next_eligible = s.eligible_at;
      }
    } else {
      map.set(key, {
        gateway_code: code,
        settlement_cycle: cycle,
        count: 1,
        total_net: s.net_amount,
        total_fee_deducted: fee,
        next_eligible: s.eligible_at ?? null,
      });
    }
  }
  return Array.from(map.values()).sort((a, b) => b.total_net - a.total_net);
}

const CYCLE_LABEL: Record<string, string> = {
  daily: "Daily",
  weekly: "Weekly",
  monthly: "Monthly",
  "—": "—",
};

export default function PayoutsTab() {
  const { density } = useDensity();
  const formatMoney = useCurrencyStore((s) => s.format);
  const { user, isLoggedIn, isLoading: authLoading } = useAuth();
  const role = user?.role ?? null;
  const [payouts, setPayouts] = useState<PayoutRecord[]>([]);
  const [payoutsLoading, setPayoutsLoading] = useState(false);
  const [payoutActionId, setPayoutActionId] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [settlements, setSettlements] = useState<SettlementRecord[]>([]);
  const [settlementsLoading, setSettlementsLoading] = useState(false);

  const fetchPayouts = useCallback(async () => {
    if (authLoading || !isLoggedIn || !isAdminStaffRole(role)) return;

    setPayoutsLoading(true);
    try {
      const res = await apiFetch("/admin/payouts/pending");
      if (res.ok) setPayouts(await res.json());
    } catch {}
    setPayoutsLoading(false);
  }, [authLoading, isLoggedIn, role]);

  const fetchSettlements = useCallback(async () => {
    if (authLoading || !isLoggedIn || !isAdminStaffRole(role)) return;

    setSettlementsLoading(true);
    try {
      const res = await apiFetch("/finance/admin/supplier-settlements?status=eligible&limit=100");
      if (res.ok) setSettlements(await res.json());
    } catch {}
    setSettlementsLoading(false);
  }, [authLoading, isLoggedIn, role]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (authLoading || !isLoggedIn || !isAdminStaffRole(role)) return;
    void fetchPayouts();
    void fetchSettlements();
  }, [authLoading, isLoggedIn, role, fetchPayouts, fetchSettlements]);

  const handlePayoutAction = async (id: number, action: "approve" | "reject") => {
    setPayoutActionId(id);
    try {
      const res = await apiFetch(`/admin/payouts/${id}/${action}`, { method: "POST" });
      if (res.ok) fetchPayouts();
    } catch {}
    setPayoutActionId(null);
  };

  const gatewaySummaries = buildGatewaySummaries(settlements);
  const payoutColumns = useMemo<Array<EnterpriseColumn<PayoutRecord>>>(() => [
    { key: "id", label: "ID", sortable: true, render: (row) => `#${row.id}` },
    { key: "supplier_id", label: "Supplier", searchable: true, render: (row) => row.supplier_username || `#${row.supplier_id}` },
    { key: "amount", label: "Amount", sortable: true, align: "right", render: (row) => formatMoney(row.amount) },
    { key: "method", label: "Method", searchable: true, render: (row) => row.method || "—" },
    { key: "reference", label: "Reference", searchable: true, render: (row) => row.reference ?? "—" },
    {
      key: "status",
      label: "Status",
      sortable: true,
      render: (row) => (
        <span className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded-lg text-[10px] font-semibold ${
          row.status === "approved" ? "theme-chip-success" :
          row.status === "rejected" ? "theme-chip-danger" : "theme-chip-warning"
        }`}>
          {row.status}
        </span>
      ),
    },
    {
      key: "created_at",
      label: "Created",
      sortable: true,
      render: (row) => new Date(row.created_at).toLocaleDateString(),
      sortValue: (row) => new Date(row.created_at).getTime(),
    },
  ], [formatMoney]);
  const settlementColumns = useMemo<Array<EnterpriseColumn<SettlementRecord>>>(() => [
    { key: "order_id", label: "Order", sortable: true, render: (row) => `#${row.order_id}` },
    { key: "supplier_id", label: "Supplier", sortable: true, render: (row) => `#${row.supplier_id}` },
    { key: "gateway_code", label: "Gateway", searchable: true, render: (row) => row.gateway_code || "—" },
    { key: "settlement_cycle", label: "Cycle", searchable: true, render: (row) => CYCLE_LABEL[row.settlement_cycle || "—"] ?? row.settlement_cycle ?? "—" },
    { key: "net_amount", label: "Net", sortable: true, align: "right", render: (row) => formatMoney(row.net_amount) },
    { key: "gateway_fee_deducted", label: "Fee", sortable: true, align: "right", render: (row) => formatMoney(row.gateway_fee_deducted ?? 0) },
    {
      key: "eligible_at",
      label: "Eligible",
      sortable: true,
      render: (row) => row.eligible_at ? new Date(row.eligible_at).toLocaleDateString() : "—",
      sortValue: (row) => row.eligible_at ? new Date(row.eligible_at).getTime() : 0,
    },
    { key: "status", label: "Status", sortable: true, searchable: true },
  ], [formatMoney]);

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      <div className="theme-card rounded-xl border overflow-hidden">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between px-3 py-2.5 border-b border-border">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <CreditCard className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-primary" />
            <h3 className="font-semibold text-text">Gateway Settlement Summary</h3>
          </div>
          <button
            onClick={fetchSettlements}
            className="p-1.5 rounded-lg hover:bg-surface-2 text-text-muted transition-colors"
          >
            <RefreshCw className={`w-4 h-4 ${settlementsLoading ? "animate-spin" : ""}`} />
          </button>
        </div>
        {settlementsLoading ? (
          <div className="p-5 text-center text-xs text-text-muted">Loading settlements…</div>
        ) : gatewaySummaries.length === 0 ? (
          <div className="p-5 text-center text-xs text-text-muted">No eligible settlements found</div>
        ) : (
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-3 p-3 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3">
            {gatewaySummaries.map((gs) => (
              <div key={`${gs.gateway_code}-${gs.settlement_cycle}`} className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface-2/50 p-3 space-y-2">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                  <span className="text-xs font-bold text-text uppercase tracking-wide">{gs.gateway_code}</span>
                  <span className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded-lg text-[10px] font-semibold ${
                    gs.settlement_cycle === "daily" ? "theme-chip-success" :
                    gs.settlement_cycle === "weekly" ? "theme-chip-warning" : "theme-chip-secondary"
                  }`}>
                    {CYCLE_LABEL[gs.settlement_cycle] ?? gs.settlement_cycle}
                  </span>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <p className="text-base font-bold text-text">{formatMoney(gs.total_net)}</p>
                  <p className="text-xs text-text-muted">{gs.count} settlement{gs.count !== 1 ? "s" : ""} eligible</p>
                </div>
                {gs.total_fee_deducted > 0 ? (
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-1 text-xs text-text-muted">
                    <TrendingDown className="w-3 h-3 text-danger" />
                    <span>{formatMoney(gs.total_fee_deducted)} gateway fees deducted</span>
                  </div>
                ) : null}
                {gs.next_eligible ? (
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-1 text-xs text-text-muted">
                    <Clock className="w-3 h-3" />
                    <span>Eligible from {new Date(gs.next_eligible).toLocaleDateString()}</span>
                  </div>
                ) : null}
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      <div className="theme-card rounded-xl border p-3">
        <EnterpriseDataTable
          columns={settlementColumns}
          rows={settlements}
          rowKey={(row) => row.id}
          densityMode={density}
          title="Eligible Settlement Rows"
          description="Pre-settlement records grouped in the gateway summary above."
          enableExport
          searchPlaceholder="Search settlements..."
          initialRowsPerPage={25}
          virtualizeRows
          virtualWindowHeight={420}
          mobileCardRenderer={(row) => (
            <div className="space-y-2 text-xs">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
                <span className="font-semibold text-text">Order #{row.order_id}</span>
                <span className="text-text-muted">{row.gateway_code || "—"}</span>
              </div>
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 text-text-muted">
                <span>Supplier #{row.supplier_id}</span>
                <span>{formatMoney(row.net_amount)}</span>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
        />
      </div>

      <div className="theme-card rounded-xl border p-3">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between px-3 py-2.5 border-b border-border">
          <h3 className="font-semibold text-text">Supplier Payouts</h3>
          <button onClick={fetchPayouts} className="p-1.5 rounded-lg hover:bg-surface-2 text-text-muted transition-colors">
            <RefreshCw className={`w-4 h-4 ${payoutsLoading ? "animate-spin" : ""}`} />
          </button>
        </div>
        {payoutsLoading ? (
          <div className="p-6 text-center text-xs text-text-muted">Loading…</div>
        ) : payouts.length === 0 ? (
          <div className="p-6 text-center text-xs text-text-muted">No pending payouts</div>
        ) : (
          <EnterpriseDataTable
            columns={payoutColumns}
            rows={payouts}
            rowKey={(row) => row.id}
            densityMode={density}
            enableExport
            searchPlaceholder="Search payouts..."
            initialRowsPerPage={25}
            virtualizeRows
            virtualWindowHeight={420}
            rowActions={(row) => row.status === "pending" ? (
              <div className="flex justify-end gap-1.5">
                <button
                  disabled={payoutActionId === row.id}
                  onClick={() => handlePayoutAction(row.id, "approve")}
                  className="theme-chip-success rounded-lg px-2.5 py-1 text-[10px] font-semibold flex items-center gap-1 disabled:opacity-50"
                >
                  <CheckCircle className="w-3 h-3" /> Approve
                </button>
                <button
                  disabled={payoutActionId === row.id}
                  onClick={() => handlePayoutAction(row.id, "reject")}
                  className="theme-chip-danger rounded-lg px-2.5 py-1 text-[10px] font-semibold flex items-center gap-1 disabled:opacity-50"
                >
                  <XCircle className="w-3 h-3" /> Reject
                </button>
              </div>
            ) : null}
            mobileCardRenderer={(row) => (
              <div className="space-y-2 text-xs">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
                  <span className="font-semibold text-text">Payout #{row.id}</span>
                  <span className="text-text-muted capitalize">{row.method}</span>
                </div>
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 text-text-muted">
                  <span>{row.supplier_username || `Supplier #${row.supplier_id}`}</span>
                  <span>{formatMoney(row.amount)}</span>
                </div>
              </div>
            )}
          />
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```text
"use client";

import { useCurrencyStore } from "@/lib/currencyStore";

interface AdminProduct {
  id: number;
  name: string;
  category: string;
  price: number | string | null | undefined;
  stock: number;
  supplier_id?: number;
}

interface Props {
  products: AdminProduct[];
  search: string;
}

export default function ProductsTab({ products, search }: Props) {
  const formatMoney = useCurrencyStore((s) => s.format);

  const filtered = products
    .filter((p) => !search || p.name?.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase()))
    .slice(0, 100);

  return (
    <div className="theme-card rounded-2xl border overflow-hidden">
      <div className="overflow-x-auto">
        <table className="w-full text-sm">
          <thead>
            <tr className="border-b border-border">
              {["ID", "Name", "Category", "Price", "Stock"].map((h) => (
                <th key={h} className="text-left p-4 text-xs font-semibold text-text-faint">{h}</th>
              ))}
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody>
            {filtered.map((p) => (
              <tr key={p.id} className="border-b border-border/50 last:border-0 hover:bg-surface-2/50 transition-colors">
                <td className="p-4 text-text-muted text-xs">#{p.id}</td>
                <td className="max-w-50 truncate p-4 font-medium text-text">{p.name}</td>
                <td className="p-4 text-text-muted text-xs">{p.category}</td>
                <td className="p-4 text-text font-medium">{formatMoney(Number(p.price) || 0)}</td>
                <td className="p-4">
                  <span className={`text-xs font-semibold ${p.stock <= 5 ? "theme-status-danger" : p.stock <= 20 ? "theme-status-warning" : "theme-status-success"}`}>
                    {p.stock}
                  </span>
                </td>
              </tr>
            ))}
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

### `frontend\web_app\src\app\admin\dashboard\tabs\SupplierDocumentsTab.tsx`

```text
"use client";

import { useEffect, useState, useCallback } from "react";
import { FileCheck2, CheckCircle, XCircle, RefreshCw } from "lucide-react";
import { apiFetch } from "@/lib/api";

interface SupplierDoc {
  id: number;
  supplier_id: number;
  supplier_username?: string;
  document_type: string;
  document_name: string;
  file_url: string;
  status: string;
  review_note?: string | null;
  reviewed_at?: string | null;
  created_at: string;
}

export default function SupplierDocumentsTab() {
  const [supplierDocs, setSupplierDocs] = useState<SupplierDoc[]>([]);
  const [supplierDocsLoading, setSupplierDocsLoading] = useState(false);
  const [supplierDocActionId, setSupplierDocActionId] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [supplierDocNotes, setSupplierDocNotes] = useState<Record<number, string>>({});
  const [supplierDocStatusFilter, setSupplierDocStatusFilter] = useState("");

  const fetchSupplierDocs = useCallback(async () => {
    setSupplierDocsLoading(true);
    try {
      const params = supplierDocStatusFilter ? `?status=${supplierDocStatusFilter}` : "";
      const res = await apiFetch(`/admin/suppliers/documents${params}`);
      if (res.ok) setSupplierDocs(await res.json());
    } catch {}
    setSupplierDocsLoading(false);
  }, [supplierDocStatusFilter]);

  useEffect(() => { fetchSupplierDocs(); }, [fetchSupplierDocs]);

  const handleReviewDoc = async (docId: number, action: "approved" | "rejected") => {
    setSupplierDocActionId(docId);
    try {
      const res = await apiFetch(`/admin/suppliers/documents/${docId}/review`, {
        method: "PUT",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ status: action, review_note: supplierDocNotes[docId] ?? "" }),
      });
      if (res.ok) fetchSupplierDocs();
    } catch {}
    setSupplierDocActionId(null);
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <div>
          <h2 className="text-base font-bold text-text flex items-center gap-2"><FileCheck2 className="w-4 h-4 theme-status-info" /> Supplier KYC Documents</h2>
          <p className="text-xs text-text-muted mt-1">Review and approve / reject supplier verification documents.</p>
        </div>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <select
            value={supplierDocStatusFilter}
            onChange={(e) => setSupplierDocStatusFilter(e.target.value)}
            className="theme-input rounded-xl border px-3 py-1.5 text-xs"
          >
            <option value="">All statuses</option>
            {["pending", "under_review", "approved", "rejected", "expired"].map((s) => (
              <option key={s} value={s}>{s}</option>
            ))}
          </select>
          <button onClick={fetchSupplierDocs} disabled={supplierDocsLoading}
            className="flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface-2 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-text-muted hover:text-text disabled:opacity-50">
            <RefreshCw className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 ${supplierDocsLoading ? "animate-spin" : ""}`} />
            Refresh
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
      {supplierDocsLoading ? (
        <div className="grid gap-3">{Array.from({ length: 3 }).map((_, i) => <div key={i} className="h-20 rounded-2xl bg-surface-2 animate-pulse" />)}</div>
      ) : supplierDocs.length === 0 ? (
        <div className="py-12 text-center text-sm text-text-muted">No documents found.</div>
      ) : (
        <div className="theme-card rounded-2xl border overflow-hidden">
          <div className="overflow-x-auto">
            <table className="w-full text-sm">
              <thead>
                <tr className="border-b border-border">
                  {["Doc", "Supplier", "Type", "Status", "Submitted", "Actions"].map((h) => (
                    <th key={h} className="p-4 text-left text-xs font-semibold text-text-faint">{h}</th>
                  ))}
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody>
                {supplierDocs.map((doc) => (
                  <tr key={doc.id} className="border-b border-border/50 last:border-0 hover:bg-surface-2/40 transition-colors">
                    <td className="p-4">
                      <a href={doc.file_url} target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"
                        className="text-xs font-medium text-primary hover:underline">
                        {doc.document_name}
                      </a>
                    </td>
                    <td className="p-4 text-xs text-text-muted">{doc.supplier_username ?? `#${doc.supplier_id}`}</td>
                    <td className="p-4 text-xs text-text-muted capitalize">{doc.document_type.replace(/_/g, " ")}</td>
                    <td className="p-4">
                      <span className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded-lg text-[10px] font-semibold ${
                        doc.status === "approved" ? "theme-chip-success" :
                        doc.status === "rejected" ? "theme-chip-danger" :
                        doc.status === "under_review" ? "theme-chip-info" :
                        doc.status === "expired" ? "theme-chip-muted" : "theme-chip-warning"
                      }`}>{doc.status}</span>
                    </td>
                    <td className="p-4 text-xs text-text-faint">{new Date(doc.created_at).toLocaleDateString()}</td>
                    <td className="p-4">
                      <div className="flex flex-col gap-1.5 min-w-48">
                        <input
                          value={supplierDocNotes[doc.id] ?? ""}
                          onChange={(e) => setSupplierDocNotes((prev) => ({ ...prev, [doc.id]: e.target.value }))}
                          placeholder="Review note (optional)"
                          className="theme-input rounded-lg border px-2 py-1 text-xs"
                        />
                        {["pending", "under_review"].includes(doc.status) && (
                          <div className="flex gap-1.5">
                            <button
                              disabled={supplierDocActionId === doc.id}
                              onClick={() => handleReviewDoc(doc.id, "approved")}
                              className="theme-chip-success rounded-lg px-2.5 py-1 text-[10px] font-semibold flex items-center gap-1 disabled:opacity-50"
                            ><CheckCircle className="w-3 h-3" />Approve</button>
                            <button
                              disabled={supplierDocActionId === doc.id}
                              onClick={() => handleReviewDoc(doc.id, "rejected")}
                              className="theme-chip-danger rounded-lg px-2.5 py-1 text-[10px] font-semibold flex items-center gap-1 disabled:opacity-50"
                            ><XCircle className="w-3 h-3" />Reject</button>
                          </div>
                        )}
                        {doc.review_note && <p className="text-[10px] text-text-faint italic">{doc.review_note}</p>}
                      </div>
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                ))}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```
