```text
﻿"use client";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import {
  Banknote,
  Building2,
  CheckCircle,
  CreditCard,
  RefreshCw,
  ShieldCheck,
  Trash2,
  XCircle,
} from "@/lib/icons";
import { apiFetch, getErrorMessage, parseJsonResponse } from "@/lib/api";

interface FinanceBankSettings {
  configured: boolean;
  id?: number | null;
  scope: string;
  account_label?: string | null;
  beneficiary_name?: string | null;
  bank_name?: string | null;
  branch_name?: string | null;
  account_number?: string | null;
  iban?: string | null;
  swift_code?: string | null;
  routing_number?: string | null;
  currency: string;
  support_email?: string | null;
  support_phone?: string | null;
  remittance_reference_prefix?: string | null;
  instructions?: string | null;
  is_active: boolean;
  updated_by?: number | null;
  updated_at?: string | null;
}

interface FinanceBankSettingsFormState {
  account_label: string;
  beneficiary_name: string;
  bank_name: string;
  branch_name: string;
  account_number: string;
  iban: string;
  swift_code: string;
  routing_number: string;
  currency: string;
  support_email: string;
  support_phone: string;
  remittance_reference_prefix: string;
  instructions: string;
  is_active: boolean;
}

interface FinanceBankConnectionTest {
  provider: string;
  endpoint?: string | null;
  ok: boolean;
  reachable: boolean;
  status_code?: number | null;
  detail: string;
  missing_requirements: string[];
}

interface TransferProvider {
  key: string;
  name: string;
  description: string;
  supports_direct_execution: boolean;
  configured: boolean;
  missing_requirements?: string[];
  is_default: boolean;
}

interface TransferProviderResponse {
  default_provider: string;
  providers: TransferProvider[];
}

interface BankAccountRecord {
  id: number;
  supplier_id?: number | null;
  partner_id?: number | null;
  entity_name?: string | null;
  beneficiary_name?: string | null;
  bank_name?: string | null;
  branch_name?: string | null;
  account_number?: string | null;
  iban?: string | null;
  swift_code?: string | null;
  routing_number?: string | null;
  currency?: string;
  bank_country?: string | null;
  verification_status: "pending" | "verified" | "rejected";
  verification_note?: string | null;
  verified_at?: string | null;
  created_at?: string | null;
  updated_at?: string | null;
}

type VerificationView = "treasury" | "supplier" | "logistics_partner";
type QueueKind = "supplier" | "logistics_partner";

const EMPTY_FORM: FinanceBankSettingsFormState = {
  account_label: "",
  beneficiary_name: "",
  bank_name: "",
  branch_name: "",
  account_number: "",
  iban: "",
  swift_code: "",
  routing_number: "",
  currency: "OMR",
  support_email: "",
  support_phone: "",
  remittance_reference_prefix: "",
  instructions: "",
  is_active: true,
};

function bankSettingsToForm(settings?: FinanceBankSettings | null): FinanceBankSettingsFormState {
  if (!settings) return EMPTY_FORM;
  return {
    account_label: settings.account_label || "",
    beneficiary_name: settings.beneficiary_name || "",
    bank_name: settings.bank_name || "",
    branch_name: settings.branch_name || "",
    account_number: settings.account_number || "",
    iban: settings.iban || "",
    swift_code: settings.swift_code || "",
    routing_number: settings.routing_number || "",
    currency: settings.currency || "OMR",
    support_email: settings.support_email || "",
    support_phone: settings.support_phone || "",
    remittance_reference_prefix: settings.remittance_reference_prefix || "",
    instructions: settings.instructions || "",
    is_active: settings.is_active ?? true,
  };
}

function toneClass(ok: boolean) {
  return ok ? "theme-chip-success" : "theme-chip-warning";
}

function formatDate(value?: string | null) {
  if (!value) return "Not yet";
  return new Date(value).toLocaleString();
}

function queueLabel(kind: QueueKind) {
  return kind === "supplier" ? "Supplier" : "Logistics Partner";
}

export default function BankAccountsPanel() {
  const [activeView, setActiveView] = useState<VerificationView>("treasury");
  const [loadingTreasury, setLoadingTreasury] = useState(true);
  const [savingTreasury, setSavingTreasury] = useState(false);
  const [testingConnection, setTestingConnection] = useState(false);
  const [bankSettings, setBankSettings] = useState<FinanceBankSettings | null>(null);
  const [bankForm, setBankForm] = useState<FinanceBankSettingsFormState>(EMPTY_FORM);
  const [connectionTest, setConnectionTest] = useState<FinanceBankConnectionTest | null>(null);
  const [providers, setProviders] = useState<TransferProviderResponse | null>(null);
  const [records, setRecords] = useState<Record<QueueKind, BankAccountRecord[]>>({ supplier: [], logistics_partner: [] });
  const [queueLoading, setQueueLoading] = useState<Record<QueueKind, boolean>>({ supplier: false, logistics_partner: false });
  const [noteMap, setNoteMap] = useState<Record<number, string>>({});
  const [actioning, setActioning] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [expandedId, setExpandedId] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [message, setMessage] = useState<{ type: "success" | "error"; text: string } | null>(null);

  const loadTreasury = async () => {
    setLoadingTreasury(true);
    setMessage(null);
    try {
      const [settingsResponse, providerResponse] = await Promise.all([
        apiFetch("/finance/admin/bank-settings"),
        apiFetch("/finance/admin/transfer-providers"),
      ]);

      const settingsPayload = await parseJsonResponse(settingsResponse);
      const providerPayload = await parseJsonResponse(providerResponse);

      if (settingsResponse.ok && settingsPayload) {
        const nextSettings = settingsPayload as FinanceBankSettings;
        setBankSettings(nextSettings);
        setBankForm(bankSettingsToForm(nextSettings));
      } else {
        setBankSettings(null);
        setBankForm(EMPTY_FORM);
      }

      if (providerResponse.ok && providerPayload) {
        setProviders(providerPayload as TransferProviderResponse);
      } else {
        setProviders(null);
      }
    } finally {
      setLoadingTreasury(false);
    }
  };

  const loadQueue = async (kind: QueueKind) => {
    setQueueLoading((current) => ({ ...current, [kind]: true }));
    setMessage(null);
    try {
      const response = await apiFetch(`/admin/bank-accounts/pending?kind=${kind}`);
      const payload = await parseJsonResponse(response);
      setRecords((current) => ({
        ...current,
        [kind]: response.ok && Array.isArray(payload) ? (payload as BankAccountRecord[]) : [],
      }));
    } finally {
      setQueueLoading((current) => ({ ...current, [kind]: false }));
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    void loadTreasury();
    void loadQueue("supplier");
    void loadQueue("logistics_partner");
  }, []);

  const handleSaveTreasury = async () => {
    setSavingTreasury(true);
    setMessage(null);
    try {
      const response = await apiFetch("/finance/admin/bank-settings", {
        method: "PUT",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          account_label: bankForm.account_label.trim() || undefined,
          beneficiary_name: bankForm.beneficiary_name.trim() || undefined,
          bank_name: bankForm.bank_name.trim() || undefined,
          branch_name: bankForm.branch_name.trim() || undefined,
          account_number: bankForm.account_number.trim() || undefined,
          iban: bankForm.iban.trim() || undefined,
          swift_code: bankForm.swift_code.trim() || undefined,
          routing_number: bankForm.routing_number.trim() || undefined,
          currency: bankForm.currency.trim() || "AED",
          support_email: bankForm.support_email.trim() || undefined,
          support_phone: bankForm.support_phone.trim() || undefined,
          remittance_reference_prefix: bankForm.remittance_reference_prefix.trim() || undefined,
          instructions: bankForm.instructions.trim() || undefined,
          is_active: bankForm.is_active,
        }),
      });
      const payload = await parseJsonResponse(response);
      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error(getErrorMessage(payload));
      }
      const nextSettings = payload as FinanceBankSettings;
      setBankSettings(nextSettings);
      setBankForm(bankSettingsToForm(nextSettings));
      setMessage({ type: "success", text: "Treasury bank account saved." });
      await loadTreasury();
    } catch (error) {
      setMessage({ type: "error", text: error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Failed to save treasury bank account." });
    } finally {
      setSavingTreasury(false);
    }
  };

  const handleTestConnection = async () => {
    setTestingConnection(true);
    setMessage(null);
    try {
      const response = await apiFetch("/finance/admin/bank-settings/test-connection", { method: "POST" });
      const payload = await parseJsonResponse(response);
      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error(getErrorMessage(payload));
      }
      setConnectionTest(payload as FinanceBankConnectionTest);
      setMessage({ type: "success", text: "Treasury connection test completed." });
    } catch (error) {
      setMessage({ type: "error", text: error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Connection test failed." });
    } finally {
      setTestingConnection(false);
    }
  };

  const handleVerification = async (kind: QueueKind, id: number, action: "approve" | "reject") => {
    setActioning(id);
    setMessage(null);
    try {
      const response = await apiFetch(`/admin/bank-accounts/${id}/${action}?kind=${kind}`, {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ note: noteMap[id] || null }),
      });
      const payload = await parseJsonResponse(response);
      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error(getErrorMessage(payload));
      }
      setRecords((current) => ({
        ...current,
        [kind]: current[kind].filter((record) => record.id !== id),
      }));
      setMessage({ type: "success", text: `${queueLabel(kind)} bank account ${action === "approve" ? "approved" : "rejected"}.` });
    } catch (error) {
      setMessage({ type: "error", text: error instanceof Error ? error.message : `Failed to ${action} bank account.` });
    } finally {
      setActioning(null);
    }
  };

  const handleDelete = async (kind: QueueKind, id: number) => {
    if (!window.confirm(`Delete this ${queueLabel(kind).toLowerCase()} bank account record?`)) {
      return;
    }

    setActioning(id);
    setMessage(null);
    try {
      const response = await apiFetch(`/admin/bank-accounts/${id}?kind=${kind}`, {
        method: "DELETE",
      });
      const payload = await parseJsonResponse(response);
      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error(getErrorMessage(payload));
      }
      setRecords((current) => ({
        ...current,
        [kind]: current[kind].filter((record) => record.id !== id),
      }));
      setExpandedId((current) => (current === id ? null : current));
      setMessage({ type: "success", text: `${queueLabel(kind)} bank account deleted.` });
    } catch (error) {
      setMessage({ type: "error", text: error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Failed to delete bank account." });
    } finally {
      setActioning(null);
    }
  };

  const pendingTotal = records.supplier.length + records.logistics_partner.length;
  const defaultProvider = providers?.providers.find((provider) => provider.is_default) || null;

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      <div className="rounded-2xl border border-border bg-linear-to-br from-surface via-surface to-primary/5 p-4">
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-4">
          <div className="max-w-4xl">
            <p className="text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.22em] text-primary">Treasury And Verification</p>
            <h2 className="mt-2 text-2xl font-bold text-text">Bank accounts that power payout execution</h2>
            <p className="mt-2 text-sm text-text-muted">
              Treasury setup belongs here, not on Finance. Configure Zozi’s payout account, test the bank API connection, and verify supplier plus logistics accounts before dispatch.
            </p>
          </div>
          <button onClick={() => { void loadTreasury(); void loadQueue("supplier"); void loadQueue("logistics_partner"); }} className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface-2 px-3 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-text-muted hover:text-text">
            <RefreshCw className={`h-4 w-4 ${loadingTreasury || queueLoading.supplier || queueLoading.logistics_partner ? "animate-spin" : ""}`} /> Refresh
          </button>
        </div>

        <div className="mt-4 grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-4">
          <SummaryCard label="Treasury status" value={bankSettings?.configured ? "Configured" : "Needs setup"} icon={Banknote} tone={toneClass(Boolean(bankSettings?.configured))} />
          <SummaryCard label="Bank API" value={defaultProvider?.configured ? defaultProvider.name : "Not ready"} icon={CreditCard} tone={toneClass(Boolean(defaultProvider?.configured))} />
          <SummaryCard label="Pending verification" value={String(pendingTotal)} icon={ShieldCheck} tone={pendingTotal > 0 ? "theme-chip-warning" : "theme-chip-success"} />
          <SummaryCard label="Treasury active" value={bankSettings?.is_active ? "Yes" : "No"} icon={CheckCircle} tone={toneClass(Boolean(bankSettings?.is_active))} />
        </div>

        <div className="mt-4 flex flex-wrap gap-2">
          {([
            ["treasury", "Treasury"],
            ["supplier", "Supplier verification"],
            ["logistics_partner", "Logistics verification"],
          ] as const).map(([view, label]) => (
            <button key={view} onClick={() => { setActiveView(view); setExpandedId(null); }} className={`rounded-xl px-3 py-2 text-xs font-semibold ${activeView === view ? "bg-primary text-on-brand" : "border border-border bg-surface-2 text-text-muted hover:text-text"}`}>
              {label}
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>

      {message ? (
        <div className={`rounded-xl border px-3 py-2 text-xs font-medium ${message.type === "success" ? "border-success/30 bg-success/5 text-success" : "border-danger/30 bg-danger/5 text-danger"}`}>
          {message.text}
        </div>
      ) : null}

      {activeView === "treasury" ? (
        <div className="grid gap-4 xl:grid-cols-[1.2fr,0.8fr]">
          <div className="rounded-2xl border border-border bg-surface p-4">
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-3">
              <div>
                <h3 className="text-base font-bold text-text">Zozi treasury bank account</h3>
                <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-text-muted">Used for supplier payouts, logistics payouts, COD remittance collection, and VAT transfers.</p>
              </div>
              <span className={`rounded-full px-2 py-1 text-[10px] font-semibold ${toneClass(Boolean(bankSettings?.configured))}`}>
                {bankSettings?.configured ? "configured" : "needs setup"}
              </span>
            </div>

            <div className="mt-4 grid gap-3 md:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-3">
              {[
                ["account_label", "Account label"],
                ["beneficiary_name", "Beneficiary name"],
                ["bank_name", "Bank name"],
                ["branch_name", "Branch / office"],
                ["account_number", "Account number"],
                ["iban", "IBAN"],
                ["swift_code", "SWIFT / BIC"],
                ["routing_number", "Routing number"],
                ["currency", "Currency"],
                ["support_email", "Finance support email"],
                ["support_phone", "Finance support phone"],
                ["remittance_reference_prefix", "Reference prefix"],
              ].map(([field, label]) => (
                <label key={field} className="space-y-1 text-[11px] text-text-muted">
                  <span>{label}</span>
                  <input
                    value={bankForm[field as keyof FinanceBankSettingsFormState] as string}
                    onChange={(event) => setBankForm((current) => ({ ...current, [field]: event.target.value }))}
                    className="w-full rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface-2 px-3 py-2 text-xs text-text outline-none focus:border-primary"
                  />
                </label>
              ))}
            </div>

            <label className="mt-3 block space-y-1 text-[11px] text-text-muted">
              <span>Bank instructions</span>
              <textarea
                value={bankForm.instructions}
                onChange={(event) => setBankForm((current) => ({ ...current, instructions: event.target.value }))}
                className="min-h-24 w-full rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface-2 px-3 py-2 text-xs text-text outline-none focus:border-primary"
                placeholder="Example: use payout ID or order ID in transfer references; COD remittances must reference the bank statement line."
              />
            </label>

            <div className="mt-3 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">
              <label className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs text-text-muted">
                <input type="checkbox" checked={bankForm.is_active} onChange={(event) => setBankForm((current) => ({ ...current, is_active: event.target.checked }))} />
                Treasury account is active for payout execution
              </label>
              <button onClick={() => void handleSaveTreasury()} disabled={savingTreasury || loadingTreasury} className="theme-chip-success rounded-lg px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold disabled:opacity-50">
                {savingTreasury ? "Saving..." : "Save treasury account"}
              </button>
              <button onClick={() => setBankForm(bankSettingsToForm(bankSettings))} className="theme-chip-muted rounded-lg px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold">
                Reset
              </button>
            </div>

            <p className="mt-3 text-[11px] text-text-faint">
              Last updated {formatDate(bankSettings?.updated_at)}{bankSettings?.updated_by ? ` by admin #${bankSettings.updated_by}` : ""}
            </p>
          </div>

          <div className="space-y-4">
            <div className="rounded-2xl border border-border bg-surface p-4">
              <div className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-3">
                <div>
                  <h3 className="text-base font-bold text-text">Bank API connection</h3>
                  <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-text-muted">Tests whether the configured payout endpoint is reachable before live dispatch.</p>
                </div>
                <button onClick={() => void handleTestConnection()} disabled={testingConnection || loadingTreasury} className="theme-chip-brand rounded-lg px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold disabled:opacity-50">
                  {testingConnection ? "Testing..." : "Test connection"}
                </button>
              </div>

              {connectionTest ? (
                <div className="mt-4 rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface-2 p-3 text-xs text-text-muted">
                  <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                    <span className={`rounded-full px-2 py-1 text-[10px] font-semibold ${toneClass(connectionTest.ok)}`}>{connectionTest.ok ? "reachable" : "not ready"}</span>
                    <span className="rounded-full bg-surface px-2 py-1 text-[10px] font-semibold text-text">{connectionTest.provider}</span>
                    {connectionTest.status_code ? <span className="rounded-full bg-surface px-2 py-1 text-[10px] font-semibold text-text">status {connectionTest.status_code}</span> : null}
                  </div>
                  <p className="mt-3"><span className="font-semibold text-text">Endpoint:</span> {connectionTest.endpoint || "Not configured"}</p>
                  <p className="mt-2"><span className="font-semibold text-text">Detail:</span> {connectionTest.detail || "No additional detail."}</p>
                  {connectionTest.missing_requirements.length > 0 ? (
                    <div className="mt-3 rounded-xl border border-warning/30 bg-warning/5 p-3 text-warning">
                      <p className="font-semibold">Missing requirements</p>
                      <ul className="mt-2 space-y-1">
                        {connectionTest.missing_requirements.map((item) => (
                          <li key={item}>{item}</li>
                        ))}
                      </ul>
                    </div>
                  ) : null}
                </div>
              ) : (
                <div className="mt-4 rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface-2 p-4 text-xs text-text-muted">
                  Run the connection test after saving treasury details. A reachable endpoint is required for direct bank dispatch.
                </div>
              )}
            </div>

            <div className="rounded-2xl border border-border bg-surface p-4">
              <h3 className="text-base font-bold text-text">Transfer provider readiness</h3>
              <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-text-muted">Finance dispatch uses the ready provider shown here.</p>
              <div className="mt-4 space-y-3">
                {(providers?.providers || []).map((provider) => (
                  <div key={provider.key} className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface-2 p-3">
                    <div className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-3">
                      <div>
                        <p className="text-xs font-semibold text-text">{provider.name}</p>
                        <p className="mt-1 text-[11px] text-text-muted">{provider.description}</p>
                      </div>
                      <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                        {provider.is_default ? <span className="theme-chip-brand rounded-full px-2 py-1 text-[10px] font-semibold">default</span> : null}
                        <span className={`rounded-full px-2 py-1 text-[10px] font-semibold ${toneClass(provider.configured)}`}>{provider.configured ? "configured" : "needs setup"}</span>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                    <p className="mt-2 text-[11px] text-text-faint">{provider.supports_direct_execution ? "Supports direct bank execution." : "File export only. Use manual bank handoff."}</p>
                    {provider.missing_requirements && provider.missing_requirements.length > 0 ? (
                      <div className="mt-3 rounded-xl border border-warning/30 bg-warning/5 p-3 text-[11px] text-warning">
                        {provider.missing_requirements.join(" · ")}
                      </div>
                    ) : null}
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <VerificationQueue
          kind={activeView as QueueKind}
          records={records[activeView as QueueKind]}
          loading={queueLoading[activeView as QueueKind]}
          noteMap={noteMap}
          expandedId={expandedId}
          actioning={actioning}
          onRefresh={() => void loadQueue(activeView as QueueKind)}
          onToggleExpanded={(id) => setExpandedId((current) => (current === id ? null : id))}
          onNoteChange={(id, value) => setNoteMap((current) => ({ ...current, [id]: value }))}
          onApprove={(id) => void handleVerification(activeView as QueueKind, id, "approve")}
          onReject={(id) => void handleVerification(activeView as QueueKind, id, "reject")}
          onDelete={(id) => void handleDelete(activeView as QueueKind, id)}
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

function SummaryCard({ label, value, icon: Icon, tone }: { label: string; value: string; icon: typeof Building2; tone: string }) {
  return (
    <div className="rounded-2xl border border-border bg-surface p-4">
      <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3">
        <span className={`rounded-xl px-2 py-1 text-[10px] font-semibold ${tone}`}>{label}</span>
        <Icon className="h-4 w-4 text-primary" />
      </div>
      <p className="mt-3 text-lg font-bold text-text">{value}</p>
    </div>
  );
}

function VerificationQueue({
  kind,
  records,
  loading,
  noteMap,
  expandedId,
  actioning,
  onRefresh,
  onToggleExpanded,
  onNoteChange,
  onApprove,
  onReject,
  onDelete,
}: {
  kind: QueueKind;
  records: BankAccountRecord[];
  loading: boolean;
  noteMap: Record<number, string>;
  expandedId: number | null;
  actioning: number | null;
  onRefresh: () => void;
  onToggleExpanded: (id: number) => void;
  onNoteChange: (id: number, value: string) => void;
  onApprove: (id: number) => void;
  onReject: (id: number) => void;
  onDelete: (id: number) => void;
}) {
  return (
    <div className="rounded-2xl border border-border bg-surface p-4">
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-3">
        <div>
          <h3 className="text-base font-bold text-text">{queueLabel(kind)} bank verification</h3>
          <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-text-muted">Only verified accounts should enter payout dispatch batches.</p>
        </div>
        <button onClick={onRefresh} className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface-2 px-3 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-text-muted hover:text-text">
          <RefreshCw className={`h-4 w-4 ${loading ? "animate-spin" : ""}`} /> Refresh queue
        </button>
      </div>

      {loading ? (
        <div className="mt-4 space-y-3">{Array.from({ length: 3 }).map((_, index) => <div key={index} className="h-20 animate-pulse rounded-xl bg-surface-2" />)}</div>
      ) : records.length === 0 ? (
        <div className="mt-4 rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface-2 p-8 text-center">
          <Building2 className="mx-auto h-8 w-8 text-primary/40" />
          <p className="mt-3 text-xs font-semibold text-text">No pending accounts</p>
          <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-text-muted">All pending {queueLabel(kind).toLowerCase()} bank accounts have already been reviewed.</p>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className="mt-4 space-y-3">
          {records.map((record) => (
            <div key={record.id} className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface-2 p-3">
              <button onClick={() => onToggleExpanded(record.id)} className="flex w-full items-start justify-between gap-3 text-left">
                <div>
                  <p className="text-xs font-semibold text-text">{record.entity_name || `${queueLabel(kind)} #${record.supplier_id ?? record.partner_id ?? record.id}`}</p>
                  <p className="mt-1 text-[11px] text-text-muted">{record.bank_name || "Bank not provided"}{record.bank_country ? ` · ${record.bank_country}` : ""}{record.currency ? ` · ${record.currency}` : ""}</p>
                </div>
                <span className="theme-chip-warning rounded-full px-2 py-1 text-[10px] font-semibold">pending</span>
              </button>

              {expandedId === record.id ? (
                <div className="mt-3 space-y-3 border-t border-border pt-3">
                  <div className="grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3">
                    {[
                      ["Beneficiary name", record.beneficiary_name],
                      ["Bank name", record.bank_name],
                      ["Branch", record.branch_name],
                      ["Account number", record.account_number],
                      ["IBAN", record.iban],
                      ["SWIFT / BIC", record.swift_code],
                      ["Routing number", record.routing_number],
                      ["Bank country", record.bank_country],
                      ["Currency", record.currency],
                    ].map(([label, value]) => (
                      <div key={label} className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface p-3">
                        <p className="text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.16em] text-text-faint">{label}</p>
                        <p className="mt-1 text-xs font-semibold text-text">{value || "Not provided"}</p>
                      </div>
                    ))}
                  </div>

                  <label className="block space-y-1 text-[11px] text-text-muted">
                    <span>Verification note</span>
                    <input value={noteMap[record.id] || ""} onChange={(event) => onNoteChange(record.id, event.target.value)} placeholder="Reason, follow-up, or review note" className="w-full rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface px-3 py-2 text-xs text-text outline-none focus:border-primary" />
                  </label>

                  <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-3">
                    <button onClick={() => onApprove(record.id)} disabled={actioning === record.id} className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-lg bg-success px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-white disabled:opacity-50">
                      <CheckCircle className="h-4 w-4" /> {actioning === record.id ? "Processing..." : "Approve"}
                    </button>
                    <button onClick={() => onReject(record.id)} disabled={actioning === record.id} className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-lg bg-danger px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-white disabled:opacity-50">
                      <XCircle className="h-4 w-4" /> {actioning === record.id ? "Processing..." : "Reject"}
                    </button>
                    <button onClick={() => onDelete(record.id)} disabled={actioning === record.id} className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-lg border border-danger/20 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-danger disabled:opacity-50">
                      <Trash2 className="h-4 w-4" /> {actioning === record.id ? "Processing..." : "Delete"}
                    </button>
                  </div>

                  <p className="text-[11px] text-text-faint">Submitted {formatDate(record.created_at)}{record.updated_at && record.updated_at !== record.created_at ? ` · Updated ${formatDate(record.updated_at)}` : ""}</p>
                </div>
              ) : null}
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```text
"use client";

import { Suspense, useEffect } from "react";
import { useRouter, useSearchParams } from "next/navigation";
import { TrendingUp, Wallet, Building2 } from "@/lib/icons";
import { useAuth } from "@/lib/useAuth";
import { isAdminStaffRole } from "@shared/adminPermissions";
import AdminLayout from "@/components/AdminLayout";
import { PanelContent, PanelLoadingState, PanelTabs } from "@/components/PanelPage";
import FinanceTab from "../dashboard/tabs/FinanceTab";
import PayoutsTab from "../dashboard/tabs/PayoutsTab";
import BankAccountsPanel from "./BankAccountsPanel";

function AdminFinanceInner() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const searchParams = useSearchParams();
  const section = searchParams.get("section") ?? "finance";
  const { user, isLoggedIn, isLoading } = useAuth();
  const role = user?.role ?? null;

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isLoading) return;
    if (!isLoggedIn || !isAdminStaffRole(role)) {
      router.push("/admin/login");
    }
  }, [isLoading, isLoggedIn, role, router]);

  if (isLoading || !isLoggedIn || !isAdminStaffRole(role)) {
    return (
      <AdminLayout title="Finance" headerMode="compact">
        <PanelLoadingState count={3} blockClassName="h-16 rounded-xl bg-surface-2 animate-pulse" />
      </AdminLayout>
    );
  }

  return (
    <AdminLayout title="Finance & Cash Management" headerMode="compact">
      <PanelContent className="space-y-3">
      <div className="theme-card rounded-xl border p-2">
        <PanelTabs
          items={[
            { key: "finance", label: "Finance", icon: TrendingUp },
            { key: "payouts", label: "Payouts", icon: Wallet },
            { key: "bank-accounts", label: "Bank Accounts", icon: Building2 },
          ]}
          value={section}
          onChange={(nextSection) => router.push(`/admin/finance?section=${nextSection}`)}
          className="border-0 bg-transparent p-0"
        />
      </div>

      {section === "finance" && <FinanceTab />}

      {section === "payouts" && <PayoutsTab />}
      {section === "bank-accounts" && <BankAccountsPanel />}
      </PanelContent>
    </AdminLayout>
  );
}

export default function AdminFinancePage() {
  return (
    <Suspense>
      <AdminFinanceInner />
    </Suspense>
  );
}
```

```text
﻿"use client";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import {
  Search, Download, RefreshCw,
} from "@/lib/icons";
import AdminLayout from "@/components/AdminLayout";
import { PanelContent } from "@/components/PanelPage";
import { apiFetch } from "@/lib/api";
import { useAuth } from "@/lib/useAuth";

interface Invoice {
  id: number;
  invoice_number: string;
  supplier_id: number;
  supplier_name: string;
  amount: number;
  currency: string;
  issued_date: string;
  due_date: string;
  status: "pending" | "approved" | "paid" | "disputed";
  document_url?: string;
  notes?: string;
}

const STATUS_CHIP: Record<string, string> = {
  pending: "theme-chip-warning",
  approved: "theme-chip-info",
  paid: "theme-chip-success",
  disputed: "theme-chip-danger",
};

const PAGE_SIZE = 20;

export default function AdminInvoicesPage() {
  const { isLoading: authLoading } = useAuth();
  const [invoices, setInvoices] = useState<Invoice[]>([]);
  const [search, setSearch] = useState("");
  const [statusFilter, setStatusFilter] = useState("all");
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [page, setPage] = useState(1);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (authLoading) return;

    const fetchInvoices = async () => {
      setLoading(true);
      try {
        const res = await apiFetch("/invoices/");
        if (res.ok) {
          const { normalizeListPage } = await import("@/lib/listResponse");
          const payload = normalizeListPage<Invoice>(await res.json());
          setInvoices(payload.data);
        }
      } catch (error) {
        console.error("Failed to fetch invoices", error);
      } finally {
        setLoading(false);
      }
    };

    fetchInvoices();
  }, [authLoading]);

  const filtered = invoices.filter((inv) => {
    const matchesSearch =
      !search ||
      inv.invoice_number.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase()) ||
      inv.supplier_name.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase()) ||
      String(inv.id).includes(search);
    const matchesStatus = statusFilter === "all" || inv.status === statusFilter;
    return matchesSearch && matchesStatus;
  });

  const totalPages = Math.ceil(filtered.length / PAGE_SIZE);
  const paginated = filtered.slice((page - 1) * PAGE_SIZE, page * PAGE_SIZE);

  return (
    <AdminLayout title="Invoices">
      <PanelContent className="space-y-6">
        <div className="flex justify-end">
          <button
            onClick={() => window.location.reload()}
            className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-primary px-4 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-white transition hover:opacity-90"
          >
            <RefreshCw className="h-4 w-4" />
            Refresh
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Search and Filters */}
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-3 lg:flex-row lg:items-center">
          <div className="flex-1 relative">
            <Search className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 h-4 w-4 text-text-muted" />
            <input
              type="text"
              placeholder="Search by invoice number, supplier name, or ID…"
              value={search}
              onChange={(e) => {
                setSearch(e.target.value);
                setPage(1);
              }}
              className="w-full rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface-2 pl-10 pr-4 py-2 text-xs text-text-primary focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary/30"
            />
          </div>
          <select
            value={statusFilter}
            onChange={(e) => {
              setStatusFilter(e.target.value);
              setPage(1);
            }}
            className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface-2 px-4 py-2 text-xs text-text-primary focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary/30"
          >
            <option value="all">All statuses</option>
            <option value="pending">Pending</option>
            <option value="approved">Approved</option>
            <option value="paid">Paid</option>
            <option value="disputed">Disputed</option>
          </select>
        </div>

        {/* Stats */}
        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 lg:grid-cols-4">
          {[
            { label: "All", count: invoices.length },
            { label: "Pending", count: invoices.filter((i) => i.status === "pending").length },
            { label: "Approved", count: invoices.filter((i) => i.status === "approved").length },
            { label: "Paid", count: invoices.filter((i) => i.status === "paid").length },
          ].map((stat) => (
            <div key={stat.label} className="theme-card rounded-xl border p-4">
              <p className="text-2xl font-bold text-text">{stat.count}</p>
              <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-text-muted">{stat.label}</p>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>

        {/* Table */}
        <div className="theme-card rounded-xl border overflow-hidden">
          {loading ? (
            <div className="p-12 text-center text-xs text-text-muted">
              Loading invoices…
            </div>
          ) : paginated.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="p-12 text-center text-xs text-text-muted">
              No invoices found.
            </div>
          ) : (
            <>
              <div className="overflow-x-auto">
                <table className="w-full text-xs">
                  <thead className="border-b border-border bg-surface-2">
                    <tr>
                      <th className="px-4 py-3 text-left font-semibold text-text-muted">Invoice #</th>
                      <th className="px-4 py-3 text-left font-semibold text-text-muted">Supplier</th>
                      <th className="px-4 py-3 text-left font-semibold text-text-muted">Amount</th>
                      <th className="px-4 py-3 text-left font-semibold text-text-muted">Issued</th>
                      <th className="px-4 py-3 text-left font-semibold text-text-muted">Due</th>
                      <th className="px-4 py-3 text-left font-semibold text-text-muted">Status</th>
                      <th className="px-4 py-3 text-left font-semibold text-text-muted">Actions</th>
                    </tr>
                  </thead>
                  <tbody className="divide-y divide-border">
                    {paginated.map((inv) => (
                      <tr
                        key={inv.id}
                        className="hover:bg-surface-2/50 transition-colors"
                      >
                        <td className="px-4 py-3 font-mono text-text-muted">{inv.invoice_number}</td>
                        <td className="px-4 py-3 text-text">{inv.supplier_name}</td>
                        <td className="px-4 py-3 font-semibold text-text">
                          {new Intl.NumberFormat("en-US", {
                            style: "currency",
                            currency: inv.currency || "USD",
                          }).format(inv.amount)}
                        </td>
                        <td className="px-4 py-3 text-text-muted whitespace-nowrap">
                          {new Date(inv.issued_date).toLocaleDateString()}
                        </td>
                        <td className="px-4 py-3 text-text-muted whitespace-nowrap">
                          {new Date(inv.due_date).toLocaleDateString()}
                        </td>
                        <td className="px-4 py-3">
                          <span
                            className={`inline-flex rounded-full px-3 py-1 text-xs font-semibold ${
                              STATUS_CHIP[inv.status] || "theme-chip-muted"
                            }`}
                          >
                            {inv.status}
                          </span>
                        </td>
                        <td className="px-4 py-3">
                          <div className="flex gap-2">
                            {inv.document_url && (
                              <a
                                href={inv.document_url}
                                target="_blank"
                                rel="noopener noreferrer"
                                className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-lg border border-border px-2 py-1 text-xs font-semibold text-text transition hover:bg-surface-2"
                              >
                                <Download className="h-3 w-3" />
                                Download
                              </a>
                            )}
                          </div>
                        </td>
                      </tr>
                    ))}
                  </tbody>
                </table>
              </div>

              {/* Pagination */}
              {totalPages > 1 && (
                <div className="border-t border-border bg-surface-2 px-4 py-3 flex items-center justify-between">
                  <span className="text-xs text-text-muted">
                    Page {page} of {totalPages}
                  </span>
                  <div className="flex gap-2">
                    <button
                      onClick={() => setPage((p) => Math.max(1, p - 1))}
                      disabled={page === 1}
                      className="rounded-lg border border-border px-3 py-1 text-xs font-semibold text-text transition hover:bg-surface-2 disabled:opacity-40"
                    >
                      ← Prev
                    </button>
                    <button
                      onClick={() => setPage((p) => Math.min(totalPages, p + 1))}
                      disabled={page === totalPages}
                      className="rounded-lg border border-border px-3 py-1 text-xs font-semibold text-text transition hover:bg-surface-2 disabled:opacity-40"
                    >
                      Next →
                    </button>
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}
            </>
          )}
        </div>
      </PanelContent>
    </AdminLayout>
  );
}
```

### `frontend\web_app\src\app\admin\login\page.tsx`

```text
"use client";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { motion } from "framer-motion";
import { Crown, LogIn, AlertCircle } from "lucide-react";
import { apiFetch, getErrorMessage, parseJsonResponse, setAccessToken, clearAccessToken } from "@/lib/api";
import { useLocaleStore } from "@/lib/localeStore";
import { useAuth } from "@/lib/useAuth";

const MotionDiv = motion.div as any;

const STAFF_ROLES = new Set(["admin", "sub_admin", "moderator", "support"]);

export default function AdminLoginPage() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const { refresh, user, isLoading } = useAuth();
  const tr = useLocaleStore((s) => s.t);
  const [username, setUsername] = useState("");
  const [password, setPassword] = useState("");
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isLoading || !user || !STAFF_ROLES.has(user.role)) {
      return;
    }
    router.replace("/admin/dashboard");
  }, [isLoading, router, user]);

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setError("");
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const body = new URLSearchParams({ username, password });
      const res = await apiFetch("/auth/login", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/x-www-form-urlencoded" },
        body,
      });
      const data = await parseJsonResponse(res);
      if (!res.ok) {
        setError(getErrorMessage(data || {}));
        setLoading(false);
        return;
      }
      if (!data?.access_token) {
        setError(tr("networkError"));
        setLoading(false);
        return;
      }
      setAccessToken(data.access_token);
      localStorage.setItem("zozi_has_session", "1");
      const user = await refresh(true);
      if (!user) {
        clearAccessToken();
        localStorage.removeItem("zozi_has_session");
        setError(tr("networkError"));
        return;
      }
      if (!STAFF_ROLES.has(user.role)) {
        setError(tr("adminStaffOnly"));
        clearAccessToken();
        localStorage.removeItem("zozi_has_session");
        setLoading(false);
        return;
      }
      router.push("/admin/dashboard");
    } catch {
      setError(tr("networkError"));
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <main className="min-h-screen flex items-center justify-center bg-surface-base px-4 py-16 text-text">
      <MotionDiv
        initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }}
        animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
        className="w-full max-w-md"
      >
        <div className="text-center mb-8">
          <div className="theme-chip-brand mx-auto mb-4 flex h-14 w-14 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl">
            <Crown className="h-7 w-7 text-primary" />
          </div>
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-text">{tr("adminAccess")}</h1>
          <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-text-muted">
            {tr("staffCredentialsRequired")}
          </p>
        </div>

        <form
          onSubmit={handleSubmit}
          className="theme-card space-y-5 rounded-2xl border p-6"
        >
          {error && (
            <div className="theme-alert-danger flex items-center gap-2 rounded-xl p-3 text-sm">
              <AlertCircle className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0" />
              {error}
            </div>
          )}

          <div>
            <label className="mb-1.5 block text-xs font-semibold text-text-muted">
              {tr("username")}
            </label>
            <input
              value={username}
              onChange={(e) => setUsername(e.target.value)}
              required
              placeholder={tr("usernamePlaceholder")}
              className="theme-input w-full rounded-xl border px-4 py-3 text-sm placeholder:text-text-faint focus:border-primary focus:outline-none transition-colors"
            />
          </div>

          <div>
            <label className="mb-1.5 block text-xs font-semibold text-text-muted">
              {tr("password")}
            </label>
            <input
              type="password"
              value={password}
              onChange={(e) => setPassword(e.target.value)}
              required
              placeholder="••••••••"
              className="theme-input w-full rounded-xl border px-4 py-3 text-sm placeholder:text-text-faint focus:border-primary focus:outline-none transition-colors"
            />
          </div>

          <button
            type="submit"
            disabled={loading}
            className="theme-btn-primary flex w-full items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl py-3 text-sm font-bold disabled:opacity-50"
          >
            {loading ? (
              <div className="h-4 w-4 animate-spin rounded-full border-2 border-on-brand/30 border-t-on-brand" />
            ) : (
              <LogIn className="w-4 h-4" />
            )}
            {loading ? tr("signingIn") : tr("signIn")}
          </button>
        </form>
      </MotionDiv>
    </main>
  );
}

```

```text
    description: "Approve partner-wide or area-specific base, weight, and compatibility controls before they affect live quote breakdowns.",
  },
  categories: {
    title: "Handling Rule Review",
    description: "Review the single shipment-level handling amount separately from route pricing and load-fit compatibility.",
  },
  vehicles: {
    title: "Load-fit Rule Review",
    description: "Manage route-aware load-fit selection, capacity thresholds, and compatibility factors in one place.",
  },
  distance: {
    title: "Distance Matrix",
    description: "Maintain the route-distance source of truth used by all per-km logistics pricing.",
  },
};

type PricingCalculatorForm = {
  routeType: "in_city" | "inter_city";
  weightKg: string;
  distanceKm: string;
  pickupCount: string;
  dropoffCount: string;
  selectedCategories: string[];
};

function createDefaultCalculatorForm(): PricingCalculatorForm {
  return {
    routeType: "in_city",
    weightKg: "8",
    distanceKm: "0",
    pickupCount: "2",
    dropoffCount: "1",
    selectedCategories: ["fragile"],
  };
}

function roundCharge(value: number): number {
  return Math.round((value + Number.EPSILON) * 100) / 100;
}

function normalizeGeoKey(countryCode: string | null | undefined, cityName: string | null | undefined): string {
  return `${String(countryCode || "").trim().toUpperCase()}::${String(cityName || "").trim().toLowerCase()}`;
}

function hasCoordinates(latitude: number | null | undefined, longitude: number | null | undefined): boolean {
  return typeof latitude === "number" && Number.isFinite(latitude) && typeof longitude === "number" && Number.isFinite(longitude);
}

  const BLANK_PROFILE_FORM = { partner_id: "", service_area_id: "", profile_name: "", base_in_city_fee: "", base_inter_city_fee: "", per_km_rate: "", per_kg_rate: "", minimum_charge: "", maximum_charge: "", fuel_multiplier: "", bulk_discount_threshold_kg: "", bulk_discount_percent: "", currency: "OMR", is_active: true };
  const BLANK_CAT_RULE_FORM = { partner_id: "", service_area_id: "", category_name: "", flat_fee_override: "", special_handling_fee: "", currency: "OMR", is_active: true };

  const [catRuleFormSaving, setCatRuleFormSaving] = useState(false);

  const [showVehRuleForm, setShowVehRuleForm] = useState(false);
  const [editingVehRuleId, setEditingVehRuleId] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [adminVehRuleForm, setAdminVehRuleForm] = useState<typeof BLANK_VEH_RULE_FORM>(BLANK_VEH_RULE_FORM);
  const [vehRuleFormSaving, setVehRuleFormSaving] = useState(false);

  const [cityDistances, setCityDistances] = useState<CityDistance[]>([]);
  const [distancesLoading, setDistancesLoading] = useState(false);
  const [distanceForm, setDistanceForm] = useState({ origin_country_code: "", origin_city_name: "", destination_country_code: "", destination_city_name: "", distance_km: "", notes: "" });
  const [distanceSaving, setDistanceSaving] = useState(false);
  const [editingDistanceId, setEditingDistanceId] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [distanceActionError, setDistanceActionError] = useState("");
  const [controlPartnerId, setControlPartnerId] = useState<string>("");

  const fetchCityDistances = useCallback(async () => {

      const response = await apiFetch("/logistics-partners/city-distances");

      }
    } catch {
      setDistanceActionError("Could not load city distances");
    } finally {
      setDistancesLoading(false);
    }
  }, []);

  const handleSaveDistance = async () => {
    setDistanceSaving(true);

    try {
      const url = editingDistanceId ? `/logistics-partners/city-distances/${editingDistanceId}` : "/logistics-partners/city-distances";
      const response = await apiFetch(url, {
        method: editingDistanceId ? "PUT" : "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ ...distanceForm, distance_km: Number(distanceForm.distance_km) }),
      });
      if (!response.ok) {
        const payload = await response.json().catch(() => ({}));
        throw new Error(payload.detail || "Could not save city distance");
      }
      await fetchCityDistances();
      setDistanceForm({ origin_country_code: "", origin_city_name: "", destination_country_code: "", destination_city_name: "", distance_km: "", notes: "" });
      setEditingDistanceId(null);
    } catch (error) {
      setDistanceActionError(error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Could not save city distance");
    } finally {
      setDistanceSaving(false);
    }
  };

    } catch (error) {

    }
  };

  // Admin charge CRUD handlers

      const response = await apiFetch(url, {

Number(adminAreaForm.latitude) : null, longitude: adminAreaForm.longitude ? Number(adminAreaForm.longitude) : null, charge_amount: Number(adminAreaForm.charge_amount) || 0, minimum_charge: adminAreaForm.minimum_charge ? Number(adminAreaForm.minimum_charge) : null, per_kg_rate: adminAreaForm.per_kg_rate ? Number(adminAreaForm.per_kg_rate) : null, per_km_rate: adminAreaForm.per_km_rate ? Number(adminAreaForm.per_km_rate) : null, fuel_multiplier: adminAreaForm.fuel_multiplier ? Number(adminAreaForm.fuel_multiplier) : null, pickup_charge: adminAreaForm.pickup_charge ? Number(adminAreaForm.pickup_charge) : null, dropoff_charge: adminAreaForm.dropoff_charge ? Number(adminAreaForm.dropoff_charge) : null, delivery_days_min: adminAreaForm.delivery_days_min ? Number(adminAreaForm.delivery_days_min) : null, delivery_days_max: adminAreaForm.delivery_days_max ? Number(adminAreaForm.delivery_days_max) : null }),
      });
      if (!response.ok) { const err = await response.json().catch(() => ({})); throw new Error((err as { detail?: string }).detail || "Could not save service area"); }
      setShowAreaForm(false);
      setEditingAreaId(null);
      setAdminAreaForm(BLANK_AREA_FORM);
      await fetchData();
    } catch (error) {

      await fetchData();
    } catch (error) {
      setAreaFormError(error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Could not delete service area");

  const handleAdminSaveProfile = async () => {
    setProfileFormSaving(true);
    setProfileFormError("");
    try {
      const url = editingProfileId ? `/logistics-partners/pricing-profiles/${editingProfileId}` : "/logistics-partners/pricing-profiles";
      const response = await apiFetch(url, {

Number(adminProfileForm.service_area_id) : null, base_in_city_fee: adminProfileForm.base_in_city_fee ? Number(adminProfileForm.base_in_city_fee) : null, base_inter_city_fee: adminProfileForm.base_inter_city_fee ? Number(adminProfileForm.base_inter_city_fee) : null, per_km_rate: adminProfileForm.per_km_rate ? Number(adminProfileForm.per_km_rate) : null, per_kg_rate: adminProfileForm.per_kg_rate ? Number(adminProfileForm.per_kg_rate) : null, minimum_charge: adminProfileForm.minimum_charge ? Number(adminProfileForm.minimum_charge) : null, maximum_charge: adminProfileForm.maximum_charge ? Number(adminProfileForm.maximum_charge) : null, fuel_multiplier: adminProfileForm.fuel_multiplier ? Number(adminProfileForm.fuel_multiplier) : null, bulk_discount_threshold_kg: adminProfileForm.bulk_discount_threshold_kg ? Number(adminProfileForm.bulk_discount_threshold_kg) : null, bulk_discount_percent: adminProfileForm.bulk_discount_percent ? Number(adminProfileForm.bulk_discount_percent) : null }),
      });
      if (!response.ok) { const err = await response.json().catch(() => ({})); throw new Error((err as { detail?: string }).detail || "Could not save pricing profile"); }
      setShowProfileForm(false);
      setEditingProfileId(null);
      setAdminProfileForm(BLANK_PROFILE_FORM);
      await fetchData();
    } catch (error) {

  };

  const handleAdminDeleteProfile = async (profileId: number) => {

      if (!response.ok) throw new Error("Could not delete pricing profile");
      await fetchData();
    } catch (error) {

  const handleAdminSaveCatRule = async () => {

    try {

      const response = await apiFetch(url, {

        body: JSON.stringify({ ...adminCatRuleForm, partner_id: Number(adminCatRuleForm.partner_id), service_area_id: adminCatRuleForm.service_area_id ? Number(adminCatRuleForm.service_area_id) : null, flat_fee_override: null, special_handling_fee: adminCatRuleForm.special_handling_fee ? Number(adminCatRuleForm.special_handling_fee) : null }),
      });
      if (!response.ok) { const err = await response.json().catch(() => ({})); throw new Error((err as { detail?: string }).detail || "Could not save handling rule"); }
      setShowCatRuleForm(false);
      setEditingCatRuleId(null);

  const handleAdminDeleteCatRule = async (ruleId: number) => {

      if (!response.ok) throw new Error("Could not delete handling rule");
      await fetchData();
    } catch (error) {

  const handleAdminSaveVehRule = async () => {
    setVehRuleFormSaving(true);
    setVehRuleFormError("");
    try {
      const url = editingVehRuleId ? `/logistics-partners/vehicle-rules/${editingVehRuleId}` : "/logistics-partners/vehicle-rules";
      const response = await apiFetch(url, {
        method: editingVehRuleId ? "PUT" : "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ ...adminVehRuleForm, partner_id: Number(adminVehRuleForm.partner_id), service_area_id: adminVehRuleForm.service_area_id ? Number(adminVehRuleForm.service_area_id) : null, max_weight_kg: adminVehRuleForm.max_weight_kg ? Number(adminVehRuleForm.max_weight_kg) : null, max_volume_cm3: adminVehRuleForm.max_volume_cm3 ? Number(adminVehRuleForm.max_volume_cm3) : null, cost_multiplier: Number(adminVehRuleForm.cost_multiplier) || 1, priority_rank: Number(adminVehRuleForm.priority_rank) || 100 }),
      });
      if (!response.ok) { const err = await response.json().catch(() => ({})); throw new Error((err as { detail?: string }).detail || "Could not save load-fit rule"); }
      setShowVehRuleForm(false);
      setEditingVehRuleId(null);
      setAdminVehRuleForm(BLANK_VEH_RULE_FORM);
      await fetchData();
    } catch (error) {
      setVehRuleFormError(error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Could not save load-fit rule");
    } finally {
      setVehRuleFormSaving(false);
    }
  };

  const handleAdminDeleteVehRule = async (ruleId: number) => {
    setVehRuleFormError("");
    try {
      const response = await apiFetch(`/logistics-partners/vehicle-rules/${ruleId}`, { method: "DELETE" });
      if (!response.ok) throw new Error("Could not delete load-fit rule");
      await fetchData();
    } catch (error) {
      setVehRuleFormError(error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Could not delete load-fit rule");
    }
  };

  const fetchData = useCallback(async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    setActionError("");
    try {
      const [partnersRes, serviceAreasRes, pricingProfilesRes, categoryRulesRes, vehicleRulesRes] = await Promise.all([
        apiFetch("/logistics-partners/"),
        apiFetch("/logistics-partners/service-areas"),
        apiFetch("/logistics-partners/pricing-profiles"),
        apiFetch("/logistics-partners/category-rules"),
        apiFetch("/logistics-partners/vehicle-rules"),
      ]);
      if (!partnersRes.ok) {
        throw new Error("Could not load logistics partners");
      }

      const nextPartners: LogisticsPartner[] = await partnersRes.json();
      const nextAreas: ServiceArea[] = serviceAreasRes.ok ? await serviceAreasRes.json() : [];
        const nextPricingProfiles: PricingProfile[] = pricingProfilesRes.ok ? await pricingProfilesRes.json() : [];
        const nextCategoryRules: CategoryPricingRule[] = categoryRulesRes.ok ? await categoryRulesRes.json() : [];
        const nextVehicleRules: VehicleRule[] = vehicleRulesRes.ok ? await vehicleRulesRes.json() : [];
      setPartners(nextPartners);
      setSelectedPartnerIds((prev) => new Set(Array.from(prev).filter((id) => nextPartners.some((partner) => partner.id === id))));
      setServiceAreas(Array.isArray(nextAreas) ? nextAreas : []);
        setPricingProfiles(Array.isArray(nextPricingProfiles) ? nextPricingProfiles : []);
        setCategoryRules(Array.isArray(nextCategoryRules) ? nextCategoryRules : []);
        setVehicleRules(Array.isArray(nextVehicleRules) ? nextVehicleRules : []);
      setStats({
        total_partners: nextPartners.length,
        active_partners: nextPartners.filter((partner) => partner.status === "active").length,
        approved_profiles: nextPartners.filter((partner) => partner.verification_status === "approved").length,
        pending_profiles: nextPartners.filter((partner) => ["pending", "under_review"].includes(partner.verification_status)).length,
      });
    } catch (error) {
      setActionError(error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Could not load logistics admin data");
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isLoggedIn && canAccessAdminLogisticsPartnerManagement(user?.role)) fetchData();
  }, [fetchData, isLoggedIn, user?.role]);

  useEffect(() => {
    setActiveWorkspace(defaultWorkspace);
  }, [defaultWorkspace]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if ((isWorkspaceVisible("distance") || isWorkspaceVisible("areas")) && !distancesLoading && cityDistances.length === 0) {
      void fetchCityDistances();
    }
  }, [activeWorkspace, cityDistances.length, distancesLoading, fetchCityDistances, isStackedScope, isWorkspaceVisible, scope]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (scope !== "pricing") return;
    setControlPartnerId((current) => {
      if (selectedPartnerId !== "all") return selectedPartnerId;
      if (current && partners.some((partner) => String(partner.id) === current)) return current;
      return partners[0] ? String(partners[0].id) : "";
    });
  }, [scope, selectedPartnerId, partners]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (expandedPartnerId != null && !partners.some((partner) => partner.id === expandedPartnerId)) {
      setExpandedPartnerId(null);
    }
  }, [expandedPartnerId, partners]);

  const partnerAreaCounts = useMemo(() => {
    return serviceAreas.reduce<Record<number, { approved: number; pending: number; rejected: number }>>((accumulator, area) => {
      if (!accumulator[area.partner_id]) {
        accumulator[area.partner_id] = { approved: 0, pending: 0, rejected: 0 };
      }
      if (area.approval_status === "approved") accumulator[area.partner_id].approved += 1;
      else if (area.approval_status === "rejected") accumulator[area.partner_id].rejected += 1;
      else accumulator[area.partner_id].pending += 1;
      return accumulator;
    }, {});
  }, [serviceAreas]);

  const filteredAreas = useMemo(() => {
    let areas = selectedPartnerId === "all" ? serviceAreas : serviceAreas.filter((area) => area.partner_id === Number(selectedPartnerId));
    if (areaStatusFilter !== "all") areas = areas.filter((a) => a.approval_status === areaStatusFilter);
    return areas;
  }, [selectedPartnerId, serviceAreas, areaStatusFilter]);

  const filteredPricingProfiles = useMemo(() => {
    let profiles = selectedPartnerId === "all" ? pricingProfiles : pricingProfiles.filter((profile) => profile.partner_id === Number(selectedPartnerId));
    if (pricingProfileStatusFilter !== "all") profiles = profiles.filter((profile) => profile.approval_status === pricingProfileStatusFilter);
    return profiles;
  }, [selectedPartnerId, pricingProfiles, pricingProfileStatusFilter]);

  const filteredCategoryRules = useMemo(() => {
    let rules = selectedPartnerId === "all" ? categoryRules : categoryRules.filter((rule) => rule.partner_id === Number(selectedPartnerId));
    if (categoryRuleStatusFilter !== "all") rules = rules.filter((rule) => rule.approval_status === categoryRuleStatusFilter);
    return rules;
  }, [selectedPartnerId, categoryRules, categoryRuleStatusFilter]);

  const filteredVehicleRules = useMemo(() => {
    let rules = selectedPartnerId === "all" ? vehicleRules : vehicleRules.filter((rule) => rule.partner_id === Number(selectedPartnerId));
    if (vehicleRuleStatusFilter !== "all") rules = rules.filter((rule) => rule.approval_status === vehicleRuleStatusFilter);
    return rules;
  }, [selectedPartnerId, vehicleRules, vehicleRuleStatusFilter]);

  const filteredCityDistances = useMemo(() => {
    if (selectedPartnerId === "all") return cityDistances;
    const partnerAreaKeys = new Set(
      serviceAreas
        .filter((area) => area.partner_id === Number(selectedPartnerId))
        .map((area) => normalizeGeoKey(area.country_code, area.city_name || area.zone_label || area.country_name)),
    );
    return cityDistances.filter((entry) => (
      partnerAreaKeys.has(normalizeGeoKey(entry.origin_country_code, entry.origin_city_name))
      || partnerAreaKeys.has(normalizeGeoKey(entry.destination_country_code, entry.destination_city_name))
    ));
  }, [cityDistances, selectedPartnerId, serviceAreas]);

  const cityCoordinateLookup = useMemo(() => {
    const lookup = new Map<string, CoverageCityPoint>();
    serviceAreas.forEach((area) => {
      if (!hasCoordinates(area.latitude, area.longitude)) return;
      const latitude = Number(area.latitude);
      const longitude = Number(area.longitude);
      if (typeof latitude !== "number" || typeof longitude !== "number") return;
      const cityKey = normalizeGeoKey(area.country_code, area.city_name || area.zone_label || area.country_name);
      if (!cityKey || lookup.has(cityKey)) return;
      lookup.set(cityKey, {
        key: cityKey,
        label: area.city_name || area.zone_label || area.country_name,
        latitude,
        longitude,
      });
    });
    return lookup;
  }, [serviceAreas]);

  const mappedServiceAreas = useMemo<CoverageReviewPoint[]>(() => filteredAreas.reduce<CoverageReviewPoint[]>((items, area) => {
    if (!hasCoordinates(area.latitude, area.longitude)) return items;
    const latitude = Number(area.latitude);
    const longitude = Number(area.longitude);
    if (typeof latitude !== "number" || typeof longitude !== "number") return items;
    const partner = partners.find((candidate) => candidate.id === area.partner_id);
    items.push({
      id: area.id,
      key: `area-${area.id}`,
      label: area.zone_label || area.city_name || area.country_name,
      latitude,
      longitude,
      approvalStatus: area.approval_status,
      partnerName: partner?.name ?? null,
    });
    return items;
  }, []), [filteredAreas, partners]);

  const routeReviewRows = useMemo<CoverageRouteRow[]>(() => filteredCityDistances.map((entry) => ({
    id: entry.id,
    label: `${entry.origin_city_name} to ${entry.destination_city_name}`,
    distanceKm: entry.distance_km,
    notes: entry.notes,
    origin: cityCoordinateLookup.get(normalizeGeoKey(entry.origin_country_code, entry.origin_city_name)) ?? null,
    destination: cityCoordinateLookup.get(normalizeGeoKey(entry.destination_country_code, entry.destination_city_name)) ?? null,
  })), [cityCoordinateLookup, filteredCityDistances]);

  const unresolvedCoverageRows = useMemo(() => {
    const unresolvedAreas = filteredAreas
      .filter((area) => !hasCoordinates(area.latitude, area.longitude))
      .map((area) => ({
        key: `area-${area.id}`,
        label: area.zone_label || area.city_name || area.country_name,
        detail: "Missing service-area latitude or longitude.",
      }));
    const unresolvedRoutes = routeReviewRows
      .filter((route) => !route.origin || !route.destination)
      .map((route) => ({
        key: `route-${route.id}`,
        label: route.label,
        detail: `${!route.origin ? "Origin" : "Destination"} city has no mapped service-area point yet.`,
      }));
    return [...unresolvedAreas, ...unresolvedRoutes];
  }, [filteredAreas, routeReviewRows]);

  const coverageBoardBounds = useMemo(() => {
    const latitudes: number[] = [];
    const longitudes: number[] = [];
    mappedServiceAreas.forEach((point) => {
      latitudes.push(point.latitude);
      longitudes.push(point.longitude);
    });
    routeReviewRows.forEach((route) => {
      if (route.origin) {
        latitudes.push(route.origin.latitude);
        longitudes.push(route.origin.longitude);
      }
      if (route.destination) {
        latitudes.push(route.destination.latitude);
        longitudes.push(route.destination.longitude);
      }
    });
    if (!latitudes.length || !longitudes.length) return null;
    const minLat = Math.min(...latitudes);
    const maxLat = Math.max(...latitudes);
    const minLng = Math.min(...longitudes);
    const maxLng = Math.max(...longitudes);
    return {
      minLat,
      minLng,
      latSpan: Math.max(maxLat - minLat, 0.01),
      lngSpan: Math.max(maxLng - minLng, 0.01),
    };
  }, [mappedServiceAreas, routeReviewRows]);

  const pendingAreaCount = useMemo(() => serviceAreas.filter((a) => a.approval_status === "pending" || a.approval_status === "under_review").length, [serviceAreas]);
  const pendingPricingProfileCount = useMemo(() => pricingProfiles.filter((profile) => profile.approval_status === "pending" || profile.approval_status === "under_review").length, [pricingProfiles]);
  const pendingCategoryRuleCount = useMemo(() => categoryRules.filter((rule) => rule.approval_status === "pending" || rule.approval_status === "under_review").length, [categoryRules]);
  const pendingVehicleRuleCount = useMemo(() => vehicleRules.filter((rule) => rule.approval_status === "pending" || rule.approval_status === "under_review").length, [vehicleRules]);

  const openAreaEditor = useCallback((area: ServiceArea) => {

      latitude: area.latitude != null ? String(area.latitude) : "",

      charge_amount: String(area.charge_amount),
      minimum_charge: area.minimum_charge != null ? String(area.minimum_charge) : "",
      per_kg_rate: area.per_kg_rate != null ? String(area.per_kg_rate) : "",
      per_km_rate: area.per_km_rate != null ? String(area.per_km_rate) : "",
      fuel_multiplier: area.fuel_multiplier != null ? String(area.fuel_multiplier) : "",
      pickup_charge: formatMoney(area.pickup_charge) ?? "",
      dropoff_charge: formatMoney(area.dropoff_charge) ?? "",
      currency: area.currency,
      delivery_days_min: area.delivery_days_min != null ? String(area.delivery_days_min) : "",
      delivery_days_max: area.delivery_days_max != null ? String(area.delivery_days_max) : "",
      is_active: area.is_active,
    });
    setAreaFormError("");
    setShowAreaForm(true);
  }, []);

  const openProfileEditor = useCallback((pricingProfile: PricingProfile) => {

      per_km_rate: pricingProfile.per_km_rate != null ? String(pricingProfile.per_km_rate) : "",
      per_kg_rate: pricingProfile.per_kg_rate != null ? String(pricingProfile.per_kg_rate) : "",
      minimum_charge: pricingProfile.minimum_charge != null ? String(pricingProfile.minimum_charge) : "",
      maximum_charge: pricingProfile.maximum_charge != null ? String(pricingProfile.maximum_charge) : "",
      fuel_multiplier: pricingProfile.fuel_multiplier != null ? String(pricingProfile.fuel_multiplier) : "",
      bulk_discount_threshold_kg: pricingProfile.bulk_discount_threshold_kg != null ? String(pricingProfile.bulk_discount_threshold_kg) : "",
      bulk_discount_percent: pricingProfile.bulk_discount_percent != null ? String(pricingProfile.bulk_discount_percent) : "",

      render: (rule) => {
        const serviceArea = serviceAreas.find((area) => area.id === rule.service_area_id);
        return <span className="text-text-muted">{serviceArea ? `Targets ${serviceArea.zone_label || serviceArea.city_name || serviceArea.country_name}` : "All service areas"} · {rule.route_scope.replace(/_/g, " ")}</span>;
      },
    },
    {
      key: "limits",
      label: "Limits",
      searchValue: (rule) => `${rule.max_weight_kg || ""} ${rule.max_volume_cm3 || ""} ${rule.cost_multiplier} ${rule.priority_rank}`,
      render: (rule) => <span className="text-text-muted">{rule.max_weight_kg != null ? `up to ${rule.max_weight_kg}kg` : "No weight cap"}{rule.max_volume_cm3 != null ? ` · ${rule.max_volume_cm3}cm3` : ""}{` · legacy x${rule.cost_multiplier} · priority ${rule.priority_rank}`}</span>,
    },
  ], [partners, serviceAreas]);
  const distanceColumns = useMemo<Array<EnterpriseColumn<CityDistance>>>(() => [
    {
      key: "origin_city_name",
      label: "Origin",
      sortable: true,
      sortValue: (entry) => `${entry.origin_country_code}-${entry.origin_city_name}`,
      searchValue: (entry) => `${entry.origin_country_code} ${entry.origin_city_name}`,
      render: (entry) => <span className="font-semibold text-text">{entry.origin_country_code} / {entry.origin_city_name}</span>,
    },
    {
      key: "destination_city_name",
      label: "Destination",
      sortable: true,
      sortValue: (entry) => `${entry.destination_country_code}-${entry.destination_city_name}`,
      searchValue: (entry) => `${entry.destination_country_code} ${entry.destination_city_name}`,
      render: (entry) => <span className="font-semibold text-text">{entry.destination_country_code} / {entry.destination_city_name}</span>,
    },
    {
      key: "distance_km",
      label: "Distance",
      sortable: true,
      sortValue: (entry) => entry.distance_km,
      searchValue: (entry) => `${entry.distance_km} ${entry.notes || ""}`,
      render: (entry) => <span className="text-text">{entry.distance_km} km</span>,
      align: "right",
    },
  ], []);

  const controlApprovedAreas = useMemo(() => {
    if (!controlPartnerId) return [] as ServiceArea[];
    return serviceAreas.filter(
      (area) => area.partner_id === Number(controlPartnerId) && area.approval_status === "approved" && area.is_active,
    );
  }, [controlPartnerId, serviceAreas]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (scope !== "pricing") return;
    setControlServiceAreaId((current) => {
      if (current && controlApprovedAreas.some((area) => String(area.id) === current)) return current;
      return controlApprovedAreas[0] ? String(controlApprovedAreas[0].id) : "";
    });
  }, [scope, controlApprovedAreas]);

  const controlArea = useMemo(() => {
    if (!controlServiceAreaId) return null;
    return controlApprovedAreas.find((area) => area.id === Number(controlServiceAreaId)) ?? null;
  }, [controlApprovedAreas, controlServiceAreaId]);

  const controlApprovedProfiles = useMemo(() => {
    if (!controlPartnerId) return [] as PricingProfile[];
    return pricingProfiles.filter(
      (profile) => profile.partner_id === Number(controlPartnerId) && profile.approval_status === "approved" && profile.is_active,
    );
  }, [controlPartnerId, pricingProfiles]);

  const controlProfile = useMemo(() => {
    const scopedAreaId = controlServiceAreaId ? Number(controlServiceAreaId) : null;
    return controlApprovedProfiles.find((profile) => profile.service_area_id === scopedAreaId)
      ?? controlApprovedProfiles.find((profile) => profile.service_area_id == null)
      ?? null;
  }, [controlApprovedProfiles, controlServiceAreaId]);

  const controlCategoryOptions = useMemo(() => {
    if (!controlPartnerId) return [] as Array<{ key: string; rule: CategoryPricingRule }>;
    const scopedAreaId = controlServiceAreaId ? Number(controlServiceAreaId) : null;
    const candidates = categoryRules
      .filter(
        (rule) => rule.partner_id === Number(controlPartnerId)
          && rule.approval_status === "approved"
          && rule.is_active
          && (rule.service_area_id == null || rule.service_area_id === scopedAreaId),
      )
      .sort((left, right) => {
        const leftPriority = left.service_area_id === scopedAreaId ? 0 : 1;
        const rightPriority = right.service_area_id === scopedAreaId ? 0 : 1;
        if (leftPriority !== rightPriority) return leftPriority - rightPriority;
        return left.category_name.localeCompare(right.category_name);
      });

    const deduped = new Map<string, CategoryPricingRule>();
    candidates.forEach((rule) => {
      const key = normalizeControlKey(rule.category_name);
      if (key && !deduped.has(key)) deduped.set(key, rule);
    });
    return Array.from(deduped.entries()).map(([key, rule]) => ({ key, rule }));
  }, [categoryRules, controlPartnerId, controlServiceAreaId]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const allowedKeys = new Set(controlCategoryOptions.map((option) => option.key));
    setCalculatorForm((current) => {
      const selectedCategories = current.selectedCategories.filter((categoryKey) => allowedKeys.has(categoryKey));
      if (!selectedCategories.length && controlCategoryOptions.length > 0) {
        return { ...current, selectedCategories: [controlCategoryOptions[0].key] };
      }
      if (selectedCategories.length === current.selectedCategories.length) return current;
      return { ...current, selectedCategories };
    });
  }, [controlCategoryOptions]);

  const selectedCategoryRules = useMemo(
    () => controlCategoryOptions.filter((option) => calculatorForm.selectedCategories.includes(option.key)).map((option) => option.rule),
    [calculatorForm.selectedCategories, controlCategoryOptions],
  );

  const calculatorBreakdown = useMemo(() => {
    const routeType = calculatorForm.routeType;
    const weightKg = Math.max(Number(calculatorForm.weightKg) || 0, 0);
    const distanceKm = routeType === "inter_city" ? Math.max(Number(calculatorForm.distanceKm) || 0, 0) : 0;
    const pickupCount = Math.max(Number(calculatorForm.pickupCount) || 1, 1);
    const dropoffCount = Math.max(Number(calculatorForm.dropoffCount) || 1, 1);
    const extraPickupCount = Math.max(pickupCount - 1, 0);
    const extraDropoffCount = Math.max(dropoffCount - 1, 0);

    const baseFee = roundCharge(routeType === "in_city"
      ? Number(controlProfile?.base_in_city_fee ?? controlArea?.charge_amount ?? 0)
      : Number(controlProfile?.base_inter_city_fee ?? controlArea?.charge_amount ?? 0));
    const perKgRate = Number(controlProfile?.per_kg_rate ?? controlArea?.per_kg_rate ?? 0);
    const perKmRate = routeType === "inter_city" ? Number(controlProfile?.per_km_rate ?? controlArea?.per_km_rate ?? 0) : 0;
    const pickupRate = Number(controlArea?.pickup_charge ?? 0);
    const dropoffRate = Number(controlArea?.dropoff_charge ?? 0);
    const fuelMultiplier = Number(controlProfile?.fuel_multiplier ?? controlArea?.fuel_multiplier ?? 1);
    const minimumCharge = controlProfile?.minimum_charge ?? controlArea?.minimum_charge ?? null;
    const maximumCharge = controlProfile?.maximum_charge ?? null;
    const weightFee = roundCharge(weightKg * perKgRate);
    const distanceFee = roundCharge(distanceKm * perKmRate);
    const pickupFee = roundCharge(extraPickupCount * pickupRate);
    const dropoffFee = roundCharge(extraDropoffCount * dropoffRate);
    const appliedCategoryRule = selectedCategoryRules.reduce<{ rule: CategoryPricingRule | null; total: number }>((current, rule) => {
      const total = roundCharge(Math.max(Number(rule.flat_fee_override ?? 0), Number(rule.special_handling_fee ?? 0)));
      if (!current.rule || total > current.total) {
        return { rule, total };
      }
      return current;
    }, { rule: null, total: 0 });
    const categoryTotal = appliedCategoryRule.total;
    const subtotal = roundCharge(baseFee + weightFee + distanceFee + pickupFee + dropoffFee + categoryTotal);
    const fuelAdjusted = roundCharge(subtotal * fuelMultiplier);
    const minimumChargeApplied = minimumCharge != null && fuelAdjusted < minimumCharge;
    const afterMinimum = minimumChargeApplied ? roundCharge(Number(minimumCharge)) : fuelAdjusted;
    const maximumChargeApplied = maximumCharge != null && maximumCharge > 0 && afterMinimum > maximumCharge;
    const finalCharge = maximumChargeApplied ? roundCharge(Number(maximumCharge)) : afterMinimum;

    return {
      routeType,
      pickupCount,
      dropoffCount,
      extraPickupCount,
      extraDropoffCount,
      baseFee,
      perKgRate,
      perKmRate,
      pickupRate,
      dropoffRate,
      weightFee,
      distanceFee,
      pickupFee,
      dropoffFee,
      categoryTotal,
      appliedCategoryRule: appliedCategoryRule.rule,
      subtotal,
```
