      fuelMultiplier,
      fuelAdjusted,
      minimumCharge,
      maximumCharge,
      minimumChargeApplied,
      maximumChargeApplied,
      finalCharge,
    };
  }, [calculatorForm, controlArea, controlProfile, selectedCategoryRules]);

  if (authLoading) return <div className="space-y-3">{Array.from({ length: 3 }).map((_, i) => <div key={i} className="h-16 animate-pulse rounded-xl bg-surface-2" />)}</div>;

  const openCreate = () => {
    setActiveWorkspace("partners");
    setEditingId(null);
    setForm(BLANK_FORM);
    setSaveError("");
    setShowForm(true);
  };

  const openEdit = (partner: LogisticsPartner) => {
    setActiveWorkspace("partners");
    setEditingId(partner.id);
    setForm({
      name: partner.name,
      code: partner.code,
      contact_name: partner.contact_name ?? "",
      contact_email: partner.contact_email ?? "",
      contact_phone: partner.contact_phone ?? "",
      website: partner.website ?? "",
      status: partner.status,
      coverage_regions: (partner.coverage_regions ?? []).join(", "),
      service_types: (partner.service_types ?? []).join(", "),
      linked_user_email: partner.linked_user_email ?? "",
      country: partner.country ?? "",
      city: partner.city ?? "",
      address: partner.address ?? "",
      bio: partner.bio ?? "",
      verification_note: partner.verification_note ?? "",
    });
    setSaveError("");
    setShowForm(true);
  };

  const handleSave = async (event: React.FormEvent) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    setSaveError("");
    if (!form.name.trim() || !form.code.trim()) {
      setSaveError("Name and code are required");
      return;
    }
    setSaving(true);
    try {
      const body = {
        ...form,
        coverage_regions: form.coverage_regions.split(",").map((value) => value.trim()).filter(Boolean),
        service_types: form.service_types.split(",").map((value) => value.trim()).filter(Boolean),
        linked_user_email: form.linked_user_email.trim() || null,
      };
      const url = editingId ? `/logistics-partners/${editingId}` : "/logistics-partners/";
      const method = editingId ? "PUT" : "POST";
      const response = await apiFetch(url, {
        method,
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify(body),
      });
      if (!response.ok) {
        const payload = await response.json().catch(() => ({}));
        throw new Error(payload.detail || "Save failed");
      }
      await fetchData();
      setActiveWorkspace("partners");
      setShowForm(false);
      setEditingId(null);
      setActionMessage(editingId ? "Partner updated." : "Partner created.");
    } catch (error) {
      setSaveError(error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Network error");
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  };

  const handleReviewProfile = async (partnerId: number, status: "approved" | "rejected") => {
    setReviewingKey(`profile-${partnerId}-${status}`);
    setActionError("");
    setActionMessage("");
    try {
      const response = await apiFetch(`/logistics-partners/review/profile/${partnerId}`, {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ status }),
      });
      if (!response.ok) {
        const payload = await response.json().catch(() => ({}));
        throw new Error(payload.detail || "Could not review partner profile");
      }
      await fetchData();
      setActionMessage(`Profile ${status}.`);
    } catch (error) {
      setActionError(error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Could not review partner profile");
    } finally {
      setReviewingKey(null);
    }
  };

  const handleReviewArea = async (areaId: number, status: "approved" | "rejected") => {
    setReviewingKey(`area-${areaId}-${status}`);
    setActionError("");
    setActionMessage("");
    try {
      const response = await apiFetch(`/logistics-partners/review/service-areas/${areaId}`, {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ status }),
      });
      if (!response.ok) {
        const payload = await response.json().catch(() => ({}));
        throw new Error(payload.detail || "Could not review service area");
      }
      await fetchData();
      setActionMessage(`Service area ${status}.`);
    } catch (error) {
      setActionError(error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Could not review service area");
    } finally {
      setReviewingKey(null);
    }
  };

  const handleReviewPricingProfile = async (profileId: number, status: "approved" | "rejected") => {
    setReviewingKey(`pricing-profile-${profileId}-${status}`);
    setActionError("");
    setActionMessage("");
    try {
      const response = await apiFetch(`/logistics-partners/review/pricing-profiles/${profileId}`, {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ status }),
      });
      if (!response.ok) {
        const payload = await response.json().catch(() => ({}));
        throw new Error(payload.detail || "Could not review pricing profile");
      }
      await fetchData();
      setActionMessage(`Pricing profile ${status}.`);
    } catch (error) {
      setActionError(error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Could not review pricing profile");
    } finally {
      setReviewingKey(null);
    }
  };

  const handleReviewCategoryRule = async (ruleId: number, status: "approved" | "rejected") => {
    setReviewingKey(`category-rule-${ruleId}-${status}`);
    setActionError("");
    setActionMessage("");
    try {
      const response = await apiFetch(`/logistics-partners/review/category-rules/${ruleId}`, {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ status }),
      });
      if (!response.ok) {
        const payload = await response.json().catch(() => ({}));
        throw new Error(payload.detail || "Could not review handling rule");
      }
      await fetchData();
      setActionMessage(`Handling rule ${status}.`);
    } catch (error) {
      setActionError(error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Could not review handling rule");
    } finally {
      setReviewingKey(null);
    }
  };

  const handleReviewVehicleRule = async (ruleId: number, status: "approved" | "rejected") => {
    setReviewingKey(`vehicle-rule-${ruleId}-${status}`);
    setActionError("");
    setActionMessage("");
    try {
      const response = await apiFetch(`/logistics-partners/review/vehicle-rules/${ruleId}`, {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ status }),
      });
      if (!response.ok) {
        const payload = await response.json().catch(() => ({}));
        throw new Error(payload.detail || "Could not review load-fit rule");
      }
      await fetchData();
      setActionMessage(`Load-fit rule ${status}.`);
    } catch (error) {
      setActionError(error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Could not review load-fit rule");
    } finally {
      setReviewingKey(null);
    }
  };

  const handleTogglePartnerStatus = async (partner: LogisticsPartner) => {
    const nextStatus = partner.status === "active" ? "suspended" : "active";
    setStatusActionId(partner.id);
    setActionError("");
    setActionMessage("");
    try {
      const response = await apiFetch(`/logistics-partners/${partner.id}`, {
        method: "PUT",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ status: nextStatus }),
      });
      if (!response.ok) {
        const payload = await response.json().catch(() => ({}));
        throw new Error(payload.detail || "Could not update partner status");
      }
      await fetchData();
      setActionMessage(`Partner ${nextStatus === "active" ? "activated" : "suspended"}.`);
    } catch (error) {
      setActionError(error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Could not update partner status");
    } finally {
      setStatusActionId(null);
    }
  };

  const handleDeletePartner = async (partner: LogisticsPartner) => {
    if (!confirm(`Delete ${partner.name}? This removes the logistics partner record.`)) {
      return;
    }
    setDeleteActionId(partner.id);
    setActionError("");
    setActionMessage("");
    try {
      const response = await apiFetch(`/logistics-partners/${partner.id}`, { method: "DELETE" });
      if (!response.ok) {
        const payload = await response.json().catch(() => ({}));
        throw new Error(payload.detail || "Could not delete logistics partner");
      }
      await fetchData();
      setActionMessage("Partner deleted.");
    } catch (error) {
      setActionError(error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Could not delete logistics partner");
    } finally {
      setDeleteActionId(null);
    }
  };

  const handleBulkPartnerAction = async (action: "approve" | "reject" | "activate" | "suspend" | "delete") => {
    const partnerIds = Array.from(selectedPartnerIds);
    if (!partnerIds.length) return;
    if (action === "delete" && !confirm(`Delete ${partnerIds.length} logistics partner record(s)?`)) {
      return;
    }

    setBulkLoading(true);
    setActionError("");
    setActionMessage("");
    try {
      const response = await apiFetch("/logistics-partners/bulk", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ partner_ids: partnerIds, action }),
      });
      const payload = await response.json().catch(() => ({}));
      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error(payload.detail || "Could not process logistics partner bulk action");
      }
      await fetchData();
      setSelectedPartnerIds(new Set());
      setActionMessage(`${payload.processed ?? partnerIds.length} partner(s) processed.`);
    } catch (error) {
      setActionError(error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Could not process logistics partner bulk action");
    } finally {
      setBulkLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const totalPendingReviews = pendingAreaCount + pendingPricingProfileCount + pendingCategoryRuleCount + pendingVehicleRuleCount;
  const workspaceTabs: Array<{ key: WorkspaceKey; label: string; count?: number }> = [
    { key: "overview", label: "Overview" },
    { key: "partners", label: "Partners", count: partners.length },
    { key: "areas", label: "Service Areas", count: pendingAreaCount },
    { key: "profiles", label: "Pricing Profiles", count: pendingPricingProfileCount },
    { key: "categories", label: "Handling Rules", count: pendingCategoryRuleCount },
    { key: "vehicles", label: "Load-fit Rules", count: pendingVehicleRuleCount },
    { key: "distance", label: "Distance Matrix", count: cityDistances.length },
  ];

  const reviewShortcutCards = [
    {
      title: "Service areas",
      count: pendingAreaCount,
      action: () => {
        setActiveWorkspace("areas");
        setAreaStatusFilter("pending");
      },
    },
    {
      title: "Pricing profiles",
      count: pendingPricingProfileCount,
      action: () => {
        setActiveWorkspace("profiles");
        setPricingProfileStatusFilter("pending");
      },
    },
    {
      title: "Handling rules",
      count: pendingCategoryRuleCount,
      action: () => {
        setActiveWorkspace("categories");
        setCategoryRuleStatusFilter("pending");
      },
    },
    {
      title: "Load-fit rules",
      count: pendingVehicleRuleCount,
      action: () => {
        setActiveWorkspace("vehicles");
        setVehicleRuleStatusFilter("pending");
      },
    },
  ];

  const renderStatusTabs = (
    value: "all" | "pending" | "approved" | "rejected",
    onChange: (next: "all" | "pending" | "approved" | "rejected") => void,
  ) => (
    <div className="flex gap-1 rounded-lg bg-surface-2 p-0.5">
      {(["all", "pending", "approved", "rejected"] as const).map((status) => (
        <button
          key={status}
          type="button"
          onClick={() => onChange(status)}
          className={`rounded-md px-2.5 py-1 text-[10px] font-semibold capitalize transition-colors ${
            value === status
              ? status === "pending"
                ? "theme-chip-warning"
                : status === "approved"
                  ? "theme-chip-success"
                  : status === "rejected"
                    ? "theme-chip-danger"
                    : "theme-chip-brand"
              : "text-text-muted hover:text-text"
          }`}
        >
          {status}
        </button>
      ))}
    </div>
  );

  const closePartnerForm = () => {
    setShowForm(false);
    setEditingId(null);
    setSaveError("");
  };

  const resetDistanceEditor = () => {
    setEditingDistanceId(null);
    setDistanceForm({ origin_country_code: "", origin_city_name: "", destination_country_code: "", destination_city_name: "", distance_km: "", notes: "" });
  };

  const scrollToDistanceMatrix = () => {
    if (typeof document === "undefined") return;
    document.getElementById("admin-distance-matrix")?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth", block: "start" });
  };

  const openSelectedProfileEditor = () => {
    setShowProfileForm(true);
    setProfileFormError("");
    if (controlProfile) {
      setEditingProfileId(controlProfile.id);
      setAdminProfileForm({
        partner_id: String(controlProfile.partner_id),
        service_area_id: controlProfile.service_area_id != null ? String(controlProfile.service_area_id) : "",
        profile_name: controlProfile.profile_name ?? "",
        base_in_city_fee: controlProfile.base_in_city_fee != null ? String(controlProfile.base_in_city_fee) : "",
        base_inter_city_fee: controlProfile.base_inter_city_fee != null ? String(controlProfile.base_inter_city_fee) : "",
        per_km_rate: controlProfile.per_km_rate != null ? String(controlProfile.per_km_rate) : "",
        per_kg_rate: controlProfile.per_kg_rate != null ? String(controlProfile.per_kg_rate) : "",
        minimum_charge: controlProfile.minimum_charge != null ? String(controlProfile.minimum_charge) : "",
        maximum_charge: controlProfile.maximum_charge != null ? String(controlProfile.maximum_charge) : "",
        fuel_multiplier: controlProfile.fuel_multiplier != null ? String(controlProfile.fuel_multiplier) : "",
        bulk_discount_threshold_kg: controlProfile.bulk_discount_threshold_kg != null ? String(controlProfile.bulk_discount_threshold_kg) : "",
        bulk_discount_percent: controlProfile.bulk_discount_percent != null ? String(controlProfile.bulk_discount_percent) : "",
        currency: controlProfile.currency,
        is_active: controlProfile.is_active,
      });
      return;
    }

    setEditingProfileId(null);
    setAdminProfileForm({
      ...BLANK_PROFILE_FORM,
      partner_id: controlPartnerId,
      service_area_id: controlServiceAreaId,
    });
  };

  return (
      <>
      <div className="space-y-6">
        {scope === "full" ? (
        <section className="theme-card rounded-xl border p-3">
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-end gap-2">
            <button onClick={openCreate} className="theme-btn-primary flex items-center gap-2 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-xs font-semibold">
              <Plus className="h-4 w-4" />Add Partner
            </button>
            <button
              onClick={() => setActiveWorkspace("distance")}
              className="rounded-lg border border-border bg-surface-2 px-3 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-text-muted transition-colors hover:text-text"
            >
              Open Distance Matrix
            </button>
            <button
              onClick={fetchData}
              disabled={loading}
              className="flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg border border-border bg-surface-2 px-3 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-text-muted hover:text-text disabled:opacity-50"
            >
              <RefreshCw className={`h-3.5 w-3.5 ${loading ? "animate-spin" : ""}`} />
              Refresh Data
            </button>
          </div>

          {actionMessage ? <div className="mt-3 rounded-xl border border-success/30 bg-success/10 px-4 py-3 text-xs text-success">{actionMessage}</div> : null}
          {actionError ? <div className="mt-3 rounded-xl border border-danger/30 bg-danger/10 px-4 py-3 text-xs text-danger">{actionError}</div> : null}

          {stats ? (
            <div className="mt-3 grid gap-2 md:grid-cols-4">
              {[
                { label: "Total Partners", value: stats.total_partners, chip: "theme-chip-info" },
                { label: "Active Portals", value: stats.active_partners, chip: "theme-chip-success" },
                { label: "Approved Profiles", value: stats.approved_profiles, chip: "theme-chip-success" },
                { label: "Pending Review", value: totalPendingReviews, chip: "theme-chip-warning" },
              ].map(({ label, value, chip }) => (
                <div key={label} className="rounded-lg border border-border bg-surface-2 px-3 py-2.5">
                  <span className={`rounded-lg px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold ${chip}`}>{label}</span>
                  <p className="mt-2 text-lg font-bold text-text">{value}</p>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          ) : null}
        </section>
        ) : null}

        {scope !== "full" && scopedHeader ? (
          <section className="theme-card rounded-xl border p-3">
            <div className="flex flex-col gap-2 lg:flex-row lg:items-center lg:justify-between">
              <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 text-xs text-text-muted">
                <span className="rounded-lg border border-border bg-surface-2 px-2 py-1 text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.16em] text-text-faint">
                  {scopedHeader.eyebrow}
                </span>
                <span className="font-semibold text-text">{scopedHeader.title}</span>
                <span className="hidden text-text-faint xl:inline">{scopedHeader.description}</span>
              </div>
              <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                {scope === "partners" ? (
                  <button onClick={openCreate} className="theme-btn-primary flex items-center gap-2 rounded-xl px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold">
                    <Plus className="h-4 w-4" />Add Partner
                  </button>
                ) : null}
                <button
                  onClick={fetchData}
                  disabled={loading}
                  className="flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface-2 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-text-muted hover:text-text disabled:opacity-50"
                >
                  <RefreshCw className={`h-3.5 w-3.5 ${loading ? "animate-spin" : ""}`} />
                  Refresh Data
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
            {actionMessage ? <div className="mt-3 rounded-xl border border-success/30 bg-success/10 px-4 py-3 text-xs text-success">{actionMessage}</div> : null}
            {actionError ? <div className="mt-3 rounded-xl border border-danger/30 bg-danger/10 px-4 py-3 text-xs text-danger">{actionError}</div> : null}
          </section>
        ) : null}

        {scope === "pricing" ? (
          <section className="theme-card rounded-xl border p-3">
            <div className="flex flex-col gap-3 xl:flex-row xl:items-start xl:justify-between">
              <div>
                <p className="text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.18em] text-text-faint">Cost Drivers</p>
                <h2 className="mt-1 text-sm font-bold text-text">ZOZI logistics pricing control</h2>
                <p className="mt-1 text-[11px] text-text-muted">Pick a partner and approved service area, inspect the active charges, and test the simplified if-else formula before editing the queues below.</p>
              </div>
              <div className="grid gap-2 sm:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-4">
                <label className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-text-muted">
                  Rate Card Filter
                  <select value={selectedPartnerId} onChange={(event) => setSelectedPartnerId(event.target.value)} className="theme-input mt-1 w-full rounded-xl border px-3 py-2 text-xs">
                    <option value="all">All rate cards</option>
                    {partners.map((partner) => (
                      <option key={partner.id} value={String(partner.id)}>{partner.name}</option>
                    ))}
                  </select>
                </label>
                <label className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-text-muted">
                  Partner
                  <select value={controlPartnerId} onChange={(event) => setControlPartnerId(event.target.value)} className="theme-input mt-1 w-full rounded-xl border px-3 py-2 text-xs">
                    <option value="">Select partner</option>
                    {partners.map((partner) => (
                      <option key={partner.id} value={String(partner.id)}>{partner.name}</option>
                    ))}
                  </select>
                </label>
                <label className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-text-muted">
                  Service Area
                  <select value={controlServiceAreaId} onChange={(event) => setControlServiceAreaId(event.target.value)} className="theme-input mt-1 w-full rounded-xl border px-3 py-2 text-xs" disabled={!controlApprovedAreas.length}>
                    {!controlApprovedAreas.length ? <option value="">No approved areas</option> : null}
                    {controlApprovedAreas.map((area) => (
                      <option key={area.id} value={String(area.id)}>{area.zone_label || area.city_name || area.country_name}</option>
                    ))}
                  </select>
                </label>
                <button onClick={openSelectedProfileEditor} disabled={!controlPartnerId} className="theme-btn-secondary mt-5 rounded-xl border px-3 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-text-muted disabled:opacity-50">
                  {controlProfile ? "Edit Selected Profile" : "Create Profile"}
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>

            {actionMessage ? <div className="mt-3 rounded-xl border border-success/30 bg-success/10 px-4 py-3 text-xs text-success">{actionMessage}</div> : null}
            {actionError ? <div className="mt-3 rounded-xl border border-danger/30 bg-danger/10 px-4 py-3 text-xs text-danger">{actionError}</div> : null}

            {!controlPartnerId ? (
              <div className="mt-4 rounded-xl border border-dashed border-border px-4 py-8 text-center text-xs text-text-muted">Select a logistics partner to load approved service areas, compatibility controls, and the live calculator.</div>
            ) : !controlArea ? (
              <div className="mt-4 rounded-xl border border-dashed border-border px-4 py-8 text-center text-xs text-text-muted">This partner has no approved service area yet. Approve a route first so the pricing control can load real charge inputs.</div>
            ) : !controlProfile ? (
              <div className="mt-4 rounded-xl border border-dashed border-border px-4 py-8 text-center text-xs text-text-muted">No approved pricing profile is available for the selected area. Create or approve a pricing profile to activate the live control widget.</div>
            ) : (
              <div className="mt-4 grid gap-4 2xl:grid-cols-[1.1fr_0.9fr]">
                <div className="grid gap-4 xl:grid-cols-2">
                  <section className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface-2 p-4">
                    <p className="text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.16em] text-text-faint">Rate Card Inputs</p>
                    <div className="mt-3 grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2">
                      <div className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface p-3">
                        <p className="text-xs font-bold text-text">In-City</p>
                        <p className="mt-2 text-[11px] text-text-muted">Base Fee: {controlProfile.base_in_city_fee != null ? `${controlProfile.base_in_city_fee.toFixed(2)} ${controlProfile.currency}` : "Not set"}</p>
                        <p className="mt-1 text-[11px] text-text-muted">Per-Kg: {controlProfile.per_kg_rate != null ? `${controlProfile.per_kg_rate.toFixed(2)} ${controlProfile.currency}/kg` : "0.00"}</p>
                      </div>
                      <div className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface p-3">
                        <p className="text-xs font-bold text-text">Inter-City</p>
                        <p className="mt-2 text-[11px] text-text-muted">Base Fee: {controlProfile.base_inter_city_fee != null ? `${controlProfile.base_inter_city_fee.toFixed(2)} ${controlProfile.currency}` : "Not set"}</p>
                        <p className="mt-1 text-[11px] text-text-muted">Per-Km: {controlProfile.per_km_rate != null && controlProfile.per_km_rate > 0 ? `${controlProfile.per_km_rate.toFixed(2)} ${controlProfile.currency}/km` : "Flat rate only"}</p>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </section>

                  <section className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface-2 p-4">
                    <p className="text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.16em] text-text-faint">Extra Stop Charges</p>
                    <div className="mt-3 space-y-2 text-[11px] text-text-muted">
                      <div className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface p-3">
                        <p className="font-semibold text-text">Pickups</p>
                        <p className="mt-1">1st pickup is included. Each additional stop adds {(controlArea.pickup_charge ?? 0).toFixed(2)} {controlArea.currency}.</p>
                      </div>
                      <div className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface p-3">
                        <p className="font-semibold text-text">Drop-offs</p>
                        <p className="mt-1">1st drop-off is included. Each additional stop adds {(controlArea.dropoff_charge ?? 0).toFixed(2)} {controlArea.currency}.</p>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </section>

                  <section className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface-2 p-4 xl:col-span-2">
                    <p className="text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.16em] text-text-faint">Highest Handling Rule</p>
                    {controlCategoryOptions.length === 0 ? (
                      <div className="mt-3 rounded-xl border border-dashed border-border px-4 py-6 text-center text-xs text-text-muted">No approved handling rules for this area yet. The calculator will apply the single highest approved handling amount once one exists.</div>
                    ) : (
                      <div className="mt-3 space-y-3">
                        <div className="rounded-xl border border-primary/20 bg-primary/5 px-3 py-2 text-[11px] text-text-muted">
                          If more than one handling rule matches, the calculator uses only the single highest approved handling amount.
                        </div>
                        <div className="overflow-x-auto">
                        <table className="w-full text-[11px]">
                          <thead>
                            <tr className="border-b border-border text-left text-text-faint">
                              <th className="pb-2 pr-3 font-semibold">Category</th>
                              <th className="pb-2 pr-3 font-semibold">Handling Amount</th>
                              <th className="pb-2 font-semibold">Runtime Behavior</th>
                            </tr>
                          </thead>
                          <tbody className="divide-y divide-border">
                            {controlCategoryOptions.map(({ key, rule }) => (
                              <tr key={key}>
                                <td className="py-2 pr-3 font-medium text-text">{rule.category_name}</td>
                                <td className="py-2 pr-3 text-text-muted">{Math.max(Number(rule.flat_fee_override ?? 0), Number(rule.special_handling_fee ?? 0)).toFixed(2)} {rule.currency}</td>
                                <td className="py-2 text-text-muted">Highest match wins</td>
                              </tr>
                            ))}
                          </tbody>
                        </table>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </section>

                  <section className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface-2 p-4 xl:col-span-2">
                    <p className="text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.16em] text-text-faint">Compatibility Controls</p>
                    <div className="mt-3 grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-4">
                      <div className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface p-3">
                        <p className="text-xs font-bold text-text">Floor Charge</p>
                        <p className="mt-2 text-lg font-bold text-text">{calculatorBreakdown.minimumCharge != null ? `${Number(calculatorBreakdown.minimumCharge).toFixed(2)} ${controlProfile.currency}` : "None"}</p>
                      </div>
                      <div className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface p-3">
                        <p className="text-xs font-bold text-text">Ceiling Charge</p>
                        <p className="mt-2 text-lg font-bold text-text">{calculatorBreakdown.maximumCharge != null ? `${Number(calculatorBreakdown.maximumCharge).toFixed(2)} ${controlProfile.currency}` : "None"}</p>
                      </div>
                      <div className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface p-3">
                        <p className="text-xs font-bold text-text">Runtime Surcharge Factor</p>
                        <p className="mt-2 text-lg font-bold text-text">x{calculatorBreakdown.fuelMultiplier.toFixed(2)}</p>
                      </div>
                      <div className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface p-3">
                        <p className="text-xs font-bold text-text">Area Split</p>
                        <p className="mt-2 text-[11px] text-text-muted">Pickup {(controlArea.pickup_charge ?? 0).toFixed(2)} / Drop-off {(controlArea.dropoff_charge ?? 0).toFixed(2)} {controlArea.currency}</p>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </section>
                </div>

                <section className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface-2 p-4">
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
                    <div>
                      <p className="text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.16em] text-text-faint">Live Calculator</p>
                      <h3 className="mt-1 text-sm font-bold text-text">Test the weight-first formula</h3>
                    </div>
                    <button onClick={scrollToDistanceMatrix} className="theme-btn-secondary rounded-xl border px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-text-muted">
                      Open Distance Matrix
                    </button>
                  </div>

                  <div className="mt-4 grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2">
                    <label className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-text-muted">
                      Route Type
                      <select value={calculatorForm.routeType} onChange={(event) => setCalculatorForm((current) => ({ ...current, routeType: event.target.value as PricingCalculatorForm["routeType"] }))} className="theme-input mt-1 w-full rounded-xl border px-3 py-2 text-xs">
                        <option value="in_city">In-City</option>
                        <option value="inter_city">Inter-City</option>
                      </select>
                    </label>
                    <label className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-text-muted">
                      Weight (kg)
                      <input type="number" min="0" value={calculatorForm.weightKg} onChange={(event) => setCalculatorForm((current) => ({ ...current, weightKg: event.target.value }))} className="theme-input mt-1 w-full rounded-xl border px-3 py-2 text-xs" />
                    </label>
                    <label className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-text-muted">
                      Pickups
                      <input type="number" min="1" value={calculatorForm.pickupCount} onChange={(event) => setCalculatorForm((current) => ({ ...current, pickupCount: event.target.value }))} className="theme-input mt-1 w-full rounded-xl border px-3 py-2 text-xs" />
                    </label>
                    <label className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-text-muted">
                      Drop-offs
                      <input type="number" min="1" value={calculatorForm.dropoffCount} onChange={(event) => setCalculatorForm((current) => ({ ...current, dropoffCount: event.target.value }))} className="theme-input mt-1 w-full rounded-xl border px-3 py-2 text-xs" />
                    </label>
                    <label className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-text-muted sm:col-span-2">
                      Distance (km)
                      <input type="number" min="0" value={calculatorForm.distanceKm} onChange={(event) => setCalculatorForm((current) => ({ ...current, distanceKm: event.target.value }))} disabled={calculatorForm.routeType !== "inter_city"} className="theme-input mt-1 w-full rounded-xl border px-3 py-2 text-xs disabled:opacity-50" />
                    </label>
                  </div>

                  <div className="mt-4">
                    <p className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-text-muted">Handling rules</p>
                    <div className="mt-2 flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                      {controlCategoryOptions.length === 0 ? <span className="text-xs text-text-muted">No approved handling rules</span> : null}
                      {controlCategoryOptions.map(({ key, rule }) => {
                        const isSelected = calculatorForm.selectedCategories.includes(key);
                        return (
                          <button
                            key={key}
                            type="button"
                            onClick={() => setCalculatorForm((current) => ({
                              ...current,
                              selectedCategories: isSelected
                                ? current.selectedCategories.filter((value) => value !== key)
                                : [...current.selectedCategories, key],
                            }))}
                            className={`rounded-full border px-3 py-1 text-[11px] font-semibold transition-colors ${isSelected ? "theme-btn-primary" : "theme-btn-secondary text-text-muted"}`}
                          >
                            {rule.category_name}
                          </button>
                        );
                      })}
                    </div>
                    <p className="mt-2 text-[11px] text-text-muted">
                      {calculatorBreakdown.appliedCategoryRule
                        ? `Highest rule: ${calculatorBreakdown.appliedCategoryRule.category_name}`
                        : "No handling rule selected."}
                    </p>
                  </div>

                  <div className="mt-4 rounded-xl border border-primary/20 bg-primary/5 px-3 py-2 text-[11px] text-text-muted">
                    Load-fit rules stay in the queue below for operational approval. They do not change the customer charge shown in this calculator.
                  </div>

                  <div className="mt-4 rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface p-4">
                    <div className="space-y-2 text-[11px] text-text-muted">
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3"><span>Base Fee</span><span>{calculatorBreakdown.baseFee.toFixed(2)} {controlProfile.currency}</span></div>
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3"><span>Weight ({Number(calculatorForm.weightKg || 0)}kg x {calculatorBreakdown.perKgRate.toFixed(2)})</span><span>{calculatorBreakdown.weightFee.toFixed(2)} {controlProfile.currency}</span></div>
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3"><span>Distance {calculatorForm.routeType === "inter_city" ? `(${Number(calculatorForm.distanceKm || 0)}km x ${calculatorBreakdown.perKmRate.toFixed(2)})` : "(ignored)"}</span><span>{calculatorBreakdown.distanceFee.toFixed(2)} {controlProfile.currency}</span></div>
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3"><span>Extra Pickups ({calculatorBreakdown.extraPickupCount})</span><span>{calculatorBreakdown.pickupFee.toFixed(2)} {controlProfile.currency}</span></div>
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3"><span>Extra Drop-offs ({calculatorBreakdown.extraDropoffCount})</span><span>{calculatorBreakdown.dropoffFee.toFixed(2)} {controlProfile.currency}</span></div>
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3"><span>Handling Amount</span><span>{calculatorBreakdown.categoryTotal.toFixed(2)} {controlProfile.currency}</span></div>
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3"><span>Applied Handling Rule</span><span>{calculatorBreakdown.appliedCategoryRule?.category_name ?? "None"}</span></div>
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 border-t border-border pt-2"><span>Subtotal</span><span>{calculatorBreakdown.subtotal.toFixed(2)} {controlProfile.currency}</span></div>
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3"><span>After runtime surcharge (x{calculatorBreakdown.fuelMultiplier.toFixed(2)})</span><span>{calculatorBreakdown.fuelAdjusted.toFixed(2)} {controlProfile.currency}</span></div>
                    </div>
                    <div className="mt-3 grid gap-2 sm:grid-cols-2">
                      <div className={`rounded-xl border px-3 py-2 text-[11px] ${calculatorBreakdown.minimumChargeApplied ? "border-warning/40 bg-warning/10 text-warning" : "border-border bg-surface-2 text-text-muted"}`}>
                        Minimum floor {calculatorBreakdown.minimumCharge != null ? `${Number(calculatorBreakdown.minimumCharge).toFixed(2)} ${controlProfile.currency}` : "not set"}
                      </div>
                      <div className={`rounded-xl border px-3 py-2 text-[11px] ${calculatorBreakdown.maximumChargeApplied ? "border-warning/40 bg-warning/10 text-warning" : "border-border bg-surface-2 text-text-muted"}`}>
                        Maximum cap {calculatorBreakdown.maximumCharge != null ? `${Number(calculatorBreakdown.maximumCharge).toFixed(2)} ${controlProfile.currency}` : "not set"}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                    <div className="mt-4 flex items-center justify-between gap-3 border-t border-border pt-3">
                      <div>
                        <p className="text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.16em] text-text-faint">Final Charge</p>
                        <p className="text-lg font-bold text-text">{calculatorBreakdown.finalCharge.toFixed(2)} {controlProfile.currency}</p>
                      </div>
                      <div className="text-right text-[11px] text-text-muted">
                        <p>{calculatorBreakdown.minimumChargeApplied ? "Minimum floor applied" : "Minimum floor not hit"}</p>
                        <p>{calculatorBreakdown.maximumChargeApplied ? "Maximum cap applied" : "Maximum cap not hit"}</p>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </section>
              </div>
            )}
          </section>
        ) : null}

        {scope === "full" ? (
        <section className="theme-card rounded-xl border p-3">
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-4">
            <div>
              <h2 className="text-sm font-bold text-text">{WORKSPACE_COPY[activeWorkspace].title}</h2>
              <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-text-muted">{WORKSPACE_COPY[activeWorkspace].description}</p>
            </div>
            {activeWorkspace !== "overview" && activeWorkspace !== "distance" ? (
              <select value={selectedPartnerId} onChange={(event) => setSelectedPartnerId(event.target.value)} className="theme-input rounded-xl border px-3 py-2 text-xs">
                <option value="all">All partners</option>
                {partners.map((partner) => (
                  <option key={partner.id} value={String(partner.id)}>{partner.name}</option>
                ))}
              </select>
            ) : null}
          </div>

          <div className="mt-3 flex flex-wrap gap-2">
            {workspaceTabs.map((workspace) => (
              <button
                key={workspace.key}
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setActiveWorkspace(workspace.key)}
                className={`inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-xl px-3 py-2 text-xs font-semibold transition-colors ${
                  activeWorkspace === workspace.key ? "theme-btn-primary" : "theme-btn-secondary border text-text-muted"
                }`}
              >
                <span>{workspace.label}</span>
                {workspace.count != null ? (
                  <span className={`rounded-full px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold ${activeWorkspace === workspace.key ? "bg-black/10 text-current" : "theme-chip-brand"}`}>
                    {workspace.count}
                  </span>
                ) : null}
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>

          {isWorkspaceVisible("overview") ? (
            <div className="mt-4 grid gap-3 xl:grid-cols-[1.15fr,0.85fr]">
              <div className="space-y-3">
                <div className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface-2 p-3">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-warning">
                    <AlertCircle className="h-4 w-4" />
                    <p className="text-xs font-bold text-text">{totalPendingReviews} item(s) need admin review</p>
                  </div>
                  <div className="mt-3 grid gap-2 sm:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-4">
                    {reviewShortcutCards.map((card) => (
                      <button
                        key={card.title}
                        onClick={card.action}
                        className="rounded-lg border border-border bg-surface px-3 py-2.5 text-left transition-colors hover:border-warning/40 hover:bg-warning/5"
                      >
                        <p className="text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.16em] text-text-faint">Queue</p>
                        <p className="mt-1 text-sm font-bold text-text">{card.title}</p>
                        <p className="mt-2 text-xs text-text-muted">{card.count} pending</p>
                      </button>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div className="grid gap-3 md:grid-cols-3">
                  {GOVERNANCE_CARDS.map((card) => (
                    <div key={card.title} className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface-2 p-3">
                      <p className="text-xs font-bold text-text">{card.title}</p>
                      <p className="mt-2 text-xs text-text-muted">{card.body}</p>
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface-2 p-3">
                <p className="text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.18em] text-text-faint">How to use this page</p>
                <div className="mt-3 space-y-2 text-xs text-text-muted">
                  <div className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface p-3">
                    <p className="font-semibold text-text">1. Check pending review</p>
                    <p className="mt-1">Use the overview cards to jump into the queue that is blocking approvals.</p>
                  </div>
                  <div className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface p-3">
                    <p className="font-semibold text-text">2. Work one workspace at a time</p>
                    <p className="mt-1">Partner registry, service areas, pricing, categories, vehicles, and distance lookups are separated so actions are easier to understand.</p>
                  </div>
                  <div className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface p-3">
                    <p className="font-semibold text-text">3. Use the shared partner filter</p>
                    <p className="mt-1">Every review workspace can be narrowed to a single partner instead of scanning one long mixed queue.</p>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          ) : null}
        </section>
        ) : null}

        {isWorkspaceVisible("partners") ? (
          <>
            <div className={showForm ? "grid gap-6 xl:grid-cols-[minmax(0,1.6fr),minmax(320px,0.9fr)]" : ""}>
              <div className="theme-card rounded-xl border p-3">
                {loading ? (
                  <div className="space-y-3 p-6">{Array.from({ length: 3 }).map((_, index) => <div key={index} className="h-16 animate-pulse rounded-xl bg-surface-2" />)}</div>
                ) : partners.length === 0 ? (
                  <div className="p-12 text-center text-xs text-text-muted">No logistics partners yet. Create the first one from the action bar above.</div>
                ) : (
                  <EnterpriseDataTable
                    columns={partnerColumns}
                    rows={partners}
                    rowKey={(partner) => partner.id}
                    densityMode={density}
                    enableBulkActions
                    enableExport={false}
                    searchPlaceholder="Search by partner, code, portal user, contact, or location"
                    selectedRowKeys={Array.from(selectedPartnerIds)}
                    onSelectedRowKeysChange={(keys) => setSelectedPartnerIds(new Set(keys.map((key) => Number(key))))}
                    showSelectionSummary={false}
                    emptyState="No logistics partners yet. Create the first one from the action bar above."
                    toolbarSlot={<span className="rounded-full bg-surface-2 px-3 py-1 text-[11px] font-semibold text-text-muted">{partners.length} partner record(s){selectedPartnerIds.size ? ` · ${selectedPartnerIds.size} selected` : ""}</span>}
                    rowActions={(partner) => {
                      const isExpanded = expandedPartnerId === partner.id;
                      const disabled = reviewingKey !== null || statusActionId === partner.id || deleteActionId === partner.id;
                      return (
                        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-end gap-1.5">
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            onClick={() => setExpandedPartnerId(isExpanded ? null : partner.id)}
                            className="rounded-md border border-border bg-surface-2 px-2 py-1 text-[11px] font-semibold text-text-muted transition-colors hover:border-primary/30 hover:text-primary"
                          >
                            {isExpanded ? "Hide details" : "Details"}
                          </button>
                          <button type="button" onClick={() => openEdit(partner)} className="rounded-md border border-border bg-surface-2 px-2 py-1 text-[11px] font-semibold text-text-muted transition-colors hover:border-primary/30 hover:text-primary">Edit</button>
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            onClick={() => handleReviewProfile(partner.id, "approved")}
                            disabled={disabled}
                            className="theme-chip-success rounded-md px-2 py-1 text-[11px] font-semibold disabled:opacity-50"
                          >
                            Approve
                          </button>
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            onClick={() => handleReviewProfile(partner.id, "rejected")}
                            disabled={disabled}
                            className="theme-chip-danger rounded-md px-2 py-1 text-[11px] font-semibold disabled:opacity-50"
                          >
                            Reject
                          </button>
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            onClick={() => handleTogglePartnerStatus(partner)}
                            disabled={disabled}
                            className="theme-chip-info rounded-md px-2 py-1 text-[11px] font-semibold disabled:opacity-50"
                          >
                            {partner.status === "active" ? "Suspend" : "Activate"}
                          </button>
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            onClick={() => handleDeletePartner(partner)}
                            disabled={disabled}
                            className="theme-chip-danger rounded-md px-2 py-1 text-[11px] font-semibold disabled:opacity-50"
                          >
                            Delete
                          </button>
                        </div>
                      );
                    }}
                    mobileCardRenderer={(partner) => {
                      const counts = partnerAreaCounts[partner.id] || { approved: 0, pending: 0, rejected: 0 };
                      return (
                        <div className="space-y-2 text-xs">
                          <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3">
                            <div>
                              <p className="font-semibold text-text">{partner.name}</p>
                              <p className="mt-1 font-mono text-[11px] text-text-muted">{partner.code}</p>
                            </div>
                            <span className={`inline-flex rounded-full px-2 py-1 text-[10px] font-semibold ${STATUS_CHIP[partner.status] ?? "theme-chip-muted"}`}>
                              {formatStatusLabel(partner.status)}
                            </span>
                          </div>
                          <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">
                            <span className={`rounded-full px-2 py-1 text-[10px] font-semibold ${STATUS_CHIP[partner.verification_status] ?? "theme-chip-muted"}`}>{formatStatusLabel(partner.verification_status)}</span>
                            <span className="theme-chip-success rounded-full px-2 py-1 text-[10px] font-semibold">Areas {counts.approved}/{counts.pending}/{counts.rejected}</span>
                          </div>
                          <p className="text-text-muted">{[partner.city, partner.country].filter(Boolean).join(", ") || "Location pending"}</p>
                          <p className="text-text-muted">{partner.contact_email || partner.contact_phone || "No contact info"}</p>
                        </div>
                      );
                    }}
                    expandedRowKey={expandedPartnerId ?? undefined}
                    expandedRowRenderer={(partner) => {
                      const counts = partnerAreaCounts[partner.id] || { approved: 0, pending: 0, rejected: 0 };
                      const partnerProfiles = pricingProfiles.filter((profile) => profile.partner_id === partner.id);
                      const partnerCategoryRules = categoryRules.filter((rule) => rule.partner_id === partner.id);
                      const partnerVehicleRules = vehicleRules.filter((rule) => rule.partner_id === partner.id);
                      return (
                        <div className="p-4">
                          <div className="mb-3 flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
                            <div>
                              <h4 className="text-sm font-bold text-text">Partner Details</h4>
                              <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-text-muted">Expanded partner context for {partner.name}. Profile, coverage, and pricing governance stay in the same workspace.</p>
                            </div>
                            <button type="button" onClick={() => setExpandedPartnerId(null)} className="rounded-lg border border-border bg-surface px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-text-muted hover:text-text">
                              Close
                            </button>
                          </div>
                          <div className="grid gap-3 md:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-3">
                            <div className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface-1 p-3">
                              <p className="text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.18em] text-text-faint">Portal Access</p>
                              <p className="mt-1.5 text-xs font-medium text-text">{partner.linked_user_email || partner.linked_username || "No linked portal user"}</p>
                              <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-text-muted">{partner.contact_name || "Primary contact not set"}</p>
                            </div>
                            <div className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface-1 p-3">
                              <p className="text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.18em] text-text-faint">Coverage Regions</p>
                              <p className="mt-1.5 text-xs font-medium text-text">{partner.coverage_regions?.join(", ") || "No coverage regions submitted"}</p>
                              <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-text-muted">Service types: {partner.service_types?.join(", ") || "No service types set"}</p>
                            </div>
                            <div className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface-1 p-3">
                              <p className="text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.18em] text-text-faint">Lifecycle</p>
                              <p className="mt-1.5 text-xs font-medium text-text">Created {new Date(partner.created_at).toLocaleDateString()}</p>
                              <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-text-muted">Website: {partner.website ? <a href={partner.website} target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" className="text-primary hover:underline">{partner.website}</a> : "Not provided"}</p>
                            </div>
                            <div className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface-1 p-3">
                              <p className="text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.18em] text-text-faint">Coverage Review</p>
                              <div className="mt-2 flex flex-wrap gap-1.5 text-[11px]">
                                <span className="theme-chip-success rounded-lg px-2 py-0.5 font-semibold">Approved {counts.approved}</span>
                                <span className="theme-chip-warning rounded-lg px-2 py-0.5 font-semibold">Pending {counts.pending}</span>
                                <span className="theme-chip-danger rounded-lg px-2 py-0.5 font-semibold">Rejected {counts.rejected}</span>
                              </div>
                            </div>
                            <div className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface-1 p-3">
                              <p className="text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.18em] text-text-faint">Pricing Inputs</p>
                              <p className="mt-1.5 text-xs font-medium text-text">{partnerProfiles.length} pricing profile(s)</p>
                              <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-text-muted">{partnerCategoryRules.length} handling rule(s) · {partnerVehicleRules.length} load-fit rule(s)</p>
                            </div>
                            <div className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface-1 p-3">
                              <p className="text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.18em] text-text-faint">Location Notes</p>
                              <p className="mt-1.5 text-xs font-medium text-text">{[partner.city, partner.country].filter(Boolean).join(", ") || "Location not provided"}</p>
                              <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-text-muted">{partner.address || partner.bio || partner.verification_note || "No address, bio, or admin note recorded."}</p>
                            </div>
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      );
                    }}
                  />
                )}
              </div>

              {showForm ? (
                <div className="space-y-4">
                  <form onSubmit={handleSave} className="theme-card space-y-4 rounded-xl border p-5">
            <h2 className="text-xs font-bold text-text">{editingId ? "Edit Partner" : "Add New Partner"}</h2>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2">
              {[
                ["Company Name *", "name"],
                ["Code (unique) *", "code"],
                ["Contact Name", "contact_name"],
                ["Contact Email", "contact_email"],
                ["Contact Phone", "contact_phone"],
                ["Website", "website"],
                ["Country", "country"],
                ["City", "city"],
                ["Linked Portal User Email", "linked_user_email"],
                ["Coverage Regions", "coverage_regions"],
                ["Service Types", "service_types"],
              ].map(([label, field]) => (
                <div key={String(field)} className={field === "linked_user_email" || field === "coverage_regions" || field === "service_types" ? "sm:col-span-2" : ""}>
                  <label className="mb-1 block text-xs font-semibold text-text-muted">{label}</label>
                  <input
                    value={form[field as keyof typeof form]}
                    onChange={(event) => setForm((current) => ({ ...current, [field]: field === "code" ? event.target.value.toUpperCase() : event.target.value }))}
                    className="theme-input w-full rounded-xl border px-3 py-2 text-xs"
                  />
                </div>
              ))}
              <div>
                <label className="mb-1 block text-xs font-semibold text-text-muted">Portal Status</label>
                <select value={form.status} onChange={(event) => setForm((current) => ({ ...current, status: event.target.value }))} className="theme-input w-full rounded-xl border px-3 py-2 text-xs">
                  <option value="pending_onboarding">Pending Onboarding</option>
                  <option value="active">Active</option>
                  <option value="suspended">Suspended</option>
                </select>
              </div>
              <div className="sm:col-span-2">
                <label className="mb-1 block text-xs font-semibold text-text-muted">Address</label>
                <textarea value={form.address} onChange={(event) => setForm((current) => ({ ...current, address: event.target.value }))} className="theme-input w-full rounded-xl border px-3 py-2 text-xs" rows={3} />
              </div>
              <div className="sm:col-span-2">
                <label className="mb-1 block text-xs font-semibold text-text-muted">Short Bio</label>
                <textarea value={form.bio} onChange={(event) => setForm((current) => ({ ...current, bio: event.target.value }))} className="theme-input w-full rounded-xl border px-3 py-2 text-xs" rows={3} />
              </div>
              <div className="sm:col-span-2">
                <label className="mb-1 block text-xs font-semibold text-text-muted">Verification Note</label>
                <textarea value={form.verification_note} onChange={(event) => setForm((current) => ({ ...current, verification_note: event.target.value }))} className="theme-input w-full rounded-xl border px-3 py-2 text-xs" rows={2} />
              </div>
            </div>
            {saveError ? <p className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs text-danger"><AlertCircle className="h-4 w-4" />{saveError}</p> : null}
            <div className="flex gap-3">
              <button type="submit" disabled={saving} className="theme-btn-primary flex items-center gap-2 rounded-xl px-5 py-2.5 text-xs font-semibold disabled:opacity-50">
                {saving ? <RefreshCw className="h-4 w-4 animate-spin" /> : <CheckCircle className="h-4 w-4" />}
                {editingId ? "Update" : "Create"}
              </button>
              <button type="button" onClick={closePartnerForm} className="theme-btn-secondary rounded-xl px-5 py-2.5 text-xs font-semibold">
                Cancel
              </button>
            </div>
                  </form>
                </div>
              ) : null}
            </div>

            <BulkActionBar
              selectedCount={selectedPartnerIds.size}
              onClearSelection={() => setSelectedPartnerIds(new Set())}
              actions={[
                { label: "Approve Selected", onClick: () => handleBulkPartnerAction("approve"), loading: bulkLoading, variant: "success" },
                { label: "Reject Selected", onClick: () => handleBulkPartnerAction("reject"), loading: bulkLoading, variant: "danger" },
                { label: "Activate Selected", onClick: () => handleBulkPartnerAction("activate"), loading: bulkLoading, variant: "primary" },
                { label: "Suspend Selected", onClick: () => handleBulkPartnerAction("suspend"), loading: bulkLoading, variant: "warning" },
                { label: "Delete Selected", onClick: () => handleBulkPartnerAction("delete"), loading: bulkLoading, variant: "danger" },
              ]}
            />
          </>
        ) : null}

        {isWorkspaceVisible("areas") ? (
          <div className="theme-card space-y-4 rounded-xl border p-5">
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3">
            <div>
              <h2 className="flex items-center gap-2 text-lg font-bold text-text">
                <ShieldCheck className="h-5 w-5 text-primary" /> Service Area Review Queue
                {pendingAreaCount > 0 && (
                  <span className="theme-chip-warning rounded-full px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold">{pendingAreaCount} pending</span>
                )}
              </h2>
              <p className="text-xs text-text-muted">Approve or reject the city, country, and charge rows that control customer shipping quotes and prepared pickup visibility.</p>
            </div>
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
              {renderStatusTabs(areaStatusFilter, setAreaStatusFilter)}
              <button onClick={() => { setEditingAreaId(null); setAdminAreaForm(BLANK_AREA_FORM); setAreaFormError(""); setShowAreaForm((v) => !v); }} className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-xl border border-border px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-text hover:bg-surface-2">
                <Plus className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />New Area
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>

          {showAreaForm && (
            <div className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface-2 p-4 space-y-3">
              <p className="text-xs font-bold text-text">{editingAreaId ? "Edit Service Area" : "Create Service Area"}</p>
              {areaFormError && <p className="text-xs font-medium text-danger">{areaFormError}</p>}
              <div className="grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3">
                <div><label className="mb-1 block text-xs font-semibold text-text-muted">Partner *</label>
                  <select value={adminAreaForm.partner_id} onChange={(e) => setAdminAreaForm((p) => ({ ...p, partner_id: e.target.value }))} className="theme-input w-full rounded-xl border px-3 py-2 text-xs">
                    <option value="">— Select partner —</option>
                    {partners.map((pt) => <option key={pt.id} value={pt.id}>{pt.name}</option>)}
                  </select>
                </div>
                <div><label className="mb-1 block text-xs font-semibold text-text-muted">Country Code *</label><input value={adminAreaForm.country_code} onChange={(e) => setAdminAreaForm((p) => ({ ...p, country_code: e.target.value.toUpperCase() }))} placeholder="AE" className="theme-input w-full rounded-xl border px-3 py-2 text-xs" /></div>
                <div><label className="mb-1 block text-xs font-semibold text-text-muted">Country Name *</label><input value={adminAreaForm.country_name} onChange={(e) => setAdminAreaForm((p) => ({ ...p, country_name: e.target.value }))} placeholder="United Arab Emirates" className="theme-input w-full rounded-xl border px-3 py-2 text-xs" /></div>
                <div><label className="mb-1 block text-xs font-semibold text-text-muted">City</label><input value={adminAreaForm.city_name} onChange={(e) => setAdminAreaForm((p) => ({ ...p, city_name: e.target.value }))} placeholder="Dubai" className="theme-input w-full rounded-xl border px-3 py-2 text-xs" /></div>
                <div><label className="mb-1 block text-xs font-semibold text-text-muted">Zone Label</label><input value={adminAreaForm.zone_label} onChange={(e) => setAdminAreaForm((p) => ({ ...p, zone_label: e.target.value }))} placeholder="Zone A" className="theme-input w-full rounded-xl border px-3 py-2 text-xs" /></div>
                <div><label className="mb-1 block text-xs font-semibold text-text-muted">Latitude</label><input type="number" value={adminAreaForm.latitude} onChange={(e) => setAdminAreaForm((p) => ({ ...p, latitude: e.target.value }))} placeholder="25.2048" className="theme-input w-full rounded-xl border px-3 py-2 text-xs" /></div>
                <div><label className="mb-1 block text-xs font-semibold text-text-muted">Longitude</label><input type="number" value={adminAreaForm.longitude} onChange={(e) => setAdminAreaForm((p) => ({ ...p, longitude: e.target.value }))} placeholder="55.2708" className="theme-input w-full rounded-xl border px-3 py-2 text-xs" /></div>
                <div><label className="mb-1 block text-xs font-semibold text-text-muted">Charge Amount *</label><input type="number" value={adminAreaForm.charge_amount} onChange={(e) => setAdminAreaForm((p) => ({ ...p, charge_amount: e.target.value }))} placeholder="15.00" className="theme-input w-full rounded-xl border px-3 py-2 text-xs" /></div>
                <div><label className="mb-1 block text-xs font-semibold text-text-muted">Minimum Charge</label><input type="number" value={adminAreaForm.minimum_charge} onChange={(e) => setAdminAreaForm((p) => ({ ...p, minimum_charge: e.target.value }))} placeholder="10.00" className="theme-input w-full rounded-xl border px-3 py-2 text-xs" /></div>
                <div><label className="mb-1 block text-xs font-semibold text-text-muted">Per kg Rate</label><input type="number" value={adminAreaForm.per_kg_rate} onChange={(e) => setAdminAreaForm((p) => ({ ...p, per_kg_rate: e.target.value }))} placeholder="0.50" className="theme-input w-full rounded-xl border px-3 py-2 text-xs" /></div>
                <div><label className="mb-1 block text-xs font-semibold text-text-muted">Per km Rate</label><input type="number" value={adminAreaForm.per_km_rate} onChange={(e) => setAdminAreaForm((p) => ({ ...p, per_km_rate: e.target.value }))} placeholder="0.30" className="theme-input w-full rounded-xl border px-3 py-2 text-xs" /></div>
                <div><label className="mb-1 block text-xs font-semibold text-text-muted">Runtime Surcharge Factor</label><input type="number" value={adminAreaForm.fuel_multiplier} onChange={(e) => setAdminAreaForm((p) => ({ ...p, fuel_multiplier: e.target.value }))} placeholder="1.0" className="theme-input w-full rounded-xl border px-3 py-2 text-xs" /></div>
                <div><label className="mb-1 block text-xs font-semibold text-text-muted">Pickup Fee Per Stop</label><input type="number" value={adminAreaForm.pickup_charge} onChange={(e) => setAdminAreaForm((p) => ({ ...p, pickup_charge: e.target.value }))} placeholder="5.00" className="theme-input w-full rounded-xl border px-3 py-2 text-xs" /></div>
                <div><label className="mb-1 block text-xs font-semibold text-text-muted">Dropoff Fee Per Stop</label><input type="number" value={adminAreaForm.dropoff_charge} onChange={(e) => setAdminAreaForm((p) => ({ ...p, dropoff_charge: e.target.value }))} placeholder="5.00" className="theme-input w-full rounded-xl border px-3 py-2 text-xs" /></div>
                <div><label className="mb-1 block text-xs font-semibold text-text-muted">Currency</label><input value={adminAreaForm.currency} onChange={(e) => setAdminAreaForm((p) => ({ ...p, currency: e.target.value }))} placeholder="AED" className="theme-input w-full rounded-xl border px-3 py-2 text-xs" /></div>
                <div><label className="mb-1 block text-xs font-semibold text-text-muted">Min Delivery Days</label><input type="number" value={adminAreaForm.delivery_days_min} onChange={(e) => setAdminAreaForm((p) => ({ ...p, delivery_days_min: e.target.value }))} placeholder="1" className="theme-input w-full rounded-xl border px-3 py-2 text-xs" /></div>
                <div><label className="mb-1 block text-xs font-semibold text-text-muted">Max Delivery Days</label><input type="number" value={adminAreaForm.delivery_days_max} onChange={(e) => setAdminAreaForm((p) => ({ ...p, delivery_days_max: e.target.value }))} placeholder="3" className="theme-input w-full rounded-xl border px-3 py-2 text-xs" /></div>
              </div>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <label className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-semibold text-text-muted cursor-pointer"><input type="checkbox" checked={adminAreaForm.is_active} onChange={(e) => setAdminAreaForm((p) => ({ ...p, is_active: e.target.checked }))} className="rounded" /> Active</label>
              </div>
              <div className="flex gap-2">
                <button onClick={handleAdminSaveArea} disabled={areaFormSaving || !adminAreaForm.partner_id || !adminAreaForm.country_code} className="theme-btn-primary inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-xl px-4 py-2 text-xs font-semibold disabled:opacity-50">{areaFormSaving ? "Saving..." : editingAreaId ? "Update Area" : "Create Area"}</button>
                <button onClick={() => { setShowAreaForm(false); setEditingAreaId(null); setAdminAreaForm(BLANK_AREA_FORM); setAreaFormError(""); }} className="rounded-xl border border-border px-4 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-text-muted hover:text-text">Cancel</button>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          <div className="grid gap-4 xl:grid-cols-[1.15fr_0.85fr]">
            <div className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface-2 p-4">
              <div>
                <p className="text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.16em] text-text-faint">Coverage and Route Board</p>
                <h3 className="mt-1 text-sm font-bold text-text">Approved and pending coverage on one map</h3>
                <p className="mt-1 text-[11px] text-text-muted">Service-area points and route rows are projected from stored coordinates so admins can review coverage and missing map data in one place.</p>
              </div>

              {coverageBoardBounds ? (
                <div className="mt-4 rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface p-3">
                  <svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" className="h-72 w-full rounded-lg bg-[radial-gradient(circle_at_top,rgba(14,165,233,0.18),transparent_42%),linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(15,23,42,0.04),rgba(15,23,42,0.12))]">
                    <defs>
                      <pattern id="coverage-grid" width="12" height="12" patternUnits="userSpaceOnUse">
                        <path d="M 12 0 L 0 0 0 12" fill="none" stroke="rgba(148,163,184,0.22)" strokeWidth="0.4" />
                      </pattern>
                    </defs>
                    <rect x="0" y="0" width="100" height="100" fill="url(#coverage-grid)" rx="4" />
                    {routeReviewRows.filter((route) => route.origin && route.destination).map((route) => {
                      const x1 = 8 + (((route.origin?.longitude ?? 0) - coverageBoardBounds.minLng) / coverageBoardBounds.lngSpan) * 84;
                      const y1 = 8 + (1 - (((route.origin?.latitude ?? 0) - coverageBoardBounds.minLat) / coverageBoardBounds.latSpan)) * 78;
                      const x2 = 8 + (((route.destination?.longitude ?? 0) - coverageBoardBounds.minLng) / coverageBoardBounds.lngSpan) * 84;
                      const y2 = 8 + (1 - (((route.destination?.latitude ?? 0) - coverageBoardBounds.minLat) / coverageBoardBounds.latSpan)) * 78;
                      return <line key={route.id} x1={x1} y1={y1} x2={x2} y2={y2} stroke="rgba(14,165,233,0.55)" strokeWidth="1.6" strokeDasharray="2.5 1.5" />;
                    })}
                    {mappedServiceAreas.map((point) => {
                      const cx = 8 + ((point.longitude - coverageBoardBounds.minLng) / coverageBoardBounds.lngSpan) * 84;
                      const cy = 8 + (1 - ((point.latitude - coverageBoardBounds.minLat) / coverageBoardBounds.latSpan)) * 78;
                      const fill = point.approvalStatus === "approved" ? "rgba(34,197,94,0.95)" : point.approvalStatus === "rejected" ? "rgba(239,68,68,0.95)" : "rgba(245,158,11,0.95)";
                      return (
                        <g key={point.key}>
                          <circle cx={cx} cy={cy} r="2.7" fill={fill} stroke="rgba(255,255,255,0.92)" strokeWidth="0.8" />
                          <text x={cx + 2.8} y={cy - 2.5} fontSize="3.3" fill="rgba(15,23,42,0.82)">{point.label}</text>
                        </g>
                      );
                    })}
                  </svg>
                </div>
              ) : (
                <div className="mt-4 rounded-xl border border-dashed border-border px-4 py-10 text-center text-xs text-text-muted">No route or service-area coordinates are ready to project yet. Add latitude and longitude to start the coverage board.</div>
              )}
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-4">
