```text
                  <select value={adminVehRuleForm.route_scope} onChange={(e) => setAdminVehRuleForm((p) => ({ ...p, route_scope: e.target.value }))} className="theme-input w-full rounded-xl border px-3 py-2 text-xs">
                    <option value="any">Any</option>
                    <option value="in_city">In City</option>
                    <option value="inter_city">Inter City</option>
                  </select>
                </div>
                <div><label className="mb-1 block text-xs font-semibold text-text-muted">Weight Ceiling (kg)</label><input type="number" value={adminVehRuleForm.max_weight_kg} onChange={(e) => setAdminVehRuleForm((p) => ({ ...p, max_weight_kg: e.target.value }))} placeholder="30" className="theme-input w-full rounded-xl border px-3 py-2 text-xs" /></div>
                <div><label className="mb-1 block text-xs font-semibold text-text-muted">Volume Ceiling (cm³)</label><input type="number" value={adminVehRuleForm.max_volume_cm3} onChange={(e) => setAdminVehRuleForm((p) => ({ ...p, max_volume_cm3: e.target.value }))} placeholder="50000" className="theme-input w-full rounded-xl border px-3 py-2 text-xs" /></div>
                <div><label className="mb-1 block text-xs font-semibold text-text-muted">Legacy Snapshot Multiplier</label><input type="number" value={adminVehRuleForm.cost_multiplier} onChange={(e) => setAdminVehRuleForm((p) => ({ ...p, cost_multiplier: e.target.value }))} placeholder="1.0" className="theme-input w-full rounded-xl border px-3 py-2 text-xs" /></div>
                <div><label className="mb-1 block text-xs font-semibold text-text-muted">Priority Rank</label><input type="number" value={adminVehRuleForm.priority_rank} onChange={(e) => setAdminVehRuleForm((p) => ({ ...p, priority_rank: e.target.value }))} placeholder="100" className="theme-input w-full rounded-xl border px-3 py-2 text-xs" /></div>
              </div>
              <p className="text-[11px] text-text-muted">Keep the legacy multiplier at 1.0 for new rules. The simplified delivery story is weight-first; this field only exists for older runtime compatibility and frozen acceptance snapshots.</p>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <label className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-semibold text-text-muted cursor-pointer"><input type="checkbox" checked={adminVehRuleForm.is_active} onChange={(e) => setAdminVehRuleForm((p) => ({ ...p, is_active: e.target.checked }))} className="rounded" /> Active</label>
              </div>
              <div className="flex gap-2">
                <button onClick={handleAdminSaveVehRule} disabled={vehRuleFormSaving || !adminVehRuleForm.partner_id || !adminVehRuleForm.vehicle_type} className="theme-btn-primary inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-xl px-4 py-2 text-xs font-semibold disabled:opacity-50">{vehRuleFormSaving ? "Saving..." : editingVehRuleId ? "Update Load-fit Rule" : "Create Load-fit Rule"}</button>
                <button onClick={() => { setShowVehRuleForm(false); setEditingVehRuleId(null); setAdminVehRuleForm(BLANK_VEH_RULE_FORM); setVehRuleFormError(""); }} className="rounded-xl border border-border px-4 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-text-muted hover:text-text">Cancel</button>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          <div className="theme-card rounded-xl border p-3">
            <EnterpriseDataTable
              columns={vehicleRuleColumns}
              rows={filteredVehicleRules}
              rowKey={(rule) => rule.id}
              densityMode={density}
              searchPlaceholder="Search load-fit rules by partner, scope, or limit"
              emptyState="No load-fit rules found for the current filter."
              expandedRowKey={expandedVehicleRuleId ?? undefined}
              rowActions={(rule) => {
                const isExpanded = expandedVehicleRuleId === rule.id;
                return (
                  <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2 justify-end">
                    <button type="button" onClick={() => setExpandedVehicleRuleId(isExpanded ? null : rule.id)} className="rounded-md border border-border bg-surface px-2 py-1 text-[11px] font-semibold text-text-muted hover:border-primary/30 hover:text-primary">{isExpanded ? "Hide details" : "Details"}</button>
                    <button type="button" onClick={() => openVehicleRuleEditor(rule)} className="theme-chip-info rounded-lg px-2.5 py-1 text-[10px] font-semibold">Edit</button>
                    <button type="button" onClick={() => handleReviewVehicleRule(rule.id, "approved")} disabled={reviewingKey !== null} className="theme-chip-success rounded-lg px-2.5 py-1 text-[10px] font-semibold disabled:opacity-50">Approve</button>
                    <button type="button" onClick={() => handleReviewVehicleRule(rule.id, "rejected")} disabled={reviewingKey !== null} className="theme-chip-danger rounded-lg px-2.5 py-1 text-[10px] font-semibold disabled:opacity-50">Reject Rule</button>
                    <button type="button" onClick={() => void handleAdminDeleteVehRule(rule.id)} className="theme-chip-muted rounded-lg px-2.5 py-1 text-[10px] font-semibold hover:theme-chip-danger">Delete</button>
                  </div>
                );
              }}
              expandedRowRenderer={(rule) => (
                <div className="p-4 text-xs text-text-muted">
                  <p className="font-semibold text-text">Load-fit Rule Details</p>
                  <p className="mt-1">{rule.route_scope.replace(/_/g, " ")}{rule.max_weight_kg != null ? ` · up to ${rule.max_weight_kg}kg` : ""}{rule.max_volume_cm3 != null ? ` · up to ${rule.max_volume_cm3}cm3` : ""}{` · legacy x${rule.cost_multiplier} · priority ${rule.priority_rank}`}</p>
                  <p className="mt-1">{rule.review_note || "Awaiting admin review."}</p>
                </div>
              )}
            />
          </div>
        </div>
        ) : null}

        {isWorkspaceVisible("distance") ? (
      <div id="admin-distance-matrix" className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface p-4">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
          <div>
            <h2 className="text-base font-bold text-text">City Distance Matrix</h2>
            <p className="text-xs text-text-muted">Admin-only route row table for inter-city pricing. These rows stay visible inside the same flat review board as the rest of the rate card.</p>
          </div>
          <button
            onClick={() => void fetchCityDistances()}
            disabled={distancesLoading}
            className="rounded-xl border border-border px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-text-muted hover:text-text disabled:opacity-50"
          >
            {distancesLoading ? "Refreshing..." : "Refresh matrix"}
          </button>
        </div>

          <div className="mt-4 space-y-4">
            {distanceActionError ? <p className="text-xs font-medium text-danger">{distanceActionError}</p> : null}

            {/* Entry form */}
            <div className="grid gap-3 md:grid-cols-3">
              {([
                ["Origin country code", "origin_country_code"],
                ["Origin city", "origin_city_name"],
                ["Dest country code", "destination_country_code"],
                ["Dest city", "destination_city_name"],
                ["Distance (km)", "distance_km"],
                ["Notes", "notes"],
              ] as [string, keyof typeof distanceForm][]).map(([label, field]) => (
                <div key={field}>
                  <label className="mb-1 block text-xs font-semibold text-text-muted">{label}</label>
                  <input
                    value={distanceForm[field]}
                    onChange={(e) => setDistanceForm((prev) => ({ ...prev, [field]: field === "origin_country_code" || field === "destination_country_code" ? e.target.value.toUpperCase() : e.target.value }))}
                    className="theme-input w-full rounded-xl border px-3 py-2 text-xs"
                  />
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
            <div className="flex gap-2">
              <button
                onClick={handleSaveDistance}
                disabled={distanceSaving}
                className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-xl theme-btn-primary px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold disabled:opacity-50"
              >
                {distanceSaving ? <RefreshCw className="h-3.5 w-3.5 animate-spin" /> : <Plus className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />}
                {editingDistanceId ? "Update entry" : "Add entry"}
              </button>
              {editingDistanceId ? (
                <button
                  onClick={resetDistanceEditor}
                  className="rounded-xl border border-border px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-text-muted hover:text-text"
                >
                  Cancel edit
                </button>
              ) : null}
            </div>

            {/* Distance list */}
            {distancesLoading ? (
              <div className="space-y-2">{Array.from({ length: 3 }).map((_, i) => <div key={i} className="h-10 animate-pulse rounded-xl bg-surface-2" />)}</div>
            ) : (
              <div className="theme-card rounded-xl border p-3">
                <EnterpriseDataTable
                  columns={distanceColumns}
                  rows={filteredCityDistances}
                  rowKey={(entry) => entry.id}
                  densityMode={density}
                  searchPlaceholder="Search distance rows by origin, destination, or notes"
                  emptyState="No distance entries yet."
                  expandedRowKey={expandedDistanceId ?? undefined}
                  rowActions={(entry) => {
                    const isExpanded = expandedDistanceId === entry.id;
                    return (
                      <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2 justify-end">
                        <button type="button" onClick={() => setExpandedDistanceId(isExpanded ? null : entry.id)} className="rounded-md border border-border bg-surface px-2 py-1 text-[11px] font-semibold text-text-muted hover:border-primary/30 hover:text-primary">{isExpanded ? "Hide details" : "Details"}</button>
                        <button type="button" onClick={() => openDistanceEditor(entry)} className="rounded-lg border border-border px-2 py-1 text-[10px] font-semibold text-text-muted hover:text-text">Edit</button>
                        <button type="button" onClick={() => void handleDeleteDistance(entry.id)} className="rounded-lg border border-danger/30 px-2 py-1 text-[10px] font-semibold text-danger">Delete</button>
                      </div>
                    );
                  }}
                  expandedRowRenderer={(entry) => (
                    <div className="p-4 text-xs text-text-muted">
                      <p className="font-semibold text-text">Distance Matrix Details</p>
                      <p className="mt-1">{entry.origin_country_code} / {entry.origin_city_name} → {entry.destination_country_code} / {entry.destination_city_name}</p>
                      <p className="mt-1">{entry.distance_km} km{entry.notes ? ` · ${entry.notes}` : ""}</p>
                    </div>
                  )}
                />
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
      </div>
        ) : null}
      </div>
      </>
  );
}
```

### `frontend\web_app\src\app\admin\logistics\page.tsx`

```text
﻿"use client";

"use client";

import { Suspense, useEffect } from "react";
import { useRouter, useSearchParams } from "next/navigation";
import { Layers3, Network } from "@/lib/icons";
import AdminLayout from "@/components/AdminLayout";
import { PanelContent, PanelLoadingState, PanelTabs } from "@/components/PanelPage";
import { useAuth } from "@/lib/useAuth";
import { isAdminStaffRole } from "@shared/adminPermissions";
import LogisticsPartnersPanel from "./LogisticsPartnersPanel";

const SECTIONS = [
  { key: "partners", label: "Coverage & Routes", icon: Network },
  { key: "pricing", label: "Cost Drivers", icon: Layers3 },
] as const;

type Section = (typeof SECTIONS)[number]["key"];

function LogisticsHubInner() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const searchParams = useSearchParams();
  const { user, isLoggedIn, isLoading } = useAuth();
  const requestedSection = searchParams.get("section");
  const section = (SECTIONS.some((item) => item.key === requestedSection) ? requestedSection : "partners") as Section;

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isLoading && (!isLoggedIn || !isAdminStaffRole(user?.role))) {
      router.replace("/admin/login");
    }
  }, [isLoading, isLoggedIn, router, user?.role]);

  if (isLoading) {
    return (
      <AdminLayout title="Logistics" headerMode="compact">
        <PanelLoadingState count={4} blockClassName="h-24 rounded-2xl bg-surface-2 animate-pulse" />
      </AdminLayout>
    );
  }

  if (!isLoggedIn || !isAdminStaffRole(user?.role)) {
    return null;
  }

  return (
    <AdminLayout title="Logistics" headerMode="compact">
      <PanelContent width="full" className="space-y-3">
        <div className="theme-card rounded-xl border p-2">
          <PanelTabs
            items={SECTIONS}
            value={section}
            onChange={(nextSection) => router.replace(`/admin/logistics?section=${nextSection}`, { scroll: false })}
            className="border-0 bg-transparent p-0"
          />
        </div>

        <section className="theme-card rounded-xl border p-3">
          <p className="text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.16em] text-text-faint">Logistics Admin Cycle</p>
          <h2 className="mt-1 text-sm font-bold text-text">Coverage first, one simple charge model second</h2>
          <p className="mt-1 text-[11px] text-text-muted">Approve mapped service areas and route rows first, then manage one customer-charge story: base fee, weight, distance when needed, extra stops, and the highest approved handling fee. Vehicle fit stays operational only.</p>
        </section>

        {section === "partners" ? <LogisticsPartnersPanel key="partners-scope" scope="partners" /> : null}
        {section === "pricing" ? <LogisticsPartnersPanel key="cost-drivers-scope" scope="pricing" /> : null}
      </PanelContent>
    </AdminLayout>
  );
}

export default function LogisticsHubPage() {
  return (
    <Suspense>
      <LogisticsHubInner />
    </Suspense>
  );
}
```

```text
﻿"use client";

import { useEffect } from "react";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { useAuth } from "@/lib/useAuth";
import { isAdminStaffRole } from "@shared/adminPermissions";
import AdminLayout from "@/components/AdminLayout";
import { PanelContent, PanelLoadingState } from "@/components/PanelPage";

export default function AdminModerationPage() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const { user, isLoggedIn, isLoading } = useAuth();
  const role = user?.role ?? null;

  useEffect(() => {

    if (!isLoggedIn || !isAdminStaffRole(role)) {

  if (isLoading || !isLoggedIn || !isAdminStaffRole(role)) {

      <AdminLayout title="Moderation">
        <PanelLoadingState count={3} />
      </AdminLayout>

  }

  return (
    <AdminLayout title="Moderation">
      <PanelContent className="space-y-4">
        <ModerationTab />
      </PanelContent>
    </AdminLayout>
  );
}
```

### `frontend\web_app\src\app\admin\orders\BarcodePanel.tsx`

```text
﻿"use client";

import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import {
  Camera, ScanLine, Keyboard, RefreshCw, CheckCircle,
  XCircle, Package, Truck, MapPin, AlertCircle,
} from "@/lib/icons";
import { PanelContent } from "@/components/PanelPage";
import { apiFetch } from "@/lib/api";

interface ShipmentInfo {
  id: number;
  order_id: number;
  status: string;
  carrier_name?: string | null;
  tracking_number?: string | null;
  distribution_channel?: string | null;
  current_hub?: string | null;
  shipping_address?: string | null;
  created_at?: string;
  updated_at?: string;
}

const STATUS_CHIP: Record<string, string> = {
  pending: "theme-chip-warning",
  picked: "theme-chip-info",
  in_transit: "theme-chip-brand",
  delivered: "theme-chip-success",
  returned: "theme-chip-danger",
  failed: "theme-chip-danger",
};

export default function BarcodePanel() {
  const videoRef = useRef<HTMLVideoElement>(null);
  const canvasRef = useRef<HTMLCanvasElement>(null);
  const streamRef = useRef<MediaStream | null>(null);
  const scanIntervalRef = useRef<number | null>(null);
  const zxingReaderRef = useRef<any>(null);

  const [mode, setMode] = useState<"camera" | "manual">("manual");
  const [cameraActive, setCameraActive] = useState(false);
  const [cameraError, setCameraError] = useState("");
  const [manualCode, setManualCode] = useState("");
  const [scanning, setScanning] = useState(false);

  const [shipment, setShipment] = useState<ShipmentInfo | null>(null);
  const [lookupError, setLookupError] = useState("");
  const [scannedCode, setScannedCode] = useState("");
  const [newStatus, setNewStatus] = useState("");
  const [eventNote, setEventNote] = useState("");
  const [updating, setUpdating] = useState(false);
  const [updateSuccess, setUpdateSuccess] = useState(false);

  const stopCamera = useCallback(() => {
    if (scanIntervalRef.current) {
      clearInterval(scanIntervalRef.current);
      scanIntervalRef.current = null;
    }
    if (zxingReaderRef.current) {
      try { zxingReaderRef.current.reset(); } catch {}
      zxingReaderRef.current = null;
    }
    if (streamRef.current) {
      streamRef.current.getTracks().forEach((t) => t.stop());
      streamRef.current = null;
    }
    setCameraActive(false);
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    return () => stopCamera();
  }, [stopCamera]);

  const startCamera = async () => {
    setCameraError("");
    try {
      const stream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({
        video: { facingMode: "environment" },
      });
      streamRef.current = stream;
      if (videoRef.current) {
        videoRef.current.srcObject = stream;
        videoRef.current.play();
      }
      setCameraActive(true);

      if ("BarcodeDetector" in window) {
        const detector = new (window as any).BarcodeDetector({
          formats: ["qr_code", "code_128", "ean_13", "ean_8", "code_39", "upc_a", "upc_e"],
        });
        scanIntervalRef.current = window.setInterval(async () => {
          if (!videoRef.current || videoRef.current.readyState < 2) return;
          try {
            const barcodes = await detector.detect(videoRef.current);
            if (barcodes.length > 0) {
              const code = barcodes[0].rawValue as string;
              stopCamera();
              await lookupShipment(code);
            }
          } catch {}
        }, 500);
      } else {
        try {
          const { BrowserMultiFormatReader } = await import("@zxing/library");
          const reader = new BrowserMultiFormatReader();
          zxingReaderRef.current = reader;

          (reader as any).decodeFromVideoElement(videoRef.current!, (result: any, _err: unknown) => {
            if (result) {
              const code = result.getText();
              stopCamera();
              lookupShipment(code);
            }
          });
        } catch {
          setCameraError(
            "Barcode detection is not supported in this browser. Please enter the code manually."
          );
        }
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      setCameraError(err?.message || "Camera access denied or not available");
    }
  };

  const lookupShipment = async (code: string) => {
    if (!code.trim()) return;
    setScanning(true);
    setLookupError("");
    setShipment(null);
    setUpdateSuccess(false);
    const trimmed = code.trim();
    setScannedCode(trimmed);

    try {
      let res = await apiFetch(`/logistics/shipments/scan?code=${encodeURIComponent(trimmed)}`);
      if (!res.ok && !isNaN(Number(trimmed))) {
        res = await apiFetch(`/logistics/shipments/${trimmed}`);
      }
      if (res.ok) {
        const data = await res.json();
        setShipment(data);
        setNewStatus(data.status);
      } else {
        setLookupError(`No shipment found for code "${trimmed}"`);
      }
    } catch { setLookupError("Network error looking up shipment"); }
    setScanning(false);
  };

  const handleManualLookup = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    await lookupShipment(manualCode);
  };

  const handleUpdateStatus = async () => {
    if (!shipment) return;
    setUpdating(true);
    setUpdateSuccess(false);
    try {
      const res = await apiFetch(`/logistics/shipments/${shipment.id}/status`, {
        method: "PUT",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          status: newStatus,
          note: eventNote || `Scanned: ${scannedCode}`,
        }),
      });
      if (res.ok) {
        const updated = await res.json();
        setShipment((prev) => prev ? { ...prev, ...updated } : updated);
        setUpdateSuccess(true);
        setEventNote("");
      }
    } catch {}
    setUpdating(false);
  };

  return (
    <PanelContent width="medium" className="py-3 sm:py-4">

      {/* Mode toggle */}
      <div className="theme-card rounded-xl border p-1 flex gap-1 w-fit">
        <button onClick={() => { setMode("camera"); stopCamera(); }}
          className={`flex items-center gap-2 rounded-xl px-4 py-2 text-xs font-semibold transition-colors ${mode === "camera" ? "theme-btn-primary" : "text-text-muted hover:text-text"}`}>
          <Camera className="w-4 h-4" /> Camera
        </button>
        <button onClick={() => { setMode("manual"); stopCamera(); }}
          className={`flex items-center gap-2 rounded-xl px-4 py-2 text-xs font-semibold transition-colors ${mode === "manual" ? "theme-btn-primary" : "text-text-muted hover:text-text"}`}>
          <Keyboard className="w-4 h-4" /> Manual
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* Camera mode */}
      {mode === "camera" && (
        <div className="theme-card rounded-xl border p-5 space-y-4">
          <div className="relative rounded-xl overflow-hidden bg-black aspect-video max-h-72">
            <video ref={videoRef} className="w-full h-full object-cover" playsInline muted />
            {!cameraActive && (
              <div className="absolute inset-0 flex items-center justify-center">
                <Camera className="w-12 h-12 text-white/30" />
              </div>
            )}
            {cameraActive && (
              <div className="absolute inset-0 flex items-center justify-center pointer-events-none">
                <div className="w-48 h-28 border-2 border-primary rounded-xl opacity-80 animate-pulse" />
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
          <canvas ref={canvasRef} className="hidden" />

          {cameraError && (
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs text-warning">
              <AlertCircle className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0" />
              {cameraError}
            </div>
          )}

          <div className="flex gap-3">
            {!cameraActive ? (
              <button onClick={startCamera}
                className="theme-btn-primary rounded-xl px-5 py-2.5 text-xs font-semibold flex items-center gap-2">
                <Camera className="w-4 h-4" /> Start Camera
              </button>
            ) : (
              <button onClick={stopCamera}
                className="theme-btn-secondary rounded-xl px-5 py-2.5 text-xs font-semibold">
                Stop Camera
              </button>
            )}
          </div>

          <form onSubmit={handleManualLookup} className="flex gap-2 mt-2">
            <input
              value={manualCode}
              onChange={(e) => setManualCode(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="Or type / paste code here"
              className="theme-input flex-1 rounded-xl border px-3 py-2 text-xs"
            />
            <button type="submit" disabled={scanning || !manualCode}
              className="theme-btn-accent rounded-xl px-4 py-2 text-xs font-semibold disabled:opacity-50 flex items-center gap-2">
              {scanning ? <RefreshCw className="w-4 h-4 animate-spin" /> : "Lookup"}
            </button>
          </form>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Manual mode */}
      {mode === "manual" && (
        <div className="theme-card rounded-xl border p-5">
          <h3 className="text-xs font-bold text-text mb-3">Enter Barcode / Tracking Number</h3>
          <form onSubmit={handleManualLookup} className="flex gap-3">
            <input
              value={manualCode}
              onChange={(e) => setManualCode(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="e.g. TRK-0000123 or scan code"
              className="theme-input flex-1 rounded-xl border px-3 py-2.5 text-xs"
              autoFocus
            />
            <button type="submit" disabled={scanning || !manualCode}
              className="theme-btn-primary rounded-xl px-5 py-2.5 text-xs font-semibold disabled:opacity-50 flex items-center gap-2">
              {scanning ? <><RefreshCw className="w-4 h-4 animate-spin" />Scanning…</> : <><ScanLine className="w-4 h-4" />Lookup</>}
            </button>
          </form>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Lookup error */}
      {lookupError && (
        <div className="theme-alert-danger flex items-center gap-2 rounded-xl p-4 text-xs">
          <XCircle className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0" />
          {lookupError}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Shipment result */}
      {shipment && (
        <div className="theme-card rounded-xl border p-5 space-y-5">
          <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3">
            <div>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-1">
                <Package className="w-5 h-5 theme-status-info" />
                <h3 className="text-base font-bold text-text">Shipment #{shipment.id}</h3>
                <span className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-semibold ${STATUS_CHIP[shipment.status] ?? "theme-chip-muted"}`}>
                  {shipment.status.replace(/_/g, " ")}
                </span>
              </div>
              <p className="text-xs text-text-muted">Order #{shipment.order_id}</p>
            </div>
            {updateSuccess && (
              <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-success text-xs font-semibold">
                <CheckCircle className="w-4 h-4" />Updated
              </div>
            )}
          </div>

          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3 text-xs">
            {[
              { label: "Carrier", value: shipment.carrier_name },
              { label: "Tracking #", value: shipment.tracking_number },
              { label: "Channel", value: shipment.distribution_channel?.replace(/_/g, " ") },
              { label: "Current Hub", value: shipment.current_hub },
            ].map(({ label, value }) => (
              <div key={label} className="rounded-xl bg-surface-2 px-4 py-3">
                <p className="text-xs text-text-muted">{label}</p>
                <p className="text-xs font-semibold text-text mt-0.5">{value || "—"}</p>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>

          {shipment.shipping_address && (
            <div className="flex items-start gap-2 rounded-xl bg-surface-2 px-4 py-3 text-xs">
              <MapPin className="w-4 h-4 text-text-muted shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
              <p className="text-text">{shipment.shipping_address}</p>
            </div>
          )}

          <div className="border-t border-border pt-4 space-y-3">
            <h3 className="text-xs font-bold text-text flex items-center gap-2">
              <Truck className="w-4 h-4" />Update Status
            </h3>
            <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
              {["pending", "picked", "in_transit", "delivered", "returned", "failed"].map((s) => (
                <button key={s} onClick={() => setNewStatus(s)}
                  className={`rounded-xl px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold border transition-colors ${
                    newStatus === s ? STATUS_CHIP[s] ?? "theme-chip-info" : "border-border text-text-muted hover:text-text"
                  }`}>
                  {s.replace(/_/g, " ")}
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>
            <input
              value={eventNote}
              onChange={(e) => setEventNote(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="Event note (optional, e.g. Scanned at Dubai Hub)"
              className="theme-input w-full rounded-xl border px-3 py-2 text-xs"
            />
            <button
              onClick={handleUpdateStatus}
              disabled={updating || newStatus === shipment.status}
              className="theme-btn-primary rounded-xl px-5 py-2.5 text-xs font-semibold disabled:opacity-50 flex items-center gap-2"
            >
              {updating ? <RefreshCw className="w-4 h-4 animate-spin" /> : <CheckCircle className="w-4 h-4" />}
              Confirm Update
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </PanelContent>
  );
}
```

```text
﻿"use client";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { motion } from "framer-motion";
import { Search, RefreshCw, CheckCircle, XCircle, PackageCheck } from "@/lib/icons";
import BulkActionBar from "@/components/BulkActionBar";
import { apiFetch } from "@/lib/api";
import { useAuth } from "@/lib/useAuth";
import { canAccessAdminReturnsManagement } from "@shared/adminPermissions";
import { RETURN_STATUS_CHIP } from "@shared/statusColors";

interface ReturnRequest {
  id: number;
  order_id: number;
  user_id: number;
  reason: string;
  status: "pending" | "approved" | "rejected" | "completed";
  resolution_notes?: string;
  created_at: string;
  resolved_at?: string;
}

const STATUS_COLORS = RETURN_STATUS_CHIP;
const PAGE_SIZE = 20;

export default function ReturnsPanel() {
  const { user, isLoggedIn } = useAuth();
  const [returns, setReturns] = useState<ReturnRequest[]>([]);
  const [search, setSearch] = useState("");
  const [statusFilter, setStatusFilter] = useState("all");
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [page, setPage] = useState(1);
  const [actionLoadingId, setActionLoadingId] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [notesInput, setNotesInput] = useState<Record<number, string>>({});
  const [selectedReturnIds, setSelectedReturnIds] = useState<Set<number>>(new Set());
  const [bulkLoading, setBulkLoading] = useState(false);
  const [bulkNotes, setBulkNotes] = useState("");

  const fetchReturns = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const res = await apiFetch("/returns/");
      if (res.ok) {
        const data = await res.json();
        const items = Array.isArray(data) ? data : [];
        setReturns(items);
        setSelectedReturnIds((prev) => {
          const next = new Set<number>();
          const validIds = new Set(items.map((item) => item.id));
          prev.forEach((id) => {
            if (validIds.has(id)) next.add(id);
          });
          return next;
        });
      }
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isLoggedIn && canAccessAdminReturnsManagement(user?.role)) fetchReturns();
  }, [isLoggedIn, user?.role]);

  if (!isLoggedIn || !canAccessAdminReturnsManagement(user?.role)) {
    return null;
  }

  const updateStatus = async (ret: ReturnRequest, newStatus: string) => {
    setActionLoadingId(ret.id);
    try {
      const res = await apiFetch(`/returns/${ret.id}`, {
        method: "PUT",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          status: newStatus,
          resolution_notes: notesInput[ret.id] || ret.resolution_notes || "",
        }),
      });
      if (res.ok) {
        setReturns((prev) =>
          prev.map((r) =>
            r.id === ret.id ? { ...r, status: newStatus as ReturnRequest["status"] } : r
          )
        );
      }
    } finally {
      setActionLoadingId(null);
    }
  };

  const toggleReturnSelection = (returnId: number) => {
    setSelectedReturnIds((prev) => {
      const next = new Set(prev);
      if (next.has(returnId)) next.delete(returnId);
      else next.add(returnId);
      return next;
    });
  };

  const filtered = returns.filter((r) => {
    const matchesSearch =
      !search ||
      String(r.id).includes(search) ||
      String(r.order_id).includes(search) ||
      r.reason.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase());
    const matchesStatus = statusFilter === "all" || r.status === statusFilter;
    return matchesSearch && matchesStatus;
  });

  const totalPages = Math.ceil(filtered.length / PAGE_SIZE);
  const paginated = filtered.slice((page - 1) * PAGE_SIZE, page * PAGE_SIZE);
  const allVisibleSelected = paginated.length > 0 && paginated.every((ret) => selectedReturnIds.has(ret.id));

  const toggleSelectVisible = () => {
    setSelectedReturnIds((prev) => {
      const next = new Set(prev);
      if (allVisibleSelected) paginated.forEach((ret) => next.delete(ret.id));
      else paginated.forEach((ret) => next.add(ret.id));
      return next;
    });
  };

  const bulkUpdateStatus = async (status: ReturnRequest["status"]) => {
    const ids = Array.from(selectedReturnIds);
    if (!ids.length) return;

    setBulkLoading(true);
    try {
      const res = await apiFetch("/returns/bulk", {
        method: "PUT",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          return_ids: ids,
          status,
          resolution_notes: bulkNotes.trim() || undefined,
        }),
      });
      if (res.ok) {
        await fetchReturns();
        setSelectedReturnIds(new Set());
        setBulkNotes("");
      }
    } finally {
      setBulkLoading(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="p-6 space-y-6">
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-start sm:items-center justify-between gap-4">
        <div>
          <h2 className="text-xl font-bold text-text-primary">Return Requests</h2>
          <p className="text-text-muted text-xs mt-1">
            Manage customer return and refund requests
          </p>
        </div>
        <button
          onClick={fetchReturns}
          className="flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2 rounded-lg theme-btn-primary text-xs"
        >
          <RefreshCw className="w-4 h-4" />
          Refresh
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* Filters */}
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row gap-3">
        <div className="relative flex-1">
          <Search className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 w-4 h-4 text-text-muted" />
          <input
            type="text"
            placeholder="Search by return ID, order ID or reason…"
            value={search}
            onChange={(e) => { setSearch(e.target.value); setPage(1); }}
            className="w-full pl-10 pr-4 py-2 rounded-lg bg-surface-2 border border-border text-text-primary text-xs focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary/30"
          />
        </div>
        <select
          value={statusFilter}
          onChange={(e) => { setStatusFilter(e.target.value); setPage(1); }}
          className="px-3 py-2 rounded-lg bg-surface-2 border border-border text-text-primary text-xs focus:outline-none"
        >
          <option value="all">All statuses</option>
          <option value="pending">Pending</option>
          <option value="approved">Approved</option>
          <option value="rejected">Rejected</option>
          <option value="completed">Completed (refunded)</option>
        </select>
      </div>

      {/* Stats bar */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-4 gap-3">
        {["pending", "approved", "rejected", "completed"].map((s) => (
          <div key={s} className="theme-card rounded-xl border p-4 text-center">
            <div className="text-2xl font-bold text-text-primary">
              {returns.filter((r) => r.status === s).length}
            </div>
            <div className="text-xs text-text-muted capitalize mt-1">{s}</div>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>

      {/* Table */}
      {loading ? (
        <div className="text-center py-12 text-text-muted">Loading return requests…</div>
      ) : paginated.length === 0 ? (
        <div className="text-center py-12 text-text-muted">No return requests found.</div>
      ) : (
        <div className="theme-card overflow-x-auto rounded-xl border">
          <table className="w-full text-xs">
            <thead className="bg-surface-2 text-text-muted">
              <tr>
                <th className="px-4 py-3 text-left font-medium">
                  <input
                    type="checkbox"
                    aria-label="Select visible returns"
                    checked={allVisibleSelected}
                    onChange={toggleSelectVisible}
                    className="rounded border-border"
                  />
                </th>
                <th className="px-4 py-3 text-left font-medium">ID</th>
                <th className="px-4 py-3 text-left font-medium">Order</th>
                <th className="px-4 py-3 text-left font-medium">Reason</th>
                <th className="px-4 py-3 text-left font-medium">Status</th>
                <th className="px-4 py-3 text-left font-medium">Date</th>
                <th className="px-4 py-3 text-left font-medium">Notes</th>
                <th className="px-4 py-3 text-left font-medium">Actions</th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody className="divide-y divide-border">
              {paginated.map((ret) => (
                <motion.tr
                  key={ret.id}
                  initial={{ opacity: 0 }}
                  animate={{ opacity: 1 }}
                  className="bg-surface hover:bg-surface-2 transition-colors"
                >
                  <td className="px-4 py-3">
                    <input
                      type="checkbox"
                      aria-label={`Select return ${ret.id}`}
                      checked={selectedReturnIds.has(ret.id)}
                      onChange={() => toggleReturnSelection(ret.id)}
                      className="rounded border-border"
                    />
                  </td>
                  <td className="px-4 py-3 font-mono text-text-muted">#{ret.id}</td>
                  <td className="px-4 py-3 font-mono text-primary">#{ret.order_id}</td>
                  <td className="px-4 py-3 text-text-primary max-w-xs truncate" title={ret.reason}>
                    {ret.reason}
                  </td>
                  <td className="px-4 py-3">
                    <span className={`px-2 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-medium ${STATUS_COLORS[ret.status]}`}>
                      {ret.status}
                    </span>
                  </td>
                  <td className="px-4 py-3 text-text-muted whitespace-nowrap">
                    {new Date(ret.created_at).toLocaleDateString()}
                  </td>
                  <td className="px-4 py-3">
                    <input
                      type="text"
                      placeholder="Resolution notes…"
                      value={notesInput[ret.id] ?? ret.resolution_notes ?? ""}
                      onChange={(e) =>
                        setNotesInput((prev) => ({ ...prev, [ret.id]: e.target.value }))
                      }
                      className="w-40 px-2 py-1 text-xs rounded bg-surface-2 border border-border text-text-primary focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-primary/30"
                    />
                  </td>
                  <td className="px-4 py-3">
                    <div className="flex gap-2 flex-wrap">
                      {ret.status === "pending" && (
                        <>
                          <button
                            onClick={() => updateStatus(ret, "approved")}
                            disabled={actionLoadingId === ret.id}
                            className="flex items-center gap-1 px-2 py-1 text-xs rounded bg-info/10 text-info border border-info/20 hover:bg-info/20 transition-colors disabled:opacity-50"
                          >
                            <CheckCircle className="w-3 h-3" />
                            Approve
                          </button>
                          <button
                            onClick={() => updateStatus(ret, "rejected")}
                            disabled={actionLoadingId === ret.id}
                            className="flex items-center gap-1 px-2 py-1 text-xs rounded bg-danger/10 text-danger border border-danger/20 hover:bg-danger/20 transition-colors disabled:opacity-50"
                          >
                            <XCircle className="w-3 h-3" />
                            Reject
                          </button>
                        </>
                      )}
                      {ret.status === "approved" && (
                        <button
                          onClick={() => updateStatus(ret, "completed")}
                          disabled={actionLoadingId === ret.id}
                          className="flex items-center gap-1 px-2 py-1 text-xs rounded bg-success/10 text-success border border-success/20 hover:bg-success/20 transition-colors disabled:opacity-50"
                        >
                          <PackageCheck className="w-3 h-3" />
                          Complete &amp; Refund
                        </button>
                      )}
                      {["rejected", "completed"].includes(ret.status) && (
                        <span className="text-xs text-text-muted italic">
                          {ret.resolved_at
                            ? new Date(ret.resolved_at).toLocaleDateString()
                            : "Resolved"}
                        </span>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  </td>
                </motion.tr>
              ))}
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Pagination */}
      {totalPages > 1 && (
        <div className="flex justify-center gap-2">
          <button
            onClick={() => setPage((p) => Math.max(1, p - 1))}
            disabled={page === 1}
            className="px-3 py-1 text-xs rounded border border-border disabled:opacity-40 hover:bg-surface-2"
          >
            ← Prev
          </button>
          <span className="px-3 py-1 text-xs text-text-muted">
            {page} / {totalPages}
          </span>
          <button
            onClick={() => setPage((p) => Math.min(totalPages, p + 1))}
            disabled={page === totalPages}
            className="px-3 py-1 text-xs rounded border border-border disabled:opacity-40 hover:bg-surface-2"
          >
            Next →
          </button>
        </div>
      )}

      <BulkActionBar
        selectedCount={selectedReturnIds.size}
        onClearSelection={() => setSelectedReturnIds(new Set())}
        actions={[
          {
            label: "Approve Selected",
            onClick: () => bulkUpdateStatus("approved"),
            loading: bulkLoading,
            variant: "primary",
          },
          {
            label: "Reject Selected",
            onClick: () => bulkUpdateStatus("rejected"),
            loading: bulkLoading,
            variant: "warning",
          },
          {
            label: "Complete Selected",
            onClick: () => bulkUpdateStatus("completed"),
            loading: bulkLoading,
            variant: "success",
          },
        ]}
      >
        <input
          type="text"
          value={bulkNotes}
          onChange={(e) => setBulkNotes(e.target.value)}
          placeholder="Bulk notes"
          className="w-40 rounded-lg border border-border bg-surface-2 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs text-text-primary focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-primary/30"
        />
      </BulkActionBar>
    </div>
  );
}
```
