### `frontend\web_app\src\app\admin\products\VerificationPanel.tsx`

```text
﻿"use client";

import { useEffect, useState, useCallback } from "react";
import {
  ShieldCheck, RefreshCw, Plus, CheckCircle, XCircle,
  AlertCircle, Package, Truck, MapPin,
} from "@/lib/icons";
import BulkActionBar from "@/components/BulkActionBar";
import { PanelContent } from "@/components/PanelPage";
import { apiFetch } from "@/lib/api";
import { useAuth } from "@/lib/useAuth";
import { normalizePaginatedList } from "@shared/adminListUtils";
import { canAccessAdminProductVerification } from "@shared/adminPermissions";

interface ProductVerification {
  id: number;
  product_id?: number;
  order_id?: number;
  shipment_id?: number;
  verified_by?: number;
  verification_type: string;
  result: string;
  expected_specs?: Record<string, any> | null;
  actual_specs?: Record<string, any> | null;
  discrepancies?: string[] | null;
  scan_code?: string | null;
  notes?: string | null;
  image_urls?: string[] | null;
  created_at: string;
}

const TYPE_META: Record<string, { label: string; icon: typeof Package; chip: string }> = {
  supplier_dispatch: { label: "Supplier Dispatch", icon: Package, chip: "theme-chip-info" },
  logistics_receipt: { label: "Logistics Receipt", icon: Truck, chip: "theme-chip-brand" },
  customer_receipt: { label: "Customer Receipt", icon: MapPin, chip: "theme-chip-success" },
};

const RESULT_CHIP: Record<string, string> = {
  passed: "theme-chip-success",
  failed: "theme-chip-danger",
  partial: "theme-chip-warning",
};

const RESULT_ICON: Record<string, typeof CheckCircle> = {
  passed: CheckCircle,
  failed: XCircle,
  partial: AlertCircle,
};

const BLANK_FORM = {
  product_id: "",
  order_id: "",
  shipment_id: "",
  verification_type: "supplier_dispatch",
  result: "passed",
  scan_code: "",
  notes: "",
  expected_specs: "",
  actual_specs: "",
};

export default function VerificationPanel() {
  const { user, isLoggedIn, isLoading: authLoading } = useAuth();
  const [verifications, setVerifications] = useState<ProductVerification[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [typeFilter, setTypeFilter] = useState("");
  const [resultFilter, setResultFilter] = useState("");
  const [showForm, setShowForm] = useState(false);
  const [form, setForm] = useState(BLANK_FORM);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [saveError, setSaveError] = useState("");
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState<ProductVerification | null>(null);
  const [selectedVerificationIds, setSelectedVerificationIds] = useState<Set<number>>(new Set());
  const [bulkLoading, setBulkLoading] = useState(false);
  const [bulkNotes, setBulkNotes] = useState("");

  const fetchVerifications = useCallback(async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const params = new URLSearchParams();
      params.set("page", "1");
      params.set("page_size", "100");
      if (typeFilter) params.set("verification_type", typeFilter);
      if (resultFilter) params.set("result", resultFilter);
      const res = await apiFetch(`/product-verifications/?${params}`);
      if (res.ok) {
        const payload = normalizePaginatedList<ProductVerification>(await res.json(), ["items", "results", "data", "verifications"]);
        setVerifications(payload.items);
        setSelectedVerificationIds((prev) => {
          const next = new Set<number>();
          const validIds = new Set(payload.items.map((item) => item.id));
          prev.forEach((id) => {
            if (validIds.has(id)) next.add(id);
          });
          return next;
        });
      }
    } catch {}
    setLoading(false);
  }, [typeFilter, resultFilter]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isLoggedIn && canAccessAdminProductVerification(user?.role)) fetchVerifications();
  }, [fetchVerifications, isLoggedIn, user?.role]);

  const parseJsonSafe = (str: string): Record<string, any> | null => {
    if (!str.trim()) return null;
    try { return JSON.parse(str); } catch { return null; }
  };

  if (authLoading || !isLoggedIn || !canAccessAdminProductVerification(user?.role)) {
    return null;
  }

  const handleCreate = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setSaveError("");
    setSaving(true);
    try {
      const body: Record<string, any> = {
        verification_type: form.verification_type,
        result: form.result,
      };
      if (form.product_id) body.product_id = Number(form.product_id);
      if (form.order_id) body.order_id = Number(form.order_id);
      if (form.shipment_id) body.shipment_id = Number(form.shipment_id);
      if (form.scan_code) body.scan_code = form.scan_code.trim();
      if (form.notes) body.notes = form.notes.trim();
      const exp = parseJsonSafe(form.expected_specs);
      const act = parseJsonSafe(form.actual_specs);
      if (exp) body.expected_specs = exp;
      if (act) body.actual_specs = act;

      const res = await apiFetch("/product-verifications/", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify(body),
      });
      if (res.ok) {
        setForm(BLANK_FORM);
        setShowForm(false);
        await fetchVerifications();
      } else {
        const err = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
        setSaveError(err.detail || "Failed to create verification");
      }
    } catch { setSaveError("Network error"); }
    setSaving(false);
  };

  const toggleVerificationSelection = (verificationId: number) => {
    setSelectedVerificationIds((prev) => {
      const next = new Set(prev);
      if (next.has(verificationId)) next.delete(verificationId);
      else next.add(verificationId);
      return next;
    });
  };

  const allVisibleSelected = verifications.length > 0 && verifications.every((verification) => selectedVerificationIds.has(verification.id));

  const toggleSelectAllVisible = () => {
    setSelectedVerificationIds((prev) => {
      const next = new Set(prev);
      if (allVisibleSelected) verifications.forEach((verification) => next.delete(verification.id));
      else verifications.forEach((verification) => next.add(verification.id));
      return next;
    });
  };

  const bulkUpdateResult = async (result: "passed" | "failed" | "partial") => {
    const ids = Array.from(selectedVerificationIds);
    if (!ids.length) return;

    setBulkLoading(true);
    try {
      const res = await apiFetch("/product-verifications/bulk", {
        method: "PUT",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          verification_ids: ids,
          result,
          notes: bulkNotes.trim() || undefined,
        }),
      });
      if (res.ok) {
        await fetchVerifications();
        setSelectedVerificationIds(new Set());
        setBulkNotes("");
        if (selected && ids.includes(selected.id)) {
          setSelected((prev) => (prev ? { ...prev, result, notes: bulkNotes.trim() || prev.notes } : prev));
        }
      }
    } finally {
      setBulkLoading(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <PanelContent className="space-y-6 py-3 sm:py-4">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-2">
          <button onClick={() => setShowForm((s) => !s)}
            className="theme-btn-primary rounded-xl px-4 py-2 text-xs font-semibold flex items-center gap-2">
            <Plus className="w-4 h-4" />{showForm ? "Cancel" : "New Check"}
          </button>
          <button onClick={fetchVerifications} disabled={loading}
            className="flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface-2 px-3 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-text-muted hover:text-text disabled:opacity-50">
            <RefreshCw className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 ${loading ? "animate-spin" : ""}`} />
            Refresh
          </button>
      </div>

      {/* Create form */}
      {showForm && (
        <form onSubmit={handleCreate} className="theme-card rounded-xl border p-5 space-y-4">
          <h3 className="text-xs font-bold text-text">Record Verification</h3>
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs text-text-muted mb-1">Verification Type</label>
              <select value={form.verification_type} onChange={(e) => setForm((f) => ({ ...f, verification_type: e.target.value }))}
                className="theme-input w-full rounded-xl border px-3 py-2 text-xs">
                {Object.entries(TYPE_META).map(([val, { label }]) => <option key={val} value={val}>{label}</option>)}
              </select>
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs text-text-muted mb-1">Result</label>
              <select value={form.result} onChange={(e) => setForm((f) => ({ ...f, result: e.target.value }))}
                className="theme-input w-full rounded-xl border px-3 py-2 text-xs">
                {["passed", "failed", "partial"].map((r) => <option key={r} value={r}>{r}</option>)}
              </select>
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs text-text-muted mb-1">Scan Code</label>
              <input value={form.scan_code} onChange={(e) => setForm((f) => ({ ...f, scan_code: e.target.value }))}
                placeholder="Barcode / QR code"
                className="theme-input w-full rounded-xl border px-3 py-2 text-xs" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs text-text-muted mb-1">Product ID</label>
              <input type="number" value={form.product_id} onChange={(e) => setForm((f) => ({ ...f, product_id: e.target.value }))}
                placeholder="Optional"
                className="theme-input w-full rounded-xl border px-3 py-2 text-xs" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs text-text-muted mb-1">Order ID</label>
              <input type="number" value={form.order_id} onChange={(e) => setForm((f) => ({ ...f, order_id: e.target.value }))}
                placeholder="Optional"
                className="theme-input w-full rounded-xl border px-3 py-2 text-xs" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs text-text-muted mb-1">Shipment ID</label>
              <input type="number" value={form.shipment_id} onChange={(e) => setForm((f) => ({ ...f, shipment_id: e.target.value }))}
                placeholder="Optional"
                className="theme-input w-full rounded-xl border px-3 py-2 text-xs" />
            </div>
            <div className="sm:col-span-3">
              <label className="block text-xs text-text-muted mb-1">Notes</label>
              <textarea value={form.notes} onChange={(e) => setForm((f) => ({ ...f, notes: e.target.value }))}
                rows={2} placeholder="Describe findings..."
                className="theme-input w-full rounded-xl border px-3 py-2 text-xs resize-none" />
            </div>
            <div className="sm:col-span-3 grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs text-text-muted mb-1">Expected Specs (JSON)</label>
                <textarea value={form.expected_specs} onChange={(e) => setForm((f) => ({ ...f, expected_specs: e.target.value }))}
                  rows={3} placeholder='{"color": "red", "weight_g": 500}'
                  className="theme-input w-full rounded-xl border px-3 py-2 text-xs font-mono resize-none" />
              </div>
              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs text-text-muted mb-1">Actual Specs (JSON)</label>
                <textarea value={form.actual_specs} onChange={(e) => setForm((f) => ({ ...f, actual_specs: e.target.value }))}
                  rows={3} placeholder='{"color": "blue", "weight_g": 480}'
                  className="theme-input w-full rounded-xl border px-3 py-2 text-xs font-mono resize-none" />
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
          {saveError && <p className="text-xs text-danger flex items-center gap-2"><AlertCircle className="w-4 h-4" />{saveError}</p>}
          <div className="flex gap-3">
            <button type="submit" disabled={saving}
              className="theme-btn-primary rounded-xl px-5 py-2.5 text-xs font-semibold disabled:opacity-50 flex items-center gap-2">
              {saving ? <RefreshCw className="w-4 h-4 animate-spin" /> : <ShieldCheck className="w-4 h-4" />}
              Save Record
            </button>
            <button type="button" onClick={() => setShowForm(false)}
              className="theme-btn-secondary rounded-xl px-5 py-2.5 text-xs font-semibold">
              Cancel
            </button>
          </div>
        </form>
      )}

      {/* Filters */}
      <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-3 items-center">
        <div className="flex gap-1 flex-wrap">
          <button onClick={() => setTypeFilter("")}
            className={`rounded-xl px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold border transition-colors ${!typeFilter ? "theme-btn-accent" : "border-border text-text-muted hover:text-text"}`}>
            All Types
          </button>
          {Object.entries(TYPE_META).map(([val, { label }]) => (
            <button key={val} onClick={() => setTypeFilter(val)}
              className={`rounded-xl px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold border transition-colors ${typeFilter === val ? "theme-btn-accent" : "border-border text-text-muted hover:text-text"}`}>
              {label}
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>
        <div className="flex gap-1 flex-wrap">
          {["", "passed", "failed", "partial"].map((r) => (
            <button key={r} onClick={() => setResultFilter(r)}
              className={`rounded-xl px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold border transition-colors ${resultFilter === r ? RESULT_CHIP[r] ?? "theme-btn-accent" : "border-border text-text-muted hover:text-text"}`}>
              {r === "" ? "All Results" : r}
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Table + detail */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
        {/* List */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-2 theme-card rounded-xl border overflow-hidden">
          {loading ? (
            <div className="p-6 space-y-3">{Array.from({ length: 4 }).map((_, i) => <div key={i} className="h-14 rounded-xl bg-surface-2 animate-pulse" />)}</div>
          ) : verifications.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="p-12 text-center text-xs text-text-muted">No verification records found.</div>
          ) : (
            <div className="overflow-x-auto">
              <table className="w-full text-xs">
                <thead>
                  <tr className="border-b border-border">
                    <th className="p-4 text-left text-xs font-semibold text-text-faint">
                      <input
                        type="checkbox"
                        aria-label="Select all verifications"
                        checked={allVisibleSelected}
                        onChange={toggleSelectAllVisible}
                        className="rounded border-border"
                      />
                    </th>
                    {["#", "Type", "Product", "Order", "Result", "Date"].map((h) => (
                      <th key={h} className="p-4 text-left text-xs font-semibold text-text-faint">{h}</th>
                    ))}
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody>
                  {verifications.map((v) => {
                    const meta = TYPE_META[v.verification_type];
                    const Icon = meta?.icon ?? Package;
                    const ResultIcon = RESULT_ICON[v.result] ?? AlertCircle;
                    return (
                      <tr key={v.id} onClick={() => setSelected(selected?.id === v.id ? null : v)}
                        className={`border-b border-border/50 last:border-0 cursor-pointer hover:bg-surface-2/50 transition-colors ${selected?.id === v.id ? "bg-surface-2/70" : ""}`}>
                        <td className="p-4">
                          <input
                            type="checkbox"
                            aria-label={`Select verification ${v.id}`}
                            checked={selectedVerificationIds.has(v.id)}
                            onClick={(event) => event.stopPropagation()}
                            onChange={() => toggleVerificationSelection(v.id)}
                            className="rounded border-border"
                          />
                        </td>
                        <td className="p-4 text-text-muted font-mono text-xs">#{v.id}</td>
                        <td className="p-4">
                          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                            <Icon className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-text-muted" />
                            <span className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded-lg text-[10px] font-semibold ${meta?.chip ?? "theme-chip-muted"}`}>
                              {meta?.label ?? v.verification_type}
                            </span>
                          </div>
                        </td>
                        <td className="p-4 text-xs text-text-muted">{v.product_id ? `#${v.product_id}` : "—"}</td>
                        <td className="p-4 text-xs text-text-muted">{v.order_id ? `#${v.order_id}` : "—"}</td>
                        <td className="p-4">
                          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                            <ResultIcon className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                            <span className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded-lg text-[10px] font-semibold ${RESULT_CHIP[v.result] ?? "theme-chip-muted"}`}>{v.result}</span>
                          </div>
                        </td>
                        <td className="p-4 text-xs text-text-faint">{new Date(v.created_at).toLocaleDateString()}</td>
                      </tr>
                    );
                  })}
                </tbody>
              </table>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* Detail panel */}
        <div className="theme-card rounded-xl border p-5 space-y-4 lg:max-h-screen lg:overflow-y-auto">
          {!selected ? (
            <p className="text-xs text-text-muted text-center py-8">Select a record to view details</p>
          ) : (
            <>
              <div>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-1">
                  <h3 className="text-xs font-bold text-text">Verification #{selected.id}</h3>
                  <span className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded-lg text-[10px] font-semibold ${RESULT_CHIP[selected.result] ?? "theme-chip-muted"}`}>{selected.result}</span>
                </div>
                <p className="text-xs text-text-muted capitalize">{TYPE_META[selected.verification_type]?.label ?? selected.verification_type}</p>
                <p className="text-xs text-text-faint">{new Date(selected.created_at).toLocaleString()}</p>
              </div>

              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 text-xs">
                {[
                  ["Product", selected.product_id ? `#${selected.product_id}` : "—"],
                  ["Order", selected.order_id ? `#${selected.order_id}` : "—"],
                  ["Shipment", selected.shipment_id ? `#${selected.shipment_id}` : "—"],
                  ["Scan Code", selected.scan_code || "—"],
                ].map(([label, val]) => (
                  <div key={String(label)} className="rounded-xl bg-surface-2 px-3 py-2">
                    <p className="text-text-muted">{label}</p>
                    <p className="font-semibold text-text mt-0.5 font-mono">{val}</p>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>

              {selected.notes && (
                <div className="rounded-xl bg-surface-2 px-4 py-3 text-xs">
                  <p className="text-xs text-text-muted mb-1">Notes</p>
                  <p className="text-text">{selected.notes}</p>
                </div>
              )}

              {selected.expected_specs && (
                <div>
                  <p className="text-xs font-semibold text-text-muted mb-1">Expected Specs</p>
                  <pre className="rounded-xl bg-surface-2 p-3 text-xs text-text overflow-auto max-h-32 font-mono">
                    {JSON.stringify(selected.expected_specs, null, 2)}
                  </pre>
                </div>
              )}

              {selected.actual_specs && (
                <div>
                  <p className="text-xs font-semibold text-text-muted mb-1">Actual Specs</p>
                  <pre className="rounded-xl bg-surface-2 p-3 text-xs text-text overflow-auto max-h-32 font-mono">
                    {JSON.stringify(selected.actual_specs, null, 2)}
                  </pre>
                </div>
              )}

              {selected.discrepancies && selected.discrepancies.length > 0 && (
                <div>
                  <p className="text-xs font-semibold text-danger mb-1 flex items-center gap-1.5">
                    <AlertCircle className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />Discrepancies
                  </p>
                  <ul className="space-y-1">
                    {selected.discrepancies.map((d, i) => (
                      <li key={i} className="text-xs text-text-muted flex items-start gap-1.5">
                        <span className="text-danger mt-0.5">•</span>{d}
                      </li>
                    ))}
                  </ul>
                </div>
              )}
            </>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      <BulkActionBar
        selectedCount={selectedVerificationIds.size}
        onClearSelection={() => setSelectedVerificationIds(new Set())}
        actions={[
          {
            label: "Mark Passed",
            onClick: () => bulkUpdateResult("passed"),
            loading: bulkLoading,
            variant: "success",
          },
          {
            label: "Mark Failed",
            onClick: () => bulkUpdateResult("failed"),
            loading: bulkLoading,
            variant: "danger",
          },
          {
            label: "Mark Partial",
            onClick: () => bulkUpdateResult("partial"),
            loading: bulkLoading,
            variant: "warning",
          },
        ]}
      >
        <input
          type="text"
          value={bulkNotes}
          onChange={(e) => setBulkNotes(e.target.value)}
          placeholder="Bulk notes"
          className="w-40 rounded-lg border border-border bg-surface-2 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs text-text-primary focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-primary/30"
        />
      </BulkActionBar>
    </PanelContent>
  );
}
```

```text
﻿"use client";

import { Suspense, useCallback, useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { useRouter, useSearchParams } from "next/navigation";
import { CheckCircle, XCircle, RefreshCw, Search, Flame, Star, Trash2, RotateCcw, Package, ShieldCheck } from "@/lib/icons";
import AdminLayout from "@/components/AdminLayout";
import BulkActionBar from "@/components/BulkActionBar";
import InlineActionButtons from "@/components/InlineActionButtons";
import { PanelContent, PanelTabs } from "@/components/PanelPage";
import { apiFetch } from "@/lib/api";
import { normalizeListPage } from "@/lib/listResponse";
import { useAuth } from "@/lib/useAuth";
import { useCurrencyStore } from "@/lib/currencyStore";
import { resolveImage } from "@/lib/utils";
import { useToastStore } from "@/lib/toastStore";
import { PRODUCT_STATUS_CHIP } from "@shared/statusColors";
import { dc, useDensity } from "@/lib/densityContext";
import { EnterpriseDataTable, type EnterpriseColumn } from "@shared/components/EnterpriseDataTable";
import VerificationPanel from "./VerificationPanel";

interface AdminProduct {
  id: number;
  name: string;
  description?: string;
  category?: string;
  price: number | string;
  compare_price?: number | string | null;
  stock: number;
  supplier_id?: number;
  is_approved?: boolean;
  is_deleted?: boolean;
  is_hot?: boolean | null;
  is_featured?: boolean | null;
  verification_status?: string;
  image_url?: string | null;
  additional_images?: string | null;
  images?: string[];
}

const STATUS_COLORS = PRODUCT_STATUS_CHIP;

const SECTIONS = [
  { key: "products", label: "Product Catalog", icon: Package },
  { key: "verification", label: "Verifications", icon: ShieldCheck },
] as const;
type Section = (typeof SECTIONS)[number]["key"];

const PAGE_SIZE = 50;

function AdminProductsHubInner() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const searchParams = useSearchParams();
  const { user, isLoggedIn, isLoading: authLoading } = useAuth();
  const { density } = useDensity();
  const [products, setProducts] = useState<AdminProduct[]>([]);
  const [totalProducts, setTotalProducts] = useState(0);
  const [search, setSearch] = useState("");
  const [filter, setFilter] = useState("all");
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [actionId, setActionId] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [badgeLoading, setBadgeLoading] = useState<Record<string, boolean>>({});
  const [deletingId, setDeletingId] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [archiveTarget, setArchiveTarget] = useState<AdminProduct | null>(null);
  const [selectedProductIds, setSelectedProductIds] = useState<Set<number>>(new Set());
  const [bulkLoading, setBulkLoading] = useState(false);
  const [page, setPage] = useState(1);
  const [loadError, setLoadError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const addToast = useToastStore((s) => s.addToast);
  const formatMoney = useCurrencyStore((s) => s.format);
  const section = (searchParams.get("section") || "products") as Section;

  const getProductThumb = (product: AdminProduct) => {
    if (product.image_url) return resolveImage(product.image_url);
    if (Array.isArray(product.images) && product.images.length > 0) return resolveImage(product.images[0]);
    if (product.additional_images) {
      try {
        const parsed = JSON.parse(product.additional_images);
        if (Array.isArray(parsed) && parsed.length > 0) return resolveImage(String(parsed[0]));
      } catch {}
    }
    return null;
  };

  const toggleBadge = async (id: number, field: "is_hot" | "is_featured", value: boolean) => {
    const key = `${id}_${field}`;
    setBadgeLoading((prev) => ({ ...prev, [key]: true }));
    try {
      const res = await apiFetch(`/admin/products/${id}/badge?field=${field}&value=${value}`, { method: "PATCH" });
      if (res.ok) {
        setProducts((prev) => prev.map((p) => p.id === id ? { ...p, [field]: value } : p));
        addToast(`Product badge updated`, "success");
      } else {
        const err = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
        addToast(err.detail || "Failed to update product badge", "error");
      }
    } finally {
      setBadgeLoading((prev) => ({ ...prev, [key]: false }));
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (authLoading) return;
    if (!isLoggedIn || !["admin", "sub_admin", "moderator"].includes(user?.role || "")) {
      router.push("/admin/login");
    }
  }, [authLoading, isLoggedIn, user, router]);

  const fetchProducts = useCallback(async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const params = new URLSearchParams();
      params.set("limit", String(PAGE_SIZE));
      params.set("offset", String((page - 1) * PAGE_SIZE));
      if (search.trim()) params.set("search", search.trim());
      if (filter !== "all") params.set("filter", filter);
      const res = await apiFetch(`/admin/products?${params.toString()}`);
      if (!res.ok) {
        const err = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
        throw new Error(err.detail || "Unable to load admin products.");
      }
      const payload = normalizeListPage<AdminProduct>(await res.json());
      setProducts(payload.data);
      setTotalProducts(payload.total);
      setLoadError(null);
    } catch (error) {
      const message = error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Unable to load admin products.";
      setLoadError(message);
      setProducts([]);
      setTotalProducts(0);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, [filter, page, search]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isLoggedIn) fetchProducts();
  }, [fetchProducts, isLoggedIn]);

  // Reset to page 1 when filters change
  useEffect(() => { setPage(1); }, [search, filter]);

  const approve = async (id: number) => {
    setActionId(id);
    try {
      const res = await apiFetch(`/admin/products/${id}/approve`, { method: "POST" });
      if (res.ok) {
        await fetchProducts();
        addToast(`Product approved`, "success");
      } else {
        const err = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
        addToast(err.detail || "Failed to approve product", "error");
      }
    } finally {
      setActionId(null);
    }
  };

  const reject = async (id: number) => {
    setActionId(id);
    try {
      const res = await apiFetch(`/admin/products/${id}/reject`, { method: "POST" });
      if (res.ok) {
        await fetchProducts();
        addToast(`Product rejected`, "success");
      } else {
        const err = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
        addToast(err.detail || "Failed to reject product", "error");
      }
    } finally {
      setActionId(null);
    }
  };

  const deleteProduct = async (id: number) => {
    setDeletingId(id);
    try {
      const res = await apiFetch(`/admin/products/${id}`, { method: "DELETE" });
      if (res.ok) {
        await fetchProducts();
        addToast(`Product archived`, "success");
      } else {
        const err = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
        if (res.status === 404) {
          await fetchProducts();
          addToast(`Product #${id} was already removed`, "info");
        } else {
          addToast(err.detail || "Failed to archive product", "error");
        }
      }
    } finally {
      setDeletingId(null);
    }
  };

  const restoreProduct = async (id: number) => {
    setDeletingId(id);
    try {
      const res = await apiFetch(`/admin/products/${id}/restore`, { method: "POST" });
      if (res.ok) {
        await fetchProducts();
        addToast(`Product restored`, "success");
      } else {
        const err = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
        addToast(err.detail || "Failed to restore product", "error");
      }
    } finally {
      setDeletingId(null);
    }
  };

  const hasActiveFilters = search.trim() !== "" || filter !== "all";
  const clearFilters = () => {
    setSearch("");
    setFilter("all");
    setPage(1);
  };

  const toggleProductSelect = (id: number) => {
    setSelectedProductIds((prev) => {
      const next = new Set(prev);
      if (next.has(id)) next.delete(id); else next.add(id);
      return next;
    });
  };

  const toggleSelectAllVisible = () => {
    const allSelected = paged.every((p) => selectedProductIds.has(p.id));
    setSelectedProductIds((prev) => {
      const next = new Set(prev);
      if (allSelected) paged.forEach((p) => next.delete(p.id));
      else paged.forEach((p) => next.add(p.id));
      return next;
    });
  };

  const bulkModerate = async (action: "approve" | "reject") => {
    const ids = Array.from(selectedProductIds);
    if (!ids.length) return;
    setBulkLoading(true);
    try {
      const res = await apiFetch("/admin/products/bulk-moderate", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ product_ids: ids, action }),
      });
      if (res.ok) {
        const data = await res.json();
        fetchProducts();
        setSelectedProductIds(new Set());
        addToast(`${data.updated ?? ids.length} products ${action}d`, "success");
      } else {
        const err = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
        addToast(err.detail || `Bulk ${action} failed`, "error");
      }
    } finally {
      setBulkLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const bulkDeleteProducts = async () => {
    const ids = Array.from(selectedProductIds);
    if (!ids.length) return;
    setBulkLoading(true);
    try {
      const res = await apiFetch("/admin/products/bulk", {
        method: "DELETE",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ product_ids: ids }),
      });
      if (res.ok) {
        const data = await res.json();
        fetchProducts();
        setSelectedProductIds(new Set());
        addToast(`${data.deleted ?? ids.length} products archived`, "success");
      } else {
        const err = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
        addToast(err.detail || "Bulk archive failed", "error");
      }
    } finally {
      setBulkLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const bulkRestoreProducts = async () => {
    const ids = Array.from(selectedProductIds);
    if (!ids.length) return;
    setBulkLoading(true);
    try {
      const res = await apiFetch("/admin/products/bulk/restore", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ ids }),
      });
      if (res.ok) {
        fetchProducts();
        setSelectedProductIds(new Set());
        addToast(`${ids.length} products restored`, "success");
      } else {
        const err = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
        addToast(err.detail || "Bulk restore failed", "error");
      }
    } finally {
      setBulkLoading(false);
    }
  };

  if (authLoading) return null;

  const bodyText = dc(density, "text-[10px]", "text-xs", "text-sm");
  const imgSize = dc(density, "w-6 h-6", "w-7 h-7", "w-9 h-9");

  const totalPages = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(totalProducts / PAGE_SIZE));
  const paged = products;
  const productColumns: Array<EnterpriseColumn<AdminProduct>> = [
    {
      key: "id",
      label: "#",
      width: "72px",
      sortable: true,
      searchValue: (product) => product.id,
      render: (product) => <span className={`${bodyText} tabular-nums text-text-faint`}>{product.id}</span>,
    },
    {
      key: "name",
      label: "Product",
      width: "280px",
      sortable: true,
      searchValue: (product) => `${product.name} ${product.description ?? ""}`,
      render: (product) => {
        const thumb = getProductThumb(product);
        return (
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
            {thumb ? <img src={thumb} alt={product.name} className={`${imgSize} rounded-lg object-cover shrink-0`} /> : null}
            <div className="min-w-0">
              <p className={`truncate font-medium text-text ${bodyText}`}>{product.name}</p>
              {product.description ? <p className="mt-0.5 line-clamp-1 text-[11px] text-text-faint">{product.description}</p> : null}
            </div>
          </div>
        );
      },
    },
    {
      key: "category",
      label: "Category",
      width: "120px",
      sortable: true,
      render: (product) => <span className={`${bodyText} text-text-muted`}>{product.category || "—"}</span>,
    },
    {
      key: "price",
      label: "Price",
      width: "120px",
      align: "right",
      sortable: true,
      sortValue: (product) => Number(product.price),
      render: (product) => (
        <div className="text-right">
          <p className={`${bodyText} font-semibold tabular-nums text-text`}>{formatMoney(Number(product.price))}</p>
          {product.compare_price && Number(product.compare_price) > Number(product.price) ? (
            <p className="text-[10px] tabular-nums text-text-faint line-through">{formatMoney(Number(product.compare_price))}</p>
          ) : null}
        </div>
      ),
    },
    {
      key: "stock",
      label: "Stock",
      width: "90px",
      align: "right",
      sortable: true,
      render: (product) => <span className={`${bodyText} tabular-nums text-text-muted`}>{product.stock}</span>,
    },
    {
      key: "supplier_id",
      label: "Supplier",
      width: "90px",
      align: "right",
      sortable: true,
      render: (product) => <span className={`${bodyText} tabular-nums text-text-faint`}>#{product.supplier_id ?? "—"}</span>,
    },
    {
      key: "status",
      label: "Status",
      width: "120px",
      sortable: true,
      sortValue: (product) => (product.is_deleted ? "deleted" : (product.verification_status ?? (product.is_approved ? "approved" : "pending"))),
      searchValue: (product) => (product.is_deleted ? "deleted" : (product.verification_status ?? (product.is_approved ? "approved" : "pending"))),
      render: (product) => {
        const status = product.is_deleted ? "deleted" : (product.verification_status ?? (product.is_approved ? "approved" : "pending"));
        return (
          <span className={`inline-flex rounded-full px-2 py-1 text-[10px] font-semibold capitalize ${STATUS_COLORS[status] ?? "bg-surface-2 text-text-muted"}`}>
            {status}
          </span>
        );
      },
    },
    {
      key: "badges",
      label: "Badges",
      width: "180px",
      searchable: false,
      render: (product) => (
        <div className="flex flex-wrap justify-end gap-1.5">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => toggleBadge(product.id, "is_hot", !product.is_hot)}
            disabled={badgeLoading[`${product.id}_is_hot`]}
            className={`inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-full border px-2 py-1 text-[10px] font-semibold transition-colors disabled:opacity-50 ${
              product.is_hot
                ? "border-accent/40 bg-accent/10 text-accent"
                : "border-border bg-surface-1 text-text-muted hover:text-accent"
            }`}
          >
            <Flame className="h-3 w-3" />
            Hot
          </button>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => toggleBadge(product.id, "is_featured", !product.is_featured)}
            disabled={badgeLoading[`${product.id}_is_featured`]}
            className={`inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-full border px-2 py-1 text-[10px] font-semibold transition-colors disabled:opacity-50 ${
              product.is_featured
                ? "border-primary/40 bg-primary/10 text-primary"
                : "border-border bg-surface-1 text-text-muted hover:text-primary"
            }`}
          >
            <Star className="h-3 w-3" />
            Featured
          </button>
        </div>
      ),
    },
  ];

  return (
    <>
    {archiveTarget ? (
      <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center theme-overlay p-4">
        <div className="theme-card w-full max-w-sm rounded-xl border p-6">
          <h2 className="text-base font-semibold text-text">Archive product?</h2>
          <p className="mt-2 text-xs text-text-muted">
            <span className="font-medium text-text">{archiveTarget.name}</span> will be hidden from the storefront until it is restored.
          </p>
          <div className="mt-5 flex gap-3">
            <button onClick={() => setArchiveTarget(null)} className="flex-1 rounded-xl border border-border py-2 text-xs text-text-muted hover:bg-surface-2">Cancel</button>
            <button
              onClick={async () => {
                await deleteProduct(archiveTarget.id);
                setArchiveTarget(null);
              }}
              disabled={deletingId === archiveTarget.id}
              className="flex-1 rounded-xl bg-danger py-2 text-xs font-medium text-white disabled:opacity-50"
            >
              {deletingId === archiveTarget.id ? "Archiving..." : "Archive"}
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    ) : null}
    <AdminLayout title="Products" headerMode="compact">
      <PanelContent width="full" className="space-y-4">
      <PanelTabs
        items={SECTIONS}
        value={section}
        onChange={(nextSection) => router.replace(`/admin/products?section=${nextSection}`, { scroll: false })}
      />

      {section === "products" && (<>
      {loading ? (
        <div className="space-y-2">
          {Array.from({ length: 10 }).map((_, i) => <div key={i} className="h-10 rounded-xl bg-surface-2 animate-pulse" />)}
        </div>
      ) : paged.length === 0 ? (
        <div className="rounded-2xl border border-border bg-surface-1 px-6 py-12 text-center">
          <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-text">{loadError ? "Products could not be loaded" : hasActiveFilters ? "No products match the current filters" : "No products yet"}</p>
          <p className="mt-2 text-xs text-text-faint">{loadError ? loadError : hasActiveFilters ? "Try clearing the search or status filter to see more results." : "Approved and pending catalog items will appear here."}</p>
          <div className="mt-4 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-center gap-2">
            <button onClick={fetchProducts} className="rounded-xl bg-primary px-4 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-on-brand">Retry</button>
            {hasActiveFilters ? <button onClick={clearFilters} className="rounded-xl border border-border px-4 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-text-muted hover:bg-surface-2">Clear filters</button> : null}
          </div>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <EnterpriseDataTable
          columns={productColumns}
          rows={paged}
          rowKey={(product) => product.id}
          densityMode={density}
          enableBulkActions
          enableExport
          enableGlobalSearch={false}
          showPagination={false}
          selectedRowKeys={Array.from(selectedProductIds)}
          onSelectedRowKeysChange={(keys) => setSelectedProductIds(new Set(keys.map((key) => Number(key))))}
          toolbarSlot={(
            <>
              <div className="relative min-w-[16rem] flex-1 xl:w-72 xl:flex-none">
                <Search className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 h-4 w-4 -translate-y-1/2 text-text-faint" />
                <input
                  value={search}
                  onChange={(event) => setSearch(event.target.value)}
                  placeholder="Search products"
                  className="h-9 w-full rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface-1 py-2 pl-9 pr-3 text-xs text-text placeholder:text-text-faint focus:border-primary focus:outline-none"
                />
              </div>
              <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1">
                {["all", "pending", "approved", "rejected", "deleted"].map((statusFilter) => (
                  <button
                    key={statusFilter}
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => setFilter(statusFilter)}
                    className={`rounded-lg px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold capitalize transition-colors ${
                      filter === statusFilter ? "theme-btn-primary shadow-none" : "theme-btn-secondary border text-text-muted"
                    }`}
                  >
                    {statusFilter}
                  </button>
                ))}
              </div>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={fetchProducts}
                disabled={loading}
                className="flex h-9 items-center justify-center rounded-lg border border-border bg-surface-1 px-3 text-xs text-text-muted transition-colors hover:bg-surface-2 disabled:opacity-50"
                aria-label="Refresh products"
              >
                <RefreshCw className={`h-3.5 w-3.5 ${loading ? "animate-spin" : ""}`} />
              </button>
              {hasActiveFilters ? (
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={clearFilters}
                  className="h-9 rounded-lg border border-border bg-surface-1 px-3 text-xs font-medium text-text-muted transition-colors hover:bg-surface-2 hover:text-text"
                >
                  Clear filters
                </button>
              ) : null}
            </>
          )}
          emptyState={loadError ? loadError : "No products matched the current filters."}
          rowActions={(product) => {
            const status = product.is_deleted ? "deleted" : (product.verification_status ?? (product.is_approved ? "approved" : "pending"));
            return (
              <div className="flex justify-end">
                <InlineActionButtons
                  actions={[
                    ...(status === "pending"
                      ? [
                          { label: `Approve ${product.name}`, icon: <CheckCircle className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />, onClick: () => approve(product.id), tone: "success" as const, disabled: actionId === product.id },
                          { label: `Reject ${product.name}`, icon: <XCircle className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />, onClick: () => reject(product.id), tone: "warning" as const, disabled: actionId === product.id },
                        ]
                      : []),
                    product.is_deleted
                      ? { label: `Restore ${product.name}`, icon: <RotateCcw className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />, onClick: () => restoreProduct(product.id), tone: "success" as const, disabled: deletingId === product.id }
                      : { label: `Archive ${product.name}`, icon: <Trash2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />, onClick: () => setArchiveTarget(product), tone: "danger" as const, disabled: deletingId === product.id },
                  ]}
                />
              </div>
            );
          }}
        />
      )}

      {/* Pagination */}
      {totalPages > 1 && (
        <div className="mt-3 flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
          <p className="text-xs text-text-faint">
            {totalProducts === 0 ? 0 : (page - 1) * PAGE_SIZE + 1}–{Math.min(page * PAGE_SIZE, totalProducts)} of {totalProducts}
          </p>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
            <button onClick={() => setPage(1)} disabled={page === 1} className="px-2 py-1 rounded-lg bg-surface-2 text-text-faint text-xs disabled:opacity-40 hover:bg-surface-1">«</button>
            <button onClick={() => setPage((p) => Math.max(1, p - 1))} disabled={page === 1} className="px-2 py-1 rounded-lg bg-surface-2 text-text-faint text-xs disabled:opacity-40 hover:bg-surface-1">‹</button>
            {Array.from({ length: Math.min(5, totalPages) }, (_, i) => {
              const start = Math.max(1, Math.min(page - 2, totalPages - 4));
              return start + i;
            }).map((p) => (
              <button key={p} onClick={() => setPage(p)} className={`px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg text-xs font-medium transition-colors ${p === page ? "bg-primary text-on-brand" : "bg-surface-2 text-text-muted hover:bg-surface-1"}`}>{p}</button>
            ))}
            <button onClick={() => setPage((p) => Math.min(totalPages, p + 1))} disabled={page === totalPages} className="px-2 py-1 rounded-lg bg-surface-2 text-text-faint text-xs disabled:opacity-40 hover:bg-surface-1">›</button>
            <button onClick={() => setPage(totalPages)} disabled={page === totalPages} className="px-2 py-1 rounded-lg bg-surface-2 text-text-faint text-xs disabled:opacity-40 hover:bg-surface-1">»</button>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
      </>)}
      {section === "verification" && <VerificationPanel />}
      </PanelContent>
    </AdminLayout>

    {section === "products" && (
    <BulkActionBar
      selectedCount={selectedProductIds.size}
      onClearSelection={() => setSelectedProductIds(new Set())}
      actions={[
        { label: "Approve Selected", onClick: () => bulkModerate("approve"), loading: bulkLoading, variant: "success" },
        { label: "Reject Selected", onClick: () => bulkModerate("reject"), loading: bulkLoading, variant: "warning" },
        { label: "Archive Selected", onClick: bulkDeleteProducts, loading: bulkLoading, variant: "danger" },
        { label: "Restore Selected", onClick: bulkRestoreProducts, loading: bulkLoading, variant: "success" },
      ]}
    />
    )}
    </>
  );
}

export default function AdminProductsPage() {
  return (
    <Suspense>
      <AdminProductsHubInner />
    </Suspense>
  );
}
```

```text
const BANNER_TYPE_APPEARANCE_DEFAULTS: Record<Banner["banner_type"], BannerAppearancePatch> = {

    btn_bg_color: "#ffd400",
    btn_text_color: "#111111",
    badge_color: "rgba(255,255,255,0.14)",
    effect: "aurora",
  },
  flash: {
    bg_color: "#0f172a",
    text_color: "#f8fafc",
    subtitle_color: "rgba(248,250,252,0.82)",
    btn_bg_color: "#ffd400",
    btn_text_color: "#111111",
    badge_color: "rgba(255,255,255,0.14)",
    effect: "poppers",
  },
};

const APPEARANCE_PRESETS: Array<{ key: string; label: string; description: string; patch: BannerAppearancePatch }> = [
  {
    key: "editorial-light",
    label: "Editorial Light",
    description: "Bright campaign shell with dark copy and a crisp CTA.",
    patch: {
      bg_color: "#eef5e7",
      text_color: "#10210f",
      subtitle_color: "rgba(16,33,15,0.72)",
      btn_bg_color: "#10210f",
      btn_text_color: "#ffffff",
      badge_color: "rgba(47,148,64,0.14)",
      effect: "aurora",
    },
  },
  {
    key: "night-luxe",
    label: "Night Luxe",
    description: "Dark premium surface with bright contrast for hero launches.",
    patch: {
      bg_color: "#0f172a",
      text_color: "#f8fafc",
      subtitle_color: "rgba(248,250,252,0.8)",
      btn_bg_color: "#ffd400",
      btn_text_color: "#111111",
      badge_color: "rgba(255,255,255,0.16)",
      effect: "aurora",
    },
  },
  {
    key: "festive-contrast",
    label: "Festive Contrast",
    description: "Richer seasonal background with brighter badge and CTA energy.",
    patch: {
      bg_color: "#166534",
      text_color: "#ffffff",
      subtitle_color: "rgba(255,255,255,0.84)",
      btn_bg_color: "#f8fafc",
      btn_text_color: "#111111",
      badge_color: "rgba(248,250,252,0.2)",
      effect: "eid",
    },
  },
  {
    key: "flash-campaign",
    label: "Flash Campaign",
    description: "High-contrast promo palette tuned for urgent offers.",
    patch: {
      bg_color: "#7f1d1d",
      text_color: "#ffffff",
      subtitle_color: "rgba(255,255,255,0.82)",
      btn_bg_color: "#ffd400",
      btn_text_color: "#111111",
      badge_color: "rgba(255,255,255,0.16)",
      effect: "poppers",
    },
  },
];

function getBannerTypeAppearanceDefaults(type: Banner["banner_type"]): BannerAppearancePatch {
  return BANNER_TYPE_APPEARANCE_DEFAULTS[type] ?? BANNER_TYPE_APPEARANCE_DEFAULTS.hero;
}

function isSupportedBannerImageFile(file?: File | null) {
  return Boolean(file && /\.(jpe?g|png|gif|webp|avif|bmp)$/i.test(file.name));
}

const EMPTY_FORM: Omit<Banner, "id"> = {
  title: "",
  subtitle: "",
  image_url: "",
  cta_label: "Shop Now",
  cta_url: "/products",
  banner_type: "hero",
  is_active: true,
  sort_order: 0,
  starts_at: "",
  ends_at: "",
  bg_color: "",
  text_color: "#ffffff",
  subtitle_color: "",
  btn_bg_color: "",
  btn_text_color: "#ffffff",
  badge_text: "",
  badge_color: "",
  effect: "",
};

/* ─── colour field helper ───────────────────────── */
function ColorField({
  label, value, onChange, placeholder,
}: { label: string; value: string; onChange: (v: string) => void; placeholder?: string }) {
  return (
    <div>
      <label className="text-xs font-medium text-text-muted mb-1 block">{label}</label>
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
        <input type="color" value={value || "#ffffff"} onChange={(e) => onChange(e.target.value)}
          className="w-8 h-8 rounded-md border border-border cursor-pointer p-0.5 bg-surface-1 shrink-0" />
        <input value={value} onChange={(e) => onChange(e.target.value)} placeholder={placeholder ?? "leave blank for default"}
          className="flex-1 px-3 py-2 rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface-1 text-xs text-text focus:outline-none focus:border-primary font-mono" />
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

/* ─── live mini-preview ─────────────────────────── */
function BannerPreview({ form }: { form: Omit<Banner, "id"> }) {
  const bg = form.bg_color || BANNER_TYPE_DEFAULTS[form.banner_type] || "#22c55e";
  const textColor = form.text_color || "#ffffff";
  const subtitleColor = form.subtitle_color || "rgba(255,255,255,0.85)";
  const btnBg = form.btn_bg_color || "rgba(255,255,255,0.2)";
  const btnText = form.btn_text_color || "#ffffff";
  const badgeBg = form.badge_color || "rgba(255,255,255,0.15)";

  return (
    <div className="rounded-xl overflow-hidden border border-border" style={{ backgroundColor: bg }}>
      {form.image_url && (
        <div className="relative h-24 w-full">
          <img src={resolveImage(form.image_url)} alt="" className="w-full h-full object-cover" onError={(e) => { e.currentTarget.style.display = "none"; }} />
          <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-linear-to-b from-black/5 to-black/40" />
        </div>
      )}
      <div className="p-3">
        {form.badge_text && (
          <span className="inline-block text-[9px] font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full mb-1.5" style={{ backgroundColor: badgeBg, color: textColor }}>
            {form.badge_text}
          </span>
        )}
        <p className="text-xs font-bold leading-snug" style={{ color: textColor }}>{form.title || "Banner Title"}</p>
        {form.subtitle && <p className="text-[10px] mt-0.5" style={{ color: subtitleColor }}>{form.subtitle}</p>}
        {form.cta_label && (
          <button className="mt-2 text-[10px] font-semibold px-3 py-1 rounded-full" style={{ backgroundColor: btnBg, color: btnText }}>
            {form.cta_label}
          </button>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

/* ─── page ──────────────────────────────────────── */
export default function BannersPanel() {
  const { user, isLoggedIn, isLoading: authLoading } = useAuth();
  const [banners, setBanners] = useState<Banner[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [showForm, setShowForm] = useState(false);
  const [editingId, setEditingId] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [form, setForm] = useState<Omit<Banner, "id">>({ ...EMPTY_FORM });
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<"content" | "appearance">("content");
  const [uploadingId, setUploadingId] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const fileInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const modalImageInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const [pendingImageBannerId, setPendingImageBannerId] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [pendingModalImageFile, setPendingModalImageFile] = useState<File | null>(null);
  const [pendingModalImagePreview, setPendingModalImagePreview] = useState("");
  const [search, setSearch] = useState("");

  const clearPendingModalImage = () => {
    setPendingModalImageFile(null);
    setPendingModalImagePreview((current) => {
      if (current.startsWith("blob:")) {
        URL.revokeObjectURL(current);
      }
      return "";
    });
  };

  const attachModalImage = (file?: File | null) => {
    if (!file) return;
    if (!isSupportedBannerImageFile(file)) {
      clearPendingModalImage();
      setError(`Banner images must be ${SUPPORTED_BANNER_IMAGE_LABEL}.`);
      return;
    }
    setError("");
    clearPendingModalImage();
    setPendingModalImageFile(file);
    setPendingModalImagePreview(URL.createObjectURL(file));
  };

  const closeForm = () => {
    clearPendingModalImage();
    setError("");
    setShowForm(false);
  };

  const uploadBannerImage = async (bannerId: number, file: File): Promise<string | null> => {
    const fd = new FormData();
    fd.append("file", file);
    const response = await apiFetch(`/banners/${bannerId}/image`, { method: "POST", body: fd });
    const payload = await response.json().catch(() => null);
    if (!response.ok) {
      const detail = typeof payload?.detail === "string" ? payload.detail : "Failed to upload banner image.";
      throw new Error(detail);
    }
    return typeof payload?.image_url === "string" ? payload.image_url : null;
  };

  /* fetch */
  const fetchBanners = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const res = await apiFetch("/banners/all");
      if (res.ok) {
        const payload = normalizeListPage<Banner>(await res.json());
        setBanners(payload.data);
      }
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isLoggedIn && canAccessAdminBannerManagement(user?.role)) fetchBanners();
  }, [isLoggedIn, user?.role]);

  /* form helpers */
  const f = (patch: Partial<Omit<Banner, "id">>) => setForm((prev) => ({ ...prev, ...patch }));
  const applyAppearancePreset = (patch: BannerAppearancePatch) => f(patch);

  const openCreate = () => {
    setForm({ ...EMPTY_FORM });
    setEditingId(null);
    setError("");
    setActiveTab("content");
    clearPendingModalImage();
    setShowForm(true);
  };

  const openEdit = (b: Banner) => {
    setForm({
      title: b.title,
      subtitle: b.subtitle ?? "",
      image_url: b.image_url ?? "",
      cta_label: b.cta_label ?? "Shop Now",
      cta_url: b.cta_url ?? "/products",
      banner_type: b.banner_type ?? "hero",
      is_active: b.is_active,
      sort_order: b.sort_order ?? 0,
      starts_at: b.starts_at ? b.starts_at.slice(0, 10) : "",
      ends_at: b.ends_at ? b.ends_at.slice(0, 10) : "",
      bg_color: b.bg_color ?? "",
      text_color: b.text_color ?? "#ffffff",
      subtitle_color: b.subtitle_color ?? "",
      btn_bg_color: b.btn_bg_color ?? "",
      btn_text_color: b.btn_text_color ?? "#ffffff",
      badge_text: b.badge_text ?? "",
      badge_color: b.badge_color ?? "",
      effect: b.effect ?? "",
    });
    setEditingId(b.id);
    setError("");
    setActiveTab("content");
    clearPendingModalImage();
    setShowForm(true);
  };

  /* save */
  const save = async () => {
    if (!form.title.trim()) { setError("Title is required."); return; }
    setSaving(true);
    setError("");
    let resolvedBannerId = editingId;
    try {
      const body = {
        title: form.title.trim(),
        subtitle: form.subtitle || null,
        image_url: form.image_url || null,
        cta_label: form.cta_label || null,
        cta_url: form.cta_url || null,
        banner_type: form.banner_type,
        is_active: form.is_active,
        sort_order: Number(form.sort_order) || 0,
        starts_at: form.starts_at || null,
        ends_at: form.ends_at || null,
        bg_color: form.bg_color || null,
        text_color: form.text_color || null,
        subtitle_color: form.subtitle_color || null,
        btn_bg_color: form.btn_bg_color || null,
        btn_text_color: form.btn_text_color || null,
        badge_text: form.badge_text || null,
        badge_color: form.badge_color || null,
        effect: form.effect || null,
      };
      const res = editingId
        ? await apiFetch(`/banners/${editingId}`, { method: "PUT", headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" }, body: JSON.stringify(body) })
        : await apiFetch("/banners", { method: "POST", headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" }, body: JSON.stringify(body) });
      if (!res.ok) {
        const err = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
        setError(err?.detail ?? "Failed to save banner.");
        return;
      }
      if (!editingId) {
        const created = await res.json().catch(() => null);
        resolvedBannerId = typeof created?.id === "number" ? created.id : null;
        if (resolvedBannerId) setEditingId(resolvedBannerId);
      }
      if (resolvedBannerId && pendingModalImageFile) {
        const uploadedImageUrl = await uploadBannerImage(resolvedBannerId, pendingModalImageFile);
        if (uploadedImageUrl) {
          setForm((prev) => ({ ...prev, image_url: uploadedImageUrl }));
        }
      }
      await fetchBanners();
      closeForm();
    } catch (saveError) {
      if (resolvedBannerId) {
        setEditingId(resolvedBannerId);
        await fetchBanners();
      }
      setError(saveError instanceof Error ? saveError.message : "Failed to save banner.");
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  };

  /* delete */
  const deleteBanner = async (id: number) => {
    if (!confirm("Delete this banner? This cannot be undone.")) return;
    await apiFetch(`/banners/${id}`, { method: "DELETE" });
    setBanners((prev) => prev.filter((b) => b.id !== id));
  };

  /* toggle active */
  const toggleActive = async (b: Banner) => {
    const res = await apiFetch(`/banners/${b.id}`, {
      method: "PUT",
      headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      body: JSON.stringify({ is_active: !b.is_active }),
    });
    if (res.ok) setBanners((prev) => prev.map((x) => x.id === b.id ? { ...x, is_active: !x.is_active } : x));
  };

  /* image upload */
  const handleImageUpload = async (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
    if (!file || pendingImageBannerId == null) return;
    if (!isSupportedBannerImageFile(file)) {
      setError(`Banner images must be ${SUPPORTED_BANNER_IMAGE_LABEL}.`);
      setPendingImageBannerId(null);
      if (fileInputRef.current) fileInputRef.current.value = "";
      return;
    }
    setUploadingId(pendingImageBannerId);
    try {
      const fd = new FormData();
      fd.append("file", file);
      const res = await apiFetch(`/banners/${pendingImageBannerId}/image`, { method: "POST", body: fd });
      const payload = await res.json().catch(() => null);
      if (!res.ok) {
        setError(typeof payload?.detail === "string" ? payload.detail : "Failed to upload banner image.");
        return;
      }
      setError("");
      await fetchBanners();
    } finally {
      setUploadingId(null);
      setPendingImageBannerId(null);
      if (fileInputRef.current) fileInputRef.current.value = "";
    }
  };

  const triggerImageUpload = (id: number) => {
    setPendingImageBannerId(id);
    fileInputRef.current?.click();
  };

  if (authLoading) return null;

  const filteredBanners = search.trim()
    ? banners.filter((b) => b.title.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase()))
    : banners;

  const typeBadge: Record<string, string> = {
    hero:        "theme-chip-success",
    seasonal:    "theme-chip-warning",
    promotional: "theme-chip-brand",
    flash:       "theme-chip-danger",
  };

  return (
    <>
      {/* hidden file input for image uploads */}
      <input ref={fileInputRef} type="file" accept={SUPPORTED_BANNER_IMAGE_ACCEPT} className="hidden" onChange={handleImageUpload} />

      {/* header */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-3">
        <p className="text-xs text-text-faint flex items-center gap-1">
          <Megaphone className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />{banners.length} banners
        </p>
        <div className="flex gap-2">
          <button onClick={fetchBanners} disabled={loading}
            className="p-2 rounded-lg bg-surface-2 text-text-muted hover:bg-surface-1 disabled:opacity-50">
            <RefreshCw className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 ${loading ? "animate-spin" : ""}`} />
          </button>
          <button onClick={openCreate}
            className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-medium theme-btn-primary">
            <Plus className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />New Banner
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Search bar */}
      <div className="relative mb-5">
        <Search className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 w-3.5 h-3.5 text-text-faint pointer-events-none" />
        <input
          value={search}
          onChange={(e) => setSearch(e.target.value)}
          placeholder="Search banners by title…"
          className="w-full pl-9 pr-3 py-2 rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface-1 text-xs text-text focus:outline-none focus:border-primary"
        />
      </div>

      {!showForm && error && (
        <p className="mb-4 rounded-lg bg-danger/10 px-3 py-2 text-xs text-danger">{error}</p>
      )}

      {/* banner list */}
      {loading ? (
        <div className="grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3">
          {[...Array(3)].map((_, i) => (
            <div key={i} className="h-28 rounded-xl bg-surface-2 animate-pulse" />
          ))}
        </div>
      ) : filteredBanners.length === 0 ? (
        <div className="text-center py-16 text-text-faint">
          <Megaphone className="w-10 h-10 mx-auto mb-3 text-primary/30" />
          <p className="text-xs">
            {search.trim() ? `No banners matching "${search}"` : "No banners yet. Create your first one."}
          </p>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3">
          {filteredBanners.map((b) => {
            const bg = b.bg_color || BANNER_TYPE_DEFAULTS[b.banner_type] || "#22c55e";
            return (
              <motion.div key={b.id} layout initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 8 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
                className="theme-card rounded-xl border overflow-hidden shadow-sm">
                {/* banner preview strip */}
                <div className="relative h-24" style={{ backgroundColor: bg }}>
                  {b.image_url && (
                    <img src={resolveImage(b.image_url)} alt={b.title}
                      className="w-full h-full object-cover mix-blend-overlay opacity-80" />
                  )}
                    <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-linear-to-b from-transparent to-black/40 p-3 flex flex-col justify-end">
                    {b.badge_text && (
                      <span className="text-[9px] font-bold text-white bg-white/20 rounded-full px-2 py-0.5 self-start mb-1">
                        {b.badge_text}
                      </span>
                    )}
                    <p className="text-white font-bold text-xs leading-tight line-clamp-1">{b.title}</p>
                    {b.subtitle && <p className="text-white/80 text-[10px] line-clamp-1">{b.subtitle}</p>}
                  </div>
                  {/* active toggle overlay */}
                  <button onClick={() => toggleActive(b)}
                    className="absolute top-2 right-2 p-1 rounded-full bg-black/40 hover:bg-black/60 text-white transition-colors"
                    title={b.is_active ? "Deactivate" : "Activate"}>
                    {b.is_active ? <ToggleRight className="w-4 h-4 text-success" /> : <ToggleLeft className="w-4 h-4" />}
                  </button>
                </div>

                {/* card footer */}
                <div className="p-3">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-2">
                    <span className={`text-[10px] font-semibold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full ${typeBadge[b.banner_type] ?? ""}`}>
                      {b.banner_type}
                    </span>
                    {b.effect && (
                      <span className="text-[9px] px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-surface-2 text-text-muted">✦ {b.effect}</span>
                    )}
                    <span className="ml-auto text-[10px] text-text-faint">#{b.sort_order}</span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 flex-wrap">
                    <button onClick={() => openEdit(b)}
                      className="flex items-center gap-1 px-2 py-1 rounded-lg text-[11px] font-medium bg-surface-2 text-text-muted hover:bg-surface-1 transition-colors">
                      <Pencil className="w-3 h-3" />Edit
                    </button>
                    <button onClick={() => triggerImageUpload(b.id)} disabled={uploadingId === b.id}
                      className="flex items-center gap-1 px-2 py-1 rounded-lg text-[11px] font-medium bg-surface-2 text-text-muted hover:bg-surface-1 transition-colors disabled:opacity-50">
                      <Upload className="w-3 h-3" />{uploadingId === b.id ? "…" : "Image"}
                    </button>
                    <button onClick={() => deleteBanner(b.id)}
                      className="flex items-center gap-1 px-2 py-1 rounded-lg text-[11px] font-medium bg-danger/10 text-danger hover:bg-danger/20 transition-colors ml-auto">
                      <Trash2 className="w-3 h-3" />Delete
                    </button>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </motion.div>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* ── CREATE / EDIT MODAL ───────────────────────── */}
      {showForm && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-start justify-center theme-overlay p-4 overflow-y-auto">
          <motion.div initial={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.95 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, scale: 1 }}
            className="theme-modal-shell w-full max-w-2xl rounded-xl my-4 overflow-hidden">

            {/* modal header */}
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between px-5 py-4 border-b border-border">
              <h2 className="text-base font-semibold text-text">{editingId ? "Edit Banner" : "New Banner"}</h2>
              <button onClick={closeForm} className="p-1 rounded-lg hover:bg-surface-2 text-text-muted">
                <X className="w-4 h-4" />
              </button>
            </div>

            <div className="flex gap-0 lg:flex-row flex-col">
              {/* ── left panel: form ── */}
              <div className="flex-1 p-5 overflow-y-auto max-h-[80vh]">
                {error && <p className="text-xs text-danger mb-3 bg-danger/10 rounded-lg px-3 py-2">{error}</p>}

                {/* tab nav */}
                <div className="theme-panel flex rounded-xl border p-1 mb-4">
                  {(["content", "appearance"] as const).map((tab) => (
                    <button key={tab} onClick={() => setActiveTab(tab)}
                      className={`flex-1 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium rounded-lg capitalize transition-colors ${activeTab === tab ? "theme-card text-text shadow-sm" : "text-text-muted"}`}>
                      {tab}
                    </button>
                  ))}
                </div>

                {activeTab === "content" && (
                  <div className="space-y-3">
                    {/* Banner Type */}
                    <div>
                      <label className="text-xs font-medium text-text-muted mb-1 block">Banner Type *</label>
                      <div className="grid grid-cols-4 gap-2">
                        {(["hero", "seasonal", "promotional", "flash"] as const).map((t) => (
                          <button key={t} onClick={() => f({ banner_type: t })}
                            className={`py-1.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold capitalize transition-colors border ${form.banner_type === t ? "border-primary bg-primary/10 text-primary" : "border-border bg-surface-2 text-text-muted"}`}>
                            {t}
                          </button>
                        ))}
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    {/* Title */}
                    <div>
                      <label className="text-xs font-medium text-text-muted mb-1 block">Title *</label>
                      <input value={form.title} onChange={(e) => f({ title: e.target.value })}
                        className="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface-1 text-xs text-text focus:outline-none focus:border-primary"
                        placeholder="Summer Collection" />
                    </div>

                    {/* Subtitle */}
                    <div>
                      <label className="text-xs font-medium text-text-muted mb-1 block">Subtitle</label>
                      <input value={form.subtitle} onChange={(e) => f({ subtitle: e.target.value })}
                        className="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface-1 text-xs text-text focus:outline-none focus:border-primary"
                        placeholder="Discover the latest trends" />
                    </div>

                    {/* Badge */}
                    <div>
                      <label className="text-xs font-medium text-text-muted mb-1 block">Badge Label</label>
                      <input value={form.badge_text} onChange={(e) => f({ badge_text: e.target.value })}
                        className="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface-1 text-xs text-text focus:outline-none focus:border-primary"
                        placeholder="Flash Sale · Hot · New Arrival" />
                    </div>

                    {/* CTA */}
                    <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                      <div>
                        <label className="text-xs font-medium text-text-muted mb-1 block">CTA Label</label>
                        <input value={form.cta_label} onChange={(e) => f({ cta_label: e.target.value })}
                          className="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface-1 text-xs text-text focus:outline-none focus:border-primary"
                          placeholder="Shop Now" />
                      </div>
                      <div>
                        <label className="text-xs font-medium text-text-muted mb-1 block">CTA URL</label>
                        <input value={form.cta_url} onChange={(e) => f({ cta_url: e.target.value })}
                          className="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface-1 text-xs text-text focus:outline-none focus:border-primary"
                          placeholder="/products" />
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    {/* Image URL */}
                    <div>
                      <label className="text-xs font-medium text-text-muted mb-1 block">Image URL</label>
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">

                            className="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface-1 text-xs text-text focus:outline-none focus:border-primary"

                          <button
```
