```text
          window.history.replaceState({}, "", "/checkout");
        }

        if (finalStatus === "confirmed") {
          clearCart();
          setSuccess(true);
          addToast("Thawani Pay payment confirmed. Your order has been placed.", "success");
          return;
        }
        if (finalStatus === "failed") {
          setError("Thawani Pay payment was not completed. You can retry checkout or review the order in My Orders.");
          return;
        }
        setError("Thawani Pay payment is still being verified. Check My Orders shortly for the final status.");
        addToast("Thawani Pay payment is still being verified in the background.", "info");
      } catch (err) {
        if (cancelled) return;
        setHandledThawaniRedirectOrderId(thawaniOrderId);
        if (typeof window !== "undefined") {
          window.history.replaceState({}, "", "/checkout");
        }
        setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Could not verify Thawani payment.");
      } finally {
        if (!cancelled) setProcessing(false);
      }
    };

    void verifyThawaniRedirectOrder();
    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
    };
  }, [addToast, clearCart, handledThawaniRedirectOrderId, isLoggedIn, searchParams]);

  const confirmCardPaymentOnBackend = async (orderId: number, paymentIntentId?: string): Promise<"confirmed" | "pending"> => {
    for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 5; attempt += 1) {
      const response = await apiFetch("/payments/confirm-card-payment", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          order_id: orderId,
          payment_intent_id: paymentIntentId,
        }),
      });
      const payload = await response.json().catch(() => null);

      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error(payload?.detail || "Could not confirm payment with Zozi.");
      }

      if (payload?.status === "confirmed") return "confirmed";
      if (payload?.status === "failed") {
        throw new Error("Payment verification failed. Please retry checkout or contact support.");
      }

      if (attempt < 4) {
        await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, (attempt + 1) * 700));
      }
    }
    return "pending";
  };

  const handleCardSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!paymentMethods.card.enabled) {
      setError("Card payments are not configured yet.");
      return;
    }
    if (!stripe || !elements) {
      setError("Card payments are not configured yet.");
      return;
    }
    setError("");
    setProcessing(true);

    try {
      const order = await createOrder("card");

      const piRes = await apiFetch("/payments/create-payment-intent", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          order_id: order.id,
          currency: currency.code,
          country: deliveryDetails.country,
        }),
      });

      if (!piRes.ok) {
        const detail = await piRes.json().catch(() => null);
        setError(detail?.detail || "Could not create payment. Please try again.");
        return;
      }

      const { client_secret } = await piRes.json();

      const { error: stripeErr, paymentIntent } = await stripe.confirmCardPayment(
        client_secret,
        {
          payment_method: {
            card: elements.getElement(CardElement)!,
            billing_details: { name: deliveryDetails.fullName },
          },
        }
      );

      if (stripeErr) {
        setError(stripeErr.message || "Payment failed");
        return;
      }

      const confirmationStatus = await confirmCardPaymentOnBackend(order.id, paymentIntent?.id);
      clearCart();
      setSuccess(true);
      if (confirmationStatus === "confirmed") {
        addToast("Order placed successfully!", "success");
      } else {
        addToast("Payment received. Final order confirmation is processing in the background.", "info");
      }
    } catch {
      setError("An unexpected error occurred.");
    } finally {
      setProcessing(false);
    }
  };

  const handleCashOnDeliverySubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setError("");
    setProcessing(true);

    try {
      await createOrder("cod");
      clearCart();
      setSuccess(true);
      addToast("Cash on delivery order placed successfully!", "success");
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : "An unexpected error occurred.");
    } finally {
      setProcessing(false);
    }
  };

  const handleTapSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!paymentMethods.tap.enabled) {
      setError("Tap payments are not configured yet.");
      return;
    }
    setError("");
    setProcessing(true);
    try {
      const order = await createOrder("tap");
      const tapSuccessUrl = `${window.location.origin}/checkout?tap_order_id=${order.id}`;
      const tapRes = await apiFetch("/payments/tap/create", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          order_id: order.id,
          currency: currency.code,
          country: deliveryDetails.country,
          success_url: tapSuccessUrl,
        }),
      });
      if (tapRes.ok) {
        const tapData = await tapRes.json();
        if (tapData.redirect_url) {
          window.location.href = tapData.redirect_url;
          return;
        }
        setError("Could not get Tap redirect URL.");
        return;
      }

      const detail = await tapRes.json().catch(() => null);
      setError(detail?.detail || "Tap payment failed.");
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : "An unexpected error occurred.");
    } finally {
      setProcessing(false);
    }
  };

  const handlePayTabsSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!paymentMethods.paytabs.enabled) {
      setError("PayTabs is not configured yet.");
      return;
    }
    setError("");
    setProcessing(true);
    try {
      const order = await createOrder("paytabs");
      const payTabsSuccessUrl = `${window.location.origin}/checkout?paytabs_order_id=${order.id}`;
      const payTabsRes = await apiFetch("/payments/paytabs/create", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          order_id: order.id,
          currency: currency.code,
          country: deliveryDetails.country,
          success_url: payTabsSuccessUrl,
        }),
      });
      if (payTabsRes.ok) {
        const payTabsData = await payTabsRes.json();
        if (payTabsData.redirect_url) {
          window.location.href = payTabsData.redirect_url;
          return;
        }
        setError("Could not get PayTabs redirect URL.");
        return;
      }

      const detail = await payTabsRes.json().catch(() => null);
      setError(detail?.detail || "PayTabs payment failed.");
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : "An unexpected error occurred.");
    } finally {
      setProcessing(false);
    }
  };

  const handleThawaniSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!paymentMethods.thawani.enabled) {
      setError("Thawani Pay is not configured yet.");
      return;
    }
    setError("");
    setProcessing(true);
    try {
      const order = await createOrder("thawani");
      const thawaniSuccessUrl = `${window.location.origin}/checkout?thawani_order_id=${order.id}`;
      const thawaniRes = await apiFetch("/payments/thawani/checkout", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          order_id: order.id,
          currency: currency.code,
          country: deliveryDetails.country,
          success_url: thawaniSuccessUrl,
          cancel_url: `${window.location.origin}/checkout`,
        }),
      });
      if (thawaniRes.ok) {
        const thawaniData = await thawaniRes.json();
        if (thawaniData.checkout_url) {
          window.location.href = thawaniData.checkout_url;
          return;
        }
        setError("Could not get Thawani checkout URL.");
        return;
      }
      const detail = await thawaniRes.json().catch(() => null);
      setError(detail?.detail || "Thawani Pay checkout failed.");
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : "An unexpected error occurred.");
    } finally {
      setProcessing(false);
    }
  };

  if (success) {
    return (
      <motion.div
        initial={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.95 }}
        animate={{ opacity: 1, scale: 1 }}
        className="text-center py-16"
      >
        <div className="theme-alert-success mx-auto mb-4 flex h-16 w-16 items-center justify-center rounded-full">
          <CheckCircle className="theme-status-success h-8 w-8" />
        </div>
        <h2 className="text-xl font-bold text-text mb-2">Order Confirmed!</h2>
        <p className="text-text-muted text-xs mb-6">
          Your order has been placed successfully. You can track fulfilment from your orders page.
        </p>
        <div className="flex gap-3 justify-center">
          <button
            onClick={() => orderId ? router.push(`/orders/${orderId}`) : router.push("/orders")}
            className="theme-btn-primary rounded-xl px-5 py-2.5 text-xs font-bold"
          >
            View Order Details
          </button>
          <button
            onClick={() => router.push("/orders")}
            className="theme-btn-secondary rounded-xl border px-5 py-2.5 text-xs font-bold"
          >
            {tr("myOrders")}
          </button>
        </div>
      </motion.div>
    );
  }

  // ── Mini order summary (shown on all steps) ────────────────────────────────
  const renderOrderSummaryPanel = () => (
    <div className="glass-panel p-4 space-y-2">
      <h3 className="text-xs font-bold text-text mb-3">{tr("orderSummary")}</h3>
      {items.slice(0, 3).map((item) => (
        <div key={item.line_id} className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs">
          <span className="text-text-muted truncate max-w-40">
            {item.name} × {item.quantity}
            {(item.selected_size || item.selected_color) ? ` (${[item.selected_size, item.selected_color].filter(Boolean).join(" / ")})` : ""}
          </span>
          <span className="font-medium text-text">
            {formatPrice(Number(item.price ?? 0) * item.quantity)}
          </span>
        </div>
      ))}
      {items.length > 3 && (
        <p className="text-[11px] text-text-faint">+{items.length - 3} more items</p>
      )}
      <div className="border-t border-border pt-2 space-y-1">
        <div className="flex justify-between text-xs text-text-muted">
          <span>{tr("subtotal")}</span>
          <span>{formatPrice(subtotal)}</span>
        </div>
        {discountAmount > 0 && (
          <div className="theme-status-success flex justify-between text-xs">
            <span>Coupon discount</span>
            <span>-{formatPrice(discountAmount)}</span>
          </div>
        )}
        <div className="flex justify-between text-xs text-text-muted">
          <span>{tr("shipping")}</span>
          <span>{formatPrice(shippingAmount)}</span>
        </div>
        {shippingQuote?.source === "approved_logistics_partner" && shippingQuote.partner_name && !serverOrder ? (
          <div className="flex justify-between text-[11px] text-text-faint">
            <span>Logistics rate</span>
            <span>{shippingQuote.partner_name}</span>
          </div>
        ) : null}
        {shippingQuote?.source === "approved_logistics_partner" && !serverOrder && (
          shippingQuote.estimated_delivery_min != null || shippingQuote.estimated_delivery_max != null
        ) ? (
          <div className="flex justify-between text-[11px] text-text-faint">
            <span>Estimated delivery</span>
            <span>
              {shippingQuote.estimated_delivery_min ?? "?"}-{shippingQuote.estimated_delivery_max ?? "?"} days
            </span>
          </div>
        ) : null}
        <div className="flex justify-between text-xs text-text-muted">
          <span>{vatLabel}</span>
          <span>{formatPrice(vatAmount)}</span>
        </div>
        {paymentMethod !== "cod" && finalGatewayFee > 0 ? (
          <div className="flex justify-between text-xs text-text-muted">
            <span>
              {selectedMethodMeta.label || paymentMethod}
              {finalGatewayFeePassedToCustomer ? " fee" : " fee (covered by Zozi)"}
            </span>
            <span>{formatPrice(finalGatewayFee)}</span>
          </div>
        ) : null}
        <div className="flex justify-between text-sm font-bold text-text border-t border-border pt-2 mt-1">
          <span>{finalGatewayFeePassedToCustomer ? "Customer pays" : tr("total")}</span>
          <span>{formatPrice(finalCustomerTotal)}</span>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
        <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-3 justify-center glass-panel p-3">
        <span className="trust-badge"><Lock className="w-3 h-3 text-primary" /> SSL Protected</span>
        <span className="trust-badge"><CheckCircle className="w-3 h-3 text-primary" /> Secure Payment</span>
        <span className="trust-badge"><Shield className="w-3 h-3 text-primary/70" /> Verified Supplier</span>
      </div>
      <StepIndicator step={step} />

      {error && (
        <div className="theme-alert-danger flex items-center gap-2 rounded-xl p-3 text-xs">
          <AlertCircle className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0" />
          {error}
        </div>
      )}

      <AnimatePresence mode="wait">
        {/* ── Step 1: Cart Review + Coupon ────────────────────────────────── */}
        {step === 1 && (
          <motion.div
            key="step1"
            initial={{ opacity: 0, x: 20 }}
            animate={{ opacity: 1, x: 0 }}
            exit={{ opacity: 0, x: -20 }}
            className="space-y-4"
          >
            {/* Cart items */}
            <div className="glass-panel p-4 space-y-3">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-1">
                <ShoppingBag className="w-4 h-4 text-primary" />
                <h3 className="text-xs font-bold text-text">
                  Your Cart ({items.length} item{items.length !== 1 ? "s" : ""})
                </h3>
              </div>
              {items.length === 0 ? (
                <p className="text-xs text-text-muted">Your cart is empty.</p>
              ) : (
                items.map((item) => (
                  <div key={item.line_id} className="flex items-center gap-3">
                    {item.image_url && (
                      <Image
                        src={resolveImage(item.image_url)}
                        alt={item.name}
                        width={40}
                        height={40}
                        className="h-10 w-10 rounded-lg bg-border object-cover"
                      />
                    )}
                    <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                      <p className="text-xs font-medium text-text truncate">{item.name}</p>
                      <p className="text-[11px] text-text-muted">Qty: {item.quantity}</p>
                    </div>
                    <span className="text-xs font-bold text-text">
                      {formatPrice(Number(item.price ?? 0) * item.quantity)}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                ))
              )}
            </div>

            {/* Coupon */}
            <div className="glass-panel p-4">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-3">
                <Tag className="theme-status-warning h-4 w-4" />
                <h3 className="text-xs font-bold text-text">{tr("couponCode")}</h3>
              </div>
              <div className="flex gap-2">
                <input
                  value={couponCode}
                  onChange={(e) => {
                    setCouponCode(e.target.value);
                    setCouponResult(null);
                    setCouponError("");
                  }}
                  placeholder="Enter coupon code"
                  className="theme-input flex-1 rounded-xl border px-3 py-2 text-xs uppercase focus:border-primary focus:outline-none transition-colors"
                />
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={applyCoupon}
                  disabled={couponLoading || !couponCode.trim()}
                  className="theme-btn-primary rounded-xl px-4 py-2 text-xs font-bold disabled:opacity-50"
                >
                  {couponLoading ? "..." : tr("applyCoupon")}
                </button>
              </div>
              {couponError && <p className="theme-status-danger mt-2 text-[11px]">{couponError}</p>}
              {couponResult && (
                <p className="theme-status-success mt-2 text-[11px]">
                  ✓ Saved {formatPrice(couponResult.discount_amount)}
                </p>
              )}
            </div>

            {renderOrderSummaryPanel()}

            <button
              onClick={handleNext}
              disabled={items.length === 0}
              className="theme-btn-primary flex w-full items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl py-3 text-sm font-bold disabled:opacity-50"
            >
              Continue to Shipping
              <ChevronRight className="w-4 h-4" />
            </button>
          </motion.div>
        )}

        {/* ── Step 2: Shipping Address ─────────────────────────────────────── */}
        {step === 2 && (
          <motion.div
            key="step2"
            initial={{ opacity: 0, x: 20 }}
            animate={{ opacity: 1, x: 0 }}
            exit={{ opacity: 0, x: -20 }}
            className="space-y-4"
          >
            <div className="glass-panel p-4 space-y-3">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-1">
                <MapPin className="theme-status-info h-4 w-4 text-primary" />
                <h3 className="text-xs font-bold text-text">{tr("shippingAddress")}</h3>
              </div>
              {(
                [
                  ["fullName", tr("fullName"), "text"],
                  ["street", tr("streetAddress"), "text"],
                  ["city", tr("city"), "text"],
                  ["zip", tr("zipCode"), "text"],
                  ["country", tr("country"), "text"],
                ] as const
              ).map(([key, label]) => (
                <div key={key}>
                  <label className="mb-1 block text-[11px] text-text-muted">{label}</label>
                  <input
                    value={deliveryDetails[key]}
                    onChange={(e) => updateDeliveryField(key, e.target.value)}
                    className="theme-input w-full rounded-xl border px-3 py-2 text-xs focus:border-primary focus:outline-none transition-colors"
                  />
                </div>
              ))}

              <div>
                <label className="mb-1 block text-[11px] text-text-muted">Phone</label>
                <input
                  value={deliveryDetails.phone}
                  onChange={(e) => updateDeliveryField("phone", e.target.value)}
                  className="theme-input w-full rounded-xl border px-3 py-2 text-xs focus:border-primary focus:outline-none transition-colors"
                />
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="mb-1 block text-[11px] text-text-muted">Current Location</label>
                <div className="flex gap-2">
                  <input
                    value={deliveryDetails.deliveryLocation}
                    onChange={(e) => updateDeliveryField("deliveryLocation", e.target.value)}
                    placeholder="Latitude, Longitude or landmark"
                    className="theme-input flex-1 rounded-xl border px-3 py-2 text-xs focus:border-primary focus:outline-none transition-colors"
                  />
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => {
                      if (!navigator.geolocation) {
                        setError("Geolocation is not supported on this device.");
                        return;
                      }
                      navigator.geolocation.getCurrentPosition(
                        (position) => {
                          updateDeliveryField(
                            "deliveryLocation",
                            `${position.coords.latitude.toFixed(5)}, ${position.coords.longitude.toFixed(5)}`
                          );
                          setError("");
                        },
                        () => setError("Could not access your current location."),
                        { enableHighAccuracy: true, timeout: 10000 }
                      );
                    }}
                    className="rounded-xl border border-border px-3 py-2 text-[11px] font-semibold text-text-muted hover:text-text hover:border-primary/40 transition-colors"
                  >
                    Use Current Location
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="mb-1 block text-[11px] text-text-muted">Delivery Description</label>
                <textarea
                  value={deliveryDetails.deliveryNote}
                  onChange={(e) => updateDeliveryField("deliveryNote", e.target.value)}
                  rows={3}
                  placeholder="Add gate code, floor, landmark, or any delivery note"
                  className="theme-input w-full rounded-xl border px-3 py-2 text-xs focus:border-primary focus:outline-none transition-colors resize-none"
                />
              </div>
            </div>

            {renderOrderSummaryPanel()}

            <div className="flex gap-3">
              <button
                onClick={handleBack}
                className="theme-btn-secondary flex flex-1 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl border py-3 text-sm font-bold"
              >
                <ChevronLeft className="w-4 h-4" />
                Back
              </button>
              <button
                onClick={handleNext}
                className="theme-btn-primary flex flex-1 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl py-3 text-sm font-bold"
              >
                Continue to Payment
                <ChevronRight className="w-4 h-4" />
              </button>
            </div>
          </motion.div>
        )}

        {/* ── Step 3: Payment ──────────────────────────────────────────────── */}
        {step === 3 && (
          <motion.div
            key="step3"
            initial={{ opacity: 0, x: 20 }}
            animate={{ opacity: 1, x: 0 }}
            exit={{ opacity: 0, x: -20 }}
            className="space-y-4"
          >
            {/* Payment method selector */}
            <div className="glass-panel p-4">
              <h3 className="text-xs font-bold text-text mb-3">{tr("paymentMethod")}</h3>
              {paymentMethodsLoading ? (
                <p className="text-[11px] text-text-faint">Loading payment methods...</p>
              ) : null}
              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-3 sm:grid-cols-3">
                {([
                  { id: "cod" as PaymentMethod, label: paymentMethods.cod.label || "Cash on Delivery", Icon: Banknote },
                  { id: "card" as PaymentMethod, label: paymentMethods.card.label || "Credit / Debit Card", Icon: CreditCard },
                  { id: "tap" as PaymentMethod, label: paymentMethods.tap.label || "Tap Payments", Icon: Smartphone },
                  { id: "paytabs" as PaymentMethod, label: paymentMethods.paytabs.label || "PayTabs", Icon: CreditCard },
                  { id: "thawani" as PaymentMethod, label: paymentMethods.thawani.label || "Thawani Pay", Icon: CreditCard },
                ] as const).map(({ id, label, Icon }) => (
                  <button
                    key={id}
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => {
                      if (paymentMethods[id].enabled) {
                        setPaymentMethod(id);
                        setError("");
                      }
                    }}
                    disabled={!paymentMethods[id].enabled}
                    className={`flex items-center gap-2 rounded-xl border p-3 text-left text-xs font-medium transition-colors ${
                      paymentMethod === id
                        ? "theme-chip-brand"
                        : paymentMethods[id].enabled
                        ? "border-border text-text-muted hover:border-primary/40"
                        : "border-border/70 text-text-faint opacity-60"
                    }`}
                  >
                    <Icon className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0" />
                    <span className="flex-1">
                      <span className="block">{label}</span>
                      <span className="mt-1 block text-[10px] font-normal text-text-faint">
                        {paymentMethods[id].detail}
                      </span>
                    </span>
                  </button>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>

            {paymentMethod === "cod" && (
              <form onSubmit={handleCashOnDeliverySubmit}>
                <div className="glass-panel p-4 mb-4">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <Banknote className="theme-status-success h-4 w-4 text-success" />
                    <h3 className="text-xs font-bold text-text">Cash on Delivery</h3>
                  </div>
                  <p className="mt-2 text-xs text-text-muted">
                    Place your order now and pay the courier when the shipment arrives. Tap checkout redirects you to Tap's hosted payment page and confirms the order after the payment webhook is received.
                  </p>
                </div>

                {renderOrderSummaryPanel()}

                <div className="flex gap-3 mt-4">
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={handleBack}
                    className="theme-btn-secondary flex items-center gap-2 rounded-xl border px-5 py-3 text-sm font-bold"
                  >
                    <ChevronLeft className="w-4 h-4" />
                    Back
                  </button>
                  <button
                    type="submit"
                    disabled={processing}
                    className="btn-place-order flex flex-1 items-center justify-center gap-2 py-3 text-sm font-bold disabled:opacity-50"
                  >
                    {processing ? (
                      <div className="btn-spinner" />
                    ) : (
                      <Banknote className="w-4 h-4" />
                    )}
                    {processing ? "Placing Order..." : `Place COD Order ${formatPrice(finalTotal)}`}
                  </button>
                </div>
              </form>
            )}

            {/* Card element (Stripe) */}
            {paymentMethod === "card" && (
              <form onSubmit={handleCardSubmit}>
                <div className="glass-panel space-y-3 p-4 mb-4">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <CreditCard className="theme-status-info h-4 w-4 text-primary" />
                    <h3 className="text-xs font-bold text-text">{tr("cardDetails")}</h3>
                  </div>
                  <div className="theme-input rounded-xl border p-2.5">
                    <CardElement options={cardStyle} />
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-1 text-[11px] text-text-faint">
                    <Lock className="w-3 h-3" />
                    Secured by Stripe — card data is never stored.
                  </div>
                </div>

                {renderOrderSummaryPanel()}

                <div className="flex gap-3 mt-4">
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={handleBack}
                    className="theme-btn-secondary flex items-center gap-2 rounded-xl border px-5 py-3 text-sm font-bold"
                  >
                    <ChevronLeft className="w-4 h-4" />
                    Back
                  </button>
                  <button
                    type="submit"
                    disabled={processing || !stripe || !paymentMethods.card.enabled}
                    className="btn-place-order flex flex-1 items-center justify-center gap-2 py-3 text-sm font-bold disabled:opacity-50"
                  >
                    {processing ? (
                      <div className="btn-spinner" />
                    ) : (
                      <Lock className="w-4 h-4" />
                    )}
                    {processing ? tr("processingBtn") : `${tr("payNow")} ${formatPrice(finalCustomerTotal)}`}
                  </button>
                </div>
              </form>
            )}

            {/* Tap Payments redirect */}
            {paymentMethod === "tap" && (
              <form onSubmit={handleTapSubmit}>
                <div className="glass-panel p-4 mb-4">
                  <p className="text-xs text-text-muted">
                    You will be redirected to Tap Payments to complete your payment securely.
                  </p>
                </div>

                {renderOrderSummaryPanel()}

                <div className="flex gap-3 mt-4">
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={handleBack}
                    className="theme-btn-secondary flex items-center gap-2 rounded-xl border px-5 py-3 text-sm font-bold"
                  >
                    <ChevronLeft className="w-4 h-4" />
                    Back
                  </button>
                  <button
                    type="submit"
                    disabled={processing || !paymentMethods.tap.enabled}
                    className="btn-place-order flex flex-1 items-center justify-center gap-2 py-3 text-sm font-bold disabled:opacity-50"
                  >
                    {processing ? (
                      <div className="btn-spinner" />
                    ) : (
                      <Smartphone className="w-4 h-4" />
                    )}
                    {processing ? "Redirecting..." : `Pay ${formatPrice(finalCustomerTotal)} via Tap`}
                  </button>
                </div>
              </form>
            )}

            {paymentMethod === "paytabs" && (
              <form onSubmit={handlePayTabsSubmit}>
                <div className="glass-panel p-4 mb-4">
                  <p className="text-xs text-text-muted">
                    You will be redirected to PayTabs to complete your payment securely.
                  </p>
                </div>

                {renderOrderSummaryPanel()}

                <div className="flex gap-3 mt-4">
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={handleBack}
                    className="theme-btn-secondary flex items-center gap-2 rounded-xl border px-5 py-3 text-sm font-bold"
                  >
                    <ChevronLeft className="w-4 h-4" />
                    Back
                  </button>
                  <button
                    type="submit"
                    disabled={processing || !paymentMethods.paytabs.enabled}
                    className="btn-place-order flex flex-1 items-center justify-center gap-2 py-3 text-sm font-bold disabled:opacity-50"
                  >
                    {processing ? (
                      <div className="btn-spinner" />
                    ) : (
                      <CreditCard className="w-4 h-4" />
                    )}
                    {processing ? "Redirecting..." : `Pay ${formatPrice(finalCustomerTotal)} via PayTabs`}
                  </button>
                </div>
              </form>
            )}

            {paymentMethod === "thawani" && (
              <form onSubmit={handleThawaniSubmit}>
                <div className="glass-panel p-4 mb-4">
                  <p className="text-xs text-text-muted">
                    You will be redirected to Thawani Pay to complete your payment securely.
                  </p>
                  <p className="text-[11px] text-text-faint mt-1">
                    Amount is processed in your active checkout currency ({currency.code}).
                  </p>
                </div>

                {renderOrderSummaryPanel()}

                <div className="flex gap-3 mt-4">
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={handleBack}
                    className="theme-btn-secondary flex items-center gap-2 rounded-xl border px-5 py-3 text-sm font-bold"
                  >
                    <ChevronLeft className="w-4 h-4" />
                    Back
                  </button>
                  <button
                    type="submit"
                    disabled={processing || !paymentMethods.thawani.enabled}
                    className="btn-place-order flex flex-1 items-center justify-center gap-2 py-3 text-sm font-bold disabled:opacity-50"
                  >
                    {processing ? (
                      <div className="btn-spinner" />
                    ) : (
                      <CreditCard className="w-4 h-4" />
                    )}
                    {processing ? "Redirecting to Thawani..." : `Pay via Thawani Pay`}
                  </button>
                </div>
              </form>
            )}
          </motion.div>
        )}
      </AnimatePresence>
    </div>
  );
}

export default function CheckoutPage() {
  const tr = useLocaleStore((s) => s.t);
  return (
    <main className="min-h-screen">
      <div className="max-w-lg mx-auto px-4 py-8">
        <motion.h1
          initial={{ opacity: 0, y: -10 }}
          animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
          className="text-xl font-bold text-text mb-6"
        >
          {tr("checkout")}
        </motion.h1>
        <Elements stripe={stripePromise}>
          <CheckoutForm />
        </Elements>
      </div>
    </main>
  );
}
```

```text
﻿"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { Mail, ArrowLeft, CheckCircle } from "@/lib/icons";
import Link from "next/link";
import { apiFetch } from "@/lib/api";

export default function ForgotPasswordPage() {
  const [email, setEmail] = useState("");
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [sent, setSent] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setError("");
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const res = await apiFetch("/auth/forgot-password", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ email }),
      });
      if (res.ok) {
        setSent(true);
      } else {
        const d = await res.json();
        setError(d.detail || "Something went wrong.");
      }
    } catch {
      setError("Network error. Please try again.");
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <main className="flex min-h-screen items-center justify-center bg-surface-base px-4 text-text">
      <div className="theme-card w-full max-w-sm rounded-2xl border p-8">
        <Link
          href="/login"
          className="mb-6 inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs text-text-muted transition-colors hover:text-text"
        >
          <ArrowLeft className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> Back to Login
        </Link>

        {sent ? (
          <div className="text-center">
            <CheckCircle className="theme-status-success mx-auto mb-4 h-12 w-12" />
            <h1 className="mb-2 text-lg font-bold text-text">Check your email</h1>
            <p className="text-sm text-text-muted">
              If <span className="text-text">{email}</span> is registered, we&apos;ve sent a
              password reset link. Check your inbox (and spam folder).
            </p>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <>
            <h1 className="mb-1 text-xl font-bold text-text">Forgot Password</h1>
            <p className="mb-6 text-sm text-text-muted">
              Enter your email and we&apos;ll send you a reset link.
            </p>

            {error && (
              <div className="theme-alert-danger mb-4 rounded-xl p-3 text-xs">
                {error}
              </div>
            )}

            <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-4">
              <div>
                <label htmlFor="forgot-email" className="mb-1 block text-xs font-semibold text-text-muted">
                  Email Address
                </label>
                <div className="relative">
                  <Mail className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 w-4 h-4 text-primary/50" />
                  <input
                    id="forgot-email"
                    name="email"
                    type="email"
                    value={email}
                    required
                    onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)}
                    placeholder="you@example.com"
                    className="theme-input w-full rounded-xl border py-2.5 pl-9 pr-3 text-sm focus:border-primary focus:outline-none transition-colors"
                  />
                </div>
              </div>

              <button
                type="submit"
                disabled={loading}
                className="theme-btn-primary w-full rounded-xl py-2.5 text-sm font-bold disabled:opacity-50"
              >
                {loading ? "Sending…" : "Send Reset Link"}
              </button>
            </form>
          </>
        )}
      </div>
    </main>
  );
}
```

### `frontend\web_app\src\app\help\page.tsx`

```text
﻿"use client";

import { useState, useEffect, useCallback } from "react";
import { motion, AnimatePresence } from "framer-motion";
import { MessageSquare, Send, ChevronDown, CheckCircle, Clock, AlertCircle } from "@/lib/icons";

const MotionDiv: any = motion.div;

import { apiFetch } from "@/lib/api";
import { connectUserRealtimeSocket, isTicketRealtimeMessage } from "@/lib/userRealtime";
import { useAuth } from "@/lib/useAuth";
import { createRealtimeRefreshScheduler } from "@shared/realtime";

interface Ticket {
  id: number;
  subject: string;
  status: string;
  priority: string;
  created_at: string;
  reply_count?: number;
}

const STATUS_ICON: Record<string, React.ReactNode> = {
  open: <Clock className="theme-status-info h-3.5 w-3.5" />,
  in_progress: <AlertCircle className="theme-status-warning h-3.5 w-3.5" />,
  closed: <CheckCircle className="theme-status-success h-3.5 w-3.5" />,
};

const STATUS_COLOR: Record<string, string> = {
  open: "theme-chip-info",
  in_progress: "theme-chip-warning",
  closed: "theme-chip-success",
};

export default function HelpPage() {
  const [subject, setSubject] = useState("");
  const [message, setMessage] = useState("");
  const [priority, setPriority] = useState("normal");
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [success, setSuccess] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const [tickets, setTickets] = useState<Ticket[]>([]);
  const [ticketsLoading, setTicketsLoading] = useState(false);
  const { isLoggedIn } = useAuth();

  const fetchTickets = useCallback(async () => {
    setTicketsLoading(true);
    try {
      const res = await apiFetch("/tickets");
      if (!res.ok) return;
      const data = await res.json();
      setTickets(Array.isArray(data) ? data : data.tickets ?? []);
    } catch {
      // silently ignore — user may not be logged in
    } finally {
      setTicketsLoading(false);
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isLoggedIn) {
      void fetchTickets();
    }
  }, [fetchTickets, isLoggedIn]);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isLoggedIn) {
      return;
    }

    const scheduler = createRealtimeRefreshScheduler(fetchTickets);

    const socket = connectUserRealtimeSocket(
      () => undefined,
      (payload) => {
        if (isTicketRealtimeMessage(payload)) {
          scheduler.trigger();
        }
      },
    );

    return () => {
      scheduler.cancel();
      socket?.close();
    };
  }, [fetchTickets, isLoggedIn]);

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!subject.trim() || !message.trim()) return;

    setSubmitting(true);
    setError("");
    try {
      const res = await apiFetch("/tickets", {
        method: "POST",
        body: JSON.stringify({ subject: subject.trim(), message: message.trim(), priority }),
      });
      if (!res.ok) {
        const payload = await res.json().catch(() => null);
        setError(payload?.detail || payload?.message || "Failed to submit ticket. Please try again.");
        return;
      }
      setSuccess(true);
      setSubject("");
      setMessage("");
      setPriority("normal");
      fetchTickets();
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      const apiErr = err as { detail?: string; message?: string };
      setError(apiErr?.detail ?? apiErr?.message ?? "Failed to submit ticket. Please try again.");
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <main className="min-h-screen bg-surface-base py-12 px-4">
        <div className="max-w-2xl mx-auto space-y-8">
          {/* Hero */}
          <div className="text-center">
            <div className="theme-chip-brand mb-4 inline-flex h-14 w-14 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl">
              <MessageSquare className="theme-status-info h-7 w-7 text-primary" />
            </div>
            <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-text">Help &amp; Support</h1>
            <p className="text-text-muted mt-1 text-sm">Our team typically responds within a few hours.</p>
          </div>

          {/* Support form */}
          <MotionDiv
            initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 12 }}
            animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
            className="theme-card border rounded-2xl p-6"
          >
            <h2 className="text-sm font-bold text-text mb-5">Submit a Request</h2>

            <AnimatePresence>
              {success && (
                <MotionDiv
                  initial={{ opacity: 0, y: -8 }}
                  animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
                  exit={{ opacity: 0 }}
                  className="theme-alert-success mb-5 flex items-center gap-3 rounded-xl p-4"
                >
                  <CheckCircle className="theme-status-success h-5 w-5 shrink-0" />
                  <div>
                    <p className="theme-status-success text-sm font-semibold">Ticket Submitted!</p>
                    <p className="text-xs text-text-muted mt-0.5">
                      We&apos;ll get back to you as soon as possible.
                    </p>
                  </div>
                </MotionDiv>
              )}
            </AnimatePresence>

            {!isLoggedIn && (
              <div className="theme-alert-warning mb-5 rounded-xl p-4">
                <p className="theme-status-warning text-sm font-medium">Please log in to submit a support ticket.</p>
              </div>
            )}

            <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-4">
              <div>
                <label htmlFor="ticket-subject" className="block text-xs font-semibold text-text-muted mb-1.5">
                  Subject <span className="theme-status-danger">*</span>
                </label>
                <input
                  id="ticket-subject"
                  value={subject}
                  onChange={(e) => setSubject(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="Brief description of your issue..."
                  maxLength={200}
                  required
                  disabled={!isLoggedIn || submitting}
                  className="w-full px-4 py-2.5 rounded-xl theme-input border text-text text-sm focus:outline-none focus:border-primary disabled:opacity-60"
                />
              </div>

              <div>
                <label htmlFor="ticket-message" className="block text-xs font-semibold text-text-muted mb-1.5">
                  Message <span className="theme-status-danger">*</span>
                </label>
                <textarea
                  id="ticket-message"
                  value={message}
                  onChange={(e) => setMessage(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="Describe your issue in detail..."
                  rows={5}
                  required
                  disabled={!isLoggedIn || submitting}
                  className="w-full px-4 py-2.5 rounded-xl theme-input border text-text text-sm focus:outline-none focus:border-primary resize-none disabled:opacity-60"
                />
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-text-muted mb-1.5">Priority</label>
                <div className="relative">
                  <select
                    value={priority}
                    onChange={(e) => setPriority(e.target.value)}
                    disabled={!isLoggedIn || submitting}
                    className="w-full appearance-none px-4 py-2.5 rounded-xl theme-input border text-text text-sm focus:outline-none focus:border-primary disabled:opacity-60 pr-10"
                  >
                    <option value="low">Low — General inquiry</option>
                    <option value="normal">Normal — Default</option>
                    <option value="high">High — Affecting my orders</option>
                    <option value="urgent">Urgent — Critical issue</option>
                  </select>
                  <ChevronDown className="absolute right-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 w-3.5 h-3.5 text-text-muted pointer-events-none" />
                </div>
              </div>

              {error && <p className="theme-status-danger text-xs">{error}</p>}

              <button
                type="submit"
                disabled={!isLoggedIn || submitting || !subject.trim() || !message.trim()}
                className="theme-btn-primary flex w-full items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl px-6 py-3 text-sm font-semibold disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50"
              >
                {submitting ? (
                  <>
                    <span className="btn-spinner" />
                    Sending...
                  </>
                ) : (
                  <>
                    <Send className="w-4 h-4" /> Submit Request
                  </>
                )}
              </button>
            </form>
          </MotionDiv>

          {/* Previous tickets */}
          {isLoggedIn && (
            <MotionDiv
              initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 12 }}
              animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
              transition={{ delay: 0.1 }}
              className="theme-card border rounded-2xl p-6"
            >
              <h2 className="text-sm font-bold text-text mb-4">Your Previous Tickets</h2>

              {ticketsLoading ? (
                <div className="space-y-2">
                  {Array.from({ length: 3 }).map((_, i) => (
                    <div key={i} className="h-14 rounded-xl bg-surface-2 animate-pulse" />
                  ))}
                </div>
              ) : tickets.length === 0 ? (
                <p className="text-sm text-text-faint text-center py-6">No tickets submitted yet.</p>
              ) : (
                <div className="space-y-2">
                  {tickets.map((t) => (
                    <div key={t.id} className="flex items-center gap-3 p-3 rounded-xl bg-surface-2/50 hover:bg-surface-2 transition-colors">
                      {STATUS_ICON[t.status] ?? <Clock className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />}
                      <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                        <p className="text-sm font-medium text-text truncate">{t.subject}</p>
                        <p className="text-xs text-text-faint">{new Date(t.created_at).toLocaleDateString()}</p>
                      </div>
                      <span className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded-lg text-[10px] font-semibold shrink-0 ${STATUS_COLOR[t.status] ?? "bg-surface-2 text-text-muted"}`}>
                        {t.status.replace("_", " ")}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
              )}
            </MotionDiv>
          )}
        </div>
      </main>
  );
}
```

### `frontend\web_app\src\app\invoice\page.tsx`

```text
"use client";

import { Suspense, useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { useSearchParams } from "next/navigation";
import { apiFetch } from "@/lib/api";
import BrandLoading from "@/components/BrandLoading";
import { useCurrencyStore } from "@/lib/currencyStore";

type InvoicePayload = {
  id: number;
  invoice_number: string;
  order_id: number;
  created_at: string;
  status: string;
  customer_name: string;
  customer_email: string;
  customer_address: string;
  supplier_name: string;
  supplier_email?: string;
  items: Array<{
    product_id: number;
    product_name: string;
    quantity: number;
    unit_price: number;
    total: number;
  }>;
  subtotal: number;
  vat: number;
  shipping: number;
  total: number;
  logistics: Array<{
    stage: "supplier" | "warehouse" | "in_transit" | "delivered";
    label: string;
    timestamp?: string | null;
    notes?: string | null;
    completed: boolean;
  }>;
  tracking_number?: string;
  carrier?: string;
  scan_codes?: string[];
};

function InvoicePageClient() {
  const formatMoney = useCurrencyStore((s) => s.format);
  const params = useSearchParams();
  const orderId = params.get("order_id");
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const [invoice, setInvoice] = useState<InvoicePayload | null>(null);
  const [scanCode, setScanCode] = useState("");
  const [confirming, setConfirming] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    const id = Number(orderId);
    if (!id) {
      setError("Missing order_id query parameter.");
      setLoading(false);
      return;
    }

    apiFetch(`/orders/${id}/invoice`)
      .then(async (res) => {
        const data = await res.json();
        if (!res.ok) {
          setError(data?.detail || "Could not load invoice.");
        } else {
          setInvoice(data as InvoicePayload);
          if ((data as InvoicePayload).scan_codes?.[0]) {
            setScanCode((data as InvoicePayload).scan_codes?.[0] || "");
          }
        }
      })
      .catch(() => setError("Could not load invoice."))
      .finally(() => setLoading(false));
  }, [orderId]);

  const confirmReceipt = async () => {
    if (!invoice || !scanCode.trim()) return;
    setConfirming(true);
    try {
      const res = await apiFetch(`/orders/${invoice.order_id}/scan-receipt`, {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ scan_code: scanCode.trim(), notes: "Web customer confirmation" }),
      });
      const data = await res.json();
      if (!res.ok) {
        setError(data?.detail || "Receipt confirmation failed.");
      } else {
        setError("");
        setInvoice({ ...invoice, status: "delivered" });
      }
    } catch {
      setError("Receipt confirmation failed.");
    } finally {
      setConfirming(false);
    }
  };

  if (loading) {
    return <BrandLoading fullscreen label="Loading invoice..." />;
  }

  if (error && !invoice) {
    return (
      <main className="min-h-screen flex items-center justify-center p-6">
        <div className="rounded-2xl border border-danger/40 bg-danger/10 px-6 py-5 text-danger">
          {error}
        </div>
      </main>
    );
  }

  if (!invoice) {
    return null;
  }

  return (
    <main className="min-h-screen px-4 py-8">
      <div className="mx-auto max-w-4xl space-y-4">
        <div className="rounded-2xl border border-border bg-surface-1 p-5">
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-3">
            <div>
              <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-text">Invoice #{invoice.invoice_number}</h1>
              <p className="text-sm text-text-muted">
                Order #{invoice.order_id} · {invoice.created_at?.slice(0, 10)}
              </p>
            </div>
            <span className="rounded-lg bg-primary/15 px-3 py-1 text-xs font-semibold text-primary">
              {invoice.status.toUpperCase()}
            </span>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="grid gap-4 md:grid-cols-2">
          <div className="rounded-2xl border border-border bg-surface-1 p-4">
            <p className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-text-muted">Supplier</p>
            <p className="mt-1 text-sm font-semibold text-text">{invoice.supplier_name}</p>
            {invoice.supplier_email && <p className="text-sm text-text-muted">{invoice.supplier_email}</p>}
          </div>
          <div className="rounded-2xl border border-border bg-surface-1 p-4">
            <p className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-text-muted">Customer</p>
            <p className="mt-1 text-sm font-semibold text-text">{invoice.customer_name}</p>
            <p className="text-sm text-text-muted">{invoice.customer_address}</p>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="rounded-2xl border border-border bg-surface-1 p-4">
          <h2 className="text-sm font-bold text-text">Supply Chain Timeline</h2>
          <div className="mt-3 space-y-2">
            {invoice.logistics.map((step) => (
              <div key={step.stage} className="flex items-start gap-3 rounded-xl border border-border/60 bg-surface-2/40 p-3">
                <div className={`mt-0.5 h-2.5 w-2.5 rounded-full ${step.completed ? "bg-success" : "bg-border"}`} />
                <div>
                  <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-text">{step.label}</p>
                  {step.timestamp && (
                    <p className="text-xs text-text-muted">{step.timestamp.replace("T", " ").slice(0, 16)}</p>
                  )}
                  {step.notes && <p className="text-xs text-text-muted">{step.notes}</p>}
                </div>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
          {invoice.tracking_number && (
            <p className="mt-3 text-sm text-text-muted">
              Tracking: <span className="font-semibold text-text">{invoice.tracking_number}</span>
              {invoice.carrier ? ` · ${invoice.carrier}` : ""}
            </p>
          )}
        </div>

        <div className="rounded-2xl border border-border bg-surface-1 p-4">
          <h2 className="text-sm font-bold text-text">Items</h2>
          <div className="mt-3 space-y-2">
            {invoice.items.map((item) => (
              <div key={item.product_id} className="flex items-center justify-between rounded-xl border border-border/60 bg-surface-2/40 px-3 py-2">
                <div>
                  <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-text">{item.product_name}</p>
                  <p className="text-xs text-text-muted">
                    {item.quantity} x {formatMoney(Number(item.unit_price))}
                  </p>
                </div>
                <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-text">{formatMoney(Number(item.total))}</p>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
          <div className="mt-4 space-y-1 border-t border-border pt-3 text-sm">
            <div className="flex justify-between text-text-muted">
              <span>Subtotal</span>
              <span>{formatMoney(Number(invoice.subtotal))}</span>
            </div>
            <div className="flex justify-between text-text-muted">
              <span>VAT</span>
              <span>{formatMoney(Number(invoice.vat))}</span>
            </div>
            <div className="flex justify-between text-text-muted">
              <span>Shipping</span>
              <span>{formatMoney(Number(invoice.shipping))}</span>
            </div>
            <div className="flex justify-between font-bold text-text">
              <span>Total</span>
              <span>{formatMoney(Number(invoice.total))}</span>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="rounded-2xl border border-border bg-surface-1 p-4">
          <h2 className="text-sm font-bold text-text">Customer Receipt Scan</h2>
          <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-text-muted">
            Confirm final delivery by scanning or pasting the shipment scan code.
          </p>
          <div className="mt-3 flex flex-wrap gap-2">
            <input
              value={scanCode}
              onChange={(e) => setScanCode(e.target.value)}
              className="theme-input min-w-64 flex-1 rounded-xl border px-3 py-2 text-sm focus:border-primary focus:outline-none"
              placeholder="SHIP-204"
            />
            <button
              onClick={confirmReceipt}
              disabled={confirming || !scanCode.trim()}
              className="rounded-xl theme-btn-primary px-4 py-2 text-sm font-semibold disabled:opacity-50"
            >
              {confirming ? "Confirming..." : "Confirm Receipt"}
            </button>
          </div>
          {error && (
            <p className="mt-2 text-sm text-danger">{error}</p>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </main>
  );
}

export default function InvoicePage() {
  return (
    <Suspense
      fallback={
        <main className="min-h-screen flex items-center justify-center text-text-muted">
          Loading invoice...
        </main>
      }
    >
      <InvoicePageClient />
    </Suspense>
  );
}
```

### `frontend\web_app\src\app\login\LoginClient.tsx`

```text
﻿"use client";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { useRouter, useSearchParams } from "next/navigation";
import Link from "next/link";
import { motion } from "framer-motion";
import { LogIn, Eye, EyeOff, AlertCircle } from "@/lib/icons";

const MotionDiv: any = motion.div;

import { apiFetch, clearAccessToken, getErrorMessage, parseJsonResponse, setAccessToken } from "@/lib/api";
import { isEmailVerificationRequired, resendVerificationEmail } from "@/lib/authVerification";
import GoogleSignInButton from "@/components/auth/GoogleSignInButton";
import { useAuthCapabilities } from "@/lib/authCapabilities";
import { useAuth } from "@/lib/useAuth";
import { getPostLoginPath } from "@/lib/authRedirects";
import Logo from "@/components/Logo";
import { useLocaleStore } from "@/lib/localeStore";

const API_URL = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL || "http://localhost:8000";

export default function LoginClient() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const params = useSearchParams();
  const { refresh, user, isLoading } = useAuth();
  const tr = useLocaleStore((s) => s.t);
  const { capabilities, error: capabilitiesError } = useAuthCapabilities();
  const [identifier, setIdentifier] = useState("");
  const [password, setPassword] = useState("");
  const [showPw, setShowPw] = useState(false);
  const [isHydrated, setIsHydrated] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState(params.get("error") || "");
  const [verificationMessage, setVerificationMessage] = useState("");
  const [verificationLoading, setVerificationLoading] = useState(false);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    router.prefetch("/");
  }, [router]);

  useEffect(() => {
    setIsHydrated(true);
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isLoading || !user) {
      return;
    }
    router.replace(getPostLoginPath(user.role));
  }, [isLoading, router, user]);

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setError("");
    setVerificationMessage("");
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const body = new URLSearchParams({ username: identifier.trim(), password });
      const res = await apiFetch("/auth/login", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/x-www-form-urlencoded" },
        body,
      });

      const data = await parseJsonResponse(res); // safe: returns null for HTML/invalid JSON
      if (!res.ok) {
        const errMsg = getErrorMessage(data || {}) || "Login failed";
        setError(errMsg);
        setLoading(false);
        return;
      }

      if (!data || !data.access_token) {
        setError("Unexpected response from auth server");
        setLoading(false);
        return;
      }

      setAccessToken(data.access_token);
      localStorage.setItem("zozi_has_session", "1");
      const user = await refresh(true);
      if (!user) {
        clearAccessToken();
        localStorage.removeItem("zozi_has_session");
        setError("Network error. Please try again.");
        return;
      }

      router.push(getPostLoginPath(user.role));
    } catch {
      setError("Network error. Please try again.");
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleGoogleSuccess = async (accessToken: string) => {
    setError("");
    setVerificationMessage("");
    setAccessToken(accessToken);
    localStorage.setItem("zozi_has_session", "1");
    const user = await refresh(true);
    if (!user) {
      clearAccessToken();
      localStorage.removeItem("zozi_has_session");
      setError("Network error. Please try again.");
      return;
    }

    router.push(getPostLoginPath(user.role));
  };

  const handleResendVerification = async () => {
    const normalizedIdentifier = identifier.trim();
    if (!normalizedIdentifier) {
      setVerificationMessage(tr("enterEmailOrUsername"));
      return;
    }

    setVerificationLoading(true);
    setVerificationMessage("");
    try {
      const detail = await resendVerificationEmail(normalizedIdentifier);
      setVerificationMessage(detail);
    } catch (err) {
      setVerificationMessage(err instanceof Error ? err.message : tr("networkError"));
    } finally {
      setVerificationLoading(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <main className="flex min-h-screen items-center justify-center bg-surface-base px-4 py-12 text-text">
      <MotionDiv
        initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }}
        animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
        className="w-full max-w-sm"
      >
        <div className="text-center mb-6">
          <div className="flex justify-center mb-4">
            <Logo size="lg" />
          </div>
          <h1 className="text-xl font-bold text-text">{tr("welcomeBack")}</h1>
          <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-text-muted">
            {tr("loginSubtitle")}
          </p>
        </div>

        <form
          onSubmit={handleSubmit}
          method="post"
          className="theme-card space-y-4 rounded-2xl border p-5"
        >
          {error && (
            <div className="theme-alert-danger flex items-center gap-2 rounded-xl p-2.5 text-xs">
              <AlertCircle className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0" />
              {error}
            </div>
          )}

          {isEmailVerificationRequired(error) && (
            <div className="rounded-xl border border-primary/25 bg-primary/8 p-3 text-xs text-text-muted">
              <p>{tr("verificationHelpText")}</p>
              <div className="mt-3 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={handleResendVerification}
                  disabled={verificationLoading || !isHydrated}
                  className="theme-btn-secondary rounded-xl px-3 py-2 text-[11px] font-semibold disabled:opacity-50"
                >
                  {verificationLoading ? tr("sendingVerification") : tr("resendVerificationEmail")}
                </button>
                {verificationMessage ? (
                  <p className="text-[11px] text-text">{verificationMessage}</p>
                ) : null}
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {(capabilities?.google || capabilities?.facebook) && (
            <>
              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-2">
                {capabilities?.google && capabilities.google_client_id && (
                  <GoogleSignInButton
                    clientId={capabilities.google_client_id}
                    onSuccess={handleGoogleSuccess}
                    onError={setError}
                  />
                )}
                {capabilities?.facebook && (
                  <a
                    href={`${API_URL}/auth/oauth/facebook/start`}
                    className="flex items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl border border-border px-3 py-2.5 text-xs font-semibold text-text transition-colors hover:bg-surface-1"
                  >
                    {tr("continueWithFacebook")}
                  </a>
                )}
              </div>

              <div className="relative text-center">
                <div className="absolute inset-x-0 top-1/2 h-px -translate-y-1/2 bg-border" />
                <span className="relative bg-surface-base px-2 text-[10px] uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-text-faint">
                  {tr("orContinueWithEmail")}
                </span>
              </div>
            </>
          )}

          {capabilitiesError ? (
            <p className="text-[11px] text-text-faint">{capabilitiesError}</p>
          ) : null}

          <div>
            <label htmlFor="login-username" className="mb-1.5 block text-[11px] font-semibold text-text-muted">
              {tr("emailOrUsername")}
            </label>
            <input
              id="login-username"
              name="username"
              value={identifier}
              onChange={(e) => setIdentifier(e.target.value)}
              required
              placeholder={tr("enterEmailOrUsername")}
              autoCapitalize="none"
              autoComplete="username"
              className="theme-input w-full rounded-xl border px-3 py-2.5 text-xs focus:border-primary focus:outline-none transition-colors"
            />
          </div>

          <div>
            <label htmlFor="login-password" className="mb-1.5 block text-[11px] font-semibold text-text-muted">
              {tr("password")}
            </label>
            <div className="relative">
              <input
                id="login-password"
                name="password"
                type={showPw ? "text" : "password"}
                value={password}
                onChange={(e) => setPassword(e.target.value)}
                required
                placeholder="••••••••"
                className="theme-input w-full rounded-xl border px-3 py-2.5 pr-10 text-xs focus:border-primary focus:outline-none transition-colors"
              />
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setShowPw((v) => !v)}
                className="absolute right-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-text-muted hover:text-text"
                aria-label={showPw ? "Hide password" : "Show password"}
                title={showPw ? "Hide password" : "Show password"}
              >
                {showPw ? (
                  <EyeOff className="w-4 h-4" />
                ) : (
                  <Eye className="w-4 h-4" />
                )}
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>

          <button
            type="submit"
            disabled={loading || !isHydrated}
            className="theme-btn-primary flex w-full items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl py-2.5 text-xs font-bold disabled:opacity-50"
          >
            {loading ? (
              <div className="btn-spinner" />
            ) : (
              <LogIn className="w-4 h-4" />
            )}
            {loading ? tr("signingIn") : tr("signIn")}
          </button>

          <p className="text-right text-[11px]">
            <Link href="/forgot-password" className="text-primary hover:text-primary-light">
              {tr("forgotPassword")}
            </Link>
          </p>
        </form>

        <p className="mt-4 text-center text-xs text-text-muted">
          {tr("dontHaveAccount")}{" "}
          <Link
            href="/register"
            className="text-primary hover:text-primary-light font-semibold"
          >
            {tr("register")}
          </Link>
        </p>
        <p className="mt-2 text-center text-[11px] text-text-faint">
          <Link
            href="/supplier/login"
            className="hover:text-text-muted"
          >
            {tr("supplierLogin")}
          </Link>
        </p>
        <p className="mt-2 text-center text-[11px] text-text-faint">
          <Link
            href="/logistics-partner/login"
            className="hover:text-text-muted"
          >
            {tr("logisticsPartnerLogin")}
          </Link>
        </p>
      </MotionDiv>
    </main>
  );
}
```
