### `frontend\web_app\src\app\logistics-partner\analytics\page.tsx`

```text
"use client";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { motion } from "framer-motion";
import {
  Activity,
  CheckCircle,
  Clock,
  Download,
  Loader2,
  Package,
  TrendingUp,
  Truck,
  XCircle,
} from "@/lib/icons";
import LogisticsPartnerLayout from "@/components/LogisticsPartnerLayout";
import { apiFetch } from "@/lib/api";
import { useCurrencyStore } from "@/lib/currencyStore";

// ── Types ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

interface DeliveryKPI {
  delivery_rate: number;
  average_transit_hours: number;
  sla_on_time_rate: number;
  scan_compliance_rate: number;
  total_shipments: number;
  delivered: number;
  failed: number;
  in_transit: number;
}

interface PayoutSummary {
  id: number;
  amount: number;
  status: string;
  payout_date: string | null;
  period_start: string | null;
  period_end: string | null;
}

type Period = "7d" | "30d" | "90d";

// ── Helpers ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function exportCSV(kpi: DeliveryKPI, period: string) {
  const rows = [
    ["Metric", "Value"],
    ["Period", period],
    ["Total Shipments", kpi.total_shipments],
    ["Delivered", kpi.delivered],
    ["In Transit", kpi.in_transit],
    ["Failed", kpi.failed],
    ["Delivery Rate %", (kpi.delivery_rate * 100).toFixed(1)],
    ["SLA On-Time Rate %", (kpi.sla_on_time_rate * 100).toFixed(1)],
    ["Avg Transit Hours", kpi.average_transit_hours.toFixed(1)],
    ["Scan Compliance %", (kpi.scan_compliance_rate * 100).toFixed(1)],
  ];
  const csv = rows.map((r) => r.join(",")).join("\n");
  const blob = new Blob([csv], { type: "text/csv" });
  const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  const a = document.createElement("a");
  a.href = url;
  a.download = `lp-analytics-${period}.csv`;
  a.click();
  URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
}

// ── KPI Card ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function KPICard({
  label,
  value,
  sub,
  icon: Icon,
  color,
}: {
  label: string;
  value: string;
  sub?: string;
  icon: React.ComponentType<{ className?: string }>;
  color: string;
}) {
  return (
    <motion.div
      initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 8 }}
      animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
      className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface p-4"
    >
      <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3">
        <div>
          <p className="text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.15em] text-text-muted">{label}</p>
          <p className="mt-1.5 text-2xl font-bold text-text">{value}</p>
          {sub && <p className="mt-0.5 text-xs text-text-muted">{sub}</p>}
        </div>
        <div className={`w-9 h-9 rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center ${color}`}>
          <Icon className="w-5 h-5" />
        </div>
      </div>
    </motion.div>
  );
}

// ── Page ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export default function LPAnalyticsPage() {
  const formatMoney = useCurrencyStore((s) => s.format);
  const [period, setPeriod] = useState<Period>("30d");
  const [kpi, setKPI] = useState<DeliveryKPI | null>(null);
  const [payouts, setPayouts] = useState<PayoutSummary[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;
    setLoading(true);

    Promise.all([
      apiFetch(`/logistics-partners/analytics?period=${period}`)
        .then((r) => (r.ok ? r.json() : null))
        .catch(() => null),
      apiFetch("/logistics-partners/payouts")
        .then((r) => (r.ok ? r.json() : []))
        .catch(() => []),
    ]).then(([analyticsData, payoutsData]) => {
      if (cancelled) return;
      if (analyticsData) setKPI(analyticsData);
      setPayouts(Array.isArray(payoutsData) ? payoutsData.slice(0, 10) : []);
      setLoading(false);
    });

    return () => { cancelled = true; };
  }, [period]);

  return (
    <LogisticsPartnerLayout title="Analytics">
      <div className="space-y-5">
        <div className="theme-card rounded-2xl border p-4">
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-3 lg:flex-row lg:items-center lg:justify-between">
            <div>
              <p className="text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.18em] text-text-faint">Analytics Controls</p>
              <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-text-muted">Monitor delivery KPIs, SLA compliance, and export payout history from one workspace.</p>
            </div>
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
              <div className="flex w-full gap-1 overflow-x-auto rounded-xl bg-surface-2 p-1 sm:w-fit">
                {(["7d", "30d", "90d"] as Period[]).map((p) => (
                  <button
                    key={p}
                    onClick={() => setPeriod(p)}
                    className={`flex-1 whitespace-nowrap rounded-lg px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold transition-colors sm:flex-none ${
                      period === p ? "bg-surface text-text shadow-sm" : "text-text-muted hover:text-text"
                    }`}
                  >
                    {p === "7d" ? "7 days" : p === "30d" ? "30 days" : "90 days"}
                  </button>
                ))}
              </div>
              {kpi && (
                <button
                  onClick={() => exportCSV(kpi, period)}
                  className="flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg border border-border px-3 py-2 text-xs font-medium text-text-muted transition-colors hover:text-text"
                >
                  <Download className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  Export CSV
                </button>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {loading ? (
          <div className="flex justify-center py-12">
            <Loader2 className="w-7 h-7 animate-spin text-primary" />
          </div>
        ) : (
          <>
            {/* KPI grid */}
            {kpi && (
              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 lg:grid-cols-4">
                <KPICard
                  label="Delivery Rate"
                  value={`${(kpi.delivery_rate * 100).toFixed(1)}%`}
                  sub={`${kpi.delivered} of ${kpi.total_shipments} delivered`}
                  icon={CheckCircle}
                  color="bg-success/10 text-success"
                />
                <KPICard
                  label="SLA On-Time"
                  value={`${(kpi.sla_on_time_rate * 100).toFixed(1)}%`}
                  sub="Orders delivered within SLA"
                  icon={TrendingUp}
                  color={kpi.sla_on_time_rate >= 0.9 ? "bg-success/10 text-success" : "bg-warning/10 text-warning"}
                />
                <KPICard
                  label="Avg Transit"
                  value={`${kpi.average_transit_hours.toFixed(1)}h`}
                  sub="Average delivery time"
                  icon={Clock}
                  color="bg-primary/10 text-primary"
                />
                <KPICard
                  label="Scan Compliance"
                  value={`${(kpi.scan_compliance_rate * 100).toFixed(1)}%`}
                  sub="Packages scanned at checkpoints"
                  icon={Activity}
                  color="bg-info/10 text-info"
                />
              </div>
            )}

            {/* Status breakdown */}
            {kpi && (
              <div className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface p-4">
                <h2 className="text-sm font-semibold text-text mb-3">Shipment Status Breakdown</h2>
                <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 lg:grid-cols-4">
                  {[
                    { label: "In Transit", value: kpi.in_transit, icon: Truck, color: "text-primary" },
                    { label: "Delivered", value: kpi.delivered, icon: CheckCircle, color: "text-success" },
                    { label: "Failed", value: kpi.failed, icon: XCircle, color: "text-danger" },
                    { label: "Total", value: kpi.total_shipments, icon: Package, color: "text-text-muted" },
                  ].map((item) => (
                    <div key={item.label} className="rounded-lg bg-surface-2 p-3 flex items-center gap-3">
                      <item.icon className={`w-5 h-5 shrink-0 ${item.color}`} />
                      <div>
                        <p className="text-xs text-text-muted">{item.label}</p>
                        <p className="text-base font-bold text-text">{item.value}</p>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </div>
            )}

            {/* Payout history */}
            <div className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface p-4">
              <h2 className="text-sm font-semibold text-text mb-3">Recent Payouts</h2>
              {payouts.length === 0 ? (
                <p className="text-sm text-text-muted py-4 text-center">No payout records found</p>
              ) : (
                <div className="divide-y divide-border">
                  {payouts.map((p) => (
                    <div key={p.id} className="flex items-center justify-between py-2.5 gap-3">
                      <div>
                        <p className="text-xs font-semibold text-text">{formatMoney(p.amount)}</p>
                        {p.period_start && p.period_end && (
                          <p className="text-[10px] text-text-muted">
                            {new Date(p.period_start).toLocaleDateString()} –{" "}
                            {new Date(p.period_end).toLocaleDateString()}
                          </p>
                        )}
                      </div>
                      <div className="text-right">
                        <span
                          className={`rounded-full px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-medium ${
                            p.status === "paid"
                              ? "bg-success/10 text-success"
                              : p.status === "pending"
                              ? "bg-warning/10 text-warning"
                              : "bg-surface-2 text-text-muted"
                          }`}
                        >
                          {p.status}
                        </span>
                        {p.payout_date && (
                          <p className="text-[10px] text-text-muted mt-0.5">
                            {new Date(p.payout_date).toLocaleDateString()}
                          </p>
                        )}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          </>
        )}
      </div>
    </LogisticsPartnerLayout>
  );
}
```

### `frontend\web_app\src\app\logistics-partner\dashboard\page.tsx`

```text
﻿"use client";

import { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from "react";
import Link from "next/link";
import { motion } from "framer-motion";
import {
  AlertTriangle,
  BarChart3,
  Calculator,
  CheckCircle,
  ChevronDown,
  Clock,
  ExternalLink,
  MapPinned,
  Package,
  Radio,
  RefreshCw,
  Route,
  TrendingUp,
  Truck,
  Wallet,
  XCircle,
} from "@/lib/icons";
import LogisticsPartnerLayout from "@/components/LogisticsPartnerLayout";
import { PanelContent, PanelHero } from "@/components/PanelPage";
import { API_URL, apiFetch, getAccessToken } from "@/lib/api";
import { useLocaleStore } from "@/lib/localeStore";
import { useCurrencyStore } from "@/lib/currencyStore";
import TranslatedText from "@/components/TranslatedText";
import { formatLocalizedDateTime, isRtlLocale } from "@shared/localization";
import { createRealtimeRefreshScheduler, openRealtimeSocket } from "@shared/realtime";
import { dc, useDensity } from "@/lib/densityContext";

interface DashboardStats {
  total: number;
  active: number;
  delivered: number;
  pending: number;
  failed: number;
}

interface DashboardAnalytics {
  delivery_rate: number;
  average_transit_hours: number;
  scan_compliance_rate: number;
  sla_on_time_rate: number;
  shipments_with_events: number;
  sla_eligible_shipments: number;
  status_breakdown: Record<string, number>;
}

interface ActiveShipment {
  id: number;
  order_id: number;
  tracking_number?: string;
  carrier_name?: string;
  status: string;
  distribution_channel?: string;
  current_hub?: string;
  estimated_delivery?: string;
}

interface LiveLocation {
  shipment_id: number;
  order_id?: number;
  tracking_number?: string | null;
  status: string;
  current_hub?: string | null;
  location?: string | null;
  latitude: number;
  longitude: number;
  recorded_at?: string | null;
}

interface RouteStop extends LiveLocation {
  stop_number: number;
  distance_from_previous_km: number;
}

interface RoutePlan {
  generated_at?: string | null;
  total_stops: number;
  estimated_distance_km: number;
  estimated_duration_hours: number;
  stops: RouteStop[];
}

interface SlaAlert {
  shipment_id: number;
  order_id?: number;
  tracking_number?: string | null;
  status: string;
  current_hub?: string | null;
  estimated_delivery: string;
  overdue_hours: number;
}

interface PayoutRecord {
  id: number;
  amount: number;
  status: string;
  method?: string | null;
  created_at?: string | null;
}

interface EarningRecord {
  shipment_id: number;
  order_id: number;
  tracking_number?: string | null;
  amount: number;
  delivered_at?: string | null;
}

interface PayoutSummary {
  total_earned: number;
  available_balance: number;
  pending_amount: number;
  completed_amount: number;
  payout_count: number;
  recent_payouts: PayoutRecord[];
  recent_earnings: EarningRecord[];
}

interface DashboardData {
  stats: DashboardStats;
  analytics: DashboardAnalytics;
  channel_breakdown: Record<string, number>;
  active_shipments: ActiveShipment[];
  live_locations: LiveLocation[];
  route_plan: RoutePlan;
  sla_alerts: SlaAlert[];
  payout_summary: PayoutSummary;
}

const EMPTY_STATS: DashboardStats = {
  total: 0,
  active: 0,
  delivered: 0,
  pending: 0,
  failed: 0,
};

const EMPTY_ANALYTICS: DashboardAnalytics = {
  delivery_rate: 0,
  average_transit_hours: 0,
  scan_compliance_rate: 0,
  sla_on_time_rate: 0,
  shipments_with_events: 0,
  sla_eligible_shipments: 0,
  status_breakdown: {},
};

const EMPTY_ROUTE_PLAN: RoutePlan = {
  generated_at: null,
  total_stops: 0,
  estimated_distance_km: 0,
  estimated_duration_hours: 0,
  stops: [],
};

const EMPTY_PAYOUT_SUMMARY: PayoutSummary = {
  total_earned: 0,
  available_balance: 0,
  pending_amount: 0,
  completed_amount: 0,
  payout_count: 0,
  recent_payouts: [],
  recent_earnings: [],
};

function isRecord(value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> {
  return typeof value === "object" && value !== null;
}

function normalizeDashboardData(raw: unknown): DashboardData {
  const payload = isRecord(raw) ? raw : {};
  const stats = isRecord(payload.stats) ? payload.stats : {};
  const analytics = isRecord(payload.analytics) ? payload.analytics : {};
  const routePlan = isRecord(payload.route_plan) ? payload.route_plan : {};
  const payoutSummary = isRecord(payload.payout_summary) ? payload.payout_summary : {};

  return {
    stats: {
      total: Number(stats.total ?? EMPTY_STATS.total),
      active: Number(stats.active ?? EMPTY_STATS.active),
      delivered: Number(stats.delivered ?? EMPTY_STATS.delivered),
      pending: Number(stats.pending ?? EMPTY_STATS.pending),
      failed: Number(stats.failed ?? EMPTY_STATS.failed),
    },
    analytics: {
      delivery_rate: Number(analytics.delivery_rate ?? EMPTY_ANALYTICS.delivery_rate),
      average_transit_hours: Number(analytics.average_transit_hours ?? EMPTY_ANALYTICS.average_transit_hours),
      scan_compliance_rate: Number(analytics.scan_compliance_rate ?? EMPTY_ANALYTICS.scan_compliance_rate),
      sla_on_time_rate: Number(analytics.sla_on_time_rate ?? EMPTY_ANALYTICS.sla_on_time_rate),
      shipments_with_events: Number(analytics.shipments_with_events ?? EMPTY_ANALYTICS.shipments_with_events),
      sla_eligible_shipments: Number(analytics.sla_eligible_shipments ?? EMPTY_ANALYTICS.sla_eligible_shipments),
      status_breakdown: isRecord(analytics.status_breakdown)
        ? Object.fromEntries(
          Object.entries(analytics.status_breakdown).map(([key, value]) => [key, Number(value ?? 0)]),
        )
        : EMPTY_ANALYTICS.status_breakdown,
    },
    channel_breakdown: isRecord(payload.channel_breakdown)
      ? Object.fromEntries(
        Object.entries(payload.channel_breakdown).map(([key, value]) => [key, Number(value ?? 0)]),
      )
      : {},
    active_shipments: Array.isArray(payload.active_shipments) ? payload.active_shipments as ActiveShipment[] : [],
    live_locations: Array.isArray(payload.live_locations) ? payload.live_locations as LiveLocation[] : [],
    route_plan: {
      generated_at: typeof routePlan.generated_at === "string" ? routePlan.generated_at : null,
      total_stops: Number(routePlan.total_stops ?? EMPTY_ROUTE_PLAN.total_stops),
      estimated_distance_km: Number(routePlan.estimated_distance_km ?? EMPTY_ROUTE_PLAN.estimated_distance_km),
      estimated_duration_hours: Number(routePlan.estimated_duration_hours ?? EMPTY_ROUTE_PLAN.estimated_duration_hours),
      stops: Array.isArray(routePlan.stops) ? routePlan.stops as RouteStop[] : [],
    },
    sla_alerts: Array.isArray(payload.sla_alerts) ? payload.sla_alerts as SlaAlert[] : [],
    payout_summary: {
      total_earned: Number(payoutSummary.total_earned ?? EMPTY_PAYOUT_SUMMARY.total_earned),
      available_balance: Number(payoutSummary.available_balance ?? EMPTY_PAYOUT_SUMMARY.available_balance),
      pending_amount: Number(payoutSummary.pending_amount ?? EMPTY_PAYOUT_SUMMARY.pending_amount),
      completed_amount: Number(payoutSummary.completed_amount ?? EMPTY_PAYOUT_SUMMARY.completed_amount),
      payout_count: Number(payoutSummary.payout_count ?? EMPTY_PAYOUT_SUMMARY.payout_count),
      recent_payouts: Array.isArray(payoutSummary.recent_payouts) ? payoutSummary.recent_payouts as PayoutRecord[] : [],
      recent_earnings: Array.isArray(payoutSummary.recent_earnings) ? payoutSummary.recent_earnings as EarningRecord[] : [],
    },
  };
}

interface PricingBreakdown {
  base_fee: number;
  pickup_fee: number;
  dropoff_fee: number;
  weight_fee: number;
  distance_fee: number;
  distance_km?: number | null;
  per_kg_rate?: number | null;
  per_km_rate?: number | null;
  handling_fee: number;
  load_fit_adjustment_amount: number;
  load_fit_label?: string | null;
  surcharge_amount: number;
  floor_charge?: number | null;
  floor_applied: boolean;
  weight_discount_amount: number;
  shipping_amount: number;
  currency: string;
  route_type: string;
  total_weight_kg?: number;
}

interface ShippingQuoteResult {
  shipping_amount: number;
  currency: string;
  partner_id?: number | null;
  partner_name?: string | null;
  partner_code?: string | null;
  service_area?: string | null;
  pricing_breakdown?: PricingBreakdown | null;
  source: string;
}

const STAT_CARDS = [
  { key: "total" as const, label: "Total Shipments", icon: Package, cls: "theme-chip-info", chip: "theme-chip-info" },
  { key: "active" as const, label: "Active", icon: Truck, cls: "theme-chip-warning", chip: "theme-chip-warning" },
  { key: "delivered" as const, label: "Delivered", icon: CheckCircle, cls: "theme-chip-success", chip: "theme-chip-success" },
  { key: "pending" as const, label: "Pending", icon: Clock, cls: "theme-chip-muted", chip: "theme-chip-muted" },
  { key: "failed" as const, label: "Failed / Returned", icon: XCircle, cls: "theme-chip-danger", chip: "theme-chip-danger" },
];

const ANALYTICS_CARDS = [
  { key: "delivery_rate" as const, label: "Delivery Rate", format: (value: number) => `${value.toFixed(1)}%` },
  { key: "average_transit_hours" as const, label: "Avg Transit", format: (value: number) => `${value.toFixed(1)}h` },
  { key: "scan_compliance_rate" as const, label: "Scan Coverage", format: (value: number) => `${value.toFixed(1)}%` },
  { key: "sla_on_time_rate" as const, label: "On-Time SLA", format: (value: number) => `${value.toFixed(1)}%` },
];

function buildMapHref(location: LiveLocation): string {
  return `https://www.openstreetmap.org/?mlat=${location.latitude}&mlon=${location.longitude}#map=12/${location.latitude}/${location.longitude}`;
}

function buildMapEmbedUrl(locations: LiveLocation[], selected: LiveLocation | null): string | null {
  if (!selected) return null;
  const latitudes = locations.map((location) => location.latitude);
  const longitudes = locations.map((location) => location.longitude);
  const latPad = Math.max(0.02, (Math.max(...latitudes) - Math.min(...latitudes)) * 0.25 || 0.02);
  const lngPad = Math.max(0.02, (Math.max(...longitudes) - Math.min(...longitudes)) * 0.25 || 0.02);
  const minLat = Math.min(...latitudes, selected.latitude) - latPad;
  const maxLat = Math.max(...latitudes, selected.latitude) + latPad;
  const minLng = Math.min(...longitudes, selected.longitude) - lngPad;
  const maxLng = Math.max(...longitudes, selected.longitude) + lngPad;
  return `https://www.openstreetmap.org/export/embed.html?bbox=${minLng}%2C${minLat}%2C${maxLng}%2C${maxLat}&layer=mapnik&marker=${selected.latitude}%2C${selected.longitude}`;
}

function buildLogisticsSocketUrl(): string | null {
  if (typeof window === "undefined") return null;
  const token = getAccessToken();
  if (!token) return null;
  const base = API_URL.replace(/^http/i, "ws").replace(/\/$/, "");
  return `${base}/ws/logistics?scope=partner&token=${encodeURIComponent(token)}`;
}

export default function LogisticsPartnerDashboardPage() {
  const { density } = useDensity();
  const cellPad = dc(density, "px-1.5 py-1", "px-2 py-1.5", "px-3 py-2");
  const bodyText = dc(density, "text-[10px]", "text-[11px]", "text-xs");
  const [data, setData] = useState<DashboardData | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [refreshing, setRefreshing] = useState(false);
  const [selectedShipmentId, setSelectedShipmentId] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const hasLoadedRef = useRef(false);
  const requestInFlightRef = useRef<Promise<void> | null>(null);
  const locale = useLocaleStore((s) => s.locale);
  const isRtl = isRtlLocale(locale);
  const formatPrice = useCurrencyStore((s) => s.format);

  // Quote calculator state
  const [calcExpanded, setCalcExpanded] = useState(false);
  const [calcCountry, setCalcCountry] = useState("");
  const [calcCity, setCalcCity] = useState("");
  const [calcWeight, setCalcWeight] = useState("");
  const [calcLoading, setCalcLoading] = useState(false);
  const [calcResult, setCalcResult] = useState<ShippingQuoteResult | null>(null);
  const [calcError, setCalcError] = useState("");

  const handleCalcQuote = useCallback(async () => {
    setCalcLoading(true);
    setCalcError("");
    setCalcResult(null);
    try {
      const res = await apiFetch("/logistics-partners/shipping-quote", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          country: calcCountry,
          city: calcCity,
          total_weight_kg: parseFloat(calcWeight) || 0,
        }),
      });
      const payload = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error(payload.detail || "Quote failed");
      setCalcResult(payload as ShippingQuoteResult);
    } catch (err) {
      setCalcError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Could not compute quote");
    } finally {
      setCalcLoading(false);
    }
  }, [calcCountry, calcCity, calcWeight]);

  const fetchDashboard = useCallback(async (mode: "initial" | "background" | "manual" = "initial") => {
    if (requestInFlightRef.current) {
      return requestInFlightRef.current;
    }

    if (mode === "initial" && !hasLoadedRef.current) {
      setLoading(true);
    } else {
      setRefreshing(true);
    }

    const requestPromise = (async () => {
      const res = await apiFetch("/logistics-partners/dashboard").catch(() => null);
      if (res?.ok) {
        const nextData = normalizeDashboardData(await res.json());
        setData(nextData);
      }
      hasLoadedRef.current = true;
    })()
      .finally(() => {
        requestInFlightRef.current = null;
        setLoading(false);
        setRefreshing(false);
      });

    requestInFlightRef.current = requestPromise;
    return requestPromise;
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    void fetchDashboard("initial");
  }, [fetchDashboard]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!data?.live_locations?.length) {
      setSelectedShipmentId(null);
      return;
    }
    setSelectedShipmentId((current) => {
      if (current && data.live_locations.some((location) => location.shipment_id === current)) {
        return current;
      }
      return data.live_locations[0].shipment_id;
    });
  }, [data]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const socketUrl = buildLogisticsSocketUrl();
    if (!socketUrl) return;
    const scheduler = createRealtimeRefreshScheduler(() => fetchDashboard("background"), 900);
    const handle = openRealtimeSocket(socketUrl, {
      onMessage: () => {
        scheduler.trigger();
      },
    });
    return () => {
      scheduler.cancel();
      handle.close();
    };
  }, [fetchDashboard]);

  const selectedLocation = useMemo(() => {
    if (!data?.live_locations?.length) return null;
    return data.live_locations.find((location) => location.shipment_id === selectedShipmentId) ?? data.live_locations[0];
  }, [data, selectedShipmentId]);

  const mapEmbedUrl = useMemo(
    () => buildMapEmbedUrl(data?.live_locations ?? [], selectedLocation),
    [data, selectedLocation],
  );

  return (
    <LogisticsPartnerLayout title="Dashboard">
        <PanelContent className="space-y-3" dir={isRtl ? "rtl" : "ltr"}>
        <PanelHero
          eyebrow="Operations"
          title={<TranslatedText text="Shipment Operations" />}
          description={<TranslatedText text="Live fleet activity, SLA compliance, and delivery operations." />}
          actions={
            <>
              <Link href="/logistics-partner/payouts" className="theme-btn-accent rounded-xl px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-bold">
                <TranslatedText text="Open Payouts" />
              </Link>
              <button
                onClick={() => {
                  void fetchDashboard("manual");
                }}
                className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface-2 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-text-muted transition-colors hover:text-text"
              >
                <RefreshCw className={`h-3.5 w-3.5 ${loading || refreshing ? "animate-spin" : ""}`} />
                <TranslatedText text="Refresh" />
              </button>
            </>
          }
        />

        {/* Stats strip */}
        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 sm:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-5">
          {loading || !data
            ? Array.from({ length: 5 }).map((_, index) => (
                <div key={index} className="h-14 animate-pulse rounded-xl bg-surface-2" />
              ))
            : STAT_CARDS.map((card, index) => (
                <motion.div
                  key={card.key}
                  initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 6 }}
                  animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
                  transition={{ delay: index * 0.04 }}
                  className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface p-2.5"
                >
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-1 mb-0.5">
                    <span className={`rounded-lg px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold ${card.chip}`}>
                      <TranslatedText text={card.label} />
                    </span>
                    <card.icon className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-primary" />
                  </div>
                  <p className="text-xs font-bold text-text">{data.stats[card.key]}</p>
                </motion.div>
              ))}
        </div>

        {loading || !data ? (
          <div className="grid gap-3 xl:grid-cols-[1.35fr_0.95fr]">
            <div className="space-y-3">
              {Array.from({ length: 3 }).map((_, i) => (
                <div key={i} className="h-32 animate-pulse rounded-xl bg-surface-2" />
              ))}
            </div>
            <div className="space-y-3">
              {Array.from({ length: 2 }).map((_, i) => (
                <div key={i} className="h-24 animate-pulse rounded-xl bg-surface-2" />
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <>
            <div className="grid gap-3 xl:grid-cols-[1.35fr_0.95fr]">
              <div className="space-y-3">
                <div className="theme-card rounded-xl border p-3">
                  <div className="mb-2 flex items-center gap-2">
                    <BarChart3 className="h-4 w-4 text-primary" />
                    <h3 className="text-xs font-bold text-text"><TranslatedText text="Operational Analytics" /></h3>
                  </div>
                    <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-1.5 lg:grid-cols-4">
                      {ANALYTICS_CARDS.map((card) => (
                        <div key={card.key} className="rounded-lg border border-border bg-surface-2/50 px-2 py-1.5">
                          <p className="text-xs font-bold text-text">{card.format(data.analytics[card.key])}</p>
                          <p className="text-[11px] text-text-muted"><TranslatedText text={card.label} /></p>
                      </div>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                  {Object.keys(data.analytics.status_breakdown).length > 0 && (
                    <div className="mt-2 grid grid-cols-2 gap-1.5 lg:grid-cols-4">
                      {Object.entries(data.analytics.status_breakdown).map(([status, count]) => (
                        <div key={status} className="rounded-lg border border-border bg-surface-2/50 px-2 py-1.5">
                          <p className="text-xs font-bold text-text">{count}</p>
                          <p className="text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-text-faint">
                            <TranslatedText text={status.replace(/_/g, " ")} />
                          </p>
                        </div>
                      ))}
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>

                <div className="theme-card rounded-xl border p-3">
                  <div className="mb-2 flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                      <MapPinned className="h-4 w-4 text-primary" />
                      <h3 className="text-xs font-bold text-text"><TranslatedText text="Live Fleet Map" /></h3>
                    </div>
                    <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-full bg-primary/10 px-2.5 py-1 text-[11px] font-semibold text-primary">
                      <Radio className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                      {data.live_locations.length} live pings
                    </span>
                  </div>
                  {selectedLocation && mapEmbedUrl ? (
                    <>
                      <div className="overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface-2">
                        <iframe
                          title="Live fleet map"
                          src={mapEmbedUrl}
                          className="h-48 w-full border-0"
                          loading="lazy"
                          referrerPolicy="no-referrer-when-downgrade"
                        />
                      </div>
                      <div className="mt-2 flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">
                        {data.live_locations.map((location) => (
                          <button
                            key={location.shipment_id}
                            onClick={() => setSelectedShipmentId(location.shipment_id)}
                            className={`rounded-lg border px-2 py-1 text-left text-xs transition-colors ${selectedShipmentId === location.shipment_id ? "border-primary bg-primary/10 text-primary" : "border-border bg-surface-2 text-text-muted hover:text-text"}`}
                          >
                            <span className="block font-semibold text-[11px]">#{location.shipment_id}</span>
                            <span className="block text-[10px] text-text-faint">{location.current_hub || location.location || location.tracking_number || "GPS"}</span>
                          </button>
                        ))}
                      </div>
                      <div className="mt-2 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface-2/50 px-3 py-2 text-xs text-text-muted">
                        <div>
                          <p className="font-semibold text-text">Shipment #{selectedLocation.shipment_id}</p>
                          <p>{selectedLocation.current_hub || selectedLocation.location || "No hub recorded"}</p>
                          <p className="tabular-nums">{selectedLocation.latitude.toFixed(4)}, {selectedLocation.longitude.toFixed(4)}</p>
                        </div>
                        <a
                          href={buildMapHref(selectedLocation)}
                          target="_blank"
                          rel="noreferrer"
                          className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 font-semibold text-primary hover:underline"
                        >
                          Open full map <ExternalLink className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                        </a>
                      </div>
                    </>
                  ) : (
                    <div className="rounded-xl border border-dashed border-border bg-surface-2/40 px-4 py-8 text-center text-xs text-text-muted">
                      <TranslatedText text="No GPS checkpoints have been received yet for active shipments." />
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>

                <div className="theme-card overflow-hidden rounded-xl border">
                  <div className="border-b border-border px-3 py-2">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                      <Package className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-primary" />
                      <h3 className="text-xs font-bold text-text"><TranslatedText text="Active Shipments" /></h3>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  {data.active_shipments.length === 0 ? (
                    <div className="p-5 text-center text-xs text-text-muted"><TranslatedText text="No active shipments" /></div>
                  ) : (
                    <div className="overflow-x-auto">
                      <table className="w-full text-xs">
                        <thead>
                          <tr className="border-b border-border bg-surface-2/40">
                            {["Order", "Tracking", "Carrier", "Status", "Hub", "ETA"].map((heading) => (
                              <th key={heading} className={`${cellPad} text-left text-[11px] font-semibold text-text-faint uppercase tracking-wide`}><TranslatedText text={heading} /></th>
                            ))}
                          </tr>
                        </thead>
                        <tbody>
                          {data.active_shipments.map((shipment) => (
                            <tr key={shipment.id} className="border-b border-border/40 last:border-0 transition-colors hover:bg-surface-2/40">
                              <td className={`${cellPad} ${bodyText} text-text-muted tabular-nums`}>#{shipment.order_id}</td>
                              <td className={`${cellPad} font-mono ${bodyText} text-text`}>{shipment.tracking_number ?? "\u2014"}</td>
                              <td className={`${cellPad} ${bodyText} text-text-muted`}>{shipment.carrier_name ?? "\u2014"}</td>
                              <td className={cellPad}>
                                <span className="theme-chip-warning rounded-md px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-semibold">
                                  {shipment.status.replace(/_/g, " ")}

                              <td className={`${cellPad} ${bodyText} text-text-muted`}>{shipment.current_hub ?? "\u2014"}</td>
                              <td className={`${cellPad} ${bodyText} text-text-muted tabular-nums`}>

                              </td>
                            </tr>

                        </tbody>
                      </table>
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="space-y-3">
                <div className="theme-card rounded-xl border p-3">
                  <div className="mb-2 flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2">

                    </div>
                    <Link href="/logistics-partner/payouts" className="text-xs font-semibold text-primary hover:underline">
                      <TranslatedText text="Manage payouts" />

                  </div>
                  <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-1.5">
                    <div className="rounded-lg border border-border bg-surface-2/50 px-2 py-1.5">

                      <p className="text-xs text-text-muted"><TranslatedText text="Total earned" /></p>

                    <div className="rounded-lg border border-border bg-surface-2/50 px-2 py-1.5">
                      <p className="text-xs font-bold text-text">{formatPrice(data.payout_summary.available_balance)}</p>
                      <p className="text-xs text-text-muted"><TranslatedText text="Available balance" /></p>
                    </div>
                    <div className="rounded-lg border border-border bg-surface-2/50 px-2 py-1.5">
                      <p className="text-xs font-bold text-text">{formatPrice(data.payout_summary.pending_amount)}</p>
                      <p className="text-xs text-text-muted"><TranslatedText text="Pending" /></p>
                    </div>
                    <div className="rounded-lg border border-border bg-surface-2/50 px-2 py-1.5">
                      <p className="text-xs font-bold text-text">{formatPrice(data.payout_summary.completed_amount)}</p>
                      <p className="text-xs text-text-muted"><TranslatedText text="Completed" /></p>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <div className="mt-2 space-y-1.5">
                    {data.payout_summary.recent_payouts.length === 0 ? (

                          <div>
                            <p className="font-semibold text-text">{formatPrice(payout.amount)}</p>

                            {payout.status}
                          </span>
                        </div>
                      ))
                    )}
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* ── Recent Earnings Breakdown ─────────────────────────── */}
                <div className="theme-card rounded-xl border p-3">
                  <div className="mb-2 flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                      <TrendingUp className="h-4 w-4 text-primary" />
                      <h3 className="text-xs font-bold text-text"><TranslatedText text="Recent Earnings" /></h3>
                    </div>
                    <Link href="/logistics-partner/payouts" className="text-xs font-semibold text-primary hover:underline">
                      <TranslatedText text="View all" />
                    </Link>
                  </div>
                  {data.payout_summary.recent_earnings.length === 0 ? (
                    <p className="text-xs text-text-muted"><TranslatedText text="No delivered shipments yet." /></p>
                  ) : (
                    <div className="space-y-1.5">
                      {data.payout_summary.recent_earnings.map((earning) => (
                        <div key={earning.shipment_id} className="flex items-center justify-between rounded-lg border border-border bg-surface-2/40 px-2 py-1.5 text-xs">
                          <div>
                            <p className="font-semibold text-text">{formatPrice(earning.amount)}</p>
                            <p className="text-[10px] text-text-muted">
                              Order #{earning.order_id} · Shipment #{earning.shipment_id}
                              {earning.tracking_number ? ` · ${earning.tracking_number}` : ""}
                            </p>
                            <p className="text-[10px] text-text-faint">
                              {earning.delivered_at ? new Date(earning.delivered_at).toLocaleDateString() : "—"}

                {/* ── Earnings Calculator ───────────────────────────────── */}
                <div className="theme-card rounded-xl border p-3">
                  <button

                      <Calculator className="h-4 w-4 text-primary" />
                      <h3 className="text-xs font-bold text-text"><TranslatedText text="Earnings Calculator" /></h3>
                    </div>
                    <ChevronDown className={`h-4 w-4 text-text-muted transition-transform ${calcExpanded ? "rotate-180" : ""}`} />
                  </button>
                  {calcExpanded && (
                    <div className="mt-3 space-y-3">
                      <p className="text-[11px] text-text-muted"><TranslatedText text="Estimate how much you earn delivering to a destination based on your approved service areas." /></p>
                      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
                        <div>
                          <label className="mb-1 block text-[10px] font-semibold text-text-muted">Country</label>
                          <input
                            value={calcCountry}
                            onChange={(e) => setCalcCountry(e.target.value)}
                            placeholder="e.g. UAE"
                            className="theme-input w-full rounded-lg border px-2 py-1.5 text-xs"
                          />
                        </div>
                        <div>
                          <label className="mb-1 block text-[10px] font-semibold text-text-muted">City</label>
                          <input
                            value={calcCity}
                            onChange={(e) => setCalcCity(e.target.value)}
                            placeholder="e.g. Dubai"
                            className="theme-input w-full rounded-lg border px-2 py-1.5 text-xs"
                          />
                        </div>
                        <div className="col-span-2">
                          <label className="mb-1 block text-[10px] font-semibold text-text-muted">Weight (kg)</label>
                          <input
                            type="number"
                            min="0"
                            step="0.1"
                            value={calcWeight}
                            onChange={(e) => setCalcWeight(e.target.value)}
                            placeholder="e.g. 2.5"
                            className="theme-input w-full rounded-lg border px-2 py-1.5 text-xs"
                          />
                        </div>
                      </div>
                      <button
                        onClick={handleCalcQuote}
                        disabled={calcLoading || !calcCountry.trim()}
                        className="theme-btn-primary w-full rounded-xl px-4 py-2 text-xs font-semibold disabled:opacity-50"
                      >
                        {calcLoading ? (
                          <RefreshCw className="mx-auto h-4 w-4 animate-spin" />
                        ) : (
                          <TranslatedText text="Calculate Earnings" />
                        )}
                      </button>
                      {calcError && <p className="text-xs text-danger">{calcError}</p>}
                      {calcResult && (
                        <div className="space-y-1.5">
                          {calcResult.source === "none" ? (
                            <div className="rounded-xl border border-warning/30 bg-warning/10 px-3 py-2.5 text-xs text-warning">
                              <TranslatedText text="No approved service area matches this route. Submit and get a service area approved to start earning for this destination." />
                            </div>
                          ) : (
                            <>
                              <div className="flex items-center justify-between rounded-xl border border-success/30 bg-success/10 px-3 py-2">
                                <p className="text-xs font-bold text-text"><TranslatedText text="You earn" /></p>
                                <p className="text-sm font-black text-success">{formatPrice(calcResult.shipping_amount)}</p>
                              </div>
                              {calcResult.pricing_breakdown && (
                                <div className="space-y-1 rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface-2/50 p-2.5 text-xs">
                                  {(
                                    [
                                      { label: "Base fee", value: calcResult.pricing_breakdown.base_fee },
                                      ...(calcResult.pricing_breakdown.pickup_fee > 0 ? [{ label: "Pickup charge", value: calcResult.pricing_breakdown.pickup_fee }] : []),
                                      ...(calcResult.pricing_breakdown.dropoff_fee > 0 ? [{ label: "Dropoff charge", value: calcResult.pricing_breakdown.dropoff_fee }] : []),
                                      ...(calcResult.pricing_breakdown.weight_fee > 0
                                        ? [{
                                            label: `Weight (${calcResult.pricing_breakdown.total_weight_kg ?? "?"}kg × ${calcResult.pricing_breakdown.per_kg_rate ?? "?"}/${String.fromCharCode(0x6b,0x67)})`,
                                            value: calcResult.pricing_breakdown.weight_fee,
                                          }]
                                        : []),
                                      ...(calcResult.pricing_breakdown.distance_fee > 0
                                        ? [{
                                            label: `Distance (${calcResult.pricing_breakdown.distance_km ?? "?"}km × ${calcResult.pricing_breakdown.per_km_rate ?? "?"}/km)`,
                                            value: calcResult.pricing_breakdown.distance_fee,
                                          }]
                                        : []),
                                      ...(calcResult.pricing_breakdown.handling_fee !== 0 ? [{ label: "Handling", value: calcResult.pricing_breakdown.handling_fee }] : []),
                                      ...(calcResult.pricing_breakdown.load_fit_adjustment_amount !== 0 ? [{ label: `Load-fit (${calcResult.pricing_breakdown.load_fit_label || "standard"})`, value: calcResult.pricing_breakdown.load_fit_adjustment_amount }] : []),
                                      ...(calcResult.pricing_breakdown.surcharge_amount !== 0 ? [{ label: "Runtime surcharge", value: calcResult.pricing_breakdown.surcharge_amount }] : []),
                                      ...(calcResult.pricing_breakdown.weight_discount_amount > 0 ? [{ label: "Weight discount", value: -calcResult.pricing_breakdown.weight_discount_amount }] : []),
                                    ] as Array<{ label: string; value: number }>
                                  ).map(({ label, value }) => (
                                    <div key={label} className="flex items-center justify-between text-[11px]">
                                      <span className="text-text-muted">{label}</span>
                                      <span className={`font-semibold tabular-nums ${value < 0 ? "text-success" : "text-text"}`}>
                                        {value < 0 ? "−" : "+"}{formatPrice(Math.abs(value))}
                                      </span>
                                    </div>
                                  ))}
                                  <div className="mt-1 flex items-center justify-between border-t border-border pt-1.5 text-xs font-bold">
                                    <span className="text-text"><TranslatedText text="Total" /></span>
                                    <span className="text-primary">{formatPrice(calcResult.pricing_breakdown.shipping_amount)}</span>
                                  </div>
                                  {calcResult.pricing_breakdown.floor_applied && (
                                    <p className="text-[10px] text-text-muted"><TranslatedText text="Minimum charge floor applied." /></p>
                                  )}
                                  <p className="mt-0.5 text-[10px] text-text-faint capitalize">
                                    {calcResult.pricing_breakdown.route_type === "in_city" ? "In-city delivery" : "Inter-city delivery"}
                                    {calcResult.partner_name ? ` · ${calcResult.partner_name}` : ""}
                                  </p>
                                </div>
                              )}
                            </>
                          )}
                        </div>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>

                <div className="theme-card rounded-xl border p-3">
                  <div className="mb-2 flex items-center gap-2">
                    <Route className="h-4 w-4 text-primary" />
                    <h3 className="text-xs font-bold text-text"><TranslatedText text="Suggested Route Plan" /></h3>
                  </div>
                  <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-1.5">
                    <div className="rounded-lg border border-border bg-surface-2/50 px-2 py-1.5">
                      <p className="text-xs font-bold text-text">{data.route_plan.total_stops}</p>
                      <p className="text-xs text-text-muted"><TranslatedText text="Stops" /></p>
                    </div>
                    <div className="rounded-lg border border-border bg-surface-2/50 px-2 py-1.5">
                      <p className="text-xs font-bold text-text">{data.route_plan.estimated_distance_km.toFixed(1)} km</p>
                      <p className="text-xs text-text-muted"><TranslatedText text="Distance" /></p>
                    </div>
                    <div className="col-span-2 rounded-lg border border-border bg-surface-2/50 px-2 py-1.5">
                      <p className="text-xs font-bold text-text">{data.route_plan.estimated_duration_hours.toFixed(1)} h</p>
                      <p className="text-xs text-text-muted"><TranslatedText text="Est. duration" /></p>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <div className="mt-2 space-y-1.5">
                    {data.route_plan.stops.length === 0 ? (
                      <p className="text-xs text-text-muted"><TranslatedText text="Route guidance will appear after GPS updates arrive." /></p>
                    ) : (
                      data.route_plan.stops.slice(0, 5).map((stop) => (
                        <div key={stop.shipment_id} className="rounded-lg border border-border bg-surface-2/40 px-2 py-1.5 text-xs">
                          <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
                            <p className="font-semibold text-text">Stop {stop.stop_number}: #{stop.shipment_id}</p>
                            <span className="text-text-muted tabular-nums">+{stop.distance_from_previous_km.toFixed(1)} km</span>
                          </div>
                          <p className="text-[11px] text-text-muted">{stop.current_hub || stop.location || stop.tracking_number || "Live position"}</p>
                        </div>
                      ))
                    )}
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div className="theme-card rounded-xl border p-3">
                  <div className="mb-2 flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                      <AlertTriangle className="h-4 w-4 text-danger" />
                      <h3 className="text-xs font-bold text-text"><TranslatedText text="SLA Breach Alerts" /></h3>
                    </div>
                    <span className="rounded-full bg-danger/10 px-2.5 py-1 text-[11px] font-semibold text-danger">
                      {data.sla_alerts.length} <TranslatedText text="open alerts" />
                    </span>
                  </div>
                  {data.sla_alerts.length === 0 ? (
                    <div className="rounded-xl border border-dashed border-border bg-surface-2/30 px-4 py-4 text-center text-xs text-text-muted">
                      <TranslatedText text="No overdue shipments. Current route is within SLA." />
                    </div>
                  ) : (
                    <div className="space-y-1.5">
                      {data.sla_alerts.map((alert) => (
                        <div key={alert.shipment_id} className="rounded-lg border border-danger/20 bg-danger/5 px-2.5 py-1.5 text-xs">
                          <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
                            <p className="font-semibold text-text">#{alert.shipment_id}</p>
                            <span className="font-medium text-danger tabular-nums">{alert.overdue_hours.toFixed(1)}h overdue</span>
                          </div>
                          <p className="text-[11px] text-text-muted">{alert.current_hub || "Unknown"} · <TranslatedText text="ETA was" /> {formatLocalizedDateTime(alert.estimated_delivery, locale)}</p>
                        </div>
                      ))}
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>

                {Object.keys(data.channel_breakdown).length > 0 && (
                  <div className="theme-card rounded-xl border p-3">
                    <div className="mb-2 flex items-center gap-2">
                      <BarChart3 className="h-4 w-4 text-primary" />
                      <h3 className="text-xs font-bold text-text"><TranslatedText text="Distribution Channels" /></h3>
                    </div>
                    <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-1.5">
                      {Object.entries(data.channel_breakdown).map(([channel, count]) => (
                        <div key={channel} className="theme-chip-info rounded-xl px-3 py-2">
                          <p className="text-base font-bold text-text">{count}</p>
                          <p className="text-[11px] capitalize text-text-muted"><TranslatedText text={channel.replace(/_/g, " ")} /></p>
                        </div>
                      ))}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>
          </>
        )}
        </PanelContent>
    </LogisticsPartnerLayout>
  );
}
```

### `frontend\web_app\src\app\logistics-partner\login\page.tsx`

```text
"use client";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import Link from "next/link";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { motion } from "framer-motion";
import { LogIn, AlertCircle, Truck } from "lucide-react";
import { apiFetch, getErrorMessage, parseJsonResponse, setAccessToken, clearAccessToken } from "@/lib/api";
import { useAuth } from "@/lib/useAuth";

export default function LogisticsPartnerLoginPage() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const { refresh, user, isLoading } = useAuth();
  const [username, setUsername] = useState("");
  const [password, setPassword] = useState("");
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    router.prefetch("/logistics-partner/dashboard");
  }, [router]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isLoading || user?.role !== "logistics_partner") {
      return;
    }
    router.replace("/logistics-partner/dashboard");
  }, [isLoading, router, user]);

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setError("");
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const body = new URLSearchParams({ username, password });
      const res = await apiFetch("/auth/login", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/x-www-form-urlencoded" },
        body,
      });
      const data = await parseJsonResponse(res);
      if (!res.ok) {
        setError(getErrorMessage(data || {}));
        setLoading(false);
        return;
      }
      if (!data?.access_token) {
        setError("Network error — please try again.");
        setLoading(false);
        return;
      }
      setAccessToken(data.access_token);
      localStorage.setItem("zozi_has_session", "1");
      const user = await refresh(true);
      if (!user) {
        clearAccessToken();
        localStorage.removeItem("zozi_has_session");
        setError("Network error — please try again.");
        return;
      }
      if (user.role !== "logistics_partner") {
        setError("This account does not have logistics partner access.");
        clearAccessToken();
        localStorage.removeItem("zozi_has_session");
        setLoading(false);
        return;
      }
      router.push("/logistics-partner/dashboard");
    } catch {
      setError("Network error — please try again.");
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <main className="flex min-h-screen items-center justify-center bg-surface-base px-4 py-16 text-text">
      <motion.div
        initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }}
        animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
        className="w-full max-w-md"
      >
        <div className="text-center mb-8">
          <div className="theme-chip-brand mx-auto mb-4 flex h-14 w-14 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl">
            <Truck className="h-7 w-7 text-primary" />
          </div>
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-text">Logistics Partner</h1>
          <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-text-muted">Sign in to access your delivery portal</p>
        </div>

        <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="theme-card space-y-5 rounded-2xl border p-6">
          {error && (
            <div className="theme-alert-danger flex items-center gap-2 rounded-xl p-3 text-sm">
              <AlertCircle className="h-4 w-4 shrink-0" />
              {error}
            </div>
          )}

          <div>
            <label className="mb-1.5 block text-xs font-semibold text-text-muted">Username</label>
            <input
              value={username}
              onChange={(e) => setUsername(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="Username"
              required
              className="theme-input w-full rounded-xl border px-4 py-3 text-sm placeholder:text-text-faint focus:border-primary focus:outline-none transition-colors"
            />
          </div>
          <div>
            <label className="mb-1.5 block text-xs font-semibold text-text-muted">Password</label>
            <input
              type="password"
              value={password}
              onChange={(e) => setPassword(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="••••••••"
              required
              className="theme-input w-full rounded-xl border px-4 py-3 text-sm placeholder:text-text-faint focus:border-primary focus:outline-none transition-colors"
            />
          </div>

          <button
            type="submit"
            disabled={loading || !username || !password}
            className="theme-btn-primary flex w-full items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl py-3 text-sm font-bold disabled:opacity-50"
          >
            {loading ? (
              <div className="h-4 w-4 rounded-full border-2 border-on-brand/30 border-t-on-brand animate-spin" />
            ) : (
              <LogIn className="w-4 h-4" />
            )}
            {loading ? "Signing in…" : "Sign In"}
          </button>
        </form>

        <p className="mt-4 text-center text-sm text-text-muted">
          No Logistic account?{" "}
          <Link
            href="/logistics-partner/register"
            className="theme-link-brand font-semibold"
          >
            Register
          </Link>
        </p>
      </motion.div>
    </main>
  );
}
```

```text
﻿"use client";

import { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { motion } from "framer-motion";
import { TrendingUp, ChevronDown, ChevronUp, AlertTriangle, Building2, CheckCircle, Clock, XCircle, Save } from "@/lib/icons";
import { apiFetch } from "@/lib/api";
import { formatCurrencyAmount } from "@/lib/currencyStore";

interface FinanceSummary {
  total_delivery_fees: number;
  total_cod_collected: number;
  total_cod_remitted: number;
  pending_cod_remittance: number;
  total_deliveries: number;
  total_pickup_fees?: number;
  total_dropoff_fees?: number;
  total_refund_reversals?: number;
  currency: string;
  bank_instruction?: BankInstruction | null;
}

interface BankInstruction {
  configured: boolean;
  title: string;
  beneficiary_name?: string | null;
  bank_name?: string | null;
  branch_name?: string | null;
  account_number?: string | null;
  iban?: string | null;
  swift_code?: string | null;
  routing_number?: string | null;
  support_email?: string | null;
  support_phone?: string | null;
  reference_value?: string | null;
  reference_help?: string | null;
  instructions?: string | null;
}

interface Settlement {
  id: number;
  order_id: number;
  total_delivery_fee: number;
  pickup_charge: number;
  dropoff_charge: number;
  currency?: string;
  cod_collected?: number;
  cod_remitted?: number;
  cod_retained?: number;
  cod_remittance_status?: string;
  status: string;
  created_at: string;
  settled_at: string | null;
  payment_method?: string | null;
  destination_country?: string | null;
  destination_city?: string | null;
  partner_name?: string | null;
  partner_code?: string | null;
  service_area_label?: string | null;
  allocation_source?: string | null;
  refund_status?: string | null;
  logistics_reversal_amount?: number | null;
  customer_refund_amount?: number | null;
  allocations?: Array<{
    supplier_id: number;
    supplier_name?: string | null;
    shipping_amount: number;
    pickup_charge: number;
    dropoff_charge: number;
  }>;
}

interface RecipientBankAccount {
  configured: boolean;
  id?: number;
  beneficiary_name?: string | null;
  bank_name?: string | null;
  branch_name?: string | null;
  account_number?: string | null;
  iban?: string | null;
  swift_code?: string | null;
  routing_number?: string | null;
  currency?: string;
  bank_country?: string | null;
  verification_status?: "pending" | "verified" | "rejected";
  verification_note?: string | null;
  verified_at?: string | null;
}

interface CODReceipt {
  id: number;
  settlement_id: number;
  partner_id: number;
  order_id: number;
  amount: number;
  currency: string;
  bank_reference?: string | null;
  receipt_file_url: string;
  notes?: string | null;
  status: string;
  review_note?: string | null;
  created_at: string;
  reviewed_at?: string | null;
  due_amount: number;
  remitted_before_receipt: number;
  remaining_amount: number;
}

const EMPTY_BANK_FORM = {
  beneficiary_name: "",
  bank_name: "",
  branch_name: "",
  account_number: "",
  iban: "",
  swift_code: "",
  routing_number: "",
  currency: "OMR",
  bank_country: "",
};

const EMPTY_RECEIPT_FORM = {
  settlement_id: "",
  amount: "",
  bank_reference: "",
  notes: "",
};

function fmtCurrency(v: number, currency = "OMR") {
  return formatCurrencyAmount(v || 0, currency);
}

function paymentMethodLabel(value?: string | null) {
  if (value === "cod") return "Cash on Delivery";
  if (value === "tap") return "Tap";
  if (value === "paytabs") return "PayTabs";
  if (value === "thawani") return "Thawani Pay";
  if (value === "paypal") return "PayPal";
  if (value === "stripe" || value === "card") return "Card";
  if (value === "hyperpay") return "HyperPay";
  if (value === "omannet") return "OmanNet";
  return "Unspecified";
}

function chipClass(status?: string | null) {
  if (status === "settled" || status === "complete" || status === "completed") return "theme-chip-success";
  if (status === "pending" || status === "eligible" || status === "processing" || status === "partial") return "theme-chip-warning";
  if (status === "reversed" || status === "failed") return "theme-chip-danger";
  return "theme-chip-muted";
}

function normalizeStatus(value?: string | null) {
  return String(value || "").trim().toLowerCase();
}

function buildRouteLabel(settlement: Settlement) {
  const routeBits = [settlement.partner_name, settlement.service_area_label].filter(Boolean);
  const destinationBits = [settlement.destination_city, settlement.destination_country].filter(Boolean);
  return {
    route: routeBits.join(" · ") || "Snapshot unavailable",
    destination: destinationBits.join(", ") || null,
  };
}

export default function FinanceSection() {
  const [summary, setSummary] = useState<FinanceSummary | null>(null);
  const [settlements, setSettlements] = useState<Settlement[]>([]);
  const [receipts, setReceipts] = useState<CODReceipt[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  const [bankOpen, setBankOpen] = useState(false);

  const [bankSaving, setBankSaving] = useState(false);

  const [receiptForm, setReceiptForm] = useState({ ...EMPTY_RECEIPT_FORM });

  const [receiptMsg, setReceiptMsg] = useState<{ type: "success" | "error"; text: string } | null>(null);

  const loadFinanceData = useCallback(async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    Promise.all([
      apiFetch("/finance/logistics/summary").then((r) => (r.ok ? r.json() : null)).catch(() => null),
      apiFetch("/finance/logistics/settlements").then((r) => (r.ok ? r.json() : [])).catch(() => []),
      apiFetch("/logistics-partners/me/bank-account").then((r) => (r.ok ? r.json() : null)).catch(() => null),
      apiFetch("/logistics-partners/me/cod-remittance-receipts").then((r) => (r.ok ? r.json() : [])).catch(() => []),
    ]).then(([sum, sett, ba, receiptRows]) => {
      if (sum) setSummary(sum);
      if (Array.isArray(sett)) setSettlements(sett);
      if (Array.isArray(receiptRows)) setReceipts(receiptRows);
      if (ba && ba.id) {
        setBankAccount(ba);
        setBankForm({
          beneficiary_name: ba.beneficiary_name || "",
          bank_name: ba.bank_name || "",
          branch_name: ba.branch_name || "",
          account_number: ba.account_number || "",
          iban: ba.iban || "",
          swift_code: ba.swift_code || "",
          routing_number: ba.routing_number || "",
          currency: ba.currency || "OMR",
          bank_country: ba.bank_country || "",
        });
      }
      setLoading(false);
    });
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    void loadFinanceData();
  }, [loadFinanceData]);

  const pendingCodSettlements = useMemo(
    () => settlements.filter((settlement) => Number(settlement.cod_collected || 0) > Number(settlement.cod_remitted || 0)),
    [settlements],
  );

  const latestReceiptBySettlement = useMemo(() => {
    const mapping = new Map<number, CODReceipt>();
    receipts.forEach((receipt) => {
      if (!mapping.has(receipt.settlement_id)) {
        mapping.set(receipt.settlement_id, receipt);
      }
    });
    return mapping;
  }, [receipts]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!receiptForm.settlement_id && pendingCodSettlements.length > 0) {
      setReceiptForm((current) => ({ ...current, settlement_id: String(pendingCodSettlements[0].id) }));
    }
  }, [pendingCodSettlements, receiptForm.settlement_id]);

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div className="theme-card rounded-xl border p-5 space-y-3">
        <div className="h-5 w-40 rounded bg-surface-2 animate-pulse" />
        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-4 gap-3">
          {Array.from({ length: 4 }).map((_, i) => (
            <div key={i} className="h-20 rounded-xl bg-surface-2 animate-pulse" />
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (!summary) return null;

  const hasPendingCod = summary.pending_cod_remittance > 0;

  return (
    <div className="theme-card rounded-xl border overflow-hidden">
      {/* Header toggle */}
      <button onClick={() => setOpen((p) => !p)}
        className="w-full flex items-center justify-between p-5 text-left hover:bg-surface-2/50 transition-colors">
        <span className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-bold text-text">
          <TrendingUp className="w-4 h-4 text-primary" />
          Financial Overview
          {hasPendingCod && (
            <span className="ml-1 inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-lg bg-warning/10 px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold text-warning">
              <AlertTriangle className="w-3 h-3" /> COD pending
            </span>
          )}
        </span>
        {open ? <ChevronUp className="w-4 h-4 text-text-muted" /> : <ChevronDown className="w-4 h-4 text-text-muted" />}
      </button>

      {open && (
        <motion.div initial={{ opacity: 0 }} animate={{ opacity: 1 }} className="px-5 pb-5 space-y-5">
          {/* KPI cards */}
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 xl:grid-cols-6 gap-3">
            {[
              { label: "Delivery Fees", value: fmtCurrency(summary.total_delivery_fees, summary.currency), chip: "theme-chip-success" },
              { label: "COD Collected", value: fmtCurrency(summary.total_cod_collected, summary.currency), chip: "theme-chip-info" },
              { label: "COD Remitted", value: fmtCurrency(summary.total_cod_remitted, summary.currency), chip: "theme-chip-muted" },
              { label: "Pending COD", value: fmtCurrency(summary.pending_cod_remittance, summary.currency), chip: hasPendingCod ? "theme-chip-warning" : "theme-chip-muted" },
              { label: "Pickup Fees", value: fmtCurrency(summary.total_pickup_fees || 0, summary.currency), chip: "theme-chip-brand" },
              { label: "Refund Reversals", value: fmtCurrency(summary.total_refund_reversals || 0, summary.currency), chip: "theme-chip-danger" },
            ].map((c) => (
              <div key={c.label} className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface p-3">
                <span className={`rounded-lg px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold ${c.chip}`}>{c.label}</span>
                <p className="mt-2 text-lg font-bold text-text">{c.value}</p>

                <strong>COD Remittance Pending:</strong> You have {fmtCurrency(summary.pending_cod_remittance, summary.currency)} in collected cash-on-delivery

                </div>
                <div className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface-2/40 p-3">
                  <p className="text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.18em] text-text-faint">Bank</p>

                  {summary.bank_instruction?.beneficiary_name && (
                    <p className="mt-1 text-[11px] text-text-muted">{summary.bank_instruction.beneficiary_name}</p>
                  )}
                </div>
                <div className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface-2/40 p-3">
                  <p className="text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.18em] text-text-faint">Account / IBAN</p>
                  <p className="mt-2 text-xs font-semibold text-text">{summary.bank_instruction?.account_number || summary.bank_instruction?.iban || "Not configured"}</p>
                  {summary.bank_instruction?.swift_code && (
                    <p className="mt-1 text-[11px] text-text-muted">SWIFT {summary.bank_instruction.swift_code}</p>

              </div>

              {(summary.bank_instruction?.support_email || summary.bank_instruction?.support_phone || summary.bank_instruction?.instructions) && (
                <div className="mt-3 space-y-1 text-xs text-text-muted">

          <div className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface p-4">
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-3">

              </div>
              <span className={`rounded-lg px-2 py-1 text-[10px] font-bold ${pendingCodSettlements.length > 0 ? "theme-chip-warning" : "theme-chip-success"}`}>
                {pendingCodSettlements.length > 0 ? `${pendingCodSettlements.length} pending COD row${pendingCodSettlements.length === 1 ? "" : "s"}` : "No COD proof pending"}
              </span>

            <div className="mt-4 grid gap-4 xl:grid-cols-[0.95fr,1.05fr]">
              <div className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface-2/40 p-3">

                      >
                        {pendingCodSettlements.map((settlement) => {
                          const remaining = Number(settlement.cod_collected || 0) - Number(settlement.cod_retained || 0) - Number(settlement.cod_remitted || 0);
                          return (
                            <option key={settlement.id} value={settlement.id}>
                              {`Order #${settlement.order_id} · due ${fmtCurrency(Math.max(remaining, 0), settlement.currency || summary.currency)}`}
                            </option>
                          );
                        })}
                      </select>
                    </div>
                    <div className="grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2">
                      <div>
                        <label className="mb-1 block text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.12em] text-text-faint">Amount remitted</label>

                      </div>

                    <div>
                      <label className="mb-1 block text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.12em] text-text-faint">Notes</label>
                      <textarea

                        onChange={(event) => setReceiptForm((current) => ({ ...current, notes: event.target.value }))}
                        placeholder="Optional note for finance review"
                        className="w-full resize-none rounded-lg border border-border bg-surface px-3 py-2 text-xs text-text focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary/40"
                      />
                    </div>
                    <div>
                      <label className="mb-1 block text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.12em] text-text-faint">Receipt file</label>
                      <input
                        type="file"
                        accept=".pdf,.jpg,.jpeg,.png,.webp"
                        onChange={(event) => setReceiptFile(event.target.files?.[0] || null)}
                        className="block w-full rounded-lg border border-border bg-surface px-3 py-2 text-xs text-text file:mr-3 file:rounded-lg file:border-0 file:bg-primary/10 file:px-3 file:py-1 file:text-primary"
                      />
                    </div>
                    {receiptMsg ? (
                      <div className={`rounded-lg border px-3 py-2 text-xs ${receiptMsg.type === "success" ? "border-success/30 bg-success/5 text-success" : "border-danger/30 bg-danger/5 text-danger"}`}>
                        {receiptMsg.text}
                      </div>
                    ) : null}
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      disabled={receiptSaving || !receiptForm.settlement_id || !receiptForm.amount || !receiptFile}
                      onClick={async () => {
                        setReceiptSaving(true);
                        setReceiptMsg(null);
                        try {
                          const body = new FormData();
                          body.append("settlement_id", receiptForm.settlement_id);
                          body.append("amount", receiptForm.amount);
                          if (receiptForm.bank_reference.trim()) body.append("bank_reference", receiptForm.bank_reference.trim());
                          if (receiptForm.notes.trim()) body.append("notes", receiptForm.notes.trim());
                          if (receiptFile) body.append("file", receiptFile);
                          const response = await apiFetch("/logistics-partners/me/cod-remittance-receipts", { method: "POST", body });
                          const payload = await response.json();
                          if (!response.ok) {
                            setReceiptMsg({ type: "error", text: payload.detail || "Failed to upload COD receipt." });
                          } else {
                            setReceiptForm({ ...EMPTY_RECEIPT_FORM, settlement_id: receiptForm.settlement_id });

                            setReceiptMsg({ type: "success", text: "COD receipt submitted for finance verification." });
                            await loadFinanceData();

                        } catch {
                          setReceiptMsg({ type: "error", text: "Network error while uploading receipt." });
                        } finally {
                          setReceiptSaving(false);
                        }
                      }}
                      className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-lg theme-btn-primary px-4 py-2 text-xs font-semibold disabled:opacity-50"
                    >
```
