### `frontend\web_app\src\app\logistics-partner\scan\page.tsx`

```text
﻿"use client";

import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import {
  Camera, ScanLine, Keyboard, RefreshCw, CheckCircle,
  XCircle, Package, Truck, MapPin, AlertCircle,
} from "@/lib/icons";
import LogisticsPartnerLayout from "@/components/LogisticsPartnerLayout";
import { PanelContent, PanelHero } from "@/components/PanelPage";
import SignaturePad from "@/components/SignaturePad";
import { apiFetch } from "@/lib/api";
import type { ShipmentConfirmationRequest } from "@/lib/types";
import { ORDER_STATUS_CHIP } from "@shared/statusColors";

interface ShipmentInfo {
  id: number;
  order_id: number;
  status: string;
  status_label?: string | null;
  carrier_name?: string | null;
  tracking_number?: string | null;
  scan_code?: string | null;
  distribution_channel?: string | null;
  current_hub?: string | null;
  shipping_address?: string | null;
  customer_name?: string | null;
  customer_phone?: string | null;
  package_count?: number | null;
  package_weight_kg?: number | null;
  package_dimensions?: string | null;
  delivery_signature_name?: string | null;
  delivery_signature_data_url?: string | null;
  delivery_signature_captured_at?: string | null;
  active_confirmation_request?: ShipmentConfirmationRequest | null;
}

interface ShipmentAction {
  status: string;
  eventType: string;
  label: string;
}

const STATUS_CHIP = ORDER_STATUS_CHIP;

function formatShipmentStatus(shipment: ShipmentInfo | null): string {
  if (!shipment) return "";
  const rawStatus = shipment.status || "";
  return shipment.status_label || rawStatus.replace(/_/g, " ");
}

function getAvailableActions(currentStatus: string): ShipmentAction[] {
  switch (currentStatus) {
    case "prepared":
      return [{ status: "picking_up", eventType: "pickup_confirmed", label: "Confirm Pickup" }];
    case "picking_up":
      return [
        { status: "shipped", eventType: "picked_from_supplier", label: "Picked From Supplier" },
        { status: "prepared", eventType: "pickup_cancelled", label: "Cancel Pickup" },
      ];
    case "shipped":
      return [
        { status: "shipped", eventType: "logistics_received", label: "Logistics Received" },
        { status: "in_transit", eventType: "distribution_checkpoint", label: "Distribution Checkpoint" },
        { status: "in_transit", eventType: "out_for_delivery", label: "Out for Delivery" },
        { status: "shipped", eventType: "shipment_delayed", label: "Shipment Delayed" },
        { status: "shipped", eventType: "shipment_rescheduled", label: "Shipment Rescheduled" },
        { status: "failed", eventType: "shipment_failed", label: "Shipment Failed" },
        { status: "returned", eventType: "shipment_cancelled", label: "Shipment Cancelled" },
        { status: "returned", eventType: "shipment_returned", label: "Shipment Returned" },
      ];
    case "in_transit":
      return [
        { status: "in_transit", eventType: "distribution_checkpoint", label: "Distribution Checkpoint" },
        { status: "in_transit", eventType: "out_for_delivery", label: "Out for Delivery" },
        { status: "delivered", eventType: "customer_received", label: "Delivered" },
        { status: "in_transit", eventType: "shipment_delayed", label: "Shipment Delayed" },
        { status: "in_transit", eventType: "shipment_rescheduled", label: "Shipment Rescheduled" },
        { status: "failed", eventType: "shipment_failed", label: "Shipment Failed" },
        { status: "returned", eventType: "shipment_cancelled", label: "Shipment Cancelled" },
        { status: "returned", eventType: "shipment_returned", label: "Shipment Returned" },
      ];
    default:
      return [];
  }
}

function actionRequiresConfirmationRequest(shipment: ShipmentInfo | null, status: string): boolean {
  if (!shipment) return false;
  return (
    (shipment.status === "picking_up" && status === "shipped")
    || ((shipment.status === "shipped" || shipment.status === "in_transit") && status === "delivered")
  );
}

function LPScannerInner() {
  const videoRef = useRef<HTMLVideoElement>(null);
  const canvasRef = useRef<HTMLCanvasElement>(null);
  const streamRef = useRef<MediaStream | null>(null);
  const scanIntervalRef = useRef<number | null>(null);
  const zxingReaderRef = useRef<any>(null);

  const [mode, setMode] = useState<"camera" | "manual">("manual");
  const [cameraActive, setCameraActive] = useState(false);
  const [cameraError, setCameraError] = useState("");
  const [manualCode, setManualCode] = useState("");
  const [scanning, setScanning] = useState(false);

  const [shipment, setShipment] = useState<ShipmentInfo | null>(null);
  const [lookupError, setLookupError] = useState("");
  const [scannedCode, setScannedCode] = useState("");
  const [newStatus, setNewStatus] = useState("");
  const [eventType, setEventType] = useState("");
  const [hubInput, setHubInput] = useState("");
  const [trackingInput, setTrackingInput] = useState("");
  const [eventNote, setEventNote] = useState("");
  const [signatureName, setSignatureName] = useState("");
  const [signatureDataUrl, setSignatureDataUrl] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [updating, setUpdating] = useState(false);
  const [updateMessage, setUpdateMessage] = useState("");

  const stopCamera = useCallback(() => {
    if (scanIntervalRef.current) {
      clearInterval(scanIntervalRef.current);
      scanIntervalRef.current = null;
    }
    if (zxingReaderRef.current) {
      try { zxingReaderRef.current.reset(); } catch {}
      zxingReaderRef.current = null;
    }
    if (streamRef.current) {
      streamRef.current.getTracks().forEach((t) => t.stop());
      streamRef.current = null;
    }
    setCameraActive(false);
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => () => stopCamera(), [stopCamera]);

  const lookupShipment = useCallback(async (code: string) => {
    if (!code.trim()) return;
    setScanning(true);
    setLookupError("");
    setShipment(null);
    setUpdateMessage("");
    const trimmed = code.trim();
    setScannedCode(trimmed);
    try {
      const res = await apiFetch(`/logistics-partners/shipments/scan?code=${encodeURIComponent(trimmed)}`);
      if (res.ok) {
        const data = await res.json();
        setShipment(data);
        setManualCode(trimmed);
        setHubInput(data.current_hub || "");
        setTrackingInput(data.tracking_number || "");
        setSignatureName(data.customer_name || data.delivery_signature_name || "");
        setSignatureDataUrl(data.delivery_signature_data_url || null);
        const availableActions = getAvailableActions(data.status);
        setNewStatus(availableActions[0]?.status ?? data.status);
        setEventType(availableActions[0]?.eventType ?? "");
      } else {
        const payload = await res.json().catch(() => null);
        setLookupError(payload?.detail || `No shipment found for code "${trimmed}"`);
      }
    } catch {
      setLookupError("Network error looking up shipment");
    }
    setScanning(false);
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (typeof window === "undefined") {
      return;
    }
    const initialCode = (new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get("code") || "").trim();
    if (!initialCode || initialCode === scannedCode || scanning) {
      return;
    }
    setManualCode(initialCode);
    void lookupShipment(initialCode);
  }, [lookupShipment, scannedCode, scanning]);

  const startCamera = async () => {
    setCameraError("");
    try {
      const stream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({
        video: { facingMode: "environment" },
      });
      streamRef.current = stream;
      if (videoRef.current) {
        videoRef.current.srcObject = stream;
        // Don't call play() here — decodeFromStream will call it internally
      }
      setCameraActive(true);

      // ZXing primary — most reliable for printed/industrial QR codes
      let zxingStarted = false;
      try {
        const { BrowserMultiFormatReader } = await import("@zxing/library");
        const reader = new BrowserMultiFormatReader();
        zxingReaderRef.current = reader;
        // decodeFromStream correctly handles an existing MediaStream
        reader.decodeFromStream(stream, videoRef.current!, (result: any, _err: any) => {
          if (result) {
            const code = result.getText();
            stopCamera();
            lookupShipment(code);
          }
        });
        zxingStarted = true;
      } catch {
        // ZXing failed — play manually for BarcodeDetector fallback
        if (videoRef.current) {
          try { await videoRef.current.play(); } catch { /* autoplay blocked */ }
        }
      }

      if (!zxingStarted) {
        if ("BarcodeDetector" in window) {
          const detector = new (window as any).BarcodeDetector({
            formats: ["qr_code", "code_128", "ean_13", "ean_8", "code_39", "upc_a", "upc_e"],
          });
          scanIntervalRef.current = window.setInterval(async () => {
            if (!videoRef.current || videoRef.current.readyState < 2) return;
            try {
              const barcodes = await detector.detect(videoRef.current);
              if (barcodes.length > 0) {
                const code = barcodes[0].rawValue as string;
                stopCamera();
                await lookupShipment(code);
              }
            } catch {}
          }, 500);
        } else {
          setCameraError(
            "Barcode detection is not supported in this browser. Please enter the code manually."
          );
        }
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      setCameraError(err?.message || "Camera access denied or not available");
    }
  };

  const handleManualLookup = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    await lookupShipment(manualCode);
  };

  const handleUpdateStatus = async () => {
    if (!shipment) return;
    setLookupError("");
    setUpdateMessage("");
    if (shipment.active_confirmation_request?.status === "pending") {
      setLookupError("A confirmation request is already pending for this shipment.");
      return;
    }
    if (newStatus === "delivered" && (!signatureName.trim() || !signatureDataUrl)) {
      setLookupError("Customer name and signature are required to confirm delivery.");
      return;
    }
    setUpdating(true);
    try {
      const requiresConfirmationRequest = actionRequiresConfirmationRequest(shipment, newStatus);
      const res = await apiFetch(
        requiresConfirmationRequest
          ? `/logistics-partners/shipments/${shipment.id}/confirmation-request`
          : `/logistics-partners/shipments/${shipment.id}/status`,
        {
        method: requiresConfirmationRequest ? "POST" : "PUT",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          ...(requiresConfirmationRequest ? { requested_status: newStatus } : { status: newStatus }),
          release_assignment: !requiresConfirmationRequest && shipment.status === "picking_up" && newStatus === "prepared",
          event_type: eventType || undefined,
          current_hub: hubInput || undefined,
          tracking_number: trackingInput || undefined,
          delivery_signature_name: newStatus === "delivered" ? signatureName.trim() : undefined,
          delivery_signature_data_url: newStatus === "delivered" ? signatureDataUrl || undefined : undefined,
          scan_code: manualCode || shipment.scan_code || undefined,
          notes: eventNote || `Scanned: ${scannedCode}`,
        }),
      });
      if (!res.ok) {
        const payload = await res.json().catch(() => null);
        setLookupError(payload?.detail || "Could not update shipment status.");
        return;
      }
      const updated = await res.json();
      if (requiresConfirmationRequest) {
        setShipment((prev) => {
          const base = prev ?? shipment;
          return {
            ...base,
            current_hub: updated.request?.current_hub ?? hubInput ?? base.current_hub,
            tracking_number: updated.request?.tracking_number ?? trackingInput ?? base.tracking_number,
            active_confirmation_request: updated.request,
          };
        });
        setUpdateMessage("Confirmation request sent. Status will update after approval.");
      } else {
        setShipment((prev) => {
          const base = prev ?? shipment;
          return {
            ...base,
            ...updated,
            current_hub: updated.current_hub ?? hubInput,
            tracking_number: updated.tracking_number ?? trackingInput,
            delivery_signature_name: newStatus === "delivered" ? signatureName.trim() : base.delivery_signature_name,
            delivery_signature_data_url: newStatus === "delivered" ? signatureDataUrl : base.delivery_signature_data_url,
            delivery_signature_captured_at: newStatus === "delivered" ? new Date().toISOString() : base.delivery_signature_captured_at,
            active_confirmation_request: null,
          };
        });
        const nextActions = getAvailableActions(updated.status);
        setNewStatus(nextActions[0]?.status ?? updated.status);
        setEventType(nextActions[0]?.eventType ?? "");
        setUpdateMessage("Shipment status updated.");
      }
      setEventNote("");
    } catch {
      setLookupError("Could not update shipment status.");
    } finally {
      setUpdating(false);
    }
  };

  const availableActions = shipment ? getAvailableActions(shipment.status) : [];
  const selectedAction = availableActions.find((action) => action.status === newStatus && action.eventType === eventType) || null;
  const activeConfirmation = shipment?.active_confirmation_request ?? null;
  const hasPendingConfirmation = activeConfirmation?.status === "pending";
  const selectedActionRequiresConfirmation = actionRequiresConfirmationRequest(shipment, newStatus);
  const actionButtonLabel = hasPendingConfirmation
    ? "Awaiting Confirmation"
    : selectedActionRequiresConfirmation
      ? "Send Confirmation Request"
      : (selectedAction?.label || "Confirm Update");

  return (
    <LogisticsPartnerLayout title="Scan">
      <PanelContent width="narrow">
        <PanelHero
          eyebrow="Field Operations"
          title="QR / Barcode Scanner"
          description="Scan a shipment QR code or enter a tracking number to view shipment details and update delivery status."
          icon={<ScanLine className="w-6 h-6" />}
          className="rounded-4xl bg-linear-to-br from-surface via-surface to-primary/10"
        />

        {/* Mode toggle */}
        <div className="theme-card flex w-full gap-1 overflow-x-auto rounded-xl border p-1 sm:w-fit">
          <button
            onClick={() => { setMode("camera"); stopCamera(); }}
            className={`flex flex-1 items-center justify-center gap-2 whitespace-nowrap rounded-xl px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold transition-colors sm:flex-none ${mode === "camera" ? "theme-btn-primary" : "text-text-muted hover:text-text"}`}
          >
            <Camera className="w-4 h-4" /> Camera
          </button>
          <button
            onClick={() => { setMode("manual"); stopCamera(); }}
            className={`flex flex-1 items-center justify-center gap-2 whitespace-nowrap rounded-xl px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold transition-colors sm:flex-none ${mode === "manual" ? "theme-btn-primary" : "text-text-muted hover:text-text"}`}
          >
            <Keyboard className="w-4 h-4" /> Manual
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Camera mode */}
        {mode === "camera" && (
          <div className="theme-card rounded-xl border p-4 space-y-4">
            <div className="relative rounded-xl overflow-hidden bg-black aspect-video max-h-72">
              <video ref={videoRef} className="w-full h-full object-cover" playsInline muted />
              {!cameraActive && (
                <div className="absolute inset-0 flex items-center justify-center">
                  <Camera className="w-12 h-12 text-white/30" />
                </div>
              )}
              {cameraActive && (
                <div className="absolute inset-0 flex items-center justify-center pointer-events-none">
                  <div className="w-48 h-28 border-2 border-primary rounded-xl opacity-80 animate-pulse" />
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
            <canvas ref={canvasRef} className="hidden" />

            {cameraError && (
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs text-warning">
                <AlertCircle className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0" />
                {cameraError}
              </div>
            )}

            <div className="flex flex-col gap-3 sm:flex-row">
              {!cameraActive ? (
                <button
                  onClick={startCamera}
                  className="theme-btn-primary flex w-full items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl px-4 py-2 text-xs font-semibold sm:w-auto"
                >
                  <Camera className="w-4 h-4" /> Start Camera
                </button>
              ) : (
                <button onClick={stopCamera} className="theme-btn-secondary w-full rounded-xl px-4 py-2 text-xs font-semibold sm:w-auto">
                  Stop Camera
                </button>
              )}
            </div>

            <form onSubmit={handleManualLookup} className="mt-2 flex flex-col gap-2 sm:flex-row">
              <input
                value={manualCode}
                onChange={(e) => setManualCode(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="Or type / paste code here"
                className="theme-input flex-1 rounded-xl border px-3 py-2 text-xs"
              />
              <button
                type="submit"
                disabled={scanning || !manualCode}
                className="theme-btn-accent flex w-full items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl px-3 py-2 text-xs font-semibold disabled:opacity-50 sm:w-auto"
              >
                {scanning ? <RefreshCw className="w-4 h-4 animate-spin" /> : "Lookup"}
              </button>
            </form>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Manual mode */}
        {mode === "manual" && (
          <div className="theme-card rounded-xl border p-4">
            <h2 className="text-xs font-bold text-text mb-3">Enter Scan Code / Tracking Number</h2>
            <form onSubmit={handleManualLookup} className="flex flex-col gap-3 sm:flex-row">
              <input
                value={manualCode}
                onChange={(e) => setManualCode(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="e.g. ZZ-2024-XXXX or TRK-001234"
                className="theme-input flex-1 rounded-xl border px-3 py-2 text-xs"
                autoFocus
              />
              <button
                type="submit"
                disabled={scanning || !manualCode}
                className="theme-btn-primary flex w-full items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl px-4 py-2 text-xs font-semibold disabled:opacity-50 sm:w-auto"
              >
                {scanning ? (
                  <><RefreshCw className="w-4 h-4 animate-spin" />Scanning…</>
                ) : (
                  <><ScanLine className="w-4 h-4" />Lookup</>
                )}
              </button>
            </form>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Lookup error */}
        {lookupError && (
          <div className="theme-alert-danger flex items-center gap-2 rounded-xl p-3 text-xs">
            <XCircle className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0" />
            {lookupError}
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Shipment result */}
        {shipment && (
          <div className="theme-card rounded-xl border p-4 space-y-4">
            <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3">
              <div>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-1">
                  <Package className="w-5 h-5 text-primary" />
                  <h2 className="text-base font-bold text-text">Shipment #{shipment.id}</h2>
                  <span className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-semibold ${STATUS_CHIP[shipment.status] ?? "theme-chip-muted"}`}>
                    {formatShipmentStatus(shipment)}
                  </span>
                </div>
                <p className="text-xs text-text-muted">Order #{shipment.order_id}</p>
              </div>
              {updateMessage && (
                <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-success text-xs font-semibold">
                  <CheckCircle className="w-4 h-4" />{updateMessage}
                </div>
              )}
            </div>

            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3 text-xs">
              {[
                { label: "Carrier", value: shipment.carrier_name },
                { label: "Tracking #", value: shipment.tracking_number },
                { label: "Scan Code", value: shipment.scan_code },
                { label: "Current Hub", value: shipment.current_hub },
                { label: "Customer", value: shipment.customer_name },
                { label: "Phone", value: shipment.customer_phone },
                { label: "Packages", value: shipment.package_count != null ? String(shipment.package_count) : null },
                { label: "Weight", value: shipment.package_weight_kg != null ? `${shipment.package_weight_kg} kg` : null },
              ].map(({ label, value }) => (
                  <div key={label} className="rounded-xl bg-surface-2 px-3 py-2">
                  <p className="text-xs text-text-muted">{label}</p>
                  <p className="text-xs font-semibold text-text mt-0.5 font-mono">{value || "—"}</p>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>

            {shipment.shipping_address && (
              <div className="flex items-start gap-2 rounded-xl bg-surface-2 px-3 py-2 text-xs">
                <MapPin className="w-4 h-4 text-text-muted shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
                <p className="text-text">{shipment.shipping_address}</p>
              </div>
            )}

            {/* Update status */}
            <div className="border-t border-border pt-4 space-y-3">
              <h3 className="text-xs font-bold text-text flex items-center gap-2">
                <Truck className="w-4 h-4" />Update Status
              </h3>
              {hasPendingConfirmation && activeConfirmation && (
                <div className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface-2/40 p-3 space-y-2 text-xs">
                  <p className="font-bold text-text">{activeConfirmation.confirmation_type_label || "Confirmation"} request pending</p>
                  <p className="text-text-muted">
                    Waiting for {activeConfirmation.target_role || "the recipient"} to approve before the shipment moves to {activeConfirmation.requested_status.replace(/_/g, " ")}.
                  </p>
                  {activeConfirmation.current_hub ? <p className="text-text-muted">Hub: <span className="text-text">{activeConfirmation.current_hub}</span></p> : null}
                  {activeConfirmation.tracking_number ? <p className="text-text-muted">Tracking: <span className="font-mono text-text">{activeConfirmation.tracking_number}</span></p> : null}
                  {activeConfirmation.created_at ? <p className="text-text-muted">Requested: <span className="text-text">{new Date(activeConfirmation.created_at).toLocaleString()}</span></p> : null}
                </div>
              )}
              <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                {availableActions.map((action) => (
                  <button
                    key={`${action.status}:${action.eventType}`}
                    onClick={() => {
                      setNewStatus(action.status);
                      setEventType(action.eventType);
                    }}
                    className={`rounded-xl px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold border transition-colors ${
                      newStatus === action.status && eventType === action.eventType
                        ? STATUS_CHIP[action.status] ?? "theme-chip-info"
                        : "border-border text-text-muted hover:text-text"
                    }`}
                    disabled={hasPendingConfirmation}
                  >
                    {action.label}
                  </button>
                ))}
              </div>
              {eventType && (
                <div className="rounded-xl bg-surface-2 px-3 py-2 text-xs text-text-muted">
                  Selected milestone: <span className="font-semibold text-text">{selectedAction?.label || eventType.replace(/_/g, " ")}</span>
                </div>
              )}
              <input
                value={hubInput}
                onChange={(e) => setHubInput(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="Current hub (e.g. Dubai Sorting Center)"
                className="theme-input w-full rounded-xl border px-3 py-2 text-xs"
                disabled={hasPendingConfirmation}
              />
              <input
                value={trackingInput}
                onChange={(e) => setTrackingInput(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="Tracking number (optional)"
                className="theme-input w-full rounded-xl border px-3 py-2 text-xs"
                disabled={hasPendingConfirmation}
              />
              <input
                value={eventNote}
                onChange={(e) => setEventNote(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="Event note (optional, e.g. Cleared line-haul transfer)"
                className="theme-input w-full rounded-xl border px-3 py-2 text-xs"
                disabled={hasPendingConfirmation}
              />
              {newStatus === "delivered" && (
                <div className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface-2/40 p-3 space-y-3">
                  <div>
                    <h4 className="text-xs font-bold text-text">Customer E-Signature</h4>
                    <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-text-muted">
                      Delivery is only confirmed after the customer name and signature are captured.
                    </p>
                  </div>
                  <input
                    value={signatureName}
                    onChange={(e) => setSignatureName(e.target.value)}
                    placeholder="Customer full name"
                    className="theme-input w-full rounded-xl border px-3 py-2 text-xs"
                    disabled={hasPendingConfirmation}
                  />
                  <SignaturePad onChange={setSignatureDataUrl} />
                  {signatureDataUrl && (
                    <div className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-white p-3">
                      <p className="text-xs font-semibold text-text-muted mb-2">Signature Preview</p>
                      <img src={signatureDataUrl} alt="Customer delivery signature" className="max-h-32 rounded-lg border border-border bg-white" />
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>
              )}
              {shipment.delivery_signature_captured_at && shipment.delivery_signature_data_url && (
                <div className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface-2/30 p-3 space-y-2">
                  <p className="text-xs font-bold text-text">Delivery Signature On File</p>
                  <p className="text-xs text-text-muted">
                    {shipment.delivery_signature_name || "Customer signature"} captured on {new Date(shipment.delivery_signature_captured_at).toLocaleString()}.
                  </p>
                  <img src={shipment.delivery_signature_data_url} alt="Recorded delivery signature" className="max-h-28 rounded-lg border border-border bg-white" />
                </div>
              )}
              <button
                onClick={handleUpdateStatus}
                disabled={updating || availableActions.length === 0 || hasPendingConfirmation}
                className="theme-btn-primary rounded-xl px-4 py-2 text-xs font-semibold disabled:opacity-50 flex items-center gap-2"
              >
                {updating ? <RefreshCw className="w-4 h-4 animate-spin" /> : <CheckCircle className="w-4 h-4" />}
                {actionButtonLabel}
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
      </PanelContent>
    </LogisticsPartnerLayout>
  );
}

export default function LPScanPage() {
  return <LPScannerInner />;
}
```

```text
const STATUSES = ["", "prepared", "picking_up", "shipped", "in_transit", "delivered", "failed", "returned"];

const STATUS_COLORS = ORDER_STATUS_CHIP;

const VEHICLE_OPTIONS = [
  { type: "bike", label: "Bike", mult: 0.90 },
  { type: "car", label: "Car", mult: 1.00 },
  { type: "van", label: "Van", mult: 1.20 },
  { type: "truck", label: "Truck", mult: 1.50 },
] as const;

const SHIPMENT_WORKFLOW_STEPS = [
  {
    title: "Prepared",
    body: "Supplier has packed the parcel. It appears here only when your approved profile and approved service-area rules match the order lane.",
  },
  {
    title: "Picking Up",
    body: "You accept the pickup from this page. That reserves the parcel for your team and starts the live pickup leg.",
  },
  {
    title: "Scan and move",
    body: "Use the Scan page to confirm handoff and update field milestones instead of forcing status jumps from the desk.",
  },
  {
    title: "Complete or exception",
    body: "The route closes as Delivered, Failed, or Returned. Finance uses the order quote until pickup is confirmed, then the accepted vehicle and charge snapshot flow into settlement.",
  },
];

function formatVehicleTypeLabel(vehicleType?: string | null): string | null {
  if (!vehicleType) return null;
  const matched = VEHICLE_OPTIONS.find((option) => option.type === vehicleType);
  if (matched) return matched.label;
  return vehicleType.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + vehicleType.slice(1);
}

function formatVehicleMultiplier(multiplier?: number | null): string | null {
  if (multiplier == null || Number.isNaN(multiplier)) return null;
  return `x${multiplier.toFixed(2)}`;
}

function formatShipmentStatus(shipment: Shipment): string {
  return shipment.status_label || shipment.status.replace(/_/g, " ");
}

// formatPayout removed â€“ uses formatMoney from currencyStore inside component

function buildMapLink(address?: string | null, location?: string | null): string | null {
  const query = [address, location].filter((value) => Boolean(value && value.trim())).join(" ").trim();
  if (!query) return null;
  return `https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=${encodeURIComponent(query)}`;
}

function getAllowedUpdateStatuses(currentStatus: string): string[] {
  switch (currentStatus) {
    case "prepared":
      return ["picking_up"];
    case "picking_up":
      return ["prepared"];
    case "shipped":
      return [];
    case "in_transit":
      return [];
    default:
      return [];
  }
}

function getSuggestedEventType(currentStatus: string, nextStatus: string): string {
  if (currentStatus === "prepared" && nextStatus === "picking_up") return "pickup_confirmed";
  if (currentStatus === "picking_up" && nextStatus === "prepared") return "pickup_cancelled";
  return "";
}

async function readErrorMessage(response: Response, fallback: string): Promise<string> {
  try {
    const payload = await response.json();
    if (typeof payload?.detail === "string" && payload.detail.trim()) {
      return payload.detail;
    }
    if (Array.isArray(payload?.detail) && payload.detail.length > 0 && payload.detail[0]?.msg) {
      return String(payload.detail[0].msg);
    }
    if (typeof payload?.message === "string" && payload.message.trim()) {
      return payload.message;
    }
  } catch {
    // Ignore invalid JSON payloads and fall back to the default message.
  }
  return fallback;
}

function buildLogisticsSocketUrl(): string | null {
  if (typeof window === "undefined") return null;
  const token = getAccessToken();
  if (!token) return null;
  return `${API_URL.replace(/^http/i, "ws").replace(/\/$/, "")}/ws/logistics?scope=partner&token=${encodeURIComponent(token)}`;
}

function LogisticsShipmentsInner() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const searchParams = useSearchParams();
  const formatMoney = useCurrencyStore((s) => s.format);
  const [data, setData] = useState<ShipmentListResponse | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [page, setPage] = useState(Number(searchParams.get("page") ?? 1));
  const [statusFilter, setStatusFilter] = useState(searchParams.get("status") ?? "");
  const [actionId, setActionId] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [pickupSelections, setPickupSelections] = useState<Record<number, string>>({});
  const [vehicleSelection, setVehicleSelection] = useState<Record<number, string>>({});
  const [updateModal, setUpdateModal] = useState<Shipment | null>(null);
  const [updateForm, setUpdateForm] = useState({ status: "", current_hub: "", tracking_number: "", notes: "", event_type: "" });
  const [actionFeedback, setActionFeedback] = useState<{ type: "success" | "error"; message: string } | null>(null);
  const [selectedShipmentIds, setSelectedShipmentIds] = useState<Set<number>>(new Set());
  const [bulkLoading, setBulkLoading] = useState(false);
  const [bulkStatusValue, setBulkStatusValue] = useState("in_transit");
  const addToast = useToastStore((s) => s.addToast);

  const modalAllowedStatuses = updateModal ? getAllowedUpdateStatuses(updateModal.status) : [];
  const modalEventTypeOptions = ["", ...modalAllowedStatuses.map((status) => getSuggestedEventType(updateModal?.status || "", status)).filter(Boolean)];
  const shipments = data?.items ?? [];

  const fetchShipments = useCallback(async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    const params = new URLSearchParams({ page: String(page), page_size: "30" });
    if (statusFilter) params.set("status", statusFilter);
    const res = await apiFetch(`/logistics-partners/shipments?${params}`).catch(() => null);
    if (res?.ok) setData(await res.json());
    setLoading(false);
  }, [page, statusFilter]);

  useEffect(() => { fetchShipments(); }, [fetchShipments]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const socketUrl = buildLogisticsSocketUrl();
    if (!socketUrl) return;
    const handle = openRealtimeSocket(socketUrl, {
      onMessage: () => {
        void fetchShipments();
      },
    });
    return () => handle.close();
  }, [fetchShipments]);

  const applyLocalShipmentStatus = useCallback((shipmentId: number, nextStatus: string, nextStatusLabel?: string | null) => {
    setData((prev) => {
      if (!prev) return prev;
      const patched = prev.items.map((item) => (
        item.id === shipmentId
          ? { ...item, status: nextStatus, status_label: nextStatusLabel ?? item.status_label }
          : item
      ));
      const filtered = statusFilter && nextStatus !== statusFilter
        ? patched.filter((item) => item.id !== shipmentId)
        : patched;
      const removedCount = patched.length - filtered.length;
      return {
        ...prev,
        total: Math.max(0, prev.total - removedCount),
        items: filtered,
      };
    });
  }, [statusFilter]);

  const openUpdate = (shipment: Shipment) => {
    const allowedStatuses = getAllowedUpdateStatuses(shipment.status);
    setUpdateModal(shipment);
    setUpdateForm({
      status: allowedStatuses[0] ?? shipment.status,
      current_hub: shipment.current_hub ?? "",
      tracking_number: shipment.tracking_number ?? "",
      notes: "",
      event_type: allowedStatuses[0] ? getSuggestedEventType(shipment.status, allowedStatuses[0]) : "",
    });
  };

  const bulkUpdateShipmentStatus = async () => {
    const ids = Array.from(selectedShipmentIds);
    if (!ids.length || !bulkStatusValue) return;
    setBulkLoading(true);
    try {
      const res = await apiFetch("/logistics-partners/shipments/bulk-status", {
        method: "PUT",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ shipment_ids: ids, status: bulkStatusValue }),
      });
      if (res.ok) {
        const result = await res.json();
        fetchShipments();
        setSelectedShipmentIds(new Set());
        addToast(`${result.updated ?? ids.length} shipments updated to ${bulkStatusValue.replace(/_/g, " ")}`, "success");
      } else {
        const err = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
        addToast(err.detail || "Bulk status update failed", "error");
      }
    } finally {
      setBulkLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleUpdate = async () => {
    if (!updateModal) return;
    const modalShipment = updateModal;
    setActionFeedback(null);
    setActionId(modalShipment.id);
    const res = await apiFetch(`/logistics-partners/shipments/${modalShipment.id}/status`, {
      method: "PUT",
      headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      body: JSON.stringify({
        ...updateForm,
        release_assignment: modalShipment.status === "picking_up" && updateForm.status === "prepared",
      }),
    }).catch(() => null);

    if (!res) {
      setActionFeedback({ type: "error", message: "Unable to update shipment status right now." });
      setActionId(null);
      return;
    }

    if (!res.ok) {
      setActionFeedback({
        type: "error",
        message: await readErrorMessage(res, "Failed to update shipment status."),
      });
      setActionId(null);
      return;
    }

    const payload = await res.json().catch(() => null) as { status?: string; status_label?: string | null } | null;
    if (payload?.status) {
      applyLocalShipmentStatus(modalShipment.id, payload.status, payload.status_label);
    }
    setUpdateModal(null);
    setActionFeedback({ type: "success", message: "Shipment status updated." });
    await fetchShipments();
    setActionId(null);
  };

  const shipmentColumns = useMemo<Array<EnterpriseColumn<Shipment>>>(() => [
    {
      key: "order",
      label: "Order",
      width: "180px",
      sortable: true,
      sortValue: (shipment) => shipment.order_id,
      searchValue: (shipment) => `${shipment.order_id} ${shipment.tracking_number ?? ""} ${shipment.scan_code ?? ""} ${shipment.carrier_name ?? ""}`,
      render: (shipment) => (
        <div className="space-y-1 text-xs text-text-muted">
          <p className="font-semibold text-text">Order #{shipment.order_id}</p>
          <p className="font-mono text-text-muted">Tracking: {shipment.tracking_number ?? "-"}</p>
          <p className="font-mono text-text-faint">Scan: {shipment.scan_code ?? "-"}</p>
          {shipment.carrier_name ? <p>Carrier: {shipment.carrier_name}</p> : null}
        </div>
      ),
    },
    {
      key: "supplier_pickup",
      label: "Supplier Pickup",
      width: "220px",
      sortable: true,
      sortValue: (shipment) => `${shipment.supplier_name ?? ""} ${shipment.supplier_pickup_address ?? shipment.current_hub ?? ""}`.toLowerCase(),
      searchValue: (shipment) => `${shipment.supplier_name ?? ""} ${shipment.supplier_phone ?? ""} ${shipment.supplier_pickup_address ?? ""} ${shipment.supplier_pickup_location ?? ""}`,
      render: (shipment) => {
        const pickupMap = buildMapLink(shipment.supplier_pickup_address || shipment.current_hub, shipment.supplier_pickup_location);
        return (
          <div className="space-y-1 text-xs text-text-muted">
            <p className="font-semibold text-text">{shipment.supplier_name || "Supplier"}</p>
            {shipment.supplier_phone ? <p>{shipment.supplier_phone}</p> : null}
            <p>{shipment.supplier_pickup_address || shipment.current_hub || "No pickup address yet"}</p>
            {shipment.supplier_pickup_location ? <p className="text-text-faint">{shipment.supplier_pickup_location}</p> : null}
            {pickupMap ? <a href={pickupMap} target="_blank" rel="noreferrer" className="inline-flex items-center text-primary hover:underline">Open pickup map</a> : null}
          </div>
        );
      },
    },
    {
      key: "customer_dropoff",
      label: "Customer Dropoff",
      width: "220px",
      sortable: true,
      sortValue: (shipment) => `${shipment.customer_name ?? ""} ${shipment.customer_dropoff_address ?? shipment.shipping_address ?? ""}`.toLowerCase(),
      searchValue: (shipment) => `${shipment.customer_name ?? ""} ${shipment.customer_phone ?? ""} ${shipment.customer_dropoff_address ?? shipment.shipping_address ?? ""} ${shipment.customer_dropoff_location ?? shipment.delivery_location ?? ""}`,
      render: (shipment) => {
        const dropoffMap = buildMapLink(shipment.customer_dropoff_address || shipment.shipping_address, shipment.customer_dropoff_location || shipment.delivery_location);
        return (
          <div className="space-y-1 text-xs text-text-muted">
            <p className="font-semibold text-text">{shipment.customer_name || "Customer"}</p>
            {shipment.customer_phone ? <p>{shipment.customer_phone}</p> : null}
            <p>{shipment.customer_dropoff_address || shipment.shipping_address || "No customer address yet"}</p>
            {shipment.customer_dropoff_location || shipment.delivery_location ? <p className="text-text-faint">{shipment.customer_dropoff_location || shipment.delivery_location}</p> : null}
            {dropoffMap ? <a href={dropoffMap} target="_blank" rel="noreferrer" className="inline-flex items-center text-primary hover:underline">Open dropoff map</a> : null}
          </div>
        );
      },
    },
    {
      key: "charges",
      label: "Charges",
      width: "260px",
      searchable: false,
      sortValue: (shipment) => Number(shipment.estimated_partner_payout ?? 0),
      searchValue: (shipment) => `${shipment.accepted_load_fit_label ?? shipment.accepted_vehicle_type ?? ""} ${shipment.pricing_breakdown?.load_fit_label ?? ""}`,
      render: (shipment) => {
        const acceptedVehicleLabel = formatVehicleTypeLabel(shipment.accepted_load_fit_label ?? shipment.accepted_vehicle_type);
        const acceptedVehicleMultiplier = formatVehicleMultiplier(shipment.accepted_load_fit_factor ?? shipment.accepted_vehicle_multiplier);
        const quoteVehicleLabel = formatVehicleTypeLabel(shipment.pricing_breakdown?.load_fit_label);
        const quoteVehicleMultiplier = formatVehicleMultiplier(shipment.pricing_breakdown?.load_fit_factor);
        const chargeFlags = [
          (shipment.accepted_load_fit_label ?? shipment.accepted_vehicle_type) ? `Locked ${acceptedVehicleLabel}` : null,
          shipment.pricing_breakdown?.floor_applied ? "Min floor" : null,
          shipment.pricing_breakdown?.ceiling_applied ? "Max cap" : null,
          ((shipment.pricing_breakdown?.pickup_fee ?? 0) > 0 || (shipment.pricing_breakdown?.dropoff_fee ?? 0) > 0) ? "Stop fees" : null,
        ].filter(Boolean) as string[];

        return (
          <div className="space-y-1 text-xs text-text-muted">
            <p className="rounded-lg bg-success/10 px-2 py-1 text-[11px] font-semibold text-success">Expected earning: {formatMoney(Number(shipment.estimated_partner_payout ?? 0))}</p>
            {shipment.accepted_shipping_amount != null ? <p className="font-medium text-text">Locked route charge: {formatMoney(Number(shipment.accepted_shipping_amount))}</p> : null}
            {shipment.accepted_shipping_amount == null && shipment.pricing_breakdown?.shipping_amount != null ? <p>Quoted route charge: {formatMoney(Number(shipment.pricing_breakdown.shipping_amount))}</p> : null}
            {acceptedVehicleLabel ? <p className="font-medium text-text">Load-fit lock: {acceptedVehicleLabel}{acceptedVehicleMultiplier ? ` ${acceptedVehicleMultiplier}` : ""}</p> : null}
            {!acceptedVehicleLabel && quoteVehicleLabel ? <p>Quoted load-fit: {quoteVehicleLabel}{quoteVehicleMultiplier ? ` ${quoteVehicleMultiplier}` : ""}</p> : null}
            {((shipment.pricing_breakdown?.pickup_fee ?? 0) > 0 || (shipment.pricing_breakdown?.dropoff_fee ?? 0) > 0) ? <p>Stops: pickup {formatMoney(Number(shipment.pricing_breakdown?.pickup_fee ?? 0))} / drop-off {formatMoney(Number(shipment.pricing_breakdown?.dropoff_fee ?? 0))}</p> : null}
            {shipment.accepted_vehicle_selected_at ? <p>Locked at: {new Date(shipment.accepted_vehicle_selected_at).toLocaleString()}</p> : null}
            {!shipment.accepted_vehicle_selected_at && shipment.status === "prepared" ? <p className="text-text-faint">Confirm pickup to lock the load-fit choice for finance and settlement.</p> : null}
            {shipment.estimated_delivery ? <p>ETA: {new Date(shipment.estimated_delivery).toLocaleDateString()}</p> : null}
            {shipment.package_count != null || shipment.package_weight_kg != null || shipment.package_dimensions ? (
              <p>
                {[shipment.package_count != null ? `${shipment.package_count} pkg` : null, shipment.package_weight_kg != null ? `${shipment.package_weight_kg} kg` : null, shipment.package_dimensions || null]
                  .filter(Boolean)
                  .join(" • ")}
              </p>
            ) : null}
            {chargeFlags.length ? (
              <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1 pt-1">
                {chargeFlags.map((flag) => (
                  <span key={flag} className="rounded-full border border-border bg-surface px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-semibold text-text-muted">{flag}</span>
                ))}
              </div>
            ) : null}
          </div>
        );
      },
    },
    {
      key: "status",
      label: "Status",
      width: "140px",
      sortable: true,
      sortValue: (shipment) => shipment.status,
      searchValue: (shipment) => `${shipment.status} ${shipment.status_label ?? ""}`,
      render: (shipment) => <span className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded-lg text-[10px] font-semibold ${STATUS_COLORS[shipment.status] ?? "theme-chip-muted"}`}>{formatShipmentStatus(shipment)}</span>,
    },
  ], [formatMoney]);

  const handleAcceptPickup = async (shipment: Shipment) => {
    const requestedStatus = pickupSelections[shipment.id] || "picking_up";
    if (requestedStatus !== "picking_up") {
      setActionFeedback({ type: "error", message: "Select Picking Up to confirm this parcel pickup." });
      return;
    }
    setActionFeedback(null);
    setActionId(shipment.id);
    const res = await apiFetch(`/logistics-partners/shipments/${shipment.id}/status`, {
      method: "PUT",
      headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      body: JSON.stringify({
        status: requestedStatus,
        event_type: "pickup_confirmed",
        notes: "Pickup accepted from logistics partner shipments panel",
        load_fit_label: vehicleSelection[shipment.id] || "car",
      }),
    }).catch(() => null);

    if (!res) {
      setActionFeedback({ type: "error", message: "Unable to accept pickup right now." });
      setActionId(null);
      return;
    }

    if (!res.ok) {
      setActionFeedback({
        type: "error",
        message: await readErrorMessage(res, "Failed to accept pickup."),
      });
      setActionId(null);
      return;
    }

    const payload = await res.json().catch(() => null) as { status?: string; status_label?: string | null } | null;
    applyLocalShipmentStatus(shipment.id, payload?.status || requestedStatus, payload?.status_label || "Picking Up");
    setPickupSelections((prev) => {
      const next = { ...prev };
      delete next[shipment.id];
      return next;
    });
    setVehicleSelection((prev) => {
      const next = { ...prev };
      delete next[shipment.id];
      return next;
    });
    setActionFeedback({ type: "success", message: `Order #${shipment.order_id} is now in Picking Up.` });
    await fetchShipments();
    setActionId(null);
  };

  return (
    <>
    <LogisticsPartnerLayout title="Shipments">
      <PanelContent className="space-y-5">
        <PanelHero
          eyebrow="Logistics partner workspace"
          title="Shipment Management"
          description="Accept pickup assignments, update delivery status, and bulk-manage your active shipments. Use Scan for quick QR-based updates."
          actions={(
            <>
              <button
                onClick={() => router.push("/logistics-partner/scan")}
                className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-2xl theme-btn-primary px-4 py-2 text-xs font-bold"
              >
                Scan QR
              </button>
              <button
                onClick={fetchShipments}
                className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-2xl border border-border bg-surface-2 px-3 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-text-muted transition-colors hover:text-text"
              >
                <RefreshCw className={`h-3.5 w-3.5 ${loading ? "animate-spin" : ""}`} />
                Refresh
              </button>
            </>
          )}
        />

        <div className="grid gap-4 md:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-4">
          {SHIPMENT_WORKFLOW_STEPS.map((step) => (
            <div key={step.title} className="rounded-2xl border border-border bg-surface p-4">
              <p className="text-xs font-bold text-text">{step.title}</p>
              <p className="mt-2 text-xs text-text-muted">{step.body}</p>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>

        {actionFeedback ? (
          <div
            className={`rounded-xl border px-3 py-2 text-xs font-medium ${
              actionFeedback.type === "error"
                ? "border-danger/40 bg-danger/10 text-danger"
                : "border-success/40 bg-success/10 text-success"
            }`}
          >
            {actionFeedback.message}
          </div>
        ) : null}

        <EnterpriseDataTable
          title="Active Shipments"
          description="Search the live shipment roster, confirm pickups, and keep route, payout, and exception data aligned with the shared enterprise CRUD surface."
          columns={shipmentColumns}
          rows={shipments}
          rowKey={(shipment) => shipment.id}
          initialRowsPerPage={30}
          rowsPerPageOptions={[30]}
          enableBulkActions
          enableExport
          showPagination={false}
          showSelectionSummary={false}
          searchPlaceholder="Search by order, tracking, supplier, customer, address, or vehicle..."
          emptyState={loading ? "Loading shipments..." : "No shipments found"}
          selectedRowKeys={Array.from(selectedShipmentIds)}
          onSelectedRowKeysChange={(keys) => setSelectedShipmentIds(new Set(keys.map((key) => Number(key))))}
          toolbarSlot={(
            <>
              <p className="text-xs text-text-muted">{data ? `${data.total} total shipments` : "Loading..."}</p>
              <select
                value={statusFilter}
                onChange={(event) => { setStatusFilter(event.target.value); setPage(1); }}
                className="theme-input rounded-xl border px-3 py-2 text-sm focus:border-primary focus:outline-none"
              >
                {STATUSES.map((status) => (
                  <option key={status} value={status}>{status ? status.replace(/_/g, " ") : "All Statuses"}</option>
                ))}
              </select>
            </>
          )}
          rowActions={(shipment) => (
            <div className="flex flex-col items-start gap-2 text-xs">
              {shipment.status === "prepared" ? (
                <div className="flex max-w-56 flex-col items-start gap-2">
                  <label className="w-full text-[10px] font-semibold text-text-muted">
                    Pickup action
                    <select
                      aria-label={`Pickup action for order ${shipment.order_id}`}
                      value={pickupSelections[shipment.id] || "picking_up"}
                      onChange={(event) => setPickupSelections((prev) => ({ ...prev, [shipment.id]: event.target.value }))}
                      className="theme-input mt-1 w-full rounded-lg border px-2 py-1 text-[10px]"
                    >
                      <option value="picking_up">Picking Up</option>
                    </select>
                  </label>
                  <p className="text-[10px] font-semibold text-text-muted">Select vehicle:</p>
                  <div className="grid w-full grid-cols-2 gap-1">
                    {VEHICLE_OPTIONS.map((vehicle) => {
                      const selected = (vehicleSelection[shipment.id] || "car") === vehicle.type;
                      const estimatedPayout = Number(shipment.estimated_partner_payout ?? 0) * vehicle.mult;
                      return (
                        <button
                          key={vehicle.type}
                          onClick={() => setVehicleSelection((prev) => ({ ...prev, [shipment.id]: vehicle.type }))}
                          className={`rounded-lg border px-2 py-1 text-[10px] font-semibold transition-colors ${selected ? "theme-btn-primary border-primary" : "border-border bg-surface-2 text-text-muted hover:text-text"}`}
                        >
                          <span>{vehicle.label}</span>
                          <span className={`block text-[9px] ${selected ? "text-white/80" : "text-text-faint"}`}>{formatMoney(estimatedPayout)}</span>
                        </button>
                      );
                    })}
                  </div>
                  <button
                    disabled={actionId === shipment.id}
                    onClick={() => void handleAcceptPickup(shipment)}
                    className="theme-btn-accent inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-lg px-2.5 py-1 text-[10px] font-semibold disabled:opacity-50"
                    title="Confirm Picking Up"
                  >
                    <CheckCircle className="w-3 h-3" />
                    {actionId === shipment.id ? "Confirming..." : "Confirm"}
                  </button>
                  <p className="text-[10px] leading-4 text-text-faint">Confirming pickup stores this vehicle selection on the shipment and allocation records used for settlement.</p>
                </div>
              ) : null}
              {shipment.status === "picking_up" ? (
                <button
                  disabled={actionId === shipment.id}
                  onClick={() => openUpdate(shipment)}
                  className="theme-chip-info inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-lg px-2.5 py-1 text-[10px] font-semibold disabled:opacity-50"
                >
                  <CheckCircle className="w-3 h-3" />
                  Manage Pickup
                </button>
              ) : null}
              {shipment.status === "picking_up" || shipment.status === "shipped" || shipment.status === "in_transit" ? (
                <button
                  onClick={() => router.push(`/logistics-partner/scan?code=${encodeURIComponent(shipment.scan_code || shipment.tracking_number || "")}`)}
                  className="font-semibold text-primary hover:underline"
                >
                  {shipment.status === "picking_up" ? "Receive via Scan" : "Open Scan Flow"}
                </button>
              ) : null}
              <button
                onClick={() => router.push(`/tracking/${shipment.order_id}`)}
                className="font-semibold text-primary hover:underline"
              >
                Open Tracker
              </button>
            </div>
          )}
        />

        {/* Pagination */}
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
          <button
            disabled={page === 1}
            onClick={() => setPage((p) => p - 1)}
            className="flex items-center gap-1 rounded-xl border border-border px-3 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-text-muted disabled:opacity-40 hover:text-text transition-colors"
          >
            <ChevronLeft className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> Prev
          </button>
          <span className="text-xs text-text-muted">
            Page {page}{data ? ` of ${data.total_pages}` : ""}
          </span>
          <button
            disabled={!data || page >= data.total_pages}
            onClick={() => setPage((p) => p + 1)}
            className="flex items-center gap-1 rounded-xl border border-border px-3 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-text-muted disabled:opacity-40 hover:text-text transition-colors"
          >
            Next <ChevronRight className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
          </button>
        </div>
      </PanelContent>

      {/* Update Status Modal */}
      {updateModal && (
        <div
          className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 theme-overlay"
          onClick={(e) => e.target === e.currentTarget && setUpdateModal(null)}
        >
          <motion.div
            initial={{ scale: 0.95, opacity: 0, y: 20 }}
            animate={{ scale: 1, opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
            className="theme-card w-full max-w-md rounded-2xl border p-6"
          >
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-5">
              <div>
                <h2 className="text-base font-bold text-text">Manage Pickup</h2>
                <p className="text-xs text-text-muted">Order #{updateModal.order_id}</p>
              </div>
              <button onClick={() => setUpdateModal(null)} className="p-1.5 rounded-lg hover:bg-surface-2 text-text-muted">
                <X className="w-4 h-4" />
              </button>
            </div>
            <div className="space-y-3">
              <div>
                <label className="mb-1 block text-xs text-text-muted">New Status</label>
                <select
                  value={updateForm.status}
                  onChange={(e) => setUpdateForm((f) => ({
                    ...f,
                    status: e.target.value,
                    event_type: getSuggestedEventType(updateModal.status, e.target.value),
                  }))}
                  className="theme-input w-full rounded-xl border px-3 py-2.5 text-sm focus:border-primary focus:outline-none"
                >
                  {modalAllowedStatuses.map((s) => (
                    <option key={s} value={s}>{s.replace(/_/g, " ")}</option>
                  ))}
                </select>
              </div>
              <div>
                <label className="mb-1 block text-xs text-text-muted">Current Hub (optional)</label>
                <input
                  value={updateForm.current_hub}
                  onChange={(e) => setUpdateForm((f) => ({ ...f, current_hub: e.target.value }))}
                  placeholder="Dubai Sorting Center"
                  className="theme-input w-full rounded-xl border px-3 py-2.5 text-sm placeholder:text-text-faint focus:border-primary focus:outline-none"
                />
              </div>
              <div>
                <label className="mb-1 block text-xs text-text-muted">Tracking Number (optional)</label>
                <input
                  value={updateForm.tracking_number}
                  onChange={(e) => setUpdateForm((f) => ({ ...f, tracking_number: e.target.value }))}
                  placeholder="TRK-001234"
                  className="theme-input w-full rounded-xl border px-3 py-2.5 text-sm placeholder:text-text-faint focus:border-primary focus:outline-none"
                />
              </div>
              <div>
                <label className="mb-1 block text-xs text-text-muted">Event Type (optional)</label>
                <select
                  value={updateForm.event_type}
                  onChange={(e) => setUpdateForm((f) => ({ ...f, event_type: e.target.value }))}
                  className="theme-input w-full rounded-xl border px-3 py-2.5 text-sm focus:border-primary focus:outline-none"
                >
                  {modalEventTypeOptions.map((eventTypeOption) => (
                    <option key={eventTypeOption || "none"} value={eventTypeOption}>
                      {eventTypeOption ? eventTypeOption.replace(/_/g, " ") : "â€” select event type â€”"}
                    </option>
                  ))}
                </select>
              </div>
              {updateModal.status === "picking_up" && (
                <p className="rounded-xl bg-surface-2 px-3 py-2 text-xs text-text-muted">
                  Use the scan page to confirm the parcel has been received from the supplier. This modal only supports pickup cancellation.
                </p>
              )}
              {(updateModal.status === "shipped" || updateModal.status === "in_transit") && (
                <p className="rounded-xl bg-surface-2 px-3 py-2 text-xs text-text-muted">
                  Delivery confirmation is handled in the mobile app so the customer signature can be captured before the shipment is marked delivered.
                </p>
              )}
              <div>
                <label className="mb-1 block text-xs text-text-muted">Notes (optional)</label>
                <textarea
                  value={updateForm.notes}
                  onChange={(e) => setUpdateForm((f) => ({ ...f, notes: e.target.value }))}
                  rows={2}
                  placeholder="Any notes..."
                  className="theme-input w-full rounded-xl border px-3 py-2.5 text-sm placeholder:text-text-faint focus:border-primary focus:outline-none resize-none"
                />
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="flex gap-3 mt-5">
              <button
                onClick={() => setUpdateModal(null)}
                className="flex-1 rounded-xl border border-border py-2.5 text-sm font-semibold text-text-muted hover:text-text transition-colors"
              >Cancel</button>
              <button
                onClick={handleUpdate}
                disabled={actionId === updateModal.id || !updateForm.status || modalAllowedStatuses.length === 0}
                className="theme-btn-accent flex-1 rounded-xl py-2.5 text-sm font-bold disabled:opacity-50"
              >{actionId === updateModal.id ? "Savingâ€¦" : "Update Status"}</button>
            </div>
          </motion.div>
        </div>
      )}
    </LogisticsPartnerLayout>
    <BulkActionBar
      selectedCount={selectedShipmentIds.size}
      onClearSelection={() => setSelectedShipmentIds(new Set())}
      actions={[
        {
          label: `Set to ${bulkStatusValue.replace(/_/g, " ")}`,
          onClick: bulkUpdateShipmentStatus,
          loading: bulkLoading,
          variant: "primary",
          disabled: !bulkStatusValue,
        },
      ]}
    >
      <select
        value={bulkStatusValue}
        onChange={(e) => setBulkStatusValue(e.target.value)}
        className="theme-input rounded-lg border px-2 py-1 text-xs"
      >
        {["picking_up", "shipped", "in_transit", "failed", "returned"].map((s) => (
          <option key={s} value={s}>{s.replace(/_/g, " ")}</option>
        ))}
      </select>
    </BulkActionBar>
    </>
  );
}

export default function LogisticsPartnerShipmentsPage() {
  return (
    <Suspense>
      <LogisticsShipmentsInner />
    </Suspense>
  );
}
```

```text
"use client";

import Link from "next/link";
import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { AlertCircle, Globe, MapPin, RefreshCw, Search, ShieldCheck, Truck } from "@/lib/icons";
import { apiFetch } from "@/lib/api";
import { resolveImage } from "@/lib/utils";
import { useAuth } from "@/lib/useAuth";

type LogisticsPartnerSummary = {
  id: number;
  name: string;
  code: string;
  bio?: string | null;
  city?: string | null;
  country?: string | null;
  website?: string | null;
  logo_url?: string | null;
  banner_url?: string | null;
  verification_status: string;
  service_types?: string[];
  coverage_regions?: string[];
};

type PublicPartnersResponse = {
  total: number;
  items: LogisticsPartnerSummary[];
};

export default function LogisticsPartnersDiscoveryPage() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const { isLoggedIn, isLoading: authLoading } = useAuth();
  const [query, setQuery] = useState("");
  const [submittedQuery, setSubmittedQuery] = useState("");
  const [reloadKey, setReloadKey] = useState(0);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const [data, setData] = useState<PublicPartnersResponse>({ total: 0, items: [] });

  useEffect(() => {
    if (authLoading) return;
    if (!isLoggedIn) {
      router.push("/login");
    }
  }, [authLoading, isLoggedIn, router]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isLoggedIn) return;
    let active = true;

    const load = async () => {
      setLoading(true);
      setError("");
      try {
        const params = new URLSearchParams();
        if (submittedQuery.trim()) {
          params.set("q", submittedQuery.trim());
        }
        params.set("limit", "24");
        const path = `/logistics-partners/public${params.toString() ? `?${params.toString()}` : ""}`;
        const response = await apiFetch(path);
        const payload = await response.json().catch(() => null);
        if (!response.ok) {
          throw new Error(payload?.detail || "Could not load logistics partners right now.");
        }
        if (!active) return;
        setData({
          total: Number(payload?.total ?? 0),
          items: Array.isArray(payload?.items) ? payload.items : [],
        });
      } catch (err) {
        if (!active) return;
        setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Could not load logistics partners right now.");
      } finally {
        if (active) {
          setLoading(false);
        }
      }
    };

    void load();
    return () => {
      active = false;
    };
  }, [isLoggedIn, reloadKey, submittedQuery]);

  const activeFilters = useMemo(() => submittedQuery.trim(), [submittedQuery]);

  if (authLoading || !isLoggedIn) {
    return <main className="min-h-screen flex items-center justify-center text-sm text-text-muted">Loading logistics partners...</main>;
  }

  return (
    <main className="min-h-screen bg-[radial-gradient(circle_at_top,_rgba(14,165,233,0.10),_transparent_40%),linear-gradient(180deg,_var(--color-surface-0),_var(--color-surface-1))] px-4 py-8">
      <div className="mx-auto max-w-6xl space-y-6">
        <section className="theme-card overflow-hidden rounded-3xl border p-6 sm:p-8">
          <div className="grid gap-6 lg:grid-cols-[1.1fr_0.9fr] lg:items-end">
            <div>
              <p className="text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.28em] text-primary">Approved Delivery Network</p>
              <h1 className="mt-3 text-3xl font-black tracking-tight text-text sm:text-4xl">Discover logistics partners approved for the marketplace.</h1>
              <p className="mt-3 max-w-2xl text-sm leading-6 text-text-muted">
                These partners passed profile approval. Their approved service areas and charge rows are what drive customer quotes and shipment pickup eligibility.
              </p>
              <div className="mt-5 flex flex-wrap gap-2 text-xs">
                <span className="theme-chip-success rounded-full px-3 py-1 font-semibold">Profile approved</span>
                <span className="theme-chip-info rounded-full px-3 py-1 font-semibold">Coverage visible</span>
                <span className="theme-chip-warning rounded-full px-3 py-1 font-semibold">Charges still depend on destination</span>
              </div>
            </div>
            <form
              onSubmit={(event) => {
                event.preventDefault();
                setSubmittedQuery(query);
              }}
              className="rounded-2xl border border-border bg-surface-2/60 p-4"
            >
              <label className="text-xs font-semibold text-text-muted">Search partner, city, country, or code</label>
              <div className="mt-2 flex gap-2">
                <div className="relative flex-1">
                  <Search className="pointer-events-none absolute left-3 top-1/2 h-4 w-4 -translate-y-1/2 text-text-faint" />
                  <input
                    value={query}
                    onChange={(event) => setQuery(event.target.value)}
                    placeholder="Search approved logistics partners"
                    className="theme-input w-full rounded-2xl border px-10 py-3 text-sm"
                  />
                </div>
                <button type="submit" className="theme-btn-primary rounded-2xl px-4 py-3 text-sm font-semibold">Search</button>
              </div>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => {
                  setQuery("");
                  setSubmittedQuery("");
                }}
                className="mt-3 text-xs font-semibold text-primary hover:underline"
              >
                Clear filter
              </button>
            </form>
          </div>
        </section>

        <section className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 text-sm">
          <div>
            <p className="font-semibold text-text">{loading ? "Loading..." : `${data.total.toLocaleString()} approved partner${data.total === 1 ? "" : "s"}`}</p>
            <p className="text-xs text-text-muted">{activeFilters ? `Filtered by \"${activeFilters}\"` : "Showing all currently approved partner profiles."}</p>
          </div>
          <button
            onClick={() => setReloadKey((current) => current + 1)}
            disabled={loading}
            className="flex items-center gap-2 rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface px-3 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-text-muted hover:text-text disabled:opacity-50"
          >
            <RefreshCw className={`h-3.5 w-3.5 ${loading ? "animate-spin" : ""}`} />
            Refresh
          </button>
        </section>

        {error ? (
          <div className="rounded-2xl border border-danger/30 bg-danger/10 p-4 text-sm text-danger">
            <div className="flex items-start gap-2">
              <AlertCircle className="mt-0.5 h-4 w-4 shrink-0" />
              <span>{error}</span>
            </div>
          </div>
        ) : null}

        {loading ? (
          <div className="grid gap-4 md:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-3">
            {Array.from({ length: 6 }).map((_, index) => (
              <div key={index} className="h-72 animate-pulse rounded-3xl border border-border bg-surface-2" />
            ))}
          </div>
        ) : data.items.length === 0 ? (
          <div className="rounded-3xl border border-dashed border-border bg-surface/60 px-6 py-16 text-center">
            <Truck className="mx-auto h-8 w-8 text-text-faint" />
            <h2 className="mt-4 text-lg font-bold text-text">No approved logistics partners matched</h2>
            <p className="mt-2 text-sm text-text-muted">Try a broader city, country, or partner name. Only approved partner profiles appear here.</p>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div className="grid gap-4 md:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-3">
            {data.items.map((partner) => {
              const location = [partner.city, partner.country].filter(Boolean).join(", ");
              const logo = resolveImage(partner.logo_url || partner.banner_url || undefined);
              return (
                <Link
                  key={partner.id}
                  href={`/logistics-partners/${partner.id}`}
                  className="group overflow-hidden rounded-3xl border border-border bg-surface transition-all duration-200 hover:-translate-y-0.5 hover:border-primary/30 hover:shadow-xl hover:shadow-primary/5"
                >
                  <div className="relative h-28 overflow-hidden bg-linear-to-r from-primary/10 via-accent/10 to-brand/10">
                    <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-[radial-gradient(circle_at_top_right,_rgba(14,165,233,0.20),_transparent_45%)]" />
                    <img src={logo} alt={partner.name} className="absolute bottom-4 left-4 h-16 w-16 rounded-2xl border border-white/60 bg-white object-cover shadow-lg" />
                  </div>
                  <div className="space-y-4 p-5">
                    <div>
                      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                        <h2 className="text-lg font-bold text-text group-hover:text-primary">{partner.name}</h2>
                        <span className="theme-chip-success rounded-full px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold">
                          <ShieldCheck className="mr-1 inline h-3 w-3" />Approved
                        </span>
                      </div>
                      <p className="mt-1 text-xs font-mono text-text-faint">{partner.code}</p>
                    </div>

                    <div className="space-y-2 text-xs text-text-muted">
                      {location ? (
                        <p className="flex items-center gap-2"><MapPin className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />{location}</p>
                      ) : null}
                      {partner.website ? (
                        <p className="flex items-center gap-2"><Globe className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />{partner.website.replace(/^https?:\/\//, "")}</p>
                      ) : null}
                    </div>

                    {partner.bio ? <p className="line-clamp-3 text-sm leading-6 text-text-muted">{partner.bio}</p> : null}

                    <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2 text-[11px]">
                      {(partner.service_types || []).slice(0, 3).map((service) => (
                        <span key={service} className="rounded-full border border-border bg-surface-2 px-2.5 py-1 font-semibold text-text-muted">
                          {service.replace(/_/g, " ")}
                        </span>
                      ))}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </Link>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </main>
  );
}
```
