### `frontend\web_app\src\app\supplier\orders\SupplierOrdersList.tsx`

```text
import BrandLoading from "@/components/BrandLoading";
import {
  CalendarDays,
  ChevronDown,
  ChevronUp,
  Hash,
  Loader2,
  MapPin,
  Package,
  Printer,
  Send,
  ShieldCheck,
  Truck,
  Upload,
} from "@/lib/icons";
import type { OrderTracking } from "@/lib/types";
import { resolveImage } from "@/lib/utils";
import { buildTrackingMapHref, extractTrackingMapPoints } from "@shared/trackingMap";
import {
  badgeClass,
  createEmptyShipmentForm,
  formatDate,
  formatDateTime,
  supplierWorkflowStatus,
  Timeline,
  titleStatus,
  type ParcelProof,
  type ShipmentForm,
  type SupplierOrder,
} from "./shared";

type SupplierOrdersListProps = {
  loading: boolean;
  loadError: string | null;
  hasActiveFilters: boolean;
  filteredOrders: SupplierOrder[];
  trackingByOrder: Record<number, OrderTracking | null | undefined>;
  trackingLoading: Record<number, boolean>;
  parcelProofByOrder: Record<number, ParcelProof | null | undefined>;
  expandedOrderId: number | null;
  userId?: number;
  formatMoney: (amount: number) => string;
  cardPadding: string;
  expandedPadding: string;
  shipmentCreateDrafts: Record<number, ShipmentForm>;
  shipmentUpdateDrafts: Record<number, ShipmentForm>;
  proofNotes: Record<number, string>;
  responseNotes: Record<number, string>;
  creatingShipmentOrderId: number | null;
  updatingShipmentId: number | null;
  uploadingProofOrderId: number | null;
  respondingConfirmationId: number | null;
  page: number;
  totalPages: number;
  totalOrdersCount: number;
  pageSize: number;
  onRefresh: () => void | Promise<void>;
  onClearFilters: () => void;
  onPageChange: (page: number) => void;
  onToggleExpanded: (orderId: number) => void;
  onOpenPackingSheet: (orderId: number) => void;
  onCreateShipment: (orderId: number) => Promise<boolean>;
  onUpdateShipment: (orderId: number, shipmentId: number) => Promise<void>;
  onUploadProof: (orderId: number) => Promise<void>;
  onConfirmationResponse: (
    orderId: number,
    confirmationId: number,
    decision: "accepted" | "rejected",
  ) => Promise<void>;
  onShipmentCreateDraftChange: (
    orderId: number,
    field: keyof ShipmentForm,
    value: string,
  ) => void;
  onShipmentUpdateDraftChange: (
    shipmentId: number,
    field: keyof ShipmentForm,
    value: string,
  ) => void;
  onProofFileChange: (orderId: number, file: File | null) => void;
  onProofNoteChange: (orderId: number, value: string) => void;
  onResponseNoteChange: (confirmationId: number, value: string) => void;
};

export default function SupplierOrdersList({
  loading,
  loadError,
  hasActiveFilters,
  filteredOrders,
  trackingByOrder,
  trackingLoading,
  parcelProofByOrder,
  expandedOrderId,
  userId,
  formatMoney,
  cardPadding,
  expandedPadding,
  shipmentCreateDrafts,
  shipmentUpdateDrafts,
  proofNotes,
  responseNotes,
  creatingShipmentOrderId,
  updatingShipmentId,
  uploadingProofOrderId,
  respondingConfirmationId,
  page,
  totalPages,
  totalOrdersCount,
  pageSize,
  onRefresh,
  onClearFilters,
  onPageChange,
  onToggleExpanded,
  onOpenPackingSheet,
  onCreateShipment,
  onUpdateShipment,
  onUploadProof,
  onConfirmationResponse,
  onShipmentCreateDraftChange,
  onShipmentUpdateDraftChange,
  onProofFileChange,
  onProofNoteChange,
  onResponseNoteChange,
}: SupplierOrdersListProps) {
  return (
    <>
      <div className="space-y-3">
        {loading ? (
          <div className="theme-card rounded-xl border p-8 text-center text-xs text-text-muted">
            <BrandLoading label="Loading supplier orders..." />
          </div>
        ) : filteredOrders.length === 0 ? (
          <div className="theme-card rounded-xl border p-8 text-center">
            <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-text">
              {loadError
                ? "Supplier orders could not be loaded"
                : hasActiveFilters
                  ? "No supplier orders match the current filters"
                  : "No supplier orders yet"}
            </p>
            <p className="mt-2 text-xs text-text-muted">
              {loadError
                ? loadError
                : hasActiveFilters
                  ? "Clear the active filters to return to the full fulfilment queue."
                  : "Orders assigned to your catalog will appear here when checkout activity starts."}
            </p>
            <div className="mt-4 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-center gap-2">
              <button
                onClick={() => void onRefresh()}
                className="theme-btn-primary rounded-xl px-4 py-2 text-xs font-semibold"
              >
                Retry
              </button>
              {hasActiveFilters ? (
                <button
                  onClick={onClearFilters}
                  className="theme-btn-secondary rounded-xl px-4 py-2 text-xs font-semibold"
                >
                  Clear filters
                </button>
              ) : null}
            </div>
          </div>
        ) : (
          filteredOrders.map((order) => {
            const tracking = trackingByOrder[order.id];
            const proof = parcelProofByOrder[order.id];
            const isExpanded = expandedOrderId === order.id;
            const supplierTracking = tracking
              ? {
                  ...tracking,
                  items: tracking.items.filter(
                    (item) => item.supplier_id == null || item.supplier_id === userId,
                  ),
                  shipments: tracking.shipments.filter(
                    (shipment) => shipment.supplier_id === userId,
                  ),
                }
              : null;
            const currentOrderStatus = supplierWorkflowStatus(
              supplierTracking?.order_status || order.status,
            );
            const canUploadProof = ["processing", "prepared"].includes(currentOrderStatus);
            const canStartPreparation = currentOrderStatus === "pending";
            const mapPoints = supplierTracking
              ? extractTrackingMapPoints(supplierTracking)
              : [];

            return (
              <div key={order.id} className="theme-card overflow-hidden rounded-xl border">
                <div
                  className={`grid gap-3 border-b border-border lg:grid-cols-[1.3fr_0.9fr_0.9fr_1.1fr_auto] lg:items-center ${cardPadding}`}
                >
                  <div>
                    <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                      <p className="text-base font-bold text-text">Order #{order.id}</p>
                      <span

                      {order.payment_status === "paid" ? (

                      {order.settlement_status ? (

                              : order.settlement_status === "eligible" ||
                                  order.settlement_status === "processing"
                                ? "border-info/40 bg-info/10 text-info"
                                : order.settlement_status === "reversed"
                                  ? "border-danger/40 bg-danger/10 text-danger"
                                  : "border-border bg-surface-2 text-text-muted"

                        >
                          settled: {order.settlement_status}
                        </span>
                      ) : null}
                    </div>
                    <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-text-muted">

                      {order.customer_email ? ` · ${order.customer_email}` : ""}

                      <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-text-faint">{order.customer_phone}</p>

                  <div>

                  <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-2">

                      </div>
                    ) : currentOrderStatus === "prepared" ? (
                      <div className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface-2 px-3 py-2 text-right text-[11px] text-text-muted">

                      <div className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface-2 px-3 py-2 text-right text-[11px] text-text-muted">

                      </div>

                          ? "Starting Preparation..."
                          : "Start Preparation"}

                        <ChevronUp className="h-4 w-4" />

                        <ChevronDown className="h-4 w-4" />

                    </button>
                  </div>
                </div>

                {isExpanded ? (

                              <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3">

                                  <p className="text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.24em] text-text-faint">

                                  <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-text-muted">
                                    Generate the professional packing sheet and invoice from this workspace.
                                  </p>
                                </div>
                                <button
                                  onClick={() => onOpenPackingSheet(order.id)}
                                  className="theme-btn-primary inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-lg px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold"

                                  <Printer className="h-4 w-4" />

                                </button>
                              </div>
                            </div>

                            <div className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface-1 p-3">

                              <div className="mt-3 grid gap-3 md:grid-cols-2">
                                <div className="space-y-2 text-xs text-text-muted">
                                  <p className="font-semibold text-text">Customer</p>

                                  {order.customer_email ? <p>{order.customer_email}</p> : null}
                                  {order.customer_phone ? <p>{order.customer_phone}</p> : null}
                                </div>
                                <div className="space-y-2 text-xs text-text-muted">
                                  <p className="font-semibold text-text">Delivery</p>

                                  {order.delivery_location ? (

                                  {order.delivery_note ? <p>Note: {order.delivery_note}</p> : null}

                                    <div className="flex items-start gap-3">
                                      {item.product_image ? (
                                        <img

                                        <div className="flex h-16 w-16 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-surface-3 text-text-faint">
                                          <Package className="h-5 w-5" />
                                        </div>
                                      )}
                                      <div className="min-w-0">
                                        <p className="text-xs font-semibold text-text">
                                          {item.product_name}
                                        </p>
                                        <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-text-muted">
                                          Qty {item.quantity}
                                        </p>
                                        <p className="text-xs font-semibold text-text">
                                          {formatMoney((item.price || 0) * item.quantity)}
                                        </p>
                                      </div>
                                    </div>
                                  </div>
                                ))}
                              </div>
                            </div>

                            {!supplierTracking.shipments.length ? (
                              <div className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface-1 p-3">
                                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                                  <Truck className="h-4 w-4 text-primary" />
                                  <p className="text-xs font-semibold text-text">
                                    Create Parcel Record
                                  </p>
                                </div>
                                <p className="mt-1.5 text-xs text-text-muted">
                                  Save the supplier-side parcel details. Logistics partner, carrier, tracking channel, and handoff status will be handled later by logistics.
                                </p>
                                <div className="mt-4 grid gap-3 md:grid-cols-2">
                                  <input
                                    value={shipmentCreateDrafts[order.id]?.current_hub || ""}
                                    onChange={(event) =>
                                      onShipmentCreateDraftChange(
                                        order.id,
                                        "current_hub",
                                        event.target.value,
                                      )
                                    }
                                    placeholder="Current hub / pickup location"
                                    className="theme-input h-8 rounded-xl border px-3 text-xs"
                                  />
                                  <input
                                    value={shipmentCreateDrafts[order.id]?.package_count || ""}
                                    onChange={(event) =>
                                      onShipmentCreateDraftChange(
                                        order.id,
                                        "package_count",
                                        event.target.value,

                                    className="theme-input h-8 rounded-xl border px-3 text-xs"

                                  <input

                                      onShipmentCreateDraftChange(

                                        "package_weight_kg",
                                        event.target.value,

                                  <input

                                  <textarea
                                    value={shipmentCreateDrafts[order.id]?.packaging_notes || ""}
                                    onChange={(event) =>
                                      onShipmentCreateDraftChange(
                                        order.id,

                                        event.target.value,

                                    className="theme-input min-h-20 rounded-xl border px-3 py-2 text-xs md:col-span-2"
                                  />
                                  <textarea
                                    value={shipmentCreateDrafts[order.id]?.notes || ""}
                                    onChange={(event) =>
                                      onShipmentCreateDraftChange(
                                        order.id,
                                        "notes",
                                        event.target.value,
                                      )
                                    }
                                    placeholder="Shipment note"
                                    className="theme-input min-h-20 rounded-xl border px-3 py-2 text-xs md:col-span-2"

                                  <button

                                    <Send className="h-4 w-4" />

                                        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                                          <p className="text-xs font-semibold text-text">

                                          </p>
                                          <span
                                            className={`inline-flex rounded-full border px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide ${badgeClass(shipment.status)}`}
                                          >
                                            {shipment.status_label || titleStatus(shipment.status)}
                                          </span>
                                        </div>
                                        <div className="mt-1 space-y-1 text-xs text-text-muted">
                                          <p>
                                            {shipment.assigned_partner_name
                                              ? `${shipment.assigned_partner_name} · `
                                              : ""}
                                            {shipment.scan_code || "No scan code yet"}
                                          </p>
                                          {shipment.tracking_number ? (
                                            <p>
                                              Tracking Number:{" "}
                                              <span className="font-mono text-text">
                                                {shipment.tracking_number}
                                              </span>
                                            </p>
                                          ) : null}
                                          {shipment.carrier_name ? (
                                            <p>
                                              Carrier:{" "}
                                              <span className="text-text">
                                                {shipment.carrier_name}
                                              </span>
                                            </p>
                                          ) : null}
                                          {shipment.distribution_channel ? (
                                            <p>
                                              Distribution Channel:{" "}
                                              <span className="text-text">
                                                {titleStatus(shipment.distribution_channel)}
                                              </span>
                                            </p>
                                          ) : null}
                                        </div>
                                      </div>
                                      {shipment.tracking_url ? (
                                        <a
                                          href={shipment.tracking_url}

                                        </a>
                                      ) : null}
                                    </div>
                                    <div className="mt-4 grid gap-3 md:grid-cols-2">
                                      <input
                                        value={draft.current_hub}
                                        onChange={(event) =>
                                          onShipmentUpdateDraftChange(
                                            shipment.id,
                                            "current_hub",

                                          )
                                        }
                                        placeholder="Current hub"
                                        className="theme-input h-8 rounded-xl border px-3 text-xs"
                                      />
                                      <input
                                        value={draft.package_count}
                                        onChange={(event) =>
                                          onShipmentUpdateDraftChange(
                                            shipment.id,
                                            "package_count",
                                            event.target.value,
                                          )
                                        }
                                        placeholder="Package count"
                                        className="theme-input h-8 rounded-xl border px-3 text-xs"
                                      />
                                      <input
                                        value={draft.package_weight_kg}
                                        onChange={(event) =>
                                          onShipmentUpdateDraftChange(
                                            shipment.id,
                                            "package_weight_kg",
                                            event.target.value,
                                          )
                                        }
                                        placeholder="Weight (kg)"
                                        className="theme-input h-8 rounded-xl border px-3 text-xs"
                                      />
                                      <input
                                        value={draft.package_dimensions}
                                        onChange={(event) =>
                                          onShipmentUpdateDraftChange(
                                            shipment.id,
                                            "package_dimensions",
                                            event.target.value,
                                          )
                                        }
                                        placeholder="Dimensions"
                                        className="theme-input h-8 rounded-xl border px-3 text-xs md:col-span-2"
                                      />
                                      <textarea
                                        value={draft.packaging_notes}
                                        onChange={(event) =>
                                          onShipmentUpdateDraftChange(
                                            shipment.id,
                                            "packaging_notes",
                                            event.target.value,
                                          )
                                        }
                                        placeholder="Packaging notes"
                                        className="theme-input min-h-16 rounded-xl border px-3 py-2 text-xs md:col-span-2"
                                      />
                                      <textarea
                                        value={draft.notes}
                                        onChange={(event) =>
                                          onShipmentUpdateDraftChange(
                                            shipment.id,
                                            "notes",
                                            event.target.value,
                                          )
                                        }
                                        placeholder="Shipment note"
                                        className="theme-input min-h-16 rounded-xl border px-3 py-2 text-xs md:col-span-2"

                                        <p className="mt-1 text-xs font-semibold text-text">
                                          {shipment.active_confirmation_request.confirmation_type_label ||
                                            titleStatus(
                                              shipment.active_confirmation_request.confirmation_type,
                                            )}
                                        </p>
                                        <div className="mt-2 space-y-1 text-xs text-text-muted">
                                          <p>
                                            Requested status:{" "}
                                            <span className="text-text">
                                              {titleStatus(
                                                shipment.active_confirmation_request.requested_status,
                                              )}
                                            </span>
                                          </p>
                                          {shipment.active_confirmation_request.current_hub ? (
                                            <p>
                                              Hub:{" "}
                                              <span className="text-text">
                                                {shipment.active_confirmation_request.current_hub}
                                              </span>
                                            </p>
                                          ) : null}
                                          {shipment.active_confirmation_request.tracking_number ? (
                                            <p>
                                              Tracking:{" "}
                                              <span className="font-mono text-text">

                                              </span>

                                            <p>{shipment.active_confirmation_request.notes}</p>
                                          ) : null}
                                        </div>

                                            )
                                          }

                                          className="theme-input mt-3 min-h-20 w-full rounded-xl border px-3 py-2 text-xs"

                                          <button
                                            onClick={() =>
                                              void onConfirmationResponse(
                                                order.id,
                                                shipment.active_confirmation_request!.id,

                                              respondingConfirmationId ===

                                            }

                                            onClick={() =>
                                              void onConfirmationResponse(
                                                order.id,
                                                shipment.active_confirmation_request!.id,
                                                "rejected",

                                            disabled={
                                              respondingConfirmationId ===
                                              shipment.active_confirmation_request.id
                                            }
                                            className="theme-btn-secondary rounded-lg px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold disabled:opacity-50"
                                          >
                                            Reject Confirmation

                                        </div>
                                      </div>
                                    ) : null}
                                    <div className="mt-4 flex justify-end">
                                      <button
                                        onClick={() => void onUpdateShipment(order.id, shipment.id)}

                                      >
                                        {updatingShipmentId === shipment.id
                                          ? "Saving Parcel Details..."
                                          : "Save Parcel Details"}
                                      </button>
                                    </div>
                                  </div>
                                );
                              })
                            )}
                          </div>

                          <div className="space-y-4">
                            <div className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface-1 p-3">
                              <p className="text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.24em] text-text-faint">
                                Packed Parcel Confirmation
                              </p>
                              <p className="mt-1.5 text-xs text-text-muted">
                                Upload the packed parcel photo after packaging is complete so the order moves into prepared pickup status.
                              </p>
                              <div className="mt-4 space-y-3">
                                <input
                                  type="file"
                                  accept="image/*"
                                  onChange={(event) =>
                                    onProofFileChange(
                                      order.id,
                                      event.target.files?.[0] || null,
                                    )
                                  }
                                  className="block w-full text-xs text-text-muted"
                                />
                                <textarea
                                  value={proofNotes[order.id] || ""}
                                  onChange={(event) =>
                                    onProofNoteChange(order.id, event.target.value)
                                  }
                                  placeholder="Add packing notes for admin and logistics"
                                  className="theme-input min-h-20 rounded-xl border px-3 py-2 text-xs"
                                />
                                <button
                                  onClick={() => void onUploadProof(order.id)}
                                  disabled={
                                    !canUploadProof || uploadingProofOrderId === order.id
                                  }
                                  className="theme-btn-primary inline-flex w-full items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl px-3 py-2 text-xs font-semibold disabled:opacity-50"
                                >
                                  <Upload className="h-4 w-4" />
                                  {uploadingProofOrderId === order.id
                                    ? "Uploading Packed Parcel Photo..."
                                    : "Upload Packed Parcel Photo"}

                                {!canUploadProof ? (
                                  <p className="text-xs text-text-faint">
                                    Start packaging first. Once the order is processing, upload the packed parcel photo to mark it prepared.
                                  </p>
                                ) : null}
                              </div>
                              {proof ? (
                                <div className="mt-3 rounded-xl border border-border/70 bg-surface-2/40 p-2.5">
                                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3">

                                    </p>
                                    <span
                                      className={`inline-flex rounded-full border px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide ${badgeClass(proof.result || "processing")}`}

                                      {titleStatus(proof.result || "passed")}
                                    </span>
                                  </div>
                                  <p className="mt-1 text-[11px] text-text-muted">
                                    {formatDateTime(proof.created_at)}
                                  </p>
                                  {proof.notes ? (
                                    <p className="mt-2 text-xs text-text-muted">
                                      {proof.notes}
                                    </p>
                                  ) : null}
                                  {proof.image_urls?.[0] ? (
                                    <img
                                      src={resolveImage(proof.image_urls[0])}
                                      alt={`Parcel proof for order ${order.id}`}
                                      className="mt-3 w-full rounded-xl border border-border object-cover"
                                    />
                                  ) : null}
                                </div>
                              ) : null}
                            </div>

                            <div className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface-1 p-3">
                              <p className="text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.24em] text-text-faint">
                                Tracking Details
                              </p>
                              <div className="mt-3 space-y-2 text-xs text-text-muted">
                                {supplierTracking.shipping_address ? (
                                  <div className="flex items-start gap-2">
                                    <MapPin className="mt-0.5 h-4 w-4 shrink-0 text-primary" />
                                    <span>{supplierTracking.shipping_address}</span>
                                  </div>
                                ) : null}
                                {supplierTracking.delivery_location ? (
                                  <p>
                                    Location:{" "}
                                    <span className="text-text">
                                      {supplierTracking.delivery_location}
                                    </span>
                                  </p>
                                ) : null}
                                {supplierTracking.customer_phone ? (
                                  <p>
                                    Phone:{" "}
                                    <span className="text-text">
                                      {supplierTracking.customer_phone}
                                    </span>
                                  </p>
                                ) : null}
                                {supplierTracking.delivery_note ? (
                                  <p>
                                    Note:{" "}
                                    <span className="text-text">
                                      {supplierTracking.delivery_note}
                                    </span>
                                  </p>
                                ) : null}
                              </div>
                              {mapPoints.length ? (
                                <div className="mt-4 space-y-2">
                                  <p className="text-xs font-semibold text-text">
                                    Checkpoint links
                                  </p>
                                  {mapPoints.map((point) => (
                                    <a
                                      key={`${order.id}-${point.shipmentId}-${point.latitude}-${point.longitude}`}
                                      href={buildTrackingMapHref(
                                        point.latitude,
                                        point.longitude,
                                      )}
                                      target="_blank"
                                      rel="noreferrer"
                                      className="block rounded-xl border border-border/70 bg-surface-2/40 px-3 py-2 text-xs text-text-muted transition-colors hover:border-primary/40"
                                    >
                                      <span className="font-semibold text-text">
                                        {point.label}
                                      </span>
                                      <span className="block mt-1">
                                        {point.location ||
                                          point.currentHub ||
                                          "Latest checkpoint"}
                                      </span>
                                    </a>
                                  ))}
                                </div>
                              ) : null}
                            </div>

                            <div className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface-1 p-3">
                              <p className="text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.24em] text-text-faint">
                                Financial Summary
                              </p>
                              <div className="mt-3 space-y-2 text-xs">
                                <div className="flex justify-between text-text-muted">
                                  <span>Subtotal</span>
                                  <span>
                                    {formatMoney(supplierTracking.subtotal_amount || 0)}
                                  </span>
                                </div>
                                <div className="flex justify-between text-text-muted">
                                  <span>VAT</span>
                                  <span>{formatMoney(supplierTracking.vat_amount || 0)}</span>
                                </div>
                                <div className="flex justify-between text-text-muted">
                                  <span>Shipping</span>
                                  <span>
                                    {formatMoney(supplierTracking.shipping_amount || 0)}
                                  </span>
                                </div>
                                <div className="flex justify-between font-bold text-text">
                                  <span>Total</span>
                                  <span>
                                    {formatMoney(supplierTracking.total_amount || 0)}
                                  </span>
                                </div>
                              </div>
                            </div>
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      </>
                    ) : (
                      <div className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface-1 p-5 text-xs text-text-muted">
                        Tracking details are not available yet for this order.
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </div>
                ) : null}
              </div>
            );
          })
        )}
      </div>

      {totalPages > 1 ? (
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface-1 px-4 py-3">
          <p className="text-xs text-text-faint">
            {totalOrdersCount === 0 ? 0 : (page - 1) * pageSize + 1}-
            {Math.min(page * pageSize, totalOrdersCount)} of {totalOrdersCount}
          </p>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => onPageChange(Math.max(1, page - 1))}
              disabled={page === 1}
              className="rounded-lg border border-border bg-surface-2 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-text-muted disabled:opacity-40"
            >
              Prev
            </button>
            <span className="text-xs text-text-muted">
              {page} / {totalPages}
            </span>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => onPageChange(Math.min(totalPages, page + 1))}
              disabled={page === totalPages}
              className="rounded-lg border border-border bg-surface-2 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-text-muted disabled:opacity-40"
            >
              Next
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      ) : null}
    </>
  );
}
```

```text
﻿"use client";

import { normalizeListPage } from "@/lib/listResponse";

import { dc, useDensity } from "@/lib/densityContext";
import { useToastStore } from "@/lib/toastStore";
import type { OrderTracking } from "@/lib/types";

} from "./shared";

type LogisticsSummary = {
  awaiting_fulfilment: number;
  in_transit: number;
  delivered_total: number;
  total_shipments: number;
  pending_shipments: number;
  active_zones: number;
};
const PAGE_SIZE = 20;

function SupplierOrdersWorkspaceContent() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const searchParams = useSearchParams();
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const { density } = useDensity();
  const addToast = useToastStore((state) => state.addToast);
  const formatMoney = useCurrencyStore((state) => state.format);
  const [orders, setOrders] = useState<SupplierOrder[]>([]);
  const [totalOrdersCount, setTotalOrdersCount] = useState(0);
  const [summary, setSummary] = useState<LogisticsSummary | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [refreshing, setRefreshing] = useState(false);
  const [loadError, setLoadError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [expandedOrderId, setExpandedOrderId] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [search, setSearch] = useState("");
  const [statusFilter, setStatusFilter] = useState<(typeof ORDER_STATUS_FILTERS)[number]>("all");
  const [page, setPage] = useState(1);
  const [trackingByOrder, setTrackingByOrder] = useState<Record<number, OrderTracking | null | undefined>>({});
  const [trackingLoading, setTrackingLoading] = useState<Record<number, boolean>>({});
  const [parcelProofByOrder, setParcelProofByOrder] = useState<Record<number, ParcelProof | null | undefined>>({});
  const [shipmentCreateDrafts, setShipmentCreateDrafts] = useState<Record<number, ShipmentForm>>({});
  const [shipmentUpdateDrafts, setShipmentUpdateDrafts] = useState<Record<number, ShipmentForm>>({});
  const [proofFiles, setProofFiles] = useState<Record<number, File | null>>({});
  const [proofNotes, setProofNotes] = useState<Record<number, string>>({});
  const [responseNotes, setResponseNotes] = useState<Record<number, string>>({});
  const [creatingShipmentOrderId, setCreatingShipmentOrderId] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [updatingShipmentId, setUpdatingShipmentId] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [uploadingProofOrderId, setUploadingProofOrderId] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [respondingConfirmationId, setRespondingConfirmationId] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [quickShipmentOpen, setQuickShipmentOpen] = useState(false);
  const [quickShipmentOrderId, setQuickShipmentOrderId] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const requestedSection = searchParams.get("section") || "";
  const returnsFocus = requestedSection === "returns";

  const initializeShipmentDraft = useCallback((orderId: number, currentHub?: string | null) => {
    setShipmentCreateDrafts((prev) => prev[orderId] ? prev : {
      ...prev,
      [orderId]: {
        ...createEmptyShipmentForm(),
        current_hub: currentHub || "",
      },
    });
  }, []);

  const fetchOrders = useCallback(async () => {
    const params = new URLSearchParams();
    params.set("limit", String(PAGE_SIZE));
    params.set("offset", String((page - 1) * PAGE_SIZE));
    if (search.trim()) params.set("search", search.trim());
    if (statusFilter !== "all") params.set("status", statusFilter);
    const [ordersResponse, summaryResponse] = await Promise.all([
      apiFetch(`/supplier/orders?${params.toString()}`),
      apiFetch("/logistics/summary"),
    ]);

    if (!ordersResponse.ok) {
      throw new Error("Could not load supplier orders.");
    }

    const ordersPayload = normalizeListPage<SupplierOrder>(await ordersResponse.json());
    setOrders(ordersPayload.data);
    setTotalOrdersCount(ordersPayload.total);
    setLoadError(null);
    setShipmentCreateDrafts((prev) => {
      const next = { ...prev };
      for (const order of ordersPayload.data) {
        if (!next[order.id]) {
          next[order.id] = createEmptyShipmentForm();
        }
      }
      return next;
    });

    if (summaryResponse.ok) {
      setSummary((await summaryResponse.json()) as LogisticsSummary);
    }
  }, [page, search, statusFilter]);

  const refreshWorkspace = useCallback(async () => {
    setRefreshing(true);
    try {
      await fetchOrders();
    } catch (error: unknown) {
      const message = error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Could not load supplier orders.";
      setLoadError(message);
      addToast(message, "error");
    } finally {
      setRefreshing(false);
    }
  }, [addToast, fetchOrders]);

  const fetchTrackingForOrder = useCallback(async (orderId: number, force = false) => {
    if (!force && (trackingByOrder[orderId] !== undefined || trackingLoading[orderId])) {
      return;
    }
    setTrackingLoading((prev) => ({ ...prev, [orderId]: true }));
    try {
      const response = await apiFetch(`/orders/${orderId}/tracking`);
      if (!response.ok) {
        setTrackingByOrder((prev) => ({ ...prev, [orderId]: null }));
        return;
      }
      const tracking = (await response.json()) as OrderTracking;
      setTrackingByOrder((prev) => ({ ...prev, [orderId]: tracking }));
      initializeShipmentDraft(orderId, tracking.shipping_address || tracking.delivery_location || "");
      setShipmentUpdateDrafts((prev) => {
        const next = { ...prev };
        for (const shipment of tracking.shipments.filter((entry) => !user?.id || entry.supplier_id === user.id)) {
          next[shipment.id] = {
            current_hub: shipment.current_hub || "",
            notes: shipment.notes || "",
            package_count: shipment.package_count != null ? String(shipment.package_count) : "",
            package_weight_kg: shipment.package_weight_kg != null ? String(shipment.package_weight_kg) : "",
            package_dimensions: shipment.package_dimensions || "",
            packaging_notes: shipment.packaging_notes || "",
          };
        }
        return next;
      });
    } finally {
      setTrackingLoading((prev) => ({ ...prev, [orderId]: false }));
    }
  }, [initializeShipmentDraft, trackingByOrder, trackingLoading, user?.id]);

  const fetchParcelProof = useCallback(async (orderId: number) => {
    if (parcelProofByOrder[orderId] !== undefined) return;
    try {
      const response = await apiFetch(`/product-verifications/?order_id=${orderId}&verification_type=supplier_dispatch&page=1&page_size=1`);
      if (!response.ok) {
        setParcelProofByOrder((prev) => ({ ...prev, [orderId]: null }));
        return;
      }
      const payload = (await response.json()) as { items?: ParcelProof[] };
      setParcelProofByOrder((prev) => ({ ...prev, [orderId]: payload.items?.[0] || null }));
    } catch {
      setParcelProofByOrder((prev) => ({ ...prev, [orderId]: null }));
    }
  }, [parcelProofByOrder]);

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchOrders()
      .catch((error: unknown) => {
        const message = error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Could not load supplier orders.";
        setLoadError(message);
        addToast(message, "error");
      })
      .finally(() => setLoading(false));
  }, [addToast, fetchOrders]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!orders.length) return;
    const targetOrder = Number(searchParams.get("order") || "");
    if (!targetOrder || Number.isNaN(targetOrder)) return;
    const found = orders.find((order) => order.id === targetOrder);
    if (!found) return;
    setExpandedOrderId(targetOrder);
    void fetchTrackingForOrder(targetOrder);
    void fetchParcelProof(targetOrder);
  }, [fetchParcelProof, fetchTrackingForOrder, orders, searchParams]);

  const filteredOrders = orders;
  const totalPages = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(totalOrdersCount / PAGE_SIZE));

  const computedSummary = useMemo(() => {
    const activeShipments = Object.values(trackingByOrder)
      .filter(Boolean)
      .flatMap((tracking) => (tracking as OrderTracking).shipments)
      .filter((shipment) => !user?.id || shipment.supplier_id === user.id)
      .filter((shipment) => !["delivered", "returned"].includes(shipment.status));

    return {
      totalOrders: totalOrdersCount,
      awaitingHandoff: summary?.awaiting_fulfilment ?? orders.filter((order) => ["confirmed", "processing"].includes(order.status)).length,
      activeShipments: summary?.in_transit ?? activeShipments.length,
      delivered: summary?.delivered_total ?? orders.filter((order) => order.status === "delivered").length,
    };
  }, [orders, summary, totalOrdersCount, trackingByOrder, user]);

  const quickShipmentCandidates = useMemo(() => orders.filter((order) => {
    const tracking = trackingByOrder[order.id];
    const hasShipment = (tracking?.shipment_count ?? 0) > 0;
    const status = supplierWorkflowStatus(tracking?.order_status || order.status);
    return !hasShipment && ["pending", "confirmed", "processing"].includes(status);
  }), [orders, trackingByOrder]);

  const quickShipmentOrder = useMemo(
    () => quickShipmentCandidates.find((order) => order.id === quickShipmentOrderId) ?? null,
    [quickShipmentCandidates, quickShipmentOrderId]
  );
  const hasActiveFilters = search.trim() !== "" || statusFilter !== "all";
  const clearFilters = () => {
    setSearch("");
    setStatusFilter("all");
    setPage(1);
  };
  const cardPadding = dc(density, "px-3 py-2.5", "px-3 py-2.5", "px-4 py-3.5");
  const expandedPadding = dc(density, "px-3 py-3", "px-4 py-4", "px-5 py-5");
  const statsPadding = dc(density, "px-3 py-2", "px-3 py-2", "px-4 py-3");

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!quickShipmentCandidates.length) {
      setQuickShipmentOrderId(null);
      return;
    }
    setQuickShipmentOrderId((current) => {
      if (current && quickShipmentCandidates.some((order) => order.id === current)) {
        return current;
      }
      return quickShipmentCandidates[0]?.id ?? null;
    });
  }, [quickShipmentCandidates]);

  const toggleExpanded = (orderId: number) => {
    setExpandedOrderId((current) => current === orderId ? null : orderId);
    if (expandedOrderId !== orderId) {
      void fetchTrackingForOrder(orderId);
      void fetchParcelProof(orderId);
    }
  };

  const updateShipmentCreateDraft = useCallback((orderId: number, field: keyof ShipmentForm, value: string) => {
    setShipmentCreateDrafts((prev) => ({
      ...prev,
      [orderId]: {
        ...(prev[orderId] || createEmptyShipmentForm()),
        [field]: value,
      },
    }));
  }, []);

  const updateShipmentDraft = useCallback((shipmentId: number, field: keyof ShipmentForm, value: string) => {
    setShipmentUpdateDrafts((prev) => ({
      ...prev,
      [shipmentId]: {
        ...(prev[shipmentId] || createEmptyShipmentForm()),
        [field]: value,
      },
    }));
  }, []);

  const updateProofFile = useCallback((orderId: number, file: File | null) => {

  const updateProofNote = useCallback((orderId: number, value: string) => {

  }, []);

  const updateResponseNote = useCallback((confirmationId: number, value: string) => {
    setResponseNotes((prev) => ({ ...prev, [confirmationId]: value }));
  }, []);

  const openPackingSheet = useCallback((orderId: number) => {
    router.push(`/supplier/labels/${orderId}`);
  }, [router]);

  const handleCreateShipment = async (orderId: number) => {
    const draft = shipmentCreateDrafts[orderId];
    if (!draft) return false;
    setCreatingShipmentOrderId(orderId);
    try {
      const body: Record<string, unknown> = {
        order_id: orderId,
        current_hub: draft.current_hub || undefined,
        notes: draft.notes || undefined,
        package_count: draft.package_count || undefined,
        package_weight_kg: draft.package_weight_kg || undefined,
        package_dimensions: draft.package_dimensions || undefined,
        packaging_notes: draft.packaging_notes || undefined,
      };
      const response = await apiFetch("/logistics/shipments", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify(body),
      });
      const payload = await response.json().catch(() => null);
      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error(payload?.detail || `Could not create shipment for order #${orderId}.`);
      }
      await Promise.all([fetchOrders(), fetchTrackingForOrder(orderId, true)]);
      addToast(`Shipment created for order #${orderId}.`, "success");
      return true;
    } catch (error: unknown) {
      addToast(error instanceof Error ? error.message : `Could not create shipment for order #${orderId}.`, "error");
      return false;
    } finally {
      setCreatingShipmentOrderId(null);
    }
  };

  const handleUpdateShipment = async (orderId: number, shipmentId: number) => {
    const draft = shipmentUpdateDrafts[shipmentId];
    if (!draft) return;
    setUpdatingShipmentId(shipmentId);
    try {
      const body: Record<string, unknown> = {
        current_hub: draft.current_hub || undefined,
        notes: draft.notes || undefined,
        package_count: draft.package_count || undefined,
        package_weight_kg: draft.package_weight_kg || undefined,
        package_dimensions: draft.package_dimensions || undefined,
        packaging_notes: draft.packaging_notes || undefined,
      };
      const response = await apiFetch(`/logistics/shipments/${shipmentId}`, {
        method: "PATCH",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },

      }
      await Promise.all([fetchOrders(), fetchTrackingForOrder(orderId, true)]);
      addToast(`Shipment #${shipmentId} updated.`, "success");
    } catch (error: unknown) {
      addToast(error instanceof Error ? error.message : `Could not update shipment #${shipmentId}.`, "error");
    } finally {
      setUpdatingShipmentId(null);

  };

  const handleUploadProof = async (orderId: number) => {
    const file = proofFiles[orderId];
    if (!file) {
      addToast("Select a packed parcel photo first.", "error");
      return;
    }
    setUploadingProofOrderId(orderId);
    try {
      const form = new FormData();
      form.append("file", file);
      if (proofNotes[orderId]?.trim()) {
        form.append("notes", proofNotes[orderId].trim());
      }
      const response = await apiFetch(`/supplier/orders/${orderId}/parcel-proof`, {
        method: "POST",
        body: form,

      const payload = await response.json().catch(() => null);

        throw new Error(payload?.detail || `Could not upload packed parcel proof for order #${orderId}.`);
      }
      setProofFiles((prev) => ({ ...prev, [orderId]: null }));
      setProofNotes((prev) => ({ ...prev, [orderId]: "" }));
      setParcelProofByOrder((prev) => ({
        ...prev,
        [orderId]: {
          id: payload?.id,
          result: payload?.result,
          scan_code: payload?.scan_code,
          notes: payload?.notes,
          created_at: payload?.created_at,

      addToast(`Packed parcel proof saved for order #${orderId}.`, "success");
    } catch (error: unknown) {
      addToast(error instanceof Error ? error.message : `Could not upload proof for order #${orderId}.`, "error");
    } finally {
      setUploadingProofOrderId(null);
    }
  };

  const handleConfirmationResponse = async (orderId: number, confirmationId: number, decision: "accepted" | "rejected") => {
    setRespondingConfirmationId(confirmationId);
    try {
      const response = await apiFetch(`/orders/${orderId}/confirmation-requests/${confirmationId}/respond`, {
        method: "POST",

        body: JSON.stringify({
          decision,
          response_notes: responseNotes[confirmationId] || undefined,
        }),
      });
      const payload = await response.json().catch(() => null);
      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error(payload?.detail || "Could not submit confirmation response.");
      }
      setResponseNotes((prev) => ({ ...prev, [confirmationId]: "" }));
      await Promise.all([fetchOrders(), fetchTrackingForOrder(orderId, true)]);
      addToast(decision === "accepted" ? "Confirmation accepted." : "Confirmation rejected.", "success");
    } catch (error: unknown) {
      addToast(error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Could not submit confirmation response.", "error");
    } finally {
      setRespondingConfirmationId(null);
    }
  };

  return (
    <SupplierLayout title="Orders">
      <PanelContent className="space-y-4">
        {returnsFocus ? (
          <div className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface-1 px-4 py-3">
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-3">
              <div>
                <p className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase text-warning">Returns are handled from orders</p>
                <p className="mt-1 text-sm font-semibold text-text">Delivered orders with return activity stay anchored to the original order record.</p>
                <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-text-muted">Use the order list below to open the relevant order, review its shipment and settlement context, and continue the return or replacement conversation from the same workflow.</p>
              </div>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => router.replace("/supplier/orders")}
                className="rounded-lg border border-border px-3 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-text-muted transition-colors hover:bg-surface-2 hover:text-text"
              >
                Back to all orders
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        ) : null}

        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3">
          <div>
            <p className="text-xs text-text-muted">Manage handoffs, shipments, delivery confirmations, and return-linked order follow-up from one workspace.</p>
          </div>
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => void refreshWorkspace()}
              disabled={loading || refreshing}
              className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface-1 px-3 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-text-muted transition-colors hover:bg-surface-2 hover:text-text disabled:opacity-50"
            >
              <RefreshCw className={`h-4 w-4 ${(loading || refreshing) ? "animate-spin" : ""}`} />
              Refresh
            </button>
            {quickShipmentCandidates.length > 0 ? (
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setQuickShipmentOpen(true)}
                className="theme-btn-primary inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-xl px-3 py-2 text-xs font-semibold"
              >
                <Plus className="h-4 w-4" />
                Quick Shipment
              </button>
            ) : null}
            {[
              { label: "Orders", value: computedSummary.totalOrders, icon: Package },
              { label: "Handoff", value: computedSummary.awaitingHandoff, icon: Clock3 },
              { label: "Shipments", value: computedSummary.activeShipments, icon: Truck },
              { label: "Delivered", value: computedSummary.delivered, icon: ShieldCheck },
            ].map(({ label, value, icon: Icon }) => (
              <div key={label} className={`theme-card rounded-xl border flex items-center gap-2 ${statsPadding}`}>
                <Icon className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-text-faint" />
                <span className="text-xs font-bold text-text">{value}</span>
                <span className="text-[10px] text-text-faint">{label}</span>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">
            <label className="relative w-full flex-1 sm:min-w-72">
              <Search className="pointer-events-none absolute left-3 top-1/2 h-4 w-4 -translate-y-1/2 text-text-faint" />
              <input
                value={search}
                onChange={(event) => { setSearch(event.target.value); setPage(1); }}
                placeholder="Search by order, customer, phone, or address"
                className="theme-input h-9 w-full rounded-xl border pl-10 pr-3 text-xs"
              />
            </label>
            <div className="flex w-full flex-wrap gap-1.5 sm:w-auto">
              {ORDER_STATUS_FILTERS.map((filter) => (
                <button
                  key={filter}
                  onClick={() => { setStatusFilter(filter); setPage(1); }}
                  className={`rounded-xl px-2.5 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide transition-colors ${statusFilter === filter ? "bg-primary text-on-brand" : "border border-border bg-surface-2 text-text-muted hover:text-text"}`}
                >
                  {filter === "all" ? "All" : titleStatus(filter)}
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>
            {hasActiveFilters ? (
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={clearFilters}
                className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface-1 px-3 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-text-muted transition-colors hover:bg-surface-2 hover:text-text"
              >
                Clear filters
              </button>
            ) : null}
          </div>

        <SupplierOrdersList
          loading={loading}
          loadError={loadError}
          hasActiveFilters={hasActiveFilters}
          filteredOrders={filteredOrders}
          trackingByOrder={trackingByOrder}
          trackingLoading={trackingLoading}
          parcelProofByOrder={parcelProofByOrder}
          expandedOrderId={expandedOrderId}
          userId={user?.id}
          formatMoney={formatMoney}
          cardPadding={cardPadding}
          expandedPadding={expandedPadding}
          shipmentCreateDrafts={shipmentCreateDrafts}
          shipmentUpdateDrafts={shipmentUpdateDrafts}
          proofNotes={proofNotes}
          responseNotes={responseNotes}
          creatingShipmentOrderId={creatingShipmentOrderId}
          updatingShipmentId={updatingShipmentId}
          uploadingProofOrderId={uploadingProofOrderId}
          respondingConfirmationId={respondingConfirmationId}
          page={page}
          totalPages={totalPages}
          totalOrdersCount={totalOrdersCount}
          pageSize={PAGE_SIZE}
          onRefresh={refreshWorkspace}
          onClearFilters={clearFilters}
          onPageChange={(nextPage) => setPage(nextPage)}
          onToggleExpanded={toggleExpanded}
          onOpenPackingSheet={openPackingSheet}
          onCreateShipment={handleCreateShipment}
          onUpdateShipment={handleUpdateShipment}
          onUploadProof={handleUploadProof}
          onConfirmationResponse={handleConfirmationResponse}
          onShipmentCreateDraftChange={updateShipmentCreateDraft}
          onShipmentUpdateDraftChange={updateShipmentDraft}
          onProofFileChange={updateProofFile}
          onProofNoteChange={updateProofNote}
          onResponseNoteChange={updateResponseNote}
        />
      </PanelContent>

      <QuickDetailModal
        open={quickShipmentOpen}
        onClose={() => setQuickShipmentOpen(false)}
        title="Quick Shipment"
        subtitle={quickShipmentOrder ? `Create parcel record for order #${quickShipmentOrder.id}` : "No eligible orders"}
        widthClassName="max-w-2xl"
      >
        {quickShipmentCandidates.length === 0 ? (
          <div className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface-1 p-4 text-sm text-text-muted">
            No supplier orders are ready for quick shipment creation right now.
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div className="space-y-4">
            <div className="grid gap-3 md:grid-cols-[1fr_auto] md:items-end">
              <label className="space-y-1">
                <span className="text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.16em] text-text-faint">Order</span>
                <select
                  value={quickShipmentOrderId ?? ""}
                  onChange={(event) => setQuickShipmentOrderId(Number(event.target.value))}
                  className="theme-input h-10 w-full rounded-xl border px-3 text-sm"
                >
                  {quickShipmentCandidates.map((order) => (
                    <option key={order.id} value={order.id}>
                      #{order.id} · {order.customer_name} · {formatMoney(order.total_amount || 0)}
                    </option>
                  ))}
                </select>
              </label>
              {quickShipmentOrder ? (
                <div className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface-1 px-3 py-2 text-sm text-text-muted">
                  <p className="font-semibold text-text">{quickShipmentOrder.customer_name}</p>
                  <p className="mt-1 text-xs">{quickShipmentOrder.shipping_address || "No address captured yet"}</p>
                </div>
              ) : null}
            </div>

            {quickShipmentOrder ? (
              <div className="grid gap-3 md:grid-cols-2">
                <input
                  value={shipmentCreateDrafts[quickShipmentOrder.id]?.current_hub || ""}
                  onChange={(event) => setShipmentCreateDrafts((prev) => ({
                    ...prev,
                    [quickShipmentOrder.id]: {
                      ...(prev[quickShipmentOrder.id] || createEmptyShipmentForm()),
                      current_hub: event.target.value,
                    },
                  }))}
                  placeholder="Current hub / pickup location"
                  className="theme-input h-10 rounded-xl border px-3 text-sm"
                />
                <input
                  value={shipmentCreateDrafts[quickShipmentOrder.id]?.package_count || ""}
                  onChange={(event) => setShipmentCreateDrafts((prev) => ({
                    ...prev,
                    [quickShipmentOrder.id]: {
                      ...(prev[quickShipmentOrder.id] || createEmptyShipmentForm()),
                      package_count: event.target.value,
                    },
                  }))}
                  placeholder="Package count"
                  className="theme-input h-10 rounded-xl border px-3 text-sm"
                />
                <input
                  value={shipmentCreateDrafts[quickShipmentOrder.id]?.package_weight_kg || ""}
                  onChange={(event) => setShipmentCreateDrafts((prev) => ({
                    ...prev,
                    [quickShipmentOrder.id]: {
                      ...(prev[quickShipmentOrder.id] || createEmptyShipmentForm()),
                      package_weight_kg: event.target.value,
                    },
                  }))}
                  placeholder="Weight (kg)"
                  className="theme-input h-10 rounded-xl border px-3 text-sm"
                />
                <input
                  value={shipmentCreateDrafts[quickShipmentOrder.id]?.package_dimensions || ""}
                  onChange={(event) => setShipmentCreateDrafts((prev) => ({
                    ...prev,
                    [quickShipmentOrder.id]: {
                      ...(prev[quickShipmentOrder.id] || createEmptyShipmentForm()),
                      package_dimensions: event.target.value,
                    },
                  }))}
                  placeholder="Dimensions"
                  className="theme-input h-10 rounded-xl border px-3 text-sm"
                />
                <textarea
                  value={shipmentCreateDrafts[quickShipmentOrder.id]?.packaging_notes || ""}
                  onChange={(event) => setShipmentCreateDrafts((prev) => ({
                    ...prev,
                    [quickShipmentOrder.id]: {
                      ...(prev[quickShipmentOrder.id] || createEmptyShipmentForm()),
                      packaging_notes: event.target.value,
                    },
                  }))}
                  placeholder="Packaging notes"
                  className="theme-input min-h-24 rounded-xl border px-3 py-2 text-sm md:col-span-2"
                />
                <textarea
                  value={shipmentCreateDrafts[quickShipmentOrder.id]?.notes || ""}
                  onChange={(event) => setShipmentCreateDrafts((prev) => ({
                    ...prev,
                    [quickShipmentOrder.id]: {
                      ...(prev[quickShipmentOrder.id] || createEmptyShipmentForm()),
                      notes: event.target.value,
                    },
                  }))}
                  placeholder="Shipment note"
                  className="theme-input min-h-24 rounded-xl border px-3 py-2 text-sm md:col-span-2"
                />
              </div>
            ) : null}

            <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface-1 px-4 py-3 text-sm text-text-muted">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <LayoutGrid className="h-4 w-4 text-primary" />
                This reuses the same parcel-record flow as the expanded workspace.
              </div>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={async () => {
                  if (!quickShipmentOrder) return;
                  const created = await handleCreateShipment(quickShipmentOrder.id);
                  if (created) setQuickShipmentOpen(false);
                }}
                disabled={!quickShipmentOrder || creatingShipmentOrderId === quickShipmentOrder.id}
                className="theme-btn-primary inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-xl px-4 py-2 text-sm font-semibold disabled:opacity-50"
              >
                <Send className="h-4 w-4" />
                {quickShipmentOrder && creatingShipmentOrderId === quickShipmentOrder.id ? "Creating..." : "Create Parcel Record"}
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
      </QuickDetailModal>
    </SupplierLayout>
  );
}

export default function SupplierOrdersWorkspacePage() {
  return (
    <Suspense
      fallback={
        <SupplierLayout title="Orders">
          <div className="theme-card rounded-xl border p-8 text-center text-xs text-text-muted">
            <BrandLoading label="Loading supplier orders..." />
          </div>
        </SupplierLayout>
      }
    >
      <SupplierOrdersWorkspaceContent />
    </Suspense>
  );
}
```

### `frontend\web_app\src\app\supplier\orders\shared.tsx`

```text
import {
  CheckCircle2,
  Clock3,
  Truck,
} from "@/lib/icons";
import type { OrderTracking } from "@/lib/types";

export type SupplierOrder = {
  id: number;
  user_id: number;
  total_amount: number;
  status: string;
  created_at: string;
  customer_name: string;
  customer_email?: string | null;
  customer_phone?: string | null;
  shipping_address?: string | null;
  delivery_location?: string | null;
  delivery_note?: string | null;
  payment_status?: "paid" | "unpaid" | null;
  paid_at?: string | null;
  payment_method?: string | null;
  settlement_status?: string | null;
  settlement_id?: number | null;
  settlement_net_amount?: number | null;
  items: Array<{
    id: number;
    product_id: number;
    quantity: number;
    price: number;
    product_name: string;
    product_image?: string | null;
  }>;
};

export type ParcelProof = {
  id: number;
  result?: string | null;
  scan_code?: string | null;
  notes?: string | null;
  created_at?: string | null;
  image_urls?: string[] | null;
};

export type ShipmentForm = {
  current_hub: string;
  notes: string;
  package_count: string;
  package_weight_kg: string;
  package_dimensions: string;
  packaging_notes: string;
};

export const ORDER_STATUS_FILTERS = [
  "all",
  "pending",
  "confirmed",
  "processing",
  "prepared",
  "picking_up",
  "shipped",
  "delivered",
  "cancelled",
] as const;

export function createEmptyShipmentForm(): ShipmentForm {
  return {
    current_hub: "",
    notes: "",
    package_count: "",
    package_weight_kg: "",
    package_dimensions: "",
    packaging_notes: "",
  };
}

export function formatDate(value?: string | null): string {
  if (!value) return "-";
  const parsed = new Date(value);
  if (Number.isNaN(parsed.getTime())) return value;
  return parsed.toLocaleDateString();
}

export function formatDateTime(value?: string | null): string {
  if (!value) return "-";
  const parsed = new Date(value);
  if (Number.isNaN(parsed.getTime())) return value;
  return parsed.toLocaleString();
}

function sentenceStatus(value?: string | null): string {
  if (!value) return "Pending";
  return value.replaceAll("_", " ");
}

export function titleStatus(value?: string | null): string {
  const normalized = sentenceStatus(value);
  return normalized.replace(/\b\w/g, (char) => char.toUpperCase());
}

export function supplierWorkflowStatus(value?: string | null): string {
  if (!value) return "pending";
  return value === "confirmed" ? "pending" : value;
}

export function badgeClass(status?: string | null): string {
  switch (status) {
    case "delivered":
      return "theme-chip-success";
    case "shipped":
    case "in_transit":
    case "picking_up":
    case "prepared":
      return "theme-chip-brand";
    case "processing":
    case "confirmed":
      return "theme-chip-warning";
    case "cancelled":
    case "failed":
    case "returned":
      return "theme-chip-danger";
    default:
      return "theme-chip-muted";
  }
}

export function Timeline({
  tracking,
  statusOverride,
}: {
  tracking: OrderTracking;
  statusOverride?: string | null;
}) {
  const displayStatus = statusOverride || tracking.order_status;

  return (
    <div className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface-1 p-3">
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3">
        <div>
          <p className="text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.24em] text-text-faint">
            Order Progress
          </p>
          <p className="mt-1 text-xs font-semibold text-text">
            {titleStatus(displayStatus)}
          </p>
        </div>
        <div className="text-xs text-text-muted">
          {tracking.delivered_shipments}/{tracking.shipment_count} shipments delivered
        </div>
      </div>
      <div className="mt-4 flex items-start gap-0 overflow-x-auto pb-1">
        {tracking.timeline.map((step, index) => {
          const isLast = index === tracking.timeline.length - 1;
          return (
            <div key={step.key} className="flex min-w-[6.5rem] flex-1 items-center">
              <div className="flex shrink-0 flex-col items-center">
                <div
                  className={
                    `flex h-9 w-9 items-center justify-center rounded-full border-2 ${
                      step.completed
                        ? "border-success bg-success text-on-brand"
                        : step.active
                          ? "border-primary bg-primary/15 text-primary"
                          : "border-border bg-surface-2 text-text-faint"
                    }`
                  }
                >
                  {step.completed ? (
                    <CheckCircle2 className="h-4 w-4" />
                  ) : step.active ? (
                    <Truck className="h-4 w-4" />
                  ) : (
                    <Clock3 className="h-4 w-4" />
                  )}
                </div>
                <span
                  className={
                    `mt-1 text-center text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wide ${
                      step.completed
                        ? "theme-status-success"
                        : step.active
                          ? "theme-status-info font-semibold"
                          : "text-text-faint"
                    }`
                  }
                >
                  {step.label}
                </span>
              </div>
              {!isLast ? (
                <div
                  className={`mb-4 h-0.5 flex-1 ${
                    step.completed
                      ? "bg-success"
                      : step.active
                        ? "bg-primary/35"
                        : "bg-border"
                  }`}
                />
              ) : null}
            </div>
          );
        })}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```
