### `frontend\web_app\src\app\supplier\orders\[id]\page.tsx`

```text
"use client";

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { useParams, useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { motion } from 'framer-motion';
import SupplierLayout from '@/components/SupplierLayout';
import { API_URL, apiFetch } from '@/lib/api';
import {
  ArrowLeft,
  Package,
  Truck,
  CheckCircle,
  Clock,
  AlertCircle,
  User,
  Mail,
  Phone,
  MapPin,
  Calendar,
  DollarSign,
  RefreshCw,
  MessageSquare,
  Printer,
  Download
} from 'lucide-react';

interface OrderItem {
  id: number;
  product_id: number;
  quantity: number;
  price: number;
  product_name: string;
  product_image: string;
}

interface Order {
  id: number;
  user_id: number;
  total_amount: number;
  status: string;
  created_at: string;
  customer_name: string;
  customer_email: string;
  customer_phone?: string;
  shipping_address?: string;
  items: OrderItem[];
}

const statusConfig = {
  pending: { color: 'bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-800', icon: Clock, label: 'Pending' },
  processing: { color: 'bg-blue-100 text-blue-800', icon: RefreshCw, label: 'Processing' },
  shipped: { color: 'bg-purple-100 text-purple-800', icon: Truck, label: 'Shipped' },
  delivered: { color: 'bg-green-100 text-green-800', icon: CheckCircle, label: 'Delivered' },
  cancelled: { color: 'bg-red-100 text-red-800', icon: AlertCircle, label: 'Cancelled' }
};

const statusSteps = [
  { key: 'pending', label: 'Order Received', description: 'Order has been placed' },
  { key: 'processing', label: 'Processing', description: 'Preparing your order' },
  { key: 'shipped', label: 'Shipped', description: 'Order is on the way' },
  { key: 'delivered', label: 'Delivered', description: 'Order completed' }
];

export default function SupplierOrderDetail() {
  const params = useParams();
  const router = useRouter();
  const orderId = params.id as string;

  const [order, setOrder] = useState<Order | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [updatingStatus, setUpdatingStatus] = useState(false);

  async function fetchOrderDetail() {
    try {
      const response = await apiFetch(`/supplier/orders/${orderId}`);

      if (response.ok) {
        const data = await response.json();
        setOrder(data);
      } else if (response.status === 404) {
        router.push('/supplier/orders');
      } else {
        console.error('Failed to fetch order detail');
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error fetching order detail:', error);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchOrderDetail();
  }, [orderId]);

  const updateOrderStatus = async (newStatus: string) => {
    setUpdatingStatus(true);

    try {
      const response = await apiFetch(`/supplier/orders/${orderId}/status`, {
        method: 'PUT',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ status: newStatus }),
      });

      if (response.ok) {
        setOrder(prev => prev ? { ...prev, status: newStatus } : null);
      } else {
        console.error('Failed to update order status');
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error updating order status:', error);
    } finally {
      setUpdatingStatus(false);
    }
  };

  const getCurrentStepIndex = (status: string) => {
    return statusSteps.findIndex(step => step.key === status);
  };

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <SupplierLayout>
        <div className="min-h-screen bg-gradient-to-br from-zozi-primary via-background-luxury to-zozi-secondary">
          {/* header via layout */}
          <div className="flex items-center justify-center min-h-[60vh]">
            <div className="animate-spin rounded-full h-12 w-12 border-b-2 border-zozi-primary"></div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </SupplierLayout>
    );
  }

  if (!order) {
    return (
      <SupplierLayout>
        <div className="min-h-screen bg-gradient-to-br from-zozi-primary via-background-luxury to-zozi-secondary">
          {/* header via layout */}
          <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-8">
            <div className="text-center">
              <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-zozi-neutral mb-4">Order Not Found</h1>
              <Link
                href="/supplier/orders"
                className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2 bg-zozi-primary text-white rounded-lg hover:bg-zozi-secondary transition-colors"
              >
              <ArrowLeft className="w-4 h-4" />
              Back to Orders
            </Link>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </SupplierLayout>
    );
  }

  const StatusIcon = statusConfig[order.status as keyof typeof statusConfig]?.icon || Clock;
  const statusInfo = statusConfig[order.status as keyof typeof statusConfig] || statusConfig.pending;
  const currentStepIndex = getCurrentStepIndex(order.status);

  return (
    <SupplierLayout>
      <div className="min-h-screen bg-gradient-to-br from-zozi-primary via-background-luxury to-zozi-secondary">
        {/* header via layout */}

      <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-8">
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-8">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
            <Link
              href="/supplier/orders"
              className="flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2 bg-white/10 text-zozi-neutral rounded-lg hover:bg-white/20 transition-colors"
            >
              <ArrowLeft className="w-4 h-4" />
              Back to Orders
            </Link>
            <div>
              <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold text-zozi-neutral">Order #{order.id}</h1>
              <p className="text-foreground-secondary">Order details and fulfillment</p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className={`px-4 py-2 rounded-full text-sm font-medium flex items-center gap-2 ${statusInfo.color}`}>
            <StatusIcon className="w-4 h-4" />
            {statusInfo.label}
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-8">
          {/* Main Content */}
          <div className="lg:col-span-2 space-y-6">
            {/* Order Progress */}
            <motion.div
              initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }}
              animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
              className="bg-white/95 backdrop-blur-xl rounded-2xl p-6 shadow-2xl border border-zozi-primary/20"
            >
              <h2 className="text-xl font-bold text-zozi-neutral mb-6">Order Progress</h2>

              <div className="relative">
                {/* Progress Line */}
                <div className="absolute top-5 left-5 right-5 h-0.5 bg-zozi-neutral/20">
                  <div
                    className="h-full bg-gradient-to-r from-zozi-primary to-zozi-secondary transition-all duration-500"
                    style={{ width: `${((currentStepIndex + 1) / statusSteps.length) * 100}%` }}
                  ></div>
                </div>

                {/* Steps */}
                <div className="relative flex justify-between">
                  {statusSteps.map((step, index) => {
                    const isCompleted = index <= currentStepIndex;
                    const isCurrent = index === currentStepIndex;

                    return (
                      <div key={step.key} className="flex flex-col items-center">
                        <div className={`w-10 h-10 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center border-2 transition-all duration-300 ${
                          isCompleted
                            ? 'bg-(--zozi-primary) border-(--zozi-primary) text-white'
                            : isCurrent
                            ? 'border-(--zozi-primary) text-(--zozi-primary) bg-white'
                            : 'border-gray-300 text-gray-400 bg-white'
                        }`}>
                          {isCompleted ? <CheckCircle className="w-5 h-5" /> : <Clock className="w-5 h-5" />}
                        </div>
                        <div className="mt-3 text-center">
                          <div className={`text-sm font-medium ${isCompleted || isCurrent ? 'text-(--zozi-neutral)' : 'text-(--foreground-secondary)'}`}>
                            {step.label}
                          </div>
                          <div className="text-xs text-(--foreground-secondary) mt-1 max-w-20">
                            {step.description}
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    );
                  })}
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Status Update */}
              <div className="mt-8 pt-6 border-t border-(--zozi-primary)/10">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                  <div>
                    <h3 className="font-semibold text-(--zozi-neutral) mb-1">Update Order Status</h3>
                    <p className="text-sm text-(--foreground-secondary)">Change the fulfillment status of this order</p>
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                    <select
                      value={order.status}
                      onChange={(e) => updateOrderStatus(e.target.value)}
                      disabled={updatingStatus}
                      className="px-4 py-2 border border-(--zozi-primary)/20 rounded-lg focus:ring-2 focus:ring-(--zozi-primary) focus:border-transparent disabled:opacity-50"
                    >
                      <option value="pending">Pending</option>
                      <option value="processing">Processing</option>
                      <option value="shipped">Shipped</option>
                      <option value="delivered">Delivered</option>

                    </select>
                    {updatingStatus && (

            <motion.div

            >
              <h2 className="text-xl font-bold text-(--zozi-neutral) mb-6">Your Products in this Order</h2>

              <div className="space-y-4">
                {order.items.map((item) => (
                  <div key={item.id} className="flex items-center gap-4 p-4 bg-background-secondary rounded-lg">
                    <div className="w-16 h-16 bg-gray-200 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center flex-shrink-0">
                      {item.product_image ? (
                        <img
                          src={`${API_URL}/${item.product_image}`}
                          alt={item.product_name}
                          className="w-full h-full object-cover rounded-lg"
                        />

                        <Package className="w-8 h-8 text-gray-500" />
                      )}
                    </div>

                    <div className="flex-1">
                      <h3 className="font-semibold text-(--zozi-neutral)">{item.product_name}</h3>
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-4 mt-1 text-sm text-(--foreground-secondary)">
                        <span>Quantity: {item.quantity}</span>
                        <span>Price: ${item.price.toFixed(2)}</span>
                        <span className="font-medium text-(--zozi-primary)">
                          Subtotal: ${(item.quantity * item.price).toFixed(2)}
                        </span>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>

              {/* Order Total */}
              <div className="mt-6 pt-4 border-t border-(--zozi-primary)/10">
                <div className="flex justify-between items-center">
                  <span className="text-lg font-semibold text-(--zozi-neutral)">Your Portion Total</span>
                  <span className="text-2xl font-bold text-(--zozi-primary)">
                    ${order.items.reduce((total, item) => total + (item.quantity * item.price), 0).toFixed(2)}
                  </span>
                </div>
              </div>
            </motion.div>
          </div>

          {/* Sidebar */}
          <div className="space-y-6">
            {/* Customer Information */}
            <motion.div
              initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }}
              animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
              transition={{ delay: 0.2 }}
              className="bg-white/95 backdrop-blur-xl rounded-2xl p-6 shadow-2xl border border-(--zozi-primary)/20"
            >
              <h2 className="text-xl font-bold text-(--zozi-neutral) mb-6">Customer Information</h2>

              <div className="space-y-4">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                  <User className="w-5 h-5 text-(--zozi-primary)" />
                  <div>
                    <div className="font-medium text-(--zozi-neutral)">{order.customer_name}</div>
                    <div className="text-sm text-(--foreground-secondary)">Customer</div>
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                  <Mail className="w-5 h-5 text-(--zozi-primary)" />
                  <div>
                    <div className="font-medium text-(--zozi-neutral)">{order.customer_email}</div>
                    <div className="text-sm text-(--foreground-secondary)">Email</div>
                  </div>
                </div>

                {order.customer_phone && (
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                    <Phone className="w-5 h-5 text-(--zozi-primary)" />
                    <div>
                      <div className="font-medium text-(--zozi-neutral)">{order.customer_phone}</div>
                      <div className="text-sm text-(--foreground-secondary)">Phone</div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>

              {/* Quick Actions */}
              <div className="mt-6 pt-4 border-t border-(--zozi-primary)/10">
                <h3 className="font-semibold text-(--zozi-neutral) mb-3">Quick Actions</h3>
                <div className="space-y-2">
                  <button className="w-full flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2 bg-(--zozi-primary) text-white rounded-lg hover:bg-(--zozi-secondary) transition-colors">
                    <MessageSquare className="w-4 h-4" />
                    Contact Customer
                  </button>
                  <button className="w-full flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2 bg-(--zozi-secondary) text-white rounded-lg hover:bg-(--zozi-primary) transition-colors">
                    <Printer className="w-4 h-4" />
                    Print Shipping Label
                  </button>
                  <button className="w-full flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2 bg-gray-100 text-(--zozi-neutral) rounded-lg hover:bg-gray-200 transition-colors">
                    <Download className="w-4 h-4" />
                    Download Invoice
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>
            </motion.div>

            {/* Shipping Information */}
            {order.shipping_address && (
              <motion.div
                initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }}
                animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
                transition={{ delay: 0.3 }}
                className="bg-white/95 backdrop-blur-xl rounded-2xl p-6 shadow-2xl border border-(--zozi-primary)/20"
              >
                <h2 className="text-xl font-bold text-(--zozi-neutral) mb-6">Shipping Address</h2>

                <div className="flex items-start gap-3">
                  <MapPin className="w-5 h-5 text-(--zozi-primary) mt-0.5" />
                  <div className="text-sm text-(--zozi-neutral) whitespace-pre-line">
                    {order.shipping_address}
                  </div>
                </div>
              </motion.div>
            )}

            {/* Order Summary */}
            <motion.div
              initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }}
              animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
              transition={{ delay: 0.4 }}
              className="bg-white/95 backdrop-blur-xl rounded-2xl p-6 shadow-2xl border border-(--zozi-primary)/20"
            >
              <h2 className="text-xl font-bold text-(--zozi-neutral) mb-6">Order Summary</h2>

              <div className="space-y-3">
                <div className="flex justify-between items-center">
                  <span className="text-(--foreground-secondary)">Order ID</span>
                  <span className="font-medium text-(--zozi-neutral)">#{order.id}</span>
                </div>

                <div className="flex justify-between items-center">
                  <span className="text-(--foreground-secondary)">Order Date</span>
                  <span className="font-medium text-(--zozi-neutral)">
                    {new Date(order.created_at).toLocaleDateString()}
                  </span>
                </div>

                <div className="flex justify-between items-center">
                  <span className="text-(--foreground-secondary)">Status</span>
                  <span className={`px-2 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-medium ${statusInfo.color}`}>
                    {statusInfo.label}
                  </span>
                </div>

                <div className="flex justify-between items-center pt-3 border-t border-(--zozi-primary)/10">
                  <span className="font-semibold text-(--zozi-neutral)">Your Revenue</span>
                  <span className="font-bold text-(--zozi-primary)">
                    ${order.items.reduce((total, item) => total + (item.quantity * item.price), 0).toFixed(2)}
                  </span>
                </div>
              </div>
            </motion.div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
    </SupplierLayout>
  );
}
```

```text
﻿"use client";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { motion } from "framer-motion";
import { TrendingUp, ChevronDown, ChevronUp, Building2, CheckCircle, Clock, XCircle, Save } from "@/lib/icons";
import { apiFetch } from "@/lib/api";
import { formatCurrencyAmount } from "@/lib/currencyStore";

interface FinanceSummary {
  total_gross_revenue: number;
  total_commission_deducted: number;
  total_net_earnings: number;
  pending_settlement: number;
  total_settled: number;
  total_orders: number;
  total_vat_on_orders?: number;
  total_refund_reversals?: number;
  currency: string;
  bank_instruction?: BankInstruction | null;
}

interface BankInstruction {
  configured: boolean;
  title: string;
  account_label?: string | null;
  beneficiary_name?: string | null;
  bank_name?: string | null;
  account_number?: string | null;
  iban?: string | null;
  support_email?: string | null;
  support_phone?: string | null;
  reference_value?: string | null;
  reference_help?: string | null;
  instructions?: string | null;
}

interface Settlement {
  id: number;
  order_id: number;
  gross_amount: number;
  commission_deducted: number;
  net_amount: number;
  status: string;
  currency?: string;
  created_at: string;
  settled_at: string | null;
  payment_method?: string | null;
  vat_amount?: number | null;
  destination_country?: string | null;
  destination_city?: string | null;
  partner_name?: string | null;
  partner_code?: string | null;
  service_area_label?: string | null;
  allocation_source?: string | null;
  refund_status?: string | null;
  supplier_reversal_amount?: number | null;
  customer_refund_amount?: number | null;
  commission_rate?: number | null;
}

interface RecipientBankAccount {
  configured: boolean;
  id?: number;
  beneficiary_name?: string | null;
  bank_name?: string | null;
  branch_name?: string | null;
  account_number?: string | null;
  iban?: string | null;
  swift_code?: string | null;
  routing_number?: string | null;
  currency?: string;
  bank_country?: string | null;
  verification_status?: "pending" | "verified" | "rejected";
  verification_note?: string | null;
  verified_at?: string | null;
}

const EMPTY_BANK_FORM = {
  beneficiary_name: "",
  bank_name: "",
  branch_name: "",
  account_number: "",
  iban: "",
  swift_code: "",
  routing_number: "",
  currency: "OMR",
  bank_country: "",
};

function fmtCurrency(v: number, currency = "OMR") {
  return formatCurrencyAmount(v || 0, currency);
}

function paymentMethodLabel(value?: string | null) {
  if (value === "cod") return "Cash on Delivery";
  if (value === "tap") return "Tap";
  if (value === "paytabs") return "PayTabs";
  if (value === "thawani") return "Thawani Pay";
  if (value === "paypal") return "PayPal";
  if (value === "stripe" || value === "card") return "Card";
  if (value === "hyperpay") return "HyperPay";
  if (value === "omannet") return "OmanNet";
  return "Unspecified";
}

function chipClass(status?: string | null) {
  if (status === "settled" || status === "completed") return "theme-chip-success";
  if (status === "pending" || status === "eligible" || status === "processing" || status === "partial") return "theme-chip-warning";
  if (status === "reversed" || status === "failed") return "theme-chip-danger";
  return "theme-chip-muted";
}

function buildRouteLabel(settlement: Settlement) {
  const routeBits = [settlement.partner_name, settlement.service_area_label].filter(Boolean);
  const destinationBits = [settlement.destination_city, settlement.destination_country].filter(Boolean);
  return {
    route: routeBits.join(" · ") || "Snapshot unavailable",
    destination: destinationBits.join(", ") || null,
  };
}

export default function FinanceSection() {
  const [summary, setSummary] = useState<FinanceSummary | null>(null);
  const [settlements, setSettlements] = useState<Settlement[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(true);

  // Bank account state
  const [bankAccount, setBankAccount] = useState<RecipientBankAccount | null>(null);
  const [bankOpen, setBankOpen] = useState(false);
  const [bankForm, setBankForm] = useState({ ...EMPTY_BANK_FORM });
  const [bankSaving, setBankSaving] = useState(false);
  const [bankMsg, setBankMsg] = useState<{ type: "success" | "error"; text: string } | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    Promise.all([
      apiFetch("/finance/supplier/summary").then((r) => (r.ok ? r.json() : null)).catch(() => null),
      apiFetch("/finance/supplier/settlements").then((r) => (r.ok ? r.json() : [])).catch(() => []),
      apiFetch("/supplier/bank-account").then((r) => (r.ok ? r.json() : null)).catch(() => null),
    ]).then(([sum, sett, ba]) => {
      if (sum) setSummary(sum);
      if (Array.isArray(sett)) setSettlements(sett);
      if (ba && ba.id) {
        setBankAccount(ba);
        setBankForm({
          beneficiary_name: ba.beneficiary_name || "",
          bank_name: ba.bank_name || "",
          branch_name: ba.branch_name || "",
          account_number: ba.account_number || "",
          iban: ba.iban || "",
          swift_code: ba.swift_code || "",
          routing_number: ba.routing_number || "",
          currency: ba.currency || "OMR",
          bank_country: ba.bank_country || "",
        });
      }
      setLoading(false);
    });
  }, []);

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div className="theme-card rounded-xl border p-5 space-y-3">
        <div className="h-5 w-40 rounded bg-surface-2 animate-pulse" />
        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-4 gap-3">
          {Array.from({ length: 4 }).map((_, i) => (
            <div key={i} className="h-20 rounded-xl bg-surface-2 animate-pulse" />
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (!summary) return null;

  return (
    <div className="theme-card rounded-xl border overflow-hidden">
      {/* Header toggle */}
      <button onClick={() => setOpen((p) => !p)}
        className="w-full flex items-center justify-between p-5 text-left hover:bg-surface-2/50 transition-colors">
        <span className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-bold text-text">
          <TrendingUp className="w-4 h-4 text-primary" />
          Financial Overview
        </span>
        {open ? <ChevronUp className="w-4 h-4 text-text-muted" /> : <ChevronDown className="w-4 h-4 text-text-muted" />}
      </button>

      {open && (
        <motion.div initial={{ opacity: 0 }} animate={{ opacity: 1 }} className="px-5 pb-5 space-y-5">
          {/* KPI cards */}
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 xl:grid-cols-6 gap-3">
            {[
              { label: "Gross Revenue", value: fmtCurrency(summary.total_gross_revenue, summary.currency), chip: "theme-chip-success" },
              { label: "Commission (ZOZI)", value: fmtCurrency(summary.total_commission_deducted, summary.currency), chip: "theme-chip-warning" },
              { label: "Net Earnings", value: fmtCurrency(summary.total_net_earnings, summary.currency), chip: "theme-chip-info" },
              { label: "Pending Settlement", value: fmtCurrency(summary.pending_settlement, summary.currency), chip: "theme-chip-muted" },
              { label: "VAT On Orders", value: fmtCurrency(summary.total_vat_on_orders || 0, summary.currency), chip: "theme-chip-brand" },
              { label: "Refund Reversals", value: fmtCurrency(summary.total_refund_reversals || 0, summary.currency), chip: "theme-chip-danger" },
            ].map((c) => (
              <div key={c.label} className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface p-3">
                <span className={`rounded-lg px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold ${c.chip}`}>{c.label}</span>
                <p className="mt-2 text-lg font-bold text-text">{c.value}</p>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>

          {/* Effective commission rate bar */}
          {summary.total_gross_revenue > 0 && (
            <div className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface-2/40 px-4 py-3 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">
              <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-text-muted">Effective Commission Rate</span>
              <span className="text-sm font-bold text-warning">
                {((summary.total_commission_deducted / summary.total_gross_revenue) * 100).toFixed(2)}%
              </span>
              <div className="flex-1 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-surface min-w-16">
                <div
                  className="h-full rounded-full bg-warning/60"
                  style={{ width: `${Math.min(((summary.total_commission_deducted / summary.total_gross_revenue) * 100), 100)}%` }}
                />
              </div>
              <span className="text-[11px] text-text-faint">of gross revenue</span>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Settlement summary row */}
          <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-4 text-xs text-text-muted">
            <span>Total Orders: <strong className="text-text">{summary.total_orders}</strong></span>
            <span>Pending: <strong className="text-warning">{settlements.filter((s) => ["pending", "eligible", "processing"].includes(s.status)).length}</strong></span>
            <span>Completed: <strong className="text-success">{settlements.filter((s) => s.status === "settled").length}</strong></span>
            <span>Settled Value: <strong className="text-text">{fmtCurrency(summary.total_settled, summary.currency)}</strong></span>
          </div>

          {summary.bank_instruction && (
            <div className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface p-4">
              <div className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-3">
                <div>
                  <h4 className="text-xs font-bold text-text">{summary.bank_instruction.title || "Payout Reference Guide"}</h4>
                  <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-text-muted">
                    {summary.bank_instruction.reference_help || "Use the stored payout reference when you need Zozi finance to trace a transfer."}
                  </p>
                </div>
                <span className={`rounded-lg px-2 py-1 text-[10px] font-bold ${summary.bank_instruction.configured ? "theme-chip-success" : "theme-chip-warning"}`}>
                  {summary.bank_instruction.configured ? "bank configured" : "reference only"}
                </span>
              </div>

              <div className="mt-4 grid gap-3 md:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-4">
                <div className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface-2/40 p-3">
                  <p className="text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.18em] text-text-faint">Reference</p>
                  <p className="mt-2 text-xs font-bold text-text">{summary.bank_instruction.reference_value || "Pending"}</p>
                </div>
                <div className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface-2/40 p-3">
                  <p className="text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.18em] text-text-faint">From Bank</p>
                  <p className="mt-2 text-xs font-semibold text-text">{summary.bank_instruction.bank_name || summary.bank_instruction.account_label || "Zozi treasury"}</p>
                  {summary.bank_instruction.beneficiary_name && (
                    <p className="mt-1 text-[11px] text-text-muted">{summary.bank_instruction.beneficiary_name}</p>
                  )}
                </div>
                <div className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface-2/40 p-3">
                  <p className="text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.18em] text-text-faint">Account</p>
                  <p className="mt-2 text-xs font-semibold text-text">{summary.bank_instruction.account_number || summary.bank_instruction.iban || "Configured in treasury"}</p>
                </div>
                <div className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface-2/40 p-3">
                  <p className="text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.18em] text-text-faint">Support</p>
                  <p className="mt-2 text-xs font-semibold text-text">{summary.bank_instruction.support_email || summary.bank_instruction.support_phone || "Finance helpdesk"}</p>
                  {summary.bank_instruction.support_email && summary.bank_instruction.support_phone && (
                    <p className="mt-1 text-[11px] text-text-muted">{summary.bank_instruction.support_phone}</p>
                  )}
                </div>
              </div>

              {summary.bank_instruction.instructions && (
                <p className="mt-3 text-xs leading-5 text-text-muted">{summary.bank_instruction.instructions}</p>
              )}
            </div>
          )}

          {/* ─── Payout Bank Account ──────────────────────────────── */}
          <div className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface overflow-hidden">
            <button
              onClick={() => setBankOpen((p) => !p)}
              className="w-full flex items-center justify-between px-4 py-3 text-left hover:bg-surface-2/50 transition-colors"
            >
              <span className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-bold text-text">
                <Building2 className="w-4 h-4 text-primary" />
                Payout Bank Account
                {bankAccount?.verification_status === "verified" && (
                  <span className="theme-chip-success rounded-lg px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold flex items-center gap-1">
                    <CheckCircle className="w-3 h-3" /> verified
                  </span>
                )}
                {bankAccount?.verification_status === "pending" && (
                  <span className="theme-chip-warning rounded-lg px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold flex items-center gap-1">
                    <Clock className="w-3 h-3" /> pending review
                  </span>
                )}
                {bankAccount?.verification_status === "rejected" && (
                  <span className="theme-chip-danger rounded-lg px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold flex items-center gap-1">
                    <XCircle className="w-3 h-3" /> rejected
                  </span>
                )}
                {!bankAccount?.id && (
                  <span className="theme-chip-muted rounded-lg px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold">not configured</span>
                )}
              </span>
              {bankOpen ? <ChevronUp className="w-4 h-4 text-text-muted" /> : <ChevronDown className="w-4 h-4 text-text-muted" />}
            </button>

            {bankOpen && (
              <motion.div initial={{ opacity: 0 }} animate={{ opacity: 1 }} className="px-4 pb-4 space-y-3">
                <p className="text-xs text-text-muted">
                  Submit your bank account details for payout transfers. Details are reviewed by the Zozi finance team before activation.
                  {bankAccount?.verification_status === "rejected" && bankAccount.verification_note && (
                    <span className="block mt-1 text-danger font-medium">Rejection reason: {bankAccount.verification_note}</span>
                  )}
                </p>
                <div className="grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2">
                  {(
                    [
                      { key: "beneficiary_name", label: "Beneficiary Name", placeholder: "As shown on bank account" },
                      { key: "bank_name", label: "Bank Name", placeholder: "e.g. Bank Muscat" },
                      { key: "branch_name", label: "Branch Name", placeholder: "e.g. Main Branch" },
                      { key: "account_number", label: "Account Number", placeholder: "12-digit account number" },
                      { key: "iban", label: "IBAN", placeholder: "e.g. OM91NSKL..." },
                      { key: "swift_code", label: "SWIFT / BIC", placeholder: "e.g. BMUSOMOMX" },
                      { key: "routing_number", label: "Routing Number", placeholder: "Optional" },
                      { key: "bank_country", label: "Bank Country", placeholder: "e.g. Oman" },
                    ] as { key: keyof typeof EMPTY_BANK_FORM; label: string; placeholder: string }[]
                  ).map(({ key, label, placeholder }) => (
                    <div key={key}>
                      <label className="block text-[11px] font-semibold text-text-faint mb-1 uppercase tracking-[0.12em]">{label}</label>
                      <input
                        className="w-full rounded-lg border border-border bg-surface-2 px-3 py-2 text-xs text-text placeholder:text-text-faint focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary/40"
                        value={bankForm[key]}
                        placeholder={placeholder}
                        onChange={(e) => setBankForm((f) => ({ ...f, [key]: e.target.value }))}
                      />
                    </div>
                  ))}
                  <div>
                    <label className="block text-[11px] font-semibold text-text-faint mb-1 uppercase tracking-[0.12em]">Currency</label>
                    <select
                      className="w-full rounded-lg border border-border bg-surface-2 px-3 py-2 text-xs text-text focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary/40"
                      value={bankForm.currency}
                      onChange={(e) => setBankForm((f) => ({ ...f, currency: e.target.value }))}
                    >
                      {["OMR", "AED", "USD", "EUR", "GBP", "SAR", "QAR", "KWD", "BHD"].map((c) => (
                        <option key={c} value={c}>{c}</option>
                      ))}
                    </select>
                  </div>
                </div>

                {bankMsg && (
                  <p className={`text-xs font-medium ${bankMsg.type === "success" ? "text-success" : "text-danger"}`}>{bankMsg.text}</p>
                )}

                <button
                  disabled={bankSaving}
                  onClick={async () => {
                    setBankSaving(true);
                    setBankMsg(null);
                    try {
                      const r = await apiFetch("/supplier/bank-account", {
                        method: "PUT",
                        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
                        body: JSON.stringify(bankForm),
                      });
                      const data = await r.json();
                      if (r.ok) {
                        setBankAccount((prev) => ({ ...prev, ...bankForm, configured: true, id: data.id, verification_status: data.verification_status }));
                        setBankMsg({ type: "success", text: "Bank account saved. Pending admin verification." });
                      } else {
                        setBankMsg({ type: "error", text: data.detail || "Failed to save bank account." });
                      }
                    } catch {
                      setBankMsg({ type: "error", text: "Network error. Please try again." });
                    } finally {
                      setBankSaving(false);
                    }
                  }}
                  className="flex items-center gap-2 rounded-lg theme-btn-primary px-4 py-2 text-xs font-semibold disabled:opacity-50"
                >
                  <Save className="w-4 h-4" />
                  {bankSaving ? "Saving…" : "Save Bank Account"}
                </button>
              </motion.div>
            )}
          </div>

          {/* Recent settlements table */}
          {settlements.length > 0 && (
            <div className="rounded-xl border border-border overflow-hidden">
              <div className="border-b border-border px-4 py-3">
                <h4 className="text-xs font-bold text-text">Recent Settlements</h4>
              </div>
              <div className="overflow-x-auto">
                <table className="w-full text-xs">
                  <thead>
                    <tr className="border-b border-border bg-surface-2/40">
                      {["Order", "Route", "Settlement", "Net / Reversal", "Status", "Date"].map((h) => (
                        <th key={h} className="text-left p-3 font-semibold text-text-faint">{h}</th>
                      ))}
                    </tr>
                  </thead>
                  <tbody>
                    {settlements.slice(0, 10).map((s) => {
                      const route = buildRouteLabel(s);
                      return (
                      <tr key={s.id} className="border-b border-border/50 last:border-0 align-top">
                        <td className="p-3 text-text font-medium">
                          <div>#{s.order_id}</div>
                          <div className="mt-1 text-[11px] text-text-muted">{paymentMethodLabel(s.payment_method)}</div>
                        </td>
                        <td className="p-3 text-text">
                          <div>{route.route}</div>
                          {route.destination && <div className="mt-1 text-[11px] text-text-muted">{route.destination}</div>}
                          {s.partner_code && <div className="mt-1 text-[11px] text-text-faint">Code {s.partner_code}</div>}
                        </td>
                        <td className="p-3 text-text">
                          <div className="font-semibold">Gross {fmtCurrency(s.gross_amount, s.currency || summary.currency)}</div>
                          <div className="mt-1 text-[11px] text-warning">
                            Commission {fmtCurrency(s.commission_deducted, s.currency || summary.currency)}
                            {s.commission_rate ? <span className="ml-1 opacity-60">({(s.commission_rate * 100).toFixed(1)}%)</span> : null}
                          </div>
                          <div className="mt-1 text-[11px] text-text-muted">VAT {fmtCurrency(s.vat_amount || 0, s.currency || summary.currency)}</div>
                        </td>
                        <td className="p-3 text-text">
                          <div className="font-semibold">{fmtCurrency(s.net_amount, s.currency || summary.currency)}</div>
                          {s.refund_status && (
                            <div className="mt-1 text-[11px] text-danger">Reversal {fmtCurrency(s.supplier_reversal_amount || 0, s.currency || summary.currency)}</div>
                          )}
                          {s.customer_refund_amount ? (
                            <div className="mt-1 text-[11px] text-text-muted">Customer refund {fmtCurrency(s.customer_refund_amount, s.currency || summary.currency)}</div>
                          ) : null}
                        </td>
                        <td className="p-3">
                          <div className="flex flex-col gap-1">
                            <span className={`inline-block w-fit rounded-lg px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold ${chipClass(s.status)}`}>{s.status}</span>
                            {s.refund_status && (
                              <span className={`inline-block w-fit rounded-lg px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold ${chipClass(s.refund_status)}`}>refund {s.refund_status}</span>
                            )}
                          </div>
                        </td>
                        <td className="p-3 text-text-muted">
                          <div>{new Date(s.created_at).toLocaleDateString()}</div>
                          {s.settled_at && <div className="mt-1 text-[11px] text-success">Settled {new Date(s.settled_at).toLocaleDateString()}</div>}
                        </td>
                      </tr>
                    )})}
                  </tbody>
                </table>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
        </motion.div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```text
﻿"use client";

import { Fragment, Suspense, useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { useRouter, useSearchParams } from "next/navigation";
import { AlertCircle, CheckCircle, Clock, FileText, RefreshCw, Search, Send, Truck } from "@/lib/icons";
import SupplierLayout from "@/components/SupplierLayout";
import { apiFetch } from "@/lib/api";
import { Payout } from "@/lib/types";
import { useToastStore } from "@/lib/toastStore";
import { useCurrencyStore } from "@/lib/currencyStore";
import FinanceSection from "./FinanceSection";
import { dc, useDensity } from "@/lib/densityContext";

type PayoutStatusFilter = "all" | "pending" | "processing" | "completed" | "rejected";
type FinanceView = "requests" | "invoices";

interface Invoice {
  id: number;
  invoice_number: string;
  order_id?: number;
  total_amount: number;
  currency: string;
  status: "draft" | "issued" | "in_transit" | "delivered" | "cancelled";
  due_date?: string;
  notes?: string;
  created_at: string;
}

interface InvoiceListResponse {
  items?: unknown;
  total?: number;
  total_pages?: number;
}

const INVOICE_STATUS_COLORS: Record<string, string> = {
  draft: "theme-chip-muted",
  issued: "theme-chip-info",
  in_transit: "theme-chip-warning",
  delivered: "theme-chip-success",
  cancelled: "theme-chip-danger",
};

const INVOICE_STATUS_ICONS: Record<string, typeof FileText> = {
  draft: FileText,
  issued: CheckCircle,
  in_transit: Truck,
  delivered: CheckCircle,
  cancelled: AlertCircle,
};

const NEXT_INVOICE_STATUS: Record<string, string> = {
  draft: "issued",
  issued: "in_transit",
  in_transit: "delivered",
};

const DEFAULT_INVOICE_FORM = {
  order_id: "",
  shipment_id: "",
  currency: "AED",
  notes: "",
};

function normalizeStatus(value?: string | null) {
  return String(value || "").trim().toLowerCase();
}

function titleCase(value?: string | null) {
  if (!value) return "Unknown";
  return value.replace(/_/g, " ").replace(/\b\w/g, (letter) => letter.toUpperCase());
}

function payoutMethodLabel(method?: string | null) {
  const normalized = normalizeStatus(method);
  if (normalized === "bank") return "Bank Transfer";
  if (!normalized) return "Unspecified";
  return titleCase(normalized);
}

function payoutStatusTone(status?: string | null) {
  const normalized = normalizeStatus(status);
  if (normalized === "completed") return "theme-chip-success";
  if (normalized === "rejected") return "theme-chip-danger";
  if (normalized === "processing") return "theme-chip-info";
  return "theme-chip-warning";
}

function normalizeInvoices(payload: unknown): Invoice[] {
  if (Array.isArray(payload)) {
    return payload as Invoice[];
  }
  if (!payload || typeof payload !== "object") {
    return [];
  }
  const list = payload as InvoiceListResponse;
  return Array.isArray(list.items) ? (list.items as Invoice[]) : [];
}

function toAmount(value: unknown): number {
  if (typeof value === "number" && Number.isFinite(value)) return value;
  if (typeof value === "string") {
    const parsed = Number(value);
    return Number.isFinite(parsed) ? parsed : 0;
  }
  return 0;
}

function SupplierPayoutsPageContent() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const searchParams = useSearchParams();
  const requestedView = searchParams.get("view") === "invoices" ? "invoices" : "requests";
  const { density } = useDensity();
  const cellPad = dc(density, "p-2", "p-3", "p-4");
  const bodyText = dc(density, "text-[11px]", "text-xs", "text-sm");
  const formatMoney = useCurrencyStore((state) => state.format);
  const [payouts, setPayouts] = useState<Payout[]>([]);
  const [invoices, setInvoices] = useState<Invoice[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [reqAmount, setReqAmount] = useState("");
  const [reqNotes, setReqNotes] = useState("");
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [invoiceForm, setInvoiceForm] = useState(DEFAULT_INVOICE_FORM);
  const [invoiceSubmitting, setInvoiceSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [invoiceActionId, setInvoiceActionId] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [refreshing, setRefreshing] = useState(false);
  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState("");
  const [statusFilter, setStatusFilter] = useState<PayoutStatusFilter>("all");
  const [expandedPayoutId, setExpandedPayoutId] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [viewOverride, setViewOverride] = useState<FinanceView | null>(null);
  const addToast = useToastStore((s) => s.addToast);
  const view = viewOverride ?? requestedView;

  useEffect(() => {
    setViewOverride(null);
  }, [requestedView]);

  const loadWorkspace = async ({ silent = false }: { silent?: boolean } = {}) => {
    if (silent) {
      setRefreshing(true);
    } else {
      setLoading(true);
    }

    return Promise.all([
      apiFetch("/supplier/payouts").catch(() => null),
      apiFetch("/invoices/?page=1&page_size=10").catch(() => null),
    ])
      .then(async ([payoutRes, invoiceRes]) => {
        if (payoutRes?.ok) {
          const payoutData = await payoutRes.json().catch(() => []);
          setPayouts(Array.isArray(payoutData) ? payoutData : []);
        } else {
          setPayouts([]);
        }

        if (invoiceRes?.ok) {
          const invoiceData = await invoiceRes.json().catch(() => []);
          setInvoices(normalizeInvoices(invoiceData));
        } else {
          setInvoices([]);
        }
      })
      .catch(() => undefined)
      .finally(() => {
        setLoading(false);
        setRefreshing(false);
      });
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    void loadWorkspace();
  }, []);

  const totalEarned = payouts
    .filter((p) => p.status === "completed")
    .reduce((s, p) => s + p.amount, 0);
  const pending = payouts
    .filter((p) => p.status === "pending")
    .reduce((s, p) => s + p.amount, 0);

  const processingCount = payouts.filter((p) => normalizeStatus(p.status) === "processing").length;
  const completedCount = payouts.filter((p) => normalizeStatus(p.status) === "completed").length;
  const rejectedCount = payouts.filter((p) => normalizeStatus(p.status) === "rejected").length;
  const invoiceSummary = useMemo(() => ({
    draft: invoices.filter((invoice) => invoice.status === "draft").length,
    issued: invoices.filter((invoice) => invoice.status === "issued").length,
    transit: invoices.filter((invoice) => invoice.status === "in_transit").length,
    delivered: invoices.filter((invoice) => invoice.status === "delivered").length,
  }), [invoices]);

  const filteredPayouts = useMemo(() => {
    const search = searchTerm.trim().toLowerCase();
    return payouts.filter((payout) => {
      if (statusFilter !== "all" && normalizeStatus(payout.status) !== statusFilter) return false;
      if (!search) return true;
      return [
        String(payout.id),
        String(payout.reference || ""),
        String(payout.notes || ""),
        String(payout.method || ""),
        String(payout.status || ""),
      ].some((value) => value.toLowerCase().includes(search));
    });
  }, [payouts, searchTerm, statusFilter]);

  const sortedInvoices = useMemo(
    () => [...invoices].sort((a, b) => new Date(b.created_at).getTime() - new Date(a.created_at).getTime()),
    [invoices]
  );

  const setWorkspaceView = (nextView: FinanceView) => {
    setViewOverride(nextView);
    router.replace(nextView === "invoices" ? "/supplier/payouts?view=invoices" : "/supplier/payouts");
  };

  const handleRequest = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!reqAmount || parseFloat(reqAmount) <= 0) {
      addToast("Enter a valid amount", "error");
      return;
    }
    setSubmitting(true);
    try {
      const res = await apiFetch("/supplier/payouts/request", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ amount: parseFloat(reqAmount), method: "bank", notes: reqNotes.trim() || undefined }),
      });
      if (res.ok) {
        const data = await res.json();
        setPayouts((prev) => [
          data,
          ...prev,
        ]);
        setReqAmount("");
        setReqNotes("");
        setExpandedPayoutId(data.id ?? null);
        addToast("Payout request submitted!", "success");
        void loadWorkspace({ silent: true });
      } else {
        const err = await res.json();
        addToast(err.detail || "Request failed", "error");
      }
    } catch {
      addToast("Network error", "error");
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  const handleCreateInvoice = async (event: React.FormEvent) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    const parsedOrderId = Number.parseInt(invoiceForm.order_id.trim(), 10);
    if (!Number.isInteger(parsedOrderId) || parsedOrderId <= 0) {
      addToast("Enter a valid order ID to create an invoice", "error");
      return;
    }

    setInvoiceSubmitting(true);
    try {
      const body: Record<string, unknown> = {
        order_id: parsedOrderId,
        currency: invoiceForm.currency,
      };
      if (invoiceForm.shipment_id.trim()) {
        const parsedShipmentId = Number.parseInt(invoiceForm.shipment_id.trim(), 10);
        if (Number.isInteger(parsedShipmentId) && parsedShipmentId > 0) {
          body.shipment_id = parsedShipmentId;
        }
      }
      if (invoiceForm.notes.trim()) {
        body.notes = invoiceForm.notes.trim();
      }

      const response = await apiFetch("/invoices/", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify(body),
      });
      const payload = await response.json().catch(() => ({}));
      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error(payload.detail || "Failed to create invoice");
      }
      setInvoiceForm(DEFAULT_INVOICE_FORM);
      addToast("Invoice record created", "success");
      await loadWorkspace({ silent: true });
    } catch (error) {
      addToast(error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Failed to create invoice", "error");
    } finally {
      setInvoiceSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  const handleAdvanceInvoiceStatus = async (invoiceId: number, nextStatus: string) => {
    setInvoiceActionId(invoiceId);
    try {
      const response = await apiFetch(`/invoices/${invoiceId}/status`, {
        method: "PUT",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ status: nextStatus }),
      });
      if (!response.ok) {
        const payload = await response.json().catch(() => ({}));
        throw new Error(payload.detail || "Failed to update invoice status");
      }
      addToast("Invoice status updated", "success");
      await loadWorkspace({ silent: true });
    } catch (error) {
      addToast(error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Failed to update invoice status", "error");
    } finally {
      setInvoiceActionId(null);
    }
  };

  return (
    <SupplierLayout title="Payouts">
      <FinanceSection />

      <div className="mt-6 rounded-2xl border border-border bg-surface-1 p-5">
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-4">
          <div>
            <p className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.18em] text-text-faint">Supplier finance flow</p>
            <h1 className="mt-2 text-2xl font-bold text-text">Orders, settlements, payout requests, and invoice records now sit in one finance workspace</h1>
            <p className="mt-2 max-w-3xl text-sm text-text-muted">Use the bank account block above for transfer setup. This page now keeps payout statuses, invoice documents, and finance follow-up together so suppliers do not need a separate invoice destination.</p>
          </div>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => void loadWorkspace({ silent: true })}
            className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface-2 px-3 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-text-muted transition-colors hover:text-text"
          >
            <RefreshCw className={`h-4 w-4 ${refreshing ? "animate-spin" : ""}`} /> Refresh finance
          </button>
        </div>

        <div className="mt-5 grid gap-3 md:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-4">
          <div className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface-2 px-4 py-3">
            <p className="text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.18em] text-text-faint">Pending requests</p>
            <p className="mt-2 text-xl font-bold text-warning">{formatMoney(pending)}</p>
            <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-text-muted">Waiting for finance approval</p>
          </div>
          <div className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface-2 px-4 py-3">
            <p className="text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.18em] text-text-faint">Processing</p>
            <p className="mt-2 text-xl font-bold text-info">{processingCount}</p>
            <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-text-muted">Bank transfer being prepared</p>
          </div>
          <div className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface-2 px-4 py-3">
            <p className="text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.18em] text-text-faint">Paid out</p>
            <p className="mt-2 text-xl font-bold text-success">{completedCount}</p>
            <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-text-muted">Completed transfer requests</p>
          </div>
          <div className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface-2 px-4 py-3">
            <p className="text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.18em] text-text-faint">Rejected</p>

        </div>

        <div className="mt-4 rounded-xl border border-info/25 bg-info/5 px-4 py-3 text-sm text-info">
          {"Order delivered -> settlement enters finance review -> payout request is approved -> transfer is sent to your saved bank account. Invoice records are tracked in the same workspace for audit follow-up."}
        </div>

      <div className="mt-4 flex gap-2 rounded-2xl border border-border bg-surface-2 p-1">

          >

      {view === "requests" ? (
      <div className="mt-6 grid gap-4 xl:grid-cols-[340px,1fr]">

              </h3>

            </div>
              <button

              onClick={() => void loadWorkspace({ silent: true })}
                className="inline-flex w-full items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface-2 px-3 py-2 text-[11px] font-semibold text-text-muted hover:text-text sm:w-auto"
            >

            <div className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface-2 px-3 py-2">
              <p className="text-text-faint">Pending</p>
              <p className="mt-1 font-bold text-warning">{formatMoney(pending)}</p>
            </div>
            <div className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface-2 px-3 py-2">
              <p className="text-text-faint">Processing</p>
              <p className="mt-1 font-bold text-info">{processingCount}</p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="mt-4 rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface-2 p-3 text-[11px] text-text-muted">
            Bank configuration is handled in the finance summary above. Update it there before sending a new request.

          <form onSubmit={handleRequest} className="mt-4 space-y-3">

              />

              <textarea
                rows={3}

              />
            </div>

              <div className="flex w-full flex-col gap-2 sm:w-auto sm:flex-row sm:flex-wrap">

                  />
                </label>

                >
                  <option value="all">All statuses</option>
                  <option value="pending">Pending</option>
                  <option value="processing">Processing</option>
                  <option value="completed">Completed</option>
                  <option value="rejected">Rejected</option>
                </select>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          {loading ? (

              {Array.from({ length: 4 }).map((_, i) => (
                <div key={i} className="h-14 rounded-xl bg-surface-2 animate-pulse" />
              ))}

                      return (
                        <tr key={invoice.id} className="border-b border-border/50 align-top last:border-0">
                          <td className={`${cellPad} ${bodyText} text-text`}>
                            <div className="font-semibold">{invoice.invoice_number}</div>
                            <div className="mt-1 text-[10px] text-text-faint">Created {new Date(invoice.created_at).toLocaleDateString()}</div>
                          </td>
                          <td className={`${cellPad} ${bodyText} text-text-muted`}>{invoice.order_id ? `#${invoice.order_id}` : "-"}</td>
                          <td className={`${cellPad} ${bodyText} font-semibold text-text`}>{invoice.currency} {toAmount(invoice.total_amount).toFixed(2)}</td>
                          <td className={cellPad}>
                            <span className={`inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-lg px-2.5 py-1 text-[11px] font-semibold ${INVOICE_STATUS_COLORS[invoice.status] || "theme-chip-muted"}`}>
                              <StatusIcon className="h-3.5 w-3.5" /> {invoice.status.replaceAll("_", " ")}
                            </span>
                          </td>
                          <td className={`${cellPad} ${bodyText} text-text-muted`}>{invoice.due_date ? new Date(invoice.due_date).toLocaleDateString() : "Pending"}</td>
                          <td className={`${cellPad} ${bodyText}`}>
                            {nextStatus ? (
                              <button
                                type="button"
                                disabled={invoiceActionId === invoice.id}
                                onClick={() => void handleAdvanceInvoiceStatus(invoice.id, nextStatus)}
                                className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-lg border border-border bg-surface-2 px-3 py-1.5 text-[11px] font-semibold text-text-muted hover:text-text disabled:opacity-50"
                              >
                                <Clock className="h-3.5 w-3.5" /> Advance to {nextStatus.replaceAll("_", " ")}
                              </button>
                            ) : (
                              <span className="text-text-faint">-</span>
                            )}
                          </td>
                        </tr>
                      );
                    })}
                  </tbody>
                </table>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </SupplierLayout>
  );
}

export default function SupplierPayoutsPage() {
  return (
    <Suspense fallback={<div className="min-h-screen" />}>
      <SupplierPayoutsPageContent />
    </Suspense>
  );
}
```

```text
interface SupplierAuditAttentionGroup {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  status: "OK" | "WARN" | "FAIL";
  warnings: string[];
}

interface SupplierAuditSummary {
  attentionCount: number;
  warningCount: number;
  curatedGroupCount: number;
  attentionGroups: SupplierAuditAttentionGroup[];
}

function parseFlexibleList(value: unknown): string[] {
  if (Array.isArray(value)) {
    return value
      .map((entry) => String(entry || "").trim())
      .filter(Boolean);
  }
  if (typeof value !== "string") {
    return [];
  }
  const trimmed = value.trim();
  if (!trimmed) {
    return [];
  }
  try {
    const parsed = JSON.parse(trimmed);
    if (Array.isArray(parsed)) {
      return parsed
        .map((entry) => String(entry || "").trim())
        .filter(Boolean);
    }
  } catch {
    // Fall through to comma/newline parsing.
  }
  return trimmed
    .split(/[\n,]/)
    .map((entry) => entry.trim())
    .filter(Boolean);
}

function joinList(value: unknown, separator = ", "): string {
  return parseFlexibleList(value).join(separator);
}

const formatApiError = (data: any): string | null => {
  if (!data) return null;
  if (typeof data === "string") return data;
  if (Array.isArray(data)) return data.map((e: any) => (typeof e === "string" ? e : JSON.stringify(e))).join("; ");
  if (typeof data === "object") {
    if (typeof data.detail === "string") return data.detail;
    if (Array.isArray(data.detail)) return data.detail.map((e: any) => (typeof e === "string" ? e : JSON.stringify(e))).join("; ");
    if (data.message) return data.message;
    return JSON.stringify(data);
  }
  return String(data);
};

// ── Return Window Editor ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function ReturnWindowEditor({ productId, initialDays }: { productId: number; initialDays: number }) {
  const addToast = useToastStore((s) => s.addToast);
  const [days, setDays] = useState(String(initialDays));
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);

  const handleSave = async () => {
    const d = parseInt(days, 10);
    if (isNaN(d) || d < 10) {
      addToast("Minimum return window is 10 days", "error");
      return;
    }
    setSaving(true);
    try {
      const res = await apiFetch(`/supplier/products/${productId}/return-window`, {
        method: "PATCH",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ days: d }),
      });
      if (res.ok) {
        addToast("Return window updated", "success");
      } else {
        const err = await res.json().catch(() => null);
        addToast(formatApiError(err) || "Failed to update return window", "error");
      }
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="mt-4 pt-4 border-t border-border">
      <label className="block text-[11px] text-text-muted mb-1">
        Return Window (days) — minimum 10
      </label>
      <div className="flex gap-2">
        <input
          type="number"
          min="10"
          max="365"
          value={days}
          onChange={(e) => setDays(e.target.value)}
          className="flex-1 theme-input rounded-xl border px-3 py-2 text-xs focus:border-primary focus:outline-none transition-colors"
        />
        <button
          onClick={handleSave}
          disabled={saving}
          className="rounded-xl theme-btn-primary px-3 py-2 text-xs font-bold disabled:opacity-50 flex items-center gap-1"
        >
          {saving ? <div className="btn-spinner" style={{ width: '0.75rem', height: '0.75rem' }} /> : <Save className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />}
          Set
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```
