```text
                    <Image src={resolveImage(product.image_url) || ""} alt={product.name} fill sizes="280px" className="object-cover" />
                  </div>
                ) : (
                  <div className="flex aspect-square items-center justify-center text-xs text-text-faint">No primary image</div>
                )}
              </div>
              <div className="mt-3 space-y-2 text-xs text-text-muted">
                <p><span className="font-semibold text-text">Gallery assets:</span> {galleryMedia.length}</p>
                <p><span className="font-semibold text-text">Video:</span> {product.video_url ? "Linked" : "Not linked"}</p>
                <p><span className="font-semibold text-text">Variants:</span> {variantSummary.length}</p>
              </div>
              {galleryMedia.length > 0 ? (
                <div className="mt-3 flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                  {galleryMedia.slice(0, 4).map((mediaUrl) => (
                    <a key={mediaUrl} href={mediaUrl} target="_blank" rel="noreferrer" className="rounded-full border border-border px-2.5 py-1 text-[11px] font-medium text-text-muted hover:text-text">
                      Gallery asset
                    </a>
                  ))}
                </div>
              ) : null}
              <p className="mt-3 text-[11px] text-text-faint">To replace the primary image or upload more gallery files, keep using the product upload flow. This editor focuses on the saved catalog data.</p>
            </div>

            <form onSubmit={handleSave} className="space-y-4">
              <div className="grid gap-4 lg:grid-cols-2">
                <section className="rounded-2xl border border-border bg-surface-2/60 p-4">
                  <p className="text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.16em] text-text-faint">Core details</p>
                  <div className="mt-3 grid gap-3">
                    {([
                      ["name", "Product name", "text"],
                      ["brand", "Brand", "text"],
                      ["category", "Category", "text"],
                      ["subcategory", "Subcategory", "text"],
                    ] as const).map(([key, label, type]) => (
                      <div key={key}>
                        <label className="mb-1 block text-[11px] text-text-muted">{label}</label>
                        <input
                          type={type}
                          value={form[key]}
                          onChange={(event) => setForm((current) => ({ ...current, [key]: event.target.value }))}
                          className="theme-input w-full rounded-xl border px-3 py-2 text-xs focus:border-primary focus:outline-none transition-colors"
                        />
                      </div>
                    ))}
                    <div>
                      <label className="mb-1 block text-[11px] text-text-muted">Description</label>
                      <textarea
                        value={form.description}
                        onChange={(event) => setForm((current) => ({ ...current, description: event.target.value }))}
                        rows={5}
                        className="theme-input w-full resize-none rounded-xl border px-3 py-2 text-xs focus:border-primary focus:outline-none transition-colors"
                      />
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </section>

                <section className="rounded-2xl border border-border bg-surface-2/60 p-4">
                  <p className="text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.16em] text-text-faint">Pricing and availability</p>
                  <div className="mt-3 grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2">
                    {([
                      ["price", `Price (${currency.code})`, "number"],
                      ["compare_price", `Compare price (${currency.code})`, "number"],
                      ["stock", "Stock quantity", "number"],
                      ["return_window_days", "Return window (days)", "number"],
                      ["discount_starts_at", "Discount starts", "datetime-local"],
                      ["discount_ends_at", "Discount ends", "datetime-local"],
                      ["weight", "Weight (kg)", "number"],
                      ["dimensions", "Dimensions", "text"],
                    ] as const).map(([key, label, type]) => (
                      <div key={key} className={key === "dimensions" ? "sm:col-span-2" : ""}>
                        <label className="mb-1 block text-[11px] text-text-muted">{label}</label>
                        <input
                          type={type}
                          value={form[key]}
                          onChange={(event) => {
                            const value = event.target.value;
                            if (key === "compare_price") {
                              const cp = parseFloat(value);
                              const pr = parseFloat(form.price);
                              const pct = !isNaN(cp) && !isNaN(pr) && cp > pr && cp > 0
                                ? String(Math.round(((cp - pr) / cp) * 10000) / 100)
                                : "";
                              setForm((current) => ({ ...current, compare_price: value, discount_percentage: pct }));
                              return;
                            }
                            if (key === "price") {
                              const pr = parseFloat(value);
                              const cp = parseFloat(form.compare_price);
                              const pct = !isNaN(cp) && !isNaN(pr) && cp > pr && cp > 0
                                ? String(Math.round(((cp - pr) / cp) * 10000) / 100)
                                : "";
                              setForm((current) => ({ ...current, price: value, discount_percentage: pct }));
                              return;
                            }
                            setForm((current) => ({ ...current, [key]: value }));
                          }}
                          step={type === "number" ? "any" : undefined}
                          min={type === "number" ? "0" : undefined}
                          className="theme-input w-full rounded-xl border px-3 py-2 text-xs focus:border-primary focus:outline-none transition-colors"
                        />
                      </div>
                    ))}
                    <div className="sm:col-span-2">
                      <label className="mb-1 block text-[11px] text-text-muted">Discount percentage</label>
                      <input
                        type="number"
                        step="0.01"
                        min="0"
                        max="99"
                        value={form.discount_percentage}
                        placeholder="Auto-calculates compare price"
                        onChange={(event) => {
                          const pct = parseFloat(event.target.value);
                          const pr = parseFloat(form.price);
                          const cp = !isNaN(pct) && !isNaN(pr) && pct > 0 && pct < 100
                            ? String(Math.round((pr / (1 - pct / 100)) * 100) / 100)
                            : "";
                          setForm((current) => ({ ...current, discount_percentage: event.target.value, compare_price: cp }));
                        }}
                        className="theme-input w-full rounded-xl border px-3 py-2 text-xs focus:border-primary focus:outline-none transition-colors"
                      />
                    </div>
                    <label className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface-base px-3 py-2 text-[11px] text-text-muted sm:col-span-2">
                      <input
                        type="checkbox"
                        checked={form.is_new}
                        onChange={(event) => setForm((current) => ({ ...current, is_new: event.target.checked }))}
                        className="h-3.5 w-3.5 rounded accent-primary"
                      />
                      Mark product with the NEW badge
                    </label>
                  </div>
                </section>

                <section className="rounded-2xl border border-border bg-surface-2/60 p-4">
                  <p className="text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.16em] text-text-faint">Catalog attributes</p>
                  <div className="mt-3 grid gap-3">
                    <div>
                      <label className="mb-1 block text-[11px] text-text-muted">Color</label>
                      <ColorPickerField inputId={`product-color-${product.id}`} value={form.color} onChange={(value) => setForm((current) => ({ ...current, color: value }))} />
                    </div>
                    <div>
                      <label className="mb-1 block text-[11px] text-text-muted">Tags</label>
                      <textarea
                        value={form.tags}
                        onChange={(event) => setForm((current) => ({ ...current, tags: event.target.value }))}
                        rows={3}
                        placeholder="Comma-separated tags"
                        className="theme-input w-full resize-none rounded-xl border px-3 py-2 text-xs focus:border-primary focus:outline-none transition-colors"
                      />
                    </div>
                    <div>
                      <label className="mb-1 block text-[11px] text-text-muted">Sizes</label>
                      <input
                        value={form.sizes}
                        onChange={(event) => setForm((current) => ({ ...current, sizes: event.target.value }))}
                        placeholder="S, M, L or custom sizes"
                        className="theme-input w-full rounded-xl border px-3 py-2 text-xs focus:border-primary focus:outline-none transition-colors"
                      />
                    </div>
                    <div>
                      <label className="mb-1 block text-[11px] text-text-muted">Materials</label>
                      <input
                        value={form.materials}
                        onChange={(event) => setForm((current) => ({ ...current, materials: event.target.value }))}
                        placeholder="Cotton, leather, steel"
                        className="theme-input w-full rounded-xl border px-3 py-2 text-xs focus:border-primary focus:outline-none transition-colors"
                      />
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </section>

                <section className="rounded-2xl border border-border bg-surface-2/60 p-4">
                  <p className="text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.16em] text-text-faint">Visibility and fulfillment</p>
                  <div className="mt-3 grid gap-3">
                    <div>
                      <label className="mb-1 block text-[11px] text-text-muted">Visibility regions</label>
                      <textarea
                        value={form.visibility_regions}
                        onChange={(event) => setForm((current) => ({ ...current, visibility_regions: event.target.value }))}
                        rows={3}
                        placeholder="OM, AE, SA"
                        className="theme-input w-full resize-none rounded-xl border px-3 py-2 text-xs focus:border-primary focus:outline-none transition-colors"
                      />
                    </div>
                    <div>
                      <label className="mb-1 block text-[11px] text-text-muted">Video URL</label>
                      <input
                        value={form.video_url}
                        onChange={(event) => setForm((current) => ({ ...current, video_url: event.target.value }))}
                        placeholder="https://... or /uploads/file.mp4"
                        className="theme-input w-full rounded-xl border px-3 py-2 text-xs focus:border-primary focus:outline-none transition-colors"
                      />
                    </div>
                    <div className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface-base p-3">
                      <p className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-text">Variant summary</p>
                      {variantSummary.length > 0 ? (
                        <div className="mt-2 space-y-2 text-xs text-text-muted">
                          {variantSummary.slice(0, 4).map((variant) => (
                            <div key={variant.id} className="rounded-lg border border-border px-3 py-2">
                              <p className="font-semibold text-text">{variant.title || [variant.color, variant.size].filter(Boolean).join(" / ") || `Variant ${variant.id}`}</p>
                              <p className="mt-1">SKU {variant.sku || "-"} · Stock {variant.stock}</p>
                            </div>
                          ))}
                          {variantSummary.length > 4 ? <p className="text-text-faint">+ {variantSummary.length - 4} more variants already attached to this product.</p> : null}
                        </div>
                      ) : (
                        <p className="mt-2 text-xs text-text-muted">No variants attached to this product yet.</p>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </section>
              </div>

              <div className="flex gap-3 border-t border-border pt-4">
                <button type="button" onClick={onClose} className="flex-1 rounded-xl border border-border py-2.5 text-xs font-bold text-text transition-colors hover:border-primary/40">
                  Cancel
                </button>
                <button type="submit" disabled={saving} className="theme-btn-primary flex-1 rounded-xl py-2.5 text-xs font-bold disabled:opacity-50 flex items-center justify-center gap-2">
                  {saving ? <div className="btn-spinner" style={{ width: '0.875rem', height: '0.875rem' }} /> : <Save className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />}
                  {saving ? "Saving…" : "Save Changes"}
                </button>
              </div>
            </form>
          </div>
        </div>
      </motion.div>
    </div>
  );
}

function ProductQrModal({
  product,
  onClose,
}: {
  product: Product;
  onClose: () => void;
}) {
  const addToast = useToastStore((s) => s.addToast);
  const [qrDataUrl, setQrDataUrl] = useState("");
  const qrPayload = useMemo(() => buildSavedProductQrPayload(product), [product]);

  useEffect(() => {
    let active = true;
    QRCode.toDataURL(qrPayload, { width: 220, margin: 1 })
      .then((value) => {
        if (active) setQrDataUrl(value);
      })
      .catch(() => {
        if (active) setQrDataUrl("");
      });
    return () => {
      active = false;
    };
  }, [qrPayload]);

  const handleDownload = () => {
    if (!qrDataUrl) return;
    const anchor = document.createElement("a");
    anchor.href = qrDataUrl;
    anchor.download = `${product.name.replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/gi, "-").toLowerCase() || `product-${product.id}`}-qr.png`;
    anchor.click();
  };

  const handlePrint = () => {
    if (!qrDataUrl) return;
    const popup = window.open("", "_blank", "noopener,noreferrer,width=520,height=720");
    if (!popup) {
      addToast("Allow pop-ups to print the QR label", "error");
      return;
    }
    popup.document.write(`<!doctype html><html><head><title>${product.name} QR Label</title><style>body{font-family:Arial,sans-serif;padding:24px;color:#111}img{width:240px;height:240px;display:block;margin:0 auto 16px}h1{font-size:18px;margin:0 0 8px}p{font-size:12px;margin:4px 0}pre{white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-word;background:#f6f7f9;border:1px solid #d9dde3;border-radius:12px;padding:12px;font-size:11px}</style></head><body><img src="${qrDataUrl}" alt="QR bundle for ${product.name}" /><h1>${product.name}</h1><p>Category: ${product.category || "General"}</p><p>Price: ${String(product.price ?? "")}</p><p>Stock: ${String(product.stock ?? "")}</p><pre>${qrPayload}</pre></body></html>`);
    popup.document.close();
    popup.focus();
    popup.print();
  };

  const variantCount = product.variants?.length ?? 0;

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4">
      <div className="absolute inset-0 theme-overlay" onClick={onClose} />
      <motion.div
        initial={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.95 }}
        animate={{ opacity: 1, scale: 1 }}
        exit={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.95 }}
        className="relative z-10 w-full max-w-lg rounded-2xl theme-card border p-5 shadow-2xl"
      >
        <div className="mb-4 flex items-start justify-between gap-4">
          <div>
            <p className="text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.16em] text-text-faint">Reusable QR Bundle</p>
            <h2 className="mt-1 text-sm font-bold text-text">{product.name}</h2>
            <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-text-muted">This uses the same supplier QR payload as Product Upload and can be downloaded or printed as a warehouse label.</p>
          </div>
          <button onClick={onClose} className="rounded-lg p-1.5 text-text-faint transition-colors hover:bg-surface-2 hover:text-text">
            <X className="h-4 w-4" />
          </button>
        </div>

        <div className="grid gap-4 md:grid-cols-[220px_minmax(0,1fr)]">
          <div className="rounded-2xl border border-border bg-surface-2/70 p-3 text-center">
            {qrDataUrl ? (
              <img src={qrDataUrl} alt={`QR bundle for ${product.name}`} className="mx-auto h-55 w-55 rounded-xl border border-border bg-white p-2" />
            ) : (
              <div className="flex h-55 items-center justify-center rounded-xl border border-dashed border-border bg-surface-base text-xs text-text-faint">
                Generating QR preview...
              </div>
            )}
          </div>

          <div className="space-y-3">
            <div className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface-2/60 p-3">
              <p className="text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.16em] text-text-faint">Bundle Summary</p>
              <div className="mt-2 space-y-1.5 text-xs text-text-muted">
                <p><span className="font-semibold text-text">Product ID:</span> {product.id}</p>
                <p><span className="font-semibold text-text">Category:</span> {product.category || "General"}</p>
                <p><span className="font-semibold text-text">Variants:</span> {variantCount}</p>
                <p><span className="font-semibold text-text">Stock:</span> {product.stock ?? 0}</p>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface-2/60 p-3">
              <p className="text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.16em] text-text-faint">Payload Preview</p>
              <pre className="mt-2 max-h-48 overflow-auto whitespace-pre-wrap break-all rounded-xl bg-surface-base p-3 text-[11px] text-text-muted">{qrPayload}</pre>
            </div>

            <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
              <button onClick={handleDownload} disabled={!qrDataUrl} className="rounded-xl theme-btn-primary px-3 py-2 text-xs font-semibold disabled:opacity-40">
                <Download className="mr-1 inline h-3.5 w-3.5" />Download QR
              </button>
              <button onClick={handlePrint} disabled={!qrDataUrl} className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface-1 px-3 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-text transition-colors hover:border-primary/30 hover:text-primary disabled:opacity-40">
                <Printer className="mr-1 inline h-3.5 w-3.5" />Print Label
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </motion.div>
    </div>
  );
}

export default function SupplierProductsPage() {
  const { density } = useDensity();
  const { isLoading: authLoading, isLoggedIn } = useAuth();
  const router = useRouter();
  const [products, setProducts] = useState<Product[]>([]);
  const [search, setSearch] = useState("");
  const [stockFilter, setStockFilter] = useState<"all" | "in_stock" | "low_stock" | "out_of_stock">("all");
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [editProduct, setEditProduct] = useState<Product | null>(null);
  const [qrProduct, setQrProduct] = useState<Product | null>(null);
  const [editStockId, setEditStockId] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [editStockValue, setEditStockValue] = useState("0");
  const [, setToggleLoading] = useState<Record<number, boolean>>({});
  const [, setToggleError] = useState<Record<number, string>>({});
  const [selectedProductIds, setSelectedProductIds] = useState<Set<number>>(new Set());
  const [bulkLoading, setBulkLoading] = useState(false);
  const [aiAudit, setAiAudit] = useState<SupplierAuditSummary | null>(null);
  const addToast = useToastStore((s) => s.addToast);
  const formatPrice = useCurrencyStore((state) => state.format);

  const loadAiAudit = () => {
    apiFetch("/supplier/reports?period=30d")
      .then((r) => (r.ok ? r.json() : null))
      .then((data) => setAiAudit(data?.aiAudit ?? null))
      .catch(() => setAiAudit(null));
  };

  const getStockStatus = (stock: number) => {
    if (stock === 0) return "out_of_stock" as const;
    if (stock < 10) return "low_stock" as const;
    return "in_stock" as const;
  };

  const fetchProducts = () => {
    setLoading(true);
    apiFetch("/supplier/products")
      .then((r) => (r.ok ? r.json() : { data: [] }))
      .then((data) => {
        setProducts(normalizeListPage<Product>(data).data);
        setLoading(false);
      })
      .catch(() => setLoading(false));
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (authLoading) {
      return;
    }
    if (!isLoggedIn) {
      setProducts([]);
      setLoading(false);
      router.replace("/supplier/login");
      return;
    }
    fetchProducts();
    loadAiAudit();
  }, [authLoading, isLoggedIn]);

  const toggleActive = async (id: number, current: boolean) => {
    setToggleLoading((prev) => ({ ...prev, [id]: true }));
    setToggleError((prev) => ({ ...prev, [id]: "" }));

    try {
      const res = await apiFetch(`/supplier/products/${id}`, {
        method: "PUT",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ is_active: !current }),
      });
      if (res.ok) {
        setProducts((prev) =>
          prev.map((p) => (p.id === id ? { ...p, is_active: !current } : p))
        );
        addToast(`Product ${!current ? "activated" : "deactivated"}`, "success");
      } else {
        const d = await res.json().catch(() => null);
        const message = formatApiError(d) || "Could not update product status.";
        setToggleError((prev) => ({ ...prev, [id]: message }));
        addToast(message, "error");
      }
    } catch {
      const message = "Network error updating product status.";
      setToggleError((prev) => ({ ...prev, [id]: message }));
      addToast(message, "error");
    } finally {
      setToggleLoading((prev) => ({ ...prev, [id]: false }));
    }
  };

  const deleteProduct = async (id: number) => {
    if (!confirm("Delete this product?")) return;
    const res = await apiFetch(`/supplier/products/${id}`, {
      method: "DELETE",
    });
    if (res.ok) {
      setProducts((prev) => prev.filter((p) => p.id !== id));
      addToast("Product deleted", "info");
    }
  };

  const saveStock = async (id: number) => {
    const parsedStock = parseInt(editStockValue, 10);
    if (isNaN(parsedStock) || parsedStock < 0) {
      addToast("Stock cannot be negative", "error");
      return;
    }

    const res = await apiFetch(`/supplier/products/${id}`, {
      method: "PUT",
      headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      body: JSON.stringify({ stock_quantity: parsedStock }),
    });

    if (res.ok) {
      setProducts((prev) => prev.map((product) => (product.id === id ? { ...product, stock: parsedStock } : product)));
      addToast("Stock updated", "success");
      setEditStockId(null);
      return;
    }

    const data = await res.json().catch(() => null);
    addToast(formatApiError(data) || "Could not update stock.", "error");
  };

  const filtered = useMemo(() => products.filter((p) =>
    (stockFilter === "all" || getStockStatus(p.stock ?? 0) === stockFilter) &&
    `${p.name} ${p.category ?? ""}`.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase())
  ), [products, search, stockFilter]);

  const active = products.filter((p) => p.is_active).length;
  const attentionGroups = aiAudit?.attentionGroups ?? [];
  const topAttentionGroups = attentionGroups.slice(0, 3);
  const firstAttentionHref = attentionGroups.length > 0 ? `/supplier/reports#ai-audit-${attentionGroups[0].id}` : null;
  const totalStock = products.reduce(
    (s, p) => s + (p.stock ?? 0),
    0
  );
  const lowStock = products.filter((p) => {
    const stock = p.stock ?? 0;
    return stock > 0 && stock < 10;
  }).length;
  const outOfStock = products.filter((p) => (p.stock ?? 0) === 0).length;
  const counts = {
    all: products.length,
    in_stock: products.filter((p) => getStockStatus(p.stock ?? 0) === "in_stock").length,
    low_stock: lowStock,
    out_of_stock: outOfStock,
  };
  const metricPadding = dc(density, "px-2.5 py-1.5", "px-3 py-1.5", "px-4 py-2.5");
  const cellPadding = dc(density, "p-2", "p-3", "p-4");
  const bodyText = dc(density, "text-[11px]", "text-xs", "text-sm");
  const imageFrame = dc(density, "w-9 h-9", "w-10 h-10", "w-12 h-12");
  const mobileCardPadding = dc(density, "p-2.5", "p-3", "p-4");

  const toggleProductSelect = (id: number) => {
    setSelectedProductIds((prev) => {
      const next = new Set(prev);
      if (next.has(id)) next.delete(id); else next.add(id);
      return next;
    });
  };

  const toggleSelectAllVisible = () => {
    const allSelected = filtered.every((p) => selectedProductIds.has(p.id));
    setSelectedProductIds((prev) => {
      const next = new Set(prev);
      if (allSelected) filtered.forEach((p) => next.delete(p.id));
      else filtered.forEach((p) => next.add(p.id));
      return next;
    });
  };

  const bulkSetActive = async (isActive: boolean) => {
    const ids = Array.from(selectedProductIds);
    if (!ids.length) return;
    setBulkLoading(true);
    try {
      const res = await apiFetch("/supplier/products/bulk", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ productIds: ids, type: "status_change", value: isActive ? "active" : "inactive" }),
      });
      if (res.ok) {
        setProducts((prev) => prev.map((p) => ids.includes(p.id) ? { ...p, is_active: isActive } : p));
        setSelectedProductIds(new Set());
        addToast(`${ids.length} products ${isActive ? "activated" : "deactivated"}`, "success");
      } else {
        const d = await res.json().catch(() => null);
        addToast(formatApiError(d) || "Bulk update failed", "error");
      }
    } finally {
      setBulkLoading(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <>
    <SupplierLayout title="Product Management">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="mb-4 flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-3">

            Open Product Upload

          <p className="text-[11px] text-text-faint md:text-right">

          </p>

      <div className="mb-4 rounded-2xl border border-border bg-surface-1 p-3">
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-3 md:flex-row md:items-center md:justify-between">

            <input

            />

          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
            <select
              value={stockFilter}

            >
              <option value="all">All stock states</option>
              <option value="in_stock">In stock</option>
              <option value="low_stock">Low stock</option>
              <option value="out_of_stock">Out of stock</option>

            <span className="rounded-full border border-border px-3 py-1.5 text-[11px] text-text-muted">Low stock {lowStock}</span>
            <span className="rounded-full border border-border px-3 py-1.5 text-[11px] text-text-muted">Out {outOfStock}</span>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {attentionGroups.length > 0 && (
        <div className="mb-4 rounded-xl border border-warning/30 bg-warning/5 p-4">
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-3">

                      >
                      <td className={cellPadding}>
                        <input
                          type="checkbox"
                          aria-label={`Select product ${p.name}`}

                        />
                      </td>
                      <td className={cellPadding}>

                            <div className={`relative ${imageFrame} rounded-lg overflow-hidden bg-surface-2 shrink-0`}>

                                alt=""

                            </div>

                          <div>
                            <p className={`${bodyText} text-text font-medium truncate max-w-45`}>
                              {p.name}
                            </p>

                              {p.category}

                        </div>
                      </td>
                      <td className={`${cellPadding} ${bodyText} text-text font-medium`}>
                          {formatPrice(Number(p.price ?? 0))}
                      </td>
                      <td className={cellPadding}>
                          {editStockId === p.id ? (
                            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                              <input
                                type="number"

                                <Save className="h-4 w-4" />

                            <button
                              onClick={() => {
                                setEditStockId(p.id);
                                setEditStockValue(String(stock));
                              }}

                                stock === 0
                                  ? "text-danger"

                                  ? "text-warning"

                      <td className={`${cellPadding} ${bodyText} text-text-muted`}>
                        {p.sales_count || 0}

                      <td className={cellPadding}>

                            {p.is_active ? "Active" : "Paused"}
                          </span>
                          {!p.is_active && firstAttentionHref && (
                            <Link href={firstAttentionHref} className="text-[10px] font-medium text-warning hover:underline">
                              Review AI warnings

                          )}
                          {!p.is_active && firstAttentionHref && (
                            <Link href={firstAttentionHref} className="text-[10px] font-medium text-warning hover:underline">
                              Review AI warnings

                        <InlineActionButtons

                            { label: `Edit ${p.name}`, icon: <Edit className="w-4 h-4" />, onClick: () => setEditProduct(p), tone: "primary" },
                            { label: `Delete ${p.name}`, icon: <Trash2 className="w-4 h-4" />, onClick: () => deleteProduct(p.id), tone: "danger" },
                          ]}

                      </td>

                  );

            </table>
          </div>

          <div className="lg:hidden p-3 space-y-3">
            {filtered.map((p) => {
              const img = resolveImage(p.image_url);
              const stock = p.stock ?? 0;
              return (
                <motion.div
                  key={p.id}
                  initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 10 }}
                  animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
                  className={`rounded-xl border bg-surface-1 ${mobileCardPadding} transition-colors ${selectedProductIds.has(p.id) ? "border-primary/40 bg-primary/5" : "border-border"}`}
                >
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-2">
                    <input
                      type="checkbox"
                      aria-label={`Select product ${p.name}`}
                      checked={selectedProductIds.has(p.id)}
                      onChange={() => toggleProductSelect(p.id)}
                      className="w-4 h-4 rounded accent-primary"
                    />
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex items-start gap-3">
                    {img && (
                      <div className="relative w-16 h-16 rounded-lg overflow-hidden bg-surface-2 shrink-0">
                        <Image src={img} alt="" fill sizes="64px" className="object-cover" />
                      </div>
                    )}
                    <div className="flex-1">
                      <p className="text-xs font-bold text-text">{p.name}</p>
                      <p className="text-[11px] text-text-faint">{p.category}</p>
                      <p className="text-xs text-text mt-1">{formatPrice(Number(p.price ?? 0))}</p>
                      <p className="text-xs text-text-faint mt-0.5">Stock {stock} • Sales {p.sales_count || 0}</p>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <div className="mt-3 rounded-xl border border-border/70 bg-surface-2/70 p-3">
                    <p className="text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.16em] text-text-faint">Inventory</p>
                    {editStockId === p.id ? (
                      <div className="mt-2 flex items-center gap-2">
                        <input
                          type="number"
                          value={editStockValue}
                          onChange={(e) => setEditStockValue(e.target.value)}
                          min="0"
                          className="w-full rounded-lg border theme-input px-3 py-2 text-xs text-text focus:outline-none"
                        />
                        <button
                          onClick={() => saveStock(p.id)}
                          className="rounded-lg border border-border bg-surface-base p-2 text-text transition-colors hover:border-primary/30 hover:text-primary"
                        >
                          <Save className="h-4 w-4" />
                        </button>
                      </div>
                    ) : (
                      <button
                        onClick={() => {
                          setEditStockId(p.id);
                          setEditStockValue(String(stock));
                        }}
                        className={`mt-2 text-xs font-semibold ${
                          stock === 0
                            ? "text-danger"
                            : stock < 10
                            ? "text-warning"
                            : "text-text"
                        }`}
                      >
                        {stock === 0 ? "Out of stock" : stock < 10 ? `${stock} units left` : `${stock} units in stock`}
                      </button>
                    )}
                  </div>
                  <div className="mt-3 flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
                    <span className={`rounded-full px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-medium ${p.is_active ? "bg-primary/10 text-primary" : "bg-surface-2 text-text-muted"}`}>
                      {p.is_active ? "Active" : "Paused"}
                    </span>
                    <InlineActionButtons
                      actions={[
                        { label: `QR bundle ${p.name}`, icon: <QrCode className="w-4 h-4" />, onClick: () => setQrProduct(p), tone: "default" },
                        { label: `${p.is_active ? "Deactivate" : "Activate"} ${p.name}`, icon: p.is_active ? <ToggleRight className="w-4 h-4" /> : <ToggleLeft className="w-4 h-4" />, onClick: () => toggleActive(p.id, !!p.is_active), tone: p.is_active ? "success" : "warning" },
                        { label: `Edit ${p.name}`, icon: <Edit className="w-4 h-4" />, onClick: () => setEditProduct(p), tone: "primary" },
                        { label: `Delete ${p.name}`, icon: <Trash2 className="w-4 h-4" />, onClick: () => deleteProduct(p.id), tone: "danger" },
                      ]}
                    />
                  </div>
                </motion.div>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        </>
        )}
      </div>
    </SupplierLayout>
    <BulkActionBar
      selectedCount={selectedProductIds.size}
      onClearSelection={() => setSelectedProductIds(new Set())}
      actions={[
        { label: "Activate Selected", onClick: () => bulkSetActive(true), loading: bulkLoading, variant: "success" },
        { label: "Deactivate Selected", onClick: () => bulkSetActive(false), loading: bulkLoading, variant: "warning" },
      ]}
    >
      {firstAttentionHref ? (
        <Link href={firstAttentionHref} className="rounded-xl border border-warning/35 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-warning transition-colors hover:bg-warning/10">
          Review AI warnings
        </Link>
      ) : null}
    </BulkActionBar>
    <AnimatePresence>
      {qrProduct && (
        <ProductQrModal
          product={qrProduct}
          onClose={() => setQrProduct(null)}
        />
      )}
    </AnimatePresence>
    <AnimatePresence>
      {editProduct && (
        <EditProductModal
          product={editProduct}
          onClose={() => setEditProduct(null)}
          onSaved={(updated) =>
            setProducts((prev) =>
              prev.map((p) => (p.id === updated.id ? { ...p, ...updated } : p))
            )
          }
        />
      )}
    </AnimatePresence>
    </>
  );
}
```

```text
"use client";

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { useParams, useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { motion } from 'framer-motion';
import SupplierLayout from '@/components/SupplierLayout';
import ErrorAlert from '@/components/ErrorAlert';
import { API_URL, apiFetch } from '@/lib/api';
import { useRequireSupplier } from '@/lib/useAuth';
import { Product } from '@/lib/types';
import {
  ArrowLeft,
  Package,
  Edit,
  Save,
  X,
  Image as ImageIcon,
  Upload,
  DollarSign,
  Hash,
  Tag,
  FileText,
  TrendingUp,
  ShoppingCart,
  Star,
  BarChart3,
  Trash2,
  Eye,
  EyeOff,
  Calendar,
  AlertTriangle
} from 'lucide-react';

export default function SupplierProductDetail() {
  useRequireSupplier();
  const params = useParams();
  const router = useRouter();
  const productId = params.id as string;

  const [product, setProduct] = useState<Product | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [success, setSuccess] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [editing, setEditing] = useState(false);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [deleting, setDeleting] = useState(false);
  const [imagePreview, setImagePreview] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [selectedImage, setSelectedImage] = useState<File | null>(null);

  const [formData, setFormData] = useState({
    name: '',
    description: '',
    price: '',
    stock_quantity: '',
    category: '',
    is_active: true
  });

  const categories = [
    'Electronics',
    'Clothing',
    'Home & Garden',
    'Sports & Outdoors',
    'Books',
    'Beauty & Personal Care',
    'Toys & Games',
    'Automotive',
    'Health & Household',
    'Industrial & Scientific',
    'Other'
  ];

  async function fetchProduct() {
    try {
      const response = await apiFetch(`/supplier/products/${productId}`);

      if (response.ok) {
        const data = await response.json();
        setProduct(data);
        setFormData({
          name: data.name,
          description: data.description,
          price: data.price.toString(),
          stock_quantity: data.stock_quantity.toString(),
          category: data.category,
          is_active: data.is_active
        });
        setImagePreview(data.image_url ? `${API_URL}/${data.image_url}` : null);
      } else if (response.status === 404) {
        router.push('/supplier/products');
      } else {
        console.error('Failed to fetch product');
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error fetching product:', error);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchProduct();
  }, [productId]);

  const handleInputChange = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement | HTMLTextAreaElement | HTMLSelectElement>) => {
    const { name, value, type } = e.target;
    setFormData(prev => ({
      ...prev,
      [name]: type === 'checkbox' ? (e.target as HTMLInputElement).checked : value
    }));
  };

  const handleImageChange = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
    if (file) {
      setSelectedImage(file);
      const reader = new FileReader();
      reader.onload = (e) => {
        setImagePreview(e.target?.result as string);
      };
      reader.readAsDataURL(file);
    }
  };

  const removeImage = () => {
    setSelectedImage(null);
    setImagePreview(product?.image_url ? `${API_URL}/${product.image_url}` : null);
  };

  const handleSave = async () => {
    setSaving(true);

    try {
      const formDataToSend = new FormData();
      formDataToSend.append('name', formData.name);
      formDataToSend.append('description', formData.description);
      formDataToSend.append('price', formData.price);
      formDataToSend.append('stock_quantity', formData.stock_quantity);
      formDataToSend.append('category', formData.category);
      formDataToSend.append('is_active', formData.is_active.toString());

      if (selectedImage) {
        formDataToSend.append('image', selectedImage);
      }

      const response = await apiFetch(`/supplier/products/${productId}`, {
        method: 'PUT',
        body: formDataToSend,
      });

      if (response.ok) {
        const result = await response.json();
        setProduct(result.product);
        setEditing(false);
        setSelectedImage(null);
      } else {
        const err = await response.json().catch(() => null);
        setError(err?.detail || 'Failed to update product');
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error updating product:', error);
      setError('Failed to update product. Please try again.');
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  };

  const handleDelete = async () => {
    if (!confirm('Are you sure you want to delete this product? This action cannot be undone.')) {
      return;
    }

    setDeleting(true);

    try {
      const response = await apiFetch(`/supplier/products/${productId}`, {
        method: 'DELETE',
      });

      if (response.ok) {
        router.push('/supplier/products');
      } else {
        const err = await response.json().catch(() => null);
        setError(err?.detail || 'Failed to delete product');
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error deleting product:', error);
      setError('Failed to delete product. Please try again.');
    } finally {
      setDeleting(false);
    }
  };

  const cancelEdit = () => {
    const normalizedPrice = Number(product?.price ?? 0);
    const normalizedStock = Number(
      ((product as (Product & { stock_quantity?: number }) | null)?.stock_quantity ?? product?.stock ?? 0)
    );

    setFormData({
      name: product?.name || '',
      description: product?.description || '',
      price: normalizedPrice.toString(),
      stock_quantity: normalizedStock.toString(),
      category: product?.category || '',
      is_active: product?.is_active || true
    });
    setImagePreview(product?.image_url ? `${API_URL}/${product.image_url}` : null);
    setSelectedImage(null);
    setEditing(false);
  };

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <SupplierLayout>
        <div className="min-h-screen bg-linear-to-br from-(--zozi-primary) via-(--background-luxury) to-(--zozi-secondary)">
          {/* header via layout */}
          <div className="flex items-center justify-center min-h-[60vh]">
            <div className="animate-spin rounded-full h-12 w-12 border-b-2 border-(--zozi-primary)"></div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </SupplierLayout>
    );
  }

  if (!product) {
    return (
      <SupplierLayout>
        <div className="min-h-screen bg-linear-to-br from-(--zozi-primary) via-(--background-luxury) to-(--zozi-secondary)">
          {/* header via layout */}
          <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-8">
            <div className="text-center">
              <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-(--zozi-neutral) mb-4">Product Not Found</h1>
              <Link
                href="/supplier/products"
                className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2 bg-(--zozi-primary) text-white rounded-lg hover:bg-(--zozi-secondary) transition-colors"
            >
              <ArrowLeft className="w-4 h-4" />
              Back to Products
            </Link>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </SupplierLayout>
    );
  }

  const productPrice = Number(product.price ?? 0);
  const productStock = Number((product as Product & { stock_quantity?: number }).stock_quantity ?? product.stock ?? 0);

  return (
    <SupplierLayout>
      <div className="min-h-screen bg-linear-to-br from-(--zozi-primary) via-(--background-luxury) to-(--zozi-secondary)">
        {/* header via layout */}

      <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-8">
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-8">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
            {error && (
              <div className="absolute top-0 right-0 mt-4 mr-4 p-2 bg-red-100 text-red-700 rounded">
                {error}
              </div>
            )}
            <Link
              href="/supplier/products"
              className="flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2 bg-white/10 text-(--zozi-neutral) rounded-lg hover:bg-white/20 transition-colors"
            >
              <ArrowLeft className="w-4 h-4" />
              Back to Products
            </Link>
            <div>
              <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold text-(--zozi-neutral)">{editing ? 'Edit Product' : product.name}</h1>
              <p className="text-(--foreground-secondary)">
                {editing ? 'Update your product information' : 'Product details and performance'}
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>

          {!editing && (
            <div className="flex gap-3">
              <button
                onClick={() => setEditing(true)}
                className="flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2 bg-(--zozi-primary) text-white rounded-lg hover:bg-(--zozi-secondary) transition-colors"
              >

                <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row gap-4 justify-end">
                  <button

                    className="px-6 py-3 border border-(--zozi-primary)/20 text-(--zozi-neutral) rounded-lg hover:bg-(--zozi-primary)/5 transition-colors"
                  >
                    Cancel
                  </button>
                  <button
                    onClick={handleSave}
                    disabled={saving}
                    className="px-6 py-3 bg-(--zozi-primary) text-white rounded-lg hover:bg-(--zozi-secondary) transition-colors disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed flex items-center gap-2"
                  >
                    {saving ? (
                      <>
                        <div className="animate-spin rounded-full h-4 w-4 border-b-2 border-white"></div>
                        Saving...
                      </>
                    ) : (
                      <>
                        <Save className="w-4 h-4" />
                        Save Changes
                      </>
                    )}
                  </button>
                </div>
              </motion.div>
            )}
          </div>

          {/* Sidebar */}
          <div className="space-y-6">
            {/* Product Image */}
            <motion.div
              initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }}
              animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
              transition={{ delay: 0.1 }}
              className="bg-white/95 backdrop-blur-xl rounded-2xl p-6 shadow-2xl border border-(--zozi-primary)/20"
            >
              <h2 className="text-xl font-bold text-(--zozi-neutral) mb-6 flex items-center gap-2">
                <ImageIcon className="w-5 h-5 text-(--zozi-primary)" />
                Product Image
              </h2>

              <div className="space-y-4">
                <div className="border-2 border-dashed border-(--zozi-primary)/20 rounded-lg p-4">
                  {imagePreview ? (
                    <div className="relative">
                      <img
                        src={imagePreview}
                        alt={product.name}
                        className="w-full h-48 object-cover rounded-lg"
                      />
                      {editing && (
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onClick={removeImage}
                          className="absolute top-2 right-2 p-1 bg-red-500 text-white rounded-full hover:bg-red-600 transition-colors"
                        >
                          <X className="w-4 h-4" />
                        </button>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  ) : (
                    <div className="text-center py-8">
                      <Package className="w-12 h-12 text-(--zozi-primary)/50 mx-auto mb-4" />
                      <div className="text-sm text-(--foreground-secondary)">No image uploaded</div>
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>

                {editing && (
                  <label className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2 bg-(--zozi-primary) text-white rounded-lg hover:bg-(--zozi-secondary) transition-colors cursor-pointer w-full justify-center">
                    <Upload className="w-4 h-4" />
                    Change Image
                    <input
                      type="file"
                      accept="image/*"
                      onChange={handleImageChange}
                      className="hidden"
                    />
                  </label>
                )}
              </div>
            </motion.div>

            {/* Performance Metrics */}
            <motion.div
              initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }}
              animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
              transition={{ delay: 0.2 }}
              className="bg-white/95 backdrop-blur-xl rounded-2xl p-6 shadow-2xl border border-(--zozi-primary)/20"
            >
              <h2 className="text-xl font-bold text-(--zozi-neutral) mb-6 flex items-center gap-2">
                <BarChart3 className="w-5 h-5 text-(--zozi-primary)" />
                Performance
              </h2>

              <div className="space-y-4">
                <div className="flex justify-between items-center">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <ShoppingCart className="w-4 h-4 text-blue-500" />
                    <span className="text-sm text-(--foreground-secondary)">Total Sales</span>
                  </div>
                  <span className="font-bold text-(--zozi-neutral)">{product.sales_count || 0}</span>
                </div>

                <div className="flex justify-between items-center">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <DollarSign className="w-4 h-4 text-green-500" />
                    <span className="text-sm text-(--foreground-secondary)">Revenue</span>
                  </div>
                  <span className="font-bold text-(--zozi-neutral)">${(product.revenue || 0).toFixed(2)}</span>
                </div>

                <div className="flex justify-between items-center">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <Star className="w-4 h-4 text-yellow-500" />
                    <span className="text-sm text-(--foreground-secondary)">Rating</span>
                  </div>
                  <span className="font-bold text-(--zozi-neutral)">
                    {product.rating ? `${product.rating.toFixed(1)}/5.0` : 'No ratings'}
                  </span>
                </div>

                <div className="pt-4 border-t border-(--zozi-primary)/10">
                  <div className="flex justify-between items-center">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                      <Calendar className="w-4 h-4 text-(--zozi-primary)" />
                      <span className="text-sm text-(--foreground-secondary)">Listed</span>
                    </div>
                    <span className="text-sm text-(--zozi-neutral)">
                      {product.created_at ? new Date(product.created_at).toLocaleDateString() : ''}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            </motion.div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
    </SupplierLayout>
  );
}
```

```text
"use client";

import { useState } from 'react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { motion } from 'framer-motion';
import SupplierLayout from '@/components/SupplierLayout';
import { API_URL, apiFetch } from '@/lib/api';
import ErrorAlert from '@/components/ErrorAlert';
import {
  ArrowLeft,
  Package,
  Upload,
  Save,
  X,
  Image as ImageIcon,
  DollarSign,
  Hash,
  Tag,
  FileText,
  Eye,
  EyeOff
} from 'lucide-react';

export default function AddProduct() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [imagePreview, setImagePreview] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string>("");
  const [formData, setFormData] = useState({
    name: '',
    description: '',
    price: '',
    stock_quantity: '',
    category: '',
    is_active: true
  });
  const [selectedImage, setSelectedImage] = useState<File | null>(null);

  const categories = [
    'Electronics',
    'Clothing',
    'Home & Garden',
    'Sports & Outdoors',
    'Books',
    'Beauty & Personal Care',
    'Toys & Games',
    'Automotive',
    'Health & Household',
    'Industrial & Scientific',
    'Other'
  ];

  const handleInputChange = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement | HTMLTextAreaElement | HTMLSelectElement>) => {
    const { name, value, type } = e.target;
    setFormData(prev => ({
      ...prev,
      [name]: type === 'checkbox' ? (e.target as HTMLInputElement).checked : value
    }));
  };

  const handleImageChange = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
    if (file) {
      setSelectedImage(file);
      const reader = new FileReader();
      reader.onload = (e) => {
        setImagePreview(e.target?.result as string);
      };
      reader.readAsDataURL(file);
    }
  };

  const removeImage = () => {
    setSelectedImage(null);
    setImagePreview(null);
  };

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setError("");

    // additional validation
    if (!formData.name || !formData.description || !formData.price || !formData.stock_quantity || !formData.category) {
      setError("Please fill in all required fields.");
      return;
    }

    const priceNum = parseFloat(formData.price);
    if (isNaN(priceNum) || priceNum <= 0) {
      setError("Price must be a positive number.");
      return;
    }

    setLoading(true);

    try {
      const formDataToSend = new FormData();
      formDataToSend.append('name', formData.name);
      formDataToSend.append('description', formData.description);
      formDataToSend.append('price', formData.price);
      formDataToSend.append('stock_quantity', formData.stock_quantity);
      formDataToSend.append('category', formData.category);
      formDataToSend.append('is_active', formData.is_active.toString());

      if (selectedImage) {
        formDataToSend.append('image', selectedImage);
      }

      const response = await apiFetch('/supplier/products', {
        method: 'POST',
        body: formDataToSend,
      });

      if (response.ok) {
        const result = await response.json();
        router.push('/supplier/products');
      } else {
        const err = await response.json().catch(() => null);
        setError(err?.detail || 'Failed to create product');
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error creating product:', error);
      setError('Failed to create product. Please try again.');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const isFormValid = formData.name && formData.description && formData.price && formData.stock_quantity && formData.category;

  return (
    <SupplierLayout>
      <div className="min-h-screen bg-gradient-to-br from-zozi-primary via-background-luxury to-zozi-secondary">
        {/* header via layout */}

      <div className="max-w-4xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-8">
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-4 mb-8">
          <Link
            href="/supplier/products"
            className="flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2 bg-white/10 text-zozi-neutral rounded-lg hover:bg-white/20 transition-colors"
          >
            <ArrowLeft className="w-4 h-4" />
            Back to Products
          </Link>
          <div>
            <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold text-zozi-neutral">Add New Product</h1>
        {error && <ErrorAlert message={error} />}
            <p className="text-foreground-secondary">Create a new product listing for your store</p>
          </div>
        </div>

        {error && (
          <div className="mb-6 p-4 bg-gradient-to-r from-red-50 to-red-100 border border-red-200/50 rounded-xl shadow-sm">
            <div className="flex items-center">
              <div className="w-8 h-8 bg-red-500/10 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center mr-3">
                <svg className="w-4 h-4 text-red-500" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                  <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={2} d="M12 8v4m0 4h.01M21 12a9 9 0 11-18 0 9 9 0 0118 0z" />
                </svg>
              </div>
              <span className="text-red-700 text-sm font-medium">{error}</span>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
        <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-8">

            <div className="lg:col-span-2 space-y-6">

                  <div>

                    <input
                      type="text"
                      name="name"
                      value={formData.name}
                      onChange={handleInputChange}
                      placeholder="Enter product name"
                      className="w-full px-4 py-3 border border-(--zozi-primary)/20 rounded-lg focus:ring-2 focus:ring-(--zozi-primary) focus:border-transparent"
                      required

                    <div className="flex items-center gap-3 mb-3">
                      <div className="w-12 h-12 bg-gray-200 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center">
                        {imagePreview ? (
                          <img src={imagePreview} alt="Preview" className="w-full h-full object-cover rounded-lg" />
                        ) : (
                          <Package className="w-6 h-6 text-gray-500" />
                        )}
                      </div>
                      <div className="flex-1">
                        <div className="font-medium text-(--zozi-neutral)">
                          {formData.name || 'Product Name'}
                        </div>
                        <div className="text-sm text-(--foreground-secondary)">
                          {formData.category || 'Category'}
                        </div>
                      </div>
                      <div className="text-right">
                        <div className="font-bold text-(--zozi-primary)">
                          ${formData.price || '0.00'}
                        </div>
                        <div className="text-xs text-(--foreground-secondary)">
                          {formData.stock_quantity || '0'} in stock
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </motion.div>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Submit Actions */}
          <motion.div
            initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }}
            animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
            transition={{ delay: 0.4 }}
            className="bg-white/95 backdrop-blur-xl rounded-2xl p-6 shadow-2xl border border-(--zozi-primary)/20"
          >
            <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row gap-4 justify-end">
              <Link
                href="/supplier/products"
                className="px-6 py-3 border border-(--zozi-primary)/20 text-(--zozi-neutral) rounded-lg hover:bg-(--zozi-primary)/5 transition-colors"
              >
                Cancel
              </Link>
              <button
                type="submit"
                disabled={!isFormValid || loading}
                className="px-6 py-3 bg-(--zozi-primary) text-white rounded-lg hover:bg-(--zozi-secondary) transition-colors disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed flex items-center gap-2"
              >
                {loading ? (
                  <>
                    <div className="animate-spin rounded-full h-4 w-4 border-b-2 border-white"></div>
                    Creating...
                  </>
                ) : (
                  <>
                    <Save className="w-4 h-4" />
                    Create Product
                  </>
                )}
              </button>
            </div>
          </motion.div>
        </form>
      </div>
    </div>
    </SupplierLayout>
  );
}
```
