```text
﻿"use client";

import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { AnimatePresence, motion } from "framer-motion";
import {
  ArrowRight,
  BadgeCheck,
  ChevronLeft,
  ChevronRight,
  Megaphone,
  ShieldCheck,
  Sparkles,
  Tag,
  Truck,
  Flame,
  Moon,
  Stars,
} from "@/lib/icons";
import Image from "next/image";
import Link from "next/link";
import { useLocaleStore } from "@/lib/localeStore";
import { useEffectStore } from "@/lib/effectStore";
import { apiFetch } from "@/lib/api";
import type { Product } from "@/lib/types";
import { useTranslateTexts } from "@/lib/useTranslate";
import { t as translateStatic } from "@/lib/i18n";
import { formatLocalizedDate, isRtlLocale } from "@shared/localization";

interface BannerData {
  id?: number | string;
  title: string;
  subtitle: string;
  badge_text?: string;
  gradientClass?: string;
  bg_from?: string;
  bg_via?: string;
  bg_to?: string;
  cta_text?: string;
  cta_label?: string;
  cta_url?: string;
  image_url?: string;
  is_active?: boolean;
  effect?: string;
  background_effect?: string;
  // Admin appearance overrides
  bg_color?: string;
  text_color?: string;
  subtitle_color?: string;
  btn_bg_color?: string;
  btn_text_color?: string;
  badge_color?: string;
  banner_type?: string;
  starts_at?: string;
  ends_at?: string;
}

interface FlashSaleSummary {
  id: number;
  title: string;
  discount_pct: number;
  starts_at: string;
  ends_at: string;
  is_active: boolean;
}

function formatOfferWindow(
  locale: string,
  startsLabel: string,
  untilLabel: string,
  startsAt?: string | null,
  endsAt?: string | null
) {
  if (!startsAt && !endsAt) return null;
  const startLabel = startsAt ? formatLocalizedDate(startsAt, locale) : null;
  const endLabel = endsAt ? formatLocalizedDate(endsAt, locale) : null;
  if (startLabel && endLabel) return `${startLabel} - ${endLabel}`;
  return endLabel ? `${untilLabel} ${endLabel}` : startLabel ? `${startsLabel} ${startLabel}` : null;
}

const CONFETTI = [
  { left: "10%", top: "-10%", delay: "0s", color: "bg-primary" },
  { left: "18%", top: "-12%", delay: "0.4s", color: "bg-accent" },
  { left: "26%", top: "-8%", delay: "0.8s", color: "bg-primary-light" },
  { left: "34%", top: "-14%", delay: "1.2s", color: "bg-accent" },
  { left: "42%", top: "-9%", delay: "1.6s", color: "bg-primary" },
  { left: "50%", top: "-16%", delay: "2s", color: "bg-warning" },
  { left: "58%", top: "-10%", delay: "0.6s", color: "bg-primary-light" },
  { left: "66%", top: "-13%", delay: "1s", color: "bg-accent" },
  { left: "74%", top: "-8%", delay: "1.4s", color: "bg-primary" },
  { left: "82%", top: "-12%", delay: "1.8s", color: "bg-accent" },
  { left: "90%", top: "-9%", delay: "2.2s", color: "bg-primary-light" },
];

export default function SeasonalBanner() {
  const [banners, setBanners] = useState<BannerData[]>([]);
  const [flashSales, setFlashSales] = useState<FlashSaleSummary[]>([]);
  const [promotions, setPromotions] = useState<BannerData[]>([]);
  const [supplierDeals, setSupplierDeals] = useState<Product[]>([]);
  const [activeIndex, setActiveIndex] = useState(0);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const locale = useLocaleStore((s) => s.locale);
  const setEffect = useEffectStore((s) => s.setEffect);
  const isRtl = isRtlLocale(locale);

  useEffect(() => {
    const parseBannerList = (data: unknown): BannerData[] => {
      if (Array.isArray(data)) return data.filter((b) => b?.is_active !== false) as BannerData[];
      if (data && typeof data === "object" && "banners" in data && Array.isArray((data as { banners?: BannerData[] }).banners)) {
        return ((data as { banners: BannerData[] }).banners).filter((b) => b?.is_active !== false);
      }
      if (data && typeof data === "object") {
        const single = data as BannerData;
        return single.is_active === false ? [] : [single];
      }
      return [];
    };

    Promise.all([
      apiFetch("/banners").then((r) => (r.ok ? r.json() : null)).catch(() => null),
      apiFetch("/flash-sales").then((r) => (r.ok ? r.json() : [])).catch(() => []),
      apiFetch("/banners?type=promotional").then((r) => (r.ok ? r.json() : [])).catch(() => []),
      apiFetch("/products?sort=discount&min_discount=5&limit=12").then((r) => (r.ok ? r.json() : [])).catch(() => []),
    ])
      .then(([bannerData, saleData, promotionData, supplierData]) => {
        const list = parseBannerList(bannerData);
        const promotionList = parseBannerList(promotionData).filter((item) => item.banner_type === "promotional");
        setBanners(list);
        setFlashSales(Array.isArray(saleData) ? saleData : []);
        setPromotions(promotionList);
        setSupplierDeals(
          (Array.isArray(supplierData) ? supplierData : []).filter(
            (item: Product) => item.offer_type === "supplier_discount"
          )
        );
        setActiveIndex(0);
      })
      .catch(() => {
        setBanners([]);
        setFlashSales([]);
        setPromotions([]);
        setSupplierDeals([]);
        setActiveIndex(0);
      })
      .finally(() => setLoading(false));
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (banners.length <= 1) return;
    const id = setInterval(() => {
      setActiveIndex((idx) => (idx + 1) % banners.length);
    }, 7000);
    return () => clearInterval(id);
  }, [banners.length]);

  const banner = banners[activeIndex];
  const liveFlashSale = flashSales.find((item) => item.is_active) ?? flashSales[0];
  const supplierDeal = supplierDeals[0];
  const promotion = promotions[0];
  const rawEffect = (banner?.background_effect || banner?.effect || "").toLowerCase();
  const resolvedEffect = banner ? rawEffect || "aurora" : "none";
  const bannerKey = banner?.id ?? `${activeIndex}-banner`;
  const ctaText = banner?.cta_text || banner?.cta_label;
  const dealsHref = liveFlashSale ? `/products?deals=1&sale_id=${liveFlashSale.id}` : "/products?deals=1";
  const [
    shippingLabel,
    verifiedLabel,
    secureLabel,
    dealsLabel,
    previousBannerLabel,
    nextBannerLabel,
    flashSalesLabel,
    promotionalOffersLabel,
    supplierDiscountsLabel,
    flashFallbackLabel,
    promotionFallbackLabel,
    promotionFallbackCopy,
    supplierFallbackLabel,
    supplierFallbackCopy,
    untilLabel,
    startsLabel,
    translatedBadgeText,
    translatedBannerTitle,
    translatedBannerSubtitle,
    translatedCtaText,
    translatedFlashHeadline,
    translatedPromotionHeadline,
    translatedPromotionSummary,
    translatedSupplierHeadline,
    bannerBackgroundLabel,
    goToBannerLabel,
  ] = useTranslateTexts([
    translateStatic("en", "homeTrustShipping"),
    translateStatic("en", "homeTrustVerified"),
    translateStatic("en", "homeTrustSecure"),
    translateStatic("en", "homeDeals"),
    "Previous banner",
    "Next banner",
    "Flash Sales",
    "Promotional Offers",
    "Supplier Discounts",
    "Admin-managed promotional campaigns publish live durations here as soon as they go active.",
    "Bundle offers and buy-one-get-one deals appear here",
    "Admin or supplier promotional campaigns publish their live window here.",
    "Supplier offers update when vendors schedule discounts",
    "Each supplier discount now follows the product's configured duration window.",
    "Until",
    "Starts",
    banner?.badge_text ?? "",
    banner?.title ?? "",
    banner?.subtitle ?? "",
    ctaText ?? "",
    liveFlashSale ? `${liveFlashSale.title} · ${Math.round(liveFlashSale.discount_pct)}% OFF` : banner?.title ?? "",
    promotion ? promotion.title : "Bundle offers and buy-one-get-one deals appear here",
    promotion?.subtitle ?? "Admin or supplier promotional campaigns publish their live window here.",
    supplierDeal ? `${supplierDeal.name} · ${Math.round(Number(supplierDeal.offer_discount_pct ?? 0))}% OFF` : "Supplier offers update when vendors schedule discounts",
    "Banner background",
    "Go to banner",
  ]);
  const bannerWindow = formatOfferWindow(locale, startsLabel, untilLabel, banner?.starts_at, banner?.ends_at);
  const flashWindow = formatOfferWindow(locale, startsLabel, untilLabel, liveFlashSale?.starts_at, liveFlashSale?.ends_at);
  const supplierWindow = formatOfferWindow(
    locale,
    startsLabel,
    untilLabel,
    supplierDeal?.offer_starts_at ?? supplierDeal?.discount_starts_at,
    supplierDeal?.offer_ends_at ?? supplierDeal?.discount_ends_at
  );
  const promotionWindow = formatOfferWindow(locale, startsLabel, untilLabel, promotion?.starts_at, promotion?.ends_at);
  const featureChips = useMemo(
    () => [
      { icon: Truck, label: shippingLabel },
      { icon: BadgeCheck, label: verifiedLabel },
      { icon: ShieldCheck, label: secureLabel },
    ],
    [shippingLabel, verifiedLabel, secureLabel]
  );
  const CtaArrowIcon = isRtl ? ChevronLeft : ArrowRight;
  // Admin-controlled colours (fall back to CSS variables / gradientClass when absent)
  const adminBgColor = banner?.bg_color;
  const adminTextColor = banner?.text_color;
  const adminSubtitleColor = banner?.subtitle_color;
  const adminBtnBg = banner?.btn_bg_color;
  const adminBtnText = banner?.btn_text_color;
  const adminBadgeColor = banner?.badge_color;
  const titleStyle = { color: adminTextColor || "#ffffff" };
  const subtitleStyle = { color: adminSubtitleColor || "rgba(255,255,255,0.82)" };

  // Sync current effect to global store so BackgroundEffect renders it
  useEffect(() => {
    setEffect(resolvedEffect);
    return () => setEffect("none");
  }, [resolvedEffect, setEffect]);
  const nextBanner = () => setActiveIndex((idx) => (idx + 1) % banners.length);
  const prevBanner = () => setActiveIndex((idx) => (idx - 1 + banners.length) % banners.length);

  if (loading) {
    return <div className="mb-3 h-20 w-full animate-pulse rounded-4xl bg-surface-2" />;
  }

  if (!banner) {
    return null;
  }

  return (
    <AnimatePresence mode="wait">
      <motion.div
        key={bannerKey}
        initial={{ opacity: 0, y: -12 }}
        animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
        exit={{ opacity: 0, y: 12 }}
        transition={{ duration: 0.5, ease: "easeOut" }}
        data-testid="seasonal-banner"
        className={`relative mx-auto mb-4 max-w-7xl overflow-hidden rounded-4xl border border-border shadow-[0_36px_90px_-54px_rgba(15,23,42,0.42)] ring-1 ring-white/12 ${adminBgColor ? "" : (banner.gradientClass ?? "theme-bg-banner-gradient-default")}`}
        style={adminBgColor ? { backgroundColor: adminBgColor } : undefined}
      >
        <div className="pointer-events-none absolute inset-0 bg-[linear-gradient(115deg,rgba(7,11,20,0.72),rgba(7,11,20,0.26)_52%,rgba(7,11,20,0.56)),radial-gradient(circle_at_top,rgba(255,255,255,0.10),transparent_54%)] opacity-100" />
        <div className="pointer-events-none absolute inset-x-0 top-0 h-20 bg-[radial-gradient(circle_at_top,rgba(255,255,255,0.08),transparent_70%)] opacity-70" />

        {/* Background image */}
        {banner.image_url && (

        {resolvedEffect === "balloons" && (

            <div className="absolute top-8 right-10 h-16 w-16 rounded-full bg-accent/25 blur-xl float-orb-drift" />
            <div className="absolute bottom-6 right-24 h-20 w-20 rounded-full bg-primary-light/25 blur-2xl float-orb-slow" />
            <div className="absolute bottom-10 left-20 h-10 w-10 rounded-full bg-accent/30 blur-lg float-orb-drift" />

        {resolvedEffect === "poppers" && (

        {resolvedEffect === "ramadan" && (
          <div className="absolute inset-0 pointer-events-none">
            <div className="crescent-float absolute right-[8%] top-[16%] h-24 w-24 rounded-full border border-white/25 bg-white/5 shadow-[0_0_40px_rgba(255,255,255,0.08)]" />
            <div className="absolute right-[10%] top-[16%] h-24 w-24 rounded-full bg-transparent shadow-[-18px_0_0_0_rgba(11,17,32,0.95)]" />
            <div className="lantern-float absolute left-[10%] top-[18%] h-20 w-10 rounded-b-2xl rounded-t-lg border border-warning/40 bg-warning/10 shadow-[0_0_30px_rgba(245,158,11,0.2)]" />
            <div className="lantern-float absolute left-[18%] top-[10%] h-16 w-8 rounded-b-2xl rounded-t-lg border border-primary-light/40 bg-primary-light/10" style={{ animationDelay: "1.2s" }} />
            {Array.from({ length: 8 }).map((_, idx) => (
              <span
                key={`ramadan-star-${idx}`}
                className="sparkle-pulse absolute h-1.5 w-1.5 rounded-full bg-white/70"
                style={{ top: `${12 + idx * 7}%`, left: `${20 + idx * 9}%`, animationDelay: `${idx * 0.35}s` }}
              />
            ))}
          </div>
        )}

        {resolvedEffect === "eid" && (
          <div className="absolute inset-0 pointer-events-none">
            {Array.from({ length: 14 }).map((_, idx) => (
              <span

                className="sparkle-pulse absolute h-2 w-2 rounded-full bg-white/70"

            <div className="absolute right-[10%] top-[10%] h-28 w-28 rounded-full bg-primary-light/20 blur-3xl" />

        {resolvedEffect === "aurora" && (

            <div className="float-orb absolute -left-10 top-8 h-40 w-40 rounded-full bg-primary/20 blur-3xl" />
            <div className="float-orb-drift absolute right-0 top-0 h-44 w-44 rounded-full bg-primary-light/20 blur-3xl" />
            <div className="float-orb-slow absolute bottom-0 left-1/3 h-36 w-52 rounded-full bg-accent/15 blur-3xl" />
            <div className="absolute inset-x-[12%] top-[18%] h-28 rounded-full bg-white/10 blur-3xl" />
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Decorative sparks */}
        <div className="absolute inset-0 pointer-events-none">
          {Array.from({ length: 10 }).map((_, idx) => (
            <span
              key={idx}
              className="absolute h-1.5 w-1.5 rounded-full bg-white/50"
              style={{
                top: `${10 + idx * 7}%`,
                left: `${idx % 2 === 0 ? 8 + idx * 3 : 65 + idx}%`,
                opacity: 0.35,
              }}
            />
          ))}
        </div>

        {banners.length > 1 && (
          <div className={`absolute top-4 z-10 flex items-center gap-2 ${isRtl ? "left-4" : "right-4"}`}>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={prevBanner}
              className="seasonal-banner-nav rounded-full p-2 transition-colors hover:text-white"
              aria-label={previousBannerLabel}
            >
              {isRtl ? <ChevronRight className="h-4 w-4" /> : <ChevronLeft className="h-4 w-4" />}
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={nextBanner}
              className="seasonal-banner-nav rounded-full p-2 transition-colors hover:text-white"
              aria-label={nextBannerLabel}
            >
              {isRtl ? <ChevronLeft className="h-4 w-4" /> : <ChevronRight className="h-4 w-4" />}
            </button>
```

### `frontend\web_app\src\components\SignaturePad.tsx`

```text
"use client";

import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";

type Point = { x: number; y: number };

interface SignaturePadProps {
  height?: number;
  strokeColor?: string;
  backgroundColor?: string;
  borderColor?: string;
  className?: string;
  onChange: (value: string | null) => void;
}

function drawStroke(
  context: CanvasRenderingContext2D,
  stroke: Point[],
  strokeColor: string,
) {
  if (!stroke.length) return;

  context.strokeStyle = strokeColor;
  context.lineWidth = 2.5;
  context.lineCap = "round";
  context.lineJoin = "round";
  context.beginPath();
  context.moveTo(stroke[0].x, stroke[0].y);

  for (let index = 1; index < stroke.length; index += 1) {
    context.lineTo(stroke[index].x, stroke[index].y);
  }

  if (stroke.length === 1) {
    context.lineTo(stroke[0].x + 0.1, stroke[0].y + 0.1);
  }

  context.stroke();
}

export default function SignaturePad({
  height = 180,
  strokeColor = "#111827",
  backgroundColor = "#ffffff",
  borderColor = "#d1d5db",
  className = "",
  onChange,
}: SignaturePadProps) {
  const canvasRef = useRef<HTMLCanvasElement>(null);
  const containerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const drawingRef = useRef(false);
  const currentStrokeRef = useRef<Point[]>([]);
  const strokesRef = useRef<Point[][]>([]);
  const [hasSignature, setHasSignature] = useState(false);

  const paintBackground = useCallback((context: CanvasRenderingContext2D, width: number, canvasHeight: number) => {
    context.save();
    context.fillStyle = backgroundColor;
    context.fillRect(0, 0, width, canvasHeight);
    context.restore();
  }, [backgroundColor]);

  const exportSignature = useCallback(() => {
    const canvas = canvasRef.current;
    if (!canvas || strokesRef.current.length === 0) {
      onChange(null);
      return;
    }
    onChange(canvas.toDataURL("image/png"));
  }, [onChange]);

  const redraw = useCallback(() => {
    const canvas = canvasRef.current;
    const container = containerRef.current;
    if (!canvas || !container) return;

    const width = container.clientWidth;
    if (!width) return;

    const devicePixelRatio = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
    canvas.width = Math.round(width * devicePixelRatio);
    canvas.height = Math.round(height * devicePixelRatio);
    canvas.style.width = `${width}px`;
    canvas.style.height = `${height}px`;

    const context = canvas.getContext("2d");
    if (!context) return;

    context.setTransform(devicePixelRatio, 0, 0, devicePixelRatio, 0, 0);
    paintBackground(context, width, height);

    for (const stroke of strokesRef.current) {
      drawStroke(context, stroke, strokeColor);
    }
  }, [height, paintBackground, strokeColor]);

  useEffect(() => {
    redraw();
    const handleResize = () => redraw();
    window.addEventListener("resize", handleResize);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("resize", handleResize);
  }, [redraw]);

  useEffect(() => {
    redraw();
  }, [backgroundColor, borderColor, redraw, strokeColor]);

  function pointFromEvent(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLCanvasElement>): Point {
    const bounds = event.currentTarget.getBoundingClientRect();
    return {
      x: event.clientX - bounds.left,
      y: event.clientY - bounds.top,
    };
  }

  function startDrawing(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLCanvasElement>) {
    const canvas = canvasRef.current;
    const context = canvas?.getContext("2d");
    if (!canvas || !context) return;

    drawingRef.current = true;
    currentStrokeRef.current = [pointFromEvent(event)];
    event.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
    redraw();
    drawStroke(context, currentStrokeRef.current, strokeColor);
  }

  function continueDrawing(event: React.PointerEvent<HTMLCanvasElement>) {
    if (!drawingRef.current) return;

    const canvas = canvasRef.current;
    const context = canvas?.getContext("2d");
    if (!canvas || !context) return;

    currentStrokeRef.current = [...currentStrokeRef.current, pointFromEvent(event)];
    redraw();
    drawStroke(context, currentStrokeRef.current, strokeColor);
  }

  function stopDrawing(event?: React.PointerEvent<HTMLCanvasElement>) {
    if (!drawingRef.current) return;
    drawingRef.current = false;
    if (event) {
      try {
        event.currentTarget.releasePointerCapture(event.pointerId);
      } catch {}
    }

    if (currentStrokeRef.current.length > 0) {
      strokesRef.current = [...strokesRef.current, currentStrokeRef.current];
      currentStrokeRef.current = [];
      setHasSignature(true);
      redraw();
      exportSignature();
    }
  }

  function clearSignature() {
    strokesRef.current = [];
    currentStrokeRef.current = [];
    setHasSignature(false);
    redraw();
    onChange(null);
  }

  return (
    <div className={`space-y-2 ${className}`.trim()}>
      <div
        ref={containerRef}
        className="overflow-hidden rounded-xl border bg-white"
        style={{ borderColor }}
      >
        <canvas
          ref={canvasRef}
          aria-label="Delivery signature pad"
          data-testid="delivery-signature-pad"
          className="block touch-none"
          onPointerDown={startDrawing}
          onPointerMove={continueDrawing}
          onPointerUp={stopDrawing}
          onPointerLeave={() => stopDrawing()}
          onPointerCancel={() => stopDrawing()}
        />
      </div>
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 text-xs text-text-muted">
        <span>{hasSignature ? "Signature captured" : "Draw the customer signature here."}</span>
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={clearSignature}
          className="rounded-lg border border-border px-2.5 py-1 font-semibold text-text hover:bg-surface-2"
        >
          Clear Signature
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

### `frontend\web_app\src\components\SupplierLayout.tsx`

```text
﻿"use client";

import { usePathname } from "next/navigation";
import { useAuth, useRequireSupplier } from "@/lib/useAuth";
import PanelShell from "@/components/PanelShell";
import { useLocaleStore } from "@/lib/localeStore";
import { useTranslateTexts } from "@/lib/useTranslate";
import { Package } from "@/lib/icons";
import { SUPPLIER_NAV_ITEMS, SUPPLIER_NAV_SECTIONS } from "@/lib/panelNavigation";

export default function SupplierLayout({ children, title }: { children: React.ReactNode; title?: string }) {
  const { user, logout } = useAuth();
  const pathname = usePathname();
  useRequireSupplier();

  const locale = useLocaleStore((s) => s.locale);
  const dir = ["ar", "fa", "ur"].includes(locale) ? "rtl" : "ltr";
  const isRtl = dir === "rtl";
  const [dashboardLabel, translatedTitleValue, zoziSupplierLabel, supplierWorkspaceLabel, supplierFallbackLabel, premiumSellerLabel, logoutLabel, manageBusinessLabel] = useTranslateTexts([
    "Dashboard",
    title || "Dashboard",
    "ZOZI Supplier",
    "Supplier Workspace",
    "Supplier",
    "Premium Seller",
    "Logout",
    "Manage your business",
  ]);
  const translatedTitle = title ? translatedTitleValue : undefined;
  const translatedGroupLabels = useTranslateTexts(SUPPLIER_NAV_SECTIONS.map((section) => section.label));
  const translatedItemTexts = useTranslateTexts(SUPPLIER_NAV_ITEMS.flatMap((item) => [item.name, item.desc]));
  const translatedItems = SUPPLIER_NAV_ITEMS.map((item, index) => ({
    ...item,
    name: translatedItemTexts[index * 2] || item.name,
    desc: translatedItemTexts[index * 2 + 1] || item.desc,
  }));
  const translatedSections = SUPPLIER_NAV_SECTIONS.map((section, sectionIndex) => ({
    ...section,
    label: translatedGroupLabels[sectionIndex] || section.label,
    items: translatedItems.filter((item) => item.group === section.key && !item.hideFromNav),
  }));
  const isActiveItem = (item: (typeof translatedItems)[number]) => pathname === item.href || pathname.startsWith(`${item.href}/`);

  return (
    <PanelShell
      title={translatedTitle || dashboardLabel}
      panelClassName="supplier"
      brandLabel={zoziSupplierLabel}
      panelBadgeLabel={supplierWorkspaceLabel}
      panelBadgeClassName="border-primary/30 bg-primary/10 text-primary"
      defaultTitle={dashboardLabel}
      defaultDescription={manageBusinessLabel}
      sections={translatedSections}
      allItems={translatedItems}
      isActiveItem={isActiveItem}
      onLogout={logout}
      logoutLabel={logoutLabel}
      userName={user?.username}
      fallbackUserLabel={supplierFallbackLabel}
      userSecondaryLabel={premiumSellerLabel}
      avatarIcon={Package}
      avatarClassName="bg-primary"
      shortcutScope="supplier"
      dir={dir}
      isRtl={isRtl}
    >
      {children}
    </PanelShell>
  );
}
```

### `frontend\web_app\src\components\ThemeProvider.tsx`

```text
"use client";

import { useEffect } from "react";
import { useThemeStore } from "@/lib/themeStore";

interface ThemeProviderProps {
  children: React.ReactNode;
}

export function ThemeProvider({ children }: ThemeProviderProps) {
  const theme = useThemeStore((state) => state.theme);

  useEffect(() => {
    const root = document.documentElement;
    root.classList.remove("light", "dark");
    root.classList.add(theme);

    root.style.colorScheme = theme;
  }, [theme]);

  return <>{children}</>;
}
```

### `frontend\web_app\src\components\ThemeToggle.tsx`

```text
"use client";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { useThemeStore } from "@/lib/themeStore";

interface ThemeToggleButtonProps {
  theme: "light" | "dark";
  onToggle: () => void;
}

function ThemeToggleButton({ theme, onToggle }: ThemeToggleButtonProps) {
  return (
    <button
      onClick={onToggle}
      className="group rounded-lg border border-border bg-surface-1 p-2 text-text-muted transition-colors hover:border-border-light hover:bg-surface-2"
      aria-label={`Switch to ${theme === "dark" ? "light" : "dark"} theme`}
      type="button"
    >
      {theme === "dark" ? "☀️" : "🌙"}
    </button>
  );
}

export default function ThemeToggle() {
  const { theme, toggleTheme } = useThemeStore();
  const [mounted, setMounted] = useState(false);
  useEffect(() => setMounted(true), []);

  if (!mounted) {
    // Render a stable placeholder that matches the server output to avoid hydration mismatch.
    return (
      <button
        className="group rounded-lg border border-border bg-surface-1 p-2 text-text-muted transition-colors hover:border-border-light hover:bg-surface-2"
        aria-label="Toggle theme"
        disabled
      />
    );
  }

  return <ThemeToggleButton theme={theme} onToggle={toggleTheme} />;
}
```

```text
        @keyframes marquee {
          0%   { transform: translateX(0); }
          100% { transform: translateX(-50%); }
        }
      `}</style>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```text
"use client";

import { useToastStore } from "@/lib/toastStore";
import { X, CheckCircle, AlertCircle, Info } from "lucide-react";
import { motion, AnimatePresence } from "framer-motion";

const STYLES = {
  error: {
    bg: "bg-danger/15 border-danger/30",
    text: "text-danger",
    Icon: AlertCircle,
  },
  success: {
    bg: "bg-success/15 border-success/30",
    text: "text-success",
    Icon: CheckCircle,
  },
  info: {
    bg: "bg-info/15 border-info/30",
    text: "text-info",
    Icon: Info,
  },
  warning: {
    bg: "bg-warning/15 border-warning/30",
    text: "text-warning",
    Icon: AlertCircle,
  },
} as const;

export default function ToastContainer() {
  const toasts = useToastStore((s) => s.toasts);
  const remove = useToastStore((s) => s.removeToast);

  if (toasts.length === 0) return null;

  return (
    <div className="fixed top-4 right-4 flex flex-col gap-1.5 z-200">
      <AnimatePresence>
        {toasts.map((t) => {
          const style = STYLES[t.type as keyof typeof STYLES] || STYLES.info;
          const IconComp = style.Icon;
          return (
            <motion.div
              key={t.id}
              initial={{ opacity: 0, x: 40 }}
              animate={{ opacity: 1, x: 0 }}
              exit={{ opacity: 0, x: 40 }}
              className={`max-w-72 w-full rounded-xl border p-3 shadow-lg backdrop-blur-sm flex items-start gap-2.5 bg-glass-mid ${style.bg}`}
            >
              <IconComp className={`w-4 h-4 shrink-0 mt-0.5 ${style.text}`} />
              <p className={`text-xs font-medium flex-1 ${style.text}`}>
                {t.message}
              </p>
              <button
                onClick={() => remove(t.id)}
                className="shrink-0 text-text-faint transition-colors hover:text-text"
              >
                <X className="w-3 h-3" />
              </button>
            </motion.div>
          );
        })}
      </AnimatePresence>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```text
"use client";

import { type ElementType } from "react";
import { useTranslateText } from "@/lib/useTranslate";

interface TranslatedTextProps {
	text: string | null | undefined;
	as?: ElementType;
	className?: string;
	fallback?: string;
}

export default function TranslatedText({
	text,
	as: Tag = "span",

	fallback = "",
}: TranslatedTextProps) {
```

### `frontend\web_app\src\components\UserRealtimeBridge.tsx`

```text
"use client";

import { useCallback, useEffect } from "react";
import { apiFetch } from "@/lib/api";
import { notificationStore, useNotificationStore } from "@/lib/notificationStore";
import { useAuth } from "@/lib/useAuth";
import { useToastStore } from "@/lib/toastStore";
import { connectUserRealtimeSocket } from "@/lib/userRealtime";
import { buildRealtimeAlert } from "@shared/userRealtimeAlerts";

export default function UserRealtimeBridge() {
  const { isLoggedIn, isLoading } = useAuth();
  const addToast = useToastStore((state) => state.addToast);
  const recalcUnreadCount = useNotificationStore((state) => state.recalcUnreadCount);
  const reset = useNotificationStore((state) => state.reset);

  const loadUnreadCount = useCallback(async () => {
    const response = await apiFetch("/notifications");
    if (!response.ok) {
      reset();
      return;
    }

    const notifications = await response.json();
    recalcUnreadCount(Array.isArray(notifications) ? notifications : []);
  }, [recalcUnreadCount, reset]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isLoading) {
      return;
    }

    if (!isLoggedIn) {
      reset();
      return;
    }

    void loadUnreadCount().catch(() => reset());
  }, [isLoading, isLoggedIn, loadUnreadCount, reset]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isLoading || !isLoggedIn) {
      return;
    }

    const socket = connectUserRealtimeSocket(
      () => undefined,
      (payload) => {
        notificationStore.getState().applyRealtimeMessage(payload);

        const alert = buildRealtimeAlert(payload);
        if (alert) {
          addToast(alert.message, alert.tone);
        }
      },
    );

    return () => {
      socket?.close();
    };
  }, [addToast, isLoading, isLoggedIn]);

  return null;
}
```

### `frontend\web_app\src\components\admin\CreateCampaignForm.tsx`

```text
﻿"use client";

import { useEffect, useState, type MouseEvent as ReactMouseEvent } from "react";
import DOMPurify from "dompurify";
import { motion } from "framer-motion";
import { X, Save } from "@/lib/icons";
import { apiFetch } from "@/lib/api";

interface EmailTemplate {
  id: number;
  name: string;
  subject: string;
  content: string;
  template_type: string;
}

interface CreateCampaignFormProps {
  onClose: () => void;
  onSuccess: () => void;
}

export default function CreateCampaignForm({ onClose, onSuccess }: CreateCampaignFormProps) {
  const [templates, setTemplates] = useState<EmailTemplate[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [formData, setFormData] = useState({
    name: "",
    subject: "",
    html_content: "",
    text_content: "",
    subject_b: "",
    ab_test_enabled: false,
    template_id: "",
    target_audience: "all",
    send_at: "",
  });

  async function loadTemplates() {
    try {
      const response = await apiFetch("/email/templates");
      if (response.ok) {
        const data = await response.json();
        const normalizedTemplates: EmailTemplate[] = Array.isArray(data)
          ? data.map((template: any) => ({
              id: Number(template?.id ?? 0),
              name: String(template?.name ?? ""),
              subject: String(template?.subject ?? ""),
              content: String(template?.content ?? template?.html_content ?? ""),
              template_type: String(template?.template_type ?? "marketing"),
            }))
          : [];
        setTemplates(normalizedTemplates);
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error("Failed to load templates:", error);
    }
  }

  useEffect(() => {
    loadTemplates();
  }, []);

  const handleTemplateChange = (templateId: string) => {
    const template = templates.find(t => t.id.toString() === templateId);
    if (template) {
      const templateContent = template.content || "";
      setFormData(prev => ({
        ...prev,
        template_id: templateId,
        subject: template.subject,
        html_content: templateContent,
        text_content: templateContent.replace(/<[^>]+>/g, " ").replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim(),
      }));
    }
  };

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setLoading(true);

    try {
      const templateId = formData.template_id ? parseInt(formData.template_id, 10) : null;
      const payload = {
        name: formData.name.trim(),
        subject: formData.subject.trim(),
        html_content: formData.html_content,
        text_content: formData.text_content || null,
        template_id: templateId,
        target_audience: formData.target_audience,
        send_at: formData.send_at || null,
        subject_b: formData.ab_test_enabled && formData.subject_b.trim() ? formData.subject_b.trim() : null,
        ab_test_enabled: formData.ab_test_enabled,
      };

      const response = await apiFetch("/email/campaigns", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: {
          "Content-Type": "application/json"
        },
        body: JSON.stringify(payload)
      });

      if (response.ok) {
        onSuccess();
        onClose();
      } else {
        alert("Failed to create campaign");
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error("Failed to create campaign:", error);
      alert("Failed to create campaign");
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <motion.div
      initial={{ opacity: 0 }}
      animate={{ opacity: 1 }}
      className="fixed inset-0 theme-overlay flex items-center justify-center p-4 z-50"
      onClick={onClose}
    >
      <motion.div
        initial={{ scale: 0.9 }}
        animate={{ scale: 1 }}
        className="bg-surface-1 rounded-lg max-w-2xl w-full max-h-[90vh] overflow-y-auto border border-border"
        onClick={(e: ReactMouseEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => e.stopPropagation()}
      >
        <div className="px-6 py-4 border-b border-border flex items-center justify-between">
          <h3 className="text-lg font-medium text-text">Create Email Campaign</h3>
          <button
            onClick={onClose}
            className="text-text-faint hover:text-text-muted"
          >
            <X className="w-5 h-5" />
          </button>
        </div>

        <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="p-6 space-y-6">
          {/* Campaign Name */}
          <div>
            <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-text mb-2">
              Campaign Name
            </label>
            <input
              type="text"
              required
              value={formData.name}
              onChange={(e) => setFormData(prev => ({ ...prev, name: e.target.value }))}
              className="w-full px-3 py-2 border border-border rounded-md focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary theme-input"
              placeholder="e.g., Spring Sale 2024"
            />
          </div>

          {/* Email Template */}
          <div>
            <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-text mb-2">
              Email Template
            </label>
            <select
              required
              value={formData.template_id}
              onChange={(e) => handleTemplateChange(e.target.value)}
              className="w-full px-3 py-2 border border-border rounded-md focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary theme-input"
            >
              <option value="">Select a template...</option>
              {templates.map((template) => (
                <option key={template.id} value={template.id}>
                  {template.name} - {template.template_type}
                </option>
              ))}
            </select>
          </div>

          {/* Subject Line */}
          <div>
            <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-text mb-2">
              Subject Line (Variant A)
            </label>
            <input
              type="text"
              required
              value={formData.subject}
              onChange={(e) => setFormData(prev => ({ ...prev, subject: e.target.value }))}
              className="w-full px-3 py-2 border border-border rounded-md focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary theme-input"
              placeholder="Enter email subject..."
            />
          </div>

          {/* A/B Test Toggle */}
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <input
              type="checkbox"
              id="ab_test_enabled"
              checked={formData.ab_test_enabled}
              onChange={(e) => setFormData(prev => ({ ...prev, ab_test_enabled: e.target.checked }))}
              className="w-4 h-4 accent-primary"
            />
            <label htmlFor="ab_test_enabled" className="text-sm font-medium text-text cursor-pointer">
              Enable A/B subject line test (50/50 split)
            </label>
          </div>

          {/* Variant B Subject */}
          {formData.ab_test_enabled && (
            <div>
              <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-text mb-2">
                Subject Line (Variant B)
              </label>
              <input
                type="text"
                required={formData.ab_test_enabled}
                value={formData.subject_b}
                onChange={(e) => setFormData(prev => ({ ...prev, subject_b: e.target.value }))}
                className="w-full px-3 py-2 border border-border rounded-md focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary theme-input"
                placeholder="Alternate subject for 50% of recipients..."
              />
              <p className="text-xs text-text-faint mt-1">
                Half your recipients will receive Variant A, half will receive Variant B.
                Compare open rates in the campaign analytics to pick a winner.
              </p>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Target Audience */}
          <div>
            <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-text mb-2">
              Target Audience
            </label>
            <select
              value={formData.target_audience}
              onChange={(e) => setFormData(prev => ({ ...prev, target_audience: e.target.value }))}
              className="w-full px-3 py-2 border border-border rounded-md focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary theme-input"
            >
              <option value="all">All Customers, Suppliers, Logistics + Newsletter</option>
              <option value="subscribers">Newsletter Subscribers Only</option>
              <option value="customers">Customers</option>
              <option value="suppliers">Suppliers</option>
              <option value="logistics">Logistics Partners</option>
              <option value="all_registered">All Registered Users</option>
            </select>
          </div>

          {/* Schedule Send */}
          <div>
            <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-text mb-2">
              Schedule Send (Optional)
            </label>
            <input
              type="datetime-local"
              value={formData.send_at}
              onChange={(e) => setFormData(prev => ({ ...prev, send_at: e.target.value }))}
              className="w-full px-3 py-2 border border-border rounded-md focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary theme-input"
            />
            <p className="text-xs text-text-faint mt-1">
              Leave empty to send immediately after creation
            </p>
          </div>

          {/* Email Content Preview */}
          {formData.html_content && (
            <div>
              <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-text mb-2">
                Email Content Preview
              </label>
              <div className="border border-border rounded-md p-4 max-h-64 overflow-y-auto">
                <div dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: DOMPurify.sanitize(formData.html_content) }} />
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Actions */}
          <div className="flex justify-end space-x-3 pt-4 border-t border-border">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={onClose}
              className="px-4 py-2 text-sm text-text-muted hover:text-text"
            >
              Cancel
            </button>
            <button
              type="submit"
              disabled={loading}
              className="theme-btn-primary px-4 py-2 rounded-md disabled:opacity-50 flex items-center gap-2"
            >
              {loading ? (
                <div className="animate-spin rounded-full h-4 w-4 border-b-2 border-white"></div>
              ) : (
                <Save className="w-4 h-4" />
              )}
              Create Campaign
            </button>
          </div>
        </form>
      </motion.div>
    </motion.div>
  );
}
```

### `frontend\web_app\src\components\admin\EmailCampaignManager.tsx`

```text
﻿"use client";

import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";
import {
  Mail, Plus, BarChart3, Users, Eye, MousePointer,
  Calendar, CheckCircle, Clock, AlertCircle, Loader2, Trash2
} from "@/lib/icons";
import { useDensity } from "@/lib/densityContext";
import { apiFetch, getErrorMessage, parseJsonResponse } from "@/lib/api";
import { BackgroundJob, trackBackgroundJob } from "@/lib/backgroundJobs";
import { useToastStore } from "@/lib/toastStore";
import { EnterpriseDataTable, type EnterpriseColumn } from "@shared/components/EnterpriseDataTable";
import CreateCampaignForm from "./CreateCampaignForm";

interface EmailCampaign {
  id: number;
  name: string;
  subject: string;
  status: string;
  send_at: string | null;
  sent_at: string | null;
  target_audience: string;
  recipient_count: number;
  sent_count: number;
  opened_count: number;
  clicked_count: number;
  created_at: string;
}

interface CampaignAnalytics {
  total_recipients: number;
  sent_count: number;
  delivered_count: number;
  opened_count: number;
  open_rate: number;
  clicked_count: number;
  click_rate: number;
  bounced_count: number;
  bounce_rate: number;
  unsubscribed_count: number;
  unsubscribe_rate: number;
}

export default function EmailCampaignManager() {
  const { density } = useDensity();
  const [campaigns, setCampaigns] = useState<EmailCampaign[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [expandedCampaignId, setExpandedCampaignId] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [analyticsByCampaignId, setAnalyticsByCampaignId] = useState<Record<number, CampaignAnalytics | null>>({});
  const [analyticsLoadingId, setAnalyticsLoadingId] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [showCreateForm, setShowCreateForm] = useState(false);
  const [sendingCampaignId, setSendingCampaignId] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [deletingCampaignId, setDeletingCampaignId] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [statusFilter, setStatusFilter] = useState<string>("all");
  const addToast = useToastStore((state) => state.addToast);

  useEffect(() => {
    loadCampaigns();
  }, []);

  async function loadCampaigns() {
    try {
      const response = await apiFetch("/email/campaigns");
      if (response.ok) {
        const data = await response.json();
        setCampaigns(data);
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error("Failed to load campaigns:", error);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }

  const loadAnalytics = async (campaignId: number) => {
    setAnalyticsLoadingId(campaignId);
    try {
      const response = await apiFetch(`/email/campaigns/${campaignId}/analytics`);
      if (response.ok) {
        const data = await response.json();
        setAnalyticsByCampaignId((current) => ({ ...current, [campaignId]: data }));
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error("Failed to load analytics:", error);
    } finally {
      setAnalyticsLoadingId((current) => (current === campaignId ? null : current));
    }
  };

  const deleteCampaign = async (campaign: EmailCampaign) => {
    if (!confirm(`Delete ${campaign.name}? Unsent campaigns can be removed permanently.`)) {
      return;
    }

    setDeletingCampaignId(campaign.id);
    try {
      const response = await apiFetch(`/email/campaigns/${campaign.id}`, { method: "DELETE" });
      const payload = (await parseJsonResponse(response)) ?? {};
      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error(getErrorMessage(payload));
      }
      setCampaigns((current) => current.filter((item) => item.id !== campaign.id));
      setExpandedCampaignId((current) => (current === campaign.id ? null : current));
      addToast("Campaign deleted", "success");
    } catch (error) {
      const message = error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Failed to delete campaign";
      addToast(message, "error");
    } finally {
      setDeletingCampaignId((current) => (current === campaign.id ? null : current));
    }
  };

  const sendCampaign = async (campaign: EmailCampaign) => {
    if (!confirm("Are you sure you want to send this campaign? This action cannot be undone.")) {
      return;
    }

    setSendingCampaignId(campaign.id);
    try {
      const response = await apiFetch(`/email/campaigns/${campaign.id}/send`, {
        method: "POST"
      });
      const payload = (await parseJsonResponse(response)) ?? {};

      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error(getErrorMessage(payload));
      }

      const job = payload as BackgroundJob<{ recipient_count?: number }>;
      const finalJob = await trackBackgroundJob(job, {
        label: "Email campaign send",
        description: campaign.name,
        route: "/admin/email",
        queuedToast: `Queued ${campaign.name} for delivery`,
        successToast: (finalJob) => {
          const recipientCount = typeof finalJob.result?.recipient_count === "number"
            ? finalJob.result.recipient_count
            : 0;
          return recipientCount > 0
            ? `${campaign.name} sent to ${recipientCount.toLocaleString()} recipients`
            : `${campaign.name} sent successfully`;
        },
        errorToast: false,
      });
      if (finalJob.status !== "completed") {
        throw new Error(finalJob.error || `Failed to send ${campaign.name}`);
      }
      await loadCampaigns();
    } catch (error) {
      console.error("Failed to send campaign:", error);
      const message = error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Failed to send campaign";
      addToast(message, "error");
    } finally {
      setSendingCampaignId((current) => (current === campaign.id ? null : current));
    }
  };

  const getStatusIcon = (status: string) => {
    switch (status) {
      case "sent":
        return <CheckCircle className="w-4 h-4 text-success" />;
      case "sending":
        return <Clock className="w-4 h-4 text-info" />;
      case "scheduled":
        return <Calendar className="w-4 h-4 text-warning" />;
      default:
        return <AlertCircle className="w-4 h-4 text-text-faint" />;
    }
  };

  const getStatusColor = (status: string) => {
    switch (status) {
      case "sent":      return "theme-chip-success";
      case "sending":   return "theme-chip-info";
      case "scheduled": return "theme-chip-warning";
      default:          return "theme-chip-muted";
    }
  };

  const filteredCampaigns = useMemo(
    () => campaigns.filter((campaign) => statusFilter === "all" || campaign.status === statusFilter),
    [campaigns, statusFilter]
  );

  const campaignColumns = useMemo<Array<EnterpriseColumn<EmailCampaign>>>(() => [
    {
      key: "name",
      label: "Campaign",
      sortable: true,
      sortValue: (campaign) => campaign.name.toLowerCase(),
      searchValue: (campaign) => `${campaign.name} ${campaign.subject}`,
      render: (campaign) => (
        <div>
          <div className="font-semibold text-text">{campaign.name}</div>
          <div className="mt-0.5 text-[11px] text-text-faint">{campaign.subject}</div>
        </div>
      ),
    },
    {
      key: "status",
      label: "Status",
      sortable: true,
      sortValue: (campaign) => campaign.status,
      searchValue: (campaign) => campaign.status,
      render: (campaign) => (
        <span className={`inline-flex items-center rounded-full px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-semibold ${getStatusColor(campaign.status)}`}>
          {campaign.status}
        </span>
      ),
    },
    {
      key: "target_audience",
      label: "Audience",
      sortable: true,
      sortValue: (campaign) => campaign.target_audience,
      searchValue: (campaign) => campaign.target_audience,
      render: (campaign) => <span className="text-text-muted">{campaign.target_audience}</span>,
    },
    {
      key: "recipient_count",
      label: "Recipients",
      sortable: true,
      sortValue: (campaign) => campaign.recipient_count,
      searchValue: (campaign) => `${campaign.recipient_count} ${campaign.sent_count}`,
      render: (campaign) => <span className="font-semibold text-text">{campaign.sent_count}/{campaign.recipient_count}</span>,
      align: "right",
    },
    {
      key: "open_rate",
      label: "Opens",
      sortable: true,
      sortValue: (campaign) => campaign.opened_count,
      searchValue: (campaign) => `${campaign.opened_count} ${campaign.clicked_count}`,
      render: (campaign) => <span className="text-text-muted">{campaign.opened_count} open · {campaign.clicked_count} click</span>,
    },
    {
      key: "created_at",
      label: "Created",
      sortable: true,
      sortValue: (campaign) => new Date(campaign.created_at).getTime(),
      searchValue: (campaign) => `${campaign.created_at} ${campaign.sent_at || ""}`,
      render: (campaign) => <span className="text-xs text-text-faint">{new Date(campaign.created_at).toLocaleDateString()}</span>,
    },
  ], []);

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div className="flex items-center justify-center p-8">
        <div className="animate-spin rounded-full h-8 w-8 border-b-2 border-primary"></div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-end justify-between gap-3">
        <div>
          <h2 className="text-lg font-bold text-text">Email Campaigns</h2>
          <p className="text-xs text-text-muted">Manage promotional emails and newsletters with the same shared table workflow used across admin.</p>
        </div>
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
          <select value={statusFilter} onChange={(event) => setStatusFilter(event.target.value)} className="theme-input rounded-xl border px-3 py-2 text-xs focus:border-primary focus:outline-none">
            <option value="all">All statuses</option>
            <option value="draft">Draft</option>
            <option value="scheduled">Scheduled</option>
            <option value="sending">Sending</option>
            <option value="sent">Sent</option>
            <option value="failed">Failed</option>
          </select>
          <button
            onClick={() => setShowCreateForm(true)}
            className="theme-btn-primary rounded-lg px-4 py-2 text-xs font-semibold flex items-center gap-2"
          >
            <Plus className="w-4 h-4" />
            New Campaign
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Create Campaign Form */}
      {showCreateForm && (
        <CreateCampaignForm
          onClose={() => setShowCreateForm(false)}
          onSuccess={() => {
            setShowCreateForm(false);
            loadCampaigns();
          }}
        />
      )}

      <div className="theme-card rounded-xl border p-3">
        <EnterpriseDataTable
          columns={campaignColumns}
          rows={filteredCampaigns}
          rowKey={(campaign) => campaign.id}
          densityMode={density}
          enableExport
          emptyState="No campaigns yet. Create your first email campaign."
          searchPlaceholder="Search by campaign, subject, audience, or status"
          expandedRowKey={expandedCampaignId ?? undefined}
          rowActions={(campaign) => {
            const isExpanded = expandedCampaignId === campaign.id;
            const canDelete = campaign.status !== "sent" && campaign.status !== "sending";
            return (
              <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-end gap-1.5">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => {
                    const nextExpanded = isExpanded ? null : campaign.id;
                    setExpandedCampaignId(nextExpanded);
                    if (nextExpanded != null && !analyticsByCampaignId[campaign.id]) {
                      void loadAnalytics(campaign.id);
                    }
                  }}
                  className="rounded-md border border-border bg-surface px-2 py-1 text-[11px] font-semibold text-text-muted transition-colors hover:border-primary/30 hover:text-primary"
                >
                  {isExpanded ? "Hide details" : "Details"}
                </button>
                {campaign.status === "draft" ? (
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => void sendCampaign(campaign)}
                    disabled={sendingCampaignId === campaign.id}
                    className="theme-btn-primary rounded-md px-2 py-1 text-[11px] font-semibold disabled:opacity-60"
                  >
                    {sendingCampaignId === campaign.id ? "Queueing..." : "Send"}
                  </button>
                ) : null}
                {canDelete ? (
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => void deleteCampaign(campaign)}
                    disabled={deletingCampaignId === campaign.id}
                    className="rounded-md bg-red-500/10 px-2 py-1 text-[11px] font-semibold text-red-600 hover:bg-red-500/20 disabled:opacity-50"
                  >
                    Delete
                  </button>
                ) : null}
              </div>
            );
          }}
          mobileCardRenderer={(campaign) => (
            <div className="space-y-2 text-xs">
              <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3">
                <div>
                  <p className="font-semibold text-text">{campaign.name}</p>
                  <p className="mt-1 text-text-faint">{campaign.subject}</p>
                </div>
                {getStatusIcon(campaign.status)}
              </div>
              <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                <span className={`inline-flex items-center rounded-full px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-semibold ${getStatusColor(campaign.status)}`}>{campaign.status}</span>
                <span className="text-text-muted">{campaign.target_audience}</span>
              </div>
              <p className="text-text-muted">{campaign.sent_count}/{campaign.recipient_count} sent</p>
            </div>
          )}
          expandedRowRenderer={(campaign) => {
            const analytics = analyticsByCampaignId[campaign.id] ?? null;
            const loadingAnalytics = analyticsLoadingId === campaign.id;
            return (
              <div className="p-4">
                <div className="mb-3 flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
                  <div>
                    <h4 className="text-sm font-bold text-text">Campaign Details</h4>
                    <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-text-muted">Delivery and engagement details for {campaign.name}.</p>
                  </div>
                  <button type="button" onClick={() => setExpandedCampaignId(null)} className="rounded-lg border border-border bg-surface px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-text-muted hover:text-text">
                    Close
                  </button>
                </div>
                <div className="grid gap-3 md:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-4">
                  <div className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface-1 p-3">
                    <p className="text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.18em] text-text-faint">Audience</p>
                    <p className="mt-1.5 text-xs font-medium text-text">{campaign.target_audience}</p>
                  </div>
                  <div className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface-1 p-3">
                    <p className="text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.18em] text-text-faint">Scheduled</p>
                    <p className="mt-1.5 text-xs font-medium text-text">{campaign.send_at ? new Date(campaign.send_at).toLocaleString() : "Not scheduled"}</p>
                  </div>
                  <div className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface-1 p-3">
                    <p className="text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.18em] text-text-faint">Sent</p>
                    <p className="mt-1.5 text-xs font-medium text-text">{campaign.sent_at ? new Date(campaign.sent_at).toLocaleString() : "Not sent yet"}</p>
                  </div>
                  <div className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface-1 p-3">
                    <p className="text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.18em] text-text-faint">Created</p>
                    <p className="mt-1.5 text-xs font-medium text-text">{new Date(campaign.created_at).toLocaleString()}</p>
                  </div>
                </div>
                <div className="mt-3 grid gap-3 md:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-4">
                  {loadingAnalytics ? (
                    <div className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface-1 p-4 text-xs text-text-muted md:col-span-2 xl:col-span-4">Loading analytics…</div>
                  ) : analytics ? (
                    <>
                      <div className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-info/10 p-4">
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-2"><Users className="h-4 w-4 text-info" /><span className="text-xs font-semibold text-info">Recipients</span></div>
                        <p className="mt-2 text-lg font-bold text-info">{analytics.total_recipients}</p>
                      </div>
                      <div className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-success/10 p-4">
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-2"><Eye className="h-4 w-4 text-success" /><span className="text-xs font-semibold text-success">Opens</span></div>
                        <p className="mt-2 text-lg font-bold text-success">{analytics.opened_count}</p>
                        <p className="text-[11px] text-success">{analytics.open_rate}% rate</p>
                      </div>
                      <div className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-primary/10 p-4">
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-2"><MousePointer className="h-4 w-4 text-primary" /><span className="text-xs font-semibold text-primary">Clicks</span></div>
                        <p className="mt-2 text-lg font-bold text-primary">{analytics.clicked_count}</p>
                        <p className="text-[11px] text-primary">{analytics.click_rate}% rate</p>
                      </div>
                      <div className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-danger/10 p-4">
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-2"><AlertCircle className="h-4 w-4 text-danger" /><span className="text-xs font-semibold text-danger">Bounces</span></div>
                        <p className="mt-2 text-lg font-bold text-danger">{analytics.bounced_count}</p>
                        <p className="text-[11px] text-danger">{analytics.bounce_rate}% rate</p>
                      </div>
                    </>
                  ) : (
                    <div className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface-1 p-4 text-xs text-text-muted md:col-span-2 xl:col-span-4">Analytics are not available for this campaign yet.</div>
                  )}
                </div>
              </div>
            );
          }}
        />
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```
